note: Shared work-level glossary for the Odyssey (Murray 1919). Keys are lowercased surface wordforms as printed (an elided form without its apostrophe). One general gloss per form, never pinned to a line; sentence notes carry context.

glossary.αἰγίσθοιο: Αἴγισθος — Aegisthus, seducer of Clytemnestra and killer of Agamemnon, later killed by Orestes; gen. sg.
glossary.αἰθίοπας: Αἰθίοψ — an Ethiopian, one of a people living at the world’s edge; masc. acc. pl.
glossary.αἰπὺν: αἰπύς — steep, sheer; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.αἰτιόωνται: αἰτιάομαι — blame, accuse; pres. 3 pl. mid., epic diectasis (= Attic αἰτιῶνται)
glossary.αἱμυλίοισι: αἱμύλιος — wheedling, cajoling; masc./neut. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
glossary.αἳ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., fem. nom. pl.
glossary.αἴγισθος: Αἴγισθος — Aegisthus, seducer of Clytemnestra and killer of Agamemnon, later killed by Orestes; nom. sg.
glossary.αἴης: αἶα — land, earth; gen. sg., epic by-form of γαῖα
glossary.αὐτοὶ: αὐτός — self; intensive pron., masc. nom. pl.: ’themselves’ · also intensive in agreement with an unexpressed ’we’: ’we ourselves’ (αὐτοὶ βῆμεν ’we ourselves stepped out’) · also in agreement with an unexpressed ’you’: ’you yourselves’ (αὐτοὶ δ’ ὀτρύνεσθε ’and you yourselves rouse yourselves’)
glossary.αὐτὰρ: αὐτάρ — but, and then; epic conj. (= Attic δέ, ἀλλά)
glossary.αὐτὸν: αὐτός — self; masc. acc. sg.: ’him(self)’ · also reinforcing σε: ’you yourself’ (σ’ αὐτὸν) · also acc. sg. reinforcing an unexpressed 1st-person pronoun: ’me myself’ (αὐτὸν δ’ ἐνθάδ’ ἔχουσα ’keeping me myself here’) · also plain acc. sg. pronoun, unemphatic ’him’, after a preposition: ἀμφ’ αὐτὸν ’around him’ · also plain acc. sg. pronoun of a thing, unemphatic ’it’ (masc. χιτών), as direct object of a verb: ἐθηήσαντο αὐτὸν ’gazed at it’ · also plain acc. sg. pronoun, unemphatic ’him’, direct object of a verb: θεὸς αὐτὸν ἐνείκαι ’a god might bring him’
glossary.αὐτὸς: αὐτός — self; masc. nom. sg.: ’himself’ · also masc. nom. sg. with a 1st-person subject: ’myself’ (ἐγὼν αὐτός) · also masc. nom. sg. with a 2nd-person subject: ’yourself’ (εἰδήσεις δὲ καὶ αὐτός ’you will see for yourself’) · also masc. nom. sg., of a thing: ’it itself’ (αὐτὸς … σίδηρος ’iron of itself’)
glossary.αὐτῶν: αὐτός — self; gen. pl.: ’their own’ (reinforcing a possessive) · also plain neut. gen. pl. personal pronoun, not reinforcing a possessive: ’them’ (λήσομαι αὐτῶν ’I will forget them’, of things said) · also intensive with a noun: ’of the heroes themselves’ (αὐτῶν ἡρώων) · also with the article, ’the same’: τοκήων τῶν αὐτῶν ’the very same parents’ · also masc./neut. gen. pl. personal pronoun, ’their’ (αὐτῶν τε φθογγήν ’their voice’, of the creatures on the far shore) · also gen. pl. ’our own’, possessive of the speaker’s group, with no other possessive (αὐτῶν … ἀφραδίῃσιν ’through our own follies’) · also masc. gen. pl., partitive: ’of them’ (οὐδέ τις αὐτῶν ’not one of them’) · also masc. gen. pl. personal pronoun after a preposition: ’them’ (δι’ αὐτῶν ’through the midst of them’) · also masc. gen. pl., ’their own’ with no possessive expressed (αὐτῶν κτήματα ’their own possessions’) · also masc. gen. pl. personal pronoun, depending on the adverb σχεδόθεν: ’near them’
glossary.βουλήν: βουλή — plan, counsel, decision; acc. sg. · also council, assembly: ’council-meeting’ (ἐς βουλήν ’to the council’)
glossary.βοῦς: βοῦς — ox, cow; pl. ’cattle’; acc. pl. · also masc./fem. nom. sg. (same spelling as the acc. pl.): ’the ox, the heifer’ (ἦλθε ... βοῦς ’the heifer came’)
glossary.γ: γε — at least, in fact, indeed; limiting/emphatic particle (elided γ’)
glossary.γαίης: γαῖα — earth, land; gen. sg. (Ionic η for α)
glossary.γαιήοχος: γαιήοχος — epithet of Poseidon: ’earth-holder’ (or ’earth-carrier’; the derivation is disputed); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.γε: γε — at least, in fact, indeed; limiting/emphatic particle
glossary.γλαυκῶπις: γλαυκῶπις — epithet of Athena: ’gleaming-eyed’ (or ’owl-eyed’; sense uncertain); fem. nom. sg.
glossary.γλαφυροῖσι: γλαφυρός — hollow; neut. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
glossary.γῆμ: γαμέω — marry; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented, elided (γῆμ’ = ἔγημε)
glossary.δή: δή — indeed, now, in fact; emphatic particle
glossary.δαΐφρονι: δαΐφρων — wise-minded, or perhaps ’warlike’; sense disputed (from δαῆναι ’learn’ or δάϊς ’battle’); masc. dat. sg.
glossary.δαίεται: δαίω — divide, rend · or the distinct verb δαίω — kindle, burn; pres. 3 sg. mid./pass.: of the heart, ’is torn’ or ’burns’
glossary.δεδαίαται: δαίω — divide; perf. 3 pl. mp., epic -αται (= Attic -νται): ’are divided’
glossary.δενδρήεσσα: δενδρήεις — wooded, full of trees; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.δηθὰ: δηθά — for a long time, long; adv.
glossary.διάκτορον: διάκτορος — epithet of Hermes, meaning unknown, traditionally ’guide, messenger’; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.διός: Ζεύς — Zeus, king of the gods; gen. sg. (stem Δι-)
glossary.δυσμόρῳ: δύσμορος — ill-fated, unlucky; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.δυσομένου: δύω/δύνω — sink, set (of the sun); pres. part. gen. sg.: ’setting’
glossary.δόμονδε: δόμος — house; acc. sg. + suffix -δε ’to, towards’: ’homeward’
glossary.δύστηνον: δύστηνος — wretched, unhappy; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.δώματα: δῶμα — house, dwelling; neut. acc. pl. (plural for a single dwelling): ’house, home’
glossary.δὴ: δή — indeed, now, in fact; emphatic particle
glossary.δῖα: δῖος — heavenly, divine, illustrious; fem. nom. sg., epithet of goddesses and heroes
glossary.εἰ: εἰ — if; conditional conj. · also introducing an indirect question after a verb of asking or telling: ’whether’ (εἰ δή ’whether indeed’) · also in εἰ δ’ ἄγε, an interjectional idiom with the imperative: ’come now, well then’ · also with opt., in a wish: ’if only’ (εἰ … ὁμοφρονέοις … γένοιο) · also ὡς εἰ + opt., ’as if’ (ὡς εἰ … ἱκοίατο ’as if they had come’) · also ὡς εἰ, ’as if’, before a noun with no verb of its own (ὡς εἰ κέρα … ἠὲ σίδηρος ’as if horn or iron’)
glossary.εἰδὼς: οἶδα — know; perf. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’knowing’
glossary.εἰλίποδας: εἰλίπους — rolling-gaited, swaying-footed (of cattle); masc./fem. acc. pl.
glossary.εἰπὲ: εἶπον — say, tell; aor. imper. 2 sg.
glossary.εἰς: εἰς — into, to; prep. + acc. · also εἰμί ’be’: pres. 2 sg., epic (= Attic εἶ): ’you are’ (τίς … εἰς; ’who are you?’) · also in the idiom εἰς ὅ (κε) ’until’: εἰς ὅ κεν … μιγήῃς ’until you mingle with’ · also in the idiom εἰς ὅτε (κε) + subj., ’until the time when’ (εἰς ὅτε κέν … καθέλῃσι ’until … brings down’)
glossary.εἴπομεν: εἶπον — say, tell; aor. 1 pl.: ’we told’
glossary.εἴπῃ: εἶπον — say, tell; aor. subj. 3 sg.: ’he may tell’
glossary.εὐρείῃ: εὐρύς — broad, wide; fem. dat. sg., epic -είῃ (= Attic -είᾳ)
glossary.εὐρὺν: εὐρύς — broad, wide; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ζεύς: Ζεύς — Zeus, king of the gods; nom. sg.
glossary.ζηνὸς: Ζεύς — Zeus; gen. sg., alternate stem Ζην- (beside Δι-)
glossary.θέλγει: θέλγω — enchant, bewitch, beguile; pres. 3 sg.
glossary.θανέειν: θνῄσκω — die; aor. inf., epic uncontracted (= Attic θανεῖν)
glossary.θεά: θεά — goddess; nom. sg. · also voc. sg. (same form): ’goddess!’
glossary.θεάων: θεά — goddess; gen. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic θεῶν)
glossary.θείοιο: θεῖος — divine, godlike; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.θείω: τίθημι — put, place; aor. subj. 1 sg. (Attic θῶ)
glossary.θεοὶ: θεός — god; nom. pl. · also voc. pl. (same form): ’you gods!’
glossary.θεοῖσιν: θεός — god; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι(ν) (= Attic -οις)
glossary.θυγάτηρ: θυγάτηρ — daughter; nom. sg. · also the nominative form used as a vocative: ’daughter!’ (the true vocative is θύγατερ)
glossary.θυμόν: θυμός — heart, spirit, soul; acc. sg. · also the life that leaves the body: ’life’ (μελέων ἐξείλετο θυμόν ’took the life out of the limbs’) · also the seat of appetite: ’appetite’ (πλησαίατο θυμόν ’might satisfy their appetite’)
glossary.θυμὸν: θυμός — heart, spirit, soul; acc. sg. · also the life that leaves the body: ’life’ (μελιηδέα θυμὸν ἀπηύρα ’took away (my) honey-sweet life’)
glossary.θόωσα: Θόωσα — Thoösa, a sea-nymph, daughter of Phorcys and mother of Polyphemus by Poseidon; nom. sg.
glossary.κάκ: κακός — bad, evil; neut. acc. pl. (elided κάκ’): ’evils, misfortunes’ · also neut. nom. pl., elided (κάκ’ = κακά), agreeing with ἀράχνια: ’foul (cobwebs)’
glossary.κάρη: κάρη — head; neut. acc. sg., acc. of respect: ’as to the head’ · also plain acc. sg., direct object of a verb: κινήσας κάρη ’shaking his head’ · also acc. sg. governed by ἀμφί: ’about the head’ (ἀμφὶ κάρη)
glossary.καλέσαντα: καλέω — call, summon; aor. part. masc. acc. sg.: ’having called’
glossary.καλυψὼ: Καλυψώ — Calypso, the nymph who keeps Odysseus on her island, her name built on καλύπτω ’hide, conceal’; nom. sg.
glossary.κατακτείνει: κατακτείνω — kill outright, slay; pres. 3 sg.
glossary.κατερύκει: κατερύκω — hold back, detain; pres. 3 sg.
glossary.κατὰ: κατά — down, throughout, in; prep. + acc.; also as preverb in tmesis (κατὰ … ἤσθιον = κατήσθιον ’devoured’) · also ’according to, in conformity with’ (κατὰ μοῖραν ’according to what is fitting’) · also + acc., ’in quest of, after’ (κατὰ ληίδα ’in quest of plunder’) · also + gen., ’down from’ (κατὰ πετράων ’down from the rocks’) · also + gen., ’all over, throughout’ (κατὰ σπείους κέχυτο ’lay spread all over the cave’) · also + acc., of the part grasped: ’by’ (κατὰ νῶτα λαβών ’taking him by the back’) · also + acc., ’on account of, on the business of’ (κατὰ χρέος ’on business’) · also + gen., ’down in, within’ (κατὰ σπείους κοίλοιο δέδυκεν ’is sunk in the hollow cave’) · also + acc., of the place struck: ’in, on’ (κατὰ δεξιὸν ὦμον ’on the right shoulder’)
glossary.κε: κε(ν) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν) · also + subj. after εἰς ὅ, ’until’ (εἰς ὅ κε … ἐποτρύνῃ ’until … urges on’) · also + subj. in a general relative: ’whoever’ (ὅς κε πίῃ) · also + subj. in a temporal clause: ’whenever, as soon as’ (ὅτε … κε θάνῃσιν; ἐπεί κε … λίπῃ) · also + subj. in a purpose clause after ὄφρα: ’so that’ (ὄφρα κε … ἀκούσῃς) · also + subj. in the protasis after εἰ: ’if ever’ (εἰ δέ κε λίσσηαι ’but if you beg’) · also + aor. indic., unreal past: ’would have’ (καὶ νύ κε … βάλεν ’and she would have hurled’) · also + subj. in a disjunctive statement of what may happen: ’may’ (ἤ κε θάνωμεν ’either we may die’) · also + opt., potential: ’would’ (καί κε … μαχοίμην ’I would fight’) · also + subj. in a relative clause of purpose: ’who are to’ (οἵ κε … ἀγγείλωσι ’who are to announce’) · also + fut. indic. (or short-vowel subj.) in a main clause: ’will’ (αἶψά κε … ἀποτίσεται ’at once he will exact payment’) · also + aor. in a general relative clause: ’who would (decide)’ (οἵ κε … ἔκριναν) · also + opt. in a relative clause: ’whoever might’ (ὅς κε … πόροι ’whoever might offer’) · also + subj. in the protasis after αἴ: ’if perhaps’ (αἴ κε … ἐντανύσῃς)
glossary.κεχρημένον: χράομαι — use; perf. part. (+ gen.) ’in need of, lacking’; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.κεχόλωται: χολόομαι — be angry, be enraged; perf. 3 sg. (state): ’is angry’
glossary.κεῖνός: κεῖνος — that, that one; demonstrative pron., epic (= Attic ἐκεῖνος); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.κεῖται: κεῖμαι — lie; pres. 3 sg., used of the dead: ’lies (dead)’ · also in the idiom θεῶν ἐν γούνασι κεῖται: ’rests with the gods, lies in the gods’ hands’ (of an outcome, not of the dead) · also subj. (= κέηται): ’should lie’ · also plain pres. 3 sg. of stored objects: ’lies, is kept/stored’ (κειμήλια κεῖται ’treasures lie stored’) · also pres. 3 sg. of a living person in a settled, ongoing state, not of the dead nor of an outcome nor of stored goods (ὁ μὲν ἐν νήσῳ κεῖται ’πάσχων’): ’remains, is stranded, dwells on’ · also of a place, ’lies, is situated’ (νῆσος ... κεῖται ’an island lies’) · also of an object: ’lies’ (ἀράχνια κεῖται ἔχουσα ’lies holding cobwebs’) · also of the spirit or heart, ’lies sunk (in)’: κεῖται ἐν ἄλγεσι θυμός ’the spirit lies in pains’
glossary.κλέος: κλέος — fame, renown, report; neut. nom. sg. · also neut. acc. sg. (same form), direct object: μέγα κλέος ἤρατο ’won great fame’; κλέος φέρειν ’bring report’
glossary.κομόωντας: κομάω — wear one’s hair long; pres. part. masc. acc. pl., epic diectasis (= Attic κομῶντας)
glossary.κράτος: κράτος — strength, power, might; neut. nom. sg.
glossary.κρειόντων: κρείων — ruling, lord; masc. gen. pl., partitive: ’among those who rule’
glossary.κρονίδη: Κρονίδης — son of Cronus, patronymic/epithet of Zeus; voc. sg.
glossary.κυκλώπεσσι: Κύκλωψ — a Cyclops, one of a race of one-eyed giants; masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσι
glossary.κύκλωπος: Κύκλωψ — a Cyclops, one of a race of one-eyed giants; Polyphemus, son of Poseidon, is the one Odysseus blinded; gen. sg.
glossary.λίην: λίαν — very much, exceedingly; adv., Ionic λίην (= Attic λίαν)
glossary.λαθοίμην: λανθάνω — mid. λανθάνομαι forget (+ gen.); aor. opt. 1 sg.: ’I could forget’
glossary.λιλαιομένη: λιλαίομαι — long for, yearn (+ inf.); pres. part. fem. nom. sg.
glossary.λόγοισιν: λόγος — word, speech, story (rare in Homer, whose usual words are μῦθος, ἔπος); masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι(ν)
glossary.μάλα: μάλα — very, very much, exceedingly; adv.
glossary.μέγιστον: μέγας — great; superl. neut. nom. sg.: ’greatest’
glossary.μέδοντος: μέδω — rule, be lord of (+ gen.); pres. part. masc. gen. sg.: ’ruling, lord of’
glossary.μένος: μένος — force, might, spirit, drive; neut. acc. sg. · also neut. nom. sg., subject (μένος … ἐνέστακται ’his force has been instilled’) · also neut. nom. sg. in the periphrasis ἱερὸν μένος Ἀλκινόοιο: ’the sacred strength of Alcinous’, a periphrasis for Alcinous himself
glossary.μήτε: μήτε — nor, and not; correlative negative conj.
glossary.μακάρεσσι: μάκαρ — blessed, happy (epithet of the gods); masc./fem. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic -σι)
glossary.μακράς: μακρός — long, tall; fem. acc. pl.
glossary.μαλακοῖσι: μαλακός — soft, gentle; masc./neut. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
glossary.μεγάροισιν: μέγαρον — hall, great room, house; neut. dat. pl., epic -οισι(ν), plural for a single house
glossary.μεθήσει: μεθίημι — let go, relax, release; fut. 3 sg.
glossary.μενέαινεν: μενεαίνω — rage, be furious (built on μένος); impf. 3 sg., unaugmented
glossary.μετεκίαθε: μετακιάθω — go to, visit, go after; aor. 3 sg. (can carry pluperfect force: ’had gone to visit’)
glossary.μετηύδα: μεταυδάω — speak among, address (+ dat.); impf. 3 sg.
glossary.μετὰ: μετά — among, with, after; prep. + dat./acc./gen. · with acc. also ’in quest of, in search of’ (μετὰ χαλκόν ’after bronze’) · also a plain adverb, no case governed: ’besides, in addition’ · also adverb, ’among them, in their midst’: μετὰ δὲ πρέπει ἀγρομένοισιν ’and he stands out among the gathered’ · also as preverb in tmesis (μετὰ … βεβήκει = μεταβεβήκει ’had moved on, passed on’) · also a plain adverb, ’afterwards’ (μετὰ γάρ τε καὶ ἄλγεσι τέρπεται ἀνήρ ’for afterwards a man takes pleasure even in pains’; some take it as ’among’ with ἄλγεσι) · also + dat. of the mind, ’in’ (μετὰ φρεσὶ σῇσι ’in your mind’)
glossary.μιγεῖσα: μίγνυμι — mix, mingle; mid./pass. ’unite with’ (+ dat.), the standard expression for sexual union; aor. pass. part. fem. nom. sg.
glossary.μιν: μιν — him, her, it; epic encl. acc. pron. (= Attic αὐτόν/αὐτήν/αὐτό)
glossary.μνάασθαι: μνάομαι — woo, court; pres. inf., epic diectasis (= Attic μνᾶσθαι)
glossary.μνήσατο: μιμνήσκομαι — remember, call to mind (+ gen.); aor. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented
glossary.μνηστήν: μνηστή — wooed and lawfully wedded; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.μνηστήρεσσιν: μνηστήρ — suitor; masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσι(ν)
glossary.μοι: ἐγώ — I; encl. dat. sg.: ’to me, for me’ · also dat. of the person affected, ’from my …’ (μοι βλεφάρων ἐξέσσυτο ὕπνος ’sleep rushed out from my eyelids’) · also dat. of possession with εἰμί: ’who are mine’ (οἵ μοι ἔασιν ’who are mine’)
glossary.μοῦσα: Μοῦσα — Muse, goddess of poetic inspiration; voc. sg.
glossary.μόρον: μόρος — portion, fate, allotted share; acc. sg.
glossary.μύθων: μῦθος — speech, word, thing said (not yet ’myth’ in Homer); gen. pl.
glossary.μὲν: μέν — on the one hand; particle, often answered by δέ · also asseverative, = μήν ’truly, indeed’: οὐ μὲν δή ’surely not’
glossary.μᾶλλον: μάλα — very, much; comparative adv. μᾶλλον: ’more, rather, the more’
glossary.μῆλ: μῆλον — sheep or goat, flock-animal; neut. acc. pl. (elided μῆλ’)
glossary.νέεσθαι: νέομαι — go, return home; pres. inf., epic uncontracted (= Attic νεῖσθαι)
glossary.νέηται: νέομαι — go, return home; pres. subj. 3 sg.
glossary.νήπιοι: νήπιος — childish, foolish, witless; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.νεφεληγερέτα: νεφεληγερέτα — epithet of Zeus: ’cloud-gatherer’ (νεφέλη ’cloud’ + ἀγείρω ’gather’); masc. nom. sg., old -α form
glossary.νημερτέα: νημερτής — unerring, infallible; fem. acc. sg., epic uncontracted · also neut. acc. pl., uncontracted, used as a noun: ’unerring things, the truth’ · also neut. acc. pl. as adv./predicative: ’unerringly, truly’ (νημερτέα πάντ’ ἐνέποντα ’telling all things unerringly’)
glossary.νηυσὶ: ναῦς — ship; dat. pl., epic νηυσί (= Attic ναυσί)
glossary.νοστήσαντα: νοστέω — return home; aor. part. masc. acc. sg.: ’having returned’
glossary.νοῆσαι: νοέω — perceive, notice, take note of; aor. inf.: ’to glimpse, to notice’ · also ’think out, think of’ (πεπνυμένα πάντα νοῆσαι ’to think of all prudent things’)
glossary.νυ: νυ — now, then; weak encl. particle
glossary.νόστιμον: νόστιμος — of homecoming, of return; neut. acc. sg., in νόστιμον ἦμαρ ’day of return’
glossary.νόσφι: νόσφι — apart from, except (+ gen.); adv./prep.
glossary.νύ: νυ — now, then; weak encl. particle
glossary.νύμφη: νύμφη — nymph, young bride; nom. sg.
glossary.νύμφῃ: νύμφη — nymph, young bride; dat. sg.
glossary.οἱ: οἱ — encl. dat. sg. pron. ’to/for him’ (very common) · also ὁ, ἡ, τό ’he, she, it’, masc. nom. pl. ’they’ (e.g. οἱ μὲν … οἱ δέ ’some … others’) · also encl. dat. sg. fem. ’to/for her’ (ἥ οἱ ὁμηλικίη ’who was of an age with her’) · also article-like with a numeral and noun, masc. nom. pl.: ’the’ (οἱ δὲ δύω σκόπελοι ’the two crags’) · also encl. dat. sg. of a thing, ’to/for it’ (δύω δέ τέ οἱ θύραι ’and it has two doors’) · also article-like with a noun, masc. nom. pl.: ’those, the’ (οἱ πέπλοι ’the robes’) · also dat. sg. of the giver with δέχομαι: ’from him’ (οἱ ἐδέξατο ’took from him’)
glossary.οἳ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., masc. nom. pl.
glossary.οἴκοι: οἴκοι — at home; adv. (locative of οἶκος)
glossary.οἵ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., masc. nom. pl. · also encl. dat. sg. pron. ’to/for him’ (= οἱ, accented οἵ in this position) · also ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; masc. nom. pl. ’they’, demonstrative: οἵ γ’ ὑβρισταί ’are they violent?’
glossary.οἵδε: ὅδε — this, this here; demonstrative pron., masc. nom. pl.: ’these here’
glossary.οἶδεν: οἶδα — know; perf. 3 sg. (with pres. sense): ’knows’
glossary.οἶκόνδε: οἶκος — house, home; acc. sg. + suffix -δε ’towards’: ’homeward’
glossary.οἶον: οἶος — alone, only; masc. acc. sg. · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with the subject: ’standing alone’ (ὅ τε φαίνεται οἶον ’which appears alone’) · also neut. acc. sg., agreeing with a neut. noun: ’alone, by itself’ (σάκος οἶον ’a shield alone’)
glossary.οἶος: οἶος — alone, only; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.οἷον: οἷος — such as, of what sort; neut. as exclamatory adv.: ’how!, what a thing!’ (rough breathing; distinct from οἶος ’alone’) · also causal conj. after a verb of emotion, ’in that, that’ · also correlative ’such as, as’ (οἷον ὅτε πρώτιστον ’such as when first’) · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with τὸν Τηλεφίδην: ’what a man, such a one as’ (ἀλλ’ οἷον … κατενήρατο ’but what a man he slew’) · also neut. acc. sg. agreeing with ἦμαρ: ’of such a kind as’ (οἷον ἐπ’ ἦμαρ ἄγησι ’such as the day he brings’) · also neut. nom./acc. sg., agreeing with μένος: ’what sort of (strength)’
glossary.οἷσι: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν — his own, her own; possessive adj. (distinct from the relative ὅς); masc. dat. pl.: ’his own’ · also the relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ (not the possessive): ’in whom’ (ἑταίρους ... οἷσι μάλιστα πεποίθεα)
glossary.οὐδ: οὐδέ (elided οὐδ’) — and not, nor, not even
glossary.οὐδέ: οὐδέ — and not, nor, not even; neg. conj.
glossary.οὔ: οὐ — not; neg. adv., in a question expecting the answer ’yes’ · also the plain negative adverb in a declarative statement, with no question implied: ’not’
glossary.πάθεν: πάσχω — suffer, experience; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔπαθεν)
glossary.πάντ: πᾶς — all, every; neut. acc. pl. (elided πάντ’): ’everything’ · also masc. acc. sg., elided, agreeing with μῆνα: ’the whole (month)’
glossary.πάντες: πᾶς — all, every; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.πάρος: πάρος — before, formerly; adv., with inf. like Attic πρίν · also a plain temporal adverb with a finite verb, not paired with an infinitive: ’formerly, in the past’ (αἳ πάρος ἦσαν ’who formerly were’) · also ’before (that)’ with a finite verb, in the past: πάρος δ’ εἰς Ἴλιον ᾤχετο ’before that he went to Ilios’ · also with a participle: ’formerly, before’ (πάρος περ ἐὼν ’though formerly being’)
glossary.πάσης: πᾶς — all, whole; fem. gen. sg.
glossary.πάτερ: πατήρ — father; voc. sg. · also πατέρα, masc. acc. sg., elided (πάτερ’ = πατέρα): ’father’ (μητρὸς … πάτερ’ ’mother’s father’)
glossary.πέμψαντες: πέμπω — send; aor. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’having sent’
glossary.πήματα: πῆμα — suffering, woe, calamity; neut. acc. pl.
glossary.παρήμενος: πάρημαι — sit beside, sit near (+ dat.); pres. part. masc. nom. sg.
glossary.παρὰ: παρά — beside, along, from; prep. + dat./acc./gen. · also used as an adverb with no case expressed: ’beside, alongside’ (παρὰ … ἐτάνυσσε τράπεζαν ’drew a table up beside (them)’) · also + acc., ’beside, contrary to’ (παρὰ μοῖραν ’beside what is fitting’)
glossary.πατρίδος: πατρίς — fatherland, native land; gen. sg.
glossary.περ: περ — even, though; concessive particle, esp. with a participle (= Attic καίπερ) · also used to intensify an adverb or pronoun rather than concede a point: ἔνθα περ ’in the very place where, just where’ · also after εἰ, ’if indeed, even if’: εἴ περ γάρ κεν ’if indeed ever’
glossary.περιπλομένων: περιπέλομαι — revolve, come round; aor. part. gen. pl.: ’as they revolve, rolling round’ (of the years)
glossary.περιφραζώμεθα: περιφράζομαι — consider from every side, devise; pres. subj. 1 pl., hortatory: ’let us devise’
glossary.περὶ: περί — around, about; prep. + gen.: ’superior to, beyond’; also as adv.: ’exceedingly, surpassingly’ · also prep. + gen. in its plain sense ’about, concerning’ (περὶ πατρός ’about his father’) · also preverb in tmesis · + dat. · also + acc., of place, ’around, about’ (περὶ ἄστυ ’around the city’) · also + gen., of place, physically ’around, encircling’ (περὶ σπείους γλαφυροῖο ’around the hollow cave’), distinct from the comparative ’beyond’ sense above · also + dat. in the fixed idiom περὶ κῆρι ’exceedingly, at heart’ (περὶ κῆρι τιμήσουσιν ’will honor him at heart’) · also + dat., of place, ’around, about’ (περὶ χροῒ ’about the skin’) · also adverb of place, no case: ’round about’ (περὶ δ’ ἕρκος ἐλήλαται ’and round it a fence is driven’) · also + dat., of the thing fought over: ’over, for’ (περὶ κτεάτεσσι μαχειόμενος ’fighting over possessions’)
glossary.πευσόμενον: πυνθάνομαι — inquire, learn by asking; fut. part. masc. acc. sg., expressing purpose: ’to inquire’
glossary.πεφευγότες: φεύγω — flee, escape; perf. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’having escaped (and remaining safe)’
glossary.πεφυγμένος: φεύγω — flee, escape; perf. part. mid. masc. nom. sg.: ’escaped, clear of’
glossary.πεῖθ: πείθω — persuade; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented, elided (πεῖθ’ = πεῖθε)
glossary.πλάγχθη: πλάζω — drive off course, make wander; aor. pass. 3 sg., unaugmented: ’was driven astray’
glossary.πλάζει: πλάζω — drive off course, make wander; pres. 3 sg. act.
glossary.πολλὰ: πολύς — much, many; neut. acc. pl.: ’many things, greatly’ · also neut. nom. pl., plain attributive adj. agreeing with a neut. pl. noun (πολλὰ ... δάκρυα ’many tears’) · also neut. acc. pl., plain attributive adj. (κτήματα πολλὰ ’many possessions’) · also neut. acc. pl. used adverbially: ’again and again’ (πολλὰ περιτροπέοντες) · also neut. nom. pl. as substantive, subject: οἷά τε πολλὰ γίγνεται ’as many things happen’
glossary.πολύτροπον: πολύτροπος — of many turns, much-turning (much-travelled, or versatile and wily; both senses debated); masc. acc. sg.
glossary.πολύφημον: Πολύφημος — Polyphemus, the Cyclops blinded by Odysseus, son of Poseidon; acc. sg.
glossary.πολύφρονα: πολύφρων — of many counsels, much-minded; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ποσειδάων: Ποσειδῶν — Poseidon, god of the sea, enemy of Odysseus after the blinding of his son Polyphemus; nom. sg., epic uncontracted · also elided acc. sg., Ποσειδάων’ = Ποσειδάωνα: ’Poseidon’ as object
glossary.ποσειδάωνι: Ποσειδῶν — Poseidon; dat. sg., epic uncontracted
glossary.ποσειδάωνος: Ποσειδῶν — Poseidon; gen. sg., epic uncontracted (Attic Ποσειδῶνος)
glossary.ποῖόν: ποῖος — what sort of, what kind of; neut. acc. sg., reproachful: ’what a...’ · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with ἔπος: ’what a (word)’
glossary.προσέφη: πρόσφημι — speak to, address; aor. 3 sg.
glossary.πρό: πρό — before, beforehand; adv./prep.; also a preverb in tmesis (πρό … εἴπομεν = προείπομεν ’we told beforehand’)
glossary.πτολίεθρον: πτολίεθρον — citadel, city; neut. acc. sg., epic lengthened by-form of πόλις
glossary.πόντῳ: πόντος — sea, open sea; dat. sg.
glossary.πόποι: πόποι — (in ὢ πόποι) exclamation of surprise or displeasure: ’ah! well!’; origin unknown
glossary.πόσιν: πόσις — husband; acc. sg. · also the distinct noun πόσις ’a drinking, drink’ (from πίνω); acc. sg.: ’drink’ (paired with βρῶσις ’eating’)
glossary.πότνι: πότνια — lady, mistress; title of respect for goddesses; fem. nom. sg. (elided πότνι’)
glossary.πύλον: Πύλος — Pylos, city in the Peloponnese, home of Nestor; acc. sg.
glossary.πᾶσι: πᾶς — all, every; masc./neut. dat. pl.
glossary.πᾶσιν: πᾶς — all, every; masc./neut. dat. pl. (ν-movable)
glossary.σπάρτην: Σπάρτη — Sparta, city in the Peloponnese, home of Menelaus; acc. sg.
glossary.σπέσσι: σπέος — cave; neut. dat. pl. (plural for a single cave), epic -εσσι
glossary.σφάζουσι: σφάζω — slaughter, slay (esp. for sacrifice); pres. 3 pl.
glossary.σφετέρῃσιν: σφέτερος — their own; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι(ν) (= Attic -αις)
glossary.σφῇσιν: σφός — their own; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι(ν) (= Attic -αις)
glossary.τ: τε (elided τ’) — and; ’epic τε’ also marks a standing fact · after οὔ νυ perhaps τοι ’to you’ · also in a question, an expressive epic τε with no connective force, giving a note of doubt or wonder (πῶς τε ...; ’how, pray...?’) · also in ἦ τ’ (= ἦ τε), a strengthened affirmation: ’truly, surely’ (ἦ τ’ ἂν πολὺ κέρδιον ἦεν ’it would surely have been far better’) · also after a relative of size or amount, with no connective force: ὅσην τ’ ὄρεος κορυφήν ’as large as a mountain’s peak’ · also after ἤ ’than’, with no connective force: ἤ τ’ οἰωνοί ’than birds’ · also after ὅ ‘that’, with no connective force: ὅ τ’ οὐκέτι νόστιμός ἐστιν ‘that he is no longer returning’
glossary.τάχιστα: ταχύς — quick, swift; superl. neut. acc. pl. as adv. τάχιστα: ’most quickly’
glossary.τέ: τε — and; enclitic connective, also marks a standing fact (epic τε) · also in the idiom ὅ τε (= ὅτι) ’in that, because’, giving a reason: ὅ τέ με … ἀποβῆναι ἀνώγει ’in that he bids me step off’ · also in ἦ τέ, a strengthened affirmation: ’truly’ (ἦ τέ μ’ ἔφαντο ’who truly said’)
glossary.τέκε: τίκτω — bear, beget; aor. 3 sg., no augment (= ἔτεκε)
glossary.τέκνον: τέκνον — child; neut. voc. sg. (= nom./acc. in form)
glossary.τί: τίς, τί — who? what?; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially ’why’ · also the enclitic indefinite τις, τι ’someone, something’ (accented τί before an enclitic): neut. acc. sg. used adverbially with a negative, ’at all’ (οὔ τι) · adj. · also plain interrogative, direct object/predicate: ’what’ (τί πάθω ’what am I to suffer’; τί ... γένηται ’what is to become’) · also the enclitic indefinite as an adjective agreeing with a noun, accented before enclitic που: εἴ τί που εἴλυμα ’if any wrapper’ · also enclitic indefinite with a negative, ’anything’, as accusative subject of an infinitive (οὐ … τί φημι κακώτερον ἄλλο … συγχεῦαι ’I say nothing else is worse’) · also enclitic indefinite, adverbial without a negative: ’somehow, in some way’ (τοῦτό τί μοι κάλλιστον ’this seems to me somehow the fairest’) · also enclitic indefinite as an adjective after μή, accented before an enclitic: ’any’ (μή τί τοι … πῆμα ’any harm to you’) · also enclitic indefinite adjective after ὅπως, accented before enclitic μοι: ’any’ (τί … ἄλγος ’any pain’) · also enclitic indefinite adjective after ἤ, accented before the enclitic μοι: ’any’ (ἤ τί μοι … κειμήλιον ’or any treasure of mine’)
glossary.τίσις: τίσις — payment, vengeance, requital; nom. sg.
glossary.ταλασίφρονος: ταλασίφρων — enduring-minded, steadfast; gen. sg. (epithet of Odysseus, from τλῆναι ’endure’)
glossary.τε: τε — and, both...and; enclitic connective; also ’epic τε’ marking a standing general truth in relative clauses
glossary.τηλόθ: τηλόθι (elided τηλόθ’) — far off, at a distance; adverb of place, epic (-θι suffix ’place where’)
glossary.τι: τις, τι — someone, something; neut. acc. sg., used adverbially with negatives ’at all’ · also adjectival indefinite: ’some, any’ (τι δήμιον ἄλλο ’some other public matter’) · also adverbial without a negative: ’in some way, in some measure’ (τι κατὰ πρῆξιν ’on some business’) · also as a substantive object, in a question: ’anything, something’ (ἦ ῥά τι ἴδμεν ’do we know anything’) · also the neut. of τις forming, with a preceding ὅ, the indefinite relative ὅ τι ’whatever, that which’ (αὔδα ὅ τι φρονέεις ’say whatever you have in mind’) · also ὅ τι as an adverbial acc. in an indirect question: ’why’ · also as a substantive object in a statement: ’something’ (καί τι ἴσασι ’they know something’)
glossary.τοιαῦτά: τοιοῦτος — such, of this kind; neut. acc. pl. ’such things’
glossary.τοὶ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. nom. pl.: ’they’; also relative: ’who’ · also τοι, the affirming particle (ἀλλ’ ἦ τοι ’but truly’), as the grave-accented form τοὶ
glossary.τοῖσι: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. dat. pl. ’to/among them’
glossary.τοῖσιν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. dat. pl. ’from/to them’ · also relative, masc./neut. dat. pl. ’on which’ (κώεα, τοῖσιν ἐνεῦδεν ’the fleeces on which he had slept’)
glossary.τοῦ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. gen. sg. ’of him, that one’ · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ: whose, of whom; masc. gen. sg. (τοῦ νῶι θεοῦ ὣς τερπόμεθ’ αὐδῇ ’whose voice we delight in’) · also demonstrative gen. of comparison after a comparative: τοῦ γε κρεῖσσον ’better than this’ · also neut. gen. sg. in ἐκ τοῦ: ’from that time’ · also neut. gen. sg., partitive, ’of it’ (τοῦ μὲν ὅσον τ’ ὄργυιαν ’of it, about a fathom’) · also article-like with a noun: ’that, the’ (τοῦ παιδὸς ’that son’) · also article-like gen. sg. with a noun and a participle (gen. absolute), distributive: ’of the one … of the other’ (τοῦ μὲν φθίνοντος μηνός, τοῦ δ’ ἱσταμένοιο ’as one month wanes and the other begins’)
glossary.τοῦτο: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο — this; neut. nom./acc. sg.
glossary.τροίης: Τροία — Troy; gen. sg. (Ionic -ης for Attic -ας)
glossary.τόν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. sg.: ’him’; also relative: ’whom’ · also demonstrative with a noun, ’that’, antecedent of a relative: ἄνδρα τόν, ὅς κε … ’that man who …’ · also masc. acc. sg. ’it’, of a thing (τόν ῥ’ ἐπὶ πήχει ἑλών ’taking it on the bow-grip’, of the arrow)
glossary.τόσον: τόσος — so much, so great; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially
glossary.τὴν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); fem. acc. sg. ’her’ · also ’it’, of a thing (τὴν = the clothing): fem. acc. sg. · also with a noun, article-like: τὴν ὁδόν ’that journey’ · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ: whom; fem. acc. sg. (τὴν Ὠκεανὸς τέκε ’whom Oceanus begot’) · also ’the other’, contrasted with a preceding τὴν … μέν: fem. acc. sg. (τὴν δέ ’the other one’) · also article-like with a numeral: ’the one’ (τὴν μὲν ἴαν ’the one portion’)
glossary.τὸν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. sg. ’him’ · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ: whom, which; masc. acc. sg. (τὸν Ἀλφειὸς τέκε ’whom Alpheus begot’) · also demonstrative adjective with a noun: ’that, the’ (τὸν μῦθον ’that story, message’) · also demonstrative, distributive: masc. acc. sg. ’the one … the other’ (τὸν μὲν … τὸν δ’) · also article-like with a participle: τὸν ἐόντα ’me, the one who am’ · also article-like with a superlative or ordinal: ’the best’ (τὸν ἄριστον), ’the fourth’ (τὸν τέταρτον) · also article-like with a substantivized adjective: ’the like (one)’ (τὸν ὁμοῖον)
glossary.τῶν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); gen. pl. ’of these things, of them’ · also with a noun, article-like: τῶν ἄλλων ἀνέμων ’of the other winds’ · also distributive, ’of the one … of the other’ (τῶν μὲν … τῶν δ’ ’of the one band … of the other’) · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ: gen. pl. ’of whom, whose’ (τῶν ὕβρις τε βίη τε … ἵκει ’whose insolence and violence reach’)
glossary.τῷ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc./neut. dat. sg.; also relative: ’in which’ · the relative dat. sg. also serves as an instrumental, ’with which’ (τῷ δάμνησι ’with which she overpowers’) · also adverbial ’therefore, and so’ (τῷ οὔ τινα οἶδα ’so I know no one’) · also article-like with a noun: ’that, the same’ (ἤματι τῷ αὐτῷ ’on that same day’) · also demonstrative instrumental, of a thing just named: ’with it’ (τῷ ἀπὸ πείσματ’ ἔκοψα ’with it I cut the cables off’) · also demonstrative of a thing just named, before a preposition: ’it’ (τῷ δ’ ἐν ’and on it’, τῷ δ’ ὑπό ’and beneath it’) · also adverbial, with κε: ’in that case, otherwise’ (τῷ κέ μιν … παύσαμεν ’otherwise we should have stopped him’)
glossary.φίλοισι: φίλος — dear, one’s own (with kin/body parts serves as a possessive); masc. dat. pl.
glossary.φίλον: φίλος — dear, one’s own (with kin/body parts serves as a possessive); neut. nom./acc. sg. · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with a masculine noun: φίλον υἱόν ’dear son’ · also masc. acc. sg. predicative, agreeing with a pronoun: ’as a friend, welcome’ (φίλον ἐλθεῖν) · also neut. voc. sg., agreeing with τέκος: ’dear (child)’
glossary.φίλου: φίλος — dear, one’s own; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.φίλων: φίλος — dear, one’s own; masc. gen. pl. (φίλοι ’kin, dear ones’) · also attributive with ἑταίρων: ’dear (companions)’ (φίλων … ἑταίρων)
glossary.φρένας: φρήν — mind, heart, wits (lit. midriff); fem. acc. pl.
glossary.φρεσὶ: φρήν — mind, heart, wits; fem. dat. pl.
glossary.φρονέων: φρονέω — think, intend, be disposed; pres. part. nom. sg. masc., epic uncontracted (= Attic φρονῶν)
glossary.φόρκυνος: Φόρκυς — Phorcys, an old sea-god, father of Thoösa; gen. sg.
glossary.φύγεν: φεύγω — flee, escape; aor. 3 sg., no augment (= ἔφυγε)
glossary.φύγον: φεύγω — flee, escape; aor. 3 pl., no augment (= ἔφυγον) · also aor. 1 sg. (same ending as 3 pl.): ’I fled’
glossary.χαρίζετο: χαρίζομαι — do a favor, please, gratify; impf. 3 sg., no augment; + dat.
glossary.χόλον: χόλος — anger, wrath (lit. gall, bile); acc. sg.
glossary.ψυχὴν: ψυχή — life, soul, life-breath; acc. sg.
glossary.ἀέθλων: ἄεθλος — trial, labor, contest (Attic ἆθλος); gen. pl., epic (= Attic ἄθλων)
glossary.ἀέκητι: ἀέκητι — against the will of, in despite of; + gen.
glossary.ἀγαθὰ: ἀγαθός — good; neut. acc. pl. ’good things’
glossary.ἀγαμεμνονίδης: Ἀγαμεμνονίδης — son of Agamemnon, i.e. Orestes; nom. sg.
glossary.ἀγορὴν: ἀγορή — assembly, gathering place; acc. sg. (Ionic for Attic ἀγορά)
glossary.ἀθήνη: Ἀθήνη — Athena, goddess of wisdom and war; nom. sg.
glossary.ἀθανάτοισι: ἀθάνατος — immortal, deathless; masc. dat. pl., epic (= Attic -οις)
glossary.ἀθανάτοισιν: ἀθάνατος — immortal, deathless; masc. dat. pl., epic (= Attic -οις)
glossary.ἀμφ: ἀμφί (elided ἀμφ’) — around, about, concerning; + dat. · also + acc., ’around, with, accompanying’ (ἀμφ’ Ὀδυσῆα ’with, around Odysseus’) · also + gen., ’about, concerning’ (ἀμφ’ Ἄρεος φιλότητος ’about the love of Ares’) · also with ὀστεόφιν, ’around’ (ἀμφ’ ὀστεόφιν θὶς ’a heap around the bones’)
glossary.ἀμφιρύτῃ: ἀμφίρυτος — sea-girt, flowed round on all sides; fem. dat. sg.
glossary.ἀμφὶς: ἀμφίς — apart, on both sides, around; adverb · also + gen.: ’apart from’ (ἀμφὶς φυλόπιδος ’apart from battle-din’)
glossary.ἀμύμονος: ἀμύμων — blameless, excellent (an old epithet whose exact force is uncertain); gen. sg.
glossary.ἀνθρώποισιν: ἄνθρωπος — human being, man; masc. dat. pl., epic (= Attic -οις)
glossary.ἀνθρώπων: ἄνθρωπος — human being, man; gen. pl.
glossary.ἀνιόντος: ἄνειμι — go up, rise (of the sun); pres. part. gen. sg.
glossary.ἀντία: ἀντίος — opposite, against; neut. acc. pl. used adverbially, + gen.
glossary.ἀντίθεον: ἀντίθεος — godlike, a match for a god; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀντιθέῳ: ἀντίθεος — godlike, a match for a god; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.ἀντιόων: ἀντιάω — meet, come to share in; pres. part. nom. sg. masc., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἀντιῶν); + gen.
glossary.ἀπέτισεν: ἀποτίνω — pay back, pay in full, atone for; aor. 3 sg.
glossary.ἀπαμειβόμενος: ἀπαμείβομαι — answer, reply; pres. part. nom. sg. masc.
glossary.ἀπειπέμεν: ἀπεῖπον (from ἀπαγορεύω) — speak out, give notice, forbid; aor. inf., epic (-έμεν = Attic ἀπειπεῖν)
glossary.ἀποθρῴσκοντα: ἀποθρῴσκω — leap up from, spring up; pres. part. acc. sg. masc.
glossary.ἀπόλοιτο: ἀπόλλυμι — destroy; mid. perish, die; aor. opt. 3 sg. mid., expressing a wish
glossary.ἀπὸ: ἀπό — from, away from; + gen. · also as preverb in tmesis, separated from its verb (ἀπὸ … ὀλέσσει = ἀπολέσει ’will destroy’; ἀπὸ … δοθείη = ἀποδοθείη ’be given back’)
glossary.ἀργείων: Ἀργεῖοι — the Argives, i.e. the Greeks; gen. pl.
glossary.ἀργεϊφόντην: Ἀργεϊφόντης — Argeïphontes, epithet of Hermes, traditionally ’slayer of Argus’ though the sense is disputed; acc. sg.
glossary.ἀρνύμενος: ἄρνυμαι — strive to win, earn; pres. part. nom. sg. masc.
glossary.ἀσκελὲς: ἀσκελής — unyielding, stubborn; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially
glossary.ἀσπερχὲς: ἀσπερχής — without pause, vehement; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially
glossary.ἀτασθαλίῃσιν: ἀτασθαλίη — wanton folly, reckless wrongdoing; fem. dat. pl., epic (= Attic -αις)
glossary.ἀτρεΐδαο: Ἀτρεΐδης — son of Atreus, i.e. Agamemnon; gen. sg., epic (-αο = Attic -ου)
glossary.ἀτρυγέτοιο: ἀτρύγετος — unharvested, restless (of the sea; exact sense uncertain); gen. sg., epic (-οιο = Attic -ου)
glossary.ἀφείλετο: ἀφαιρέω — take away, deprive of; aor. 3 sg. mid.
glossary.ἀχαιοὺς: Ἀχαιοί — the Achaeans, i.e. the Greeks; acc. pl.
glossary.ἁδινὰ: ἁδινός — close-packed, thronging, in a mass; neut. acc. pl.
glossary.ἁθρόα: ἁθρόος — all together, in a mass; neut. nom./acc. pl.
glossary.ἁθρόοι: ἁθρόος — all together, in a mass; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἁλὸς: ἅλς — sea, salt water; fem. gen. sg. · also masc. gen. sg., with the masc. adjective πολιοῖο: ’of the grey sea’ (ἁλὸς πολιοῖο)
glossary.ἁμόθεν: ἁμόθεν — from some point or other (a word found once in Homer); adv., with suffix -θεν ’from’
glossary.ἂν: ἄν — modal particle marking contingency (with subj. = future contingency, with opt. = potential) · also with a secondary indicative (impf./aor.) marking an unreal, contrary-to-fact conclusion: ’would’ (οὐκ ἂν ... ἀγόρευες ’you would not be speaking’) · also = ἀνά (preposition/preverb ’up’) in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἂν … βαῖνε = ἀνέβαινε, ἂν … βάντες = ἀναβάντες) · also = ἀνά as a preposition + acc.: ’up through, up among’ (ἂν δόνακας ’up through the reeds’) · also in ὡς ἄν + opt., a purpose clause: ’so that … might’ (ὡς ἂν … ἑλοίμεθα ’so that we might seize’)
glossary.ἄγεθ: ἄγετε (elided ἄγεθ’) — come now! (interjectional imperative of ἄγω); 2 pl.
glossary.ἄλγε: ἄλγος — pain, grief; neut. nom./acc. pl. (ἄλγεα, elided ἄλγε’)
glossary.ἄλγεα: ἄλγος — pain, grief; neut. nom./acc. pl.
glossary.ἄλλοι: ἄλλος — other, another; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἄλλος: ἄλλος — other, another; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἄλοχον: ἄλοχος — wife, one who shares the bed; acc. sg.
glossary.ἄπο: ἀπό — away from, from; + gen.; accented ἄπο when it follows its noun (anastrophe: φίλων ἄπο) · also as a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ὀλέσαντ’ ἄπο = ἀπολέσαντα ’having lost’)
glossary.ἄστεα: ἄστυ — town, city; neut. acc. pl.
glossary.ἄτλαντος: Ἄτλας — Atlas, the Titan who holds the pillars of sky and sea; gen. sg.
glossary.ἅπαντες: ἅπας — all, every one; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἐγὼν: ἐγώ — I; nom. sg., form used before a vowel
glossary.ἐκ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; + gen. · also as adverb or preverb in tmesis, no case expressed: ’out’ (ἐκ δ’ ἔβαν ’and out they stepped’)
glossary.ἐλέαιρον: ἐλεαίρω — pity, have compassion on (epic by-form of ἐλεέω); impf. 3 pl., no augment
glossary.ἐμόν: ἐμός — my, mine; neut. voc. sg. (= nom./acc. in form; agrees with τέκνον) · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with a masculine noun: οἶκον ἐμόν ’my house’
glossary.ἐν: ἐν — in, on, among; + dat.; also used as an adverb, ’in it, there’ · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐν … βάλῃ = ἐμβάλῃ ’cast in’; ἐν … χεῦον = ἔγχεον ’pour in’)
glossary.ἐνιαυτῶν: ἐνιαυτός — year, cycle of the seasons; gen. pl.
glossary.ἐνοσίχθων: ἐνοσίχθων — earth-shaker, epithet of Poseidon (from ἔνοσις ’shaking’ + χθών ’earth’); nom. sg.
glossary.ἐντρέπεται: ἐντρέπομαι — turn towards, pay regard to, heed; pres. 3 sg. mid./pass.
glossary.ἐνὶ: ἐν (epic ἐνί) — in, on, among; + dat. · also adverb or preverb, no case: ’therein’ (ἔνθ’ ἐνὶ πέπλοι ... βεβλήατο ’therein coverlets were laid’) · also + gen., of a person’s house: ’in the house of’ (ἐνὶ Κίρκης ’in Circe’s house’)
glossary.ἐξ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; + gen. · also as a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐξ … ἕντο = ἐξέντο, from ἐξίημι ’send out, put away (desire)’)
glossary.ἐοικότι: ἔοικα — be like, be fitting, be deserved; perf. part. dat. sg. masc./neut.
glossary.ἐπεκλώσαντο: ἐπικλώθω — spin (fate) for, allot by spinning; aor. 3 pl. mid.
glossary.ἐπιλήσεται: ἐπιλανθάνομαι — forget; fut. 3 sg. mid.; + gen.
glossary.ἐπιμνησθεὶς: ἐπιμιμνήσκομαι — think of, call to mind; aor. pass. part. nom. sg. masc.; + gen.
glossary.ἐποτρύνω: ἐποτρύνω — urge on, rouse; pres. subj. 1 sg. (purpose clause)
glossary.ἐριδαινέμεν: ἐριδαίνω — quarrel, strive, contend; pres. inf., epic (-έμεν = Attic ἐριδαίνειν)
glossary.ἐρρύσατο: ἐρύομαι — protect, rescue, save; aor. 3 sg. mid.
glossary.ἐς: εἰς (epic ἐς) — into, to; + acc. · also as a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb with no case expressed (ἐς … ἦλθον = εἰσῆλθον ’came in’)
glossary.ἐσελεύσομαι: εἰσέρχομαι — go into, enter; fut. 1 sg., epic (ἐς- for εἰς-)
glossary.ἐσθλὸν: ἐσθλός — good, noble, brave; neut./masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἐτέρπετο: τέρπομαι — take delight in, enjoy oneself; impf. 3 sg.
glossary.ἐυπλοκάμῳ: ἐϋπλόκαμος — fair-tressed, with fine hair; fem. dat. sg.
glossary.ἐόντας: εἰμί — be; pres. part. acc. pl. masc., epic (= Attic ὄντας)
glossary.ἐύσκοπον: ἐΰσκοπος — keen-sighted, sure of aim; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἑκατόμβης: ἑκατόμβη — hecatomb, large sacrifice (lit. of a hundred oxen); gen. sg.
glossary.ἑρμείαν: Ἑρμείας — Hermes, epic form of Ἑρμῆς; acc. sg.
glossary.ἑρμείας: Ἑρμείας — Hermes, epic form of Ἑρμῆς; nom. sg.
glossary.ἑτάρους: ἕταρος — companion (by-form of ἑταῖρος); acc. pl.
glossary.ἔγνω: γιγνώσκω — come to know, learn, perceive; aor. 3 sg., no augment
glossary.ἔκταν: κτείνω — kill, slay; aor. 3 sg. (ἔκτανε, elided ἔκταν’)
glossary.ἔλθῃσι: ἔρχομαι — go, come; aor. subj. 3 sg., epic ending -ῃσι (= Attic ἔλθῃ)
glossary.ἔμμεναι: εἰμί — be; pres. inf., epic (= Attic εἶναι)
glossary.ἔνθ: ἔνθα (elided ἔνθ’) — there, then; adverb of place or time
glossary.ἔνθα: ἔνθα — there, then; adverb of place or time · also used relatively, continuing a clause: ’where’ (ἔνθα περ ’in the very place where, just where’) · also doubled, ἔνθα καὶ ἔνθα ’this way and that’
glossary.ἔννεπε: ἐννέπω — tell of, relate, speak; pres. imper. 2 sg.
glossary.ἔπε: ἔπος — word, speech; neut. acc. pl. (ἔπεα, elided ἔπε’), epic uncontracted (= Attic ἔπη)
glossary.ἔπειτ: ἔπειτα (elided ἔπειτ’) — then, next, after that
glossary.ἔπερσεν: πέρθω — sack, destroy, lay waste; aor. 3 sg.
glossary.ἔπος: ἔπος — word, speech, thing said; neut. nom./acc. sg.
glossary.ἔρυκε: ἐρύκω — hold back, detain, keep; impf. 3 sg., no augment · also pres. imper. 2 sg., in a prohibition with μή: μὴ ... ἔρυκε ’do not detain (me)!’
glossary.ἔσαν: εἰμί — be; impf. 3 pl., epic (= Attic ἦσαν)
glossary.ἔσσεται: εἰμί — be; fut. 3 sg., epic (= Attic ἔσται)
glossary.ἔσχατοι: ἔσχατος — farthest, outermost, last; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἔφαθ: φημί — say, speak; impf. 3 sg. mid. (ἔφατο, elided ἔφαθ’, τ>θ before rough breathing)
glossary.ἔχῃσιν: ἔχω — have, hold; pres. subj. 3 sg., epic ending -ῃσι (= Attic ἔχῃ)
glossary.ἕλικας: ἕλιξ — twisted, curved (of cattle’s horns); fem. acc. pl.
glossary.ἕρκος: ἕρκος — fence, barrier, enclosure; neut. nom./acc. sg.
glossary.ἠελίοιο: Ἠέλιος — the Sun (god); gen. sg., epic (-οιο = Attic Ἡλίου)
glossary.ἠμείβετ: ἀμείβω — exchange; mid. answer, reply; impf. 3 sg. mid. (ἠμείβετο, elided ἠμείβετ’)
glossary.ἡβήσῃ: ἡβάω — reach young manhood, come of age; aor. subj. 3 sg.
glossary.ἡμέτερε: ἡμέτερος — our, ours; masc. voc. sg.
glossary.ἡμέων: ἐγώ (pl. ἡμεῖς) — I, we; gen. pl. ’of us’, epic uncontracted (= Attic ἡμῶν)
glossary.ἡμεῖς: ἐγώ (pl. ἡμεῖς) — I, we; nom. pl. ’we’
glossary.ἡμῖν: ἐγώ (pl. ἡμεῖς) — I, we; dat. pl. ’to us’
glossary.ἣν: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; fem. acc. sg. · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: whom, which (fem. acc. sg.)
glossary.ἤσθιον: ἐσθίω — eat; impf. 3 pl.; with κατά in tmesis = κατήσθιον ’were devouring’
glossary.ἥν: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; fem. acc. sg. · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: whom, which (fem. acc. sg.) · also relative + indefinite, in the compound ἥν τινα = ἥτις (fem.): ’whatever, what’
glossary.ἦεν: εἰμί — be; impf. 3 sg., epic (= Attic ἦν)
glossary.ἦμαρ: ἦμαρ — day (epic for ἡμέρα); neut. nom./acc. sg.
glossary.ἦρχε: ἄρχω — begin, rule; impf. 3 sg., + gen. ’began (the speaking)’ · also ’go first, lead the way’ (no gen.): ἦρχε δ’ Ἀθήνη ’and Athena went first, led the way’ · also + gen. of the way: ἦρχε ὁδοῖο ’led the way’ · also absolute: ’ruled, was king’
glossary.ἧς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; fem. gen. sg. · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: whose, of whom/which (fem. gen. sg.)
glossary.ἰθάκην: Ἰθάκη — Ithaca, Odysseus’ island home; acc. sg.
glossary.ἰθάκηνδ: Ἰθάκηνδε (elided Ἰθάκηνδ’) — to Ithaca, homeward to Ithaca; with directional suffix -δε
glossary.ἱέμενος: ἵημι — send, let go; mid. press forward, be eager; pres. part. nom. sg. masc.
glossary.ἱέμενός: ἵημι — send, let go; mid. press forward, be eager; pres. part. nom. sg. masc.
glossary.ἱερὰ: ἱερός — sacred, holy; neut. acc. pl. ’sacred rites, offerings’ · also attributive, agreeing with δώματα: ’sacred (halls)’ (ἱερὰ πρὸς δώματα)
glossary.ἱερὸν: ἱερός — sacred, holy; neut. acc. sg. · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with μένος: ἱερὸν μένος ’sacred might’
glossary.ἱκέσθαι: ἱκνέομαι — come to, reach, arrive at; aor. inf.
glossary.ἱμείρεται: ἱμείρομαι — long for, yearn for; pres. 3 sg. mid. (also serves as short-vowel subjunctive); + gen.
glossary.ἱρὰ: ἱερός (shortened ἱρός) — sacred, holy; neut. acc. pl. ’sacrifices’
glossary.ἴδεν: ὁράω — see; aor. 3 sg., no augment (= εἶδεν)
glossary.ἵνα: ἵνα — so that, in order that; + subj. · also + opt. after a past tense · also relative ’where’ + indic.: ἵνα … καθεύδετον ’where the two are sleeping’ · also + opt. after a future main verb: ’so that … may’ (ἄξω … ἵνα … ἄλφοι ’I will take … so that he may bring in’)
glossary.ὀδυρόμενον: ὀδύρομαι — lament, grieve; pres. part. acc. sg. masc.
glossary.ὀδυσσεύς: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus, the poem’s hero; nom. sg.
glossary.ὀδυσσεὺς: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus, the poem’s hero; nom. sg.
glossary.ὀδυσσῆος: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus; gen. sg. (double-σ, metrical variant of single-σ Ὀδυσῆος)
glossary.ὀδυσῆα: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus; acc. sg. (single-σ metrical variant of Ὀδυσσῆα)
glossary.ὀδυσῆι: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus; dat. sg. (single-σ metrical variant of Ὀδυσσῆι)
glossary.ὀδυσῆος: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus; gen. sg. (single-σ metrical variant of Ὀδυσσῆος)
glossary.ὀλέθρῳ: ὄλεθρος — destruction, ruin, death; dat. sg.
glossary.ὀλοόφρονος: ὀλοόφρων — baleful-minded (sense of this epithet, e.g. for Atlas, is debated; perhaps ’all-knowing’); gen. sg.
glossary.ὀλυμπίου: Ὀλύμπιος — Olympian, of Olympus; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.ὀλύμπιε: Ὀλύμπιος — Olympian, of Olympus; masc. voc. sg.
glossary.ὀμφαλός: ὀμφαλός — navel; also the boss of a shield; nom. sg.
glossary.ὀρέσταο: Ὀρέστης — Orestes, son of Agamemnon who avenged him; gen. sg., epic (-αο = Attic -ου)
glossary.ὀρέστης: Ὀρέστης — Orestes, son of Agamemnon who avenged him; nom. sg.
glossary.ὀτρύνομεν: ὀτρύνω — urge on, rouse, send speeding; aor. subj. 1 pl., short-vowel hortatory (= Attic ὀτρύνωμεν) · also after μή, prohibitive: ’let us not urge on’
glossary.ὀφθαλμοῦ: ὀφθαλμός — eye; gen. sg. (with a verb of depriving: ’of his eye’) · also depending on a noun: ’of the eye’ (ὀφθαλμοῦ … ἀλαωτύν ’the blinding of the eye’)
glossary.ὁ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. nom. sg. · also article-like with an adjective and a name: ’the’ (ὁ θρασὺς Ὀδυσσεύς ’bold Odysseus’) · also article-like with a noun: ’the’ (ὁ γέρων ’the old man’) · also distributive, masc. nom. sg.: ’the one’ (ὁ μὲν οὐρανὸν εὐρὺν ἱκάνει ’the one reaches the broad heaven’) · also article-like with a superlative: ’the worst’ (ὁ κάκιστος Ἀχαιῶν ’the worst of the Achaeans’)
glossary.ὁππότ: ὁππότε (elided ὁππότ’) — whenever, when; epic (= Attic ὁπότε)
glossary.ὃν: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; masc./neut. acc. sg. · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: whom, which (masc. acc. sg.)
glossary.ὃς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (relative) — who, which; masc. nom. sg. · also possessive ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: his own, her own (masc. nom. sg.) · also plain demonstrative, ’he’ (ὃς γὰρ δεύτατος ἦλθεν), not a relative
glossary.ὄλεθρον: ὄλεθρος — destruction, ruin, death; acc. sg.
glossary.ὄλοντο: ὄλλυμι — destroy; mid. perish, be destroyed; aor. 3 pl. mid., no augment
glossary.ὄφρα: ὄφρα — so that, in order that; epic (= Attic ἵνα); + subj. · also temporal, ’until’, + indic. (ὄφρα ... βάλε): marking the point an action ceases · also temporal + subj. with κε, correlative with τόφρα: ’as long as, until’ (ὄφρα κε κείνη τοῦτον ἔχῃ νόον ’for as long as she holds this purpose’) · also + opt. in a purpose clause after a secondary-sequence verb: ὄφρα ... ἕλοις/ἵκοιο ’so that you might take/arrive’ · also temporal + indic., ’as long as’ (ὄφρα μὲν … ἦν ’so long as it was’)
glossary.ὅ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. sg.; with γε: ’he’ · also relative, masc. nom. sg., accented before an enclitic: ’who’ (ὅ κε ... ἐφείη) · also = ὅτι ’that’; εἰς ὅ ’until’ · also relative, neut. nom./acc. sg.: ’which’ (ὅ οἱ πέρι δῶκεν Ἀθήνη ’which Athena gave her beyond others’) · also masc. nom. sg. pronoun ’he’ without γε, accented before an enclitic (ὅ σφιν ’he … to them’)
glossary.ὅθι: ὅθι — where; epic relative adverb (= Attic οὗ)
glossary.ὅνδε: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own; masc. acc. sg. + directional suffix -δε: ὅνδε δόμονδε ’to his own house’
glossary.ὅου: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (relative) — who, which; masc./neut. gen. sg., epic (ὅου = Attic οὗ)
glossary.ὅπως: ὅπως — so that, in order that, how; + subj. or fut. indic. · also + opt., in secondary sequence after a past-tense verb, indirect deliberative: ’how it might’ (ὅπως ἄριστα γένοιτο ’how it might turn out best’) · also ’when’ = ὅτε · also ’as, however’ + subj. in a general clause: ὅπως ἐθέλῃσιν ’however he wishes’ · also + opt. in a purpose clause after a past tense: ’so that … might follow’ (ὅπως … ἑποίατο) · also + pres. indic., ’as, in whatever way’ (ὅπως ἐθέλεις ’as you wish’) · also ’how’ + aor. indic., indirect question after a verb of telling (κατάλεξον ὅπως ἤντησας ’tell how you came upon’)
glossary.ὅς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (relative) — who, which; masc. nom. sg. · also possessive ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: his own, her own (masc. nom. sg.) · also with τις, an indirect interrogative: οὐκ οἶδ’ ὅς τις ’I know not who’ · also with τις, indefinite relative: ὅς τις … φάγοι ’whoever should eat’
glossary.ὅσοι: ὅσος — as much/many as; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ὅτε: ὅτε — when; temporal conjunction · also ’since, now that’ (ὅτε πρότερός γε πύθοιτο ’since he learned of it first’) · also with the optative, hypothetical/conditional: ’if ever, whenever’ (ὅτε ... ἵκοι ’if ever such need should come upon me’) · also with the subjunctive, general: ’whenever’ (ὅτε στείχῃσ’ ἀνὰ ἄστυ ’whenever she goes through the town’) · also with the optative, iterative in past time: ’whenever’ (ὅτε μέλλοι ’whenever he was about to’) · also with the pres. indic., ’whereas, when’ (ὅτε τ’ ἄλλοι ἅπαξ θνῄσκουσ’ ἄνθρωποι ’whereas other men die only once’) · also in ὅτε μή, ’unless, except when’ (ὅτε μὴ θεὸς … θείη ’unless a god should make’)
glossary.ὅτις: ὅστις — whoever, whatever; masc. nom. sg., epic (ὅτις = Attic ὅστις)
glossary.ὑπερίονος: Ὑπερίων — Hyperion, a name of the Sun-god; gen. sg.
glossary.ὑπὲρ: ὑπέρ — over, beyond; + acc. (ὑπὲρ μόρον ’beyond one’s portion’) · also + gen., literally ’over, above’ (ὑπὲρ ἀργυρέοιο λέβητος ’over a silver basin’) · also + gen., in an adjuration: ’by’ (ὑπὲρ θυέων καὶ δαίμονος ’by the sacrifices and a power’)
glossary.ὕπατε: ὕπατος — highest, supreme; masc. voc. sg.
glossary.ὠγυγίην: Ὠγυγίη — Ogygia, the island of Calypso; acc. sg.
glossary.ὠδύσαο: ὀδύσσομαι — be angry at, hate; aor. 2 sg. mid., epic ending -αο (= Attic -ω)
glossary.ὡς: ὡς — as, how, that, when; with the optative introduces a wish: ’so may…’ (unaccented; accented ὥς / ὣς is ’thus’) · also ὡς + unaugmented ὄφελον + inf., an unfulfillable wish: ’would that...’ · also ὡς + opt., a purpose clause (= ἵνα): ’so that’ (ὡς τὸν χόλον ἐξακέσαιτο ’so that he might appease the anger’) · also exclamatory ὡς + adj. + inf.: ’how (good, etc.) it is to...’ (ὡς ἀγαθὸν ... λιπέσθαι ’how good a thing it is to be left behind’) · also plain ὡς + indic., ’as’ (ὡς σὺ κελεύεις ’as you command’) or ’how’ in an indirect question (ὡς ἐπὶ πόντον ἐλεύσομαι ’how I shall come upon the sea’) · also ὡς ἄν + subj., a purpose clause: ’so that’ (ὡς ἂν μὴ κλαίουσα κατὰ χρόα καλὸν ἰάπτῃς ’so that you might not mar your fair skin with weeping’) · also ὡς δ’ ὅτε introducing an epic simile, ’as when’, its clause taking indic. or ἄν/κε + subj. for a general case: ὡς δ’ ὅτ’ ἂν ... φανήῃ ’as when ... should appear’ · also comparative ’like’, placed after the noun it compares (ἀνέμου ὡς πνοιή ’like a blast of wind’) · also ὡς εἰ ’as if, like’ (ὡς εἰ πτερὸν ἠὲ νόημα ’as if a wing or a thought’) · also ὡς + ἄν + opt., potential, ’as, in the way that, such as’ (ὡς οὐκ ἂν ἔλποιο ’such as you would not expect’) · also introducing a simile with the subj. and no ἄν: ’as when (a woman weeps)’ · also in an asseveration with fut. indic., ’as surely as’ (ὡς οὐκ ὀφθαλμόν γ’ ἰήσεται ’as surely as nothing will heal the eye’) · also exclamatory ὡς + adj. with a finite verb: ’how (dear) he is’ (ὡς ὅδε … φίλος … ἐστίν) · also ὡς ἄν + subj., of manner: ’as’ (ὡς ἂν ἐγὼ εἴπω ’as I shall say’) · also comparative ’like’, standing before its noun (ὡς νυκτερίς ’like a bat’) · also ὡς ὅθ’ (= ὡς ὅτε), ’as when’, comparing with an occasion in the past (ὡς ὅθ’ ὑπὸ Τροίην ’as when beneath Troy’) · also introducing an indirect statement after a verb of saying: ’that, how’ (εἴποιμ’ ὡς … ἔρχομαι ’I might tell how I am coming’) · also ὡς ἄν + opt., a purpose clause: ’so that’ (ὡς ἄν τίς σε … μακαρίζοι ’so that someone … would call you blessed’) · also ὡς + participle, ’as one who’ (ὡς ἐκ θανάτοιο φυγόντα ’as one escaped from death’) · also ὡς ἄν + subj., a purpose clause: ’so that’ (ὡς ἂν … ἔρχησθον ’so that you two may go’) · also ὡς = ’to, toward’ + acc. of a person (ὡς τὸν ὁμοῖον ’to the like’) · also exclamatory ὡς + finite verb: ’how’ (ὡς ὁ μολοβρὸς … ἀγορεύει ’how the glutton talks’)
glossary.ὢ: ὤ — oh! ah! (exclamation, as in ὢ πόποι)
glossary.ὣς: ὥς — thus, so; adverb (accented, distinct from unaccented ὡς ’as’; = Attic οὕτως) · also postpositive after its noun (anastrophe), = comparative ὡς ’as, like’: ὄρνις δ’ ὥς ’like a bird’ · also introducing a wish with the optative: ’so may…’ (ὣς ἔμ’ ἀϊστώσειαν ’so may they make me vanish’)
glossary.ὥς: ὥς — thus, so; also (with κε/ἄν + subj.) ’so that, in order that’; adverb/conjunction · also introducing an indirect question: ’how’ (ὥς κε νέηται ’how he is to return’, after φράσσεται) · or ὡς ’as’, accented before enclitic τε · also causal, ’since, seeing that’ (ὥς οἱ ἐναργὲς ὄνειρον ἐπέσσυτο ’since a vivid dream had come upon her’) · also with κεν + opt., purpose: ’so that’ (ὥς κεν … γένοιτο ’so that he might become’) · also ὥς ’just as’, in ὥς περ (accented before enclitic περ) (ὥς περ ὑπέστης ’just as you promised’) · also ὡς ’as’, accented before enclitic με (ὥς με κελεύεις ’as you bid me’) · also postpositive after its noun, comparative ’like’ (οἰωνῶν ὥς ’like birds’) · also ὡς ’as’, accented before enclitic τοι (ὥς τοι ἐγὼν ἐρέω ’as I shall tell you’) · also correlative ’so’ answering ὅπως, introducing a wish with the opt., accented before the enclitic τοι: ’so may’ (ὥς τοι Ζεὺς τελέσειεν ’so may Zeus fulfil it for you’) · also with a plain subj. (no κε/ἄν), purpose: ’so that’ (ὥς τοι δῶρ’ ἀποπέμψω ’so that I may send you the gifts’) · also ὥς accented before enclitic οἱ, of measure: ’as much as’ (ὥς οἱ χεῖρες ἐχάνδανον ’as much as his hands could hold’) · also exclamatory, ’how’, accented before the enclitic τις (ὥς τις θαρσαλέος … ἐσσι ’how bold you are’) · also with the plain optative (no κε/ἄν), purpose, accented before the enclitic μιν: ’so that’ (ὥς μιν ψυχὴ λίποι ’so that life should leave him’) · also ὡς ’as, how’, accented before enclitic μοι (ὥς μοι ἰνδάλλεται ’as it seems to me’) · also ὡς ’how’, introducing a narrated event, accented before the enclitic μιν (ὥς μιν θηρεύοντ’ ἔλασεν ’how he struck him as he hunted’) · also ὡς ’as, like’, accented before enclitic τις (ὥς τις ’like some’)
glossary.ῥ: ἄρα (weakened ῥα, elided ῥ’) — then, indeed, so; inferential particle
glossary.ῥέζοι: ῥέζω — do, act; also ’perform a sacrifice’; pres. opt. 3 sg.
glossary.ῥέζων: ῥέζω — do, act; also ’perform a sacrifice’; pres. part. nom. sg. masc.
glossary.αἰδοίη: αἰδοῖος — held in respect, revered; fem. nom. sg. · also fem. voc. sg., in address: ’revered one’ (ὦ γύναι αἰδοίη)
glossary.αἰνῶς: αἰνῶς — terribly, exceedingly (of an uncanny likeness); adv. · also general intensifier with a verb of emotion: αἰνῶς ἵεται ’is terribly eager’ · also modifying a verb of appearing: ’terribly, fearsomely’ (διεφαίνετο δ’ αἰνῶς ’glowed terribly’) · also intensifying a predicate adjective: ’terribly, wretchedly’ (αἰνῶς … εἵματ’ ἔχω κακά ’the clothes I have are terribly bad’)
glossary.αἴθωνα: αἴθων — blazing, gleaming, fire-bright (of iron the exact sense is disputed); masc. acc. sg.
glossary.αὐλείου: αὔλειος — of the courtyard; masc./neut. gen. sg. (οὐδοῦ ἐπ’ αὐλείου ’the threshold of the court’)
glossary.αὐτοί: αὐτός — self; intensive pron., masc. nom. pl.: ’themselves’ · also masc. nom. pl. with a 2nd-person subject: ’yourselves’ (χαίρετε δ’ αὐτοί ’and fare well yourselves’) · also masc. nom. pl. with a 1st-person subject: ’ourselves’ (αὐτοί τ’ ἀμβαίνωμεν ’and let us ourselves embark’)
glossary.αὐτοῖο: αὐτός — self; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -οῦ): ’himself’
glossary.αὐτοῖσι: αὐτός — self; masc./neut. dat. pl.: ’for them, to them’ (dat. of persons served)
glossary.αὐτοῖσιν: αὐτός — self; masc./neut. dat. pl. (ν-movable): ’to them, for them’
glossary.αὐτὴν: αὐτός — self; fem. acc. sg.: ’her’ · also intensive, accusative subject of an infinitive: ’she herself’ (αὐτὴν ποθέσαι ’that she herself miss [him]’) · also attributive, ’the same’: τῷ αὐτὴν ὁδὸν ’the very same road’ · also intensive with a noun, ’very’: εἰς ὁδὸν αὐτὴν ’into the very path’ · also intensive with a pronoun object, ’you yourself’ (σὲ … αὐτήν)
glossary.αὖτε: αὖτε — again, in turn, on the other hand; adv.
glossary.βάλλουσι: βάλλω — throw, cast; pres. 3 pl.: of a thought, ’put (into the heart)’
glossary.βίοτον: βίοτος — life, livelihood, substance one lives on; acc. sg.
glossary.βλάπτουσι: βλάπτω — hinder, baulk, trip up (not yet ’harm’, as later); pres. 3 pl. + gen. of separation: ’baulk (him) of (his way)’
glossary.βοῶν: βοῦς — ox, cow; pl. ’cattle’; gen. pl.
glossary.βῆ: βαίνω — go, walk, step; aor. 3 sg., root aorist, unaugmented (= ἔβη): ’went, strode’
glossary.γέροντ: γέρων — old man; masc. acc. sg., elided (γέροντ’ = γέροντα)
glossary.γλαυκῶπιν: γλαυκῶπις — epithet of Athena: ’gleaming-eyed’ (or ’owl-eyed’; sense uncertain); fem. acc. sg.
glossary.γουνὸν: γουνός — rise of ground, hillside, knoll; acc. sg.
glossary.γρηὶ: γρηῦς — old woman; dat. sg. (Attic γραῦς)
glossary.δάμνησι: δάμνημι — overpower, subdue, tame; pres. 3 sg., epic ending -ησι
glossary.δέσματ: δέσμα — bond, fetter; neut. acc. pl., elided (δέσματ’ = δέσματα)
glossary.δήμῳ: δῆμος — district, land, people; dat. sg.
glossary.δαΐφρονος: δαΐφρων — wise-minded, or perhaps ’warlike’; sense disputed (from δαῆναι ’learn’ or δάϊς ’battle’); masc. gen. sg.
glossary.δαιδάλεον: δαιδάλεος — cunningly wrought, of skilled work; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.δαιτρὸς: δαιτρός — carver, one who portions out meat; nom. sg. (from δαίομαι ’divide’)
glossary.δατεῦντο: δατέομαι — divide, portion out, share; impf. 3 pl. mid., Ionic contraction (δατεῦντο = δατέοντο): ’were portioning out’
glossary.δεξιτερὴν: δεξιτερός — right, on the right hand; fem. acc. sg. (epic = Attic δεξιός)
glossary.δηρόν: δηρός — long, lasting; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’for long, for a long time’
glossary.δμῳαὶ: δμῳή — female slave, serving-woman (fem. of δμώς); nom. pl.
glossary.δουροδόκης: δουροδόκη — spear-rack, spear-stand (δόρυ + δέχομαι); gen. sg.
glossary.δώμασιν: δῶμα — house, dwelling; neut. dat. pl. (plural for a single dwelling): ’over his house’
glossary.δῖος: δῖος — heavenly, divine, illustrious; masc. nom. sg., epithet of heroes (= fem. δῖα)
glossary.δῶ: δῶ — house, home; indeclinable epic noun (= δῶμα), used as nom./acc. sg. · also δίδωμι ’give’: aor. subj. 1 sg., ’I may give’ (ἵνα τοι δῶ ’that I may give you’)
glossary.εἰδομένη: εἴδομαι — seem, make oneself like, appear as (+ dat.); pres. part. fem. nom. sg. · also functioning as aor. part. (the same -όμενος form serves both in Homer), ’having made herself like’ (Μέντορι εἰδομένη)
glossary.εἰδώς: οἶδα — know; perf. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’knowing’
glossary.εἰδῶ: οἶδα — know; perf. subj. 1 sg.: ’that I may know’
glossary.εἰν: ἐν (epic εἰν before a vowel) — in, on; + dat.
glossary.εἰποῦσ: εἶπον — say, speak; aor. part. fem. nom. sg., elided (εἰποῦσ’ = εἰποῦσα)
glossary.εἰπὼν: εἶπον — say, speak; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.
glossary.εἴ: εἰ — if; conditional conj. (accented εἴ before a following enclitic, περ among them) · also introducing an indirect question, ‘whether’ (τίς δ’ οἶδ’ εἴ κέ ... ‘who knows whether’) · also with opt., of an aim in view: ’in case, to see if’ (εἴ τινά … λάβοι ’in case he might catch someone’) · also in ὡς εἴ τ’ + opt., ’as if’ · also in ὡς εἴ τε with no verb or optative expressed: ’as if’
glossary.εἴδατα: εἶδαρ — food, dish; neut. acc. pl. εἴδατα: ’dishes’
glossary.εἴπω: εἶπον — say, tell; aor. subj. 1 sg.
glossary.εἴρηαι: εἴρομαι — ask, inquire (epic = Attic ἔρομαι); pres. subj. 2 sg. mid., uncontracted (= Attic ἔρῃ): ’you should ask’
glossary.εἴσιδ: εἰσοράω — catch sight of, look upon; aor. 3 sg., elided (εἴσιδ’ = εἴσιδε)
glossary.εἵλετο: αἱρέω — take, seize; aor. 3 sg. mid.: ’took up (for herself)’ · also with ἐκ in tmesis: ’took away from’ (ἐκ … εἵλετο)
glossary.εἷσεν: ἵζω — seat, set; aor. 3 sg. transitive: ’seated (her)’ · also ’settled (a people in a new land)’
glossary.εὐρέι: εὐρύς — broad, wide; masc. dat. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic εὐρεῖ)
glossary.εὐχετόωντο: εὐχετάομαι — declare oneself, avow, boast; impf. 3 pl., epic diectasis (by-form of εὔχομαι) · also pray, make a vow: ’they prayed’ (εὐχετόωντο θεοῖσιν ’they prayed to the gods’)
glossary.εὐχόμεθ: εὔχομαι — declare oneself, avow; pres. 1 pl., elided (εὐχόμεθ’ = εὐχόμεθα)
glossary.εὔχομαι: εὔχομαι — declare oneself, avow, boast, pray; pres. 1 sg.: ’I declare myself (to be)’
glossary.εὖτ: εὖτε (elided εὖτ’) — when, whenever; temporal conj.
glossary.ζωὸς: ζωός — alive, living; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.θάμ: θαμά (elided θάμ’) — often, again and again; adv.
glossary.θέτο: τίθημι — put, place, set; aor. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented: ’set (for himself)’ · also in tmesis with ἀπό (ἀπὸ … θέτο = ἀπέθετο): ’put off, laid aside’ · also with a name as object: ’gave, bestowed (a name)’ (τὸ γὰρ θέτο … μήτηρ ’his mother gave him that’)
glossary.θαλπωρή: θαλπωρή — warmth, comfort; nom. sg. (from θάλπω ’warm’)
glossary.θαμὰ: θαμά — often, again and again; adv.
glossary.θείη: τίθημι — put, place, make; aor. opt. 3 sg.: ’might make’ (σκέδασιν θείη ’make a scattering’) · also aor. opt. 3 sg. in a wish with an infinitive: ’may (Zeus) grant (that I come)’
glossary.θεοειδής: θεοειδής — godlike in form (θεός + εἶδος); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.θεράποντες: θεράπων — attendant, servant; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.θρόνον: θρόνος — chair, seat of honour (with footstool); acc. sg.
glossary.θρόνους: θρόνος — chair, seat of honour; acc. pl.
glossary.θυμῷ: θυμός — heart, spirit, soul; dat. sg.
glossary.θυράων: θύρα — door; fem. gen. pl., epic -άων (= Attic θυρῶν)
glossary.θύρῃσιν: θύρα — door; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι(ν) (= Attic θύραις)
glossary.θῆκεν: τίθημι — put, place; aor. 3 sg. · also ’make (someone a certain way)’, with double acc.: ’made him (taller)’
glossary.κ: κε(ν) (elided κ’) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν) · also + subj. in a general relative: ’whoever’ (ὃς δέ κ’ … ἵκηται ’whoever comes’) · also + opt., potential: ’would’ (καί κ’ ἐλθὼν … εἴποιμι ’and I would go and tell’) · also + aor. indic., unreal past: ’would have’ (καί νύ κ’ … ἔδυ ’and … would have set’) · also + fut. indic. in a main clause: ’will’ (τοὺς δέ κ’ … θέλξει ’and then … will enchant them’) · also + subj. in the protasis after εἰ: ’if ever’ (εἰ μέν κ’ αἰνήσωσι ’if they approve’) · also + opt. in the protasis after εἴ: ’if perhaps’ (τόν κ’ εἴ μοι δοίης ’if you would give me him’) · also + subj. in the protasis after αἴ: ’if perhaps’ (αἴ κ’ αὐτὸν γνώω ’if I come to know him’) · also + subj. in a purpose clause after ὄφρα: ’so that’ (ὄφρα κ’ … ἐρεθίζω ’so that I may provoke’) · also + subj. in a purpose clause after ὥς: ’so that’ (ὥς κ’ … ἵκηται ’so that he may reach’) · also + subj. in the protasis after αἴ: ’if you should wish’ (αἴ κ’ ἐθέλῃσθα)
glossary.κάματος: κάματος — weariness, toil, fatigue; nom. sg.
glossary.κίονα: κίων — pillar, column; fem. acc. sg. (κίων is feminine in this use) · also masc. acc. sg., with μακρὸν agreeing in the masculine: ’a tall pillar’ (πρὸς κίονα μακρὸν)
glossary.κακὸν: κακός — bad, evil; masc./neut. acc. sg.: ’by an evil (fate)’, inner acc. with μόρον · also neut. nom. sg., subject of an impersonal verb (τι … κακὸν … μελέτω ’let no evil thing be a care’) · also neut. acc. sg. as a plain substantive, direct object: ’harm, evil’ (κακὸν ἀλλοδαποῖσι φέροντες ’bringing harm to men of other lands’) · also neut. acc. sg., attributive with ἦμαρ: ’evil’ (κακὸν ἦμαρ ’the evil day’) · also masc. acc. sg., predicative: ’base, cowardly’ (κακὸν καὶ ἀνήνορα ’base and unmanned’) · also neut. acc. sg. attributive with πῆμα: ’evil’ (πῆμα κακὸν ’evil harm’) · also neut. nom. sg., predicate with an infinitive as subject: κακὸν … βάζειν ’(it is) bad to speak’ · also neut. acc. sg. governed by ἐς: ’into evil’ (ἐς κακὸν … βάλῃσθα) · also neut. acc. sg. subject of an infinitive: ’an evil’ (κακὸν ἔμμεναι ’that an evil is’) · also neut. nom. sg., subject of εἴη: ’evil’ (μή τι κακὸν … εἴη ’and may no evil be’) · also neut. acc. sg., attributive with ῥάκος: ’vile’ (ῥάκος ἄλλο κακὸν ’another, a vile rag’) · also neut. nom. sg., subject of a finite verb: ’an evil’ (ἐπεὶ κακὸν ἔμπεσεν οἴκῳ ’since an evil fell upon the house’) · also neut. nom. sg., predicate with γενοίμην: ’a bane, an evil (to them)’ · also masc. acc. sg. as a plain substantive, direct object: ’a base man’ (κακὸς κακὸν ἡγηλάζει)
glossary.καλὰ: καλός — beautiful, fair, fine; neut. acc. pl. · also neut. acc. pl. used adverbially: ’handsomely, finely’ (καλά … κήδεαι ’you care so finely’) · also adverbial neut. acc. pl.: ’well, finely’ (οὐκέτι καλὰ … ἀναχωρήσειν ’no longer well’) · also neut. nom. pl. (same form), agreeing with a plural subject: καλὰ θύρετρα ’the fine doors’
glossary.καλὸν: καλός — beautiful, fair, fine; masc. acc. sg. (agreeing with a noun) · also neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’beautifully’ (with an infinitive) · also neut. acc. sg. used as a noun, direct object: ’a fine one’ (μάλα καλὸν ἑλών) · also neut. acc. sg., attributive, agreeing with a stated neut. noun: ’fine’ (καλὸν δέπας ’the fine cup’) · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with ὕδωρ: ’fair, fine’ (ὕδωρ καλὸν ’fair water’) · also neut. acc. sg., adverbial or cognate with a finite verb: οὐ καλὸν ἔειπες ’you have not spoken well’ · also neut. nom. sg., predicate with an infinitive as subject: ’a fine thing (to hear)’
glossary.καλῇ: καλός — beautiful, fair, fine; fem. dat. sg.
glossary.κανέοισιν: κάνεον — basket; neut. dat. pl., epic -οισι(ν) (= Attic -οις)
glossary.καρήνων: κάρηνον — head, peak, summit; neut. gen. pl.
glossary.κατ: κατά (elided κατ’) — down from, throughout; + gen./acc. · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (κατ’ … ἕζετο = κατέζετο ’sat down’) · also + acc., of place, ’along’ (κατ’ ἠερόεντα κέλευθα ’along the misty paths’) · also + acc., ‘over against’ (κατ’ ἄντηστιν ‘right opposite’)
glossary.κατάλεξον: καταλέγω — recount in full and in order (not yet ’choose’, as later); aor. imper. 2 sg.
glossary.κατήλυθον: κατέρχομαι — come down, put in (from the sea); aor. 1 sg. · also aor. 3 pl. (identical form): ’they came down’ (of Telemachus and Athena reaching the ship) · also aor. 1 pl.: ’we came down’ (forced by the following verb)
glossary.κατερύκεται: κατερύκω — hold back, detain; pres. pass. 3 sg.: ’is held back’
glossary.κείμεν: κεῖμαι — lie; pres. part. neut. nom./acc. pl., elided (κείμεν’ = κείμενα): ’lying’
glossary.κείνῳ: κεῖνος — that, that one; demonstrative pron., epic (= Attic ἐκεῖνος); masc. dat. sg.
glossary.κελεύθου: κέλευθος — way, road, journey, voyage; gen. sg.
glossary.κεν: κε(ν) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν) · also + secondary indic. (κατέφθιτο), unreal past conditional: ’would have perished’ · also + aor. indic. of a future event pictured as already accomplished, an eventual near-certainty rather than a counterfactual: ἤ κεν ... κτεῖνεν ’or he may well have killed (him) already’ · also + subj. in a relative clause, prospective: ’who is to, who will’ (ἥ κεν ἄγῃσι ’(a wagon) that shall carry’) · also + opt. in a purpose clause: ’so that’ (ὥς κεν … γένοιτο ’so that he might become’) · also + subj. in a temporal clause: ’whenever’ (ὅτε κεν … δαινύῃ ’whenever you feast’) · also + subj. in the protasis of a condition after αἴ: ’if ever’ · also + opt., potential: ’might, may’ · also + opt. in the protasis after εἰ: ’if ever’ (εἰ δέ κεν … ἀφικοίμεθα ’but if we should reach’) · also + fut. indic. or short-vowel subj. in an apodosis: ’will’ (αἶψά κεν … τεύξομεν ’at once we will build’) · also + subj. in the protasis after εἰ: ’if ever’ (εἴ κεν … ἵκωμαι ’if I should come’) · also + subj. in a disjunctive statement of what may happen: ’may’ (ἤ κεν ἁλώῃ ’or he may be caught’) · also + subj. in a general relative: ’whoever’ (ὅς κεν ὀπυίῃ ’whoever marries’) · also + subj. after εἰς ὅ, ’until’ (εἰς ὅ κεν ἔλθω ’until I come’) · also + fut. indic. in a main clause or an indirect disjunctive question: ’shall’ (ἤ κεν … δυνησόμεθ’ ’whether we shall be able’) · also + fut. indic. in a relative clause: ’who will’ (ὅς κεν … ἐποίσει ’who will lay on’) · also + subj. in a purpose clause after ὄφρα: ’so that’ (ὄφρα κεν … καταθείομαι ’so that I may put away’)
glossary.κεῖνον: κεῖνος — that, that one; demonstrative pron., epic (= Attic ἐκεῖνος); masc. acc. sg.
glossary.κεῖνος: κεῖνος — that, that one; demonstrative pron., epic (= Attic ἐκεῖνος); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.κεῖνόν: κεῖνος — that, that one; demonstrative pron., epic (= Attic ἐκεῖνος); masc. acc. sg. (accented on the ultima before the enclitic γ’)
glossary.κλισμούς: κλισμός — chair, seat (lighter than the θρόνος); acc. pl.
glossary.κλισμὸν: κλισμός — chair, seat (lighter than the θρόνος); acc. sg.
glossary.κοτέσσεται: κοτέομαι — bear a grudge, be angry; aor. subj. 3 sg., short-vowel: ’is angered’
glossary.κοῦροι: κοῦρος — young man, boy; nom. pl.
glossary.κρέα: κρέας — meat, flesh; neut. acc. pl., uncontracted (= Attic κρέα contr.)
glossary.κρειῶν: κρέας — meat, flesh; neut. gen. pl., epic κρειῶν with ει for ε (= Attic κρεῶν)
glossary.κρητῆρας: κρητήρ — mixing-bowl (for wine and water); acc. pl.
glossary.κρητῆρσι: κρητήρ — mixing-bowl (for wine and water); dat. pl.
glossary.κύπελλα: κύπελλον — cup, drinking-vessel; neut. acc. pl.
glossary.κῦμα: κῦμα — wave; nom. sg. · also acc. sg. (identical neut. form), object of a preposition (κατὰ κῦμα ’over the wave’) · also acc. sg., direct object: μέγα κῦμα ’a great wave’
glossary.λάβῃσιν: λαμβάνω — take, seize, take hold of; aor. subj. 3 sg., epic ending -ῃσι (= Attic λάβῃ)
glossary.λαέρτην: Λαέρτης — Laertes, father of Odysseus; acc. sg.
glossary.λεύκ: λευκός — white; neut. nom. pl., elided (λεύκ’ = λευκά) · also neut. acc. pl., elided (λεύκ’ = λευκά), agreeing with ὀστέα: ’white’
glossary.λῖτα: λίς — smooth linen cloth; acc. sg.
glossary.μάλ: μάλα (elided μάλ’) — very, very much, exceedingly; adv.
glossary.μέγα: μέγας — great, huge; neut. nom./acc. sg. · also neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’greatly’ (μέγα νήπιοι ’greatly foolish’)
glossary.μέλει: μέλω — be a care, be an object of concern (impersonal, + dat. of the person, nom. of the thing); pres. 3 sg.
glossary.μέν: μέν — on the one hand; particle, often answered by δέ (the acute μέν is kept before a following enclitic; elsewhere μὲν) · also asseverative, = μήν ’truly, indeed’ (οὐ μέν ’not indeed’) · also μένω — stay, wait; pres. imper. 2 sg., elided (μέν’ = μένε): ’stay’
glossary.μέντης: Μέντης — Mentes, a Taphian chieftain, the guise Athena takes; nom. sg.
glossary.μέντῃ: Μέντης — Mentes, a Taphian chieftain, the guise Athena takes; dat. sg.
glossary.μακρὴν: μακρός — long, tall; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.μαντεύσομαι: μαντεύομαι — prophesy, divine (from μάντις); fut. 1 sg.
glossary.μεθέπεις: μεθέπω — come after, follow, come to (a place); pres. 2 sg.: ’you are coming’
glossary.μεθήμενος: μέθημαι — sit among (+ dat.); pres. part. masc. nom. sg.
glossary.μεμήλει: μέλω — be a care; plpf. 3 sg. used with impf. force: ’was a care’
glossary.μετελθών: μετέρχομαι — come among, go after; aor. part. masc. nom. sg. (+ dat.)
glossary.μνηστῆρες: μνηστήρ — suitor; nom. pl. · also masc. voc. pl., in address: ’suitors!’
glossary.μολπή: μολπή — song, singing (joined with dancing); nom. sg.
glossary.μυθήσεαι: μυθέομαι — speak, tell, relate; fut. 2 sg. mid., uncontracted (= Attic μυθήσῃ)
glossary.μὴ: μή — not; negative particle in wishes, prohibitions, and purpose/fear clauses · also negating a conditional clause after εἰ: εἰ μὴ ’if not, unless’ · also negating a generic relative clause with the opt.: ὃς μὴ … ἐλάσειε ’whoever did not drive off’ · also ’lest’ in a warning, + 2 sg. fut./subj.: μὴ … ἀποτίσεαι ’lest you pay for it’ · also + inf., negating an infinitive of advice that gives the content of a word: ’not to’ (ἔπος … μὴ πάντα μνηστῆρσιν ὁμιλεῖν ’a word, not to mingle in everything with the suitors’)
glossary.νέον: νέος — new, young; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’newly, for the first time’ · also masc. acc. sg., ’young’ (νέον ἄνδρα ’a young man’) · also neut. nom./acc. sg., ’new’ (οὔ τι νέον ’not a new one’, of a debt) · also adv., ’just now, a moment ago’ (νέον ἠὲ πάροιθεν ’just now than before’; νέον ἦσθα γέρων ’just now you were an old man’)
glossary.νήποινον: νήποινος — unpunished, without payment (νη- + ποινή); neut. acc. sg.
glossary.νίζον: νίζω — wash; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented: ’were washing’
glossary.νίψασθαι: νίζω — wash; aor. inf. mid., purpose: ’to wash themselves’
glossary.νεμεσήσεαι: νεμεσάω — feel indignation at, take amiss (+ dat.); fut. 2 sg. mid., uncontracted (= Attic νεμεσήσῃ)
glossary.νεμεσσήθη: νεμεσάω — feel indignation, be indignant; aor. pass. 3 sg., double σ metrical
glossary.νηίῳ: Νήιον — Neion, a height in Ithaca; neut. dat. sg.
glossary.νηυσίν: ναῦς — ship; dat. pl., epic νηυσί(ν) (= Attic ναυσί)
glossary.νηὸς: ναῦς — ship; gen. sg., epic νηός (= Attic νεώς)
glossary.νηῦς: ναῦς — ship; nom. sg., epic νηῦς
glossary.ξείνῳ: ξεῖνος — stranger, guest-friend (epic = Attic ξένος); dat. sg.
glossary.ξεστὴν: ξεστός — planed smooth, polished (from ξέω); fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ξεῖνε: ξεῖνος — stranger, guest-friend (epic = Attic ξένος); voc. sg.
glossary.ξεῖνοι: ξεῖνος — stranger, guest-friend (epic = Attic ξένος); nom. pl.
glossary.ξεῖνον: ξεῖνος — stranger, guest-friend (epic = Attic ξένος); acc. sg.
glossary.ξεῖνος: ξεῖνος — stranger, guest-friend (epic = Attic ξένος); nom. sg.
glossary.ξὺν: σύν (epic ξύν) — with, together with; + dat.
glossary.οἰνοπέδοιο: οἰνόπεδος — wine-bearing, planted with vines; fem. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.οἰνοχοεύων: οἰνοχοέω — pour wine; pres. part. masc. nom. sg., lengthened epic form
glossary.οἰωνῶν: οἰωνός — bird of omen; gen. pl.
glossary.οἴνοπα: οἶνοψ — wine-faced, having the look of wine (of the sea; exact colour meant is unsettled); masc. acc. sg.
glossary.οἷσιν: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; possessive adj., neut./masc. dat. pl. (ν-movable): ’his own’ (agreeing with δώμασιν) · also relative, masc./neut. dat. pl.: whom (λαῶν οἷσιν ἄνασσε), not the possessive
glossary.οὐκέτι: οὐκέτι — no longer, not any more; adv.
glossary.οὐλύμποιο: Ὄλυμπος — Olympus; gen. sg., epic Οὐ- lengthening and genitive in -οιο (= Attic Ὀλύμπου)
glossary.οὓς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., masc. acc. pl.
glossary.οὔτ: οὔτε (elided οὔτ’) — nor, and not; correlative negative conj.
glossary.οὔτε: οὔτε — nor, and not; correlative negative conj.
glossary.οὗ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., masc. gen. sg.: ’whose’ (= Attic οὗ) · also neut. gen. sg. in ἐξ οὗ ’since, from the time when’ · also possessive ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: his own, her own; masc. gen. sg. agreeing with a noun (οὗ πατρὸς ’her own father’s’)
glossary.πάϊς: παῖς — child, son; nom. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic παῖς)
glossary.πέρ: περ — even, indeed; intensive/concessive particle, accented πέρ before the enclitic τε/τις that follows it; with εἰ: ’even if’
glossary.πίνακας: πίναξ — platter, wooden trencher; acc. pl.
glossary.παλάμῃ: παλάμη — palm, hand; dat. sg. (dat. of place: ’in her palm’)
glossary.παλλὰς: Παλλάς — Pallas, title of Athena of unknown origin (perhaps πάλλω ’brandish’); nom. sg.
glossary.παντοίων: παντοῖος — of all kinds, of every sort; masc./neut. gen. pl.
glossary.παρ: παρά (elided παρ’) — beside, among; + dat. · also + gen., ’from, from the side of’ (παρ’ Ἴλου ’from Ilus’) · also + acc., of motion, ’past, along, beside’ (παρ’ Μίμαντα ’past Mimas’)
glossary.παρέθηκε: παρατίθημι — set beside, serve; aor. 3 sg.
glossary.παρέθηκεν: παρατίθημι — set beside, serve; aor. 3 sg. (ν-movable)
glossary.παρενήνεον: παρανηνέω — heap up beside; impf. 3 pl., reduplicated, augment inside the compound
