glossary.παρεόντων: πάρειμι — be present, be at hand; pres. part. gen. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic παρόντων): ’of what was at hand’
glossary.παρτιθεῖ: παρατίθημι — set beside, serve; pres. 3 sg., epic contracted (παρτιθεῖ = παρατίθησι)
glossary.πασσάμενος: πατέομαι — partake of, taste (+ gen.); aor. part. mid. masc. nom. sg.: ’having partaken of’
glossary.πατέρ: πατήρ — father; masc. acc. sg., elided (πατέρ’ = πατέρα)
glossary.πατρώιοι: πατρώιος — inherited from one’s father, ancestral; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.πατρώιός: πατρώιος — inherited from one’s father, ancestral; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.πεζὸν: πεζός — on foot; masc. acc. sg., predicative with the subject of an infinitive
glossary.περικαλλέα: περικαλλής — very beautiful; fem. acc. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic περικαλλῆ) · also neut. nom./acc. pl., agreeing with a neuter plural noun: ’very beautiful’ (ἔργα ... περικαλλέα ’very beautiful works, fine handiwork’) · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with δίφρον: ‘very fair (stool)’
glossary.πεσσοῖσι: πεσσός — a piece in a board game (’draughts’, game and pieces unidentified); masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι
glossary.πετάσσας: πετάννυμι — spread out; aor. part. masc. nom. sg., double σ metrical
glossary.πευθοίαθ: πυνθάνομαι — hear, learn, perceive; pres. opt. 3 pl. mid., epic -ατο for -ντο, elided and aspirated (πευθοίαθ’ = πευθοίατο): ’might hear’
glossary.πλέων: πλέω — sail; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.
glossary.πνοιῇς: πνοιή — breath, blast; fem. dat. pl., Ionic η for Attic α (= Attic πνοαῖς)
glossary.ποθεν: πόθεν — from somewhere; indefinite enclitic adv. (accentless after εἰ), distinct from interrogative πόθεν ’from where?’
glossary.ποικίλον: ποικίλος — inlaid, elaborately wrought, dappled; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.πολλά: πολύς — much, many; neut. nom. pl. (agreeing with ἔγχεα): ’many’ · also neut. acc. pl., object of a verb: ’many things’ (παλαιά τε πολλά τε εἰδώς ’knowing many old things’) · also neut. acc. pl., adjectival with a noun: ’many’ (πολλά τε δῶρα ’and many gifts’)
glossary.πολλοὶ: πολύς — much, many; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.πολυμήχανός: πολυμήχανος — of many devices, resourceful (πολύς + μηχανή); masc. nom. sg., epithet of Odysseus
glossary.πολυτρήτοισι: πολύτρητος — much-pierced, full of holes; masc./neut. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
glossary.πολὺ: πολύς — much, many; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’by far’ · also neut. nom. sg. adj. agreeing with ὕδωρ: ’much, plentiful’ · also neut. acc. sg. adverbial with a negative: ’far’ (οὐ πολὺ ναῖεν ’did not live far off’)
glossary.ποσσὶν: πούς — foot; masc. dat. pl., epic double σ (= Attic ποσί)
glossary.ποτοῖο: πότος — drink, drinking; gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου): ’with drink’
glossary.πρίν: πρίν — before, until; conj./adv., + inf. (like Attic πρίν) · also + a temporal clause (πρίν γ’ ὅτ’ ἄν + subj.): ’until the time when’ · also πρίν κε + opt., an independent potential clause answering a suppressed protasis: ’sooner, before then’ (πρίν κεν ... ἵκοιο ’you would arrive home before then’) · also τὸ πρίν, substantivized with the article, no inf.: ’formerly, at first’ (parallel to the by-form πρὶν) · also πρίν γ’ ὅτε + aor. indic.: ’until the time when’ (a definite past terminus) · also πρίν γε + subj.: ’until’ (πρίν γ’ ἔτι … πειρήσεαι ’until you have tried’)
glossary.προθύροιο: πρόθυρον — forecourt, gateway before the house-door; neut. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.προθύροις: πρόθυρον — forecourt, gateway before the house-door; neut. dat. pl.
glossary.προκείμενα: πρόκειμαι — lie before, be set out; pres. part. neut. nom./acc. pl.
glossary.προπάροιθε: προπάροιθε — before, in front of; adv./prep. + gen.
glossary.προσέειπε: προσεῖπον — speak to, address; aor. 3 sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic προσεῖπε)
glossary.προσηύδα: προσαυδάω — speak to, address; impf. 3 sg.
glossary.προχόῳ: πρόχοος — pitcher, jug (for pouring); dat. sg.
glossary.πρότιθεν: προτίθημι — set out, set before; impf. 3 pl., epic short ending -εν (= Attic προετίθεσαν)
glossary.πρὸς: πρός — towards, against, to; prep. + acc. · also a plain adverb, no case governed: ’besides, in addition’ · also + dat.: πρὸς ἀλλήλῃσιν ἔχονται ’cling close to one another’ · also + gen., ’from, under the protection of’ (πρὸς Διός εἰσιν ’are from Zeus’) · also + dat., ’against’ (ῥαίοιτο πρὸς οὔδεϊ ’be dashed against the floor’) · also + dat., ’in addition to’ (πρὸς τοῖσί τε ὕπνος ’and sleep in addition to these’) · also + gen., of direction: ’toward, on the side of’ (πρὸς Βορέαο ’toward the North Wind’) · also + gen., in an appeal: ’by (your father)’ (πρὸς πατρὸς γουνάζομαι) · also as preverb in tmesis: με πρὸς μῦθον ἔειπε = με προσέειπε μῦθον ’spoke a word to me’ · also + gen., ’in the eyes of, with’ (πρὸς πόσιός τε καὶ υἱέος ’in the eyes of her husband and son’)
glossary.πτερόεντα: πτερόεις — winged (πτερόν ’feather, wing’); neut. acc. pl.: ’winged (words)’
glossary.πω: πω — yet, up to now; enclitic adv., usu. with a negative
glossary.πόδας: πούς — foot; acc. pl., accusative of respect · also acc. pl., direct object: ’feet’ (πόδας καὶ χεῖρας ’feet and hands’)
glossary.πόθι: πόθι — where?; interrog. adv. (Attic ποῦ), suffix -θι of place where
glossary.πόληος: πόλις — city; gen. sg., epic (= Attic πόλεως)
glossary.πόλινδε: πόλις — city; acc. sg. + suffix -δε ’towards’: ’to the city’
glossary.πόλλ: πολύς — much, many; neut. acc. pl., elided (πόλλ’ = πολλά): ’many’ · also used adverbially: ‘much, often’ (πόλλ’ ἐπέεσσιν ‘again and again with words’) · also neut. nom. pl., attributive: ’many’ (ἤματα πόλλ’ ’many days’)
glossary.πόντον: πόντος — sea, open sea; acc. sg.
glossary.πόσιος: πόσις — drinking; gen. sg. (abstract noun, distinct from πόσις ’husband’) · also πόσις — husband; masc. gen. sg. (εὐνὴν … πόσιος ’her husband’s bed’)
glossary.πὰρ: παρά (apocope πάρ, functioning as an adverb) — beside, alongside; adv. · also a preposition + acc., ’beside’ (πὰρ Νέστορα) · also preverb in tmesis (πὰρ … θῆκεν = παρέθηκε ’set before’) · also a preposition + dat., ’beside’ (πὰρ πυρί ’beside the fire’) · also a preposition + gen., ’from (the side of)’ (πὰρ Ταφίων ’from the Taphians’) · also a preposition + dat., ’among, in the company of’ (πὰρ παύροισι ’among few’)
glossary.σιδήρεα: σιδήρεος — of iron; neut. nom./acc. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic σιδηρᾶ)
glossary.σκέδασιν: σκέδασις — a scattering, dispersal; acc. sg.
glossary.σπόγγοισι: σπόγγος — sponge; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
glossary.στίχας: στίξ — row, rank, line (of men); acc. pl.
glossary.στιβαρόν: στιβαρός — stout, massive, sturdy; neut. nom./acc. sg.
glossary.στὰς: ἵστημι — set, stand; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having stood, standing’
glossary.στῆ: ἵστημι — set, stand; aor. 3 sg., root aorist, unaugmented (= ἔστη): ’stood’
glossary.σφι: σφι — epic dat. pl. pron. ’to/for them’ (= Attic αὐτοῖς)
glossary.σχὼν: ἔχω — have, hold; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having held’
glossary.σὸν: σός — your, yours (sg.); masc. acc. sg. · also neut. acc. sg., agreeing with γέρας: ’your (prize)’
glossary.σὺν: σύν — with, together with; prep. + dat. · also as adverb, ’together’, or as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb: σὺν … κάλυψε = συνεκάλυψε ’covered up’; σὺν … ἔπεσον = συνέπεσον ’fell together, clashed’ · also adverb ’along, with (us)’ construed with ἔχοντες, which takes the object (σὺν … χεῖρας ἔχοντες ’having hands along with us’)
glossary.σῖτον: σῖτος — bread, grain, the staple of a meal; acc. sg.
glossary.τά: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. pl.; also relative: ’which’ (accented τά before a following enclitic) · also article-like with ἄλλα, ’the other (things)’ (τά περ ἄλλα ’in the other matters’)
glossary.τίθει: τίθημι — put, place, set; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= Attic ἐτίθει) · also pres. imper. 2 sg.: ’put!’ (πὰρ … τίθει ’set beside!’)
glossary.τίνες: τίς, τί — who? what?; interrog. pron., masc. nom. pl., predicate of an infinitive · also predicate of a finite verb (εἰμί): τίνες ἐστέ; ’who are you?’ · also interrog. adj. + noun, masc. nom. pl.: ’what’ (τίνες κοῦροι)
glossary.τίς: τίς, τί — who? what?; interrog. pron., masc. nom. sg. · also the enclitic indefinite τις accented before a following enclitic, not interrogative: ’someone, anyone’ (ἤν τίς τοι εἴπῃσι ’if someone tells you’)
glossary.ταμίη: ταμίη — housekeeper, stewardess, woman with charge of the stores (Attic ταμία, Ionic η for α); nom. sg.
glossary.ταφίοισι: Τάφιοι — the Taphians, an island people led by Mentes; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι
glossary.ταφίων: Τάφιοι — the Taphians, an island people led by Mentes; gen. pl.
glossary.ταῦτα: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο — this; neut. nom./acc. pl.: ’these things’
glossary.τελέεσθαι: τελέω — bring to pass, accomplish, fulfil; fut. inf. mid., epic uncontracted (= Attic τελεῖσθαι)
glossary.τεμέσην: Τεμέση — Temese, a place known for its copper/bronze; acc. sg.
glossary.τετιημένος: τετίημαι — be grieved, be downcast (defective, perf. with pres. force); perf. part. masc. nom. sg.
glossary.τηλέμαχος: Τηλέμαχος — Telemachus, son of Odysseus; nom. sg.
glossary.τιμὴν: τιμή — honour, privilege, worth; acc. sg.
glossary.τις: τις, τι — someone, something, a certain one; indefinite pron., masc./fem. nom. sg. · also with a negative: ’any, anyone’ (οὐ … τις ’no one’; οὐδέ τις ’nor any’) · also after the relative ὅς, indefinite: ὅς τις ’whichever, whoever’
glossary.τοι: σύ — you (sg.); encl. dat. sg.: ’to/for you’ · also τοι, the affirming particle: ’you know, indeed’ (esp. in ἦ τοι, οὔ τοι); the two are not always easy to keep apart
glossary.τοιγὰρ: τοιγάρ — well then, accordingly; particle introducing a response to a request
glossary.τοκῆες: τοκεύς — parent, begetter (from τίκτω); nom. pl.
glossary.τούτοισιν: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο — this; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν: ’to these men’
glossary.τοῖον: τοῖος — such, of such a kind; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’in such a way’ · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with a noun or pronoun: ’such a one as’ (σέ γε τοῖον ἐγείνατο ’bore a son such as you’) · also ’so’, qualifying an adj. · also neut. nom./acc. sg., agreeing with a neut. noun: τοῖον … ἔρνος (acc.), τοῖον … δόρυ (nom.) ’such a shoot, such a trunk’
glossary.τοῖσίν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. dat. pl.; also relative: ’with whom’ (accented τοῖσίν before the enclitic τε)
glossary.τοῦτ: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο — this; neut. acc. sg., elided (τοῦτ’ = τοῦτο) · also neut. nom. sg., subject of εἴη: ’this’ (εἴη κεν καὶ τοῦτ’ ’this too might be’)
glossary.τόδε: ὅδε — this, this here; demonstrative pron., neut. nom./acc. sg.
glossary.τόσος: τόσος — so great, so big; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.τὰ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. pl.: ’these things’ · also in the adverbial idiom τὰ πρῶτα, ’at first, first’ (not ’these things’) · also with a noun, pointing to it: ’those, the’ (τὰ σὰ γούνατα ’those knees of yours’) · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ: which; neut. nom. pl. (μῆλα, τὰ … κατάκειτ’ ’the flocks, which lie’) · also relative, neut. acc. pl.: ’which’, object of the verb in its clause (ῥωγαλέα, τὰ … ὅρηαι ’torn, which you see’) · also article-like with a substantivized adjective, neut.: ’the (worse things)’ (τὰ χέρεια) · also neut. acc. pl. ’them’, of the cow and the goats
glossary.φέρον: φέρω — carry, bear; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented (= Attic ἔφερον): ’used to bear’ · also ’carried, were carrying’ (φέρον ἐσθῆτα ’they carried the clothes’) · also impf. 1 sg., unaugmented (= ἔφερον): ’I carried, I was carrying’
glossary.φέρουσα: φέρω — carry, bear; pres. part. fem. nom. sg.: ’carrying, bringing’
glossary.φέρων: φέρω — carry, bear; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’carrying’
glossary.φίλ: φίλος — dear, one’s own; masc. voc. sg., elided (φίλ’ = φίλε) · also neut. nom. pl., elided (φίλ’ = φίλα): ’dear’, predicate (τὰ φίλ’ ἔσκε ’were dear’)
glossary.φίλης: φίλος — dear, one’s own; fem. gen. sg.
glossary.φημίῳ: Φήμιος — Phemius, the singer in Odysseus’ house; dat. sg.
glossary.φιλήσεαι: φιλέω — treat as a φίλος, i.e. give a guest what a guest is owed (not only ’love’); fut. 2 sg. mid./pass., uncontracted (= Attic φιλήσῃ)
glossary.φιληρέτμοισιν: φιλήρετμος — oar-loving, fond of the oar (φίλος + ἐρετμόν); masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν
glossary.φορμίζων: φορμίζω — play the lyre (from φόρμιγξ); pres. part. masc. nom. sg.
glossary.φράσσεται: φράζομαι — consider, devise; fut. 3 sg. mid., double σ metrical
glossary.φρεσίν: φρήν — mind, heart, wits (lit. midriff); fem. dat. pl.
glossary.φρεσὶν: φρήν — mind, heart, wits (lit. midriff); fem. dat. pl.
glossary.φωνήσας: φωνέω — utter, raise one’s voice; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having raised his voice’
glossary.φῇσιν: φημί — say, assert; pres. subj. 3 sg., epic ending -σι(ν): ’says, may say’
glossary.χάλκεον: χάλκεος — of bronze; masc./neut. acc. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic χαλκοῦν) · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with δόρυ as subject
glossary.χέρνιβα: χέρνιψ — water for washing the hands (χείρ + νίζω); acc. sg.
glossary.χαλεποὶ: χαλεπός — harsh, difficult, hard to deal with; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.χαριζομένη: χαρίζομαι — do a favour, be free with, give freely of (+ gen.); pres. part. fem. nom. sg.
glossary.χαῖρε: χαίρω — rejoice; pres. imper. 2 sg., the ordinary greeting: ’welcome, hail’ · also impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔχαιρε): ’he rejoiced’ (χαῖρε φήμῃ ’rejoiced at the omen-word’) · also the imperative at parting: ’farewell’ · also with a dative of cause, ’be glad’ (χαῖρε … φιλότητι ’be glad in love’)
glossary.χεῖρ: χείρ — hand; fem. acc. sg., elided (χεῖρ’ = χεῖρα)
glossary.χθονὶ: χθών — earth, ground; fem. dat. sg.
glossary.χρή: χρή — there is need (of); impersonal verb, + acc. of person and gen. of thing
glossary.χρυσείῃ: χρύσεος — golden; fem. dat. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic χρυσῇ)
glossary.χρυσοῖό: χρυσός — gold; gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic χρυσοῦ), accented on the ultima before the enclitic τε
glossary.χρύσεια: χρύσεος — golden; neut. nom./acc. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic χρυσᾶ)
glossary.ἀέκοντα: ἄκων — unwilling; masc. acc. sg., epic ἀέκων (= Attic ἄκοντα): ’against his will’
glossary.ἀίξασα: ἀΐσσω — dart, rush, spring; aor. part. fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀγήνορας: ἀγήνωρ — very manly, overbearing, lordly (rendered ’lordly’ throughout); masc. acc. pl.
glossary.ἀγήνορες: ἀγήνωρ — very manly, overbearing, lordly (rendered ’lordly’ throughout); masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἀγορεύσω: ἀγορεύω — speak out, declare; fut. 1 sg.
glossary.ἀγροῦ: ἀγρός — field, countryside; gen. sg. (ἐπ’ ἀγροῦ ’out in the country’) · also plain gen. sg. dependent on a noun, ’of the field/farmland’: ἀγροῦ ἐπ’ ἐσχατιήν ’to the edge of the farmland’
glossary.ἀγχιάλοιο: Ἀγχίαλος — Anchialus, father of Mentes, ’near the sea’; gen. sg., epic -οιο
glossary.ἀγόρευσον: ἀγορεύω — speak out, declare; aor. imper. 2 sg.
glossary.ἀείρας: ἀείρω — lift, raise (Attic αἴρω); aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having lifted’
glossary.ἀθάνατοι: ἀθάνατος — immortal, deathless; masc. nom. pl.: ’the immortals’
glossary.ἀθήνην: Ἀθήνη — Athena, goddess of wisdom and war; acc. sg. · also the city Athens: εὐρυάγυιαν Ἀθήνην ’wide-streeted Athens’
glossary.ἀκαχμένον: ἀκαχμένος — sharpened, of obscure formation; perf. pass. part. masc./neut. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀλλήλοισιν: ἀλλήλων — one another; reciprocal pron., masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν
glossary.ἀλλήλων: ἀλλήλων — one another; reciprocal pron., gen. pl.
glossary.ἀλλοθρόους: ἀλλόθροος — of foreign speech, speaking another tongue (ἄλλος + θρόος); masc. acc. pl.
glossary.ἀλλότριον: ἀλλότριος — belonging to another, another’s; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀλωῆς: ἀλωή — orchard, vineyard plot; gen. sg.
glossary.ἀμβρόσια: ἀμβρόσιος — immortal, divine, ambrosial; neut. nom. pl.
glossary.ἀμφίπολος: ἀμφίπολος — handmaid, woman in attendance; nom. sg.
glossary.ἀμφιπόλῳ: ἀμφίπολος — handmaid, woman in attendance; dat. sg.
glossary.ἀνάγκῃ: ἀνάγκη — necessity, compulsion; dat. sg., dat. of manner: ’under compulsion’
glossary.ἀνάσσοι: ἀνάσσω — be lord of, rule over (+ dat.); pres. opt. 3 sg.
glossary.ἀνάσσω: ἀνάσσω — be lord of, rule over (+ dat.); pres. 1 sg.
glossary.ἀνέμοιο: ἄνεμος — wind; gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.ἀνέρες: ἀνήρ — man; masc. nom. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἄνδρες)
glossary.ἀνέρος: ἀνήρ — man; masc. gen. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἀνδρός)
glossary.ἀναβήμεναι: ἀναβαίνω — go up (from the coast inland); aor. inf., epic -μεναι (= Attic ἀναβῆναι)
glossary.ἀναθήματα: ἀνάθημα — ornament, crowning glory (from ἀνατίθημι ’set up, add’; not yet ’votive offering’); neut. nom. pl.
glossary.ἀνεβάλλετο: ἀναβάλλω — mid. strike up (a song); impf. 3 sg. mid.
glossary.ἀνθρώπους: ἄνθρωπος — human being, man; acc. pl.
glossary.ἀνιηθεὶς: ἀνιάω — distress, vex; aor. pass. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’vexed, distressed’
glossary.ἀνὰ: ἀνά — up along, throughout; prep. + acc. · also as preverb in tmesis (ἀνὰ … κέρασσεν, from ἀνακεράννυμι ’mix up’) · also + gen., ’up onto’ (ἀνὰ νηὸς ἔβην ’I went up on board’) · also + acc., proportional, ’to, at the rate of’ (ἀνὰ εἴκοσι μέτρα ’at twenty measures (of water) to the one cup’) · also in tmesis with a verb of signalling, construed with a dat.: ἀνὰ … ὀφρύσι νεῦον ’I signalled with raised brows’ · also + acc. θυμόν, ’in (their) heart’ (ἀνὰ θυμὸν ἐθάμβεον ’they were amazed in their hearts’) · also + dat., ’on, upon’ (ἀνὰ φαιδίμῳ ὤμῳ ’on the shining shoulder’)
glossary.ἀπείρονα: ἀπείρων — boundless, endless; fem. acc. sg. · also masc. acc. sg. (the same form serves both genders for this adjective): ἀπείρονα πόντον ’boundless sea’
glossary.ἀποιχομένοιο: ἀποίχομαι — be gone away, be departed; pres. part. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.ἀπόλωλε: ἀπόλλυμι — destroy; mid./pass. perish; perf. 3 sg.: ’has perished and is gone’
glossary.ἀργυρέοιο: ἀργύρεος — of silver; masc. gen. sg., epic uncontracted -οιο (= Attic ἀργυροῦ)
glossary.ἀρησαίατ: ἀράομαι — pray, vow; aor. opt. 3 pl. mid., epic -ατο, elided (ἀρησαίατ’ = ἀρησαίατο): ’they would pray’
glossary.ἀρχῆς: ἀρχή — beginning; gen. sg. (ἐξ ἀρχῆς ’from the start’)
glossary.ἀτρεκέως: ἀτρεκής — exact, unswerving; adv. ἀτρεκέως: ’exactly, precisely’
glossary.ἀτὰρ: ἀτάρ — but, and; epic conj. (by-form of αὐτάρ)
glossary.ἀφίκεο: ἀφικνέομαι — arrive, come to; aor. 2 sg. mid., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἀφίκου)
glossary.ἀφνειότεροι: ἀφνειός — rich, wealthy; comparative masc. nom. pl., + gen. of what one is rich in
glossary.ἁδήσειεν: ἁδέω — have had enough of, take no pleasure in; aor. opt. 3 sg., negative purpose after μή
glossary.ἁλὶ: ἅλς — sea, salt water; fem. dat. sg.
glossary.ἄγε: ἄγε — come now!; interjectional imper. of ἄγω, 2 sg. · also ἄγω — lead; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἦγε): ’led’ · also ἄγω — lead; pres. imper. 2 sg.: ’lead’ (μή μ’ ἄγε κεῖσ’ ’do not lead me there’)
glossary.ἄγριοι: ἄγριος — savage, wild; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἄγω: ἄγω — lead, carry, bring; pres. 1 sg.
glossary.ἄγων: ἄγω — lead, carry, bring; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’leading’
glossary.ἄλκιμον: ἄλκιμος — strong in defence, staunch (from ἀλκή); neut. acc. sg.
glossary.ἄλλα: ἄλλος — other, another; neut. nom./acc. pl.
glossary.ἄμμι: ἐγώ (pl. ἡμεῖς) — I, we; epic dat. pl. ἄμμι (= Attic ἡμῖν)
glossary.ἄν: ἄν — modal particle marking contingency (with subj. = future contingency, with opt. = potential) · also in ὄφρ’ ἄν + subj., a purpose clause: ’so that … may’ (ὄφρ’ ἄν ἔχῃς ’so that you may keep’) · also ὡς ἄν + opt., a purpose clause: ’so that … might’ (ὡς ἄν τίς σε … μακαρίζοι ’so that anyone … would call you blessed’)
glossary.ἄνδρες: ἀνήρ — man; nom. pl. · also masc. voc. pl., in address: ’men!’ (ἄνδρες, ἐπεὶ κνίση μὲν ἀνήνοθεν)
glossary.ἄρα: ἄρα — so, as it turned out, then; inferential particle
glossary.ἄριστοι: ἄριστος — best; superl., masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἅμα: ἅμα — together with, at the same time as; adv./prep. + dat. · also ἅμα … τε, correlative: ’both … and’ (ἅμα τ’ αὐτῆς Πηνελοπείης … καὶ σέθεν εἵνεκα ’both for Penelope herself and for your sake’)
glossary.ἐγώ: ἐγώ — I; nom. sg. (accented ἐγώ before the enclitic τοι that follows) · also accented ἐγώ before the enclitic μιν that follows · also accented before the enclitic τε: σύ τ’ ἐγώ τε ’you and I’ · also accented before the elided enclitic ποτ’ (ποτέ): ἐγώ ποτ’ ’I once’ · also accented before the enclitic περ: ὅσσα τ’ ἐγώ περ ’as much as I’
glossary.ἐδήσατο: δέω — bind; aor. 3 sg. mid.: ’bound on (for herself)’ · also of a man: ’bound on (for himself)’ (Μενέλαος … ἐδήσατο καλὰ πέδιλα)
glossary.ἐκεῖνος: ἐκεῖνος — that, that one; demonstrative pron. (full form, beside the shortened epic κεῖνος); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἐλαφρότεροι: ἐλαφρός — light, nimble; comparative masc. nom. pl., + acc. of respect
glossary.ἐλεύσεσθαι: ἔρχομαι — go, come; fut. inf. mid.
glossary.ἐλθὼν: ἔρχομαι — go, come; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having come’
glossary.ἐμισγόμεθ: μίσγω — mix, mingle; mid. meet, associate with (+ dat.); impf. 1 pl. mid., elided (ἐμισγόμεθ’ = ἐμισγόμεθα)
glossary.ἐνθάδ: ἐνθάδε (elided ἐνθάδ’) — here, to this place; adv.
glossary.ἐπ: ἐπί (elided ἐπ’) — on, upon, over, towards, against; + dat./acc./gen. · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐπ’ … χεῦε = ἐπέχευε ‘poured upon’) · also + dat., of time: ’in, within’ (ἐπ’ ἤματι ’in a day’) · also + acc., ’in pursuit of, after’ (ἐπ’ ἀγροτέρας ’after wild (goats)’) · also + dat., ’in favour of, on behalf of’ (ἐπ’ Ἴρῳ ἦρα φέρων ’showing favour to Irus’) · also + acc. of time: ’for’ (ἐπ’ ἦμαρ ’for a day’) · also + gen., of place: ’at, on’ (ἐπ’ ἐσχατιῆς ’at the edge’)
glossary.ἐπίστροφος: ἐπίστροφος — much-visiting, going about among (+ gen.); nom. sg.
glossary.ἐπελθὼν: ἐπέρχομαι — go to, come upon; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having gone to’
glossary.ἐπεστέψαντο: ἐπιστέφω — crown, fill to the brim (from στέφω); aor. 3 pl. mid.
glossary.ἐπιδήμιον: ἐπιδήμιος — in one’s own land, at home (ἐπί + δῆμος); masc./neut. acc. sg.
glossary.ἐπιθεῖσα: ἐπιτίθημι — lay on, add; aor. part. fem. nom. sg.: ’having laid on’
glossary.ἐπιχθονίων: ἐπιχθόνιος — upon the earth (epithet of mortals, as against the gods); masc./fem. gen. pl.
glossary.ἐπὶ: ἐπί — on, upon, over, towards, against; + dat./acc./gen. · also as adverb, no case expressed: ’to it, over it; besides’ (θεοὶ δ’ ἐπὶ μάρτυροι ’witnesses to it’; ἐπὶ κτέρεα κτερεΐξαι ’besides’) · also + dat., ’beyond, over and above, more than’ (ἐπὶ γαστέρι κύντερον ’more shameless than the belly’) · also adverb of sequence, ’next, thereupon’ (ἦλθε δ’ ἐπὶ ψυχή ’and next came the soul’) · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb: ἐπὶ … τέταλτο = ἐπιτέταλτο ’was laid upon, entrusted’ · also + acc. of time: ’for, over’ (ἐπὶ χρόνον ’for a time’) · also + dat., ’in charge of, over’ (ἐπὶ κτεάτεσσιν ’over my possessions’) · also + dat., of purpose: ’for’ (ἐπὶ δόρπῳ ’for supper’) · also + dat., of the occasion: ’at, over’ (ἐπὶ ῥηθέντι δικαίῳ ’at a fair remark’)
glossary.ἐπῴχετο: ἐποίχομαι — go to and fro to, come round to; impf. 3 sg.
glossary.ἐρυκανόωσ: ἐρυκανάω — hold back, keep back (by-form of ἐρύκω); pres. 3 pl., epic diectasis, elided
glossary.ἐσθῆτός: ἐσθής — clothing, raiment; gen. sg. (accented on the ultima before the enclitic τε)
glossary.ἐσσι: εἰμί — be; pres. 2 sg., epic (= Attic εἶ)
glossary.ἐτάνυσσε: τανύω — stretch, draw out; aor. 3 sg., double σ metrical
glossary.ἐτήτυμον: ἐτήτυμος — true, real; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’truly’
glossary.ἐυξόου: ἐΰξοος — well-planed, well-polished (ἐϋ- + ξέω); fem. gen. sg.
glossary.ἐφ: ἐπί (elided ἐφ’ before a rough breathing) — on, upon, over; + acc. · also + dat., with anastrophe (χερσὶ ἐφ’ ὕδωρ): ’over, upon (the hands)’ · also + dat. without anastrophe, ’over’ (ἐφ’ αἵματι φάσγανον ἴσχων ’holding the sword over the blood’) · also + acc., ’to, towards’, of destination (ἐφ’ ἡμέτερ’ ’to our (home)’) · also + dat., of the person favoured: ’toward’ (ἐφ’ ἡμῖν ἦρα φέρουσιν ’show favour toward us’) · also + acc., ’for, among’, of a share: κατὰ μοῖραν ἐφ’ ἡμέας ’according to what is fitting, among us’
glossary.ἐφεστάμεν: ἐφίστημι — stand at, be set over; perf. inf., epic -μεν (= Attic ἐφεστάναι)
glossary.ἐὺ: ἐΰ — well (Attic εὖ, printed without a diaeresis); adv.
glossary.ἐὼν: εἰμί — be; pres. part. masc. nom. sg., epic (= Attic ὤν)
glossary.ἑξείης: ἑξείης — in order, one after another; adv. (Attic ἑξῆς)
glossary.ἑρπύζοντ: ἑρπύζω — creep, crawl; pres. part. masc. acc. sg., elided (ἑρπύζοντ’ = ἑρπύζοντα)
glossary.ἑτάροισιν: ἕταρος — companion (by-form of ἑταῖρος); masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν
glossary.ἑτοῖμα: ἕτοιμος — ready, at hand; neut. acc. pl. · also neut. nom. pl., predicate: ἑτοῖμα τέτυκτο ’had proved real, had come true’
glossary.ἔβαν: βαίνω — go, walk; aor. 3 pl., epic (= Attic ἔβησαν)
glossary.ἔγχε: ἔγχος — spear; neut. nom. pl., elided uncontracted (ἔγχε’ = ἔγχεα)
glossary.ἔδουσιν: ἐσθίω — eat; pres. 3 pl., from the epic present ἔδω (= Attic ἐσθίουσι)
glossary.ἔκτοθεν: ἔκτοθεν — outside, away from (+ gen.); adv./prep.
glossary.ἔμ: ἐγώ — I; encl. acc. sg., elided (ἔμ’ = ἐμέ): ’me’
glossary.ἔοικας: ἔοικα — be like, resemble (+ dat.); perf. 2 sg. with pres. sense: ’you are like’
glossary.ἔπεα: ἔπος — word, speech; neut. acc. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἔπη)
glossary.ἔροιτο: ἔρομαι — ask; aor. opt. 3 sg. mid., purpose after ἵνα: ’might ask’
glossary.ἔρον: ἔρος — desire, longing (= ἔρως); acc. sg.
glossary.ἔρχεσθ: ἔρχομαι — go, come; pres. inf., elided (ἔρχεσθ’ = ἔρχεσθαι) · also pres. imper. 2 pl., elided (ἔρχεσθ’ = ἔρχεσθε): ’come!’
glossary.ἔστησε: ἵστημι — set, set up, station; aor. 3 sg. transitive: ’set (it) up’
glossary.ἔτερπον: τέρπω — delight, cheer; impf. 3 pl.: ’were delighting (their heart)’
glossary.ἔφαντ: φημί — say, assert; impf. 3 pl. mid., elided (ἔφαντ’ = ἔφαντο): ’they were saying’
glossary.ἔχε: ἔχω — have, hold; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= Attic εἶχε) · also pres. imper. 2 sg.: ’hold, keep’ (ἔχε σιγῇ μῦθον ’keep the word in silence’)
glossary.ἔχευαν: χέω — pour; aor. 3 pl., epic -αν (= Attic ἔχεαν)
glossary.ἔχοι: ἔχω — have, hold; pres. opt. 3 sg.
glossary.ἕζοντο: ἕζομαι — seat oneself, sit down; impf. 3 pl. mid.
glossary.ἕλε: αἱρέω — take, seize; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= Attic εἷλε)
glossary.ἕντο: ἵημι — send, let go; mid. put away (from oneself); aor. 3 pl. mid., in tmesis with ἐξ: ’they put away (desire)’
glossary.ἕστηκεν: ἵστημι — set, stand; perf. 3 sg. with pres. sense: ’stands, lies at anchor’
glossary.ἠμὲν: ἠμέν — both (epic correlative, ἠμέν … ἠδέ ’both … and’); conj.
glossary.ἠπείρου: ἤπειρος — mainland, dry land; gen. sg.
glossary.ἠὲ: ἠέ — or; epic conj. (= Attic ἤ) · also introducing the first alternative of a question: ’whether’ (ἠὲ διεπράθετο … ἦ … ’whether it was sacked … or …’) · also ’than’, after a word of difference (ἀλλοῖος … ἠὲ πάροιθεν ’different than before’) · also ’than’ after a comparative or word of preference (βέλτερόν ἐστι … ἠὲ ’it is better … than’) · also introducing the first alternative of a command: ’either’ (ἠὲ σὺ πρῶτος ἔσελθε ’either you go in first’)
glossary.ἡ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); fem. nom. sg.: ’she’ · also fem. nom. sg. ’it’, of a pool of water (ἡ δὲ προσέπλαζε ’and it lapped up’) · also fem. nom. sg. ’it’, of a ship (ἡ δ’ ἔθει ’and it ran’) · also fem. nom. sg. with a noun/adj., article-like: ’the other’ (ἡ δ’ ἄλλη ’and the other woman’) · also fem. nom. sg. article-like with a noun: ’the’ (ἡ γὰρ δμώων δίκη ’for the way of servants’) · also fem. nom. sg. ’it’, of a bowstring (ἡ δ’ ὑπὸ καλὸν ἄεισε ’and it sang beautifully’)
glossary.ἡγεῖθ: ἡγέομαι — lead, lead the way; impf. 3 sg., elided (ἡγεῖθ’ = ἡγεῖτο, aspirated before ἡ)
glossary.ἡμέτερον: ἡμέτερος — our, ours; neut. acc. sg. · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with κάματον: ’our (toil)’
glossary.ἢ: ἤ — or; disjunctive conj. (epic ἠέ/ἤ) · also ’than’ after a comparative: κρεῖσσον … ἢ ὅτε ’better than when’ · also ’before’ after a verb of anticipating (ἔφθης … ἢ ἐγώ ’you got here before I did’) · also introducing the first alternative of an indirect question: ’whether’ (ἢ ἔτι … ἦέ τις ’whether still … or someone’) · also ’than’ after a verb of preferring: βουλοίμην … ἢ … ἀνάσσειν ’I would rather … than rule’ · also introducing the first alternative of a deliberation: ’whether … or’ (ἢ ἐλάσει’ … ἦέ μιν ἦκ’ ἐλάσειε) · also ’than’ after a word of difference (ἀλλοῖον … ἢ Ὀδυσῆ’ ’another … than Odysseus’) · also the first of two alternatives: ’either … or’ (ἢ στοναχῆς ἠὲ κτύπου ’either groaning or noise’)
glossary.ἤγαγον: ἄγω — lead, bring; aor. 3 pl., reduplicated · also aor. 1 sg. (the same ending serves both persons): ’I brought’ (ἤγαγον ἐκ Σκύρου ’I brought him from Scyros’)
glossary.ἤειδε: ἀείδω — sing; impf. 3 sg., augment shown as η-
glossary.ἥ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., fem. nom. sg. · also ὁ, ἡ, τό (personal/demonstrative pronoun): she; fem. nom. sg. (ἥ γε ’she indeed’, of the ship)
glossary.ἥδ: ἥδε — this, this here; demonstrative pron. (fem. of ὅδε), fem. nom. sg., elided (ἥδ’ = ἥδε)
glossary.ἥμενοι: ἧμαι — sit; pres. part. masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἦ: ἦ — truly, verily; affirming particle · also interrogative particle introducing an earnest question · also = ἤ ’or’, in the correlative ἠέ … ἦ ’whether … or’ · also ἠμί — say, speak; unaugmented aor./impf. 3 sg. (= ἔφη), closing or introducing direct speech: ’he/she said’ (ἦ ῥα ’so he said’) · also ’or’, the second alternative of a pair of questions with no preceding ἠέ: ζώει … ἦ τέθνηκε ’alive or dead’; ἢ ἔτ’ ἔχει … ἦ μιν ἀτιμάζουσιν ’whether … or’
glossary.ἦλθον: ἔρχομαι — go, come; aor. 3 pl.: ’they came’ · also aor. 1 sg. (the same ending serves both persons): ’I have come’
glossary.ἰδοίατο: ὁράω — see; aor. opt. 3 pl., epic -ατο (Attic ἴδοιντο), from the root of εἶδον
glossary.ἰθάκηνδε: Ἰθάκη — Ithaca, Odysseus’ island home; acc. sg. + suffix -δε ’to’: ’to Ithaca’
glossary.ἰθὺς: ἰθύς — straight; prep. + gen. (epic = Attic εὐθύς): ’straight towards’ · also adv., no case expressed: ’straight, straight on’
glossary.ἴαλλον: ἰάλλω — send forth, put out (the hand); impf. 3 pl., unaugmented
glossary.ἴδε: ὁράω — see; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented, from the root of εἶδον (= εἶδε) · also aor. imper. 2 sg. (printed the same; Attic accents it ἰδέ): ἴδε πῶμα ’look at the lid’
glossary.ἴδον: ὁράω — see; aor. 1 sg., unaugmented, from the root of εἶδον (= εἶδον) · also aor. 3 pl. (the same ending serves both persons): ’they saw’
glossary.ἴσαν: εἶμι — go, come; impf. 3 pl., epic: ’used to go, come’ · also as a simple narrative past, ’went’ (μνηστῆρες … ἴσαν ’the suitors went’), not necessarily iterative · also οἶδα — know; unaugmented plup. 3 pl. with impf. sense, epic (= Attic ᾔδεσαν): ’they knew’ (τὰ δ’ οὐκ ἴσαν ’they did not know’)
glossary.ἵστατο: ἵστημι — set, stand; impf. 3 sg. mid./intrans. (neut. pl. subject with sg. verb): ’were standing’ · also with ἀνά in tmesis, masc. sg. subject: ’stood up, rose’ (ἀνὰ … ἵστατο) · also impf. 3 sg. mid., masc. sg. subject, no preverb: ’stood’ (Τηλεμάχου πέλας ἵστατο ’stood near Telemachus’)
glossary.ὀίομαι: ὀΐομαι — suppose, think, imagine; pres. 1 sg., uncontracted
glossary.ὀίω: ὀΐω — suppose, think (short-form by-word of ὀΐομαι); pres. 1 sg.
glossary.ὀβριμοπάτρη: ὀβριμοπάτρη — epithet of Athena alone: ’of the mighty father’ (ὄβριμος + πατήρ); fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ὀνείαθ: ὄνειαρ — good thing, benefit; of food, neut. acc. pl., elided (ὀνείαθ’ = ὀνείατα)
glossary.ὀξέι: ὀξύς — sharp; masc./neut. dat. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic ὀξεῖ)
glossary.ὀρυμαγδῷ: ὀρυμαγδός — din, uproar, loud confused noise; dat. sg.
glossary.ὀσσόμενος: ὄσσομαι — see before one, picture to oneself, foresee; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ὀστέα: ὀστέον — bone; neut. nom./acc. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ὀστᾶ)
glossary.ὀτρηροὶ: ὀτρηρός — quick, brisk, busy (of the family of ὀτρύνω); masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ὁπποίης: ὁποῖος — of what sort; interrog./indef. adj. used directly, fem. gen. sg., double π epic (Ionic η for Attic α)
glossary.ὄφρ: ὄφρα (elided ὄφρ’) — so that, in order that; epic (= Attic ἵνα); + subj. · also temporal, ’as long as, while’ + indicative (ὄφρ’ ἔτι κεῖνος ἀνὴρ ἐπιδήμιος ἦεν ’as long as that man was still at home’) · also ’while’ + ἄν and subj. · also temporal ’until’ + indicative (ὄφρ’ ἵκετ’ Ἀρήτην ’until he came to Arete’) · also ’until’ + ἄν and subj. (ὄφρ’ ἂν ἵκηαι ’until you reach’) · also + opt. in a purpose clause after a secondary verb: ’so that … might’ (ὄφρ’ … μένοιεν) · also temporal ’until’ + opt., of a hoped-for event (ὄφρ’ ἐξεμέσειεν ’until she should vomit out’) · also ὄφρ’ ἂν + opt., ’until … should’ (ὄφρ’ ἂν ἄγοιεν ’until they should carry’) · also temporal + subj. without ἄν or κε, ’so long as’ (ὄφρ’ ἀρετὴν παρέχωσι … καὶ γούνατ’ ὀρώρῃ ’so long as the gods furnish excellence and his knees are stirring’)
glossary.ὅττεό: ὅστις — whoever, whatever; epic gen. sg. neut. ὅττεο (= Attic οὗτινος), governed by χρή
glossary.ὅττι: ὅστις — whoever, whatever; epic neut. nom./acc. sg. ὅττι (= Attic ὅ τι) · also with a superlative, ’as … as possible’ (ὅττι τάχιστα ’as quickly as possible’) · also in an indirect question, ’what’ (ὅττι ἑ κήδοι ’what was troubling him’) · also conj. ’that, because’, introducing a clause (ὅττι μιν ὣς ὑπέδεκτο ’that he had received him so’)
glossary.ὑγρὴν: ὑγρός — wet, moist; fem. acc. sg. used substantively: ’the wet (sea)’
glossary.ὑλήεντι: ὑλήεις — wooded (from ὕλη); masc./neut. dat. sg.
glossary.ὑπερφιάλοισι: ὑπερφίαλος — overbearing, arrogant; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
glossary.ὑπὸ: ὑπό — under, beneath; prep. + dat./acc.; also used as an adverb, ’beneath’ · also as preverb in tmesis (ὑπὸ … ἐδήσατο = ὑπεδήσατο ’bound beneath’) · also adverbial, of breeding: ’begotten under, born of’ (ὑπὸ δ’ ἡμίονοι ’and under them [the mares], mules’) · also + dat., marking the agent with a passive verb: ’by’ (ὑπὸ μνηστῆρσιν δαμείη ’be overcome by the suitors’) · also + gen., ’from under, beneath’ (ὑπὸ στέρνοιο) · also + gen., marking agent with a passive verb/participle beyond dying, ’by’: μεγάλου ὑπὸ κύματος ἀρθείς ’lifted up by a great wave’ · also + gen., of cause: ὑπὸ ῥιπῆς ’at the rush (of the throw)’
glossary.ὑψηλοῖο: ὑψηλός — high, lofty; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -οῦ)
glossary.ὕδωρ: ὕδωρ — water; neut. acc. sg. · also nom. sg. (identical neut. form), subject of a verb (ἄνεμός τε καὶ ὕδωρ ‘wind and current’)
glossary.ὤλετο: ὄλλυμι — destroy; mid. perish, be lost; aor. 3 sg. mid., augmented: ’has perished, is gone’
glossary.ὧδε: ὧδε — here, to this place, in this way; adv.
glossary.ῥείθρῳ: Ῥεῖθρον — Rheithron, ’stream’, a harbour in Ithaca; neut. dat. sg.
glossary.ῥινοῖσι: ῥινός — hide, skin; fem. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οῖς)
glossary.αἰὲν: αἰεί — always, ever; adv., epic by-form αἰέν (Attic ἀεί)
glossary.αἴ: εἰ — if; conditional conj., epic/dialectal by-form αἰ (used before κε)
glossary.αἴγισθον: Αἴγισθος — Aegisthus, seducer of Clytemnestra and killer of Agamemnon, later killed by Orestes; acc. sg.
glossary.αἴσχεα: αἶσχος — disgrace, shame, shameful thing; neut. acc. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic αἴσχη)
glossary.αὐτόν: αὐτός — self; masc. acc. sg.: ’himself’, or reinforcing a pronoun of any person (με … καὶ αὐτόν ’me myself as well’) · also plain acc. sg. pronoun, unemphatic ’him’ as direct object of a verb: ἤλασε δ’ αὐτόν ’struck him’ · also plain acc. sg. pronoun, unemphatic ’him’, as subject of an infinitive: αὐτόν τε ζώειν ’that he live’
glossary.αὐτῷ: αὐτός — self; masc. dat. sg.: ’himself’, reinforcing a personal pronoun (σοὶ δ’ αὐτῷ ’to you yourself’) · also used alone as a plain personal pronoun, ’him’, not reinforcing anything (ἐπ’ αὐτῷ μηχανόωνται ’are plotting against him’) · also with a noun, ’own, very’, in the dat. of accompaniment: αὐτῷ φάρει ’with the cloak itself, cloak and all’ · also reinforcing a 1st-person pronoun: ’myself’ (ἐμοὶ αὐτῷ) · also plain pronoun of a thing, ’it’, after a preposition (ἀμφ’ αὐτῷ ’around it’)
glossary.αὖ: αὖ — again, in turn, back; adv., shorter form of αὖτε
glossary.αὖτις: αὖτις — back, again, once more; adv. (= αὖθις)
glossary.γένετο: γίγνομαι — become, be born, happen; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐγένετο)
glossary.γαμέεσθαι: γαμέω — marry; pres. inf. mid., epic uncontracted (= Attic γαμεῖσθαι): of a woman, ’be married’
glossary.γενέσθαι: γίγνομαι — become, be born; aor. inf.: ’to have been born’ · also of time, ’come, arrive, come to pass’ (πρὶν δωδεκάτην γε γενέσθαι ’before the twelfth day should come’) · also with a dat., ’befall, come upon’ (πῆμα γενέσθαι ’woe to come upon us’)
glossary.γενεήν: γενεή — birth, race, lineage; acc. sg., Ionic η (= Attic γενεά)
glossary.γενοίατο: γίγνομαι — become; aor. opt. 3 pl., epic -ατο (= Attic γένοιντο): ’would become’
glossary.γούνασι: γόνυ — knee; dat. pl., epic γούνασι (= Attic γόνασι)
glossary.γόνον: γόνος — birth, offspring, begetting, stock; acc. sg.
glossary.γόους: γόος — weeping, wailing, lament; acc. pl.
glossary.γῆρας: γῆρας — old age; neut. nom. sg.
glossary.δάμη: δάμνημι — overpower, subdue, kill; aor. pass. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐδάμη): ’was laid low’
glossary.δαίνυσθαι: δαίνυμι — give a feast; mid. δαίνυμαι feast, banquet; pres. inf. mid.
glossary.δαίς: δαίς — feast, banquet (of shared portions); nom. sg.
glossary.δεύτατος: δεύτατος — last; superl. adj., masc. nom. sg. (from δεύτερος ’second’)
glossary.δεύῃ: δεύομαι — lack, be in want of, need; pres. 2 sg., epic (= Attic δέῃ), + gen.
glossary.διέπτατο: διαπέτομαι — fly away, fly off; aor. 3 sg., augment inside the compound (δι-έ-πτατο)
glossary.διαρραίσουσι: διαρραίω — break in pieces, destroy utterly; fut. 3 pl.
glossary.διζήμενος: δίζημαι — seek, search for; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’seeking’
glossary.δοκέουσι: δοκέω — seem, think; pres. 3 pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic δοκοῦσι)
glossary.δολόμητιν: δολόμητις — guileful, crafty-minded (δόλος + μῆτις); adj., masc. acc. sg.
glossary.δουλιχίῳ: Δουλίχιον — Dulichium, an island near Ithaca (exact location unknown); dat. sg.
glossary.δοῦρε: δόρυ — spear, shaft; acc. dual, epic stem δουρ-: ’two spears’
glossary.δυναμένοιο: δύναμαι — be able, be powerful; pres. part. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου): ’of great power’
glossary.δόλῳ: δόλος — guile, trick, cunning; dat. sg.: ’by guile’
glossary.δόμεναι: δίδωμι — give; aor. inf., epic -μεναι, used as imperative: ’give’ · also inf. after ὀτρύνω, ’to give’ (πομπὴν ὀτρύνω δόμεναι ’I urge (him) to give a conveyance’) · also inf. complementing an impersonal ’it seemed better’: ’to give’ (κέρδιον εἶναι … δόμεναι ’better to give’) · also inf. after the impersonal χρή: ’to give’ (σε χρὴ δόμεναι ’you ought to give’) · also inf. complementing ἔτλης: ’to bring oneself to give’ · also inf. after φθονέω: ’(do not) begrudge giving’ (οὔτε τινὰ φθονέω δόμεναι) · also inf. after ἐάω, ’to give’ (οὐκ ἐάσουσιν … δόμεναι ’they will not allow (it) to be given’) · also inf. complementing ἐθέλω, ’(if I) wish to give’ (αἴ κ’ ἐθέλωμι … δόμεναι)
glossary.δὴν: δήν — for a long time, long; adv.
glossary.δῖον: δῖος — heavenly, divine, illustrious; masc. acc. sg., epithet of heroes
glossary.δῶκεν: δίδωμι — give; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔδωκεν)
glossary.δῶμα: δῶμα — house, hall, dwelling; acc. sg. · also nom. sg. (identical neut. form), subject of a verb: ’the house’
glossary.εἰλαπίνη: εἰλαπίνη — a festive banquet, feast (given by a host); nom. sg.; derivation uncertain
glossary.εἴη: εἰμί — be; pres. opt. 3 sg.: ’it might be, he might be’; impersonal + inf.: ’it might be possible for him’ · also in a wish with a dat. of the person: ’may there be (for us)’ (εἴη μὲν νῦν νῶϊν … ἐδωδὴ ’may there be food for us two’) · also in a wish after εἰ γάρ, ’if only (all things) were’ · also in a fear clause after μή, ’lest it be (a god)’ · also in a conditional protasis: ’if he were’ (εἰ τοιόσδ’ εἴη) · also in an indirect question after a past verb: ’who he was’ (τίς εἴη) · also in a negative wish with μή, ’may (no man) be’ · also potential opt. with κε in a relative clause, ’which would be’ (τό κε κέρδιον εἴη ’which would be better’) · also in a wish after αἲ γάρ, with a perf. pass. part.: ’would that it were (fulfilled)’ (αἲ γὰρ … τετελεσμένον εἴη)
glossary.εἴπῃσι: εἶπον — say, tell; aor. subj. 3 sg., epic -ῃσι (= Attic εἴπῃ)
glossary.εἴρεο: εἴρομαι — ask, inquire; pres. imper. 2 sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἔρου)
glossary.ζακύνθῳ: Ζάκυνθος — Zacynthus, an island near Ithaca; dat. sg.
glossary.ηὔδα: αὐδάω — speak, say; impf. 3 sg., augmented (αὐ- → ηὐ-)
glossary.θάμβησεν: θαμβέω — be astonished, marvel; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐθάμβησεν)
glossary.θάρσος: θάρσος — courage, boldness; neut. acc. sg.
glossary.θανόντι: θνῄσκω — die; aor. part. dat. sg.: ’(for him) dead’
glossary.θοὴν: θοός — swift, quick; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.θοῆς: θοός — swift, quick; fem. gen. sg.
glossary.θυμὸς: θυμός — heart, spirit, desire; nom. sg.
glossary.θύρῃσι: θύρη — door; dat. pl., epic -ῃσι (= Attic θύραις; Ionic η for α)
glossary.θῆκαν: τίθημι — put, make; aor. 3 pl., unaugmented (= ἔθηκαν)
glossary.θῆκε: τίθημι — put, place, make; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔθηκε)
glossary.κάλλιπεν: καταλείπω — leave behind; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented, κατά shortened (κάλλιπεν = κατέλιπεν)
glossary.κάτα: κατά — down, throughout; prep. + acc., placed after its noun with anastrophe: κραναὴν Ἰθάκην κάτα ’throughout rocky Ithaca’ · also standing after its verb, not after a noun: ἔχῃ κάτα δῆμον ἅπαντα ’holds throughout the whole land’ (κατά + acc., or tmesis for κατέχῃ)
glossary.κέ: κε(ν) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν); accented before an enclitic · also + subj. in a purpose clause after ὄφρα: ’so that’ (ὄφρα κέ τοι λύσῃ ’so that she may free’) · also + subj. in the protasis after αἴ: ’if perhaps’ (αἴ κέ ποθι Ζεὺς δώῃ ’if Zeus should somehow grant’) · also + subj. in the protasis after εἴ: ’if perhaps’ (εἴ κέ τιν’ … εὕρωμεν ’if we should find any’) · also + opt. in the protasis after αἴ: ’if perhaps’ (αἴ κέ μοι … παρασταίης ’if you would stand by me’) · also + aor. indic., unreal past: τῷ κέ με … ὤνησεν ’would have benefited me’ · also + fut./short-vowel aor. subj. in a main clause: κέ τοι καταλέξω ’I shall tell you’ · also + opt. in the protasis after εἴ: ’if perhaps’ (εἴ κέ μιν ἀγγείλαιμι ’if I might report him’) · also + subj. after εἰς ὅ, ’until’ (εἰς ὅ κέ τοι φήνωσι ’until they show you’) · also + subj. in a prospective relative clause: ’who shall’ (ὅς κέ με κεῖσ’ ἀγάγῃ ’who shall lead me there’) · also + fut. indic. (or short-vowel subj.) in a clause after εἴ: ’whether perhaps’ (εἴ κέ σφι … τελευτήσει ’whether … it will come to pass for them’) · also + opt., potential, in a main clause: ’might’ (καί κέ τεο … πειρηθεῖμεν ’we might test any of’) · also + impf. indic., unreal past: ‘would have been’ (καί κέ τοι … ἀμφεπονεῖτο ‘would have been busy for you’) · also + opt. in a relative clause: ‘from where you would’ (ὅθεν κέ τοι … ἄλφοι)
glossary.κέν: κε(ν) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν); accented before an enclitic · also + aor. indic., unreal past: κέν μοι … κατέχευας ’you would have poured on me’ · also + subj. in a main clause: ’may’ (καί κέν οἱ ὑπέρσχῃ χεῖρα ’and he may hold his hand over him’) · also + opt., potential: ’would’ (κέν μοι … εἴη ’would be mine’) · also + subj. in the protasis after αἴ: ’if perhaps’ (αἴ κέν τις … ὀρέξῃ ’if perhaps someone holds out’) · also + subj. in a temporal clause: ’whenever’ (ὅτε κέν … μεταλλῶσιν ’whenever they ask’) · also + opt., potential, in a clause with ὅ ’that’: ’might’ (ὅ κέν τις … ἀμύνοι ’that someone might defend’)
glossary.κήδε: κῆδος — care, sorrow, trouble; neut. acc. pl., elided (κήδε’ = κήδεα, uncontracted; Attic κήδη) · also neut. nom. pl., subject (κήδε’ … τετεύχαται ’sorrows have been made ready’)
glossary.κακὰ: κακός — bad, evil; neut. acc. pl. · also neut. nom. pl., subject: κακὰ ἔργα ’bad deeds’
glossary.καλέσας: καλέω — call, summon; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having called’
glossary.καλόν: καλός — beautiful, fair, fine; masc. acc. sg. agreeing with a noun (καλόν τε μέγαν τε ’fine and tall’) · also neut. acc. sg., agreeing with a neuter noun (of a gift: τιμῆεν, μάλα καλόν ’precious, very fine’)
glossary.κατέρυκε: κατερύκω — hold back, detain; pres. imper. 2 sg. (with μή: ’stop holding back’) · also impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= Attic κατήρυκε): ’was holding back, tried to hold back’
glossary.κατελεύσομαι: κατέρχομαι — go down, come down (e.g. from a house to the shore); fut. 1 sg.
glossary.κειμήλιον: κειμήλιον — a treasure, thing laid up or stored (from κεῖμαι); nom. sg.
glossary.κεῖθεν: κεῖθεν — from there, thence; adv. (= ἐκεῖθεν, with -θεν ’from’)
glossary.κεῖσε: κεῖσε — to that place, thither; adv.
glossary.κλυτὸν: κλυτός — famous, renowned, glorious; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.κοιρανέουσιν: κοιρανέω — be lord or ruler over, hold sway; pres. 3 pl., ν-movable
glossary.κραναὴν: κραναός — rocky, rugged; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.κτέρεα: κτέρεα — funeral honours, funeral gifts (pl.); neut. acc. pl.
glossary.κτεάτεσσιν: κτέαρ — possession, property; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσι
glossary.κτείνῃς: κτείνω — kill, slay; pres. subj. 2 sg.
glossary.κτερεΐξαι: κτερεΐζω (= κτερίζω) — pay funeral honours to, perform funeral rites for; aor. inf., used as imperative
glossary.κῆρ: κῆρ — heart; neut. acc. sg., accusative of respect (φίλον κῆρ ’in his own heart’) · also neut. nom. sg., subject of a verb: κῆρ ἤθελε ’my heart wished’ · also κήρ — death-fate, doom; fem. acc. sg., elided (κῆρ’ = κῆρα): ’death-fate’ (θάνατον καὶ κῆρ’ ’death and doom’) · also neut. acc. sg., after ἀμφί: ’around the heart’
glossary.λήσομαι: λανθάνομαι — forget; fut. 1 sg. + gen.: ’I will forget’
glossary.λιλαιόμενόν: λιλαίομαι — desire eagerly, be eager for; pres. part. masc. acc. sg. + gen.: ’eager for’
glossary.λοεσσάμενός: λούω — wash, bathe; aor. part. mid. masc. nom. sg., epic λοεσσάμενος: ’having bathed’
glossary.μ: ἐγώ — I; encl. acc. sg., elided (μ’ = με): ’me’ · also = dat. μοι, elided before a vowel, with a dat. participle: ’to me’ (ἥ μ’ οἴῳ ἔρροντι συνήντετο, συναντάω + dat.)
glossary.μάκαρός: μάκαρ — blessed, fortunate, happy; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.μάλιστα: μάλα — very, much; superl. adv. μάλιστα: ’most of all, especially’ · also ’for the most part, mostly’ (μάλιστα ἦμαρ ’the greater part of the day’)
glossary.μάρτυροι: μάρτυς — witness; nom. pl., epic μάρτυροι (= Attic μάρτυρες)
glossary.μέγαν: μέγας — great, big, tall; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.μέγαρον: μέγαρον — hall, main room of the house; acc. sg.
glossary.μέλλεν: μέλλω — be about to, be destined to; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔμελλεν), + inf.: ’was on course to be’
glossary.μένοντες: μένω — remain, wait, stay; pres. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’waiting’
glossary.μή: μή — not; negative particle (used with imperatives and subjunctives, unlike οὐ) · also introducing a negative purpose/fear clause with the optative in secondary sequence: μή ἑ λάθοι ’lest he should escape notice’ · also μή + fut. inf. after a verb of swearing/promising, negating its content: μή ... βουλευσέμεν ’that ... will not plan’ · also ’lest’ with the subj. after a primary verb (μή πώς ... χαλεπήνῃ ’lest he be harsh’) · also in a question expecting the answer ’no’, after ἦ: ἦ μή … φάσθ’ ἔμμεναι; ’surely you do not say … are?’ · also ’lest’ + subj. after a past verb of urging (κελόμην … μή … λάθηται ’I urged … lest he forget’) · also in a condition, ’if … not’ (εἰ … μή τίς σε βιάζεται) · also with an infinitive used as an imperative, a prohibition: μή μ’ … καταλείπειν ’do not leave me’ · also negating a purpose clause after ἵνα: ’so that … not’ (ἵνα μή τι … ἀλγήσετε ’so that you may not suffer’) · also with the optative, a negative wish: ’may … not’ (μή … ἀντιβολήσαις) · also ὡς ἂν μή + subj., negative purpose: ’so that … not’ (ὡς ἂν μή σε κατατρύχῃ ’so that he may not wear you out’) · also + subj. giving the content of an oath, ’that no one …’ (ὀμόσσατε … μή τις … πλήξῃ ’swear that no one strike’) · also μή + subj. standing alone as a warning, ’lest’ (μή τίς τοι … ἀναστῇ ’lest someone rise up against you’) · also μή + fut. indic. in a fear clause: ’lest, I fear’ (μή τίς … νεμεσήσεται ’lest anyone resent’)
glossary.μεγάροιο: μέγαρον — hall; gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.μεγάροισι: μέγαρον — hall; dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
glossary.μελέτω: μέλω — be a care, be a concern; pres. imper. 3 sg. impersonal: ’let it be a care’
glossary.μενέλαον: Μενέλαος — Menelaus, king of Sparta, brother of Agamemnon; acc. sg.
glossary.μερμερίδαο: Μερμερίδης — son of Mermerus, patronymic of Ilus; gen. sg., epic -αο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.μετέλθοι: μετέρχομαι — come among, go to join; aor. opt. 3 sg.: ’should come among (them)’
glossary.μεταλλᾷς: μεταλλάω — inquire after, ask about; pres. 2 sg.
glossary.μηδ: μηδέ — and not, nor; neg. conj., elided (μηδ’ = μηδέ)
glossary.μητέρ: μήτηρ — mother; acc. sg., elided (μητέρ’ = μητέρα)
glossary.μητιόωντες: μητιάω — devise, plan, contrive; pres. part. masc. nom. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic μητιῶντες)
glossary.μῦθον: μῦθος — word, speech, thing said; acc. sg. · also a plan, scheme agreed on (τοῖον...τελέωμεν μῦθον ’let us carry out this plan’)
glossary.νέστορα: Νέστωρ — Nestor, king of Pylos; acc. sg.
glossary.νήσοισιν: νῆσος — island; dat. pl., epic -οισι(ν) (= Attic -οις)
glossary.νεμεσίζετο: νεμεσίζομαι — feel righteous anger, stand in awe of; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented, + acc.: ’stood in awe of’
glossary.νεμεσσήσαιτό: νεμεσάω — feel righteous indignation; aor. opt. 3 sg. mid. νεμεσσήσαιτο (double σ metri gratia), with κε: ’would be indignant’
glossary.νηπιάας: νηπιέη — childishness, childish thing; acc. pl. νηπιάας (from νήπιος ’child, fool’): ’childish ways’
glossary.νοήσας: νοέω — perceive, understand; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having perceived’
glossary.νοστήσας: νοστέω — return home; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having returned’
glossary.νώνυμνον: νώνυμνος — nameless, without a name; fem./masc. acc. sg. (νη- ’not’ + ὄνυμα, epic for ὄνομα)
glossary.νῆ: ναῦς — ship; acc. sg., epic νῆα, elided (νῆ’ = νῆα)
glossary.νῆα: ναῦς — ship; acc. sg., epic νῆα
glossary.ξανθὸν: ξανθός — yellow, tawny, fair (of hair); masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ξείνοισι: ξεῖνος — stranger, guest-friend; dat. pl. (epic = Attic ξένοις)
glossary.ξεῖν: ξεῖνος — stranger, guest-friend; voc. sg., elided (ξεῖν’ = ξεῖνε)
glossary.ξυνίει: ξυνίημι — perceive, understand, attend to (= συνίημι, ξυν- epic for συν-); pres. imper. 2 sg.: ’attend!’
glossary.οἰχομένοιο: οἴχομαι — be gone, have gone away; pres. part. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου), perfect sense: ’gone’
glossary.οἴχετ: οἴχομαι — be gone, have departed; pres. 3 sg., elided (οἴχετ’ = οἴχεται), perfect sense: ’is gone’
glossary.οἶδ: οἶδα — know; perf. 1 sg., elided (οἶδ’ = οἶδα) · also perf. 3 sg. (identical elided form): ’he/she knows’ (τίς δ’ οἶδ(ε) ’who knows’)
glossary.οἶκον: οἶκος — house, household (and its stores); acc. sg.
glossary.οἷα: οἷος — such as, of what kind; neut. acc. pl., relative: ’such (things) as’
glossary.οἷς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; masc./neut. dat. pl.: ’his own’ (μετὰ οἷς ἑτάροισι ’among his own companions’) · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ: which; masc./neut. dat. pl. (οἷς ἔπι ’on which’, of the stones)
glossary.οἷόν: οἷος — such as, of what sort; masc. acc. sg. correlative with τοῖος (τοῖος ἐὼν οἷόν μιν ’just such as when’) · also neut. acc. sg., adverbial and consecutive: ’so that, such that’ (οἷόν σ’ … οὐδέ σε πείθω) · also neut. acc. sg. used adverbially, + τε: ’such as, like’ (οἷόν τε κρομύοιο λοπὸν κάτα ’such as is along the skin of an onion’) · also masc. acc. sg., οἷόν τε + inf.: ’such as to, fit to’ (οἷόν τε … ἔμεναι ’such as to be’)
glossary.οὐκ: οὐ — not; neg. adv., form before a vowel with smooth breathing (οὐχ before a rough breathing)
glossary.οὐκί: οὐ — not; emphatic form οὐκί: ’not’ (ἦε καὶ οὐκί ’or not’)
glossary.πάντας: πᾶς — all, every; masc. acc. pl.
glossary.πάροιθεν: πάροιθεν — before, formerly; adv. · also + gen., spatial: ’in front of, before’ (πάροιθεν Ὀδυσσῆος μεγάροιο ’in front of Odysseus’s hall’)
glossary.πέφραδε: φράζω — point out, declare, tell; aor. imper. 2 sg., reduplicated (πέφραδε) · also aor. indic. 3 sg., reduplicated: ’pointed out’ (ᾗ οἱ Ἀθήνη πέφραδε ’where Athena had pointed out to him’)
glossary.πίθηαι: πείθομαι — be persuaded, obey; aor. subj. mid. 2 sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic πίθῃ)
glossary.πίνοντά: πίνω — drink; pres. part. masc. acc. sg.: ’drinking’
glossary.παιδί: παῖς — child, son; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.παιδὶ: παῖς — child, son; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.παιδὸς: παῖς — child, daughter; fem. gen. sg. (φίλης ... παιδός ’a dear daughter’) · also masc. gen. sg., ’son’ (παιδὸς ἐμοῖο ’my son’; τοῦ παιδὸς ἀγαυοῦ ’the noble son’)
glossary.παναχαιοί: Παναχαιοί — all the Achaeans together (πᾶς + Ἀχαιοί); masc. nom. pl.
glossary.πατρίδα: πατρίς — native land, fatherland; fem. acc. sg. (φίλην ... πατρίδα γαῖαν ’his dear fatherland’)
glossary.πατροφονῆα: πατροφονεύς — father-slayer, killer of one’s father; acc. sg., epic -ῆα (= Attic -έα)
glossary.πεπνυμένος: πέπνυμαι — have one’s wits about one, be prudent; perf. part. masc. nom. sg. (trad. linked to πνέω ’breathe’, though uncertain), stock epithet: ’prudent’
glossary.πευσόμενος: πυνθάνομαι — learn, inquire, ask; fut. part. masc. nom. sg., purpose: ’to learn of’
glossary.πηνελόπεια: Πηνελόπεια — Penelope, wife of Odysseus; nom. sg.
glossary.πικρόγαμοί: πικρόγαμος — of bitter marriage (πικρός ’bitter’ + γάμος); masc. nom. pl.
glossary.πινυτός: πινυτός — sensible, of sound mind; masc. nom. sg. (connected with πέπνυμαι)
glossary.ποιῆσαι: ποιέω — make, do; aor. inf.: ’to make (an end)’
glossary.πολλὸν: πολύς — much, many; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially, epic (= Attic πολύ): ’much’ · also attributive, neut. nom. sg. agreeing with μέθυ: ’much (wine)’ · also neut. acc. sg. as substantive object: ’much (wine)’ · also adj.: ’big’ · also epic πολλόν (= πολύν), masc. acc. sg., agreeing with χρόνον: ’long (time)’
glossary.ποτε: ποτέ — once, at some time, formerly; enclitic adv.
glossary.πού: πού — somewhere; enclitic adv., weakened to ’I suppose, perhaps’
glossary.πρώτῃσι: πρῶτος — first; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι (= Attic -αις)
glossary.πρῶτ: πρῶτος — first; neut. acc. pl. used adverbially, elided (πρῶτ’ = πρῶτα): ’first’
glossary.πρῶτα: πρῶτος — first; neut. acc. pl. used adverbially: ’first’
glossary.πυκινῶς: πυκινός — close-packed, shrewd, well-considered; adv. πυκινῶς: ’shrewdly, closely’
glossary.πώ: πώ — yet, up to now; enclitic adv. (usually with a negative)
glossary.σ: σύ — you (sg.); encl. acc. sg., elided (σ’ = σε): ’you’ · also σός — your, yours; neut. nom./acc. pl., elided (σ’ = σά): τὰ σ’ αὐτοῦ κήδε’ ’your own troubles’
glossary.σάμῃ: Σάμη — Same, an island near Ithaca; dat. sg.
glossary.σέ: σύ — you (sg.); acc. sg., accented before an enclitic: ’you’ (σέ γε τοῖον ἐγείνατο ’bore a son such as you’)
glossary.σκίδνασθαι: σκίδνημι — scatter, disperse; pres. inf. mid./pass.: ’to scatter’
glossary.σοὶ: σύ — you (sg.); dat. sg.: ’to, for you’
glossary.σπάρτηνδε: Σπάρτη — Sparta; acc. sg. + suffix -δε ’to, towards’: ’to Sparta’
glossary.σταίη: ἵστημι — stand, make to stand; aor. opt. 3 sg.: ’would stand’
glossary.στεναχίζω: στεναχίζω — groan, wail; pres. 1 sg., epic · also pres. subj. 1 sg., short-vowel, in a purpose clause after ὄφρα: ’that I may groan’
glossary.στυγερὸν: στυγερός — hateful, loathsome; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.σφέτερα: σφέτερος — their own; neut. acc. pl.: ’their own (homes)’
glossary.σῆμά: σῆμα — sign, mark, grave-mound; neut. acc. sg.
glossary.τάδε: ὅδε — this, this here; demonstrative pron., neut. nom./acc. pl.: ’these things’ · also with a noun, neut. acc. pl.: ’these’ (τάδε δώμαθ’ ’this house’, plural for one dwelling)
glossary.τίπτε: τίπτε — why ever, what then (= τί ποτε shortened); interrog. adv.
glossary.ταῦτά: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο — this; neut. nom./acc. pl.: ’these things’, accented before an enclitic
glossary.τεθνηῶτος: θνῄσκω — die; perf. part. gen. sg., epic τεθνηώς (Attic τεθνεώς), with ἀκούω ’hear of’: ’that he is dead’
glossary.τελευτήσῃς: τελευτάω — finish, accomplish, bring to an end; aor. subj. 2 sg.
glossary.τελευτὴν: τελευτή — end, completion, conclusion; acc. sg. (τελευτὴν ποιῆσαι ’to bring to an end’)
glossary.τεοῖσι: τεός — your (sg.), of you; possessive adj., epic (Attic σός); masc./neut. dat. pl. -οισι (= Attic σοῖς)
glossary.τερπόμενόν: τέρπω — delight, gladden; mid. τέρπομαι take delight, enjoy oneself; pres. part. masc. acc. sg.: ’taking his delight’
glossary.τεταρπόμενός: τέρπω — mid. τέρπομαι delight in, take one’s fill of; aor. part. mid. masc. nom. sg., reduplicated: ’having taken his fill’
glossary.τευ: τις, τι — someone, something; indefinite pron., masc./fem. gen. sg., epic τευ (= Attic τινός)
glossary.τεύξουσι: τεύχω — make, make ready, prepare; fut. 3 pl.
glossary.τηλίκος: τηλίκος — of such an age, so old; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.τιμῆεν: τιμήεις — precious, honoured; neut. nom./acc. sg., contracted τιμῆεν
glossary.τλαίης: τλῆναι (defective, root τλα-) — endure, bear, hold out; aor. opt. 2 sg.: ’you could endure’ · also + inf., ’bring oneself to, dare’ (τλαίης … ὀμόσσαι ’you would bring yourself to swear’)
glossary.τολύπευσεν: τολυπεύω — wind up, bring to completion (from τολύπη ’ball of wool’); aor. 3 sg., unaugmented: ’wound up’ (of a war)
glossary.τοῖος: τοῖος — such, of such a kind; masc. nom. sg. (τοῖος ... οἷον ’such as’)
glossary.τρυχόμενός: τρύχω — wear out, exhaust; pres. part. pass. masc. nom. sg.: ’worn down’
glossary.τρύχουσι: τρύχω — wear out, exhaust, consume; pres. 3 pl.
glossary.τόσσοι: τόσος — so many, so great; epic τόσσος, masc. nom. pl.: ’so many’ (correlative with ὅσσοι)
glossary.τύμβον: τύμβος — burial mound, grave-mound; acc. sg.
glossary.τὸ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. sg. (τὸ πάροιθεν ’that which was before’) · also with a noun, pointing to it: ’that, the’ (τὸ σῆμα ’that mark’) · also article-like before the adverb πάρος: ’as before’ (ὡς τὸ πάρος περ) · also article-like before an ordinal, adverbial: τὸ τρίτον ’the third time’ · also distributive, neut. nom./acc. sg.: τὸ μὲν … τὸ δὲ ’one thing … another’ · also article-like before the adverb πρόσθεν: ’formerly’ (τὸ πρόσθεν ὄλοντο ’died long before’) · also article-like before a substantivized adjective, neut.: τὸ μέλαν ’the dark (part)’ · also article-like before the adverb πάροιθε: ’formerly’ (τὸ πάροιθε ’in former times’) · also article-like before an infinitive, which it makes a noun: ’the (keeping watch)’ (τὸ φυλάσσειν) · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ: which; neut. acc. sg., object of its clause (τὸ πρὶν μέν ῥ’ ἐφόρει ’which he used to carry before’)
glossary.φάρμακον: φάρμακον — drug, potion (healing or deadly); acc. sg. · also nom. sg., subject: ’the drug’ (φάρμακον οὐλόμενον … ἔφυσε)
glossary.φέρεσθαι: φέρω — carry; mid. pres. inf.: ’to carry off for oneself’ · also pass. inf., ’to be carried’ (by the wind): Βορέῃ προβάλεσκε φέρεσθαι ’would toss it to the North Wind to be carried’
glossary.φίλα: φίλος — dear, one’s own; neut. acc. pl. used adverbially with φρονέω: ’with friendly thoughts, kindly’ · also plain attributive adj. agreeing with a neut. pl. noun: ’dear’ (τέκνα φίλα ’dear children’) · also neut. acc. pl. as substantive, object: ’dear things, kindnesses’ (φίλα ἔρδοι ’may do kindnesses’)
glossary.φίλην: φίλος — dear, one’s own; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.φίλοι: φίλος — dear, one’s own; masc. nom. pl.: ’dear (guest-friends)’ · also masc. voc. pl. (identical form), direct address: ’friends!’ (δεῦτε, φίλοι) · also attributive, with a noun: φίλοι υἷες ’dear sons’
glossary.φίλος: φίλος — dear, dear one; masc. nom. sg. used as voc.: ’friend’ · also plain attributive adjective, not vocative: ’dear’ (φίλος υἱός ’dear son’) · also predicate adjective: ’dear’ (φίλος ἦεν Ἰήσων ’Jason was dear (to her)’)
glossary.φθινύθουσιν: φθινύθω — waste, consume, cause to waste away (epic lengthened form of φθίνω); pres. 3 pl. transitive: ’waste, consume’
glossary.φιλέεσκε: φιλέω — love, be fond of; impf. 3 sg., iterative in -σκ- (unaugmented): ’used to be fond of’
glossary.φράζεσθαι: φράζω — point out, tell; mid. φράζομαι consider, think out, devise; pres. inf. mid.: ’to consider’; also used as an imperative: ’consider!’
glossary.φρένα: φρήν — mind, wits, heart; acc. sg. · also acc. of respect: ’in heart’ (γέγηθε φρένα ’is glad in heart’)
glossary.φώς: φώς — man, hero (poetic word); nom. sg.
glossary.χαίρων: χαίρω — rejoice, be glad; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’rejoicing’
glossary.χαλκήρεας: χαλκήρης — fitted with bronze; masc. acc. pl.
glossary.χαλκοχιτώνων: χαλκοχίτων — bronze-shirted, with tunic of bronze (χαλκός + χιτών); gen. pl.
glossary.χερσίν: χείρ — hand; fem. dat. pl., ν-movable
glossary.χεῦαι: χέω — pour, heap up; aor. inf., used as imperative: ’heap up’ (of a grave-mound)
glossary.χρίεσθαι: χρίω — anoint, smear; mid. pres. inf.: ’to smear (for oneself)’
glossary.χρεώ: χρεώ — need, necessity; nom. sg., impersonal noun (σε χρεώ ’there is need on you’)
glossary.χρὴ: χρή — it is necessary, it is right; impersonal verb + acc. and inf. · also + acc. of the person and gen. of the thing: ’there is need of’
glossary.ἀγορεύεις: ἀγορεύω — speak out, declare, say; pres. 2 sg.
glossary.ἀκαχοίμην: ἀκαχίζω — grieve, be distressed; reduplicated aor. opt. 1 sg.: ’I would grieve’
glossary.ἀκλειῶς: ἀκλεής — without fame, inglorious; adv. ἀκλειῶς, epic spelling (= Attic ἀκλεῶς): ’without fame’
glossary.ἀμοιβῆς: ἀμοιβή — exchange, return, requital; gen. sg. (ἄξιον ἀμοιβῆς ’worth a return’)
glossary.ἀμύμων: ἀμύμων — blameless, excellent (an old epithet whose exact force is uncertain); masc./fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀνέγνω: ἀναγιγνώσκω — know for certain, recognise; aor. 3 sg., augment inside the compound (ἀν-έ-γνω), gnomic · also an ordinary narrative aor., not gnomic: ’recognised’ (νόον … ἀνέγνω ’recognised the mind’)
glossary.ἀνέρι: ἀνήρ — man, husband; dat. sg.: ’to a husband’ · also dat. sg. of the person concerned: ’for a man’
glossary.ἀναιδέσι: ἀναιδής — shameless (ἀν- + αἰδώς); masc. dat. pl.
glossary.ἀνδροφόνον: ἀνδροφόνος — man-slaying, murderous (ἀνήρ + φόνος); neut. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀνείρεαι: ἀνείρομαι — ask, inquire; pres. 2 sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic -ῃ)
glossary.ἀνερχομένῳ: ἀνέρχομαι — come back, return; pres. part. masc. dat. sg.: ’to me as I come back’
glossary.ἀνηρείψαντο: ἀνερείπομαι — snatch up and carry away; aor. 3 pl., augment inside the compound (ἀν-ηρείψαντο, ε lengthened to η)
glossary.ἀνθρώποισι: ἄνθρωπος — human being, man; dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
glossary.ἀνιόντα: ἄνειμι — come back, go up; pres. part. masc. acc. sg.: ’on his way back’
glossary.ἀντίον: ἀντίον — face to face, in answer, opposite; adv. · also prep. + gen.: ’opposite, facing’ (ἀντίον Εὐρυμάχου ’opposite Eurymachus’)
glossary.ἀνόπαια: ἀνόπαια — meaning disputed: ’upward’, or ’unseen’, or (divided ἀν’ ὀπαῖα) ’up through the smoke-vent’, or the name of a bird; adv., hapax legomenon
glossary.ἀνώγῃ: ἄνωγα — bid, command (perf. with pres. sense); subj. 3 sg.: ’may bid’
glossary.ἀπέβη: ἀποβαίνω — go away, depart; aor. 3 sg., augment inside the compound (ἀπ-έ-βη)
glossary.ἀποιχομένου: ἀποίχομαι — be gone away, be absent; pres. part. masc. gen. sg.: ’gone away’
glossary.ἀποτίσεται: ἀποτίνω — pay back, make pay, exact requital; fut. mid. 3 sg. ’will exact payment’, or perh. short-vowel aor. subj. (the form does not decide)
glossary.ἀποτμότατος: ἄποτμος — ill-fated, unlucky (ἀ- + πότμος); superl., masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀπώσεαι: ἀπωθέω — thrust away, drive out; 2 sg. mid., epic uncontracted, either fut. ’you will thrust away’ or short-vowel aor. subj. (the form does not decide)
glossary.ἀρίστη: ἄριστος — best; superl., fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀρνεῖται: ἀρνέομαι — refuse, deny, say no to; pres. 3 sg.
glossary.ἀρτυνέουσιν: ἀρτύνω — arrange, prepare, make ready; fut. 3 pl., epic uncontracted
glossary.ἀσχαλόωσι: ἀσχαλάω — be vexed, chafe, be impatient; pres. 3 pl., epic diectasis (= Attic ἀσχαλῶσι)
glossary.ἀφνειὸς: ἀφνειός — wealthy, rich; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀχαιῶν: Ἀχαιοί — the Achaeans, the Greeks; gen. pl.
glossary.ἂρ: ἄρα — then, so, as it seems; inferential particle, grave form ἂρ (ἐπεὶ ἂρ δή ’since, as it seems’)
glossary.ἄιστον: ἄιστος — unseen, vanished without trace (ἀ- + root of ἰδεῖν); masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἄιστος: ἄιστος — unseen, vanished without trace; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἄλκιμος: ἄλκιμος — strong in defence, valiant, brave (from ἀλκή); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἄνωγα: ἄνωγα — bid, command, order; perf. 1 sg. with pres. sense: ’I bid’
glossary.ἄνωχθι: ἄνωγα — bid, command; perf. imper. 2 sg.: ’bid! order!’
glossary.ἄξιον: ἄξιος — worth, worthy; neut. nom. sg., + gen.: ’worth (a return)’ · also ἄξιος — worth, worthy; masc. acc. sg., attributive: ’a worthy (price)’ (ἄξιον ὦνον) · also ἄξιος — worth, worthy; neut. acc. sg., substantive object: ‘a worthy (price)’ (ἄξιον ἄλφοι ‘would fetch a worthy price’)
glossary.ἄπυστος: ἄπυστος — unheard of, of whom nothing is learned (from root of πυνθάνομαι); masc. nom. sg. · also active, ’without tidings, not having heard’ (οὐδὲ δὴν ἦεν ἄπυστος ’nor was he long without tidings’)
glossary.ἄρ: ἄρα — then, so, as it seems; inferential particle, elided form ἄρ’ before a vowel · also the shortened form ἄρ used, without true elision, before τε in the fixed collocation ἄρ τε: τὰ μὲν ἄρ τε διεσκέδασ’ · also ἄρ before an elided κ’ (κε), ’then’, in a question: ἦ ἄρ κ’ ἐθέλοις ’would you then be willing?’ · also the shortened ἄρ before a consonant, without elision: ’then’ (ἐπεὶ ἄρ βλέφαρ’ … ἀμφικαλύψῃ ’when then (sleep) has covered the eyelids’) · also ἄρ before ἕζετ’ without elision: ’then’ (κατ’ ἄρ ἕζετ’ ’then sat down’)
glossary.ἄρσας: ἀραρίσκω — fit together, equip, fit out; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having fitted out’
glossary.ἅρπυιαι: Ἅρπυιαι — the Harpies, snatching storm-winds personified as beings that carry people off without trace (from ἁρπάζω); nom. pl.
glossary.ἐβόλοντο: βόλομαι — wish, will (epic by-form of βούλομαι); impf. 3 pl., augmented: ’willed’
glossary.ἐγείνατο: γείνομαι — beget, bear; aor. 3 sg. mid., augmented: ’bore’
glossary.ἐλθὲ: ἔρχομαι — go, come; aor. imper. 2 sg.: ’go!’
glossary.ἐμεῦ: ἐγώ — I; gen. sg., epic (= Attic ἐμοῦ): ’from me’ · also gen. as object of a verb of remembering: μνήσῃ ἐμεῦ ’you may remember me’ · also gen. with ἀέκητι: ’(against) my (will)’ (ἐμεῦ ἀέκητι) · also gen. after δαήσεαι ’learn’: ’about me’ (ἐμεῦ … δαήσεαι)
glossary.ἐμοὶ: ἐγώ — I; dat. sg.: ’to, for me’ · also dat. of possession: ’mine is, I have’ (ἐμοὶ δ’ ὄνομα ’my name is’)
glossary.ἐμπάζεο: ἐμπάζομαι — heed, care for, take account of; pres. imper. mid. 2 sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἐμπάζου), + gen.
glossary.ἐμός: ἐμός — my, mine; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἐμὴν: ἐμός — my, mine; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἐμῶν: ἐμός — my, mine; masc. gen. pl.
glossary.ἐνιαυτόν: ἐνιαυτός — year; acc. sg., accusative of duration: ’for a year’ · also as object of εἰς marking duration: εἰς ἐνιαυτόν ’for a year’
glossary.ἐνόησα: νοέω — perceive, catch sight of, notice; aor. 1 sg., augmented
glossary.ἐπίμεινον: ἐπιμένω — wait, stay on, remain; aor. imper. 2 sg.
glossary.ἐπαλαστήσασα: ἐπαλαστέω — be indignant, be bitterly moved (rare verb, from ἄλαστος ’not to be forgotten’); aor. part. fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἐπειγόμενός: ἐπείγω — press, urge on; mid./pass. ἐπείγομαι be in haste, press on; pres. part. masc. nom. sg., + gen.: ’pressing on (for the road)’
glossary.ἐπιδήμιος: ἐπιδήμιος — at home, in one’s own land (from δῆμος); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἐπικρατέουσιν: ἐπικρατέω — hold power over, rule; pres. 3 pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic -οῦσιν), + dat.
glossary.ἐπὴν: ἐπήν — when, whenever (= ἐπεὶ ἄν); conj. + subj. · also + opt. in a generalizing conditional clause, without a further ἄν/κε: ἐπὴν κρητῆρι μιγείη ’when it has been mixed’
glossary.ἐρέτῃσιν: ἐρέτης — rower, oarsman; dat. pl., epic -ῃσι (= Attic -αις)
glossary.ἐρεείνεις: ἐρεείνω — ask, question (epic, from ἔρομαι); pres. 2 sg.
glossary.ἐστίν: εἰμί — be; pres. 3 sg., ν-movable form
glossary.ἐφείη: ἐφίημι — send against, lay (hands) on; aor. opt. 3 sg.: ’would lay (his hands) on’
glossary.ἐφορμᾶται: ἐφορμάω — stir up, urge on; mid./pass. ἐφορμάομαι be roused, be set upon; pres. 3 sg.: ’is set upon, urges’
glossary.ἐφύρης: Ἐφύρη — Ephyra, name of several towns, not always identifiable; gen. sg.
glossary.ἐόντος: εἰμί — be; pres. part. gen. sg., epic (= Attic ὄντος): ’being, alive’
glossary.ἑ: ἕ — him, her, it; epic encl. acc. sg. reflexive/personal pron. (= Attic αὐτόν/-ήν/-ό)
glossary.ἑλών: αἱρέω — take, choose; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’picking out, choosing’ · also ’taking hold of, seizing’ (γούναθ’ ἑλών ’grasping the knees’)
glossary.ἑοῖς: ἑός — his own, her own (by-form of the possessive ὅς); masc./neut. dat. pl.
glossary.ἑτάροισι: ἕταρος — companion (by-form of ἑταῖρος); dat. pl., epic -οισι
glossary.ἑτέρως: ἕτερος — other, otherwise; adv. ἑτέρως: ’otherwise, the other way’
glossary.ἑὸν: ἑός — his own, her own (possessive, by-form of ὅς); masc. acc. sg. · also neut. acc./nom. sg., agreeing with a neuter noun (δῶμα ἑὸν ’his own hall’)
glossary.ἔδοντες: ἔδω — eat (epic, = Attic ἐσθίω); pres. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’eating’
glossary.ἔεδνα: ἔεδνα — wedding gifts, bridal gifts (prothetic ἐ-, beside ἕδνα); neut. acc. pl.
glossary.ἔκ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; prep. + gen., placed after its pronoun with anastrophe: τοῦ ... ἔκ = ἐκ τοῦ ’from him’ · also as a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἔκ … ὀνόμαζε = ἐξωνόμαζε ’called by name’) · also prep. + gen. with a particle between it and its noun: ἔκ γε γυναικός ’at the hands of a woman’
glossary.ἔκτα: κτείνω — kill, slay; aor. 3 sg., by-form ἔκτα (root aorist)
glossary.ἔλλαβε: λαμβάνω — take, win, get; aor. 3 sg., augmented with double λ, epic (= Attic ἔλαβε)
glossary.ἔοικε: ἔοικα — be fitting, seem; perf. with pres. sense, impersonal 3 sg.: ’it is fitting’ · also personal, ’is like, resembles’ + dat. (θεοῖσιν ἔοικε ’he is like the gods’)
glossary.ἔπι: ἐπί — on, upon, over; prep. + dat., placed after its noun with anastrophe: ἑοῖς ἔπι ’upon his own (possessions)’ · also + gen., postpositive with anastrophe, of direction: ’toward’ (νήσου ἔπι Ψυρίης ’toward the island of Psyria’) · also as adverb with no case expressed, intensifying repetition: ’besides, again’ (ἔπι δεύτερον αὖτις ’a second time, once more’) · also = ἔπεστι, accented on the first syllable when it stands for the verb: ’there is (upon)’ · also as preverb in tmesis, placed after its object: ἔπι … ὦρσεν = ἐπῶρσεν ’stirred up (against)’ · also + gen., postpositive with anastrophe, of place: ’on, upon’ (οὐδοῦ ἔπι ξεστοῦ ’on the polished threshold’) · also + acc., postpositive with anastrophe, of place: ’over, upon’ (γαῖαν ἔπι ’over the earth’)
glossary.ἔπλετο: πέλομαι — be, become, happen; aor. 3 sg. used with pres. force: ’is’ · also with ordinary past/aorist force: ’came to be, arose’ (τοῦτο νόημα ἔπλετο ’this thought has arisen’)
glossary.ἔρανος: ἔρανος — a meal to which each guest contributes his share (as against a feast given by a host); nom. sg.
glossary.ἔρξῃς: ἔρδω — do, work, accomplish (= ῥέζω); aor. subj. 2 sg.
glossary.ἔρχεο: ἔρχομαι — go, come; pres. imper. 2 sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἔρχου)
glossary.ἔσσ: εἰμί — be; pres. imper. 2 sg., epic ἔσσο, elided (ἔσσ’ = ἔσσο; = Attic ἴσθι): ’be!’
glossary.ἔστων: εἰμί — be; pres. imper. 3 pl.: ’let them be’
glossary.ἔτ: ἔτι — still, yet; adv., elided (ἔτ’ = ἔτι)
glossary.ἔτετμε: τέτμον (defective) — come upon, overtake; reduplicated aor. 3 sg., augmented: ’overtook’
glossary.ἔτευξαν: τεύχω — make, fashion, cause; aor. 3 pl., augmented
glossary.ἔχων: ἔχω — have, hold; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’holding’
glossary.ἕπεσθαι: ἕπομαι — follow, accompany, go with; pres. inf.: ’to go with, accompany’
glossary.ἠδέ: ἠδέ — and; epic conjunction, accented before an enclitic
glossary.ἡμετέρῳ: ἡμέτερος — our, ours; masc./neut. dat. sg.
glossary.ἤ: ἤ — or; disjunctive conj., accented before an enclitic (ἤ κεν); ἤ … ἦε ’whether … or’ · also ’than’ after a comparative: μεῖζον … ἤ ’greater than’ · also ’than’, ’rather than’, after a verb of preferring (βούλομ’ … ἤ τινα ’I prefer … to any’) · also the first of two alternatives, accented before an enclitic: ’either … or’ (ἤ ῥά νύ που … ἢ ὅ γ’ ’either … or’)
glossary.ἤδη: ἤδη — now, already, at once; adv.
glossary.ἤρατ: ἀείρω — lift, raise (Attic αἴρω); mid. win, gain for oneself; aor. mid. 3 sg., augmented, elided (ἤρατ’ = ἤρατο): ’won’; in sense the aorist of ἄρνυμαι ’win’, under which some lexica file it
glossary.ἥρωας: ἥρως — hero, man of rank or noble birth; acc. pl.
glossary.ἦε: ἠέ — or; epic conj. (= Attic ἤ), spelled ἦε in ἦε καὶ οὐκί ’or not’
glossary.ἦλθεν: ἔρχομαι — come, go; aor. 3 sg., augmented: ’came’
glossary.ἰσόθεος: ἰσόθεος — equal to a god, godlike (ἴσος + θεός); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἴλου: Ἶλος — Ilus, son of Mermerus, in Ephyra; gen. sg.
glossary.ἴτω: εἶμι — go; pres. imper. 3 sg.: ’let her go’ · also of a man: ’let him go’
glossary.ὀίσατο: ὀίομαι — think, suppose, imagine; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented
glossary.ὀδυρόμενος: ὀδύρομαι — lament, mourn; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’lamenting’
glossary.ὀδύνας: ὀδύνη — pain, grief, anguish; acc. pl.
glossary.ὀπίσσω: ὀπίσσω — behind; in Homer also ’hereafter, in time to come’; adv. · also ’back, home again’, of return (οἴκαδ’ ὀπίσσω ’back home’)
glossary.ὀχέειν: ὀχέω — carry, keep up, uphold; pres. inf., epic uncontracted: ’to carry on, keep up (childish ways)’
glossary.ὀψιγόνων: ὀψίγονος — late-born, born in later generations; masc. gen. pl.
glossary.ὁδοῖο: ὁδός — road, way, journey; gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -οῦ)
glossary.ὁμιλήσειεν: ὁμιλέω — be in company with, meet, consort with; aor. opt. 3 sg., wish: ’might he come among’
glossary.ὁρόω: ὁράω — see; pres. 1 sg., epic stretched form (= Attic ὁρῶ)
glossary.ὁρόων: ὁράω — see; pres. part. masc. nom. sg., epic stretched (= Attic ὁρῶν): ’seeing’
glossary.ὄσσαν: ὄσσα — voice, rumour, report (personified, from Zeus); acc. sg. · also Ὄσσα — Ossa, a mountain in Thessaly; fem. acc. sg.: ’Mount Ossa’
glossary.ὄφελον: ὀφείλω — owe; aor. 1 sg., unaugmented (Attic ὤφελον), with an infinitive, an unattainable wish: ’would that...’
glossary.ὅδ: ὅδε — this, this here; demonstrative pron., masc. nom. sg., elided (ὅδ’ = ὅδε)
glossary.ὅμιλος: ὅμιλος — crowd, throng, gathering; nom. sg.
glossary.ὅππως: ὅπως — how, in what way; epic ὅππως (double π metri gratia), with κε + subj. (or fut.): ’how you are to…’ · also + opt. in an indirect question after a past verb: ’how he might’ (ὅππως νοστήσει’ … ’how he might return’)
glossary.ὅσσα: ὅσος — as much/many as; epic ὅσσος (double σ), neut. nom./acc. pl.: ’as many as’
glossary.ὅσσοι: ὅσος — as much/many as; epic ὅσσος, masc. nom. pl.: ’as many as’ (correlative with τόσσοι)
glossary.ὑβρίζοντες: ὑβρίζω — act violently or insolently, commit outrage (from ὕβρις); pres. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’behaving insolently’
glossary.ὑπέμνησέν: ὑπομιμνῄσκω — remind; aor. 3 sg., augment inside the compound (ὑπ-έ-μνησεν), + gen.: ’made mindful of’
glossary.ὑποθήσομαι: ὑποτίθημι — suggest, advise, put before; fut. mid. 1 sg.: ’I will advise’
glossary.ὠκύμοροί: ὠκύμορος — swift-doomed, early-doomed (ὠκύς + μόρος); masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ὧδ: ὧδε — so, thus, in this way; adv., elided (ὧδ’ = ὧδε)
glossary.ᾗσι: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; fem. dat. pl.: ’in his own (mind)’ (φρεσὶν ᾗσι) · also relative, fem. dat. pl.: ’for those toward whom’ (ᾗσι τ’ ἐὺ φρονέῃσι ’for those toward whom she is well disposed’)
glossary.ᾤχετο: οἴχομαι — be gone, go, have gone; impf. 3 sg., augmented (οἰ- → ᾠ-): ’had gone’ · also of continuous motion, ’went about, kept going’ (κατὰ πτόλιν ᾤχετο πάντῃ ’she went everywhere throughout the city’)
glossary.ᾧ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; masc. dat. sg.: ’his own (son)’ · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: whom, which; masc. dat. sg. (δοίη δ’ ᾧ κ’ ἐθέλοι ’give her to whom he wished’) · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅν, neut. dat. sg. (same form), agreeing with a neut. noun: πεδίοιο ... ᾧ ἔνι ... ’a plain in which is...’ · also possessive ὅς, ἥ, ὅν, neut. dat. sg., agreeing with ἄχεϊ: ’her own (grief)’
glossary.ῥα: ἄρα — then, so; weak enclitic form ῥα (used after a vowel)
glossary.αἰθομένας: αἴθω/αἴθομαι — burn, blaze; pres. part. mid. fem. acc. pl. (agreeing with δαΐδας): ’burning’
glossary.αἴτιοι: αἴτιος — responsible, to blame; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.αἴτιος: αἴτιος — responsible, to blame; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.αἶψά: αἶψα — quickly, soon, at once; adv.
glossary.αὐδήν: αὐδή — voice, human speech; fem. acc. sg., accusative of respect: ’in voice’ · also as the direct object of a verb of hearing (θεοῦ ἔκλυεν αὐδήν ’heard the voice of the god’)
glossary.αὐτοῦ: αὐτός — self; masc. gen. sg., intensive with a possessive (ἑὸν αὐτοῦ ’his own very own’): ’of himself’ · also the fixed adv. αὐτοῦ, ’there, on the spot, right here’ · also plain gen. sg. pronoun, unemphatic ’him’, governed by a preposition: ἀπ’ αὐτοῦ ’from him’ · also intensive with a noun, masc. gen. sg.: ’Alcinous himself’ (αὐτοῦ Ἀλκινόοιο) · also reflexive intensive gen. sg. after a personal pronoun: σέο τ’ αὐτοῦ ’and of yourself’ · also plain gen. sg. pronoun of a thing, ’from it’, after ἐκ (ἐκ δ’ αὐτοῦ πείρατ’ ἀνήφθω, of the mast) · also masc. gen. sg., intensive with a possessive sense, ’his own’: αὐτοῦ ἐνεύναιον ’his own bedding’, αὐτοῦ βώτορες ’his own herdsmen’ · also plain gen. sg. pronoun with a noun, ’his’: ὀστέα δ’ αὐτοῦ ’and his bones’ · also intensive gen. sg. with a demonstrative and noun: τοῦδ’ αὐτοῦ λυκάβαντος ’this very year’ · also plain gen. sg. pronoun of a thing, ’upon it’, after ἐπί (ἐπ’ αὐτοῦ, of a stool) · also gen. sg. pronoun of comparison after a comparative: ’than he’ (προγενέστερος αὐτοῦ ’older than he’) · also masc. gen. sg. after περί: ’about himself’ (περί τ’ αὐτοῦ καὶ περὶ πάντων) · also plain gen. sg. pronoun governed by ἄγχι ’near’: ’him’ (ἄγχι δ’ αὐτοῦ ’close beside him’)
glossary.αὐτός: αὐτός — self; intensive pron., masc. nom. sg.: ’he himself’ · also masc. nom. sg. with a 1st-person subject: ’myself’ (ἐγὼ … αὐτός) · also masc. nom. sg. with a 2nd-person subject: ’you yourself’ (ὄφρα καὶ αὐτός ’so that you too yourself’)
glossary.αὐτῆς: αὐτός — self; fem. gen. sg., intensive with a possessive (τὰ σ’ αὐτῆς ἔργα ’your own works’): ’of yourself’ · also plain gen. sg. governed by ἄγχι ’near, close to’: ’her’ (ἄγχι δ’ αὐτῆς ’close beside her’) · also plain gen. sg. pronoun ’it’ (of a ship, fem.), governed by a noun: χρεὼ ... αὐτῆς ’a need of it’ · also plain gen. sg. pronoun ’it’ (of a raft, fem.), governed by a preposition: ἐπ’ αὐτῆς ’upon it’ · also plain gen. sg. pronoun ’her’, possessive with a noun: νόος ... αὐτῆς ’her mind’ · also plain gen. sg. pronoun ’her’, governed by a preposition, of a monster: ἀπ’ αὐτῆς ’away from her’ · also plain gen. sg. pronoun ’it’ (of the olive), governed by ἀγχόθι ’near’: ἀγχόθι δ’ αὐτῆς ’and near it’ · also intensive with a noun, fem. gen. sg.: αὐτῆς Ἰθάκης ’Ithaca itself’ · also ὁ αὐτός ’the same’, fem. gen. sg. with the article: τῆς αὐτῆς ἀγγελίης ’the same news’ · also reflexive intensive gen. sg. after a personal pronoun, of a woman speaking: ἐξ ἐμεῦ … αὐτῆς ’from me myself’ · also plain gen. sg. pronoun ’it’ (of a chair), after ἐκ: ἐξ αὐτῆς ’out of it’
glossary.αὖτ: αὖτε (elided αὖτ’) — again, in turn, moreover; epic adv./conj.
glossary.βάλε: βάλλω — throw, cast; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔβαλε): ’cast’ · also ’hit, strike’, with the person or part struck as object: ’struck’ (βάλε δεξιὸν ὦμον ’struck the right shoulder’)
glossary.βίηφιν: βίη — force, might, violence; instrumental case in -φι(ν) (= dat. βίῃ): ’by force’
glossary.βασιλευέμεν: βασιλεύω — be king, rule; pres. inf., epic ending -έμεν (= Attic βασιλεύειν)
glossary.βασιλεύσει: βασιλεύω — be king, rule; fut. 3 sg.
glossary.βασιλῆα: βασιλεύς — king; acc. sg., epic βασιλῆα (= Attic βασιλέα)
glossary.βασιλῆες: βασιλεύς — king; nom. pl., epic βασιλῆες (= Attic βασιλεῖς)
