glossary.βεβήκει: βαίνω — go, walk, step; plpf. 3 sg. with simple past force (Homeric pluperfect): ’had gone, went’
glossary.βλεφάροισι: βλέφαρον — eyelid; neut. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
glossary.βοητὺς: βοητύς — shouting, clamor, din; fem. nom. sg., rare noun from βοάω
glossary.βούλευε: βουλεύω — plan, deliberate, ponder; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐβούλευε)
glossary.γέ: γε — at least, in fact, indeed; limiting/emphatic particle, accented γέ before a following enclitic
glossary.γενεὴ: γενεή — birth, lineage, descent; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.γενεῇ: γενεή — birth, lineage, descent; fem. dat. sg.: ’by birth’
glossary.γνώμεναι: γιγνώσκω — come to know, recognize; epic inf. in -μεναι: ’to be known’
glossary.γραίης: γραῦς — old woman; fem. gen. sg., epic γραίης
glossary.γυναικός: γυνή — woman, wife; fem. gen. sg.
glossary.γυναικῶν: γυνή — woman; fem. gen. pl., partitive with δῖα: ’heavenly-one of women’ · also partitive with ἀρίστη: ’best of women’ · also possessive gen. with a noun: ἔργα γυναικῶν ’the works of women’ · also gen. after a verb of surpassing, ’above, beyond women’ (περίεσσι γυναικῶν) · also gen. pl. dependent on a noun of speech, ’of … women’ (φάτιν ἀνδρῶν ἠδὲ γυναικῶν ’the talk of men and of women’)
glossary.δέδμητο: δέμω — build; plpf. pass. 3 sg.: ’had been built’ · also homograph of δάμνημι/δαμάζω — subdue; plpf. pass. 3 sg.: ‘had been subdued, was in subjection’ (λαὸς δέδμητο ὑπ’ αὐτῷ)
glossary.δαινύμενοι: δαίνυμι — feast; mid. pres. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’feasting’
glossary.δακρύσασα: δακρύω — weep, shed tears; aor. part. fem. nom. sg.: ’having burst into tears’
glossary.δαναῶν: Δαναοί — the Danaans, the Greeks; masc. gen. pl.
glossary.δαῖτας: δαίς — feast, meal; fem. acc. pl.
glossary.διδόντος: δίδωμι — give; pres. part. masc. gen. sg., genitive absolute: ’Zeus granting it’
glossary.δμώων: δμώς — slave, bondman (esp. war-captive); masc. gen. pl.
glossary.δμῳάων: δμῳή — slave-woman, bondwoman; fem. gen. pl., epic -άων (= Attic -ῶν)
glossary.δοκέει: δοκέω — seem, think; pres. 3 sg., uncontracted (= Attic δοκεῖ)
glossary.δόμοιο: δόμος — house; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.δῷσι: δίδωμι — give; aor. subj. 3 sg.: ’may grant’
glossary.εὐπείθεος: Εὐπείθης — Eupeithes, father of Antinous; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.εὐρύκλει: Εὐρύκλεια — Eurycleia, Odysseus’s old nurse; fem. voc. sg., elided (Εὐρύκλει’ = Εὐρύκλεια) · also nom. sg. (identical form), in apposition naming a subject already introduced (’Eurycleia, Ops’ daughter...’), not vocative address
glossary.εὐρύμαχ: Εὐρύμαχος — Eurymachus, a leading suitor; masc. voc. sg., elided (Εὐρύμαχ’ = Εὐρύμαχε)
glossary.εὐρύμαχος: Εὐρύμαχος — Eurymachus, a leading suitor, son of Polybus; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.εὐρὺ: εὐρύς — wide, broad; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’widely’ · also attributive, agreeing with a neut. noun: ’wide’ (κλέος εὐρύ ’wide fame’)
glossary.εὔχεται: εὔχομαι — claim, boast, profess; pres. 3 sg.: ’claims (to be)’ · also pray, + dat.: ’prays’ (Διὶ δ’ εὔχεται ’and to Zeus he prays’)
glossary.ζεὺς: Ζεύς — Zeus, king of the gods; nom. sg.
glossary.θάλαμος: θάλαμος — chamber, room; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.θάνε: θνῄσκω — die; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔθανε)
glossary.θέσπιν: θέσπις — god-given, inspired; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.θαλάμοιο: θάλαμος — chamber, room; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.θαλάμου: θάλαμος — chamber, room; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.θαμβήσασα: θαμβέω — be astonished, marvel; aor. part. fem. nom. sg.
glossary.θαύμαζον: θαυμάζω — marvel at, wonder at; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented
glossary.θελκτήρια: θελκτήριον — charm, means of enchantment; neut. acc. pl.
glossary.θεοπροπίης: θεοπροπίη — a prophetic utterance, oracle; fem. gen. sg.
glossary.θεοπρόπον: θεοπρόπος — soothsayer, seer; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.θεῖον: θεῖος — divine, god-inspired; masc. acc. sg. · also neut. acc. sg., agreeing with a neuter noun (θεῖον ποτόν ’divine drink’)
glossary.κάκιστον: κακός — bad, evil; superl. κάκιστος, neut. acc. sg.: ’worst’
glossary.κέλευε: κελεύω — command, order; pres. imper. 2 sg.
glossary.καθ: κατά (elided καθ’) — down, throughout; prep. + acc., aspirated before rough breathing
glossary.καθίκετο: καθικνέομαι — come upon, reach, befall; aor. 3 sg.
glossary.καθεζώμεσθα: καθέζομαι — sit down; pres. subj. 1 pl., hortatory: ’let us sit down’
glossary.κακκείοντες: κατάκειμαι — lie down; fut. part. masc. nom. pl., reduplicated κ- (= κατακείοντες): ’intending to lie down’
glossary.κακῷ: κακός — bad, base, ignoble; masc. dat. sg. · also of smoke: κακῷ … καπνῷ ’foul smoke’
glossary.καλέσασα: καλέω — call; aor. part. fem. nom. sg.
glossary.κατεβήσετο: καταβαίνω — go down, descend; aor. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented (= κατέβη)
glossary.κείρετ: κείρω — shear, crop, here fig. ’strip bare’; pres. imper. 2 pl., elided (κείρετ’ = κείρετε)
glossary.κεδνὰ: κεδνός — careful, trusty; neut. acc. pl. used adverbially with ἰδυῖα: ’trusty, knowing in her heart’
glossary.κεδνὴ: κεδνός — careful, trusty; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.κεδνῇ: κεδνός — careful, trusty; fem. dat. sg.
glossary.κεκαλυμμένος: καλύπτω — cover, wrap; perf. pass. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’covered, wrapped’
glossary.κεφαλὴν: κεφαλή — head; fem. acc. sg. · also periphrasis for the person: ’such a man’ (τοίην κεφαλήν, of Ajax)
glossary.κιόντες: κίω — go; pres. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’going’
glossary.κλίμακα: κλῖμαξ — staircase, ladder; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.κλείουσιν: κλείω — celebrate, make famous; pres. 3 pl.
glossary.κληῖδ: κληΐς — bolt, bar; fem. acc. sg., elided (κληῖδ’ = κληῖδα)
glossary.κλιθῆναι: κλίνω — lie down, recline; aor. pass. inf.: ’to lie down’
glossary.κορώνῃ: κορώνη — handle, curved door-ring; fem. dat. sg.
glossary.κούρη: κούρη — girl, daughter; fem. nom. sg. · also fem. voc. sg., in address: ’daughter’ (θάρσει, Ἰκαρίου κούρη ’take heart, daughter of Icarius’)
glossary.κραδίη: κραδίη — heart; fem. nom. sg. · also fem. voc. sg. (same form): ’heart!’ (τέτλαθι δή, κραδίη ’endure now, heart’)
glossary.κρονίων: Κρονίων — son of Cronus, Zeus; masc. nom. sg., by-form of Κρονίδης
glossary.κτήματ: κτῆμα — possession, property; neut. acc. pl., elided (κτήματ’ = κτήματα) · also neut. nom. pl., subject: ’possessions … are’ (κτήματ’ ἔασι)
glossary.κτήματα: κτῆμα — possession, property; neut. nom./acc. pl.
glossary.κόμιζε: κομίζω — take care of, tend; pres. imper. 2 sg.
glossary.λέχεσσι: λέχος — bed, couch; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσι
glossary.λαέρτης: Λαέρτης — Laertes, father of Odysseus; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.λεχέεσσι: λέχος — bed, couch; neut. dat. pl., epic -έεσσι
glossary.ληίσσατο: ληίζομαι — take as booty, plunder; aor. 3 sg. mid.
glossary.λιπαρὰ: λιπαρός — glistening, shining; neut. acc. pl.
glossary.λυγρόν: λυγρός — bitter, baneful; masc./neut. acc. sg.
glossary.λυγρῆς: λυγρός — bitter, baneful; fem. gen. sg.
glossary.λωίτερον: λωίων — more advantageous, better; comparative, neut. nom./acc. sg.
glossary.μέγαρα: μέγαρον — hall, great room; neut. acc. pl.
glossary.μέλας: μέλας — black, dark; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.μένον: μένω — wait, wait for; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented · also impf. 1 sg. (same form), intransitive: ’I remained, stayed’
glossary.μέσον: μέσος — middle, mid-; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially with a place-name: ’mid-Argos’ · also as an ordinary attributive adjective agreeing with a neuter noun: ’the middle of the sail’ (μέσον ἱστίον) · also neut. acc. sg. as a noun after a preposition: ’the middle’ (ἐς μέσον ’into the middle’) · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with a person: ‘in the middle’ (σε μέσον βάλον ‘I would have struck you in the middle’)
glossary.μεγάρων: μέγαρον — hall, great room; neut. gen. pl.
glossary.μελήσει: μέλω — be a care to; fut. 3 sg. (impersonal + dat.): ’will be a care (to)’
glossary.μεμνημένη: μιμνήσκομαι — remember, have in mind; perf. mid. part. fem. nom. sg.
glossary.μερμηρίζων: μερμηρίζω — ponder anxiously, turn over in one’s mind; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.
glossary.μηδὲ: μηδέ — and not, nor; negative conj., companion to μή
glossary.μῦθος: μῦθος — speech, word, thing said; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.νέμεσις: νέμεσις — righteous indignation, blame; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.νέοι: νέος — young, new; masc. nom. pl. · also masc. voc. pl., in address: ‘young men!’ (νέοι, ἐκπέμψασθε ‘young men, send out’)
glossary.νήποινοί: νήποινος — unpunished, without payment; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ναιετοώσης: ναιετάω — dwell, be inhabited; pres. part. fem. gen. sg., diectasis (uncontracted -όω- for -ῶ-), genitive absolute: ’while it is inhabited’
glossary.νεωτάτη: νέος — young, new; superl. νεώτατος, fem. nom. sg.: ’newest’
glossary.νόστος: νόστος — homecoming, return; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ξείνοιο: ξεῖνος — stranger, guest-friend; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.οἰὸς: ὄϊς — sheep; gen. sg. (οἰὸς ἀώτῳ ’with the flower of a sheep’, i.e. its wool)
glossary.οἴη: οἶος — alone, only; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.οἴκοιο: οἶκος — house, home; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.οἴκους: οἶκος — house, home; masc. acc. pl.
glossary.οἴχεται: οἴχομαι — be gone, have departed; pres. with perf. sense, 3 sg.: ’is gone’
glossary.οἶτον: οἶτος — fate, doom (usually evil); masc. acc. sg.
glossary.οἷο: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; masc./neut. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic οὗ): ’her own’
glossary.οἷος: οἶος — alone, only; masc. nom. sg. · rough-breathed οἷος is relative ’such as, of the kind that’ (οἷος Ὀδυσσεὺς ἔσκεν ’such as Odysseus was’) · also οἷος in an indirect exclamation, ’what sort of’ (οἷος κείνου θυμός ’what sort his spirit is’)
glossary.οὕς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ (relative) — who, which; masc. acc. pl.: ’whom’
glossary.οὗτος: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο — this; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.πένθος: πένθος — grief, sorrow; neut. nom./acc. sg.
glossary.πέφραδ: φράζω — point out, show, tell; reduplicated aor. 3 sg., elided (πέφραδ’ = πέφραδε)
glossary.παλίντιτα: παλίντιτος — paid back in turn, requited; neut. acc. pl. (with ἔργα): ’deeds paid back in turn’
glossary.παννύχιος: παννύχιος — all night long; masc. nom. sg. used adverbially
glossary.παρέστη: παρίστημι — stand beside, take one’s stand by; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented
glossary.παραὶ: παρά (epic παραί) — beside, along; prep. + dat.
glossary.παρειάων: παρειή — cheek; fem. gen. pl., epic -άων (= Attic -ῶν)
glossary.πατρώιος: πατρώιος — hereditary, from one’s father(s); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.πατρώιόν: πατρώιος — hereditary, from one’s father(s); neut. nom. sg.
glossary.πατρὶς: πατρίς — of one’s fathers, ancestral; fem. nom. sg. (with γαῖα/ἄρουρα understood): ’fatherland’
glossary.πείθομαι: πείθομαι — trust, believe, obey (+ dat.); pres. 1 sg.
glossary.πεισηνορίδαο: Πεισηνορίδης — son of Peisenor; masc. gen. sg., epic -αο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.πεπνυμένον: πέπνυμαι — have one’s wits about one, be prudent; perf. part. masc. acc. sg., here transferred to a speech: ’showing sound sense’
glossary.περίφρων: περίφρων — circumspect, of sound understanding; fem. nom. sg., stock epithet of Penelope · also epithet of Arete: fem. nom. sg., ’the circumspect queen’ · also epithet of Eurycleia: fem. nom. sg., ’circumspect Eurycleia’
glossary.περικαλλέος: περικαλλής — very beautiful; fem. gen. sg. · also masc./neut. gen. sg. (περικαλλέος ἐκ κανέοιο ’from the very beautiful basket’)
glossary.περικλυτός: περικλυτός — very famous, far-famed; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.περισκέπτῳ: περίσκεπτος — seen all around, conspicuous; masc./neut. dat. sg.
glossary.πινόντων: πίνω — drink; pres. imper. 3 pl. (Attic πινέτωσαν): ’let them drink’
glossary.ποίης: ποῖος — of what sort, what kind of; fem. gen. sg. · also ποίη — grass; fem. gen. sg. (ἄνθεα ποίης ’flowers of the grass’)
glossary.ποθέω: ποθέω — long for, yearn for; pres. 1 sg.
glossary.ποθι: ποθι — somehow, somewhere; epic enclitic adv. (= Attic πού)
glossary.ποιήσειεν: ποιέω — make, cause to be; aor. opt. 3 sg. (wish): ’may... make’
glossary.ποιητοῖο: ποιητός — made, built; masc. gen. sg., epic -οῖο (= Attic -οῦ): ’well-built’
glossary.πολύβου: Πόλυβος — Polybus, father of Eurymachus; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.ποτ: ποτέ — once, at some time, ever; enclitic adv., elided (ποτ’ = ποτέ)
glossary.ποῦ: ποῦ — where?; interrog. adv., here in indirect use: ’where’ · also in a direct question: ’where?’ (ποῦ δέ μιν εὗρε; ’and where did she find him?’)
glossary.πρωθήβην: πρωθήβης — in the first bloom of youth; fem./masc. acc. sg.
glossary.πτύξασα: πτύσσω — fold; aor. part. fem. nom. sg.
glossary.πυκιμηδέος: πυκιμήδης — close-witted, shrewd; fem. gen. sg.
glossary.πύκα: πύκα — closely, snugly, firmly; adv. (πύκα ποιητοῖο ’closely built’)
glossary.σιωπῇ: σιωπή — silence; fem. dat. sg., dative of manner: ’in silence’
glossary.σκιόεντα: σκιόεις — shadowy, dim; neut. acc. pl.
glossary.στήθεσσι: στῆθος — breast, chest; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσι
glossary.σταθμὸν: σταθμός — door-post; masc. acc. sg. · also σταθμός — steading, farmstead; masc. acc. sg., object: ’the steading’ (σταθμὸν ῥύατ’ ’guarded the steading’)
glossary.σφιν: σφεῖς — they; epic encl. dat. pl./sg. pron.: ’to/for them’
glossary.σχομένη: ἔχω — have, hold; aor. mid. part. fem. nom. sg., here ’holding (before)’ · also ἔχομαι + dat., ’held fast by, seized with’ (ἄχεϊ σχομένη)
glossary.σύνθετο: συντίθημι — perceive, take note of; aor. mid. 3 sg.
glossary.τάφου: Τάφος — Taphos, home island of Mentes and the Taphians; masc. gen. sg. · also common noun τάφος — funeral, burial rites; masc. gen. sg., governed by ἀντιβολήσαις (+ gen. ’meet, come upon’): ’the funeral’
glossary.τέγεος: τέγος — roof (standing for the hall); neut. gen. sg.
glossary.τέρπειν: τέρπω — give delight, gladden; pres. inf.
glossary.τέρποντο: τέρπομαι — take pleasure, enjoy oneself; impf. 3 pl.
glossary.τήν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); fem. acc. sg., resumptive: ’whom’ · also demonstrative, fem. acc. sg., resuming an earlier noun: ’her’ (τήν … ῥέξω ’her I will sacrifice’) · also relative, fem. acc. sg.: ’which’ (ὀιζυῖ πολλῇ, τήν μοι ἐπῶρσε ’great misery, which he roused for me’) · also demonstrative with a noun and adjective: ’that’ (τήν γε στυγερὴν ὁδόν ’that hateful journey’)
glossary.ταύτης: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο — this; fem. gen. sg.
glossary.τείρει: τείρω — wear down, distress; pres. 3 sg.
glossary.τερπομένοισι: τέρπομαι — take pleasure, enjoy oneself; pres. part. masc. dat. pl.
glossary.τερπώμεθα: τέρπομαι — take pleasure, enjoy oneself; pres. subj. 1 pl., hortatory
glossary.τετύχθαι: τεύχω — make, bring to pass; perf. pass. inf.: ’to have come to be’
glossary.τηλέμαχ: Τηλέμαχος — Telemachus, son of Odysseus; masc. voc. sg., elided (Τηλέμαχ’ = Τηλέμαχε)
glossary.τηλέμαχον: Τηλέμαχος — Telemachus, son of Odysseus; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.τιμηέστερος: τιμήεις — honored; comparative, masc. nom. sg.
glossary.τιν: τις, τι — someone, something; neut./masc. acc. sg., elided (τιν’ = τινα) · also fem. acc. sg. (εἴ τιν’ … λύσιν ’some release’)
glossary.τινα: τις, τι — someone, something; neut. acc. sg., indefinite: ’whatever one’ · also masc./fem. acc. sg. ’someone, some’; after a relative, ὅν τινα, ἥν τινα (= ὅντινα, ἥντινα), part of ὅστις: ’what, whatever’
glossary.τοίην: τοῖος — such, of such a kind; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.τοιοῦδ: τοιόσδε — such as this; masc. gen. sg., elided (τοιοῦδ’ = τοιοῦδε)
glossary.τούτῳ: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο — this; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.τρεψάμενοι: τρέπω — turn; aor. mid. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’having turned (themselves)’
glossary.τρητοῖσι: τρητός — bored, pierced (of a bedstead strung through drilled holes); neut. dat. pl.
glossary.τυτθὸν: τυτθός — small, little; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’when small’
glossary.τόδ: ὅδε — this, this here; neut. nom./acc. sg., elided (τόδ’ = τόδε)
glossary.τότε: τότε — then, at that time; adv.
glossary.τῇ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); fem. dat. sg.: ’her, with her’ · also adverbial, ’there, in that place’, pointing back to a place just named (τῇ τόν γε μένον λοχόωντες ’there they lay in wait for him’) · also relative, fem. dat. sg., serving as an instrumental, ’with which’ (ῥάβδον, τῇ τ’ ἀνδρῶν ὄμματα θέλγει ’a wand, with which he charms men’s eyes’), not the personal pronoun · also relative adv., ’where, in the place where’ (τῇ δή μοι ἐείσατο χῶρος ἄριστος) · also adverbial, ’in that (event)’, pointing back to a contest just named: τῇ δ’ αὖτ’ Εὐρύαλος ἀπεκαίνυτο ’in that Euryalus in turn outdid all’ · also relative adv. of manner, with περ: ’in just the way that’ · also adv. of direction, ’thither, that way’ · also with a noun, article-like: fem. dat. sg. ’the’ (τῇ δεκάτῃ ’on the tenth’) · also relative, fem. dat. sg., of respect or means: ’in which, by which’ (ἀγλαΐην, τῇ … κέκασσαι ’the beauty by which you excel’)
glossary.φάτο: φημί — say, speak; impf. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented (= ἔφατο)
glossary.φέρε: φέρω — bring, carry; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔφερε) · also pres. imper. 2 sg. (same form): φέρε χηλὸν ’bring the chest’
glossary.φέριστε: φέρτατος — best, bravest; vocative superl., masc. voc. sg.
glossary.φήμιε: Φήμιος — Phemius, the minstrel of Ithaca; masc. voc. sg.
glossary.φθονέεις: φθονέω — begrudge, feel envy (+ acc./inf.); pres. 2 sg., uncontracted (= Attic φθονεῖς)
glossary.φύντες: φύω — grow; aor. part. masc. nom. pl., used adverbially (ὀδὰξ ἐν χείλεσι φύντες ’having bitten their lips’)
glossary.φῂς: φημί — say, speak; pres. 2 sg. (= φῄς)
glossary.φῶτες: φώς — man, hero; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.χείλεσι: χεῖλος — lip; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσι
glossary.χρεῖος: χρεῖος — need, business, matter; neut. nom./acc. sg. · also ’debt, what is owed’: χρεῖος ὑπαλύξας ’escaping the debt’
glossary.χώρῳ: χῶρος — place, spot; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.ἀγγελίην: ἀγγελίη — message, news; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀγγελίῃ: ἀγγελίη — message, news; fem. dat. sg.
glossary.ἀγκρεμάσασα: ἀνακρεμάννυμι — hang up; aor. part. fem. nom. sg., epic ἀγκρεμάσασα (= Attic ἀνακρεμάσασα)
glossary.ἀγορήνδε: ἀγορή — assembly; fem. acc. sg. + suffix -δε ’to, towards’: ’to the assembly’
glossary.ἀγορεύειν: ἀγορεύω — speak (esp. in assembly); pres. inf.
glossary.ἀγόρευεν: ἀγορεύω — speak (esp. in assembly); impf. 3 sg., unaugmented
glossary.ἀκουέμεν: ἀκούω — hear, listen to; pres. inf., epic -έμεν (= Attic ἀκούειν)
glossary.ἀκουόντεσσι: ἀκούω — hear, listen to; pres. part. masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσι: ’to those listening’
glossary.ἀκούειν: ἀκούω — hear, listen to; pres. inf.
glossary.ἀκούοντες: ἀκούω — hear, listen to; pres. part. masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἀλεγύνετε: ἀλεγύνω — take care of, prepare (a feast); pres. imper. 2 pl.
glossary.ἀλφηστῇσιν: ἀλφηστής — bread-eating (of mortal men); masc. dat. pl.
glossary.ἀμειβόμενοι: ἀμείβομαι — take turns, alternate; pres. part. masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἀμφίπολοι: ἀμφίπολος — handmaid, attendant; fem. nom. pl. · also fem. voc. pl., address: ’handmaids!’
glossary.ἀμφιπέληται: ἀμφιπέλομαι — circulate, go around; pres. subj. 3 sg.
glossary.ἀμφιπόλοισι: ἀμφίπολος — handmaid, attendant; fem. dat. pl., epic -οισι
glossary.ἀνάσσει: ἀνάσσω — be lord, rule (+ dat.); pres. 3 sg.
glossary.ἀνάσσοις: ἀνάσσω — be lord, rule (+ dat.); pres. opt. 2 sg. (wish): ’may you be lord’
glossary.ἀναΐξας: ἀναΐσσω — start up suddenly, spring up; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀναβᾶσα: ἀναβαίνω — go up; aor. part. fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀντίνο: Ἀντίνοος — Antinous, a leading suitor; masc. voc. sg., elided (Ἀντίνο’ = Ἀντίνοε)
glossary.ἀντίνοος: Ἀντίνοος — Antinous, son of Eupeithes, a leading suitor; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀοιδοί: ἀοιδός — minstrel, singer; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἀοιδοὶ: ἀοιδός — minstrel, singer; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἀοιδοῦ: ἀοιδός — minstrel, singer; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.ἀοιδόν: ἀοιδός — minstrel, singer; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀοιδὸν: ἀοιδός — minstrel, singer; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀοιδὸς: ἀοιδός — minstrel, singer; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀπηλεγέως: ἀπηλεγέως — bluntly, without regard for consequence; adv.
glossary.ἀποείπω: ἀπεῖπον — declare formally, renounce; aor. subj. 1 sg.
glossary.ἀποπαύε: ἀποπαύω — cause to cease; pres. mid. imper. 2 sg., elided (ἀποπαύε’ = ἀποπαύεο): ’cease from’
glossary.ἀπορραίσει: ἀπορραίω — strip away, tear off, break away; fut. 3 sg.
glossary.ἀπώλεσε: ἀπόλλυμι — destroy, lose; aor. 3 sg. act.
glossary.ἀπώλετο: ἀπόλλυμι — destroy; mid. perish, be lost; aor. 3 sg. mid.
glossary.ἀρέσθαι: ἄρνυμαι — win, gain; aor. mid. inf.
glossary.ἀργυρέῃ: ἀργύρεος — of silver; fem. dat. sg.
glossary.ἀσκήσασα: ἀσκέω — work smooth, finish by careful handling; aor. part. fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀφίκετο: ἀφικνέομαι — arrive at, reach; aor. 3 sg.
glossary.ἀφνειὸν: ἀφνειός — wealthy, rich; neut. nom. sg. · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with οἶκον: ’a wealthy house’
glossary.ἀώτῳ: ἄωτος — flower, choicest part; masc. dat. sg., kenning for fine wool
glossary.ἄλλας: ἄλλος — other, another; fem. acc. pl.
glossary.ἄμεινον: ἀγαθός — good; comparative ἀμείνων, neut. nom./acc. sg.: ’better’
glossary.ἄναξ: ἄναξ — lord, master; masc. nom. sg. · also voc. sg. (same form), in address: ’lord!’ (κλῦθι, ἄναξ ’hear me, lord’)
glossary.ἄνδρεσσι: ἀνήρ — man; masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσι
glossary.ἄνθρωποι: ἄνθρωπος — human being, man; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἄντα: ἄντα — opposite, facing; adv. · also prep. + gen., ’in front of, before’: ἄντα παρειάων ’before her cheeks’
glossary.ἄργος: Ἄργος — Argos, the Argive plain; neut. nom./acc. sg. · also Ἄργος — Argus, Odysseus’s hound; masc. nom. sg. (the dog’s name)
glossary.ἄρουρα: ἄρουρα — ploughland, soil; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἅμ: ἅμα (elided ἅμ’) — together with, at the same time as; adv./prep. + dat.
glossary.ἐεικοσάβοια: ἐεικοσάβοιος — worth twenty oxen; neut. acc. pl.
glossary.ἐελδόμενος: ἔλδομαι — desire, long for; pres. part. masc. nom. sg., reduplicated
glossary.ἐθέλοιμι: ἐθέλω — wish, be willing; pres. opt. 1 sg. (hypothetical wish)
glossary.ἐθέλῃσιν: ἐθέλω — wish, want; pres. subj. 3 sg., epic ending -ῃσι
glossary.ἐμή: ἐμός — my, mine; fem. nom. sg. · also fem. voc. sg. (= nom. in form), agreeing with μῆτερ: ’my (mother)’
glossary.ἐμοί: ἐγώ — I; dat. sg., accented (non-enclitic emphatic): ’to me’ · also dat. sg. after ὑπό: ’under me’
glossary.ἐμοῖο: ἐμός — my, mine; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -οῦ)
glossary.ἐμπάζομαι: ἐμπάζομαι — take heed of, pay attention to (+ gen.); pres. 1 sg.
glossary.ἐμὸς: ἐμός — my, mine; masc. nom. sg. · also the nominative form used as a vocative, agreeing with γαμβρός: ’my (son-in-law)!’
glossary.ἐμῆς: ἐμός — my, mine; fem. gen. sg.
glossary.ἐναλίγκιος: ἐναλίγκιος — like, resembling (+ dat.); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἐξερέηται: ἐξερέομαι — ask, inquire of; pres. subj. 3 sg.
glossary.ἐξιέναι: ἔξειμι — go out, go forth; pres. inf.
glossary.ἐοῦσαν: εἰμί — be; pres. part. fem. acc. sg., epic (= Attic οὖσαν)
glossary.ἐπέρυσσε: ἐπερύω — draw shut, pull to; aor. 3 sg.
glossary.ἐπετείλατο: ἐπιτέλλω — lay a charge upon, ordain; aor. mid. 3 sg.
glossary.ἐπιβώσομαι: ἐπιβοάομαι — call upon, invoke; fut. 1 sg.
glossary.ἐπικλείουσ: ἐπικλείω — extol, make famous; pres. 3 pl., elided (ἐπικλείουσ’ = ἐπικλείουσι)
glossary.ἐπιτολμάτω: ἐπιτολμάω — have the endurance for; pres. imper. 3 sg.
glossary.ἐποίχεσθαι: ἐποίχομαι — go about, ply (a task); pres. inf.
glossary.ἐρίηρον: ἐρίηρος — trusty, well-fitted; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἐρχομένοιο: ἔρχομαι — go, come; pres. part. masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.ἐτάνυσσεν: τανύω — stretch, draw tight; aor. 3 sg.
glossary.ἐόντα: εἰμί — be; pres. part. masc./neut. acc. sg., epic (= Attic ὄντα) · also neut. nom. pl., agreeing with θύρετρα ’doors’: καὶ εὐρέα περ ἐόντα ’wide though they are’
glossary.ἐῴκει: ἔοικα — be like, resemble; plpf. with impf. force, 3 sg.
glossary.ἑκάστῳ: ἕκαστος — each, every; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.ἑλλάδα: Ἑλλάς — Hellas, here a district of Thessaly; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἑνὸς: εἷς, μία, ἕν — one; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.ἑοῖσιν: ἑός — his own, her own (possessive, by-form of ὅς); neut. dat. pl.: ’his own’
glossary.ἔβη: βαίνω — go, walk, step; aor. 3 sg., root aorist, unaugmented (= ἔβη)
glossary.ἔκδυνε: ἐκδύω — strip off, take off (clothing); impf. 3 sg.
glossary.ἔλθοι: ἔρχομαι — go, come; aor. opt. 3 sg. (wish): ’may... come’ · also in a conditional protasis: ’if ... should come’ (εἰ καί ποθεν ἄλλοθεν ἔλθοι) · also in an indirect question after a past verb: ’from where she came’ (πόθεν ἔλθοι) · also in a relative clause with κε, prospective: ’(whoever) should come’ (ὅς κε … ἔλθοι) · also in a negative purpose clause after μή: ’lest he go’ (μή … ἔλθοι ἀπαγγέλλων) · also aor. opt. 3 sg. in a general relative clause, without κε: ’whatever he might come in need of’ (ὅτευ κεχρημένος ἔλθοι)
glossary.ἔμβαλε: ἐμβάλλω — throw into, cast into; aor. 3 sg.
glossary.ἔμεναι: εἰμί — be; pres. inf., epic (= Attic εἶναι)
glossary.ἔμικτο: μίγνυμι — mingle, unite sexually; plpf. mid. 3 sg.
glossary.ἔνθετο: ἐντίθημι — put in, lay to (heart); aor. mid. 3 sg.
glossary.ἔργ: ἔργον — deed, work; neut. nom./acc. pl., elided (ἔργ’ = ἔργα) · also ’tilled land, farmed fields’ (Ἰθάκης … ἔργ’)
glossary.ἔργα: ἔργον — deed, work; neut. nom./acc. pl.
glossary.ἔργον: ἔργον — deed, work, task; neut. acc. sg. · also neut. nom. sg., subject of an impersonal verb (κακὸν … ἔργον τε ἔπος τε μελέτω ’let no evil deed or word be a care’) · also neut. nom. sg., in apposition/predicative, naming a maker: ἔργον Ἡφαίστοιο ’the work of Hephaestus’ · also neut. nom. sg., subject of a passive verb: ’work’ (τόδε ἔργον ἀέξεται ’this work grows’)
glossary.ἔσομ: εἰμί — be; fut. 1 sg., elided (ἔσομ’ = ἔσομαι)
glossary.ἔστ: εἰμί — be; pres. 3 sg., elided (ἔστ’ = ἔστι)
glossary.ἔστω: εἰμί — be; pres. imper. 3 sg.: ’let there be’ · also as a copula with a predicate, personal: ’let (no one) be (gentle, etc.)’ (μή τις … πρόφρων … ἔστω ’let no one be ready-minded’)
glossary.ἔτρεφε: τρέφω — rear, nurse, bring up; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented
glossary.ἔχοις: ἔχω — have, hold, keep; pres. opt. 2 sg. (wish): ’may you keep’
glossary.ἔχοντες: ἔχω — have, hold; pres. part. masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἕκαστος: ἕκαστος — each, every; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἕν: εἷς, μία, ἕν — one; neut. nom./acc. sg.
glossary.ἠέ: ἠέ — or; disjunctive conj. (epic = ἤ), esp. in ἠέ ... ἦ ’either... or’ · also ’than’ after a comparative (λώϊον ἠέ περ ἄλλοι ’better than others’)
glossary.ἠρήσαντο: ἀράομαι — pray, wish; aor. mid. 3 pl.
glossary.ἠῶθεν: ἠώς — dawn; adv. ἠῶθεν, -θεν suffix ’from’: ’at dawn’
glossary.ἡδὺν: ἡδύς — sweet, pleasant; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἡμετέροιο: ἡμέτερος — our; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.ἤρχετο: ἄρχομαι — begin (+ gen.); impf. 3 sg., unaugmented: ’began (to speak)’ · also + gen.: ’led off’ (ἤρχετο μολπῆς ’led off the dance’)
glossary.ἥατ: ἧμαι — sit; epic perf./impf. 3 pl., unaugmented, elided (ἥατ’ = ἥατο, Attic ἧντο)
glossary.ἰδυῖα: οἶδα — know; perf. part. fem. nom. sg., here ’skilled, wise’
glossary.ἰκαρίοιο: Ἰκάριος — Icarius, father of Penelope; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.ἰοῦσα: εἶμι — go; pres. part. fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἱμάντι: ἱμάς — strap, thong; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.ἱμερόεσσαν: ἱμερόεις — lovely, desirable; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἱστόν: ἱστός — loom; masc. acc. sg. · also ’mast’ (of a ship), a distinct sense required by nautical context (ἐν δ’ ἱστόν τ’ ἐτίθεντο ’they set the mast in it’)
glossary.ἴμεν: εἶμι — go; pres. inf., epic (= Attic ἰέναι)
glossary.ἵν: ἵνα — so that, in order that; conj., elided (ἵν’ = ἵνα) · also relative adverb of place, ’where’ (= Attic οὗ): τῶν ἐνὶ δήμῳ, ἵν’ οἴχεται ’among those of the land where he has gone’
glossary.ἶσα: ἴσος — equal; neut. acc. pl. used adverbially: ’equally’
glossary.ὀδὰξ: ὀδάξ — with the teeth; adv. (ὀδὰξ ἐν χείλεσι φύντες ’having bitten their lips’)
glossary.ὀλέσθαι: ὄλλυμι — destroy; mid. perish, be lost; aor. mid. inf.
glossary.ὁδὸν: ὁδός — way, journey; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ὁμάδησαν: ὁμαδέω — make a din, clamor; aor. 3 pl.
glossary.ὁππόθεν: ὁππόθεν — from where; epic indirect interrog. adv. (= Attic πόθεν)
glossary.ὃ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ (relative) — who, which; neut. nom./acc. sg., referring to a person: ’that he...’ · also masc. nom. sg. relative, ’who’, used in address with a 2nd person verb (ὃ χθιζὸς θεὸς ἤλυθες ’you who came yesterday as a god’) · also pron. ’he’, masc. nom. sg. (ἧος ὃ … μιγείη) · also neut. acc. sg. relative, referring back to a thing, object of δῶκας: ’which (you gave me)’ · also = ὅτι ’that’, neut. acc. sg., introducing a clause after a verb of knowing (ὃ δὴ κακὰ μήδετο ’that evils were being devised’) · also neut. nom. sg. relative of a thing, subject of ἐστι: ’that which, whatever’ (ὃ κάλλιστον … ἐστι ’the one that is fairest’) · also neut. acc. sg. relative as a connective, ’for which reason, which is why’ (ὃ καὶ μεταμώνια βάζεις ’which is why you speak idly’)
glossary.ὄλοισθε: ὄλλυμι — destroy; mid. perish, be destroyed; aor. opt. 2 pl. (wish, curse): ’may you perish’
glossary.ὄρνυται: ὄρνυμαι — be stirred, be roused; pres. 3 sg.
glossary.ὅππῃ: ὅππῃ — in whatever way, wherever; epic relative adv. (= Attic ὅπῃ)
glossary.ὑμὰ: ὑμέτερος — your (pl.); neut. acc. pl., epic short form ὑμά (= Attic ὑμέτερα): ’your own’
glossary.ὑπέμεινε: ὑπομένω — wait, hold one’s ground; aor. 3 sg.
glossary.ὑπέρβιον: ὑπέρβιος — overweening, excessive; fem./neut. acc. sg. · also adverbial, neut. acc. sg.: ’exceedingly, with excessive violence’ (κτήματα δαρδάπτουσιν ὑπέρβιον)
glossary.ὑπερωιόθεν: ὑπερῷον — upper story, upper chamber; adv. ὑπερωιόθεν, -θεν suffix ’from’: ’from upstairs’
glossary.ὑπερῷ: ὑπερῷον — upper story, upper chamber; neut. acc. pl., elided (ὑπερῷ’ = ὑπερῷα)
glossary.ὑψαγόρην: ὑψαγόρης — high-talking, big-mouthed; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ὕβριν: ὕβρις — insolence, wanton violence; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ὦπα: ὤψ — face, countenance; neut./fem. acc. sg., accusative of respect: ’as to his face’
glossary.ὦπος: Ὤψ — Ops, father of Eurycleia; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.ᾗσιν: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσιν: ’in his own (mind)’ · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: which; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσιν: ’in which’ (ᾗσιν ἀγαλλόμενοι ’taking pride in which’)
glossary.αἰγύπτιος: Αἰγύπτιος — Aegyptius, an elder of Ithaca; masc. nom. sg. · also used as an adjective, ’Egyptian, of Egypt’, epithet of Proteus (ἀθάνατος Πρωτεὺς Αἰγύπτιος); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.αἰδέσθητε: αἰδέομαι — feel shame, respect (before others); aor. imper. 2 pl.
glossary.αἰσχύνων: αἰσχύνω — disgrace, bring reproach on, shame; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.
glossary.αἴθοπα: αἴθοψ — fire-faced, sparkling (of wine, lit. αἴθω ’burn’ + ὤψ ’face’); masc. acc. sg. · also of smoke, masc. acc. sg. (αἴθοπα καπνόν ’fiery smoke’)
glossary.αἴτιοί: αἴτιος — responsible, to blame; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.βασίλευε: βασιλεύω — be king, rule; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐβασίλευε)
glossary.γένετ: γίγνομαι — become, happen, come to be; aor. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented, elided (γένετ’ = γένετο = ἐγένετο)
glossary.γέρον: γέρων — old man; masc. voc. sg.
glossary.γέροντα: γέρων — old man, elder; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.γέροντες: γέρων — old man, elder; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.γήραϊ: γῆρας — old age; neut. dat. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic γήρᾳ)
glossary.γαίῃ: γαῖα — earth, ground; fem. dat. sg.
glossary.γλαφυρῷ: γλαφυρός — hollow, hollowed out; masc./neut. dat. sg.
glossary.δάκρυ: δάκρυ — tear; neut. acc. sg., used collectively: ’tears’ · also elided δάκρυ’ = δάκρυα, neut. acc. pl. · also literal sg. with an attributive adjective, not collective: θαλερὸν δάκρυ ’a swelling tear’ · also literal sg., no adjective: ’a tear’ (ἀπομόρξατο δάκρυ ’wiped away a tear’)
glossary.δήμιον: δήμιος — of the δῆμος, public; neut. acc. sg. (δήμιον ἄλλο ’some other public matter’)
glossary.δεδαηκότες: δάω — learn, come to know; perf. part. masc. nom. pl. (δεδαηκώς), with οὐ: ’untaught (in)’
glossary.διαρραίσει: διαρραίω — break in pieces, shatter utterly; fut. 3 sg.
glossary.διόλωλε: διόλλυμι — destroy utterly; perf. 3 sg. intr.: ’is utterly ruined’
glossary.δοίη: δίδωμι — give; aor. opt. 3 sg. (purpose): ’might give’ · also continuing a wish after εἴ πως, with a new subject: ’and might (she) grant’ (δοίη δέ μοι εὖχος Ἀθήνη ’and might Athena grant me glory’) · also in a main-clause wish: ’may (Zeus) give’ (Ζεύς τοι δοίη ’may Zeus give you’) · also opt. in a protasis after εἴ: ’if (someone) should give’ (εἴ τίς τοι … εἵματα δοίη ’if someone were to give you clothing’) · also with κέν, potential opt. in a main clause: ’would give’ (δοίη κέν τις χλαῖναν ’someone would give a cloak’)
glossary.δοθείη: δίδωμι — give; aor. pass. opt. 3 sg., in tmesis (ἀπὸ … δοθείη = ἀποδοθείη): ’should be given back’
glossary.δοιά: δοιοί — two, a pair of, twofold; neut. nom./acc. pl. δοιά
glossary.δοκεῖ: δοκέω — seem, think; pres. 3 sg.: ’he seems’
glossary.δυσμενέοντες: δυσμενέω — be hostile, bear ill will; pres. part. masc. nom. pl.
glossary.δυσμενέων: δυσμενέω — be hostile, bear ill will; pres. part. masc. nom. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic δυσμενῶν) · also adj. δυσμενής, -ές — hostile; masc. gen. pl. (ἀνδρῶν δυσμενέων ’of hostile men’)
glossary.δόλον: δόλος — trick, snare, cunning device; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.δόρπον: δόρπον — evening meal, supper; neut. acc. sg.
glossary.δύναμίς: δύναμις — power, strength, ability; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.δύω: δύο — two; numeral, epic by-form δύω, indeclinable
glossary.δῆμον: δῆμος — people, land, community; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.εἰλαπινάζουσιν: εἰλαπινάζω — feast, hold festival; pres. 3 pl.
glossary.εἴθε: εἴθε — would that, if only; particle introducing a wish + opt.
glossary.εἴποι: εἶπον — say, tell; aor. opt. 3 sg.
glossary.εἴσεαι: οἶδα — know; fut. 2 sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic εἴσῃ): ’you will know’
glossary.εἵματα: εἷμα — garment, clothing; neut. acc. pl. · also neut. nom. pl., subject: εἵματα γάρ ῥ’ ἐβάρυνε ’for the clothes weighed him down’
glossary.εἶξαν: εἴκω — give way, yield; aor. 3 pl.
glossary.εἶσι: εἶμι — go, come; pres. 3 sg. used with future sense: ’will come’ · also pres. 3 sg. with present force: ’goes, ranges’ (Ἄρτεμις εἶσι κατ’ οὔρεα ’Artemis ranges over the mountains’)
glossary.εὐνῆφιν: εὐνή — bed; fem. gen. sg., epic case-ending -φι(ν) (= Attic εὐνῆς)
glossary.εὐρύνομος: Εὐρύνομος — Eurynomus, a son of Aegyptius; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.θέμιστος: Θέμις — Themis, goddess of custom and right; fem. gen. sg., epic (= Attic Θέμιδος)
glossary.θέτ: τίθημι — put, place, set; aor. mid. 3 sg., unaugmented, elided (θέτ’ = θέτο), in tmesis (περὶ … θέτ’ = περιέθετο): ’set about’ · also in tmesis with ἀπό (ἀπὸ … θέτ’ = ἀπέθετο): ’laid aside’
glossary.θανάτοιο: θάνατος — death; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.θεσπεσίην: θεσπέσιος — wondrous, more than human (lit. god-uttered); fem. acc. sg.
glossary.θηεῦντο: θεάομαι — gaze at, marvel at; impf. 3 pl., Ionic θηεῦντο, unaugmented (= Attic ἐθεῶντο)
glossary.θόωκος: θῶκος — seat, sitting, session; masc. nom. sg., epic stretched form θόωκος
glossary.κέκλυτε: κλύω — hear, listen; aor. imper. 2 pl., reduplicated (κέκλυτε)
glossary.κέλευσε: κελεύω — order, command; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐκέλευσε)
glossary.κέρδεα: κέρδος — gain, profit; neut. acc. pl. κέρδεα, extended sense ’cunning, craft’
glossary.κέρδιον: κερδίων — more profitable, better; neut. nom. sg., comparative of κέρδος
glossary.καθέλῃσι: καθαιρέω — take down, bring down; aor. subj. 3 sg., epic ending -ῃσι (= Attic καθέλῃ)
glossary.καθίζει: καθίζω — make to sit, seat, convene; pres. 3 sg.
glossary.καθαπτόμενος: καθάπτομαι — accost, address directly, fasten on with words; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.
glossary.κατάνεται: κατάνω — use up, consume (epic = κατανύω); pres. pass. 3 sg.: ’is wasted away’
glossary.κατέχευεν: καταχέω — pour down over; aor. 3 sg.
glossary.κειμήλιά: κειμήλιον — treasure, thing laid up in store; neut. acc. pl.
glossary.κεχαρισμένος: χαρίζομαι — show favour, gratify; perf. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’welcome, pleasing’
glossary.κηρύκεσσι: κῆρυξ — herald; masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic κήρυξι)
glossary.κηρύσσειν: κηρύσσω — proclaim, summon by herald; pres. inf.
glossary.κτεατίσσας: κτεατίζω — acquire, gain possession of; aor. part. masc. nom. sg., epic double σ (κτεατίσσας)
glossary.κυφὸς: κυφός — bent, stooped, hunched; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.λήθετ: λήθομαι — forget; impf. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented, elided (λήθετ’ = λήθετο), + gen.: ’forgot’
glossary.λίσσομαι: λίσσομαι — beseech, entreat; pres. 1 sg., + gen. of the power invoked · also + acc. of the person entreated (and acc. of the thing asked): οὐχ ὑμέας ἔτι λίσσομαι ’I no longer beg you’ · also used absolutely, the addressee already given by context and left unexpressed, with the ground of the appeal in a following clause (λίσσομαι, εἴ ποτέ ...)
glossary.λαέρτῃ: Λαέρτης — Laertes, father of Odysseus; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.λαοὶ: λαός — people, host, men of the community; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.λαὸν: λαός — people, host; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.λεπτὸν: λεπτός — fine, thin, delicate; masc./neut. acc. sg.
glossary.λευγαλέοι: λευγαλέος — wretched, sorry, feeble; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.λιγυφθόγγοισι: λιγύφθογγος — clear-voiced; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
glossary.λιπαροῖσιν: λιπαρός — sleek, glistening, glossy (as skin rubbed with oil); masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οῖς)
glossary.λυγρῷ: λυγρός — baneful, bitter, grievous; masc./neut. dat. sg.
glossary.λύει: λύω — loose, dissolve; pres. 3 sg. (of an assembly): ’dismisses’ · also of quarrels: νείκεα λύει ’settles disputes’
glossary.μέσῃ: μέσος — middle, in the middle of; fem. dat. sg. (dat. of place)
glossary.μήδεα: μῆδος — counsel, plan, device; neut. acc. pl. μήδεα · also the genitals (of the body): περὶ χροῒ μήδεα φωτός ’the man’s genitals, about the skin’; neut. acc. pl. · also neut. nom. pl. (same form), subject: ’counsels’ (σά τε μήδεα … ἀπηύρα)
glossary.μίμνετ: μένω — wait, stay, abide; pres. imper. 2 pl., reduplicated stem μίμνω, elided (μίμνετ’ = μίμνετε)
glossary.μαψιδίως: μαψιδίως — idly, heedlessly, to no purpose; adv. · also ’without cause’, beside an infinitive of a wrongful act (μαψιδίως ψεύδεσθαι ’to lie without cause’)
glossary.μενοίνησεν: μενοινάω — intend, be eager for, have in mind; aor. 3 sg.
glossary.μενοινᾷ: μενοινάω — intend, be eager for, have in mind; pres. 3 sg.
glossary.μερμήριξε: μερμηρίζω — ponder, devise, turn over in the mind; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐμερμήριξε)
glossary.μετέειπε: μετεῖπον — speak among, address; aor. 3 sg., epic uncontracted, augment ἐ- kept (= Attic μετεῖπε)
glossary.μεταμώνια: μεταμώνιος — wasted, vain, gone to the winds; neut. nom. pl.
glossary.μεταστρέψωσιν: μεταστρέφω — turn about, turn back (on someone); aor. subj. 3 pl.
glossary.μευ: ἐγώ — I; encl. gen. sg., epic μευ (= Attic μου): ’of me’, with κλύω ’hear me’ · also gen. with ἄγχι: ’near me’ (μευ ἄγχι στᾶσα) · also gen. of possession, ’my’ (οἵ μευ … κῆρ ’my heart’) · also gen. sg. with a participle: ’of me hearing’ (μευ ἀκούοντος, with φίλον ἦτορ ’heart’) · also gen. with κήδομαι: ’care for me’ (ἦ μευ … κήδεαι ’you care for me’)
glossary.μεῖζον: μείζων — greater, larger; neut. nom./acc. sg., comparative of μέγας
glossary.μοῖρ: μοῖρα — fate, portion, lot; fem. nom. sg., elided (μοῖρ’ = μοῖρα)
glossary.μυρία: μυρίος — countless, numberless; neut. acc. pl. μυρία · also neut. nom. pl. (identical form), agreeing with a nominative: ’countless’ (ὀνείατα μυρία κεῖται)
glossary.μύθοισιν: μῦθος — word, speech; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις)
glossary.μύθῳ: μῦθος — word, speech, plea; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.μῆνιν: μῆνις — wrath, lasting anger (esp. a god’s); fem. acc. sg.
glossary.μῶμον: μῶμος — blame, reproach; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.νέων: νέος — young; masc. gen. pl. · also a different word, νέω ’swim’: pres. part. masc. nom. sg., ’swimming’
glossary.νήματ: νῆμα — thread, spun yarn; neut. nom. pl., elided (νήματ’ = νήματα)
glossary.νεμεσήσῃ: νεμεσάω — feel righteous indignation; aor. subj. 3 sg.
glossary.νεμεσσήθητε: νεμεσάω — feel righteous indignation; aor. imper. 2 pl., epic double σ (νεμεσσήθητε)
glossary.νηυσί: ναῦς — ship; fem. dat. pl., epic νηυσί (= Attic ναυσί), here without ν-movable
glossary.οἴκου: οἶκος — house, household; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.οἶκτος: οἶκτος — pity, compassion; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.οὐχ: οὐ — not; neg. adv., form before a rough breathing (οὐχ)
glossary.πάντα: πᾶς — all, every; neut. nom./acc. pl. · also masc. acc. sg.: ’all’ (πάντα δῆμον ’all the people’) · also neut. acc. pl. adverbial: ’altogether, in every respect’ (οὐκ ἄρα πάντα νοήμονες ’not altogether sensible’)
glossary.πένθεϊ: πένθος — grief, mourning; neut. dat. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic πένθει)
glossary.πέρι: περί — around, about, exceedingly; adv. with anastrophe (accent thrown back): ’beyond all others’ (πέρι κέρδεα οἶδεν) · also preposition with anastrophe + acc., of place: ’around’ (ἄστυ πέρι ’around the city’) · also preposition with anastrophe + gen.: ’about, concerning’ (φόνου πέρι ’about slaughter’)
glossary.πίονας: πίων — fat, rich; masc./fem. acc. pl. (fem. usually πίειρα)
glossary.παρείη: πάρειμι — be at hand, be present; pres. opt. 3 sg. (remote condition): ’were at hand’
glossary.πατρώια: πατρώιος — of one’s father, ancestral; neut. acc. pl.
glossary.πεισήνωρ: Πεισήνωρ — Peisenor, a herald of Ithaca; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.πεπνυμένα: πέπνυμαι — be prudent, wise (perf. w/ pres. sense, from πνέω ’breathe’); part. neut. acc. pl.: ’prudent (counsels)’
glossary.περίμετρον: περίμετρος — very large, of great compass (περί ’exceedingly’ + μέτρον ’measure’); masc. acc. sg.
glossary.περικτίονας: περικτίων — dwelling around, neighbouring; masc. acc. pl.
glossary.περιναιετάουσι: περιναιετάω — dwell around, live in the neighbourhood; pres. 3 pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic -ῶσι)
glossary.πιφαύσκεται: πιφαύσκω — make known, declare; pres. mid. 3 sg.
glossary.πιφαύσκομαι: πιφαύσκω — make known, declare; pres. mid. 1 sg.
glossary.ποθ: ποτέ — once, at some time, ever; enclitic adv., elided before a rough breathing (ποθ’ = ποτέ)
glossary.ποσσὶ: πούς — foot; masc. dat. pl., epic ποσσί (= Attic ποσί)
glossary.ποτιπτυσσοίμεθα: προσπτύσσομαι — embrace, press, entreat; pres. opt. 1 pl. mid., epic ποτι- (= Attic προσ-)
glossary.ποτὶ: πρός — to, toward, against; prep., epic ποτί, here as preverb in tmesis (ποτὶ … βάλε = προσέβαλε) · also a plain preposition + acc., no tmesis: ποτὶ τοῖχον ’against the wall’ · also + dat. ‘against’ · also + dat., ’on, upon’: ποτὶ χθονί ’on the ground’
glossary.ποῖον: ποῖος — of what kind, what sort of; neut. nom./acc. sg., exclamatory: ’what a thing!’
glossary.προγενέστεροί: προγενής — born before, earlier-born; masc. nom. pl. comparative προγενέστεροι
glossary.προσέειπεν: προσεῖπον — speak to, address; aor. 3 sg., epic uncontracted, augment ἐ- kept (= Attic προσεῖπε)
glossary.προϊεῖσα: προΐημι — send forth, let go; pres. part. fem. nom. sg.
glossary.πρόβασίν: πρόβασις — livestock, property that walks (προβαίνω ’walk forward’); fem. acc. sg.
glossary.πρότερός: πρότερος — earlier, before; masc. nom. sg., adverbial: ’first, before anyone else’
glossary.πρῶτον: πρῶτος — first; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’first’
glossary.πυθοίμην: πυνθάνομαι — learn, inquire; aor. opt. 1 sg. mid.
glossary.πωλεύμενοι: πωλέομαι — go to and fro, frequent, resort to; pres. part. masc. nom. pl., Ionic πωλεύμενος (εο > ευ)
glossary.πύθοιτο: πυνθάνομαι — learn, inquire; aor. opt. 3 sg. mid.
glossary.πύματον: πύματος — last, final; neut./masc. acc. sg.
glossary.σκῆπτρον: σκῆπτρον — staff, sceptre (badge of the right to speak); neut. acc. sg.
glossary.σπείρου: σπεῖρον — cloth, wrapping, winding-sheet; neut. gen. sg.
glossary.σπῆι: σπέος — cave; neut. dat. sg., epic σπῆϊ (contracted σπῆι)
glossary.στήθεσσιν: στῆθος — breast, chest; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσι(ν) (= Attic στήθεσι)
glossary.στησαμένη: ἵστημι — set up, set; aor. part. mid. fem. nom. sg.: ’having set up (for herself)’
glossary.στρατοῦ: στρατός — army, host; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.σχέσθε: ἔχω — have, hold; aor. imper. mid. 2 pl. (root aor. σχ-): ’hold back, stop’
glossary.τάχ: τάχα — soon, quickly, perhaps; adv., elided (τάχ’ = τάχα)
glossary.τέταρτον: τέταρτος — fourth; ordinal numeral, neut. nom./acc. sg. · also masc. acc. sg. with the article: τὸν τέταρτον ’the fourth (man)’
glossary.τίνα: τίς, τί — who? what?; interrog. pron., fem./masc. acc. sg.
glossary.τανηλεγέος: τανηλεγής — meaning unknown (traditionally ’laying at full length’ or ’bringing long sorrow’), epithet of death; masc./fem. gen. sg.
glossary.ταφήιον: ταφήιος — for burial, funerary; neut. nom./acc. sg., used as noun: ’burial-cloth, shroud’
glossary.τείρεσθ: τείρω — wear down, distress; pres. inf. pass., elided (τείρεσθ’ = τείρεσθαι)
glossary.τελέσειεν: τελέω — bring to pass, accomplish, fulfil; aor. opt. 3 sg. (wish): ’may he bring to pass’ · also potential (with κεν): ’might bring to pass’ · also aor. opt. 3 sg. in an indirect question after a past verb: ’how he might fulfil’ (ὅππως … τελέσειεν)
glossary.τετεύχαται: τεύχω — make, do, work; perf. pass. 3 pl., Ionic -αται (= Attic -νται): ’have been done’
glossary.τοίσδεσσιν: ὅδε — this, this here; demonstr. pron., masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσι(ν) added (= Attic τοῖσδε)
glossary.τούτους: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο — this; demonstr. pron., masc. acc. pl.
glossary.τοῖοι: τοῖος — such, of such a sort; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.τρίτον: τρίτος — third; ordinal numeral, neut. nom. sg. · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with a masc. noun: τρίτον ἄνδρα ’a third man’ (as direct object) · also neut. acc. sg., direct object: τρίτον ἦμαρ ’the third day’ (τέλεσ’ Ἠώς ’Dawn completed the third day’) · also with the article, neut. acc. sg. adverbial: τὸ τρίτον ’the third time, thirdly’
glossary.τρεῖς: τρεῖς — three; numeral, masc./fem. nom. pl. · also masc./fem. acc. pl. (same syncretic form): ’three’ (ἑταίρους τρεῖς ’three companions’, acc.)
glossary.τόνδ: ὅδε — this, this here; demonstr. pron., masc. acc. sg., elided (τόνδ’ = τόνδε)
glossary.τόφρα: τόφρα — so long, meanwhile; adv., correlative with ἕως ’until’ · also correlative with ὄφρα: ’so long’ (ὄφρα μὲν … ἔην, τόφρα ’as long as she was alive, so long’)
glossary.υἷες: υἱός — son; masc. nom. pl., epic υἷες (= Attic υἱεῖς)
glossary.φάγοιτε: ἐσθίω — eat; aor. opt. 2 pl. (root ἐφαγ-)
glossary.φάνη: φαίνω — show; aor. pass. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐφάνη): ’appeared’
glossary.φήμῃ: φήμη — a saying, utterance heard as an omen; fem. dat. sg.
glossary.φίλη: φίλος — dear, one’s own; fem. nom. sg. · also voc. sg. in address: ’dear one!’
glossary.φᾶρος: φᾶρος — large cloth, robe, web; neut. acc. sg.
glossary.χ: κε(ν) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν); elided and aspirated χ’ before a rough breathing
glossary.χάριν: χάρις — grace, charm; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.χέων: χέω — pour, shed; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.
glossary.χαλεποῖσιν: χαλεπός — harsh, difficult, severe; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οῖς)
glossary.χρήματ: χρῆμα — thing, matter; pl. χρήματα ’goods, property’; neut. acc. pl., elided (χρήματ’ = χρήματα)
glossary.χρειὼ: χρειώ — need, want, business; fem. nom. sg., epic by-form of χρεία; in τίνα χρειὼ … ἵκει ’whom has need come upon?’
glossary.χωόμενος: χώομαι — be angry, be enraged; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀγασσάμενοι: ἄγαμαι — wonder at, be indignant at, resent; aor. part. masc. nom. pl. mid., epic double σ (ἀγασσάμενοι)
glossary.ἀγγελίας: ἀγγελίη — message, news; fem. acc. pl. (Attic ἀγγελία)
glossary.ἀγορήν: ἀγορή — assembly, gathering-place; fem. acc. sg. (Attic ἀγορά)
glossary.ἀγορήσατο: ἀγοράομαι — speak in the assembly; aor. 3 sg. mid.
glossary.ἀγορεύει: ἀγορεύω — speak, speak in assembly; pres. 3 sg.
glossary.ἀγορεύω: ἀγορεύω — speak, speak in assembly; pres. 1 sg.
glossary.ἀγορὰς: ἀγορή — assembly; fem. acc. pl. (Attic ἀγοράς)
glossary.ἀγορὴ: ἀγορή — assembly; fem. nom. sg. (Attic ἀγορά)
glossary.ἀγορῇ: ἀγορή — assembly; fem. dat. sg. (Attic ἀγορᾷ)
glossary.ἀλκήν: ἀλκή — defensive strength, valour; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀμείψασθαι: ἀμείβομαι — answer, reply, exchange (words); aor. inf. mid.
glossary.ἀμειβόμενος: ἀμείβομαι — answer, reply; pres. part. masc. nom. sg. mid.
glossary.ἀμυνέμεν: ἀμύνω — ward off, defend; pres. inf., epic -έμεν (= Attic ἀμύνειν)
glossary.ἀμυναίμην: ἀμύνω — ward off, defend; aor. opt. 1 sg. mid.: ’I would defend myself’
glossary.ἀμῦναι: ἀμύνω — ward off, defend; aor. inf. act., infin. of purpose: ’to ward off’
glossary.ἀνάψαι: ἀνάπτω — fasten on, attach; aor. inf.: ’to fasten (blame) on’ · also ’fasten, make fast (a cable)’: aor. inf. (πρυμνήσι’ ἀνάψαι ’to make the stern-cables fast’)
glossary.ἀναπρήσας: ἀναπρήθω — make burst out, blow up; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’bursting out (into tears)’
glossary.ἀνσχετὰ: ἀνασχετός — to be endured, bearable; neut. nom. pl., apocope (ἀνσχετά = ἀνασχετά)
glossary.ἀπαιτίζοντες: ἀπαιτίζω — ask back, demand back (epic = ἀπαιτέω); pres. part. masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἀπερρίγασι: ἀπορριγέω — shudder back from, shrink from; perf. 3 pl. with pres. sense: ’shrink from’
glossary.ἀποτινύμενοι: ἀποτίνω — pay back, exact requital; pres. part. masc. nom. pl. mid.: ’exacting payment (from)’
glossary.ἀπρήκτους: ἄπρηκτος — not to be dealt with, without remedy; fem. acc. pl. (Attic ἄπρακτος)
glossary.ἀπώλεσα: ἀπόλλυμι — destroy, lose; aor. 1 sg. act.: ’I have lost’
glossary.ἀργοὶ: ἀργός — swift or white (meaning disputed for dogs, both senses possible); masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἀρὴν: ἀρή — bane, ruin, harm; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀτέμβει: ἀτέμβω — cheat, disappoint, deprive; pres. 3 sg.
glossary.ἀχαιούς: Ἀχαιοί — the Achaeans, the Greeks; masc. acc. pl.
glossary.ἀχαιϊάδων: Ἀχαιιάς — Achaean woman; fem. gen. pl.
glossary.ἀχεύων: ἀχεύω — grieve, be distressed; pres. part. masc. nom. sg., epic by-form of ἀχέω
glossary.ἄγριος: ἄγριος — savage, wild; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἄλγος: ἄλγος — pain, grief; neut. nom. sg.
glossary.ἄλλο: ἄλλος — other, another; neut. nom./acc. sg.
glossary.ἄλλον: ἄλλος — other, another; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἄλλους: ἄλλος — other, another; masc. acc. pl.
glossary.ἄντην: ἄντην — face to face, to the eye, in front; adv.
glossary.ἄντιφος: Ἄντιφος — Antiphus, son of Aegyptius; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἄστυ: ἄστυ — town, city; neut. acc. sg.
glossary.ἄσχετε: ἄσχετος — not to be held back, unchecked (ἀ- + σχετός; epic also ἀάσχετος); masc. voc. sg.
glossary.ἄτερ: ἄτερ — without, apart from; prep. + gen.
glossary.ἅπαντα: ἅπας — all, the whole of; masc. acc. sg. · also neut. nom./acc. pl., subject or object of a verb: ’all things’ (τελευτηθῆναι ἅπαντα ’that all things were fulfilled’)
glossary.ἐάσατε: ἐάω — let, allow, leave alone; aor. imper. 2 pl.
glossary.ἐγένοντο: γίγνομαι — become, happen; aor. 3 pl.: ’became, were’ (ὁμηγερέες ἐγένοντο ’were assembled together’) · also ’were born’ (ἠδ’ ἐγένοντο)
glossary.ἐεδνώσαιτο: ἐεδνόομαι — pay/settle the marriage-gifts (ἔεδνα) for a bride; aor. opt. 3 sg. mid.
glossary.ἐθέλοι: ἐθέλω — wish, be willing; pres. opt. 3 sg.
glossary.ἐθέλοις: ἐθέλω — wish, be willing; pres. opt. 2 sg.
glossary.ἐθελούσῃ: ἐθέλω — wish, be willing; pres. part. fem. dat. sg.: ’unwilling’ (οὐκ ἐθελούσῃ) · also without a negative: ’willing’ (οὐκ ἐθέλων ἐθελούσῃ ’he unwilling, she willing’)
glossary.ἐκήρυσσον: κηρύσσω — proclaim, make proclamation; impf. 3 pl.
glossary.ἐκτελέσω: ἐκτελέω — finish completely, accomplish; aor. subj. 1 sg.
glossary.ἐμβάλλετε: ἐμβάλλω — throw into, cast into; pres. 2 pl.
glossary.ἐμὸν: ἐμός — my, mine; masc./neut. acc. sg. · also neut. nom. sg., subject: ’my’ (ὄνομ’ … ἐμὸν ’my name’; ἐμὸν κῆρ ’my heart’)
glossary.ἐνθάδε: ἐνθάδε — here, to this place; adv., with -δε suffix of direction (’in this place’)
glossary.ἐπέχραον: ἐπιχράω — fall upon, assail; aor. 3 pl., augment after the preverb (ἐπ-έ-χραον)
glossary.ἐπειγόμενοι: ἐπείγομαι — press on, be eager for, hasten; pres. part. masc. nom. pl. mid., + acc.: ’eager for’
glossary.ἐπερχόμενον: ἐπέρχομαι — come on, approach; pres. part. masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἐσθλός: ἐσθλός — good, noble, brave; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἐσθλὸς: ἐσθλός — good, noble, brave; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἐσόμεσθα: εἰμί — be; fut. 1 pl., epic -μεσθα (= Attic ἐσόμεθα)
glossary.ἐυκνήμιδας: ἐϋκνήμις — well-greaved; masc. acc. pl., epithet of the Achaeans · also of Odysseus’ companions (ἐυκνήμιδας ἑταίρους ’well-greaved companions’)
glossary.ἐύπωλον: ἐΰπωλος — with fine foals, rich in horses; masc./fem. acc. sg. (two terminations; with fem. Ἴλιος)
glossary.ἑκὰς: ἑκάς — far, far off; adv. · also prep. + gen.: ’far from’ (νηῶν ἑκὰς ’far from the ships’)
glossary.ἑσσάμενος: ἕννυμι — clothe, put on; aor. part. masc. nom. sg. mid.: ’having put on (for himself)’
glossary.ἔειπες: εἶπον — say, speak; aor. 2 sg., epic uncontracted, augment ἐ- kept (ἔειπες = εἶπες)
glossary.ἔην: εἰμί — be; impf. 3 sg., epic (= Attic ἦν)
glossary.ἔκλυεν: κλύω — hear, hear of; aor. 3 sg.
glossary.ἔκλυον: κλύω — hear, hear of; aor. 1 sg. · also aor. 3 pl.: ’they heard’ (οἱ δ’ ἔκλυον ’they heard’)
glossary.ἔλπει: ἔλπω — make to hope, cause to expect; pres. 3 sg. act. (mid. ἔλπομαι ’hope’ is more usual): ’keeps in hope’
glossary.ἔμπεσεν: ἐμπίπτω — fall upon, fall into; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐνέπεσεν)
glossary.ἔπ: ἐπί — on, upon; standing for ἔπεστι ’is there, is at hand’, accent thrown back (ἔπι), elided ἔπ’ · also adverbial ἔπ’ with no ἔπεστι sense (τόσσον ἔπ’ εὐρεῖαν), exact force debated · also ἐπί + dat. of cause, accent thrown back (ἔπ’ = ἔπι): ’for, on account of’ (τῷ ἔπ’ … μογήσῃ ’for whom he has toiled’)
glossary.ἔπειθ: ἔπειτα — then, thereafter; adv., elided (ἔπειθ’ = ἔπειτα before a rough breathing)
glossary.ἔρεξεν: ῥέζω — do, work, perform; aor. 3 sg.
glossary.ἔσκεν: εἰμί — be; impf. iterative 3 sg. (-σκε(ν) suffix): ’used to be’
glossary.ἔτλη: τλάω — bring oneself to, dare, endure; aor. 3 sg. (ἔτλην, inf. τλῆναι)
glossary.ἔχον: ἔχω — have, hold, keep to; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented (= εἶχον) · also impf. 1 sg., unaugmented (= εἶχον): ’I had, I was carrying’
glossary.ἠγείροντο: ἀγείρω — gather, assemble; impf. 3 pl. mid.: ’gathered themselves’
glossary.ἠριγένεια: ἠριγένεια — early-born; fem. nom. sg., epithet of Dawn
glossary.ἠώς: ἠώς — dawn; fem. nom. sg. (personified Ἠώς, Attic Ἕως)
glossary.ἡμέας: ἐγώ (pl. ἡμεῖς) — I, we; acc. pl., epic ἡμέας (= Attic ἡμᾶς)
glossary.ἡμετέρη: ἡμέτερος — our, ours; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἤγειρα: ἀγείρω — gather, assemble; aor. 1 sg. act.: ’I gathered’
glossary.ἤγειρε: ἀγείρω — gather, assemble; aor. 3 sg. act.
glossary.ἤγερθεν: ἀγείρω — gather, assemble; aor. pass. 3 pl., epic -εν (= Attic ἠγέρθησαν): ’were gathered’
glossary.ἤματα: ἦμαρ — day; neut. acc. pl., acc. of time: ’all the days, every day’ · also neut. nom. pl., subject: ’the days’ (νύκτες τε καὶ ἤματα φθίνουσιν)
glossary.ἤπιος: ἤπιος — gentle, kindly; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἥρωι: ἥρως — hero, man of standing; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.ἥρως: ἥρως — hero, man of standing; masc. nom. sg. · also used as a vocative in direct address, inserted mid-sentence (ἥρως, εἴρεσθαι δέ ’and ask, hero that you are’), distinct from its use as a narrative title ’the hero’
glossary.ἦέ: ἠέ — or; disjunctive conj., epic by-form (variant accentuation ἦε)
glossary.ἦμος: ἦμος — when, at the time when; temporal conj.
glossary.ἦρχ: ἄρχω — begin, rule; impf. 3 sg., elided (ἦρχ’ = ἦρχε), + inf.: ’was first to (speak)’
glossary.ἰθακήσιοι: Ἰθακήσιος — man of Ithaca; masc. voc. pl. · also masc. nom. pl., subject: ’the Ithacans’ (Ἰθακήσιοι εἰσορόωσι ’the Ithacans look upon’)
glossary.ἰκαρίου: Ἰκάριος — Icarius, father of Penelope; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.ἱερεύοντες: ἱερεύω — slaughter as a sacrifice, sacrifice; pres. part. masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἱστὸν: ἱστός — loom, mast; masc. acc. sg. (here ’loom’, and by extension the web on it) · also ’mast’ (of a ship): ἱστὸν … στῆσαν ἀείραντες ’they raised and set up the mast’
glossary.ἴλιον: Ἴλιος — Ilios, Troy; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἵκει: ἵκω — come upon, reach, arrive at; pres. 3 sg., epic beside ἱκνέομαι
glossary.ὀλέσσει: ὄλλυμι — destroy; fut. 3 sg., epic double σ (= Attic ὀλεῖ); in tmesis ἀπὸ … ὀλέσσει = ἀπολέσει
glossary.ὀλοὴ: ὀλοός — deadly, destructive; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ὀνήμενος: ὀνίνημι — profit, benefit; aor. part. masc. nom. sg. mid.: ’having got profit, blessed, in luck’
glossary.ὀξὺ: ὀξύς — sharp, keen; neut. acc. sg.
glossary.ὀτρύνοντες: ὀτρύνω — urge on, spur on, incite; pres. part. masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ὁμίλει: ὁμιλέω — keep company with, associate with; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented, + dat. · also pres. imper. 2 sg., + dat., the identical unaugmented form: ’mingle, keep company with!’ (μνηστῆρσιν ὁμίλει)
glossary.ὁμηγερέες: ὁμηγερής — gathered together, assembled; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ὄις: ὄϊς — sheep; fem. acc. pl., epic ὄϊς (= Attic οἶς)
glossary.ὄληται: ὄλλυμαι — perish, be lost, be destroyed; aor. subj. 3 sg. mid. (μή + subj.: ’lest … perish’) · also + subj. in a temporal clause: ’when … perishes’ (ἐπὴν … ὄληται) · also + subj. in a purpose clause after ὅπως: ’so that … may perish’
glossary.ὅτι: ὅστις — whoever, whatever; epic ὅ τι written ὅτι, neut. nom./acc. sg. · also conj. ’that, because’ (ὅτι τοι κακὰ πολλὰ φυτεύει)
glossary.ὑμέας: σύ (pl. ὑμεῖς) — you; acc. pl., epic ὑμέας (= Attic ὑμᾶς)
glossary.ὑμῖν: σύ (pl. ὑμεῖς) — you; dat. pl.: ’to you’
glossary.ὑπίσχεται: ὑπισχνέομαι — promise; pres. 3 sg. mid., epic ὑπίσχομαι
glossary.ὑποδείσατε: ὑποδείδω — fear, shrink before, dread; aor. imper. 2 pl.
glossary.ὑψαγόρη: ὑψαγόρης — loud-talker, boaster (ὕψι + ἀγορεύω); masc. voc. sg.
glossary.ὕφαινε: ὑφαίνω — weave; impf. 3 sg. (an augment on initial υ- does not show in writing)
glossary.ὡπλίσσατο: ὁπλίζω — make ready, prepare, equip; aor. 3 sg. mid., epic double σ (ὡπλίσσατο): ’made ready for himself’
glossary.ὤρνυτ: ὄρνυμι — stir, rouse; impf. mid. 3 sg., elided (ὤρνυτ’ = ὤρνυτο): ’rose’
glossary.ὦκα: ὦκα — quickly, swiftly; adv., from ὠκύς
glossary.ᾔδη: οἶδα — know; plpf. 3 sg. with past sense (= impf.): ’knew’
glossary.ῥέζετε: ῥέζω — do, work, perform; pres. 2 pl.
glossary.ῥοδοδάκτυλος: ῥοδοδάκτυλος — rose-fingered; fem. nom. sg., epithet of Dawn
glossary.αἰετὼ: αἰετός — eagle; masc. nom./acc. dual: ’the pair of eagles’
glossary.αὐγὰς: αὐγή — ray, gleam, light; fem. acc. pl.
glossary.αὐτῇ: αὐτός — self; intensive pron., fem. dat. sg.: ’for herself’ · also plain anaphoric pronoun referring to a thing, dat. sg. with ἐν: ’in it’ (ἐν αὐτῇ, of the ship) · also reinforcing a 1st-person pronoun: ’myself’ (ἐμοί περ αὐτῇ, μοι αὐτῇ ’for me myself’) · also reinforcing a 2nd-person pronoun: ’you yourself’ (σοὶ ὧδ’ αὐτῇ ’for you yourself’) · also dat. sg. of a thing, no ἐν, ’against it’ or ’against her’, with ποτικέκλιται (referent uncertain: pillar or queen) · also plain pronoun, dat. sg. with μίσγεται: ’with her’ (οὐδέ τις αὐτῇ μίσγεται ’nor does anyone consort with her’) · also plain pronoun, dat. sg. after ἅμα: ’with her’ (ἅμα δ’ ἀμφίπολοι φέρον αὐτῇ, of Circe) · also intensive with a noun, fem. dat. sg. with ἐν: ’very, same’ (αὐτῇ ἐνὶ χώρῃ ’in that very place’)
glossary.βίοτόν: βίοτος — life, livelihood, substance one lives on; acc. sg., accented before enclitic τε
glossary.βεβρώσεται: βιβρώσκω — eat, devour; fut. perf. pass. 3 sg.: ’will stand devoured’
glossary.βιότοιο: βίοτος — life, livelihood; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.γέρων: γέρων — old man; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.γήμασθαι: γαμέω — marry; aor. inf. mid., of a woman: ’be married, be given in marriage’
glossary.γεραιέ: γεραιός — old, aged; masc. voc. sg. (a second word for ’old man’, beside γέρων)
glossary.γνῶναι: γιγνώσκω — know, perceive, recognize; aor. inf.: ’to know, to read (a sign)’
glossary.δαίμων: δαίμων — a god, some divine power (vague, unspecified); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.δείδιμεν: δείδω — fear, be afraid; perf. 1 pl. with pres. sense: ’we fear’
glossary.δειρὰς: δειρή — neck, throat; fem. acc. pl.
glossary.δεξιὼ: δεξιός — on the right hand, favourable; masc. nom. dual: ’the two, on the right’ (a favourable omen)
glossary.διά: διά — through; prep. + acc. · also as preverb in tmesis: διὰ … κεάσσαι ’to split up’
glossary.διατρίβῃσιν: διατρίβω — wear away, spend time, delay; pres. subj. 3 sg., epic -ῃσιν: ’wears out the time over’
glossary.δρυψαμένω: δρύπτω — tear, scratch, claw; aor. part. mid., nom. dual masc.: ’having torn (with their talons)’
glossary.εἰδῇς: οἶδα — know; perf. subj. 2 sg. with pres. sense: ’you may know’
glossary.εἰδῶσι: οἶδα — know; perf. subj. 3 pl. with pres. sense: ’they may know’
glossary.εἰσανέβαινον: εἰσαναβαίνω — go up into, march up into; impf. 3 pl., augmented (εἰσ-αν-έ-βαινον; the α of ἀνα- elides before the augment)
glossary.εἴρω: εἴρω (A) — say, tell, declare; pres. 1 sg. (fut. sense: ’I shall say’), distinct from εἴρομαι ’ask’
glossary.εἵνεκα: ἕνεκα — because of, for the sake of; prep. + gen., epic prothetic ε- (εἵνεκα)
glossary.εὐρύοπα: εὐρύοπα — epithet of Zeus, literal sense disputed (’wide-voiced’ or ’far-seeing’); masc. nom. sg. in short -α
glossary.ζώει: ζώω (Attic ζάω) — live, be alive; pres. 3 sg.
glossary.θ: τε (elided and aspirated θ’ before rough breathing, cf. ἔφαθ’) — and; connective particle · also with the relative ὅθι, no connective force: ὅθι θ’ ’where’
glossary.θάμβησαν: θαμβέω — marvel, be amazed; aor. 3 pl.
glossary.θεοί: θεός — god; nom. pl. · also voc. pl. (same form): ’you gods!’
glossary.θεοπροπέων: θεοπροπέω — prophesy, utter oracles; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.
glossary.θωὴν: θωή — a fine, penalty; acc. sg.
glossary.κέλεται: κέλομαι — bid, command, urge; pres. 3 sg.
glossary.κέρδεά: κέρδος — gain, profit; (pl.) cunning, shrewd ways; neut. acc. pl., accented before enclitic θ’
glossary.κακῶς: κακός — bad, evil; adv.: ’wickedly, shamefully’ · also ’miserably, in misery’ (ὀψὲ κακῶς ἔλθοι ’may he come late, in misery’)
glossary.καταπαύσομεν: καταπαύω — stop, put an end to; fut. 1 pl., with κε(ν) in a purpose clause
glossary.καταφθίσθαι: καταφθίνω — perish utterly, be destroyed; aor. inf. mid.-pass.: ’to have perished’
glossary.κείνη: κεῖνος — that, that one; demonstrative pron., epic (= Attic ἐκεῖνος); fem. nom. sg.
glossary.κεχολωμένον: χολόω — make angry; pass. be angry, enraged; perf. pass. part. masc. acc. sg.: ’in a state of anger’
glossary.κορυφῆς: κορυφή — peak, summit; fem. gen. sg.
glossary.κυλίνδεται: κυλίνδω — roll; pres. 3 sg. mid.-pass.: ’rolls, comes rolling on’
glossary.κῆρα: κήρ — doom, fate of death; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.λώιόν: λωίων — better, more advantageous; comparative (of ἀγαθός), neut. nom. sg.
glossary.μέσσην: μέσος — middle; fem. acc. sg., epic μέσσος (doubled σ) = Attic μέσην
glossary.μαντεύεο: μαντεύομαι — prophesy, divine; pres. imper. 2 sg. mid.
glossary.μαντεύεσθαι: μαντεύομαι — prophesy, divine; pres. inf. mid.
glossary.μαντεύομαι: μαντεύομαι — prophesy, divine; pres. 1 sg. mid.
glossary.μαστορίδης: Μαστορίδης — son of Mastor, patronymic of Halitherses; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.μετ: μετά (elided μετ’) — among, after, in quest of; prep. + acc. · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (μετ’ … βαῖνε = μετέβαινε ’followed’) · also + dat., ’among, between’ (μετ’ ἀμφοτέροισιν ’between the two of them’) · also + gen., ’among, in company with’ (μετ’ ἄλλων … ἑταίρων ’among your other companions’)
glossary.μνηστύος: μνηστύς — wooing, courtship; fem. gen. sg.
glossary.μυθέαι: μυθέομαι — speak, tell, utter; pres. 2 sg. mid., epic uncontracted (= Attic μυθῇ)
glossary.μυθήσασθαι: μυθέομαι — speak, tell, declare; aor. inf. mid.
glossary.μυκήνη: Μυκήνη — Mycene, eponymous heroine of the city; nom. sg.
glossary.νεμεσίζεται: νεμεσίζομαι — feel indignation, be ashamed; pres. 3 sg.
glossary.νεμόμεσθ: νέμομαι — dwell in, occupy, inhabit; pres. 1 pl. mid., epic, elided (νεμόμεσθ’ = Attic νεμόμεθα)
glossary.νεώτερον: νέος — young; comparative νεώτερος, masc. acc. sg.
glossary.νοήματα: νόημα — thought, design, purpose; neut. acc. pl.
glossary.νύκτας: νύξ — night; fem. acc. pl., acc. of time: ’by nights’
glossary.οἰκία: οἰκίον — house, home (Homer only in neut. pl. οἰκία, collective, = Attic οἰκία fem. sg.); neut. acc. pl.
glossary.οἴκαδ: οἴκαδε (elided οἴκαδ’) — homeward, to home; adv., -δε suffix of direction
glossary.οἷ: οἷος — of what kind, such as; relative/exclamatory adj., neut. nom./acc. pl. οἷα, elided (οἷ’) · also orthotone dat. sg. of the 3rd-person pronoun (= οἱ): ’to him, to her’
glossary.οὐδὲ: οὐδέ — and not, nor, not even; neg. conj. (grave, mid-clause form)
glossary.πάντεσσιν: πᾶς — all, every; masc./neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσι(ν) (= Attic πᾶσι)
glossary.πάσχωσιν: πάσχω — suffer, experience; pres. subj. 3 pl.
glossary.παθόντ: πάσχω — suffer, experience; aor. part. masc. acc. sg., elided (παθόντ’ = παθόντα)
glossary.παλαιά: παλαιός — old, of old; neut. acc. pl.: ’things of old’
glossary.παλαιῶν: παλαιός — old; fem. gen. pl. (substantival, ’the women of old’), partitive/comparison
glossary.παραθεῖτο: παρατίθημι — set beside, place before; aor. opt. mid. 3 sg., in a clause of repeated circumstance
glossary.παρφάμενος: παράφημι — talk over, beguile with words; part. mid., masc. nom. sg.
glossary.παυέσθων: παύω — stop, cease; pres. imper. mid. 3 pl.: ’let them stop’
glossary.παύσεσθαι: παύω — stop, cease; fut. inf. mid.
glossary.πείσομαι: πάσχω — suffer, experience; fut. 1 sg. (not of πείθω)
glossary.πηνελοπείῃ: Πηνελόπεια — Penelope; dat. sg., dat. of comparison · also dat. sg., indirect object: ’to Penelope’ (ἐρέοντα περίφρονι Πηνελοπείῃ ’to tell prudent Penelope’) · also dat. sg. in apposition to a preceding dative of the person affected: ’(the daughter of Icarius,) prudent Penelope’
glossary.πιφαυσκόμενος: πιφαύσκω — declare, make known, make plain; pres. part. mid., masc. nom. sg., reduplicated
glossary.πλησίω: πλησίος — near; masc. nom. dual, used predicatively/adverbially: ’close (to one another)’
glossary.ποθὴν: ποθή — a missing, a longing, a want of; fem. acc. sg., + gen. of the thing lacked
glossary.ποιεῖτ: ποιέω — make, do, win, cause; pres. mid. 3 sg., elided (ποιεῖτ’ = ποιεῖται): ’wins (for herself)’
glossary.πολέος: πολύς — much, many; masc./neut. gen. sg., epic (= Attic πολλοῦ)
glossary.πολέσιν: πολύς — much, many; masc./neut. dat. pl., epic (= Attic πολλοῖς)
glossary.πολύμητις: πολύμητις — of many wiles, epithet of Odysseus (built on μῆτις ’cunning intelligence’); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.πολύμυθον: πολύμυθος — full of words, talkative; masc. acc. sg. (a one-off jibe, not a fixed epithet)
glossary.πολὺν: πολύς — much, many; masc. acc. sg., acc. of duration: ’for a long time’ · also adjectival, agreeing with a direct object noun: ‘much’ (πολὺν βίοτον ‘much livelihood’)
glossary.ποτιδέγμενοι: προσδέχομαι (epic ποτιδέγμαι) — wait for, await, expect; pres. part. mid. masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ποτιδέγμενος: προσδέχομαι (epic ποτιδέγμαι) — wait for, await, expect; pres. part. mid. masc. nom. sg.
glossary.πρὶν: πρίν — before, until; adv./conj., + inf. (grave, mid-clause form) · also τὸ πρίν, substantivized with the article: ‘formerly, at first’, no infinitive · also bare adv. ’formerly’, no art./inf. · also + aor. subj., ’before’ (πρὶν … ἐπέλθῃ ’before it comes upon’) · also + opt.: ’before’ (πρὶν τλαίη ’before he would bring himself’) · also adv. with a finite verb, ’before that, sooner’ (πρὶν … ἀγείρετο ’before that … came gathering’) · also + fut. indic.: ’before’ (πρὶν … γαῖα καθέξει ’before the earth covers’) · also with a bare noun, the verb understood: ’before’ (πρὶν ὥρη ’before it is time’)
glossary.πρῆξαι: πρήσσω (Attic πράσσω) — accomplish, achieve, effect; aor. inf. act.
glossary.πτερύγεσσιν: πτέρυξ — wing; fem. dat. pl., epic -εσσι(ν)
glossary.πτερὰ: πτερόν — feather, wing; neut. acc. pl. · also neut. nom. pl., predicate: ’wings’ (τά τε πτερὰ νηυσὶ πέλονται ’which are wings for ships’)
glossary.πυκνά: πυκνός — thick, close-set, dense; neut. acc. pl.
glossary.πως: πώς — somehow, in any way; enclitic adv. (οὔ πως ’in no way’)
glossary.πόρῃσιν: πόρω (defective) — give, grant, furnish; aor. subj. 3 sg., epic -ῃσιν
glossary.πῃ: πῃ — in some way, anywhere; enclitic adv.
glossary.πῆμα: πῆμα — woe, calamity, disaster; neut. nom. sg. · also neut. acc. sg., direct object: ’woe’
glossary.σέο: σύ — you (sg.); gen. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic σοῦ), gen. of comparison · also possessive gen., ’your (own)’ (σέο τ’ αὐτοῦ κήδεα ’your own woes’) · also gen. of concern after an exclamation: ὤ μοι ἐγὼ σέο ’alas for me, for your sake’
glossary.σοῖσι: σός — your, yours; masc./neut. dat. pl., epic -οισι
glossary.στυγερὰς: στυγερός — hateful, dreaded, loathsome; fem. acc. pl.
glossary.σὴν: σός — your, yours; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.σὺ: σύ — you (sg.); nom. sg. (grave, mid-clause form)
glossary.σῷ: σός — your, yours; masc./neut. dat. sg.
glossary.τάων: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun); fem. gen. pl., epic (= Attic τῶν): ’of these/those women’ · also fem. gen. pl., partitive, of things just named: ’of these’ (τάων ἥν κ’ ἐθέλῃσιν ’whichever of these he wishes’) · also relative, fem. gen. pl., with the nouns that follow: ’of whom’ (τάων … λώβην τε καὶ αἴσχεα ’whose outrage and shames’)
glossary.τέθνηκε: θνῄσκω — die; perf. 3 sg. with pres. sense: ’is dead’
glossary.τέκεσσιν: τέκος — child; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσι(ν)
glossary.τέτρατον: τέταρτος — fourth; epic by-form τέτρατος, neut. nom. sg. (agreeing with ἔτος)
glossary.τίνων: τίνω — pay, pay a penalty; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.
glossary.τελευτηθῆναι: τελευτάω — bring to fulfilment, accomplish; aor. inf. pass., in indirect statement after φημί
glossary.τελεῖται: τελέω — bring to pass, fulfil, accomplish; pres. pass. 3 sg.
glossary.τετελεσμένον: τελέω — bring to pass, fulfil; perf. pass. part. neut. nom. sg., periphrastic with ἔσται: ’shall stand fulfilled’ · also periphrastic with the pres. ἐστίν rather than fut. ἔσται, of a thing already fixed by fate: ’it is a thing ordained, it is decreed’ · also periphrastic with the opt. εἴη, in a wish: ’may it be fulfilled’ (τετελεσμένον εἴη)
glossary.τεὸν: τεός (epic possessive = σός) — your, yours; masc./neut. acc. sg.
glossary.τηλεμάχῳ: Τηλέμαχος — Telemachus, son of Odysseus; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.τινά: τις, τι — someone, something; masc. acc. sg., indefinite, accented before enclitic οἱ (with ὅν: ὅν τινα ’whatever’) · also neut. acc. pl., ’any’, with an understood noun (εἴ τινά που δεδάηκας ’if you have learned any’)
glossary.τιταινομένω: τιταίνω — stretch, strain; pres. part. mid., nom. dual
glossary.τοῖσδεσσι: ὅδε — this, this here; demonstrative pron., masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσι
glossary.τοῦτον: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο — this; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.τοῦτό: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο — this; neut. nom./acc. sg., accented before enclitic γ’ · also accented before enclitic τί (τοῦτό τί μοι ’this, I think’)
glossary.τρίετες: τρίετες — for three years; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially (acc. of duration), from τρίετης
glossary.τυρώ: Τυρώ — Tyro, a heroine of the past, mother of Pelias and Neleus; nom. sg.
glossary.τόσσα: τόσος — so much, so many; epic τόσσος (doubled σ), neut. acc. pl.
glossary.τὼ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. dual: ’the two of them’  ·  also acc. dual, object of a verb of address: τὼ … προσέφη ’spoke to the two of them’ · also relative, nom. dual, ’who (the two)’: τοκῆε δύω, τὼ μὴ γείνασθαι ὄφελλον · also nom. dual with a noun, article-like: ’the two’ (τὼ … θεράποντε)
glossary.τῆλ: τῆλε (elided/apocopated τῆλ’) — far, far away; adv.
glossary.τῆς: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun); fem. gen. sg. · also fem. gen. sg. with the force of a relative: ’of which’ (τῆς ἕτερον μὲν θειλόπεδον ’of which one part is a drying-ground’) · also with a name, article-like: ’that’ (τῆς Σκύλλης ’of that Scylla’) · also article-like with a noun: ’the, that’ (τῆς ληΐδος ’that booty’) · also article with αὐτῆς, ’the same’: τῆς αὐτῆς ἀγγελίης ’the same news’
glossary.τῶνδε: ὅδε — this, this here; demonstrative pron., masc./neut. gen. pl.
glossary.υἷας: υἱός — son; masc. acc. pl., epic υἷας (= Attic υἱούς)
glossary.φημὶ: φημί — say, assert, declare; pres. 1 sg.
glossary.φοιτῶσ: φοιτάω — go to and fro, roam; pres. 3 pl., elided (φοιτῶσ’ = φοιτῶσι)
glossary.φραζώμεσθ: φράζομαι — consider, take thought, devise; pres. subj. 1 pl. mid., hortatory, elided (φραζώμεσθ’ = φραζώμεθα)
glossary.φρονέουσ: φρονέω — think, be minded, ponder; pres. part. fem. nom. sg., elided, uncontracted (φρονέουσ’ = φρονέουσα)
glossary.φυτεύει: φυτεύω — plant, beget; pres. 3 sg., fig. ’set in motion (a disaster)’
glossary.φόνον: φόνος — murder, slaughter, bloodshed; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.φῆν: φημί — say, assert; impf. 1 sg., uncontracted (= ἔφην)
glossary.χαλεπαίνειν: χαλεπαίνω — be harsh, be angry; pres. inf.
glossary.χαλεπὸν: χαλεπός — harsh, grievous, painful; neut. nom. sg.
glossary.χρήματα: χρῆμα — thing, possession; (pl.) property, goods; neut. nom./acc. pl.
glossary.χρόνον: χρόνος — time; masc. acc. sg., acc. of duration
glossary.ἀέκουσαν: ἄκων (epic ἀέκων) — unwilling; fem. acc. sg. (= Attic ἄκουσαν)
glossary.ἀγήνωρ: ἀγήνωρ — lordly, manly, proud; adj. (2-termination), masc./fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀγλαὸν: ἀγλαός — splendid, radiant, bright; masc./neut. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀγόρευες: ἀγορεύω — speak, declare, say; impf. 2 sg., in an unreal apodosis with ἄν
glossary.ἀκράαντον: ἀκράαντος — unaccomplished, unfulfilled, vain; fem. acc. sg. (2-termination adj., predicative): ’in vain’
glossary.ἀλκμήνη: Ἀλκμήνη — Alcmene, mother of Heracles; nom. sg.
glossary.ἀλλήλοισι: ἀλλήλων — one another; masc./neut. dat. pl., epic -οισι
glossary.ἀλλύεσκεν: ἀναλύω — unravel, undo, unloose again; impf. 3 sg. iterative in -σκον, epic assimilated (ἀλλύεσκεν = ἀναλύεσκεν)
glossary.ἀλλύουσαν: ἀναλύω — unravel, undo; pres. part. fem. acc. sg., epic assimilated (ἀλλύουσαν = ἀναλύουσαν)
glossary.ἀμείνων: ἀγαθός — good; comparative ἀμείνων, masc. nom. sg.: ’better’
glossary.ἀμφί: ἀμφί — around, about, on both sides of; prep. + acc. · also preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἀμφί … ἕπον = ἀμφέπον ’busied themselves about, dressed’)
glossary.ἀνάγκης: ἀνάγκη — necessity, compulsion; fem. gen. sg.: ’under compulsion’
glossary.ἀνιήσει: ἀνιάω — distress, vex, grieve; fut. 3 sg.
glossary.ἀνιείης: ἀνίημι — let go, incite, urge on; pres. opt. 2 sg., in an unreal apodosis with κε
glossary.ἀνιηρέστερον: ἀνιηρός — distressing, grievous; comparative, neut. nom./acc. sg.
glossary.ἀνωγέτω: ἄνωγα — bid, command; perf. imper. 3 sg. with pres. force: ’let him bid’
glossary.ἀπάνευθε: ἀπάνευθε — far away, apart, at a distance; adv., + gen.
glossary.ἀπείρητος: ἀπείρητος — untried, without experience; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀπερχομένη: ἀπέρχομαι — go away, depart; pres. part. fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀπεχθάνεαι: ἀπεχθάνομαι — become hateful, incur hatred; pres. 2 sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἀπεχθάνῃ)
glossary.ἀπονέεσθαι: ἀπονέομαι — go back, return; pres. inf.
glossary.ἀποτίνειν: ἀποτίνω — pay back, repay; pres. inf.
glossary.ἀπόπεμψον: ἀποπέμπω — send away, send off; aor. imper. 2 sg.
glossary.ἀπῶσαι: ἀπωθέω — push away, thrust away, drive out; aor. inf. act.
glossary.ἀρήσετ: ἀράομαι — pray, pray for, call down (a curse); fut. 3 sg. mid., elided (ἀρήσετ’ = ἀρήσεται)
glossary.ἀργαλέης: ἀργαλέος — grievous, painful, hard; fem. gen. sg.
glossary.ἀργεῖοι: Ἀργεῖοι — the Argives, i.e. the Greeks; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἀρετῆς: ἀρετή — excellence, worth (of a person); fem. gen. sg.
glossary.ἀσχάλλῃς: ἀσχάλλω — be vexed, chafe, be distressed; pres. subj. 2 sg.
glossary.ἀχαιαί: Ἀχαιαί (fem. of Ἀχαιός) — the Achaean women; fem. nom. pl.
glossary.ἀχαιοί: Ἀχαιοί — the Achaeans, the Greeks; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἁλιθέρσης: Ἁλιθέρσης — Halitherses, an old seer of Ithaca, son of Mastor; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἁνδάνει: ἁνδάνω — please, be pleasing to; pres. 3 sg., + dat.
glossary.ἃς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., fem. acc. pl.
glossary.ἄγνωστον: ἄγνωστος — unknown, unrecognized; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἄλλοισιν: ἄλλος — other, another; masc./neut. dat. pl.
glossary.ἄλλῃ: ἄλλος — other, another; fem. dat. sg. used adverbially: ’elsewhere’ · also fem. dat. sg. adjective, ’(at) another (woman)’ (ἄλλῃ νεμεσῶ)
glossary.ἅ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., neut. nom./acc. pl.: ’what things’
glossary.ἐγγὺς: ἐγγύς — near, close by; adv. · also prep. + gen.: ’near’ (πυρὸς ἐγγὺς ’near the fire’)
glossary.ἐεικοστῷ: εἰκοστός — twentieth; epic ἐεικοστός (prothetic ε-), masc./neut. dat. sg.
glossary.ἐθέλουσ: ἐθέλω — wish, be willing; pres. part. fem. nom. sg., elided, concessive (ἐθέλουσ’ = ἐθέλουσα): ’though unwilling’
glossary.ἐθέλῃσι: ἐθέλω — wish, be willing; pres. subj. 3 sg.
glossary.ἐκέκαστο: καίνυμαι — excel, surpass; plpf. 3 sg. with impf. sense: ’excelled’
glossary.ἐκείνῳ: κεῖνος (Attic ἐκεῖνος) — that, that one; demonstrative pron., masc. dat. sg.
glossary.ἐμπαζόμεθ: ἐμπάζομαι — care for, heed, regard; pres. 1 pl. mid., + gen., elided (ἐμπαζόμεθ’ = ἐμπαζόμεθα)
glossary.ἐμυθεόμην: μυθέομαι — tell, relate, speak; impf. 1 sg. mid., iterative sense: ’I used to tell’ · also ’I told, I was telling’, of a single past telling
glossary.ἐνίψω: ἐνέπω (also ἐννέπω) — say, tell, utter; fut. 1 sg.
glossary.ἐναίσιμα: ἐναίσιμος — fitting, in due measure, true (of an omen); neut. acc. pl.
glossary.ἐναίσιμοι: ἐναίσιμος — fitting, in due measure, true (of an omen); masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἐναίσιμον: ἐναίσιμος — fitting, in due measure; neut. acc. sg.
glossary.ἐνιαυτῷ: ἐνιαυτός — year; masc. dat. sg., dat. of time when
glossary.ἐνόησε: νοέω — perceive, think, devise; aor. 3 sg.
glossary.ἐξετέλεσσε: ἐκτελέω — bring to completion, finish; aor. 3 sg.
glossary.ἐπέεσσιν: ἔπος — word; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσι(ν)
glossary.ἐπέτοντο: πέτομαι — fly; impf. 3 dual · also impf. 3 pl.: ’they flew, sped’
glossary.ἐπήλυθον: ἐπέρχομαι — come upon, come on, pass by; aor. 3 pl., unaugmented (= Attic ἐπῆλθον)
glossary.ἐπίστασθαι: ἐπίσταμαι — know, understand, be skilled in; pres. inf.
glossary.ἐπεπείθετο: πείθω — persuade; plpf. 3 sg. with impf. sense: ’was won over’
glossary.ἐπιδινηθέντε: ἐπιδινέω — whirl about, wheel about; aor. pass. part., nom. dual
glossary.ἐπιεικὲς: ἐπιεικής — fitting, suitable, proper; neut. nom. sg., used impersonally with ἐστί
glossary.ἐπιθήσομεν: ἐπιτίθημι — impose, lay upon; fut. 1 pl.
glossary.ἐποτρύνῃς: ἐποτρύνω — urge on, incite; pres. subj. 2 sg.
glossary.ἐρέω: ἐρέω — say, tell, declare; fut. 1 sg. (epic fut. of εἶπον, = Attic ἐρῶ); in tmesis with ἐκ, ἐξερέω ’speak out plainly’
glossary.ἐριδαίνομεν: ἐριδαίνω — strive, vie, contend; pres. 1 pl.
glossary.ἐρινῦς: Ἐρινύς — a Fury, avenging spirit that answers a parent’s curse; fem. acc. pl.
glossary.ἐρχόμεθ: ἔρχομαι — go, come; pres. 1 pl., elided (ἐρχόμεθ’ = ἐρχόμεθα)
glossary.ἐσθλὰς: ἐσθλός — good, noble; fem. acc. pl.
glossary.ἐυδείελον: ἐυδείελος — stock epithet of Ithaca, exact sense disputed (perhaps ’clear-seen’); fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἐυπλοκαμῖδες: ἐυπλοκαμίς — a woman of the fine locks, fair-tressed woman; fem. nom. pl. (a nominal formation, distinct from the adj. ἐυπλόκαμος)
glossary.ἐυστέφανός: ἐυστέφανος — fair-crowned, well-garlanded; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἐφεύρομεν: ἐφευρίσκω — find, discover, catch (in the act); aor. 1 pl.
glossary.ἑκὼν: ἑκών — willing, of one’s own accord; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἑταίρους: ἑταῖρος — companion, comrade; masc. acc. pl.
glossary.ἔδονται: ἐσθίω — eat; fut. 3 pl., mid. in form (epic future)
glossary.ἔειπε: εἶπον — say, speak, tell; aor. 3 sg., epic uncontracted, augment ἐ- kept before the root’s own ει- (= Attic εἶπε)
glossary.ἔθρεψε: τρέφω — rear, nurture, bring up; aor. 3 sg.
glossary.ἔληθε: λήθω (poetic by-form of λανθάνω) — escape notice, elude; impf. 3 sg., augmented, + dat. of means: ’escaped notice by’
glossary.ἔμελλον: μέλλω — be about to, be destined to; impf. 3 pl. · also impf. 1 sg. (same form): ’I was destined, was about to’ + fut. inf.
glossary.ἔμπης: ἔμπης — nevertheless, in any case, for all that; adv.
glossary.ἔξιτέ: ἔξειμι (ἐξ + εἶμι) — go out, get out; pres. imper. 2 pl.
glossary.ἔπειθεν: πείθω — persuade, deceive; impf. 3 sg., augmented
glossary.ἔστι: εἰμί — be; pres. 3 sg. impersonal: ’it is possible’ · also existential, ‘there is’ (ἔστι δέ τις πέτρη ‘there is a rock’)
glossary.ἔτεχ: τίκτω — bear, beget; aor. 3 sg., elided and aspirated (ἔτεχ’ = ἔτεκε)
glossary.ἔχῃ: ἔχω — hold, have, keep to; pres. subj. 3 sg.
