glossary.ποθὴ: ποθή — longing, want, need (+ gen.); fem. nom. sg.
glossary.πρώτῃ: πρῶτος — first; adj., fem. dat. sg., agreeing with μοι: ’(to me) first’
glossary.πῶμα: πῶμα — lid, cover; neut. acc. sg. (distinct from πόμα ’drink’)
glossary.σπένδῃ: σπένδω — pour a libation; pres. subj. 2 sg., after ὄφρα: ’you may pour’
glossary.στῆσαι: ἵστημι — set, stand up; aor. inf. act., transitive: ’to set up’
glossary.τάλαντον: τάλαντον — talent, a weight of gold; neut. acc. sg.
glossary.τέρπηται: τέρπω — delight; mid. take one’s pleasure; pres. subj. 3 sg. mid., after ὄφρα: ’may he take his pleasure’
glossary.τετιμένον: τιμάω — honour; perf. part. pass. masc. acc. sg., epic (= Attic τετιμημένον): ’honoured’
glossary.τιμήεντος: τιμήεις — precious, valued; adj., masc. gen. sg., epic (= Attic τίμιος): ’precious (gold)’
glossary.τρίποδ: τρίπους — tripod, three-footed cauldron-stand; masc. acc. sg., elided (τρίποδ’ = τρίποδα)
glossary.τρίποδα: τρίπους — tripod, three-footed cauldron-stand; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.τρίποδος: τρίπους — tripod, three-footed cauldron-stand; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.τρισκαιδέκατος: τρισκαιδέκατος — thirteenth; ordinal, masc. nom. sg.
glossary.φάγῃσιν: ἐσθίω (aor. ἔφαγον) — eat; aor. subj. 3 sg., epic -ῃσι(ν) (= Attic φάγῃ), after ὄφρα: ’that he may eat’
glossary.φέροιεν: φέρω — carry, bear; pres. opt. 3 pl., wish: ’may they carry (it) off’
glossary.φέρωμεν: φέρω — bring, carry; pres. subj. 1 pl., hortatory: ’let us bring’
glossary.φίλησε: φιλέω — love, treat as dear; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐφίλησε): ’loved’
glossary.φῦλον: φῦλον — tribe, race, kind; neut. acc. sg.
glossary.χαλκὸν: χαλκός — bronze; masc. acc. sg. · also a bronze vessel, cauldron: ’the bronze (cauldron)’
glossary.χηλὸν: χηλός — chest, coffer; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.χρύσεον: χρύσεος — golden; adj., neut. acc. sg., uncontracted (= Attic χρυσοῦν) · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with ὅρμον: ’golden’ (ὅρμον … χρύσεον)
glossary.ἀμφιδεδίνηται: ἀμφιδινέω — whirl, run around; perf. 3 sg. mid./pass.: ’has been set round, encircles’
glossary.ἀναρπάξασαι: ἀναρπάζω — snatch up, carry off; aor. part. fem. nom. pl.: ’having snatched up’
glossary.ἀοιδῶν: ἀοιδός — minstrel, singer; masc. gen. pl.
glossary.ἀολλέα: ἀολλής — all together, in a body; adj., neut. acc. pl., uncontracted epic (= Attic ἀολλῆ)
glossary.ἀποπροταμών: ἀποπροτάμνω — cut off (a portion); aor. part. masc. nom. sg. (Attic ἀποτεμών): ’having cut off’
glossary.ἀρέσσομαι: ἀρέσκω — appease, make amends to; fut. 1 sg. mid., doubled σ (= Attic ἀρέσομαι): ’I will make amends’
glossary.ἀργιόδοντος: ἀργιόδους — white-toothed; adj., masc./fem. gen. sg., epithet of a boar or pig
glossary.ἀργυρέη: ἀργύρεος — of silver; adj., fem. nom. sg., Ionic η (= Attic ἀργυρᾶ)
glossary.ἀρεσσάμενος: ἀρέσκω — appease, make amends to; aor. part. mid. masc. nom. sg., doubled σ: ’having made amends’
glossary.ἀρεσσάσθω: ἀρέσκω — appease, make amends to; aor. imper. 3 sg. mid., doubled σ: ’let him make amends’
glossary.ἀριπρεπέ: ἀριπρεπής — outstanding; fem. acc. sg., elided (ἀριπρεπέ’ = ἀριπρεπέα, Attic ἀριπρεπῆ)
glossary.ἀριπρεπέες: ἀριπρεπής — outstanding; masc. nom. pl., uncontracted (= Attic ἀριπρεπεῖς)
glossary.ἀσάμινθον: ἀσάμινθος — bath, bathing-tub; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἄλοχόν: ἄλοχος — wife, spouse; fem. acc. sg., accented before enclitic τε
glossary.ἄμφεπε: ἀμφέπω — busy oneself about, tend, play about; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἤμφεπε): ’was busy about’
glossary.ἄορ: ἄορ — sword (poetic, = ξίφος); neut. acc. sg.
glossary.ἐβιώσαο: βιόομαι — bring to life, save the life of; aor. 2 sg. mid., epic -αο (= Attic ἐβιώσω): ’you gave me life’
glossary.ἐδίδαξε: διδάσκω — teach; aor. 3 sg., augmented, with double acc.: ’taught (them the songs)’
glossary.ἐλέλειπτο: λείπω — leave; plpf. 3 sg. pass.: ’had been left (over)’
glossary.ἐνείκατε: φέρω (aor. ἤνεγκα) — bring; aor. imper. 2 pl., epic ἐνείκατε (= Attic ἐνέγκατε): ’bring!’
glossary.ἐξέφερεν: ἐκφέρω — carry out; impf. 3 sg., augmented (= Attic ἐξέφερε): ’was bringing out’
glossary.ἐπήρτυε: ἐπαρτύω — fit on, put in order; impf. 3 sg.: ’was fitting on’
glossary.ἐπιεικές: ἐπιεικής — fitting, suitable, proper; neut. nom. sg., predicate: ’as is fitting’
glossary.ἐπιχθονίοισιν: ἐπιχθόνιος — on the earth, earthly; adj., masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις)
glossary.ἐρίγδουπος: ἐρίγδουπος — loud-crashing, traditionally loud-thundering (ἐρι- intensive; exact sense uncertain), epithet of Zeus; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἐυπλυνὲς: ἐϋπλυνής — well-washed; adj., neut. acc. sg., agreeing with φᾶρος
glossary.ἑλοῦσαι: αἱρέω — take, seize; aor. part. fem. nom. pl. (aor. stem ἑλ-): ’having taken’
glossary.ἔδωκαν: δίδωμι — give; aor. 3 pl. augmented (κ-aorist): ’they gave’
glossary.ἔμμοροί: ἔμμορος — having a share in (+ gen.); adj., masc. nom. pl., accented before enclitic εἰσι
glossary.ἔμπεδος: ἔμπεδος — steady, firm, unfailing; adj. of two endings, fem. nom. sg., predicate · also masc. nom. sg., predicate (νοῦς … ἔμπεδος ’the mind was steady’)
glossary.ἔνεικαν: φέρω — bring; aor. 3 pl., epic (= Attic ἤνεγκαν): ’they brought’
glossary.ἔνεμον: νέμω — distribute, dole out; impf. 3 pl.: ’they distributed’
glossary.ἔχεαν: χέω — pour; aor. 3 pl., ε-stem aorist with -α endings (ἔχεα): ’they poured in’
glossary.ἠυκόμοιο: ἠΰκομος — fine-haired, with beautiful hair; adj., fem. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου), epithet of goddesses
glossary.ἥρης: Ἥρη — Hera, wife of Zeus; fem. gen. sg., Ionic (= Attic Ἥρας)
glossary.ἥρῳ: ἥρως — hero, noble warrior (title of honour); masc. dat. sg.
glossary.ἰήνατε: ἰαίνω — warm, heat; aor. imper. 2 pl.: ’warm!’
glossary.ἰδών: ὁράω (aor. εἶδον) — see; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having seen’
glossary.ἴηλεν: ἰάλλω — send, cast; aor. 3 sg. (ἴηλε with movable ν): ’cast, tied (a knot)’
glossary.ἴηλον: ἰάλλω — send, cast; aor. imper. 2 sg., epic: ’cast, tie (a knot)’
glossary.ἴῃ: εἶμι — go; pres. subj. 3 sg., after ὄφρα: ’may go’ · also pres. subj. 3 sg. in a temporal clause with εὖτ’ ἂν: ’whenever she goes’ (εὖτ’ ἂν ἴῃ … χορόν ’whenever she goes to the dance’)
glossary.ὀπάσσω: ὀπάζω — grant, give as a gift; fut. 1 sg., doubled σ (= Attic ὀπάσω): ’I will give’
glossary.ὀφέλλεις: ὀφέλλω — owe (epic for ὀφείλω, not the homograph ὀφέλλω ’increase’); pres. 2 sg. (= Attic ὀφείλεις): ’you owe’
glossary.ὁρῶσα: ὁράω — see, look; pres. part. fem. nom. sg.: ’looking at’
glossary.ὑψηλοῖσι: ὑψηλός — high, lofty; adj., masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οῖς)
glossary.ὑός: ὗς — pig, boar; masc./fem. gen. sg. ὑός
glossary.ὕμνον: ὕμνος — song, lay; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.αἰδοίοιο: αἰδοῖος — revered, worthy of respect; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.αἰνίζομ: αἰνίζομαι — praise, commend; pres. 1 sg. mid., elided (αἰνίζομ’ = αἰνίζομαι)
glossary.αἰνότατον: αἰνός — dread, grim, terrible; superl. αἰνότατος, masc. acc. sg.: ’most dread’
glossary.αἷμά: αἷμα — blood, kinship by blood; neut. acc. sg., accented before an enclitic
glossary.αὐταὶ: αὐτός — self; intensive pron., fem. nom. pl.: ’themselves’
glossary.βήμεναι: βαίνω — go, step; aor. inf., epic -μεναι (= Attic βῆναι)
glossary.βαλόντες: βάλλω — throw, cast; aor. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’having thrown’ · also aor. part. masc. nom. pl., ‘having put’ (ἐν νηῒ … βαλόντες ‘having put aboard a ship’)
glossary.δηιφόβοιο: Δηίφοβος — Deiphobus, a son of Priam; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.δημόδοκ: Δημόδοκος — Demodocus, the blind minstrel of the Phaeacians; voc. sg., elided (Δημόδοκ’ = Δημόδοκε)
glossary.δημόδοκος: Δημόδοκος — Demodocus, the minstrel of the Phaeacians; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.διέπραθον: διαπέρθω — sack, destroy utterly; aor. 3 pl., augmented, with the aorist ἔπραθον (of πέρθω) after the preverb
glossary.διαπλῆξαι: διαπλήσσω — strike through, cleave asunder; aor. inf.
glossary.δορπέομέν: δορπέω — take the evening meal, dine; pres. 1 pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic δορποῦμεν), accented before an enclitic
glossary.δουράτεον: δουράτεος — wooden, of timber; masc. acc. sg., epic (= Attic δούρειον)
glossary.δουρατέου: δουράτεος — wooden, of timber; masc. gen. sg., epic (= Attic δουρείου)
glossary.δούρεσσι: δόρυ — spear, shaft; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic δόρασι): ’with spears’
glossary.εἰδῇ: οἶδα — know; perf. subj. 3 sg., in a general relative clause with κεν: ’who knows’
glossary.εἰμεν: εἰμί — be; pres. 1 pl., epic (= Attic ἐσμέν): ’we are’
glossary.εἰπόντος: εἶπον — say; aor. part. masc. gen. sg., agreeing with a noun: ’as he said’
glossary.εἰσανάγουσι: εἰσανάγω — lead in, bring up into; pres. 3 pl.
glossary.εἴρερον: εἴρερος — servitude, slavery; masc. acc. sg., of the state entered: ’into bondage’
glossary.εἴρωμαι: εἴρομαι — ask, inquire; pres. subj. 1 sg. mid., epic (= Attic ἔρωμαι), with κε in an indefinite clause
glossary.εἶβεν: εἴβω — let fall, shed (poetic by-form of λείβω); impf. 3 sg., epic εἶβεν (= ἔλειβεν)
glossary.θελκτήριον: θελκτήριον — charm, thing that soothes or propitiates; neut. nom. sg.
glossary.θνήσκοντα: θνῄσκω — die; pres. part. masc. acc. sg.: ’dying’
glossary.κήδιστοι: κήδιστος — closest-tied, nearest by kinship (superl. of κήδιος, from κῆδος ’care, tie by marriage’); masc. nom. pl.
glossary.κασιγνήτοιο: κασίγνητος — brother; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου), gen. of comparison after χερείων
glossary.κασιγνήτου: κασίγνητος — brother; masc. gen. sg., governed by ἀντί: ’in place of a brother’
glossary.καταλέξῃς: καταλέγω — recount in full and in order; aor. subj. 2 sg., in a condition with αἴ κεν
glossary.κεκαλυμμέναι: καλύπτω — cover, veil; perf. mid./pass. part. fem. nom. pl.: ’hidden’
glossary.κεκαλυμμένοι: καλύπτω — cover, hide; perf. mid./pass. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’hidden’
glossary.κεραϊζέμεν: κεραΐζω — ravage, sack, plunder; pres. inf., epic -έμεν (= Attic κεραΐζειν)
glossary.κερδαλέοισιν: κερδαλέος — cunning, crafty (lit. gainful); neut. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις)
glossary.κεχαρισμένα: χαρίζομαι — oblige, gratify; perf. part. pass. neut. acc. pl., used as an adj.: ’agreeable, kindly’
glossary.κεῦθε: κεύθω — hide, conceal; pres. imper. 2 sg.: ’hide!’
glossary.κλαίεις: κλαίω — weep, lament; pres. 2 sg.: ’you weep’
glossary.κλαίῃσι: κλαίω — weep; pres. subj. 3 sg., epic -σι (= Attic κλαίῃ), in a simile
glossary.κλισίῃσι: κλισίη — hut, tent, shelter; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι (= Attic κλισίαις)
glossary.κυβερνητῆρες: κυβερνητήρ — steersman, helmsman; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.κόπτοντες: κόπτω — strike, beat; pres. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’striking’
glossary.λίγα: λιγύς — clear, shrill; neut. acc. pl. used adverbially: ’shrilly’
glossary.μετάβηθι: μεταβαίνω — pass over, move on (to another matter); aor. imper. 2 sg.
glossary.μετάφρενον: μετάφρενον — the back (between the shoulders); neut. acc. sg.
glossary.ναιετοώσας: ναιετάω — dwell, be inhabited; pres. part. fem. acc. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ναιετώσας): ’inhabited’
glossary.ναυσιθόου: Ναυσίθοος — Nausithous, father of Alcinous; masc. gen. sg., epic -οου (= Attic -οῦ)
glossary.νεφέλῃ: νεφέλη — cloud; fem. dat. sg., of means: ’in cloud’
glossary.νηλεὲς: νηλεής — pitiless, ruthless; neut. acc. sg., uncontracted (= Attic νηλές); cf. dat. νηλέι
glossary.νικῆσαι: νικάω — conquer, prevail; aor. inf.: ’to win, to conquer’
glossary.νοήμασι: νόημα — thought, design; neut. dat. pl., of means: ’with thoughts’
glossary.ξεινοδόκοι: ξεινοδόκος — host, one who receives guests; masc. nom. pl., epic ξειν- (= Attic ξενοδόκοι)
glossary.ξεῖνός: ξεῖνος — stranger, guest-friend (epic = Attic ξένος); masc. nom. sg., accented before an enclitic
glossary.πέμπωσι: πέμπω — send, escort; pres. subj. 3 pl., in a purpose clause after ὄφρα
glossary.πέσῃσιν: πίπτω — fall, be slain; aor. subj. 3 sg., epic -σιν, in a general relative clause
glossary.παρεὼν: πάρειμι — be present, be at hand; pres. part. masc. nom. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic παρών)
glossary.παύσατ: παύω — stop, cause to cease; aor. mid. 3 sg., elided (παύσατ’ = παύσατο), intrans. ’ceased’ (+ gen.)
glossary.πηδάλι: πηδάλιον — steering-oar, rudder; neut. nom. pl., elided (πηδάλι’ = πηδάλια)
glossary.πημανθῆναι: πημαίνω — bring harm to, harm; aor. pass. inf.: ’to be harmed’
glossary.πηὸς: πηός — kinsman by marriage, relative; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.πομποὶ: πομπός — escort, conveyor; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.πομπὴ: πομπή — sending, escort, conveyance home; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ποτὲ: ποτέ — once, at some time, some day; adv.
glossary.πόλιάς: πόλις — city; fem. acc. pl., epic πόλιας (= Attic πόλεις), accented before an enclitic
glossary.πόλιας: πόλις — city; fem. acc. pl., epic πόλιας (= Attic πόλεις)
glossary.σχεθέτω: ἔχω (aor. ἔσχεθον) — hold, check, hold back; aor. imper. 3 sg., epic σχεθ- (= Attic σχέτω): ’let him hold back, stop’
glossary.τάχισθ: ταχύς — swift; superl. τάχιστα, neut. pl. used adverbially, elided and aspirated (τάχισθ’ before a rough breathing): ’most swiftly’
glossary.τέκωσι: τίκτω — bear, beget; aor. subj. 3 pl., in a temporal clause with κε
glossary.τήκετο: τήκω — melt, waste away; mid./pass. impf. 3 sg.: ’melted, dissolved (in tears)’
glossary.τίθενται: τίθημι — put, place; mid. ’lay upon, give (a name)’; pres. 3 pl., ἐπί … τίθενται in tmesis · also mid. with a noun of action, ’make, hold’: δαῖτα τίθενται ’hold a feast’
glossary.τεκέεσσιν: τέκος — child; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσιν (= Attic τέκνοις)
glossary.τελευτήσεσθαι: τελευτάω — accomplish, bring to an end; fut. mid. inf. with passive sense: ’to be fulfilled, to come to pass’
glossary.τεὴν: τεός — your, thy (epic = Attic σός); fem. acc. sg.
glossary.τεῦξαν: τεύχω — make, fashion; aor. 3 pl., epic (= Attic ἔτευξαν), unaugmented
glossary.τιτυσκόμεναι: τιτύσκομαι — aim at, make for, direct; pres. part. mid. fem. nom. pl.
glossary.τολμήσαντα: τολμάω — dare, endure; aor. part. masc. acc. sg.: ’having dared’
glossary.τρίχα: τρίχα — in three ways, threefold; adv.
glossary.φάσθαι: φημί — say, speak; pres. inf. mid., epic φάσθαι (= Attic φάναι)
glossary.φαῖνε: φαίνω — show, reveal, bring to light; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔφαινε)
glossary.φθινύθουσι: φθινύθω — waste away, wither; pres. 3 pl.
glossary.φιλέοντες: φιλέω — love, treat kindly; pres. part. masc. nom. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic φιλοῦντες)
glossary.χαλεποί: χαλεπός — harsh, hard to deal with; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.χαριζόμενος: χαρίζομαι — gratify, please (+ dat.); pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’pleasing, indulging’
glossary.χυμένη: χέω — pour; aor. mid. part. fem. nom. sg., epic syncopated χυμένη (= χεαμένη): ’poured out, flung down’
glossary.χώρας: χώρη — land, place, region; fem. acc. pl. (the lemma is Ionic χώρη, Attic χώρα)
glossary.ἀγάσασθαι: ἀγάομαι — be resentful of (+ dat.); aor. inf. mid. (also written ἀγάσσασθαι)
glossary.ἀγόρευ: ἀγορεύω — speak, say; impf. 3 sg., elided (ἀγόρευ’ = ἀγόρευε), unaugmented
glossary.ἀείδει: ἀείδω — sing; pres. 3 sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic ᾄδει)
glossary.ἀείδεις: ἀείδω — sing; pres. 2 sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic ᾄδεις)
glossary.ἀκρόπολιν: ἀκρόπολις — citadel, high city; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀμφιβέβηκεν: ἀμφιβαίνω — go about, encompass, envelop; perf. 3 sg. with present force (+ acc.): ’has enveloped’
glossary.ἀμφικαλύψειν: ἀμφικαλύπτω — enfold, cover all round; fut. inf.: ’to enfold’
glossary.ἀμφικαλύψῃ: ἀμφικαλύπτω — enfold, cover all round; aor. subj. 3 sg., in a temporal clause with ἐπήν · also aor. subj. 3 sg., after μηδ’, continuing a condition or wish: ’and may he not cover’
glossary.ἀμφιπεσοῦσα: ἀμφιπίπτω — fall around, throw oneself upon; aor. part. fem. nom. sg.: ’having flung herself upon’
glossary.ἀμύνων: ἀμύνω — ward off, defend; pres. part. masc. nom. sg., ’keeping off (a harm) from (dat.)’
glossary.ἀνθρώποις: ἄνθρωπος — human being; masc. dat. pl.
glossary.ἀνιοῦσαν: ἄνειμι — go up, come back; pres. part. fem. acc. sg. (from εἶμι): ’returning’
glossary.ἀντὶ: ἀντί — instead of, in place of; prep. + gen.
glossary.ἀνώνυμός: ἀνώνυμος — nameless; masc./fem. nom. sg., accented before an enclitic
glossary.ἀπέπλειον: ἀποπλέω — sail away; impf. 3 pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἀπέπλεον)
glossary.ἀπέφθιτο: ἀποφθίνω — perish, die; aor. 3 sg. mid.: ’had perished’
glossary.ἀπήμονές: ἀπήμων — unharmed, harmless, safe; masc. nom. pl., accented before an enclitic
glossary.ἀπεπλάγχθης: ἀποπλάζω — drive off course; aor. pass. 2 sg.: ’you were driven astray’
glossary.ἀσπαίροντα: ἀσπαίρω — gasp, quiver, struggle; pres. part. masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀτέλεστ: ἀτέλεστος — unfulfilled, unaccomplished; neut. nom. pl., elided (ἀτέλεστ’ = ἀτέλεστα)
glossary.ἄεισον: ἀείδω — sing; aor. imper. 2 sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic ᾆσον)
glossary.ἄκριτα: ἄκριτος — endless, undistinguished, confused; neut. acc. pl. used as a cognate object or adverbially
glossary.ἄστεϊ: ἄστυ — town, city; neut. dat. sg., epic ἄστεϊ (= Attic ἄστει)
glossary.ἄχεϊ: ἄχος — grief, distress; neut. dat. sg., epic ἄχεϊ (= Attic ἄχει)
glossary.ἅς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., fem. acc. pl., with τινας ’whichever’; not the possessive
glossary.ἐάαν: ἐάω — allow, let be; pres. inf., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἐᾶν)
glossary.ἐκπρολιπόντες: ἐκπρολείπω — leave, quit; aor. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’having left’
glossary.ἐκχύμενοι: ἐκχέω — pour out; aor. mid. part. masc. nom. pl., syncopated: ’pouring out’
glossary.ἐλεεινοτάτῳ: ἐλεεινός — pitiable, wretched; superl. ἐλεεινότατος, neut. dat. sg.: ’most pitiable’
glossary.ἐλεεινὸν: ἐλεεινός — pitiable, wretched; neut. acc. sg.
glossary.ἐμπλήσας: ἐμπίμπλημι — fill (+ gen. of what fills); aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having filled’
glossary.ἐμόγησαν: μογέω — toil, suffer hardship; aor. 3 pl.
glossary.ἐξαλάπαξαν: ἐξαλαπάζω — sack, utterly destroy; aor. 3 pl.
glossary.ἐπειὸς: Ἐπειός — Epeius, builder of the wooden horse; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἐπιψαύῃ: ἐπιψαύω — touch, lay hold of (+ gen.; here with the instrumental dative πραπίδεσσι ’with his wits’); pres. subj. 3 sg., in a general relative clause
glossary.ἐποίησεν: ποιέω — make, build; aor. 3 sg., augmented
glossary.ἐρύσαντας: ἐρύω — draw, drag; aor. part. masc. acc. pl.: ’having dragged’
glossary.ἐσσομένοισιν: εἰμί — be; fut. part. mid. ἐσσόμενος, masc./neut. dat. pl., epic -οισιν: ’those yet to be’
glossary.ἐστ: εἰμί — be; pres. 3 sg., elided (ἐστ’ = ἐστί)
glossary.ἐυεργέα: ἐϋεργής — well-made, well-wrought; fem. acc. sg., uncontracted (= ἐϋεργῆ)
glossary.ἐυσσέλμων: ἐΰσσελμος — well-benched, with good rowing-benches; fem. gen. pl.
glossary.ἑστήκει: ἵστημι — set, stand; plpf. 3 sg. (perf. ἕστηκα): ’had stood, was standing’
glossary.ἑῆς: ἑός, ἑή, ἑόν — his own, her own (possessive, = ὅς); fem. gen. sg.; not the relative
glossary.ἔξοχα: ἔξοχος — outstanding, preeminent; neut. pl. used as adv.: ’above all, outstandingly’
glossary.ἔπαθόν: πάσχω — suffer, undergo; aor. 3 pl., accented before an enclitic (ἔπαθον)
glossary.ἔρξαν: ῥέζω — do, perform; aor. 3 pl., epic ἔρξαν (= Attic ἔδρασαν) · also εἴργω (ἔργω) — shut in, pen; aor. 3 pl., epic (= Attic εἷρξαν): ’they penned’
glossary.ἠέρι: ἀήρ — mist, haze; masc. dat. sg., epic ἠέρι, of means: ’in mist’
glossary.ἤειδεν: ἀείδω — sing; impf. 3 sg., epic uncontracted, augmented (= Attic ᾖδεν)
glossary.ἧμιν: ἐγώ — I, we; dat. pl., epic ἧμιν (= Attic ἡμῖν): ’to us’
glossary.ἰλίου: Ἴλιος — Ilios, Troy; fem. gen. sg.
glossary.ἰλιόθι: Ἴλιος — Ilios, Troy; ἰλιόθι, locative adv. with suffix -θι: ’at Ilios’
glossary.ἱππόθεν: ἵππος — horse; ἱππόθεν, adv. with suffix -θεν: ’from the horse’
glossary.ἵκεο: ἱκνέομαι — come, reach; aor. 2 sg. mid., epic ἵκεο (= Attic ἵκου), unaugmented
glossary.ὀδύρεαι: ὀδύρομαι — lament, bewail; pres. 2 sg. mid., epic uncontracted (= Attic ὀδύρῃ)
glossary.ὀιζυροῖο: ὀιζυρός — miserable, woeful; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -οῦ)
glossary.ὀιζύν: ὀιζύς — misery, woe, hardship; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ὁρμηθεὶς: ὁρμάω — set in motion, urge on; aor. pass. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’set in motion, impelled’
glossary.ὄπισθε: ὄπισθε(ν) — behind, from behind; adv. · also ’hereafter, afterwards’ (of time)
glossary.ὤπασε: ὀπάζω — give, bestow (+ dat.); aor. 3 sg., augmented
glossary.ὤρορε: ὄρνυμι — rouse, stir up; aor. 2 3 sg., reduplicated, used without an object; the exact sense is uncertain
glossary.ᾖσι: εἰμί — be; pres. subj. 3 sg., epic ᾖσι (= Attic ᾖ), in a purpose clause after ἵνα
glossary.ῥαισέμεναι: ῥαίω — shatter, smash; fut. inf., epic -έμεναι (= Attic ῥαίσειν)
glossary.αἰαίη: Αἰαίη — Aeaean, of Aeaea (Circe’s island); fem. nom. sg. adj., epithet of Circe
glossary.αἰνομόροισιν: αἰνόμορος — dread-fated, of grim lot (αἰνός ’dread’ + μόρος ’lot’); masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις)
glossary.αὐτόθ: αὐτόθι — right there, on the spot; adv., elided (αὐτόθ’ = αὐτόθι)
glossary.αὐτὰς: αὐτός — self; intensive pron., fem. acc. pl.: ’the (ships) themselves’ · also plain anaphoric pronoun after a preposition, fem. acc. pl.: ’them’ (προτὶ δ’ αὐτὰς, of the rocks)
glossary.βουλυτόνδε: βουλυτός — time of unyoking the oxen, evening; with directional -δε: ’towards evening’
glossary.γεγώνευν: γεγωνέω — shout, call out to; impf. 3 pl., epic uncontracted, unaugmented (= Attic ἐγεγώνουν) · also impf. 1 sg. (same form): ’I cried out’
glossary.γλαφυρῇσιν: γλαφυρός — hollow; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσιν (= Attic -αις)
glossary.γλυκερώτερον: γλυκερός — sweet; comparative γλυκερώτερος, neut. acc. sg.: ’sweeter’
glossary.γλύκιον: γλυκύς — sweet; epic comparative γλύκιον, neut. nom. sg. (= Attic γλυκύτερον): ’sweeter’
glossary.δαμάσαντες: δαμάζω — subdue, overpower; aor. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’having overpowered’
glossary.δασσάμεθ: δατέομαι — divide, share out; aor. mid. 1 pl., epic -σσ-, unaugmented, elided (δασσάμεθ’ = δασσάμεθα): ’we shared out’
glossary.δείσαντες: δείδω — fear, dread; aor. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’having feared’
glossary.διέσχισεν: διασχίζω — split apart, cleave through; aor. 3 sg.: ’split’
glossary.διερῷ: διερός — sense uncertain: perhaps ’living, lively’ (so ’nimble’), or ’wet’; masc. dat. sg., agreeing with ποδί
glossary.δουλίχιόν: Δουλίχιον — Dulichium, an island near Ithaca; neut. nom. sg.
glossary.δόλοισιν: δόλος — trick, wile, cunning; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις), dat. of means: ’by tricks’
glossary.δῃωθέντες: δηϊόω — cut down, slay; aor. pass. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’cut down’
glossary.δῆσα: δέω — bind, tie; aor. 1 sg., unaugmented (= ἔδησα): ’I bound’
glossary.εἰνοσίφυλλον: εἰνοσίφυλλος — leaf-shaking, with quivering foliage; neut. nom. sg., agreeing with ὄρος · also neut. acc. sg., agreeing with Πήλιον
glossary.εἴδετ: οἶδα — know; perf. subj. 2 pl., epic short-vowel (= Attic εἰδῆτε), elided: ’that you may know’
glossary.εἴδεται: εἴδομαι — seem, appear (with inf.); pres. mid. 3 sg.: ’seems’
glossary.εἴμ: εἰμί — be; pres. 1 sg., elided (εἴμ’ = εἰμί): ’I am’
glossary.εἴρεσθ: εἴρομαι — ask; pres. inf., elided (εἴρεσθ’ = εἴρεσθαι): ’to ask’
glossary.εἴσβαινον: εἰσβαίνω — go aboard, embark; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented (= εἰσέβαινον)
glossary.εἶδαρ: εἶδαρ — food, fare; neut. acc. sg., object of ἔδουσιν
glossary.εἶεν: εἰμί — be; pres. opt. 3 pl., in an indirect question: ’(who) they might be’ · also with κε, potential: ’would be’ (κ’ … εἶεν) · also in a concessive condition after εἰ: ’were’ (οὐδ’ εἴ οἱ χεῖρες … εἶεν ’not even if he had hands’) · also in a wish with a dat. of the person: ’may (they) be’ (ἔνδον ἑταῖροι εἶεν ’may my companions be inside’) · also in a plain condition after εἰ: ’there were’ (εἰ … βόες εἶεν ’if there were oxen’)
glossary.ζάκυνθος: Ζάκυνθος — Zacynthus, an island near Ithaca; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ζυγὰ: ζυγόν — yoke; a ship’s cross-bench; neut. acc. pl., after ὑπό: ’under the benches’
glossary.θάνατόν: θάνατος — death; masc. acc. sg., enclitic accent before τε: ’death’ · also accented before the enclitic γε: θάνατόν γε ’death at least’
glossary.θάνον: θνῄσκω — die; aor. 3 pl., unaugmented (= ἔθανον): ’they died’
glossary.θοῇς: θοός — swift; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῇς (= Attic -αῖς)
glossary.κάθεμεν: καθίημι — let down, lower; aor. 1 pl., epic, unaugmented (= καθεῖμεν; Attic also καθήκαμεν): ’we let down’
glossary.κήρυχ: κῆρυξ — herald; masc. acc. sg., elided (κήρυχ’ = κήρυκα)
glossary.κίκονες: Κίκονες — the Cicones, a Thracian people; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.κίοι: κίω — go, move; pres. opt. 3 sg., in a negative purpose clause after ὡς: ’should go’
glossary.κατερήτυεν: κατερητύω — hold back, detain; impf. 3 sg., epic (= Attic κατηρήτυε)
glossary.κείμεθ: κεῖμαι — lie; impf. 1 pl., unaugmented, elided (κείμεθ’ = κείμεθα): ’we lay’
glossary.κελόμην: κέλομαι — urge, bid, command; impf. 1 sg., unaugmented (= ἐκελόμην): ’I urged’
glossary.κικόνεσσι: Κίκονες — the Cicones, a Thracian people; masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic -οσι): ’to the Cicones’
glossary.κικόνων: Κίκονες — the Cicones, a Thracian people; masc. gen. pl.: ’of the Cicones’
glossary.κλαίοντας: κλαίω — weep, wail; pres. part. masc. acc. pl.: ’weeping’
glossary.κλῖναν: κλίνω — bend, turn; aor. 3 pl., unaugmented (= ἔκλιναν): ’they turned to flight, routed’
glossary.κουροτρόφος: κουροτρόφος — nurse of young men; fem. nom. sg. (adj. of two endings): ’good at rearing youths’
glossary.κρητῆρος: κρατήρ — mixing bowl; masc. gen. sg., epic κρητήρ (= Attic κρατήρ)
glossary.κυβερνῆταί: κυβερνήτης — helmsman, steersman; masc. nom. pl., enclitic accent before τ’
glossary.κυθήρων: Κύθηρα — Cythera, an island off Laconia; neut. pl., gen. of separation with παραπλάζω: ’away from Cythera’
glossary.λάθηται: λανθάνω (mid. λήθομαι) — forget (+ gen.); aor. subj. mid. 3 sg.: ’should forget’
glossary.λαίλαπι: λαῖλαψ — squall, whirlwind; fem. dat. sg.
glossary.λαβόντες: λαμβάνω — take, seize; aor. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’having taken’
glossary.λαερτιάδης: Λαερτιάδης — son of Laertes (patronymic of Odysseus); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.λαθέσθαι: λανθάνω (mid. λήθομαι) — forget (+ gen.); aor. mid. inf.: ’to forget’
glossary.λωτοφάγοι: Λωτοφάγοι — the Lotus-eaters (λωτός + φαγεῖν); masc. nom. pl.
glossary.λωτοφάγοισι: Λωτοφάγοι — the Lotus-eaters; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
glossary.λωτοφάγοισιν: Λωτοφάγοι — the Lotus-eaters; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις)
glossary.λωτοφάγων: Λωτοφάγοι — the Lotus-eaters; masc. gen. pl.: ’of the Lotus-eaters’
glossary.λωτοῖο: λωτός — lotus, the lotus plant and its fruit; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -οῦ), partitive with φάγοι, πάσασθαι
glossary.λωτὸν: λωτός — lotus, the lotus plant and its fruit; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.μάλειαν: Μαλέα — Malea, the southern cape of Laconia; fem. acc. sg., Ionic Μάλεια
glossary.μάρνασθαι: μάρναμαι — fight, battle; pres. inf.: ’to fight’
glossary.μάχην: μάχη — battle, fight; fem. acc. sg., cognate acc. with ἐμάχοντο: ’fought a fight’
glossary.μέλω: μέλω — be a care to, be of concern to (+ dat.); pres. 1 sg.: ’I am a care’
glossary.μήδονθ: μήδομαι — plan, devise; impf. mid. 3 pl., elided and aspirated (μήδονθ’ = μήδοντο)
glossary.μίγεν: μείγνυμι — mix; aor. pass. 3 pl., unaugmented (= ἐμίγησαν), + dat.: ’they mingled with’
glossary.μενέμεν: μένω — stay, remain; pres. inf., epic -έμεν (= Attic μένειν)
glossary.μετενίσσετο: μετανίσσομαι — go across, move on; impf. 3 sg.: ’was moving on (towards)’
glossary.νήριτον: Νήριτον — Neriton, a mountain on Ithaca; neut. nom. sg., in apposition to ὄρος
glossary.ναίοντες: ναίω — dwell, inhabit; pres. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’dwelling’
glossary.ναιετάουσι: ναιετάω — dwell, inhabit; pres. 3 pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ναιετῶσι); of a place, ’are inhabited’
glossary.ναιετάω: ναιετάω — dwell in, inhabit; pres. 1 sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic ναιετῶ), + acc.
glossary.οἰνοχόος: οἰνοχόος — wine-pourer, cupbearer; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.οἰχόμενοι: οἴχομαι — go, be gone, go off; pres. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’going off’
glossary.πάθοιμεν: πάσχω — suffer, experience; aor. opt. 1 pl., in a purpose clause after ἵνα: ’that we might suffer’
glossary.πάσασθαι: πατέομαι — taste, eat (+ gen.); aor. mid. inf.: ’to eat of’
glossary.πέλασσεν: πελάζω — bring near; aor. 3 sg., epic -σσ-, unaugmented (= ἐπέλασεν), + dat.: ’brought (me) to’
glossary.πίνετο: πίνω — drink; impf. pass. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐπίνετο): ’was drunk’
glossary.πανυπερτάτη: πανύπερτατος — uppermost; sense uncertain: ’highest’ or ’farthest out’; fem. nom. sg. superlative
glossary.παρέπλαγξεν: παραπλάζω — drive astray, carry past; aor. 3 sg.: ’drove astray’
glossary.περιγνάμπτοντα: περιγνάμπτω — bend around, round (a cape); pres. part. masc. acc. sg.: ’as I was rounding’
glossary.πεύθεσθαι: πυνθάνομαι — learn, inquire; pres. inf., epic πεύθομαι (= Attic πυνθάνεσθαι): ’to find out’
glossary.πλέονάς: πολύς — much, many; comparative πλέων, masc. acc. pl. πλέονας: ’more numerous’, accented before enclitic περ
glossary.πλήθωσι: πλήθω — be full, fill; pres. subj. 3 pl., + gen.: ’may be full of’
glossary.ποδὶ: πούς — foot; masc. dat. sg., dat. of manner (διερῷ ποδί ’on a nimble foot’)
glossary.πολυκηδέ: πολυκηδής — full of woe, much-troubled; masc. acc. sg., uncontracted and elided (πολυκηδέ’ = πολυκηδέα; Attic πολυκηδῆ)
glossary.προΐειν: προΐημι — send forth; impf. 1 sg., epic (= Attic προΐην): ’I sent forward’
glossary.προερέσσαμεν: προερέσσω — row forward; aor. 1 pl., epic -σσ-, unaugmented: ’we rowed on’
glossary.πρῶτόν: πρῶτος — first; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’first’, accented before enclitic τοι
glossary.σάμη: Σάμη — Same, an island (later Cephallenia); fem. nom. sg.
glossary.σίτοιό: σῖτος — bread, grain, food; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου), partitive with ἐπασσάμεθ’; accented before enclitic τ’
glossary.σπερχομένους: σπέρχομαι — hasten, be in a hurry; pres. part. masc. acc. pl.: ’hastening’
glossary.στησάμενοι: ἵστημι — set up, place; aor. mid. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’having set up’ (also ’having taken a stand’, drawn up in line)
glossary.στονόεντα: στονόεις — full of groaning, grievous; neut. acc. pl., epic -όεντα
glossary.συνεχὲς: συνεχής — continuous, unbroken; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’without a break’
glossary.τετραχθὰ: τετραχθά — in four pieces; adv. (correlative with τριχθά)
glossary.τρίτατον: τρίτατος — third; epic superlative-form of τρίτος, masc. acc. sg.: ’as a third’
glossary.τρηχεῖ: τρηχύς — rough, rugged; fem. nom. sg., elided (τρηχεῖ’ = τρηχεῖα; Attic τραχεῖα)
glossary.φάγοι: ἐσθίω — eat; aor. (ἔφαγον) opt. 3 sg., in an indefinite relative clause: ’whoever should eat’
glossary.φαγὼν: ἐσθίω — eat; aor. (ἔφαγον) part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having eaten’
glossary.φευγέμεν: φεύγω — flee; pres. inf., epic -έμεν (= Attic φεύγειν)
glossary.φορέῃσι: φορέω — carry about, bear; pres. subj. 3 sg., epic -ῃσι (= Attic φορῇ)
glossary.φυγὼν: φεύγω — flee, escape; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having escaped’
glossary.φύγομεν: φεύγω — flee, escape; aor. 1 pl., unaugmented (= ἐφύγομεν): ’we escaped’
glossary.χαλκήρεσιν: χαλκήρης — fitted with bronze; fem. dat. pl., epic -εσιν (= Attic -εσι)
glossary.χαριέστερον: χαρίεις — graceful, pleasing; comparative χαριέστερος, neut. acc. sg.: ’more pleasing’
glossary.χθαμαλὴ: χθαμαλός — low-lying, low; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀέξετο: ἀέξω — make grow, increase; impf. pass. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἠέξετο): ’was growing’
glossary.ἀκαχήμενοι: ἀχέω (also ἀκαχίζω) — grieve, distress; perf. mid. part. masc. nom. pl., epic reduplicated: ’grieved’
glossary.ἀκουάζωνται: ἀκουάζομαι — listen to (+ gen.); pres. subj. mid. 3 pl.: ’may listen’
glossary.ἀλεξόμενοι: ἀλέξω — ward off, defend; pres. mid. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’defending ourselves’
glossary.ἀλλοδαπῇ: ἀλλοδαπός — of another land, foreign; fem. dat. sg.
glossary.ἀλόχους: ἄλοχος — wife, bedfellow; fem. acc. pl.
glossary.ἀνέμοισιν: ἄνεμος — wind; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις)
glossary.ἀπέωσε: ἀπωθέω — push away, drive off; aor. 3 sg. (aorist stem ἐωσ-): ’thrust away’
glossary.ἀπαγγεῖλαι: ἀπαγγέλλω — bring word back, report; aor. inf.
glossary.ἀτεμβόμενος: ἀτέμβω — cheat, deprive; pass. part. masc. nom. sg., + gen.: ’cheated (of)’
glossary.ἀφ: ἀπό — from, away from; prep. + gen., elided and aspirated before a rough breathing (ἀφ’ = ἀπό)
glossary.ἀφυσσάμεθ: ἀφύσσω — draw (liquid); aor. mid. 1 pl., epic -σσ-, unaugmented, elided (ἀφυσσάμεθ’ = ἀφυσσάμεθα): ’we drew’
glossary.ἀφύσσων: ἀφύσσω — draw (liquid), ladle out; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’drawing’
glossary.ἀῦσαι: ἀΰω — shout, call aloud; aor. inf.: ’to call out’
glossary.ἄνθεα: ἄνθος — flower, blossom; neut. nom. pl., uncontracted (= Attic ἄνθη)
glossary.ἄνθινον: ἄνθινος — flowery, made of flowers; neut. acc. sg.
glossary.ἄσμενοι: ἄσμενος — glad, well pleased; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἐγχείῃ: ἐγχέω — pour in; pres. subj. 3 sg., epic lengthened (= ἐγχέῃ): ’may pour’
glossary.ἐγχείῃσιν: ἐγχείη — spear; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσιν (= Attic -αις), instrumental
glossary.ἐνίσπω: ἐνέπω — tell, relate; aor. subj. 1 sg. (ἐνίσπον), hortatory after εἰ δ’ ἄγε: ’let me tell’
glossary.ἐπέβημεν: ἐπιβαίνω — step on, set foot on (+ gen.); aor. 1 pl.: ’we set foot on’
glossary.ἐπασσάμεθ: πατέομαι — taste, eat (+ gen.); aor. mid. 1 pl., epic -σσ-, elided (ἐπασσάμεθ’ = ἐπασσάμεθα): ’we tasted’
glossary.ἐπετράπετο: ἐπιτρέπω — turn over; mid. turn to, be moved to (+ inf.); aor. mid. 3 sg.: ’was inclined’
glossary.ἐπικάρσιαι: ἐπικάρσιος — sense uncertain: ’slantwise, aslant’ or ’head first’ (from κάρ-, ’head’); fem. nom. pl., agreeing with αἱ, the ships
glossary.ἐπιστάμενοι: ἐπίσταμαι — know how to (+ inf.); pres. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’skilled in’
glossary.ἐρίηρας: ἐρίηρος — traditionally ’trusty’, exact sense uncertain (of companions); masc. acc. pl.
glossary.ἐρεπτόμενοι: ἐρέπτομαι — feed on, munch; pres. part. mid. masc. nom. pl., + acc.
glossary.ἐρύσαντες: ἐρύω — draw, haul; aor. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’having hauled up’
glossary.ἐρύσσας: ἐρύω — draw, drag; aor. part. masc. nom. sg., epic -σσ-: ’having dragged’
glossary.ἐσσυμένως: ἐσσυμένως — hastily, eagerly; adv. from the participle of σεύομαι ’rush’
glossary.ἐυφροσύνη: εὐφροσύνη — cheer, merriment; fem. nom. sg., epic ἐυ- (= Attic εὐ-)
glossary.ἐφέηκεν: ἐφίημι — send upon, impose on; aor. 3 sg., epic (= Attic ἐφῆκεν): ’laid upon’
glossary.ἐφέροντ: φέρω — carry, bear; impf. pass. 3 pl., elided (ἐφέροντ’ = ἐφέροντο): ’were borne along’
glossary.ἑκάστης: ἕκαστος — each; fem. gen. sg., agreeing with νηός
glossary.ἔπειθον: πείθω — persuade; impf. 3 pl. (the ending also serves 1 sg.): ’they tried to persuade’
glossary.ἔπραθον: πέρθω — sack, destroy; aor. 1 sg. (ἔπραθον, the aor. 2 stem πραθ-): ’I sacked’
glossary.ἔσφαζον: σφάζω — slaughter; impf. 3 pl.: ’they were slaughtering’
glossary.ἔω: εἰμί — be; pres. subj. 1 sg., epic (= Attic ὦ), with ἄν: ’I may be’
glossary.ἠέλιόν: ἥλιος (epic ἠέλιος) — sun; masc. acc. sg., accented before enclitic τε
glossary.ἠέριοι: ἠέριος — sense uncertain: ’early’ (from ἠώς or ἦρι) or ’misty’ (from ἠήρ); masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἠνώγεα: ἄνωγα — command, bid; plupf. 1 sg. of a perfect with present sense, used as impf.: ’I urged’
glossary.ἡμετέροις: ἡμέτερος — our, ours; masc. dat. pl.
glossary.ἤπειρον: ἤπειρος — mainland, dry land; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἰλιόθεν: Ἴλιος — Ilium, Troy; adv. with ablatival -θεν: ’from Ilium’
glossary.ἰσμάρῳ: Ἴσμαρος — Ismarus, a city of the Cicones; masc. dat. sg., in apposition to Κικόνεσσι: ’to Ismarus’
glossary.ἰόντας: εἶμι — go; pres. part. masc. acc. pl.: ’going’
glossary.ἴθυνον: ἰθύνω — steer straight, guide; impf. 3 pl.: ’they steered’
glossary.ἴσης: ἴσος — equal, fair; fem. gen. sg. (μοίρης understood): ’(an) equal (share)’, gen. with ἀτεμβόμενος
glossary.ὀλέσαντες: ὄλλυμι — destroy, lose; aor. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’having lost’
glossary.ὀλοοῖς: ὀλοός — destructive, deadly; masc. dat. pl.
glossary.ὀπάσσας: ὀπάζω — send along as attendant, add; aor. part. masc. nom. sg., epic -σσ-: ’having added’
glossary.ὑλήεσσα: ὑλήεις — wooded; fem. nom. sg., epic -ήεσσα
glossary.ὑστάτιον: ὕστατος — last; epic by-form ὑστάτιος, neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’last’
glossary.ὠκειάων: ὠκύς — swift; fem. gen. pl., epic -άων (= Attic -ῶν), agreeing with νηῶν
glossary.ὤλεσα: ὄλλυμι — destroy, lose; aor. 1 sg.: ’I destroyed’
glossary.ὤλονθ: ὄλλυμι — destroy; mid. perish; aor. mid. 3 pl., elided and aspirated (ὤλονθ’ = ὤλοντο): ’they perished’
glossary.ῥόος: ῥόος — current, stream; masc. nom. sg., epic (= Attic ῥοῦς)
glossary.αἰγανέας: αἰγανέη — light javelin, hunting spear; fem. acc. pl.
glossary.αἴγειροι: αἴγειρος — black poplar; fem. nom. pl.
glossary.αὐλὴ: αὐλή — yard, court (of a steading); fem. nom. sg.
glossary.βαθεῖ: βαθύς — deep, thick; fem. nom. sg. βαθεῖα, elided (βαθεῖ’ = βαθεῖα): ’thick (mist)’
glossary.βαθὺ: βαθύς — deep, thick, heavy; neut. nom./acc. sg.: ’deep-standing’ (of a crop)
glossary.βουληφόροι: βουληφόρος — counsel-bearing, deliberative (βουλή ’counsel’ + φέρω); adj. of two endings, fem. nom. pl. (of assemblies) · also masc. nom. pl. as a noun: ’counsellors’ (Φαιήκων βουληφόροι ’the Phaeacians’ counsellors’)
glossary.βόσκει: βόσκω — feed, pasture, nourish; pres. 3 sg.
glossary.δάφνῃσι: δάφνη — laurel, bay; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι (= Attic -αις)
glossary.δέκ: δέκα — ten; indeclinable numeral, elided (δέκ’ = δέκα)
glossary.δι: διά — through; prep. + acc., elided (δι’ = διά): ’through (the night)’ · also + gen.: ’through, through the midst of’ (δι’ αὐτῶν ’through the midst of them’) · also + acc., causal: ’through, by reason of’ (δι’ ἀφραδίας ’through folly’)
glossary.δολιχαύλους: δολιχαύλος — long-socketed(?), of javelins (meaning uncertain); adj. of two endings, fem. acc. pl.
glossary.δρυσὶν: δρῦς — oak; fem. dat. pl., epic δρυσίν (= Attic δρυσί)
glossary.δυώδεκα: δώδεκα — twelve; indeclinable numeral, epic δυώδεκα (= Attic δώδεκα)
glossary.εἰσίδομεν: εἰσοράω — look at, behold; aor. 1 pl., unaugmented (= εἰσείδομεν): ’we saw’
glossary.εἰσοιχνεῦσι: εἰσοιχνέω — go into, enter (οἰχνέω ’go’); pres. 3 pl., epic (= Attic εἰσοιχνοῦσι)
glossary.εἱλόμεθ: αἱρέω — take; mid. take for oneself, choose; aor. mid. 1 pl., elided (εἱλόμεθ’ = εἱλόμεθα): ’we took’
glossary.θέμενος: τίθημι — put, place; mid. also ’convene (an assembly)’; aor. mid. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having convened’
glossary.θέμιστες: θέμις — custom, right, law; fem. nom. pl.: ’laws, judgements’
glossary.θήρην: θήρα — hunting, quarry, catch; fem. acc. sg., Ionic (= Attic θήραν)
glossary.θαυμάζοντες: θαυμάζω — wonder at, marvel at; pres. part. masc. nom. pl.
glossary.θαῦμ: θαῦμα — wonder, marvel; neut. nom. sg., elided (θαῦμ’ = θαῦμα)
glossary.θεμιστεύει: θεμιστεύω — lay down the law, give rulings (+ gen.); pres. 3 sg.
glossary.κάμοιεν: κάμνω — toil; aor. also ’make by toil, build’; aor. opt. 3 pl., with κε in a relative clause: ’who would build’
glossary.καθείλομεν: καθαιρέω — take down, lower; aor. 1 pl.: ’we took down (the sails)’
glossary.κακή: κακός — bad, worthless; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.καμπύλα: καμπύλος — curved, bent; neut. acc. pl.
glossary.καταΐσχεται: καταΐσχομαι (κατίσχω) — hold down, occupy (+ dat.); pres. mid./pass. 3 sg.: ’is occupied (by flocks, by ploughing)’
glossary.κατείχετο: κατέχω — hold down, cover, envelop; impf. pass. 3 sg.: ’was covered, was held fast’
glossary.κατεπλέομεν: καταπλέω — sail down, put in to land; impf. 1 pl.: ’we were sailing in’
glossary.κατωρυχέεσσι: κατωρυχής — dug down, sunk in the ground (κατά + ὀρύσσω); adj. of two endings, masc. dat. pl., epic -έεσσι (= Attic -έσι)
glossary.κελσάσῃσι: κέλλω — drive a ship ashore, beach; aor. part. fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι (= Attic -αις): ’having run ashore’
glossary.κορυφὰς: κορυφή — peak, summit; fem. acc. pl.
glossary.κοσμηθέντες: κοσμέω — arrange, marshal, draw up in order; aor. pass. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’having been ordered’
glossary.κριθαὶ: κριθή — barley; fem. nom. pl. (usually plural, ’barley-grains’)
glossary.κυλινδόμενα: κυλίνδω — roll; pres. mid./pass. part. neut. acc. pl.: ’rolling’
glossary.κυνηγέται: κυνηγέτης — hunter (lit. dog-leader); masc. nom. pl.
glossary.λάγχανον: λαγχάνω — obtain by lot, receive as one’s share; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented (= ἐλάγχανον): ’fell to (each ship)’ · also impf. 1 sg. (the same form): ’I received as my share’
glossary.λάχεια: λάχεια — of an island: level, low, or wooded (meaning disputed); fem. nom. sg. adj.
glossary.λήιον: λήιον — standing crop, grain field; neut. nom./acc. sg. (= Attic λήϊον)
glossary.λείη: λεῖος — smooth, level; fem. nom. sg., Ionic η (= Attic λεία)
glossary.λῦσαι: λύω — loose, untie; aor. inf.: ’to loose (the stern-cables)’
glossary.μακρῇσίν: μακρός — long, tall; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῇσιν (= Attic -αῖς)
glossary.μαλακοί: μαλακός — soft, tender; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.μηκάδας: μηκάς — bleating; fem. acc. pl., of goats
glossary.μιλτοπάρῃοι: μιλτοπάρῃος — red-cheeked (μίλτος ’red ochre’ + παρειά ’cheek’), of ships; adj. of two endings, fem. nom. pl.
glossary.ναυτέων: ναύτης — sailor; masc. gen. pl., Ionic -έων (= Attic -ῶν)
glossary.νεφέεσσιν: νέφος — cloud; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσιν (= Attic νέφεσιν)
glossary.πάτος: πάτος — path, trodden way, treading; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.πίτυσσιν: πίτυς — pine; fem. dat. pl., epic πίτυσσιν (= Attic πίτυσι)
glossary.παρὲκ: παρέκ — out along, beyond, outside (+ gen.); prep., epic = παρά + ἐκ
glossary.πείσματός: πεῖσμα — ship’s cable, rope; neut. gen. sg.
glossary.πελώριον: πελώριος — monstrous, huge; neut. nom. sg. · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with a masculine noun: ’huge’ (Ὠρίωνα πελώριον ’huge Orion’; λᾶαν … πελώριον ’a huge stone’)
glossary.πελώριος: πελώριος — monstrous, huge; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ποίμνῃσιν: ποίμνη — flock; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσιν (= Attic -αις)
glossary.ποιμαίνεσκεν: ποιμαίνω — tend (a flock), shepherd; impf. 3 sg., iterative -εσκ-, unaugmented: ’used to tend’
glossary.προυφαίνετ: προφαίνω — show forth; mid./pass. appear; impf. 3 sg., augment fused (προ-ε-), elided (προυφαίνετ’ = προυφαίνετο): ’was to be seen’
glossary.προύφαινε: προφαίνω — show forth, cast light; impf. 3 sg., augment fused (προύφαινε = προέφαινε): ’shone forth’
glossary.πρυμνήσια: πρυμνήσιον — stern-cable (mooring rope); neut. acc. pl.
glossary.πρόπαν: πρόπας — all through, the whole; neut. acc. sg., of time (πρόπαν ἦμαρ ’all day long’)
glossary.πωλεῖτ: πωλέομαι — go about, move to and fro, frequent; impf. mid. 3 sg., elided (πωλεῖτ’ = πωλεῖτο): ’he went about’
glossary.πῖαρ: πῖαρ — fat, richness; used as a neut. adj., ’rich, fat’ (of soil); neut. nom. sg., epic (= Attic πῖον)
glossary.σιτοφάγῳ: σιτοφάγος — grain-eating, bread-eating; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.τέκτονες: τέκτων — builder, carpenter, shipwright; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.τελέοιεν: τελέω — accomplish, complete; pres. opt. 3 pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic τελοῖεν), with κεν: ’would accomplish’
glossary.τετάνυσται: τανύω (τείνω) — stretch out; perf. pass. 3 sg.: ’lies stretched out, extends’
glossary.τόξα: τόξον — bow; neut. nom./acc. pl. (plural for a single bow)
glossary.τῶνδ: ὅδε, ἥδε, τόδε — this, this one; masc. gen. pl., elided (τῶνδ’ = τῶνδε): ’of these’
glossary.φέρουσιν: φέρω — bear, carry; produce (fruit); pres. 3 pl.
glossary.φθογγὴν: φθογγή — voice, sound; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.φυτὸν: φυτόν — plant, growing thing; neut. acc. sg.
glossary.φύονται: φύω — grow; mid. grow up, spring up; pres. mid. 3 pl.: ’they grow’
glossary.χηρεύει: χηρεύω — be bereft, be empty (+ gen.); pres. 3 sg.: ’is empty of’
glossary.χῶρον: χῶρος — place, spot, region; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀέξει: ἀέξω — make grow, increase (Attic αὐξάνω); pres. 3 sg.
glossary.ἀγοραὶ: ἀγορή — assembly, gathering (Attic ἀγορά); fem. nom. pl.
glossary.ἀθεμίστια: ἀθεμίστιος (= ἀθέμιστος) — lawless, without regard for right (ἀ- + θέμις); neut. acc. pl., as noun: ’lawless things’
glossary.ἀθεμίστων: ἀθέμιστος — lawless (ἀ- + θέμις); masc. gen. pl.
glossary.ἀλέγουσιν: ἀλέγω — care for, heed (+ gen.); pres. 3 pl.
glossary.ἀμβαίνειν: ἀναβαίνω — go up, go aboard; pres. inf., epic ἀμβαίνειν (ἀνα- apocopated to ἀμ- before β), as an instruction
glossary.ἀμῷεν: ἀμάω — reap, mow; pres. opt. 3 pl., with κεν, potential: ’would reap’
glossary.ἀνήροτα: ἀνήροτος — unploughed (ἀ- + ἀρόω); neut. nom. pl.
glossary.ἀνήροτος: ἀνήροτος — unploughed (ἀ- + ἀρόω); adj. of two endings, fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀπειρέσιαι: ἀπειρέσιος — boundless, countless; fem. nom. pl., epic (= ἀπερείσιος)
glossary.ἀπερύκει: ἀπερύκω — keep away, ward off; pres. 3 sg.
glossary.ἀποβρίξαντες: ἀποβρίζω — sleep soundly, sleep through; aor. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’having slept’
glossary.ἀποτηλοῦ: ἀποτηλοῦ — far away, far off (τηλοῦ ’far’); adv.
glossary.ἀρότοισιν: ἄροτος — ploughing, tillage; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις)
glossary.ἀρόωσιν: ἀρόω — plough, till; pres. 3 pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἀροῦσι)
glossary.ἀὴρ: ἀήρ — mist, haze (in Homer; later ’air’); nom. sg., feminine in Homer (βαθεῖα ’deep’ agrees with it)
glossary.ἀῆται: ἀήτης — blast, gust of wind; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἄγριαι: ἄγριος — wild, savage; fem. nom. pl.
glossary.ἄροσις: ἄροσις — ploughing; ploughland, tilth; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἄσπαρτα: ἄσπαρτος — unsown (ἀ- + σπείρω); neut. nom. pl.
glossary.ἄσπαρτος: ἄσπαρτος — unsown (ἀ- + σπείρω); adj. of two endings, fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἄστε: ἄστυ — city, town; neut. acc. pl., epic ἄστεα (= Attic ἄστη), elided (ἄστε’ = ἄστεα)
glossary.ἄφθιτοι: ἄφθιτος — imperishable, unfailing (ἀ- + φθίνω); adj. of two endings, fem. nom. pl.
glossary.ἐδινεόμεσθα: δινέω — whirl; mid. wander about, roam; impf. mid. 1 pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἐδινούμεθα): ’we roamed about’
glossary.ἐκάμοντο: κάμνω — toil; mid. make by toil, build; aor. mid. 3 pl., with κε: ’they would have built’
glossary.ἐλεύσσομεν: λεύσσω — look at, see, behold; impf. 1 pl.: ’we saw’
glossary.ἐμείναμεν: μένω — stay, wait, wait for; aor. 1 pl.
glossary.ἐμοῖς: ἐμός — my, mine; masc. dat. pl. · also neut. dat. pl., agreeing with μεγάροισιν: ’my (halls)’
glossary.ἐνέην: ἔνειμι — be in, be therein; impf. 3 sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἐνῆν): ’(wine) was in (them)’
glossary.ἐνίαυε: ἐνιαύω — sleep in, lodge, pass the night (ἰαύω); impf. 3 sg.
glossary.ἐξέφθιτο: ἐκφθίνω — perish, be used up; aor. mid. 3 sg., epic root aorist with pluperfect sense: ’had run out’
glossary.ἐπικέλσαι: ἐπικέλλω — drive a ship ashore, beach; aor. inf.: ’to run (the ships) ashore’
glossary.ἐπικέλσαντας: ἐπικέλλω — drive a ship ashore, beach; aor. part. masc. acc. pl.: ’having run ashore’
glossary.ἐπιπνεύσωσιν: ἐπιπνέω — blow upon, blow (of winds); aor. subj. 3 pl., in an indefinite temporal clause
glossary.ἐποτρύνῃ: ἐποτρύνω — urge on, stir up; pres. subj. 3 sg., in an indefinite temporal clause (εἰς ὅ κε): ’urges on’
glossary.ἐρίηρες: ἐρίηρος — trusty, dear (of companions; exact sense uncertain); masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἐριστάφυλον: ἐριστάφυλος — rich in grapes (ἐρι- intensive + σταφυλή ’grape-cluster’); masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἐρυθρός: ἐρυθρός — red; masc. nom. sg., of wine
glossary.ἐσέδρακεν: εἰσδέρκομαι — look at, behold; aor. 3 sg., epic (= εἰσέδρακεν): ’saw’
glossary.ἐυκτιμένην: ἐύκτιμένος — well-built, well-settled (ἐύ + κτίζω); fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἐυσσέλμους: ἐύσσελμος — well-benched, with good thwarts (ἐύ + σέλμα), of ships; adj. of two endings, fem. acc. pl.
glossary.ἐφέποντες: ἐφέπω — go over, range over, pursue; pres. part. masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἑκάστην: ἕκαστος — each, every; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἑλόντες: αἱρέω — take, capture; aor. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’having taken’
glossary.ἔβην: βαίνω — go, step; aor. 1 sg.: with ἀνά, ’I went up, went on board’
glossary.ἔειπον: εἶπον — say, speak; aor. 1 sg., epic ἔειπον (= Attic εἶπον) · also aor. 3 pl. (same ending): ’they called, said’ (μιν ἐσθλὸν ἔειπον ’call him good’)
glossary.ἕκαστοι: ἕκαστος — each, every; masc. nom. pl.: ’each of us’ · also masc. nom. pl., of a third party: ’each man’ (ἐπὶ κληῗσιν ἕκαστοι ’each man at his bench’)
glossary.ἠφύσαμεν: ἀφύσσω — draw (liquid), ladle; aor. 1 pl.: ’we drew off’
glossary.ἡγεμόνευεν: ἡγεμονεύω — lead the way, guide; impf. 3 sg.
glossary.ἰαύεσκον: ἰαύω — sleep, lie, spend the night; impf. 3 pl., iterative -εσκ-, unaugmented: ’used to lie’
glossary.ἰδὲ: ἰδέ — and; epic conj. (= Attic καί)
glossary.ἱκνεύμεναι: ἱκνέομαι — come, go to; pres. inf., epic -μεναι (= Attic ἱκνεῖσθαι): ’to go (to)’
glossary.ὀίων: ὄϊς — sheep; masc./fem. gen. pl., epic (= Attic οἰῶν)
glossary.ὀρεσκῴους: ὀρεσκῷος — living on the mountains, mountain-bedded (ὄρος + κοίτη); adj. of two endings, fem. acc. pl.
glossary.ὀρφναίην: ὀρφναῖος — dark, murky; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ὄιές: ὄϊς — sheep; masc./fem. nom. pl., epic (= Attic οἶες)
glossary.ὄχθας: ὄχθη — bank, shore; fem. acc. pl.
glossary.ὑδρηλοὶ: ὑδρηλός — watery, well-watered; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ὑλήεσσ: ὑλήεις — wooded (from ὕλη); fem. nom. sg., elided (ὑλήεσσ’ = ὑλήεσσα)
glossary.ὑπερφιάλων: ὑπερφίαλος — overweening, arrogant, unruly; masc. gen. pl.
glossary.ὑψηλὴ: ὑψηλός — high, lofty; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ὑψηλῶν: ὑψηλός — high, lofty; masc./neut. gen. pl.
glossary.ὑψικόμοισιν: ὑψίκομος — high-crowned, with lofty foliage (ὕψι ’aloft’ + κόμη); fem. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις)
glossary.ὥρας: ὥρα — season, proper time; fem. acc. pl.: ’(for) the seasons’
glossary.ὥρια: ὥριος — seasonal, in season; neut. acc. pl., as noun: ’crops of the season’
glossary.ὦρσαν: ὄρνυμι — rouse, send forth; aor. 3 pl., augmented: ’they roused, sent’
glossary.ῥίῳ: ῥίον — peak, jutting crag; neut. dat. sg.
glossary.αἰγιόχου: αἰγίοχος — aegis-bearing (of Zeus); adj., masc. gen. sg.; meaning disputed: usually ’holding the αἰγίς (goatskin shield)’, other derivations were proposed in antiquity
glossary.αἰδεῖο: αἰδέομαι — respect, stand in awe of, revere; pres. imper. mid. 2 sg., epic, partly contracted (αἰδέεο > αἰδεῖο; Attic αἰδοῦ)
glossary.αἰνυμένους: αἴνυμαι — take, take for oneself; pres. part. mid. masc. acc. pl., epic (Attic λαμβάνω): ’taking’
glossary.αἰνυμένῳ: αἴνυμαι — take, take for oneself; pres. part. mid. masc. dat. sg., epic (Attic λαμβάνω): ’to one taking’
glossary.αἰνύμενοι: αἴνυμαι — take, take for oneself; pres. part. mid. masc. nom. pl., epic (Attic λαμβάνω): ’taking’
glossary.αἴγεον: αἴγειος — of a goat; adj., masc. acc. sg., epic shortened form (αἴγεος = Attic αἴγειος)
glossary.βαθείης: βαθύς — deep; fem. gen. sg., epic -είης (= Attic -είας)
glossary.βαρὺν: βαρύς — heavy, deep-toned; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.βρῖθον: βρίθω — be heavy, be weighed down (+ gen. of what loads); impf. 3 pl., unaugmented (= ἔβριθον)
glossary.βῆν: βαίνω — go, step; aor. 1 sg., unaugmented (= ἔβην)
glossary.γαυλοί: γαυλός — milk-pail, round bucket; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.γυναικὶ: γυνή — woman, wife; fem. dat. sg.
glossary.δαείω: δάω — learn, come to know (aor. ἐδάην); aor. 2 pass. subj. 1 sg., epic lengthened (δαείω = Attic δαῶ, cf. μάθω)
glossary.δειδίμεν: δείδω — fear, dread; perf. inf. with pres. sense, epic (δειδίμεν = Attic δεδιέναι): ’to fear’
glossary.δεισάντων: δείδω — fear, dread; aor. part. act. masc./neut. gen. pl. (same form in Attic): ’of those who feared’
glossary.δενδρήεντι: δενδρήεις — full of trees, wooded; neut. dat. sg., epic (= Attic δενδρώδης)
glossary.διέπερσε: διαπέρθω — sack, destroy utterly; aor. 3 sg. (epic/poetic ἔπερσα, with augment after the preverb; Attic διεπόρθησε)
glossary.διακεκριμέναι: διακρίνω — separate, sort apart; perf. pass. part. fem. nom. pl.: ’sorted apart’
glossary.δυοκαίδεκ: δυοκαίδεκα — twelve; indeclinable numeral, epic, elided (δυοκαίδεκ’ = δυοκαίδεκα; Attic δώδεκα)
glossary.εἰδότα: οἶδα — know, know how to; perf. part. masc. acc. sg. (with εὖ: ’well versed in’), + acc.
glossary.εἴρετο: ἔρομαι (εἴρομαι) — ask, question; aor. 3 sg. mid., epic (= Attic ἤρετο): ’asked’
glossary.εἴσιδεν: εἰσοράω — look at, catch sight of; aor. 3 sg. εἴσιδεν (Attic εἰσεῖδε), with ν-movable: ’looked at, saw’
glossary.εἴφ: εἶπον — say, tell (pres. ἐρῶ, φημί); aor. imper. 2 sg., elided with aspiration before a rough breathing (εἴφ’ = εἰπέ)
glossary.εὕρομεν: εὑρίσκω — find; aor. 2 1 pl. (Attic εὕρομεν, also ηὕρομεν)
glossary.θέμιστας: θέμις — custom, established right, ordinance; fem. acc. pl.: ’ordinances, customary rights’
glossary.θεσπεσίη: θεσπέσιος — divinely wonderful, marvellous; fem. nom. sg., Ionic η (= Attic θεσπεσία)
glossary.θρέψας: τρέφω — nourish, rear; also thicken, curdle (of milk); aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg., θρ- from stem θρεφ-: ’having curdled’
glossary.θυρεὸν: θυρεός — door-stone, large stone set against a doorway; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.θύρηφιν: θύρα — door; with epic suffix -φιν (locatival/ablatival; Attic θύρασι, θύραζε): ’at the door, outside’
glossary.κήαντες: καίω (epic κείω) — burn, kindle; aor. part. act. masc. nom. pl., epic κήα- (Attic καύσαντες): ’having kindled’
glossary.κελεύοι: κελεύω — urge, bid, command; pres. opt. 3 sg., in a conditional clause after εἰ: ’should urge’ · also pres. opt. 3 sg. in an indirect question: ’whether he would bid’
glossary.κιχανόμενοι: κιχάνω (κιχάνομαι) — reach, come upon, find; pres. part. mid. masc. nom. pl., epic (Attic καταλαμβάνω, ἱκνέομαι)
glossary.λίσσοντ: λίσσομαι — beg, entreat; impf. 3 pl. mid., elided (λίσσοντ’ = λίσσοντο), unaugmented (= ἐλίσσοντο)
glossary.λευκοῖο: λευκός — white, bright; neut. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -οῦ)
glossary.λεῖπε: λείπω — leave, leave behind; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔλειπε)
glossary.μάρων: Μάρων — Maron (priest of Apollo at Ismarus, giver of the wine); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.μένειν: μένω — stay, remain, wait; pres. inf. act.
glossary.μένομέν: μένω — stay, wait for (+ acc.); impf. 1 pl., unaugmented (= ἐμένομεν), accented before the enclitic τέ
glossary.μέτασσαι: μέτασσαι — the middle-born young (of lambs and kids, between the earliest and the latest); fem. nom. pl., a rare Homeric noun, sense from the ancient explanation
glossary.μί: εἷς, μία, ἕν — one; fem. nom. sg., elided (μί’ = μία): ’one (only)’
glossary.μεγάλην: μέγας — great, mighty; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.μητίσασθαι: μητίομαι — devise, plan, contrive; aor. inf. mid. (Attic μηχανᾶσθαι)
glossary.νέμων: νέμω — pasture, tend (flocks); pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg., used absolutely: ’shepherding’
glossary.ναῖον: νάω (ναίω) — flow, be awash, swim (a different verb from ναίω ’dwell’; traditional sense, fits the context); impf. 3 pl., unaugmented (= ἔναιον), + dat. of what fills: ’swam with’
glossary.νομὸν: νομός — pasture, grazing ground; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ξείνιος: ξείνιος — of or for guests, protector of guests (epithet of Zeus); masc. nom. sg., epic (= Attic ξένιος)
glossary.οὔδεος: οὖδας — ground, floor; neut. gen. sg. (Attic ἔδαφος)
glossary.πέλωρον: πέλωρος — monstrous, huge (related noun πέλωρ ’monster’); adj., masc. acc. sg.
glossary.πίνοιεν: πίνω — drink; pres. opt. 3 pl., in a past general clause after ὅτε: ’whenever they drank’
glossary.πανάργυρον: πανάργυρος — all of silver; adj. of two endings, masc. acc. sg.
glossary.παντοίοις: παντοῖος — of every kind, of all sorts; masc. dat. pl.
glossary.περισχόμεθ: περιέχω — hold around; mid. περιέχομαι + gen. or acc., shield, protect; aor. 2 1 pl. mid., elided (περισχόμεθ’ = περισχόμεθα), unaugmented (= περιεσχόμεθα)
glossary.πεφιδοίμην: φείδομαι — spare, show mercy to (+ gen.); aor. 2 opt. mid. 1 sg., reduplicated (πεφιδοίμην = Attic φεισαίμην), potential with ἄν: ’I would spare’
glossary.πιθόμην: πείθω — persuade; mid. πείθομαι, obey, heed (+ dat.); aor. 2 mid. 1 sg., unaugmented (= ἐπιθόμην)
glossary.πλεκτοῖς: πλεκτός — plaited, woven; masc. dat. pl.
glossary.πονησάμενος: πονέομαι — labour, toil at; aor. part. mid. masc. nom. sg.: ’having laboured, having got through (his tasks)’
glossary.ποτιδόρπιον: ποτιδόρπιος — for the evening meal; neut. sg., used as a noun, ’supper-fare’; epic ποτι- (= πρός)
glossary.ποτόν: ποτός — drinkable; neut. nom./acc. sg., used as a noun ’drink’, in apposition to a noun ’wine’
glossary.πρόγονοι: πρόγονος — born before, first-born, earliest young (of lambs and kids); adj. of two endings, masc./fem. nom. pl., used as a noun
glossary.πρώτισθ: πρώτιστα — first of all, foremost; adv. (neut. pl. of the superlative πρώτιστος), elided and aspirated before a rough breathing (πρώτισθ’ = πρώτιστα)
glossary.πόροις: πόρω — give, grant (defective; aor. only); aor. 2 opt. 2 sg., in a conditional clause after εἰ: ’you might give’
glossary.σεῦ: σύ — you; gen. sg., epic σεῦ (= Attic σοῦ)
glossary.σηκοὶ: σηκός — pen, fold; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.σηκῶν: σηκός — pen, fold; masc. gen. pl.
glossary.σκαφίδες: σκαφίς — bowl, pail; fem. nom. pl.
glossary.σπεῦσε: σπεύδω — hasten, press on with (a task); aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔσπευσε)
glossary.στείνοντο: στείνομαι — be crowded, be packed tight; impf. 3 pl. mid./pass., unaugmented (= ἐστείνοντο), + gen. of what fills
glossary.ταλάροισιν: τάλαρος — wicker basket; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις)
glossary.ταρσοὶ: ταρσός — wicker frame or rack (for drying cheeses); masc. nom. pl.
glossary.τετράκυκλοι: τετράκυκλος — four-wheeled; adj. of two endings, fem. nom. pl.
glossary.τετυγμένα: τεύχω — make, fashion; perf. pass. part. neut. nom. pl.: ’wrought, well-made’, agreeing with ἄγγεα · also agreeing with δώματα: ’well-wrought’ (τετυγμένα δώματα ’well-wrought halls’) · also neut. acc. pl., agreeing with δῶρα: ’wrought, well-made’ (χρύσεα δῶρα, τετυγμένα ’golden gifts, wrought’)
glossary.τυρῶν: τυρός — cheese; masc. gen. pl. (of what a rack is laden with, or partitive: ’some of the cheeses’)
glossary.τόσσην: τόσσος — so great, so big; fem. acc. sg., epic (Attic τοσοῦτος, τοσαύτη)
glossary.φάγομεν: ἐσθίω — eat (aor. ἔφαγον); aor. 2 1 pl., unaugmented (= ἐφάγομεν)
glossary.φανεὶς: φαίνω — show; pass. φαίνομαι, appear; aor. 2 pass. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having appeared, showing himself’
glossary.φθόγγον: φθόγγος — voice, sound; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.φοίβου: Φοῖβος — Phoebus (’bright’), epithet of Apollo; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.ἀζαλέης: ἀζαλέος — dry, parched; fem. gen. sg., epic -έης (= Attic -έας)
glossary.ἀκηράσιον: ἀκηράσιος — unmixed, pure (of wine); masc. acc. sg.; derivation uncertain, traditional sense followed
glossary.ἀλέασθαι: ἀλέομαι (ἀλεύομαι) — avoid, shun; aor. inf. mid. ἀλέασθαι (Attic φυγεῖν, ἐκκλίνειν)
glossary.ἀλευάμενος: ἀλέομαι (ἀλεύομαι) — avoid, escape; aor. part. mid. masc. nom. sg., epic (Attic φυγών): ’avoiding’
glossary.ἀμησάμενος: ἀμάω — gather, scoop up; aor. part. mid. masc. nom. sg.: ’having gathered up’
glossary.ἀμφιβεβήκει: ἀμφιβαίνω — go about, bestride, guard; plpf. 3 sg. with impf. sense, unaugmented (Attic ἀμφεβεβήκει): ’was watching over’
glossary.ἀμφιπόλων: ἀμφίπολος — handmaid, attendant; fem. gen. pl.
glossary.ἀπεσσύμεθ: ἀποσεύομαι — rush away, dart off; aor. mid. 1 pl., augmented, elided (ἀπεσσύμεθ’ = ἀπεσσύμεθα), doubled σσ (Attic ἀπεσύμεθα)
glossary.ἀποπλαγχθέντες: ἀποπλάζω — drive off course; aor. pass. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’driven astray’
glossary.ἀποσχέσθαι: ἀπέχω — keep off; mid. ἀπέχομαι, hold oneself back, abstain; aor. 2 inf. mid.: ’to hold back’
glossary.ἀρνῶν: ἀρήν — lamb; gen. pl. (oblique stem ἀρν-)
glossary.ἀφύσσας: ἀφύσσω — draw (liquid), ladle; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having drawn off’
glossary.ἁζόμενοι: ἅζομαι — stand in awe of, revere; pres. part. mid. masc. nom. pl.: ’out of awe’
glossary.ἄγγεα: ἄγγος — vessel, pail; neut. nom. pl., uncontracted (= Attic ἄγγη)
glossary.ἄγριον: ἄγριος — wild, savage; masc. acc. sg. · also neut. nom. sg., predicate, ’savage’ (of the monster, with κακόν)
glossary.ἄλλην: ἄλλος — other, another; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἄλοχός: ἄλοχος — wife, bedfellow; fem. nom. sg., accented before the enclitic τε
glossary.ἄλσεϊ: ἄλσος — sacred grove; neut. dat. sg., epic -εϊ (= Attic -ει)
glossary.ἄντροιο: ἄντρον — cave; neut. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.ἄρνας: ἀρήν — lamb; acc. pl. (oblique stem ἀρν-)
glossary.ἄρσενα: ἄρσην — male; neut. acc. pl., used substantivally: ’the males’ (Attic ἄρρην, ἄρρενα) · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with βοῦν: ’a male (ox)’
glossary.ἐθηεύμεσθα: θηέομαι — gaze at, view with wonder; impf. 1 pl., epic uncontracted, with -μεσθα ending (= Attic ἐθεώμεθα)
glossary.ἐθύσαμεν: θύω — sacrifice, burn as an offering; aor. 1 pl.
glossary.ἐνάμελγεν: ἐναμέλγω — milk into; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐνήμελγεν), compound of ἐν + ἀμέλγω
glossary.ἐνόμευε: νομεύω — pasture, tend (flocks); impf. 3 sg., augmented
glossary.ἐξελάσαντας: ἐξελαύνω (epic ἐλάω) — drive out; aor. part. act. masc. acc. pl.: ’having driven out’
glossary.ἐπέθηκε: ἐπιτίθημι — put on, set upon; aor. 3 sg. (κ-aorist)
glossary.ἐπελεύσεσθαι: ἐπέρχομαι — come upon, attack, approach; fut. inf. (ἐπελεύσομαι)
glossary.ἐπιειμένον: ἐπιέννυμι — put on, clothe in; perf. mid./pass. part. masc. acc. sg., with acc. of what is worn: ’clothed in’
glossary.ἐπιπλεῖν: ἐπιπλέω — sail over, sail upon (+ acc.); pres. inf.
glossary.ἐπιτιμήτωρ: ἐπιτιμήτωρ — one who punishes wrongs, avenger, protector; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἐπῆλθε: ἐπέρχομαι — come upon, arrive; aor. 2 3 sg. (same form in Attic)
glossary.ἐρατεινὸς: ἐρατεινός — lovely, pleasing; masc. nom. sg., epic (= Attic ἐρατός)
glossary.ἐσθλαὶ: ἐσθλός — good, sturdy; fem. nom. pl.
glossary.ἐυάνθεος: Εὐάνθης — Euanthes, father of Maron; masc. gen. sg., epic -εος (= Attic -ους)
glossary.ἐυεργέος: ἐϋεργής — well-made, well-wrought; masc. gen. sg., uncontracted (= Attic -οῦς)
glossary.ἓν: εἷς, μία, ἕν — one; neut. nom./acc. sg.
glossary.ἔδωκ: δίδωμι — give; aor. 3 sg., elided (ἔδωκ’ = ἔδωκε)
glossary.ἔμβρυον: ἔμβρυον — young one, lamb or kid still at the udder; neut. acc. sg.
glossary.ἔμελλ: μέλλω — be about to, be destined to (+ fut. inf.); impf. 3 sg., elided (ἔμελλ’ = ἔμελλε)
glossary.ἔρχατο: εἴργω (ἔργω) — shut in, pen; plpf. pass. 3 pl., epic -ατο ending (Attic uses a periphrasis, εἰργμένοι ἦσαν): ’were penned’
glossary.ἔστησεν: ἵστημι — set, place, stand (trans.); aor. 1 3 sg.
glossary.ἔσχες: ἔχω — have, hold; of a ship, hold in, bring to land; aor. 2 2 sg. (ἔσχον)
glossary.ἔχθος: ἔχθος — hatred, enmity; neut. nom./acc. sg.
glossary.ἕκασται: ἕκαστος — each, every; fem. nom. pl.
glossary.ἕρσαι: ἕρση — dew; in the plural, the newest-born lambs (’dewy ones’); fem. nom. pl.
glossary.ἠείδη: οἶδα — know; plpf. 3 sg. with impf. sense, epic (= Attic ᾔδει): ’knew’
glossary.ἠλίβατον: ἠλίβατος — steep, towering, huge; adj. of two endings, fem. acc. sg.; meaning uncertain, traditional gloss followed
glossary.ἡδεῖα: ἡδύς — sweet, pleasant; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἤμελγε: ἀμέλγω — milk; impf. 3 sg., augmented ἤ- (no ν-movable)
glossary.ἤμελγεν: ἀμέλγω — milk; impf. 3 sg., augmented ἤ- (with ν-movable)
glossary.ἥμισυ: ἥμισυς — half; neut. acc. sg., used as a noun: ’half’
glossary.ἧκεν: ἵημι — send, let go, put; aor. 3 sg. (ἧκα, with ν-movable; Attic ἧκε): ’sent, put’
glossary.ἱκετάων: ἱκέτης — suppliant; masc. gen. pl., epic -άων (= Attic -ῶν)
glossary.ἱρεὺς: ἱερεύς — priest; masc. nom. sg., epic ἱρεύς (= Attic ἱερεύς)
glossary.ἴδοιμι: ὁράω — see; aor. 2 opt. 1 sg. (from εἶδον), in a purpose clause after ὄφρα: ’that I might see’ · also after εἴ πως, of an aim in view: ’(to see) if somehow I might see’
glossary.ἴσμαρον: Ἴσμαρος — Ismarus (a city of the Cicones in Thrace); acc. sg.
glossary.ὀρυμαγδὸν: ὀρυμαγδός — din, crashing noise; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ὀρῷ: ὀρός — whey; masc. dat. sg. (Attic ὀρρός), of what the vessels swim with
glossary.ὀχλίσσειαν: ὀχλίζω — heave up with a lever, dislodge; aor. opt. 3 pl., epic σσ (= Attic ὀχλίσειαν), potential with ἄν: ’could move’
glossary.ὄβριμον: ὄβριμος — mighty, heavy; adj. of two endings, masc./neut. acc. sg.
glossary.ὑπουράνιον: ὑπουράνιος — under the heavens; adj. of two endings, neut. nom. sg., epic one word (Attic ὑπ’ οὐρανῷ)
glossary.ᾤκει: οἰκέω — dwell, live; impf. 3 sg., augmented
glossary.αὐανθέν: αὐαίνω — dry, make dry; aor. pass. part. neut. nom./acc. sg.: ’dried, having been dried’
glossary.βούλευσα: βουλεύω — plan, deliberate, resolve; aor. 1 sg.: ’I planned’
glossary.δειπνήσας: δειπνέω — dine, take a meal; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having dined’
glossary.δεῦε: δεύω — wet, drench; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔδευε)
glossary.δολίοις: δόλιος — crafty, guileful; masc./neut. dat. pl. (agreeing with ἐπέεσσι)
glossary.δυνάμεσθα: δύναμαι — be able, can; epic pres. opt. 1 pl. (= Attic δυναίμεθα): with κεν ’we could’ · also pres. indic. 1 pl., epic -μεσθα (= Attic δυνάμεθα): ’we were able’ (+ inf.)
glossary.εὖχος: εὖχος — glory, triumph, the vaunt of victory; neut. nom./acc. sg.
glossary.κέχυτο: χέω — pour, spread; plpf. mid./pass. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐκέχυτο): ’lay spread out’
glossary.καλλίτριχα: καλλίθριξ — fair-fleeced, with fine wool; neut. nom./acc. pl. (θ > τ before the aspirate of the stem: -τριχ-, ’fair-fleeced flocks’)
glossary.κατέαξε: κατάγνυμι — break in pieces, shatter; aor. 3 sg. act., from the ᾱ-stem aorist ἔᾱξα
glossary.κατέθηκα: κατατίθημι — put down, lay away, store; aor. 1 sg., κ-aorist
glossary.κατακρύψας: κατακρύπτω — hide away, conceal; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having hidden’
glossary.κισσύβιον: κισσύβιον — ivy-wood cup, drinking bowl; neut. acc. sg.
glossary.κλήρῳ: κλῆρος — lot; masc. dat. sg., of means: ’by lot’
glossary.κλαίοντες: κλαίω — weep, wail; pres. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’weeping’
glossary.κλυτόν: κλυτός — famous, renowned; masc./neut. acc. sg.
glossary.κόπρῳ: κόπρος — dung, manure; fem. dat. sg.
glossary.κόπτ: κόπτω — strike, beat, smash; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented and elided (κόπτ’ = ἔκοπτε): ’was dashing’
glossary.κύκλωπα: Κύκλωψ — Cyclops, one of the one-eyed giants; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.λάθεν: λανθάνω — escape the notice of (+ acc.); aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔλαθεν)
glossary.λιπόμην: λείπω — leave; mid. be left behind, stay behind; aor. mid. 1 sg., unaugmented (= ἐλιπόμην): ’I stayed behind’
glossary.λοιβὴν: λοιβή — libation, drink-offering; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.μάρψας: μάρπτω — seize, grab; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having seized’
glossary.μαίνεαι: μαίνομαι — rage, be mad; pres. 2 sg. mid., epic uncontracted (= Attic μαίνῃ)
glossary.μελαίνης: μέλας, μέλαινα — black, dark; fem. gen. sg.
glossary.μελεϊστὶ: μελεϊστί — limb by limb, piecemeal; adv. (from μέλος ’limb’)
glossary.μοχλὸν: μοχλός — stake, bar, lever; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.μυελόεντα: μυελόεις — full of marrow, marrowy; neut. acc. pl.
glossary.νέα: ναῦς — ship; fem. acc. sg., epic νέα (= Attic ναῦν)
glossary.νέκταρός: νέκταρ — nectar, the gods’ drink; neut. gen. sg.
glossary.νηδὺν: νηδύς — belly, stomach; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.νομεύων: νομεύω — pasture, tend (flocks); pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’tending’
glossary.ξείνιον: ξείνιον — guest-gift; neut. nom./acc. sg., epic (= Attic ξένιον)
glossary.οὐτάμεναι: οὐτάω — wound, stab; aor. inf. act., epic -μεναι (= Attic οὐτάσαι)
glossary.οὖτιν: Οὖτις — ’Nobody’, the name Odysseus gives himself (οὔ τις); masc. acc. sg. ’Nobody’ as object
glossary.οὖτις: Οὖτις — ’Nobody’, the name Odysseus gives himself (οὔ τις); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.πάχος: πάχος — thickness, girth; neut. nom. sg.
glossary.πέμπτος: πέμπτος — fifth; masc. nom. sg.: ’as fifth’
glossary.πέμψειας: πέμπω — send, escort; aor. opt. 2 sg. (in an εἰ-clause): ’you would send’
glossary.πίε: πίνω — drink; aor. imper. 2 sg. act., epic πίε (= Attic πῖθι): ’drink!’
glossary.πίνων: πίνω — drink; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’drinking’
glossary.παρέθηχ: παρατίθημι — set beside, put before; aor. 1 sg., κ-aorist elided, κ > χ before a rough breathing (παρέθηχ’ = παρέθηκα)
glossary.παραστάς: παρίστημι — stand beside; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg., root aorist: ’standing beside’
glossary.πείρασι: πεῖραρ — limit, end, boundary; neut. dat. pl., epic (= Attic πέρασι, from πέρας)
glossary.πειράζων: πειράζω — test, make trial of; pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’testing’
glossary.πεπαλάσθαι: πάλλω — shake, cast (lots); reduplicated aor. inf. mid.: κλήρῳ πεπαλάσθαι ’to cast lots’
glossary.ποίησαν: ποιέω — make, do; aor. 3 pl., unaugmented (= ἐποίησαν): ’they made’
glossary.προσέθηκεν: προστίθημι — put to, set against; aor. 3 sg., κ-aorist
glossary.προσέφην: προσφημί — speak to, address; aor. 1 sg. (προσέφην, aor. of φημί): ’I addressed’
glossary.προσπελάσας: προσπελάζω — bring near, dash against; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having brought up against’
glossary.πῶμ: πῶμα — lid, cover; neut. acc. sg., elided (πῶμ’ = πῶμα)
glossary.σηκῷ: σηκός — pen, fold, enclosure; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.σκύλακας: σκύλαξ — puppy, whelp; masc./fem. acc. pl.
glossary.στενάχοντες: στενάχω — groan, lament; pres. part. masc. nom. pl., epic (= στένω): ’groaning’
glossary.στῆθος: στῆθος — breast, chest; neut. acc. sg.
glossary.σχέτλια: σχέτλιος — cruel, dreadful, monstrous; neut. acc. pl.
glossary.σχέτλιε: σχέτλιος — reckless, cruel; masc. voc. sg.: ’you reckless one!’
glossary.τέσσαρες: τέσσαρες — four; numeral, masc. nom. pl. (Attic τέτταρες)
glossary.τανυσσάμενος: τανύω — stretch out; mid. stretch oneself out; aor. part. mid. masc. nom. sg., epic σσ: ’having stretched himself out’
glossary.τισαίμην: τίνω — pay; mid. τίνυμαι, exact vengeance, punish; aor. opt. mid. 1 sg.: ’I might take vengeance’
glossary.τολμήσειεν: τολμάω — dare, bring oneself to; aor. opt. 3 sg.: ’whoever should dare’
glossary.τρέπε: τρέπω — turn, drive; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔτρεπε)
glossary.τρῖψαι: τρίβω — rub, grind, twist; aor. inf. act.: ’to twist, to grind’
glossary.φάγες: ἐσθίω — eat; aor. 2 sg., unaugmented (= ἔφαγες): ’you ate’
glossary.φαίνετο: φαίνω — show; mid. appear, seem; impf. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented (= ἐφαίνετο)
glossary.φαρέτρῃ: φαρέτρη — quiver; fem. dat. sg., Ionic η (= Attic φαρέτρᾳ)
glossary.φοροίη: φορέω — carry, bear (by-form of φέρω); pres. opt. 3 sg.: ’might carry’
glossary.χαίρῃς: χαίρω — rejoice, take delight in (+ dat.); pres. subj. 2 sg.: ’you may delight’
glossary.χείρ: χείρ — hand; fem. acc. sg., elided (χεῖρ’ = χεῖρα)
glossary.χλωρὸν: χλωρός — green, fresh (of living wood); neut. nom./acc. sg. · also of honey, neut. acc. sg.: ’yellow, pale’ (μέλι χλωρόν ’yellow honey’) · also of fear, neut. nom. sg.: ’pale’ (χλωρὸν δέος ’pale fear’)
glossary.ἀμηχανίη: ἀμηχανία — helplessness, despair; fem. nom. sg., Ionic -ίη (= Attic -ία)
glossary.ἀνδρόμεα: ἀνδρόμεος — of a man, human; neut. acc. pl. (epic, ’human flesh’)
glossary.ἀνεσχέθομεν: ἀνέχω — hold up, raise; aor. 1 pl. act., epic aorist stem ἀνεσχεθ- (= ἀνέσχομεν): ’we held up’
glossary.ἀπέκοψα: ἀποκόπτω — cut off, chop off; aor. 1 sg.
glossary.ἀπέλειπεν: ἀπολείπω — leave behind, leave over; impf. 3 sg.: ’was leaving’
glossary.ἀποξῦναι: ἀποξύω — scrape off, trim smooth; aor. inf. act.: ’to trim’
glossary.ἀπορρώξ: ἀπορρώξ — broken-off piece, hence an outflow, trickle; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀπωλόμεθ: ἀπόλλυμι — destroy; mid. perish; aor. mid. 1 pl., elided (ἀπωλόμεθ’ = ἀπωλόμεθα): ’we perished’
glossary.ἀπώσασθαι: ἀπωθέω — push away, thrust off; aor. inf. mid.
glossary.ἀφελὼν: ἀφαιρέω — take away, remove; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg. (ἀφελ- stem): ’having removed’
glossary.ἀφραδίῃσιν: ἀφραδίη — folly, thoughtlessness; fem. dat. pl., Ionic -ῃσιν (= Attic ἀφραδίαις): ’through folly’
glossary.ἄκρῃ: ἄκρη — headland, height; fem. dat. sg., Ionic η (= Attic ἄκρᾳ)
glossary.ἄμμες: ἐγώ — I; nom. pl., epic/Aeolic ἄμμες (= Attic ἡμεῖς): ’we’
glossary.ἄψορρον: ἄψορρος — backward, back again; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’in return, back’
glossary.ἆσσον: ἆσσον — nearer, closer; adv., comparative of ἄγχι
glossary.ἐίσκομεν: ἐίσκω (= ἴσκω) — liken, compare; impf. 1 pl.: ’we likened (it)’
glossary.ἐεικοσόροιο: ἐεικόσορος — twenty-oared; masc./fem. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic εἰκοσόρου)
glossary.ἐθόωσα: θοόω — sharpen, make pointed; aor. 1 sg.: ’I sharpened’
glossary.ἐκεκεύθει: κεύθω — hide, hold hidden; plpf. 3 sg. (perf. κέκευθα): ’had held in store’
glossary.ἐκπεράᾳ: ἐκπεράω — cross over, traverse; pres. subj. 3 sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἐκπερᾷ), general relative: ’that crosses’
glossary.ἐλέγμην: λέγω — pick out, count; mid. be counted in; aor. mid. 1 sg., athematic: ’I was numbered’
glossary.ἐλαΐνεον: ἐλαΐνεος — of olive-wood; neut. nom. sg., epic (= Attic ἐλαΐνος)
glossary.ἐλεήσας: ἐλεέω — pity, take pity on; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having pitied’
glossary.ἐμπλήσατο: ἐμπίπλημι — fill; mid. fill for oneself; aor. mid. 3 sg. (ἐμπλήσατο): ’filled’
glossary.ἐξερέω: ἐξερέω — tell out, declare; fut. 1 sg., uncontracted (= Attic ἐξερῶ): ’I will tell’
glossary.ἐπέθηχ: ἐπιτίθημι — put on, set upon; aor. 3 sg., κ-aorist elided, κ > χ before a rough breathing (ἐπέθηχ’ = ἐπέθηκε)
glossary.ἐπιθείη: ἐπιτίθημι — put on, set upon; aor. opt. 3 sg. act.: ’might put on’
glossary.ἐπιμασσάμενος: ἐπιμαίομαι — feel over, grope at; aor. part. mid. masc. nom. sg., epic σσ: ’having felt out’
glossary.ἐπυράκτεον: πυρακτέω — harden in fire; impf. 1 sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἐπυρακτοῦν): ’I hardened in the fire’
glossary.ἑτάροις: ἕταρος — companion (by-form of ἑταῖρος); masc. dat. pl. (= Attic ἑταίροις)
glossary.ἔγκατά: ἔγκατα — entrails, innards; neut. nom./acc. pl. (plural only)
glossary.ἔδεκτο: δέχομαι — receive, take; aor. 3 sg. mid., epic ἔδεκτο (= Attic ἐδέξατο)
glossary.ἔδομαι: ἐσθίω — eat; fut. 1 sg. mid.: ’I will eat’
glossary.ἔδωκα: δίδωμι — give; aor. 1 sg., κ-aorist: ’I gave’
glossary.ἔδων: ἔδω — eat (= ἐσθίω); pres. part. masc. nom. sg., epic: ’eating’
glossary.ἔκπιεν: ἐκπίνω — drink up, drain; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐξέπιεν)
glossary.ἔκταμεν: ἐκτέμνω — cut out, cut down; aor. 3 sg. (ν-movable), unaugmented (= ἐξέταμε) · also κτείνω — kill; aor. 1 pl., epic short form (= Attic ἐκτείναμεν): ’we killed’
glossary.ἔνεικεν: φέρω — bring, carry; aor. 3 sg., epic ἔνεικε(ν), unaugmented (= Attic ἤνεγκε)
glossary.ἔντοσθ: ἔντοσθε(ν) — inside, within; adv./prep. + gen., elided (ἔντοσθ’ = ἔντοσθε)
glossary.ἔπεσσι: ἔπος — word, speech; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic ἔπεσι)
glossary.ἔρεξας: ῥέζω — do, perform (Attic ποιέω, δράω); aor. 2 sg.: ’you did’
glossary.ἔρυκεν: ἐρύκω — hold back, restrain; impf. 3 sg. (ν-movable): ’was holding back’
glossary.ἤσθιε: ἐσθίω — eat; impf. 3 sg.: ’was eating, ate’
glossary.ἥσατο: ἥδομαι — be pleased, take delight; aor. 3 sg. (ἥσατο, Attic ἥσθη): ’was delighted’
glossary.ἱκάνοι: ἱκάνω — come, reach, come upon (= ἱκνέομαι); pres. opt. 3 sg.: ’might come upon’
glossary.ἴαλλε: ἰάλλω — send, hurl, lay on; impf. 3 sg.: ’sent, laid (on)’
glossary.ὀισάμενος: ὀΐομαι — think, suppose, suspect; aor. part. mid. masc. nom. sg. (Attic οἴομαι): ’having supposed’
glossary.ὁμαλὸν: ὁμαλός — even, smooth, level; neut. acc. sg., predicate: ’smooth’
glossary.ὄργυιαν: ὄργυια — fathom, arm-span (about six feet); fem. acc. sg., of extent
glossary.ὑμῆς: ὑμός — your (pl.); fem. gen. sg. (epic = Attic ὑμετέρας)
glossary.ὑπέκφυγον: ὑπεκφεύγω — escape from under, slip away; aor. 1 sg. or 3 pl.: ’escaped’
glossary.ὑπέστης: ὑφίστημι — undertake, promise; aor. 2 sg. (root aorist): ’you promised’
glossary.ῥέε: ῥέω — flow; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented and uncontracted (= ἔρρει)
glossary.ῥοίζῳ: ῥοῖζος — whistling, rushing noise; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.ῥόπαλον: ῥόπαλον — club, cudgel; neut. nom. sg. · also neut. acc. sg., object: ’club’ (ῥόπαλον ἔχων ’holding a club’)
glossary.αἰνύμενος: αἴνυμαι — take, seize; pres. part. mid. masc. nom. sg.: ’taking’ (σύντρεις αἰνύμενος ’taking them three at a time’)
glossary.αἵματι: αἷμα — blood; neut. dat. sg.: ’with blood’, instrumental
glossary.βάπτῃ: βάπτω — dip, plunge; pres. subj. 3 sg., in a general clause or simile: ’(as when a smith) dips’
glossary.βαλόντας: βάλλω — throw, put; aor. part. act. masc. acc. pl.: ’having thrown’
glossary.βιάζεται: βιάζομαι — use force on, do violence to; pres. mid. 3 sg. + acc.: ’he forces, overpowers’
glossary.βιβάς: βιβάω (βίβημι) — stride, step; pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’striding’ (Attic βαίνων)
glossary.βούλευον: βουλεύω — plan, deliberate; impf. 1 sg.: ’I was planning’
glossary.βοῆς: βοή — shout, cry; fem. gen. sg., gen. of what is heard (with ἀίοντες): ’hearing the cry’
glossary.γένοιο: γίγνομαι — become; aor. opt. 2 sg. mid.: ’you might become’, in a wish (εἰ … γένοιο ’if only you could become’) · also aor. opt. 2 sg. mid. in a negative wish: ’may you not become’ (μήτ’ εἴης … μήτε γένοιο)
glossary.γαστέρ: γαστήρ — belly; fem. acc. sg., elided (γαστέρ’ = γαστέρα)
glossary.γλήνης: γλήνη — eyeball, pupil of the eye; fem. gen. sg.
glossary.γοῶντες: γοάω — wail, lament; pres. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’lamenting’
glossary.δέδεντο: δέω — bind, tie; plpf. pass. 3 pl., unaugmented (= ἐδέδεντο): ’had been tied, were tied’
glossary.δίνεον: δινέω — whirl, twirl; impf. 1 sg., uncontracted and unaugmented (= ἐδίνουν): ’I twirled’
glossary.δαμασσάμενος: δαμάζω (δάμνημι) — overpower, subdue; aor. part. mid. masc. nom. sg., epic σσ (= δαμασάμενος): ’having overpowered’
glossary.δασύμαλλοι: δασύμαλλος — thick-fleeced, with shaggy wool; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.δημῷ: δημός — fat; masc. dat. sg.: ’with fat’, dat. of respect (πίονα δημῷ ’fat with fat’) · also instrumental dat. with a participle: ’covered in fat’ (καλύψας πίονι δημῷ)
glossary.διεφαίνετο: διαφαίνω (mid. διαφαίνομαι) — shine through, show through, glow; impf. 3 sg. mid.: ’it glowed through’
glossary.δινέομεν: δινέω — whirl, twirl; pres. 1 pl., uncontracted (= Attic δινοῦμεν), narrative present: ’we twirl(ed)’
glossary.δόλους: δόλος — guile, trick, cunning device; masc. acc. pl.
glossary.εἰνὶ: ἐν (epic εἰνί, ἐνί) — in, at, on; prep. + dat.
glossary.εἰροπόκων: εἰροπόκος — wool-bearing, fleecy (= ἐριοπόκος); adj., masc./fem. gen. pl.
glossary.εἴροντο: ἐρέομαι (εἴρομαι) — ask, inquire; aor. 3 pl. mid.: ’they asked’
glossary.εἴων: ἐάω — allow, let be; impf. 1 sg. (or 3 pl.), augmented: ’I allowed’; with οὐκ ’I would not let’
glossary.εἷλε: αἱρέω — take, take away; aor. 3 sg. act., augmented: ’took’
glossary.εὑροίμην: εὑρίσκω — find; aor. opt. 1 sg. mid.: ’I might find’ (after εἴ, of an aim in view)
glossary.εὗσεν: εὕω — singe, scorch; aor. 3 sg. act.: ’singed’
glossary.θάρσυνον: θαρσύνω — encourage, hearten; impf. 1 sg., unaugmented (= ἐθάρσυνον): ’I heartened’
glossary.θεινομένου: θείνω — strike, beat; pres. part. pass. masc. gen. sg.: ’being struck’, gen. agreeing with the owner of the brains
glossary.θερμαίνοιτο: θερμαίνω — heat, make hot; pres. opt. pass. 3 sg.: ’it should grow hot’ (after ἧος, of an expected end)
glossary.θερμὸν: θερμός — hot, warm; masc./neut. acc. sg.
glossary.θεσπεσίοιο: θεσπέσιος — wondrous, marvellous, divinely great; masc./neut. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= -ου)
glossary.κήδοι: κήδω — trouble, distress; pres. opt. 3 sg. act. (ὅττι ἑ κήδοι ’what was troubling him’, indirect question in secondary sequence)
glossary.καθέζετο: καθέζομαι — sit down, seat oneself; impf. 3 sg.: ’sat down’
glossary.καιομένης: καίω — burn, set on fire; pres. part. pass. fem. gen. sg.: ’burning’
glossary.κακῇσι: κακός — bad, evil, grievous; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι (= Attic κακαῖς)
glossary.καλοί: καλός — fair, fine, handsome; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.κείμην: κεῖμαι — lie; impf. 1 sg., unaugmented (= ἐκείμην): ’I lay’
glossary.κερτομίοισι: κερτόμιος — taunting, mocking; adj. used as noun, dat. pl., epic -οισι: ’with taunts’
glossary.κτείνει: κτείνω — kill, slay; pres. 3 sg.: ’is killing’
glossary.κύκλωπας: Κύκλωψ — Cyclops, one of the one-eyed giants; masc. acc. pl.
glossary.λάβοι: λαμβάνω — take, catch; aor. opt. 3 sg. act.: ’he might catch’ (after εἴ, ’in case’)
glossary.λάχνῳ: λάχνη — wool, fleece; fem. dat. sg.: ’by his wool’, dat. of cause
glossary.λαβών: λαμβάνω — take, seize; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having taken’
glossary.λασίην: λάσιος — shaggy, woolly; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.λελειμμένος: λείπω — leave; perf. part. pass. masc. nom. sg.: ’left behind, lagging behind’
glossary.λιλαίεαι: λιλαίομαι — long for, desire eagerly; pres. 2 sg., uncontracted (= Attic λιλαίῃ): ’you long’
glossary.λυγροῖς: λυγρός — grievous, baneful, wretched; masc. dat. pl.
glossary.λυόμην: λύω — loose, free; impf. mid. 1 sg., unaugmented (= ἐλυόμην): ’I freed myself’
glossary.λωφήσειε: λωφάω — rest, find relief, ease; aor. opt. 3 sg. act. + gen. of the ill: ’it might be eased of’ (with κε)
glossary.λύγοισιν: λύγος — withy, pliant twig; fem. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις)
glossary.λύσιν: λύσις — release, deliverance; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.μέμηκον: μηκάομαι — bleat; 3 pl. past, either a pluperfect or a reduplicated aorist (perf. μέμηκα): ’they bleated’
glossary.μεγάλα: μέγας — great, large; neut. nom./acc. pl. · also neut. acc. pl. used adverbially with a verb of sound: ’loudly’ (μεγάλα ἰάχοντα ’shrieking loudly’)
glossary.μεγάλοι: μέγας — great, large; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.μοχλὸς: μοχλός — stake, bar, lever; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.μοχλῷ: μοχλός — stake, bar, lever; masc. dat. sg.
