glossary.νέμεαι: νέμω — mid. graze, feed on; pres. 2 sg. mid., uncontracted (= Attic νέμῃ): ’you graze on’
glossary.νήιον: νήιος — of a ship, ship’s (epic for ναυτικός); neut. acc. sg.: δόρυ νήιον ’ship’s timber’
glossary.νήπιον: νήπιος — witless, foolish, childish; masc. acc. sg., predicate (with εἶναι)
glossary.νεῦον: νεύω — nod, make a sign; impf. 1 sg., unaugmented (= ἔνευον): ’I signalled’ (ἀνὰ … νεῦον, tmesis)
glossary.νομόνδ: νομός — pasture; masc. acc. sg. + directional -δε, elided: ’to pasture’
glossary.νοῦσον: νοῦσος — sickness, disease; fem. acc. sg., Ionic (= Attic νόσος)
glossary.οἰνοβαρείων: οἰνοβαρέω — be heavy with wine, drunk; pres. part. masc. nom. sg., epic form in -είων: ’weighed down with wine’
glossary.οἰῶν: ὄϊς (Attic οἶς) — sheep; masc./fem. gen. pl., contracted (= epic ὀίων)
glossary.οὔδεϊ: οὖδας — ground, floor; neut. dat. sg., epic -εϊ (= οὔδει)
glossary.οὖτίς: Οὖτις — ’Nobody’, the name Odysseus gives himself (= οὔ τις); masc. nom. sg., accented οὖτίς before an enclitic (Οὖτίς με)
glossary.πέλωρ: πέλωρ — monster, portent, huge creature; neut. nom. sg., also said of a person in apposition: ’monster’
glossary.πέπον: πέπων — ripe, soft; in address a familiar ’good (friend)’, exact sense uncertain; masc. voc. sg.
glossary.πέσεν: πίπτω — fall; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔπεσεν): ’fell’
glossary.πανδαμάτωρ: πανδαμάτωρ — all-subduing, all-conquering; adj., masc. nom. sg. (epithet of sleep)
glossary.πανύστατος: πανύστατος — very last, last of all; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.παχὺν: παχύς — thick, stout; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.περίρρεε: περιρρέω — flow around; impf. 3 sg., uncontracted and unaugmented (= περιέρρει): ’flowed round’
glossary.περιτροπέοντες: περιτροπέω — turn about, wheel round (sense uncertain); pres. part. masc. nom. pl., uncontracted (= Attic περιτροποῦντες): ’turning about’
glossary.πεφυγμένον: φεύγω — flee, escape; perf. part. mid./pass. masc./neut. acc. sg.: ’having escaped’ (with εἶναι, ’has escaped’)
glossary.πεφυρμένον: φύρω — mix, knead, smear; perf. part. pass. masc. acc. sg. + dat.: ’smeared with’
glossary.ποθέεις: ποθέω — long for, miss; pres. 2 sg., uncontracted (= Attic ποθεῖς): ’you long for’
glossary.πολλῆς: πολύς — much, great, many; fem. gen. sg.
glossary.πολλῷ: πολύς — much, great, many; masc./neut. dat. sg.
glossary.πολύφημ: Πολύφημος — Polyphemus, the Cyclops; masc. voc. sg., elided (Πολύφημ’ = Πολύφημε)
glossary.πολύφημος: Πολύφημος — Polyphemus, the Cyclops; masc. nom. sg. (the name perhaps ’much spoken of’)
glossary.ποτιφωνήεις: ποτιφωνήεις — able to speak, endowed with voice; adj., masc. nom. sg., epic ποτι- (= προσφωνήεις)
glossary.πυριήκεα: πυριήκης — fire-pointed, with its point hardened in fire; adj., masc. acc. sg.
glossary.σίζ: σίζω — hiss, sizzle; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented, elided (σίζ’ = σῖζε): ’hissed’
glossary.σευ: σύ — you (sg.); gen. sg., epic enclitic (= Attic σοῦ): ’your, of you’
glossary.σηκούς: σηκός — pen, fold; masc. acc. pl.
glossary.σπήεσσι: σπέος — cave, grotto; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic σπέσι)
glossary.σποδοῦ: σποδός — ashes, embers; fem. gen. sg.
glossary.στέρνοισι: στέρνον — chest, breast; neut. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= -οις)
glossary.σταθμόνδε: σταθμός — stall, fold, farmstead; masc. acc. sg. + directional -δε: ’to the stall’
glossary.στείχοντα: στείχω — go, walk, march; pres. part. masc. acc. sg.: ’going’
glossary.στεινόμενος: στείνομαι — be cramped, pressed, burdened; pres. part. pass. masc. nom. sg., epic (= Attic στενούμενος): ’weighed down’
glossary.στενάχοντο: στενάχω — groan, lament; impf. 3 pl. mid., unaugmented: ’they groaned’, + acc. ’lamented for’
glossary.στρεφθεὶς: στρέφω — turn, twist; aor. pass. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having twisted, curled round’ · also ’having turned (round)’, of a man turning: στρεφθεὶς ἐκ χώρης ’turning round from his place’
glossary.συνέεργον: συνείργω (συνέργω) — shut together, bind together; impf. 1 sg., uncontracted (= Attic συνεῖργον): ’I tied together’
glossary.σφαραγεῦντο: σφαραγέομαι — crackle, sizzle, be near bursting; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented, epic contraction -εῦντο (= -έοντο)
glossary.σύντρεις: σύντρεις — three together, three at a time; adj., masc. acc. pl.
glossary.σώοντες: σαόω (σώω) — keep safe, save; pres. part. act. masc. nom. pl., epic (= Attic σῴζοντες): ’keeping safe’
glossary.τέρεν: τέρην — tender, delicate; neut. acc. pl., elided (τέρεν’ = τέρενα) · also neut. acc. sg., agreeing with δάκρυον: ’tender (tear)’ (τέρεν, the neuter of τέρην)
glossary.τίθησθα: τίθημι — put, place, make; pres. 2 sg., epic -σθα (= Attic τίθης): ’you put, make’
glossary.ταναύποδα: ταναύπους — long-footed, long-legged (sense uncertain); adj., neut. acc. pl.
glossary.τειρόμενος: τείρω — wear out, distress; pres. part. pass. masc. nom. sg.: ’worn down’
glossary.τρυπάνῳ: τρύπανον — drill, auger; neut. dat. sg.: ’with a drill’
glossary.τρυπῷ: τρυπάω — bore through, drill; pres. subj. 3 sg., Ionic contraction -ῷ (= Attic τρυπᾷ): ’(as when a man) bores’
glossary.φάνημεν: φαίνω — show; aor. pass. 1 pl., unaugmented (= ἐφάνημεν): ’we appeared’
glossary.φάρυγος: φάρυγξ — throat, gullet; fem. gen. sg.
glossary.φέρεσκε: φέρω — carry, bear; iterative impf. 3 sg. in -σκε, unaugmented (= ἔφερε): ’used to carry’
glossary.φαρμάσσων: φαρμάσσω — treat by dipping, temper (metal); pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg., epic σσ (= φαρμάττων): ’tempering’
glossary.φῶτ: φώς — man; masc. acc. sg., elided (φῶτ’ = φῶτα)
glossary.χλωρός: χλωρός — green, fresh, unseasoned; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ψηλαφόων: ψηλαφάω — feel, grope; pres. part. masc. nom. sg., uncontracted (= ψηλαφῶν): ’groping’
glossary.ψυχῆς: ψυχή — life, breath, soul; fem. gen. sg. (περὶ ψυχῆς ’for one’s life’)
glossary.ψωμοί: ψωμός — morsel, bit (of food); masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἀίοντες: ἀΐω — hear, perceive; pres. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’hearing’, + gen.
glossary.ἀκέων: ἀκέων — silent, in silence; adj., masc. nom. sg., used adverbially: ’silently’
glossary.ἀλύων: ἀλύω — be distraught, beside oneself (with pain or distress); pres. part. masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀνήμελκτοι: ἀνήμελκτος — unmilked; adj., fem. nom. pl.
glossary.ἀναδύη: ἀναδύομαι — draw back, shrink back; aor. opt. 3 sg. (athematic aor. ἀνέδυν, opt. -ύη): ’should draw back’, after μή
glossary.ἀνακλινθεὶς: ἀνακλίνω — lean back, lay back; aor. pass. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having leaned back’
glossary.ἀνδρόμεοι: ἀνδρόμεος — of a man, human; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἀπαμειβόμενοι: ἀπαμείβομαι — answer, reply; pres. part. mid. masc. nom. pl.: ’answering’
glossary.ἀπιόντες: ἄπειμι (εἶμι) — go away, depart; pres. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’going away’
glossary.ἀποδοχμώσας: ἀποδοχμόω — bend aside, bend sideways; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having bent aside’
glossary.ἀσπάσιοι: ἀσπάσιος — welcome, gladly received; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἀυτμὴ: ἀυτμή — breath, blast, hot breath; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀφικάνεις: ἀφικάνω — come to, arrive at; pres. 2 sg. + acc. (by-form of ἀφικνέομαι): ’you reach’
glossary.ἀύπνους: ἄϋπνος — sleepless; adj., masc. acc. pl.
glossary.ἀώτου: ἄωτος — fleece, tuft of wool; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.ἁψάμενοι: ἅπτω — mid. take hold of, grasp; aor. part. mid. masc. nom. pl.: ’having taken hold’
glossary.ἄκριας: ἄκρις — hilltop, peak, height; fem. acc. pl.
glossary.ἄκρῳ: ἄκρος — topmost, at the tip; masc./neut. dat. sg. (ἐπ’ ἄκρῳ ’at the tip’)
glossary.ἄμμε: ἐγώ — I; acc. pl. ’us’, Aeolic-epic (= Attic ἡμᾶς)
glossary.ἄρσενες: ἄρσην — male; masc. nom. pl. (= Attic ἄρρενες)
glossary.ἅψεσθαι: ἅπτω — mid. take hold of, catch fire; fut. inf. mid. (after μέλλεν): ’to catch (fire)’
glossary.ἐγέλασσε: γελάω — laugh; aor. 3 sg., epic σσ (= ἐγέλασε): ’laughed’
glossary.ἐγκέφαλός: ἐγκέφαλος — brain; masc. nom. sg., accented before an enclitic (γε)
glossary.ἐλάινος: ἐλάϊνος — of olive-wood; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἐλαϊνέῳ: ἐλάϊνος — of olive-wood; masc. dat. sg., epic -έῳ (= -ῷ)
glossary.ἐλαύνει: ἐλαύνω — drive, drive off; pres. 3 sg.
glossary.ἐλυσθεὶς: εἰλύω (Hom. ἐλύω) — wrap, curl up; aor. pass. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’curled up’
glossary.ἐμμενὲς: ἐμμενής — steady, unceasing; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’without a stop’
glossary.ἐνέπνευσεν: ἐμπνέω — breathe into, inspire; aor. 3 sg. (ἐν- preverb) + acc. and dat.: ’breathed into’
glossary.ἐνέρεισαν: ἐνερείδω — press in, drive in; aor. 3 pl. + dat.: ’they drove in’
glossary.ἐξέρυσ: ἐξερύω — draw out, pull out; aor. 3 sg., elided (ἐξέρυσ’ = ἐξέρυσε)
glossary.ἐξέσσυτο: ἐκσεύομαι — rush out; aor. 3 sg. mid., epic σσ: ’rushed out’
glossary.ἐξαλάωσε: ἐξαλαόω — blind utterly, put out the eyes of; aor. 3 sg.
glossary.ἐξαπάτησεν: ἐξαπατάω — deceive utterly, cheat; aor. 3 sg.
glossary.ἐπεμαίετο: ἐπιμαίομαι — feel over, touch, grope over; impf. 3 sg., uncontracted: ’was feeling over’
glossary.ἐρεισθεὶς: ἐρείδω — press, lean, support; aor. pass. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’leaning (my weight)’
glossary.ἐρεύγετο: ἐρεύγομαι — belch, spew out; impf. 3 sg.
glossary.ἐυστρεφέεσσι: ἐϋστρεφής — well-twisted; adj., dat. pl., epic -έεσσι (= -έσι)
glossary.ἐυτρεφέες: ἐϋτρεφής — well-fed, well-nourished; masc. nom. pl., uncontracted (= -εῖς)
glossary.ἐφοίτων: φοιτάω — roam, go to and fro, come repeatedly; impf. 3 pl.: ’came thronging’ · also impf. 1 sg. (same form): ’I went to and fro’
glossary.ἐχόμην: ἔχω — mid. hold on, cling to; impf. 1 sg. + gen.: ’I clung to’
glossary.ἑκάτερθεν: ἑκάτερθε(ν) — on each side, from each side; adv.
glossary.ἑσταότων: ἵστημι — stand; perf. part. masc. gen. pl., epic (= Attic ἑστώτων): ’standing’
glossary.ἑτέρω: ἕτερος — the other (of two); masc. nom. dual: ’the other two’
glossary.ἑταίροισιν: ἑταῖρος — companion, comrade; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= -οις)
glossary.ἔρριψεν: ῥίπτω — throw, fling; aor. 3 sg., with ρρ doubled after the augment: ’flung’
glossary.ἔρχεαι: ἔρχομαι — go, come; pres. 2 sg., uncontracted (= Attic ἔρχῃ): ’you go’
glossary.ἔσσυο: σεύω — mid. rush, hasten; aor. 2 sg. mid., epic σσ: ’you rushed, hurried’
glossary.ἔστειχε: στείχω — go, walk, march; impf. 3 sg.: ’went’
glossary.ἔφαν: φημί — say; impf./aor. 3 pl., epic (= Attic ἔφασαν): ’they said’
glossary.ἠβαιὸν: ἠβαιός — little, small; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’a little (way)’
glossary.ἠλασκάζει: ἠλασκάζω — wander about, skulk; + acc. slink away from, shun; pres. 3 sg.
glossary.ἠνεμοέσσας: ἠνεμόεις — windy, wind-swept; fem. acc. pl. of ἠνεμόεσσα (epic -όεσσα for -όεις)
glossary.ἤλασα: ἐλαύνω — drive, thrust; aor. 1 sg., augmented: ’I drove, thrust’
glossary.ἤλπετ: ἔλπομαι — hope, expect, suppose; impf. 3 sg., elided (ἤλπετ’ = ἤλπετο): ’supposed’
glossary.ἤπυεν: ἠπύω — call out, shout; impf. 3 sg.: ’called loudly’
glossary.ἰάχοντα: ἰάχω — cry out, shriek, roar; pres. part. masc. acc. sg.: ’shrieking’
glossary.ἱστάμενοι: ἵστημι — mid. stand, take one’s stand; pres. part. mid. masc. nom. pl.: ’standing’
glossary.ἴτην: εἶμι — go; impf. 3 dual (= Attic ᾔτην): ’the two went’
glossary.ὀδύνῃσι: ὀδύνη — pain, pang; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι (= Attic ὀδύναις)
glossary.ὀρθῶν: ὀρθός — upright, straight; masc. gen. pl.: ’standing upright’
glossary.ὀφθαλμοῖο: ὀφθαλμός — eye; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= -οῦ)
glossary.ὀφρύας: ὀφρύς — eyebrow, brow; fem. acc. pl.
glossary.ὁμοφρονέοις: ὁμοφρονέω — be of one mind, agree with; pres. opt. 2 sg., uncontracted (= ὁμοφρονοίης): ’you might be of like mind’, in a wish
glossary.ὄεσσι: ὄϊς — sheep; masc./fem. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic οἰσί)
glossary.ὄιες: ὄϊς (Attic οἶς) — sheep; masc./fem. nom. pl.
glossary.ὑπέλυσα: ὑπολύω — loose from beneath, untie; aor. 1 sg.: ’I released’
glossary.ὑποδείσας: ὑποδείδω — fear secretly, shrink in fear; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having taken fright’
glossary.ὑποσσείουσιν: ὑποσείω — shake from below, set spinning; pres. 3 pl., epic σσ: ’they keep spinning’
glossary.ὕπτιος: ὕπτιος — on one’s back, face up; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ὠδίνων: ὠδίνω — suffer pangs, be in pain; pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’racked with pain’
glossary.ᾤκεον: οἰκέω — dwell, inhabit; impf. 3 pl., uncontracted (= Attic ᾤκουν): ’they lived’
glossary.ᾤμωξεν: οἰμώζω — cry out in pain, wail; aor. 3 sg.
glossary.ῥαίοιτο: ῥαίω — dash to pieces, shatter; opt. 3 sg. mid./pass. (with κε): ’would be dashed’
glossary.ῥοὰς: ῥοή — stream, flow; fem. acc. pl.
glossary.αἰῶνός: αἰών — life, lifetime, life-force; masc. gen. sg., of what is taken away (with εὖνιν): ’of life’
glossary.βέλος: βέλος — missile, thing thrown; neut. acc. sg. (here a hurled rock) · also neut. nom. sg., subject: ’missile’ (βέλος Ἀντινόοιο ’the missile of Antinous’)
glossary.γλαφυρῆς: γλαφυρός — hollow, hollowed; fem. gen. sg.
glossary.δυναίμην: δύναμαι — be able; pres. opt. 1 sg. mid., in a wish (αἲ γάρ … δυναίμην ’would that I could’)
glossary.εἴρηται: εἴρομαι — ask, inquire; aor. subj. 3 sg. (epic, = Attic ἔρηται): ’he asks’
glossary.εὐρυμίδης: Εὐρυμίδης — son of Eurymus; patronymic, masc. nom. sg., epic -ης as in Attic
glossary.εὔχεαι: εὔχομαι — claim, profess, boast; pres. 2 sg. mid., epic uncontracted (= Attic εὔχῃ): ’you claim’
glossary.εὕροι: εὑρίσκω — find; aor. opt. 3 sg., in a wish: ’may he find’
glossary.εὖνιν: εὖνις — bereft, robbed (of + gen.); adj., masc. acc. sg., agreeing with σε
glossary.θέμωσε: θεμόω (from θέμις) — make so, ordain, drive; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐθέμωσε); exact sense disputed
glossary.θέσφαθ: θέσφατος — decreed by a god; neut. pl. noun, ’oracles’, elided (θέσφαθ’ = θέσφατα)
glossary.κατανεύων: κατανεύω — nod, nod down; pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’nodding’
glossary.κατεγήρα: καταγηράω — grow old; imperf. 3 sg., epic -α (= κατεγήρα, Attic -ᾱ): ’was growing old’
glossary.κατερχομένης: κατέρχομαι — come down; pres. part. mid. fem. gen. sg.: ’as it came down’
glossary.κεκοτηότι: κοτέω — bear a grudge, be angry; perf. part. act. masc. dat. sg. (epic -ηότ-, = κεκοτηκότι): ’angered’
glossary.κελαινεφέι: κελαινεφής — dark with cloud, cloud-wrapped (epithet of Zeus); masc. dat. sg. (= -εῖ)
glossary.κιχήσεσθαι: κιχάνω — reach, overtake, befall; fut. inf. mid.: ’to befall’
glossary.κοντὸν: κοντός — pole, punting-pole; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.κορυφὴν: κορυφή — peak, summit; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.κρατερῆφι: κρατερός — strong, mighty; fem. dat. sg. with epic -φι (= Attic κρατερᾷ), instrumental, with βίηφι
glossary.κρατὶ: κάρη (κράς) — head; neut. dat. sg. (stem κρατ-): ’with the head’
glossary.κρονίδῃ: Κρονίδης — son of Cronos; masc. dat. sg., epithet of Zeus
glossary.κυανοπρῴροιο: κυανόπρῳρος — dark-prowed; gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου), with νεός
glossary.κυανοχαίτης: κυανοχαίτης — dark-haired (epithet of Poseidon); masc. nom. sg. as a noun: ’the dark-haired one’
glossary.κυανοχαῖτα: κυανοχαίτης — dark-haired (epithet of Poseidon); masc. voc. sg.
glossary.κυκλώπεσσιν: Κύκλωψ — Cyclops; masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσιν (= Attic Κύκλωψι)
glossary.κώπῃς: κώπη — oar; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃς (= Attic κώπαις): ’with oars’
glossary.λᾶαν: λᾶας — stone, rock; masc. acc. sg. (Attic λίθος)
glossary.μαντευόμενος: μαντεύομαι — prophesy, divine; pres. part. mid. masc. nom. sg.: ’prophesying’
glossary.μαντοσύνῃ: μαντοσύνη — art of prophecy, seercraft; fem. dat. sg., dat. of respect: ’in prophecy’
glossary.μαρμάρῳ: μάρμαρος — rock, boulder (later ’marble’); masc. dat. sg., with ὀκριόεντι
glossary.μειλιχίοις: μειλίχιος — gentle, soothing; masc. dat. pl., with ἐπέεσσιν
glossary.νήια: νήιος — of a ship (Attic ναυτικός); neut. acc. pl.: ’ship’s (timbers)’
glossary.οἰήιον: οἰήιον — tiller, steering-oar handle (Attic οἴαξ); neut. acc. sg.
glossary.οἰκί: οἰκία — dwelling, house; neut. pl., elided (οἰκί’ = οἰκία)
glossary.οἰμώξας: οἰμώζω — wail, groan aloud; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having groaned’
glossary.πέμψαι: πέμπω — send, convey; aor. inf. act.: ’to send’ · also inf. used as an imperative: ’send (me)’ (ἕσσας με … πέμψαι)
glossary.παλαίφατα: παλαίφατος — spoken long ago; neut. pl., agreeing with θέσφατα: ’long-ago-spoken’
glossary.περιμήκεα: περιμήκης — very long; masc. acc. sg., epic uncontracted (-εα = Attic -η)
glossary.πεῖθον: πείθω — persuade; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented (= ἔπειθον): ’were persuading’ (οὐ … ’did not persuade’)
glossary.πλημυρὶς: πλημυρίς — flood-tide, swell; fem. nom. sg.: ’the surge’
glossary.ποιήσας: ποιέω — make, render; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having made (him)’
glossary.πρήσσοντες: πρήσσω — accomplish, traverse (Attic πράττω); pres. part. act. masc. nom. pl.: ’making our way over’
glossary.προπεσόντες: προπίπτω — fall forward; aor. part. act. masc. nom. pl.: ’throwing themselves forward’
glossary.πτολιπόρθιον: πτολιπόρθιος — sacker of cities (Attic πτολίπορθος); masc. acc. sg., epithet of Odysseus
glossary.πόντονδε: πόντος — sea; masc. acc. sg. + directional -δε: ’seaward, into the sea’
glossary.σχέτλι: σχέτλιος — reckless, cruel; masc. voc. sg., elided (σχέτλι’ = σχέτλιε): ’you reckless one!’
glossary.σός: σός — your, yours; possessive adj. (of σύ), masc. nom. sg.: ’yours’
glossary.σύν: σύν — with, together with; prep. + dat. · also adv. or preverb in tmesis, apart from its verb (σύν … ἄραξε ’would smash together’)
glossary.τήλεμος: Τήλεμος — Telemus, a seer; masc. nom. sg., proper name
glossary.τίπτ: τίπτε (= τί ποτε) — why ever, why then; interrog. adv., elided (τίπτ’ = τίπτε)
glossary.τίσατο: τίνω (mid. τίνομαι) — pay back, punish; aor. 3 sg. mid.: ’punished’ (Attic ἐτίσατο, unaugmented)
glossary.τυτθόν: τυτθός — small, little; neut. acc. sg. used as adv.: ’by a little’
glossary.φάσαν: φημί — say; impf. 3 pl., epic (= Attic ἔφασαν): ’they said’
glossary.φθεγξαμένου: φθέγγομαι — utter a sound, speak; aor. part. mid. masc. gen. sg., with τευ: ’of someone speaking’
glossary.χολώσατο: χολόομαι — grow angry; aor. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented (= ἐχολώσατο): ’grew angry’
glossary.ἀεικελίην: ἀεικέλιος — unseemly, shameful (Attic ἀεικής); fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀλλοτρίης: ἀλλότριος — of another, foreign, strange; fem. gen. sg.
glossary.ἀπέλεθρον: ἀπέλεθρος — immense, boundless; acc. sg. (here fem., agreeing with ἶν)
glossary.ἀπολοίατο: ἀπόλλυμι — destroy; mid. perish; aor. opt. 3 pl. mid., epic -οίατο (= -οιντο): ’they might perish’
glossary.ἀπορρήξας: ἀπορρήγνυμι — break off, tear off; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having torn off’
glossary.ἀπῆμεν: ἄπειμι — be away, be distant; impf. 1 pl., epic (= Attic ἀπῇμεν): ’we were away’
glossary.ἀστερόεντα: ἀστερόεις — starry; masc. acc. sg., with οὐρανόν
glossary.ἁμαρτήσεσθαι: ἁμαρτάνω — miss, lose (+ gen.); fut. inf. mid.: ’to lose’
glossary.ἄκικυς: ἄκικυς — feeble, powerless; masc. nom. sg., of uncertain origin
glossary.ἄραξ: ἀράσσω — strike, smash; aor. 3 sg., elided (ἄραξ’ = ἄραξε), with κεν: ’would have smashed’
glossary.ἄϊδος: Ἅιδης (Ἄϊς) — Hades; masc. gen. sg., epic Ἄϊδος (Attic Ἅιδου)
glossary.ἅζεο: ἅζομαι — fear, shrink from, revere; impf. 2 sg. mid., unaugmented, uncontracted (= ἥζου): ’you shrank (from)’
glossary.ἐδέγμην: δέχομαι — receive, await, expect; aor. (root form) 1 sg. mid., epic: ’I was expecting’
glossary.ἐδαμάσσατο: δαμάζω (δαμάω) — overpower, subdue; aor. 3 sg. mid., epic -σσ-: ’overpowered’
glossary.ἐδεύησεν: δεύω (= δέω) — lack, fall short; aor. 3 sg., epic (= Attic ἐδέησεν): ’fell short’
glossary.ἐθέλῃσ: ἐθέλω — wish, be willing; pres. subj. 3 sg., elided (ἐθέλῃσ’ = ἐθέλῃσι): ’he is willing’
glossary.ἐκέλσαμεν: κέλλω — drive a ship ashore, beach; aor. 1 pl.: ’we ran (the ship) ashore’
glossary.ἐκλύσθη: κλύζω — wash, surge, dash; aor. pass. 3 sg.: ’was dashed up’
glossary.ἐμπάζετο: ἐμπάζομαι — pay heed to, care for (+ gen.); impf. 3 sg. mid.: ’was heeding’
glossary.ἐννοσίγαιον: ἐννοσίγαιος — earth-shaker (epithet of Poseidon); masc. acc. sg. as a noun
glossary.ἐξαλαῶσαι: ἐξαλαόω — blind completely; aor. inf. act.: ’to blind’
glossary.ἐπέρεισε: ἐπερείδω — lean upon, press, put weight on; aor. 3 sg.: ’put (force) into it’
glossary.ἐπιδινήσας: ἐπιδινέω — whirl round; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having whirled’
glossary.ἐρήτυον: ἐρητύω — hold back, restrain; impf. 3 pl.: ’were holding back’
glossary.ἐρεθιζέμεν: ἐρεθίζω — provoke, rouse; pres. inf. act., epic -έμεν (= Attic -ειν): ’to provoke’
glossary.ἔβαλεν: βάλλω — throw, hurl; aor. 3 sg., ν-movable: ’threw’ (κὰδ … ἔβαλεν = κατέβαλεν ’threw down’)
glossary.ἔδμεναι: ἔδω — eat; pres. inf., epic -μεναι (= Attic ἐσθίειν): ’to eat’
glossary.ἔμελλες: μέλλω — be about to, be going to (+ inf.); impf. 2 sg.: ’you were going to’
glossary.ἔρεσσον: ἐρέσσω — row; impf. 3 pl.: ’were rowing’ · also impf. 1 sg.: ’I was rowing’ (ζωὸς ἔρεσσον ’I rowed when alive’)
glossary.ἠμείβετο: ἀμείβομαι — answer, reply; impf. 3 sg. mid.: ’answered’
glossary.ἠύς: ἠύς (ἐύς) — good, noble; masc. nom. sg., epic (Attic ἀγαθός)
glossary.ἧκ: ἵημι — send, hurl; aor. 3 sg., elided (ἧκ’ = ἧκε): ’hurled’
glossary.ἰήσεται: ἰάομαι — heal, cure; fut. 3 sg. mid.: ’will heal’
glossary.ἵησιν: ἵημι — send, throw; pres. 3 sg. (Attic ἵησι): ’sends, throws’
glossary.ἶν: ἴς — strength, force; fem. acc. sg. ἶν, elided in the text (ἶν’)
glossary.ὀδυρόμενοι: ὀδύρομαι — lament, mourn; pres. part. mid. masc. nom. pl.: ’lamenting’
glossary.ὀδυσεῦ: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus; masc. voc. sg., single-σ form (Attic Ὀδυσσεῦ)
glossary.ὀκριόεντι: ὀκριόεις — jagged, rugged; masc. dat. sg. (-εντι), with μαρμάρῳ
glossary.ὀλέσας: ὄλλυμι — destroy, lose; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having lost’
glossary.ὀλίγος: ὀλίγος — little, small, puny; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ὀρέγων: ὀρέγω — stretch out; pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’stretching out’
glossary.ὀτρύνω: ὀτρύνω — urge on, stir; pres. 1 sg. indic. or subj.: ’I urge’ / ’I may urge’, with an inf. of what is urged
glossary.ὦσα: ὠθέω — push, shove; aor. 1 sg., epic ὦσα (= Attic ἔωσα): ’I pushed (off)’
glossary.αἰδοίῃς: αἰδοῖος — revered, venerable; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃς (= Attic -αῖς)
glossary.αἰολίην: Αἰόλιος, -ίη — of Aeolus, Aeolian; fem. acc. sg., Ionic -η (= Attic -ίαν)
glossary.αἰόλου: Αἴολος — Aeolus, keeper of the winds (proper name; the common adj. αἴολος means ’quick-moving, shifting’); masc. gen. sg.
glossary.αἴολος: Αἴολος — Aeolus, keeper of the winds (proper name; the common adj. αἴολος means ’quick-moving, shifting’); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.βουλὴ: βουλή — counsel, plan; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.βυκτάων: βυκτής — roaring, blustering (of winds); sense uncertain, traditional gloss; masc. gen. pl., epic -άων (= Attic -ῶν)
glossary.γλαφυρῇ: γλαφυρός — hollow, hollowed out; fem. dat. sg.
glossary.δαίνυνται: δαίνυμι — feast, give a feast; mid. pres. 3 pl.: ’they feast’
glossary.δαινύμενον: δαίνυμι — feast; mid. pres. part. masc. acc. sg.: ’feasting’
glossary.δύναμις: δύναμις — power, ability, strength; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.εὕδουσ: εὕδω — sleep, lie asleep; pres. 3 pl., elided (εὕδουσ’ = εὕδουσι): ’they sleep’
glossary.ζεφύρου: Ζέφυρος — Zephyrus, the West Wind; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.ζωοῖσι: ζωός — alive, living (Attic ζῶν); masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις): ’the living’
glossary.ζωόντων: ζώω — live (Attic ζάω); pres. part. masc. gen. pl., uncontracted (Attic ζώντων): ’of the living’
glossary.θυέλλῃ: θύελλα — storm-blast, squall; fem. dat. sg.
glossary.κήρυκά: κῆρυξ — herald; masc. acc. sg., accented before the enclitic τ’
glossary.κακῇ: κακός — bad, evil; fem. dat. sg.
glossary.κατέδει: καταδέω — bind down, bind fast; impf. 3 sg., contracted (= κατέδεε)
glossary.κεκμηῶτα: κάμνω — grow weary, be worn out; perf. part. masc. acc. sg., epic -ηῶτα (= Attic κεκμηκότα)
glossary.κενεὰς: κενεός — empty (Attic κενός); fem. acc. pl.
glossary.κνισῆεν: κνισήεις — full of the savour of burning fat (from κνίση); neut. nom. sg., epic -ῆεν
glossary.κομιζέμεν: κομίζω — take care of, tend, take in; pres. inf., epic -έμεν (= Attic κομίζειν)
glossary.μέρμιθι: μέρμις — cord, string; fem. dat. sg.
glossary.μακάρεσσιν: μάκαρ — blessed, happy; masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσιν (= Attic μάκαρσι)
glossary.μερμήριξα: μερμηρίζω — ponder, be torn in mind; aor. 1 sg.
glossary.μετείην: μέτειμι — be among, be with (μετά + εἰμί) + dat.; pres. opt. 1 sg.: ’I should be among’
glossary.μετεφώνεον: μεταφωνέω — speak among; impf. 1 sg., uncontracted (= Attic μετεφώνουν)
glossary.μῆνα: μείς, μήν — month; masc. acc. sg., acc. of duration: ’for a month’
glossary.νίκησεν: νικάω — conquer, prevail; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐνίκησεν)
glossary.νισσόμεθα: νίσσομαι — go, go home; pres. 1 pl. mid., epic -σσ-
glossary.παραπνεύσῃ: παραπνέω — blow past, blow by; aor. subj. 3 sg.
glossary.παυέμεναι: παύω — stop, make cease, calm; pres. inf. act., epic -έμεναι (= Attic παύειν)
glossary.πεμπέμεν: πέμπω — send, escort; pres. inf., epic -έμεν (= Attic πέμπειν)
glossary.περιστεναχίζεται: περιστεναχίζω — make echo all round (περί + στεναχίζω ’groan’); rare word; pres. pass. 3 sg.
glossary.πεσὼν: πίπτω — fall; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg. (aor. stem πεσ-): ’having fallen’
glossary.πλωτῇ: πλωτός — floating, afloat (from πλέω); fem. dat. sg.
glossary.πνοιὴν: πνοιή — breath, blast, blowing; fem. acc. sg., epic (= Attic πνοή)
glossary.πυρπολέοντας: πυρπολέω — tend fires, keep a fire burning; pres. part. masc. acc. pl., uncontracted (= Attic πυρπολοῦντας)
glossary.πόδα: πούς — foot; also the sheet (the rope that sets a sail); masc. acc. sg.
glossary.σταθμοῖσιν: σταθμός — doorpost, door-jamb; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οῖς) · also steading, farm-buildings; masc. dat. pl. (ἐνὶ σταθμοῖσιν ’in the farmstead’)
glossary.τάπησι: τάπης — rug, coverlet; masc. dat. pl.
glossary.τίμιός: τίμιος — held in honour, honoured, prized; masc. nom. sg., accented before the enclitic ἐστιν
glossary.ταμίην: ταμίης — steward, dispenser (Attic ταμίας); masc. acc. sg., Ionic -ην · also ταμίη — housekeeper, fem.; fem. acc. sg.: ’the housekeeper’
glossary.τεῦχε: τεύχω — make, prepare, build; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔτευχε)
glossary.τοῖσί: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc./neut. dat. pl. ’to them, to these’, epic -οισι (= Attic -οις); accented before the enclitic τε
glossary.τῳ: τις, τι — someone, anyone; masc./neut. dat. sg. (= τινί), enclitic: ’to anyone’
glossary.υἱέες: υἱός — son; masc. nom. pl., epic (= Attic υἱεῖς)
glossary.φίλει: φιλέω — love, treat as a friend, entertain; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐφίλει)
glossary.χρυσός: χρυσός — gold; masc. nom. sg., accented before the enclitic τε
glossary.ἀκέσασθε: ἀκέομαι — heal, mend, set right; aor. imper. mid. 2 pl.
glossary.ἀκοίτις: ἄκοιτις — bedfellow, wife; fem. acc. pl., epic -ις (= ἀκοίτιας)
glossary.ἀνήνατο: ἀναίνομαι — refuse, reject; aor. 3 sg. mid., epic ἀνήνατο: ’he refused’
glossary.ἀνεφαίνετο: ἀναφαίνομαι — show up, appear, come into view; impf. 3 sg. mid.: ’was coming into view’
glossary.ἀπέχθηται: ἀπεχθάνομαι — be hateful, become hated, + dat.; aor. subj. 3 sg.: ’become hateful’
glossary.ἀπεπέμπομεν: ἀποπέμπω — send away, send off; impf. 1 pl.: ’we were sending off’
glossary.ἀπεχθόμενος: ἀπεχθάνομαι — be hateful, be hated, + dat.; pres. part. mid. masc. nom. sg.: ’being hateful’
glossary.ἀποπέμπειν: ἀποπέμπω — send away, send off; pres. inf.
glossary.ἀποφθίμην: ἀποφθίνω — perish, die; aor. opt. mid. 1 sg.: ’I should perish’
glossary.ἀφίκοιο: ἀφικνέομαι — arrive, reach; aor. opt. mid. 2 sg.: ’you might reach’
glossary.ἁρπάξασα: ἁρπάζω — snatch, seize; aor. part. act. fem. nom. sg.: ’having snatched’
glossary.ἄασάν: ἀάω — blind, delude, make go wrong in the mind (cf. ἄτη); aor. 3 pl. (ἄασαν, accent shifted before enclitic μ’): ’they blinded’
glossary.ἄγεσθαι: ἄγω — lead, carry off; pres. inf. mid.: ’to carry off for oneself’
glossary.ἄγεται: ἄγω — lead, carry off; pres. 3 sg. mid.: ’carries off for himself’
glossary.ἄρρηκτον: ἄρρηκτος — unbreakable (ἀ- + ῥήγνυμι); masc./neut. acc. sg.
glossary.ἐγρόμενος: ἐγείρω — rouse; mid. wake up; aor. part. mid. masc. nom. sg., epic syncopated ἐγρ-: ’having woken’
glossary.ἐκίχανον: κιχάνω — come upon, find, reach; impf. 1 sg. (or 3 pl.): ’I found’
glossary.ἐκδείρας: ἐκδέρω — flay, skin; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having flayed’
glossary.ἐκτελέειν: ἐκτελέω — bring to an end, accomplish; pres. inf., uncontracted epic (= Attic ἐκτελεῖν)
glossary.ἐκτελέσαντες: ἐκτελέω — accomplish, complete; aor. part. act. masc. nom. pl.: ’having completed’
glossary.ἐλέγχιστε: ἐλεγχής — shameful, disgraceful; superl. ἐλέγχιστος ’most shameful’; masc. voc. sg.
glossary.ἐννεώροιο: ἐννέωρος — nine years old, of nine seasons; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.ἐνώμων: νωμάω — handle, ply, manage; impf. 1 sg.: ’I was handling’ · also impf. 3 pl.: ’they distributed’ (σπλάγχνα ἐνώμων ’they distributed the entrails’)
glossary.ἐξερέεινεν: ἐξερεείνω — ask out, question closely; impf. 3 sg., epic
glossary.ἐρέοντο: ἐρέομαι — ask, inquire (often with ἐκ in tmesis, = ἐξερέοντο); impf. 3 pl. mid.: ’they asked’
glossary.ἐφέροντο: φέρω — bear, carry; impf. 3 pl. mid./pass.: ’were carried’
glossary.ἑζόμεθ: ἕζομαι — sit down, sit; impf. 1 pl., elided (ἑζόμεθ’ = ἑζόμεθα): ’we sat down’
glossary.ἔμεινα: μένω — stay, remain, wait; aor. 1 sg.: ’I stayed’
glossary.ἔνεστιν: ἔνειμι — be in, be within (ἐν + εἰμί); pres. 3 sg.: ’is in’
glossary.ἔρρ: ἔρρω — go away, be gone, perish; pres. imper. 2 sg., elided (ἔρρ’ = ἔρρε): ’begone!’
glossary.ἔρρε: ἔρρω — go away, be gone, perish; pres. imper. 2 sg.: ’begone!’
glossary.ἔφασαν: φημί — say; impf. 3 pl., augmented (cf. unaugmented φάσαν): ’they said’, + acc. and inf.
glossary.ἕταροί: ἑταῖρος (epic ἕταρος) — companion, comrade; masc. nom. pl., epic by-form (= ἑταῖροι); accented before an enclitic
glossary.ἡβώοντες: ἡβάω — be in the prime of youth (ἥβη); pres. part. masc. nom. pl., epic lengthening (= Attic ἡβῶντες)
glossary.ἰδώμεθα: ὁράω (aor. stem ἰδ-) — see; aor. subj. mid. 1 pl., hortative: ’let us see’
glossary.ἱκοίμεθα: ἱκνέομαι — come, arrive, reach; aor. opt. mid. 1 pl.: ’we might reach’
glossary.ἱπποτάδαο: Ἱπποτάδης — son of Hippotes (patronymic); masc. gen. sg., epic -αο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.ἱπποτάδης: Ἱπποτάδης — son of Hippotes (patronymic); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ὀνείατα: ὄνειαρ — good thing, help; pl. dainties, victuals; neut. nom. pl. · also neut. acc. pl., object of a participle: ’victuals’ (ὀνείατα μυρί’ ἔχοντες ’with countless victuals’)
glossary.ὀπασσάμενος: ὀπάζω — make follow; mid. take as attendant, take along; aor. part. mid. masc. nom. sg., epic -σσ-
glossary.ὀρνύμεν: ὄρνυμι — rouse, stir up; pres. inf. act., epic -μεν (= Attic ὀρνύναι)
glossary.ὁμὴν: ὁμός — same, common; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ὄρουσαν: ὀρούω — rush, leap, spring up; aor. 3 pl., unaugmented (= ὤρουσαν): ’they rushed’
glossary.ὅσσος: ὅσος — how great, how much; epic ὅσσος; masc. nom. sg., in an indirect question
glossary.ὅτεών: ὅστις — whoever, whatever; masc. gen. pl., Ionic/epic ὅτεων (= Attic ὧντινων): ’of whatever’
glossary.ᾔτεον: αἰτέω — ask, ask for; impf. 1 sg., uncontracted (= Attic ᾔτουν): ’I asked for’
glossary.αἰήταο: Αἰήτης — Aeetes, Circe’s brother; masc. gen. sg., epic -αο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.αἰαίην: Αἰαῖος — Aeaean, of Aea (Αἰαίη νῆσος, Circe’s island); adj., fem. acc. sg., with νῆσον
glossary.αὐτοκασιγνήτη: αὐτοκασίγνητος — own brother or sister, full sibling; fem. nom. sg., ’own sister’, in apposition to Κίρκη
glossary.βασιλεὺς: βασιλεύς — king, chief; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.βουκολέων: βουκολέω — herd cattle, tend cattle; pres. part. masc. nom. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic βουκολῶν): ’herding’
glossary.γίγασιν: Γίγας — Giant (one of a savage earth-born race); masc. dat. pl. (= Attic Γίγασι), after ἐοικότες
glossary.δήσας: δέω — bind, tie; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having tied’
glossary.δεινοῖο: δεινός — dread, terrible; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -οῦ)
glossary.δρυμὰ: δρυμός — coppice, thicket (plural δρυμά, neut.); neut. acc. pl.
glossary.εἰρεσίης: εἰρεσία — rowing; fem. gen. sg., Ionic -ης (= Attic -ας)
glossary.εἰρυσάμην: ἐρύω — draw, pull out; aor. 1 sg. mid., augment lengthened to ει-: ’I drew out’
glossary.εἰσελάων: εἰσελαύνω — drive in; pres. part. masc. nom. sg., epic -άων (= Attic εἰσελαύνων): ’driving in’
glossary.εἰσῆλθον: εἰσέρχομαι — go in, enter; aor. 3 pl., + acc.: ’they entered’
glossary.εἴασ: ἐάω — allow, let be, leave; aor. 1 sg., elided (εἴασ’ = εἴασα)
glossary.εἴσοδός: εἴσοδος — entrance, way in; fem. nom. sg. (accent from the following enclitic)
glossary.θηρίον: θηρίον — wild animal, beast; neut. nom. sg.
glossary.θυγατέρ: θυγάτηρ — daughter; dat. sg. θυγατέρι with ι elided (or acc. θυγατέρα with α elided)
glossary.κέλευθοι: κέλευθος — path, way; fem. nom. pl.
glossary.κίρκης: Κίρκη — Circe, the enchantress goddess; fem. gen. sg.
glossary.καλλιρέεθρον: καλλιρέεθρος — fair-flowing (καλλι- ’fair’ + ῥέεθρον ’stream’); adj., fem. acc. sg.
glossary.κατήιεν: κάτειμι — go down, come down; impf. 3 sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic κατῄει): ’was coming down’
glossary.καταγίνεον: καταγινέω — bring down, carry down (Ionic = κατάγω); impf. 3 pl., epic uncontracted, unaugmented: ’were bringing down’
glossary.κατακλίνας: κατακλίνω — lay down, lay flat; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having laid down’
glossary.καταλοφάδεια: καταλοφάδεια — on the neck, slung over the nape (λόφος ’nape’); adv.
glossary.κατηγαγόμεσθα: κατάγω — bring down; mid. bring one’s ship to land; aor. mid. 1 pl., epic -μεσθα (= Attic -μεθα): ’we put in’
glossary.κοίλοιο: κοῖλος — hollow; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου) · also neut. gen. sg., agreeing with σπείους: ’of the hollow cave’
glossary.κονίῃσι: κονία — dust; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι (= Attic κονίαις)
glossary.κορυφήν: κορυφή — peak, summit, top; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.κρήνην: κρήνη — spring, fountain; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.κόναβος: κόναβος — din, clatter, crash; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.κῦμά: κῦμα — wave, billow; neut. nom. sg. (accent from the following enclitic)
glossary.λάμου: Λάμος — Lamus, a Laestrygonian ruler, owner of the citadel; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.λαιστρυγονίην: Λαιστρυγόνιος — Laestrygonian; adj., fem. acc. sg., with Τηλέπυλον
glossary.λαιστρυγόνες: Λαιστρύγονες — the Laestrygonians, a savage people; masc. nom. pl. (sg. Λαιστρυγών)
glossary.λαιστρυγόνος: Λαιστρυγών — Laestrygonian; masc. gen. sg., ’the Laestrygonian’, with Ἀντιφάταο
glossary.λείην: λεῖος — smooth, level; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.λύγους: λύγος — withy, pliant twig; fem. acc. pl.
glossary.μέσα: μέσος — middle, in the middle; neut. acc. pl.
glossary.μακών: μηκάομαι — bleat, cry out (of animals); aor. part. masc. nom. sg., strong aor. ἔμακον: ’crying out’
glossary.ματίῃ: ματίη — folly, recklessness (Ionic = μάτη); fem. dat. sg., dative of cause
glossary.μισθούς: μισθός — wage, pay, hire; masc. acc. pl.
glossary.μοῦνον: μοῦνος — alone, single (epic = Attic μόνος); masc. acc. sg.: ’alone’
glossary.ναύλοχον: ναύλοχος — giving anchorage to ships, ship-sheltering (ναῦς + λόχος); adj., masc. acc. sg.
glossary.νεός: ναῦς — ship; fem. gen. sg., epic-Ionic νεός (= Attic νεώς)
glossary.νομοῦ: νομός — pasture, grazing ground; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.ξύμβληντο: συμβάλλω — throw together; mid. meet, encounter (+ dat.); aor. 3 pl. mid., unaugmented, ξύμ- for συμ-: ’they met’
glossary.πέρσης: Πέρση — Perse, an Oceanid, mother of Circe; fem. gen. sg., Ionic -ης
glossary.πέτρας: πέτρα — rock, crag, cliff; fem. acc. pl.
glossary.παιπαλόεσσαν: παιπαλόεις — rugged, rocky (epic epithet of heights); fem. acc. sg.
glossary.παρασταδὸν: παρασταδόν — standing beside, at one’s side; adv. (from παρίστημι)
glossary.παριστάμενοι: παρίσταμαι — stand beside, stand by; pres. part. mid. masc. nom. pl.: ’standing by’
glossary.πείροντες: πείρω — pierce, run through, spit; pres. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’piercing’
glossary.πείσματ: πεῖσμα — ship’s cable, mooring rope; neut. acc. pl., elided (πείσματ’ = πείσματα)
glossary.πελώρου: πέλωρος — monstrous, huge; as noun πέλωρον ’monster’; neut. gen. sg.
glossary.περιωπήν: περιωπή — lookout, vantage-point; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.πεῖσμα: πεῖσμα — ship’s cable, rope; neut. acc. sg.
glossary.πιόμενος: πίνω — drink; fut. part. mid. masc. nom. sg., of purpose: ’to drink’
glossary.πλεξάμενος: πλέκω — plait, twist; aor. part. mid. masc. nom. sg.: ’having plaited’
glossary.πλῆξα: πλήσσω — strike, smite; aor. 1 sg., unaugmented (= ἔπληξα): ’I struck’
glossary.πομπή: πομπή — escort, sending home, conveyance; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ποταμόνδε: ποταμός — river; acc. + -δε of motion toward (= ποταμὸν δέ): ’to the river’; adv.
glossary.προέμεν: προΐημι — send forth; aor. inf., epic -έμεν (= Attic προεῖναι)
glossary.προσεφώνεον: προσφωνέω — speak to, address; impf. 3 pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic προσεφώνουν)
glossary.προύχουσιν: προέχω — jut out, project; pres. 3 pl., προ- + ἔχω with crasis προύχ-
glossary.πυκνὰ: πυκνός — thick, dense; neut. acc. pl. · also neut. acc. pl. used adverbially: ’thickly, closely’ (πυκνὰ ῥωγαλέην ’thickly ragged’)
glossary.σπασάμην: σπάω — draw, pull, pluck; aor. 1 sg. mid., unaugmented (= ἐσπασάμην): ’I pulled up’
glossary.στόματι: στόμα — mouth; entrance (of a harbour); neut. dat. sg.
glossary.συνέδησα: συνδέω — bind together, tie up; aor. 1 sg.: ’I bound together’
glossary.σχέθον: ἔχω — hold, keep; aor. 1 sg., epic σχέθον (= ἔσχον): ’I held’
glossary.τείρετο: τείρω — wear out, distress; impf. pass. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐτείρετο): ’was worn down’
glossary.τετύχηκε: τυγχάνω — happen, chance to be; turn out to be; perf. 3 sg.: ’has come to be’
glossary.τηλέπυλον: Τηλέπυλος — Telepylus, city of the Laestrygonians (name perhaps ’far-gated’, τῆλε + πύλη); fem. acc. sg.
glossary.φέρεσκον: φέρω — carry, bear; impf. 3 pl., iterative -σκ-, unaugmented (= ἔφερον): ’used to carry’
glossary.φέροντο: φέρω — carry; mid. carry off for oneself; impf. 3 pl. mid., unaugmented (= ἐφέροντο): ’carried off’
glossary.φαεσιμβρότου: φαεσίμβροτος — light-giving to mortals (φάος + βροτός); adj., masc. gen. sg., epic gen. in -ου, with Ἠελίοιο
glossary.φοίτων: φοιτάω — go to and fro, come repeatedly; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented, uncontracted (= Attic ἐφοίτων): ’were coming’
glossary.φυγῇ: φυγή — flight; fem. dat. sg., dative of manner: ’in flight’
glossary.φύγε: φεύγω — flee, escape; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔφυγε); + acc.: ’fled from’
glossary.χερμαδίοισιν: χερμάδιον — stone (a hand-sized throwing stone); neut. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις)
glossary.ἀίξαντε: ἀΐσσω — dart, rush; aor. part. masc. nom. dual: ’darting (the two)’
glossary.ἀίσσοντα: ἀΐσσω — dart, rush, shoot up; pres. part. masc. acc. sg.: ’darting up’
glossary.ἀγνυμενάων: ἄγνυμι — break; pass. be broken; pres. part. pass. fem. gen. pl., epic -άων (= Attic -ῶν): ’being broken’
glossary.ἀγορῆς: ἀγορή — assembly, place of assembly; fem. gen. sg.
glossary.ἀνέγειρα: ἀνεγείρω — rouse, wake up; aor. 1 sg.: ’I roused’
glossary.ἀνέρριψαν: ἀναρρίπτω — throw up, toss up; aor. 3 pl., ῥ doubled after the augment
glossary.ἀνήιον: ἄνειμι — go up; impf. 1 sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἀνῄειν): ’I went up’ · also impf. 3 pl.: ’they went up’ (παρὰ νηὸς ἀνήιον)
glossary.ἀνδραχθέσι: ἀνδράχθης — heavy as a man can lift, man-burdening (ἀνήρ + ἄχθος); adj., neut. dat. pl., epic -σι
glossary.ἀνελθών: ἀνέρχομαι — go up, come up; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having gone up’
glossary.ἀντικρὺ: ἀντικρύ — straight through, right through; adv. (epic, = ἀντικρύς)
glossary.ἀντιφάταο: Ἀντιφάτης — Antiphates, king of the Laestrygonians; masc. gen. sg., epic -αο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.ἀντιφατῆα: Ἀντιφάτης — Antiphates; masc. acc. sg., epic -ῆα (= Attic -ην)
glossary.ἀπέπεμπε: ἀποπέμπω — send away, send off; impf. 3 sg.
glossary.ἀραιὴ: ἀραιός — thin, narrow; fem. nom. sg., predicate
glossary.ἀρτακίην: Ἀρτακίη — Artacia, the name of a spring; fem. acc. sg., in apposition to κρήνην
glossary.ἀτερπέα: ἀτερπής — joyless, unpleasant; adj., fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἄκνηστιν: ἄκνηστις — spine, backbone; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἄνδρεσσιν: ἀνήρ — man; masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσιν (= Attic ἀνδράσι)
glossary.ἄργυφα: ἄργυφος — silver-white, gleaming white; neut. acc. pl.
glossary.ἄστυδ: ἄστυ — town, city; acc. sg. + -δε of motion toward, elided (ἄστυδ’ = ἄστυδε): ’to the town’
glossary.ἄυπνος: ἄυπνος — sleepless, wakeful; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἐκβάντες: ἐκβαίνω — step out, disembark; aor. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’having disembarked’
glossary.ἐκγεγάτην: ἐκγίγνομαι — be born of, spring from; perf. 3 dual, epic short stem γεγα- (= Attic ἐκγεγόνατον): ’the two were born’
glossary.ἐμβαίνων: ἐμβαίνω — step on, step upon (+ dat.); pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’stepping on’
glossary.ἐναντίαι: ἐναντίος — facing, opposite (+ dat.); fem. nom. pl.
glossary.ἐνοπήν: ἐνοπή — voice, cry, sound; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἐντός: ἐντός — within, inside; adv., or prep. + gen.
glossary.ἐξήρατο: ἐξαίρω — take out; mid. take for oneself, win, earn; aor. 3 sg. mid.
glossary.ἐξελάων: ἐξελαύνω — drive out; pres. part. masc. nom. sg., epic -άων (= Attic ἐξελαύνων): ’driving out’
glossary.ἐξεπέρησε: ἐκπεράω — pass right through, pass out through; aor. 3 sg., epic -ησε (= Attic ἐξεπέρασε)
glossary.ἐπέφραδεν: φράζω — point out, show, tell; reduplicated aor. 3 sg. ἐπέφραδε with ν-movable: ’pointed out’
glossary.ἐπηρεφέας: ἐπηρεφής — overhanging, beetling; adj., fem. acc. pl.
glossary.ἐρειδόμενος: ἐρείδω — prop, support; mid. lean (on, + dat.); pres. part. mid. masc. nom. sg.: ’leaning’
glossary.ἐυστρεφὲς: ἐϋστρεφής — well-twisted, well-twined; neut. acc. sg.
glossary.ἑβδομάτῃ: ἑβδόματος — seventh (epic = Attic ἕβδομος); fem. dat. sg., dat. of time, ἡμέρῃ understood: ’on the seventh (day)’
glossary.ἑξῆμαρ: ἑξῆμαρ — for six days (ἕξ ’six’ + ἦμαρ ’day’); adv.
glossary.ἔκοψα: κόπτω — cut, strike; aor. 1 sg.: ’I cut’
glossary.ἔπεσ: πίπτω — fall; aor. 3 sg., elided (ἔπεσ’ = ἔπεσε): ’fell’
glossary.ἔπτατο: πέτομαι — fly; aor. 3 sg. mid., epic (= Attic ἐπτάτο): ’flew’
glossary.ἔστην: ἵστημι — set up; intrans. stand; aor. 1 sg. ἔστην (root aorist): ’I stood’
glossary.ἔστυγον: στυγέω — hate, loathe, shrink from; aor. 3 pl.: ’they loathed’
glossary.ἠλίβατος: ἠλίβατος — towering, steep, sheer (sense of the epic word uncertain); fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἠπύει: ἠπύω — call out, cry aloud, hail; pres. 3 sg.
glossary.ἤματός: ἦμαρ — day; neut. gen. sg., epic ἤματος (accent from the following enclitic)
glossary.ἴφθιμοι: ἴφθιμος — mighty, stout, doughty; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ὀλλυμένων: ὄλλυμι — destroy; mid. perish; pres. part. mid. masc. gen. pl.: ’perishing’
glossary.ὄλεκον: ὀλέκω — destroy, kill (epic by-form; Attic ἀπόλλυμι); impf. 3 pl., unaugmented: ’were killing’
glossary.ὅσην: ὅσος — as great as, as much as; fem. acc. sg., of size: ’as large as’
glossary.ὑδρευούσῃ: ὑδρεύω — draw water, fetch water; pres. part. fem. dat. sg.: ’drawing water’
glossary.ὑπακούει: ὑπακούω — answer, listen and reply; pres. 3 sg.: ’answers’
glossary.ὑψίκερων: ὑψίκερως — high-horned, with lofty antlers; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ῥῶπάς: ῥώψ — twig, bush, brushwood; acc. pl.
glossary.αἰνὰ: αἰνός — dread, terrible; neut. acc. pl.
glossary.βάλανόν: βάλανος — acorn, mast (nut-like fruit of the oak); fem. acc. sg.
glossary.βήσσῃσι: βῆσσα — glen, wooded valley; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι (= Attic -αις)
glossary.βαλόμην: βάλλω — throw, put; aor. mid. 1 sg. (περὶ … βαλόμην = περιεβαλόμην): ’I slung round myself, put on’
glossary.βεβολημένος: βάλλω — strike, hit; perf. pass. part. masc. nom. sg., epic (= Attic βεβλημένος): ’struck (with grief)’
glossary.βρώμης: βρῶμη — food, eating; fem. gen. sg.
glossary.βρῶσίς: βρῶσις — food, eating; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.γοόωντας: γοάω — wail, lament; pres. part. masc. acc. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic γοῶντας)
glossary.δάπεδον: δάπεδον — floor, ground; neut. nom. sg.
glossary.δαίτηθεν: δαίς — feast, with suffix -θεν ’from’; adv. δαίτηθεν ’from the feast’
glossary.δρυμά: δρυμός — coppice, thicket (plural δρυμά, neut.); neut. acc. pl.
glossary.δόμους: δόμος — house, hall; masc. acc. pl.: ’halls’ (plural for one dwelling)
glossary.δύνατο: δύναμαι — be able, can; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐδύνατο)
glossary.εἰσαγαγοῦσα: εἰσάγω — lead in, bring in; aor. 2 part. fem. nom. sg.: ’having led in’
glossary.εἶδον: ὁράω — see; aor. 1 sg. (εἶδον ’I saw’) · also aor. 3 pl. (the form serves both persons): ’they saw’
glossary.εὐρυλόχοιο: Εὐρύλοχος — Eurylochus, a companion of Odysseus; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.εὐρύλοχ: Εὐρύλοχος — Eurylochus, a companion of Odysseus; masc. voc. sg., elided (Εὐρύλοχ’ = Εὐρύλοχε)
glossary.εὐρύλοχος: Εὐρύλοχος — Eurylochus, a companion of Odysseus; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ζόφος: ζόφος — gloom, darkness; the dark quarter of the sky, the west (opposed to ἠώς); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.θηήσαντ: θηέομαι — gaze at, behold (Attic θεάομαι); aor. mid. 3 pl., elided (θηήσαντ’ = θηήσαντο)
glossary.κάλει: καλέω — call, summon; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐκάλει)
glossary.κέκλυτέ: κλύω — hear, listen to; reduplicated aor. imper. 2 pl., + gen.: ’hear (me)’
glossary.κήδιστος: κήδιστος — dearest, most closely tied (superlative from κῆδος ’care, bond’); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.καλεῦντες: καλέω — call, summon; pres. part. masc. nom. pl., epic by-form of καλέοντες (= Attic καλοῦντες)
glossary.καλλιπλοκάμοιο: καλλιπλόκαμος — with beautiful locks, fair-plaited (κάλλος + πλόκαμος ’lock’); fem. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.καλυψάμενοι: καλύπτω — cover; aor. mid. part. masc. nom. pl., in tmesis with ἐκ (ἐκ … καλυψάμενοι): ’uncovering themselves’
glossary.κατέθελξεν: κατθέλγω (καταθέλγω) — bewitch, charm; aor. 3 sg., augmented, with movable ν
glossary.καταδυσόμεθ: καταδύω — go down; fut. mid. 1 pl., elided (καταδυσόμεθ’ = καταδυσόμεθα): ’we shall go down’
glossary.κεδνότατός: κεδνός — careful, trusty, dear; superlative κεδνότατος, masc. nom. sg.: ’most trusty’
glossary.κεῖσ: κεῖσε — thither, to that place; adv., elided (κεῖσ’ = κεῖσε)
glossary.κλήρους: κλῆρος — lot (a marked token drawn or shaken to decide); masc. acc. pl.
glossary.κλῆρος: κλῆρος — lot (a marked token drawn or shaken to decide); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.κρανείης: κρανείη — cornel-tree; fem. gen. sg., Ionic -ης: ’of the cornel’ (its fruit)
glossary.κρατερώνυχες: κρατερώνυξ — strong-clawed (κρατερός + ὄνυξ ’claw, hoof’); masc. nom. pl.
glossary.κρατερὴ: κρατερός — strong, mighty, harsh; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.κυνέῃ: κυνέη — helmet, cap (properly of dog-skin); fem. dat. sg.
glossary.κύκλωπός: Κύκλωψ — Cyclops, one of the one-eyed giants; masc. gen. sg. (Κύκλωπος)
glossary.λαθοίατο: λανθάνομαι (λήθομαι) — forget, + gen.; aor. mid. opt. 3 pl., epic -οίατο (= Attic -οιντο): ’might forget’
glossary.λιγέως: λιγύς — clear-toned, clear-voiced; adv. λιγέως: ’clearly, in a ringing voice’
glossary.λιμῷ: λιμός — hunger, famine; masc. dat. sg., instrumental: ’by hunger’
glossary.λύγρ: λυγρός — grievous, baneful; neut. acc. pl., elided (λύγρ’ = λυγρά)
glossary.μακρῇσι: μακρός — long; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι (= Attic -αις)
glossary.μειλίγματα: μείλιγμα — soothing thing, appeasement (from μειλίσσω ’soothe’); neut. acc. pl.
glossary.μνησαμένοις: μιμνήσκομαι — remember, + gen.; aor. mid. part. masc. dat. pl.: ’(to them) remembering’
glossary.μνησόμεθα: μιμνήσκομαι — remember, think of, + gen.; aor. subj. mid. 1 pl., short-vowel, hortatory (= μνησώμεθα): ’let us think of’
glossary.μυρομένοισιν: μύρομαι — weep, lament; pres. part. mid. masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις)
glossary.μόρσιμον: μόρσιμος — destined, fated, allotted (Attic μόρσιμος/μόριμος); neut. acc. sg.
glossary.νιψάμενοι: νίζω (νίπτω) — wash; aor. mid. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’having washed (their hands)’
glossary.νοῦς: νόος (contracted νοῦς) — mind, intelligence; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ξεστοῖσιν: ξεστός — smoothed, polished (from ξέω ’scrape, smooth’); masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις)
glossary.οὐρῇσιν: οὐρά — tail; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσιν (= Attic -αῖς), instrumental
glossary.πάλλομεν: πάλλω — shake, brandish; impf. 1 pl., unaugmented (= ἐπάλλομεν)
glossary.πάσχοντες: πάσχω — suffer, experience; pres. part. masc. nom. pl.
glossary.πέλωρα: πέλωρον (πέλωρ) — monster, monstrous thing; neut. acc. pl.
glossary.πίθοντο: πείθομαι — obey, be persuaded, + dat.; aor. mid. 3 pl., unaugmented (= ἐπίθοντο)
glossary.πίμπλαντο: πίμπλημι — fill; impf. pass. 3 pl., unaugmented (= ἐπίμπλαντο): ’were filled’
glossary.πεπληγυῖα: πλήσσω — strike; perf. act. part. fem. nom. sg., with aorist sense: ’having struck’
glossary.περισσαίνοντες: περισαίνω — fawn round, wag the tail around; pres. part. masc. nom. pl. (doubled σ, epic)
glossary.πολίτης: Πολίτης — Polites, a companion of Odysseus (the common noun πολίτης is ’citizen’); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.πραμνείῳ: Πράμνειος — Pramnian, a kind of wine (origin and sense uncertain); masc. dat. sg.
glossary.σίτῳ: σῖτος — grain, food; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.σαίνωσ: σαίνω — fawn on, wag the tail at; pres. subj. 3 pl., elided (σαίνωσ’ = σαίνωσι), in a general clause
glossary.σαῖνον: σαίνω — fawn on, wag the tail at; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented (= ἔσαινον)
glossary.συφεοῖσιν: συφεός — pigsty; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οῖς)
glossary.σύες: σῦς (ὗς) — swine, pig; masc./fem. nom. pl.
glossary.σῶν: σός — your, yours; masc. gen. pl. (agreeing with ἑτάρων)
glossary.τεύχοντ: τεύχω — make, prepare; impf. mid. 3 pl., elided (τεύχοντ’ = τεύχοντο): ’they prepared (for themselves)’
glossary.τοίσδεσι: ὅδε, ἥδε, τόδε — this (here); demonstrative pron., masc. dat. pl., extended epic form (= Attic τοῖσδε)
glossary.τρυχώμεθα: τρύχω — wear out, exhaust; pres. pass. subj. 1 pl., in a prohibition (μηδὲ τρυχώμεθα): ’let us not be worn down’
glossary.φαίδιμ: φαίδιμος — gleaming, glorious (epic epithet of heroes); masc. voc. sg., elided (φαίδιμ’ = φαίδιμε)
glossary.φαεινὰς: φαεινός — shining, bright; fem. acc. pl.
glossary.φαεσίμβροτος: φαεσίμβροτος — giving light to mortals (φάος ’light’ + βροτός); masc. nom. sg., epithet of the sun
glossary.φεύγωμεν: φεύγω — flee; pres. subj. 1 pl., hortatory: ’let us flee’
glossary.φθέγγοντο: φθέγγομαι — utter a sound, call out; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented (= ἐφθέγγοντο)
glossary.φθεγγώμεθα: φθέγγομαι — utter a sound, call out; pres. subj. 1 pl., hortatory: ’let us call out’
glossary.φραζώμεθα: φράζω — consider, devise; pres. subj. mid. 1 pl., hortatory: ’let us consider’
glossary.φωνήν: φωνή — voice, sound; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.χέοντες: χέω — pour, shed; pres. part. masc. nom. pl.
glossary.χαλκήρεϊ: χαλκήρης — fitted with bronze (χαλκός + ἀραρίσκω ’fit’); fem. dat. sg., epic -εϊ (= Attic -ει)
glossary.χαμαιευνάδες: χαμαιευνάς — sleeping on the ground (χαμαί + εὐνή ’bed’); fem. nom. pl., agreeing with σύες
glossary.ἀγασσάμεθ: ἀγάομαι (ἄγαμαι) — wonder at, be astonished; aor. mid. 1 pl., elided (ἀγασσάμεθ’ = ἀγασσάμεθα), doubled σ
glossary.ἀειδούσης: ἀείδω — sing; pres. part. fem. gen. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic ᾄδουσα)
glossary.ἀιδρείῃσιν: ἀιδρείη — ignorance, want of knowledge (ἀ- + ἴδμεν); fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσιν (= Attic -αις): ’in ignorance’
glossary.ἀιστώθησαν: ἀιστόω — make unseen, annihilate; aor. pass. 3 pl.: ’vanished, were made to disappear’
glossary.ἀλύξαιμεν: ἀλύσκω — escape, avoid; aor. opt. 1 pl.: ’we might escape’ (with κεν, potential)
glossary.ἀμφιμέμυκεν: ἀμφιμυκάομαι — resound, echo all round (μυκάομαι ’low, bellow’); perf. 3 sg. with present sense; the exact formation is rare
glossary.ἀνάγκη: ἀνάγκη — necessity, constraint; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀνέμισγε: ἀναμίσγω — mix in, blend; impf. 3 sg. (ἀνέμισγε, with ἀνά as preverb): ’mixed in’
glossary.ἀνδροφάγοιο: ἀνδροφάγος — man-eating (ἀνήρ + φαγεῖν); masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.ἀνελθὼν: ἀνέρχομαι — go up, climb; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having gone up’
glossary.ἀννεῖται: ἀννέομαι (ἀνα-νέομαι) — go back up, rise again; pres. 3 sg., contracted, of the sun
glossary.ἀοιδιάει: ἀοιδιάω — sing, be singing (from ἀοιδή); pres. 3 sg.
glossary.ἀπείριτος: ἀπείριτος — limitless, boundless (ἀ- + πεῖραρ ’limit’); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀχνύμενοί: ἄχνυμαι — grieve, be distressed; pres. part. mid. masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἄειδεν: ἀείδω — sing; impf. 3 sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic ᾖδε(ν))
glossary.ἄκουον: ἀκούω — hear; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented (= ἤκουον) · also impf. 1 sg., unaugmented (= ἤκουον): ’I used to hear’
glossary.ἄκυλον: ἄκυλος — acorn of the ilex (holm-oak), eaten by swine; acc. sg.
glossary.ἄξεις: ἄγω — lead, bring; fut. 2 sg.: ’you will bring’
glossary.ἅπαν: ἅπας — all, the whole; neut. nom. sg. (δάπεδον ἅπαν ’the whole floor’)
glossary.ἐέργνυ: ἐέργνυμι (εἴργνυμι) — shut in, pen; impf. 3 sg., epic form, in tmesis with κατά: ’shut up’
glossary.ἐέρχατο: ἐέργω (εἴργω) — shut in; plupf. pass. 3 pl., epic -ατο (= Attic εἴργμην-type): ’were shut in’
glossary.ἐγίγνετο: γίγνομαι — become, come about, come to be; impf. 3 sg.
glossary.ἐκφάσθαι: ἐκφημί — speak out, utter; mid. inf. ἐκφάσθαι (= ἐκφάναι), with active sense
glossary.ἐκύκα: κυκάω — stir, mix; impf. 3 sg. (ἐν … ἐκύκα in tmesis: ’stirred in’)
glossary.ἐλλίσσετο: λίσσομαι — entreat, beg; impf. 3 sg., epic doubled λ (= ἐλίσσετο)
glossary.ἐξελθοῦσα: ἐξέρχομαι — go out, come out; aor. part. fem. nom. sg.: ’having come out’
glossary.ἐξερέοντες: ἐξερέομαι — question closely, inquire; pres. part. masc. nom. pl., epic uncontracted
glossary.ἐξεφάνη: ἐκφαίνω — show forth; aor. pass. 3 sg., intransitive: ’appeared, came into view’
glossary.ἐποιχομένης: ἐποίχομαι — go to and fro at, ply (a loom); pres. part. mid. fem. gen. sg.
glossary.ἐρέων: ἐρέω (fut. of ἀγορεύω, εἶπον) — will say, tell; fut. part. masc. nom. sg., of purpose: ’to tell’ · also ἐρέω (a different verb, = ἐρωτάω) — ask, inquire after; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: τὰς ἐρέων ’asking after them’
glossary.ἐσκοπίαζον: σκοπιάζω — keep watch, look out (σκοπιή ’lookout’); impf. 1 sg.
glossary.ἐστεφάνωται: στεφανόω — wreathe, encircle (στέφανος ’crown’); perf. pass. 3 sg.: ’is wreathed round’
glossary.ἔδεισαν: δείδω — fear; aor. 3 pl.: ’they were afraid’
glossary.ἔδρακον: δέρκομαι — see, look; aor. 1 sg., augmented: ’I saw’
glossary.ἔθορε: θρῴσκω — leap, spring; aor. 3 sg. (ἔθορε, Attic ἔθορεν): ’leapt out’
glossary.ἔκπιον: ἐκπίνω — drink up, drain; aor. 3 pl. (ἔκ … πιον): ’they drank down’ · also aor. 1 sg. (same form): ’I drank down’
glossary.ἔπλετ: πέλομαι — be, come to be; aor. 3 sg., elided (ἔπλετ’ = ἔπλετο): ’has come to be’
glossary.ἔσθων: ἐσθίω — eat; pres. part. masc. nom. sg., epic (ἔσθω)
glossary.ἠρίθμεον: ἀριθμέω — count; impf. 1 sg., epic uncontracted (= ἠρίθμουν)
glossary.ἡγήσασθαι: ἡγέομαι — lead the way, guide; aor. inf. mid.: ’to lead’
glossary.ἤιομεν: εἶμι — go; impf. 1 pl., epic ἤιον (= Attic ᾖμεν, ᾔειμεν): ’we went’
glossary.ἦρχον: ἄρχω — lead, rule, + gen.; impf. 1 sg.: ’I led’
glossary.ὀλοφυρόμενος: ὀλοφύρομαι — lament, wail; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ὀρέστεροι: ὀρέστερος — of the mountains, mountain-dwelling (ὄρος); masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ὄπασσα: ὀπάζω — give as attendant, grant; aor. 1 sg., doubled σ, unaugmented (= ὤπασα)
glossary.ὑπέμεινα: ὑπομένω — stay behind, wait; aor. 1 sg.
glossary.ὑπέμεινεν: ὑπομένω — stay behind, wait; aor. 3 sg.
glossary.ὠίετο: ὀΐομαι — think, suppose, expect, forebode; impf. 3 sg. (= ᾤετο)
glossary.ὡρμήθησαν: ὁρμάω — set in motion; pass. rush, set out; aor. pass. 3 pl., intransitive: ’they rushed’
glossary.ὤιξε: ἀνοίγνυμι — open; aor. 3 sg., epic ὤιξε (= Attic ἀνέῳξε)
glossary.ῥάβδῳ: ῥάβδος — rod, wand; fem. dat. sg., instrumental
glossary.βήσσας: βῆσσα — glen, wooded valley; fem. acc. pl., with ἀνά ’up along’
glossary.βαλέει: βάλλω — throw, put; fut. 3 sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic βαλεῖ): ’will cast’
glossary.γάλακτι: γάλα — milk; neut. dat. sg. (stem γαλακτ-), with εἴκελον: ’like milk’
glossary.γυμνωθέντα: γυμνόω — strip bare, make naked; aor. pass. part. masc. acc. sg.: ’stripped, left bare’
glossary.δέπαι: δέπας — cup, goblet; neut. dat. sg., epic δέπαϊ (= Attic δέπᾳ): ’in a cup’
glossary.δήνεα: δῆνος — plan, wile, counsel (used only in the plural, epic and poetic); neut. acc. pl.
glossary.δαιδαλέου: δαιδάλεος — skilfully wrought, cunningly made; masc. gen. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic δαιδαλοῦ)
glossary.δολοφρονέουσα: δολοφρονέω — plot craftily, think guile; pres. part. fem. nom. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic δολοφρονοῦσα)
glossary.δρήστειραι: δρήστειρα — female servant, handmaid, worker; fem. nom. pl.
glossary.δύστηνε: δύστηνος — unhappy, wretched, ill-fated; masc. voc. sg.: ’poor wretch’
glossary.εἴκελον: εἴκελος — like, resembling (+ dat.); epic (= Attic ἐοικώς, ὅμοιος); neut. nom. sg.
glossary.ζέσσεν: ζέω — boil, seethe; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented, double σσ metrical, movable ν (= Attic ἔζεσε(ν)): ’boiled’, intransitive
glossary.θέλξαι: θέλγω — charm, bewitch, enchant; aor. inf. act.: ’to enchant’
glossary.θέο: τίθημι — put, place; aor. imper. mid. 2 sg., epic (= Attic θοῦ): ’put (away)’
glossary.θήῃ: τίθημι — put, make; aor. subj. 3 sg., epic -ῃ- (= Attic θῇ): ’may make (one) so-and-so’
glossary.θήῃς: τίθημι — put, make; aor. subj. 2 sg., epic -ῃ- (= Attic θῇς): ’you may make (me) so-and-so’
glossary.θαῦμά: θαῦμα — wonder, amazement, marvel; neut. nom. sg., accented before an enclitic
glossary.θρόνοις: θρόνος — chair, seat; masc. dat. pl.: ’on the chairs’
glossary.θρόνων: θρόνος — chair, seat; masc. gen. pl., with προπάροιθε: ’in front of the chairs’
glossary.θυμῆρες: θυμήρης — heart-pleasing, agreeable; neut. acc. sg., agreeing with an understood ὕδωρ, or adverbial: ’to one’s heart’s liking’
glossary.κάματον: κάματος — toil, weariness, fatigue; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.κάνεια: κάνεον — basket (of reed, for bread); neut. acc. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic κανᾶ)
glossary.κέλεσθαί: κέλομαι — bid, command, urge; pres. inf. mid., accented before an enclitic, standing for an imperative: ’bid (her)!’
glossary.κίρκῃ: Κίρκη — Circe, the enchantress goddess; fem. dat. sg., with ἐπαῖξαι/ἐπήιξα ’rush at’
glossary.καθύπερθ: καθύπερθε(ν) — above, on top; adv., elided (καθύπερθ’ = καθύπερθε)
glossary.καλέουσι: καλέω — call, name; pres. 3 pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic καλοῦσι)
glossary.καλοῦ: καλός — beautiful, fair, fine; masc. gen. sg., agreeing with θρόνου: ’of the fine (chair)’
glossary.κελήσεται: κέλομαι — bid, command, urge; fut. 3 sg. mid. (Attic would use κελεύσει), with inf.: ’will bid’
glossary.κεράσασα: κεράννυμι — mix, blend (wine with water, hot with cold); aor. part. fem. nom. sg.: ’having mixed’
glossary.κευθμῶνας: κευθμών — hiding-place, den, pen; masc. acc. pl.: ’pens, sties’ · also ’hiding-places, recesses’ of a cave (μαιομένη κευθμῶνας ἀνὰ σπέος ’searching out the recesses’)
glossary.κολεῷ: κολεόν (κολεός) — sheath, scabbard (Attic κουλεός); dat. sg.: ’in the sheath’
glossary.κομίσσῃ: κομίζω — tend, convey safely, bring home; aor. subj. 3 sg., epic σσ (= Attic κομίσῃ): ’may care for’
glossary.κρατός: κάρη — head; gen. sg. κρατός, from the by-form κράς; with κατά + gen.: ’down from the head’
glossary.κρηνέων: κρήνη — spring, fountain; fem. gen. pl., epic -έων (= Attic κρηνῶν)
glossary.κτάμεναι: κτείνω — kill, slay; aor. inf., epic -μεναι (= Attic κτεῖναι)
glossary.κυκεῶ: κυκεών — mixed drink, posset (barley, cheese, wine, honey); masc. acc. sg. κυκεῶ, epic contracted (= Attic κυκεῶνα)
glossary.λέξο: λέγομαι — lay oneself down, lie down; aor. imper. mid. 2 sg., epic (= Attic λέξαι): ’lie down!’
glossary.λυσόμενος: λύω — loose, release; mid. ’free for oneself, ransom’; fut. part. mid. masc. nom. sg., of purpose: ’to free’
glossary.λό: λούω — wash, bathe; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented, elided (λό’ = λόε, = Attic ἔλου): ’washed’
glossary.λύσῃ: λύω — loose, release, free; aor. subj. 3 sg., after ὄφρα κε: ’may set free’
glossary.λῖθ: λῖτα — linen cloth, fine linen; neut. acc. pl., elided and aspirated before a rough breathing (λῖθ’ = λῖτα)
glossary.μενέεις: μένω — stay, remain, wait; fut. 2 sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic μενεῖς)
glossary.μηκέτ: μηκέτι — no longer, no more; adv., elided (μηκέτ’ = μηκέτι)
glossary.μιγέντε: μίγνυμι — mix, mingle; aor. pass. part. masc. nom. dual: ’having mingled, we two’
glossary.μῶλυ: μῶλυ — moly, a magic herb the gods name, a Homeric word of unknown meaning with no Attic equivalent; neut. acc. sg. (indeclinable)
glossary.νέμε: νέμω — deal out, distribute, hand round; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= Attic ἔνεμε)
glossary.νεηνίῃ: νεηνίης — young man, youth; masc. dat. sg., epic (= Attic νεανίᾳ)
glossary.νοστήσειν: νοστέω — return home; fut. inf.: ’will return home’
glossary.οἵδ: ὅδε, ἥδε, τόδε — this, this here; demonstrative pron., masc. nom. pl., elided (οἵδ’ = οἵδε): ’these here’
glossary.πίοιμι: πίνω — drink; aor. opt. 1 sg., after ὄφρα: ’so that I might drink’
glossary.πίῃ: πίνω — drink; aor. subj. 3 sg., after ὅς κε: ’whoever drinks’
glossary.πεποίθομεν: πείθω — persuade; perf. πέποιθα ’trust’; perf. subj. 1 pl., epic short-vowel (= Attic πεποίθωμεν): ’may trust’
glossary.περιμήκεϊ: περιμήκης — very long; fem. dat. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic περιμήκει)
glossary.πιὼν: πίνω — drink; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having drunk’
glossary.πολυφαρμάκου: πολυφάρμακος — skilled in many drugs, of many drugs; fem. gen. sg. (two-ending adj.)
glossary.πολύτροπος: πολύτροπος — of many turns, versatile (or ’much-travelled’; the sense is disputed); masc. nom. sg., epithet of Odysseus
glossary.πορφύρεα: πορφύρεος — purple, dark red; neut. acc. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic πορφυρᾶ)
glossary.προρέουσι: προρρέω — flow forth, run on; pres. 3 pl. (Homeric spelling προρέουσι, Attic προρρέουσι)
glossary.πυκινοὺς: πυκινός — thick, close-set, stout; masc. acc. pl., epic (= Attic πυκνούς)
glossary.σαώσω: σαόω — save, keep safe; fut. 1 sg., epic (= Attic σώσω)
glossary.συφεόνδε: συφεός — pigsty; acc. sg. + suffix -δε ’to’; adv. συφεόνδε: ’to the sty’
glossary.τέως: τέως — meanwhile, for a while; adv., often with μέν
glossary.ταί: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); fem. nom. pl., epic (= Attic αἱ): ’they’ · also relative, fem. nom. pl.: ’which’ (ταί τ’ ἀμβροσίην … φέρουσιν ’which bear ambrosia’)
glossary.τετάρτη: τέταρτος — fourth; fem. nom. sg., with the pronoun ἡ: ’the fourth (maid)’
glossary.τεύξει: τεύχω — make, prepare; fut. 3 sg.: ’will make’
glossary.τρίποδι: τρίπους — tripod, three-footed cauldron-stand; masc. dat. sg., with ὑπό: ’under the tripod’
glossary.τρίτη: τρίτος — third; fem. nom. sg., with the pronoun ἡ: ’the third (maid)’
glossary.φάσκεν: φάσκω — say, declare, claim; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented, movable ν (= Attic ἔφασκε(ν)): ’kept saying’
glossary.φύσιν: φύσις — nature, growth, form (of a plant); fem. acc. sg.
glossary.χαριεστάτη: χαρίεις — graceful, charming; fem. nom. sg. superlative (χαριέστατος): ’most graceful’
glossary.χρυσέῳ: χρύσεος — golden; neut. dat. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic χρυσῷ)
glossary.χρυσόρραπις: χρυσόρραπις — with a golden wand, standing epithet of Hermes; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.χώρου: χῶρος — place, spot, land; masc. gen. sg., governed by ἄιδρις: ’of the place’ · also gen. of the starting point with ἀρξάμενοι: ’from the place’ (ἀρξάμενοι τοῦ χώρου)
glossary.ἀκήλητος: ἀκήλητος — not to be charmed, unbewitched, unmoved; masc. nom. sg. (two-ending adj.)
glossary.ἀκαχήμενος: ἀχέω (ἀκαχίζω) — distress, grieve; perf. mid. part. masc. nom. sg., epic reduplicated: ’grieved, distressed’
glossary.ἀλάλκῃσιν: ἀλαλκεῖν (ἀλέξω) — ward off, keep off; aor. 2 subj. 3 sg., epic -σιν ending (= Attic ἀλάλκῃ): ’may ward off’
glossary.ἀλλοφρονέων: ἀλλοφρονέω — be absent-minded, think of other things; pres. part. masc. nom. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἀλλοφρονῶν)
glossary.ἀλσέων: ἄλσος — sacred grove; neut. gen. pl., epic -έων (= Attic ἀλσῶν)
glossary.ἀμείψεται: ἀμείβω — change, cross, pass over; mid. 3 sg., aor. subj. (short vowel) or fut., after ὅς κε: ’passes’
glossary.ἀνέτλη: ἀνατλῆναι (τλάω) — endure, bear up under; aor. 3 sg., root aorist: ’endured, withstood’
glossary.ἀνήνορα: ἀνήνωρ — unmanly, spiritless, without manhood; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀντεβόλησεν: ἀντιβολέω — meet, encounter (+ dat.); aor. 3 sg., movable ν: ’met’
glossary.ἀπανήνασθαι: ἀπαναίνομαι — refuse, reject, decline; aor. inf. mid. (+ acc.), standing for an imperative after μηκέτι
glossary.ἀπογυμνωθέντα: ἀπογυμνόω — strip bare, strip; aor. pass. part. masc. acc. sg.: ’stripped naked’
glossary.ἀπό: ἀπό — from, away from; prep. + gen., accented before an enclitic (ἀπό τ’ ἀλσέων)
glossary.ἀπώμνυεν: ἀπόμνυμι — swear (solemnly); impf. 3 sg., augmented inside the compound, movable ν (= Attic ἀπώμνυε(ν)): ’was swearing, swore’
glossary.ἀργυρέῳ: ἀργύρεος — of silver; masc. dat. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἀργυρῷ), of a silver bowl
glossary.ἄιδρις: ἄιδρις — ignorant, unknowing (+ gen.); epic (α privative + ἴδρις); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἅλαδε: ἅλς — sea (salt); acc. ἅλα + suffix -δε ’to’; adv. ἅλαδε: ’to the sea’
glossary.ἐάσει: ἐάω — allow, permit, let be; fut. 3 sg.: ’will allow’
glossary.ἐβόησα: βοάω — shout, cry out; aor. 1 sg.: ’I shouted’
glossary.ἐθέλχθης: θέλγω — charm, bewitch; aor. pass. 2 sg.: ’you were enchanted’
glossary.ἐκέλευεν: κελεύω — bid, order, urge; impf. 3 sg., movable ν (= Attic ἐκέλευε(ν))
glossary.ἐκλύσομαι: ἐκλύω — free from, release from (+ gen.); fut. 1 sg. mid. (active sense): ’I will deliver (you) from’
glossary.ἐπέβην: ἐπιβαίνω — step upon, mount, set foot on (+ gen.); aor. 1 sg., root aorist: ’I mounted’
glossary.ἐπήιξα: ἐπαΐσσω — rush at, dart upon (+ dat.); aor. 1 sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἐπῇξα): ’I rushed at’
glossary.ἐπαῖξαι: ἐπαΐσσω — rush at, dart upon (+ dat.); aor. inf., standing for an imperative: ’rush at (her)!’
glossary.ἐπιβείομεν: ἐπιβαίνω — step upon, mount (+ gen.); aor. subj. 1 pl., epic -είομεν (= Attic ἐπιβῶμεν), hortatory: ’let us mount’
glossary.ἐρύσας: ἐρύω — draw, pull up; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having pulled up’
glossary.ἐτίταινε: τιταίνω — stretch, draw out, spread; impf. 3 sg., epic (Attic τείνω): ’was drawing out’
glossary.ἑπόμην: ἕπομαι — follow, accompany; impf. 1 sg. mid. (= Attic εἱπόμην): ’I followed’
glossary.ἑτέρη: ἕτερος — the other, second; fem. nom. sg., epic/Ionic -η (= Attic ἑτέρα), with the pronoun ἡ: ’the second (maid)’
glossary.ἔασι: εἰμί — be; pres. 3 pl., epic (= Attic εἰσί): ’are’
glossary.ἔβαλλε: βάλλω — throw, cast, lay; impf. 3 sg.: ’was laying, was throwing’
glossary.ἔδειξε: δείκνυμι — show, point out; aor. 3 sg. (Attic ἔδειξε(ν)): ’showed’
glossary.ἔθελξε: θέλγω — charm, bewitch, enchant; aor. 3 sg.: ’enchanted’
glossary.ἔθηκας: τίθημι — put, make; aor. 2 sg. (κ-aorist): ’you made (them so-and-so)’
glossary.ἔρχαται: εἴργω (ἔργω) — shut in, pen; perf. pass. 3 pl., Ionic -αται (= Attic εἰργμένοι εἰσί): ’are penned’
glossary.ἕσασα: ἵζω — set, seat (causative); aor. part. fem. nom. sg., epic (= Attic καθίσασα): ’having seated’
glossary.ἤνοπι: ἤνοψ — gleaming, flashing (of bronze; the sense is traditional, not certain); masc. dat. sg., formulaic epithet of bronze
glossary.ἤπιον: ἤπιος — gentle, kind, mild; masc. acc. sg., predicate with an infinitive: ’kind (to you)’ · also masc. acc. sg., attributive with ἄνακτα: ’so kind a master’ · also masc. acc. sg., attributive with μῦθον: ‘a gentle (word)’
glossary.ἥβη: ἥβη — youth, prime of youth; fem. nom. sg. (Ionic η for α)
glossary.ἥμην: ἧμαι — sit, remain; impf. 1 sg. (= Attic ἐκαθήμην): ’I sat’
glossary.ἰάχουσα: ἰάχω — cry out, shriek; pres. part. fem. nom. sg.: ’crying out’
glossary.ἰαίνετο: ἰαίνω — warm, heat; impf. pass. 3 sg.: ’was being warmed’
glossary.ἱερῶν: ἱερός — sacred, holy; masc. gen. pl., agreeing with ποταμῶν
glossary.ὀρύσσειν: ὀρύσσω — dig, dig up; pres. inf. (= Attic ὀρύττειν)
glossary.ὄσσετο: ὄσσομαι — forebode, see in the mind; impf. 3 sg. mid., a Homeric word with no Attic equivalent: ’boded, foreboded’
glossary.ὑλήεσσαν: ὑλήεις — wooded, forested; fem. acc. sg., epic -εσσα
glossary.ὑπέβαλλεν: ὑποβάλλω — throw under, spread beneath; impf. 3 sg., movable ν
glossary.ὑπέδραμε: ὑποτρέχω — run under, run beneath; aor. 3 sg. (Attic ὑπέδραμε): ’ran under’
glossary.ὑπηνήτῃ: ὑπηνήτης — bearded, having a beard (ὑπήνη ’beard’); masc. dat. sg., agreeing with νεηνίῃ
glossary.ὑποδείσασα: ὑποδείδω — take fright, shrink in fear; aor. part. fem. nom. sg.: ’having taken fright’
glossary.ῥίζῃ: ῥίζα — root; fem. dat. sg., of respect: ’at the root’
glossary.βοτάνης: βοτάνη — pasture, grazing, fodder; fem. gen. sg., gen. with κορέννυμι: ’have one’s fill of grazing’
glossary.βρώμην: βρῶμη — food, eating; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.γόος: γόος — wailing, lament; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.δαιμόνι: δαιμόνιος — strange, puzzling, odd (a voc. of address; the force, gentle or chiding, is uncertain); masc. voc. sg., elided (δαιμόνι’ = δαιμόνιε)
glossary.δακρυόεντες: δακρυόεις — tearful, full of tears; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.δειλοί: δειλός — miserable, wretched, poor; masc. voc. pl. in address (ἆ δειλοί ’oh miserable ones’)
glossary.διογενές: διογενής — Zeus-born, sprung from Zeus; masc. voc. sg.
glossary.διὲκ: διέκ — out through, right through; prep. + gen. (διά + ἐκ, epic)
glossary.δόκησε: δοκέω — seem, appear; aor. 3 sg., epic -ησ- aorist, unaugmented (= Attic ἔδοξε), with dat.: ’it seemed to them’
glossary.εἵπετ: ἕπομαι — follow, accompany; impf. 3 sg. mid., elided (εἵπετ’ = εἵπετο), augmented with a doubled vowel: ’followed’
glossary.εὐφροσύνῃ: εὐφροσύνη — good cheer, merriment, gladness; fem. dat. sg.
glossary.θρασὺς: θρασύς — bold, daring, rash; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.καλλίονες: καλός — beautiful, fair; comparative καλλίων; masc. nom. pl.: ’fairer’
glossary.καταβήμεναι: καταβαίνω — go down; aor. inf., epic -μεναι (= Attic καταβῆναι)
glossary.κεῖνοι: ἐκεῖνος — that, he; demonstrative pron., masc. nom. pl., epic κεῖνος (= Attic ἐκεῖνος): ’those men’
glossary.κονάβιζε: κοναβίζω — ring, resound, clatter; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented: ’rang’
glossary.κορέσωνται: κορέννυμι — sate; mid. have one’s fill of (+ gen.); aor. subj. 3 pl. mid., after ἐπὴν
glossary.κρατερὸν: κρατερός — strong, mighty (by-form of καρτερός); masc./neut. acc. sg. · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with μένος as subject
glossary.κόπρον: κόπρος — dung; the dunged farmyard, the steading’s yard; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.λάβητε: λαμβάνω — take, get, recover; aor. subj. 2 pl., with εἰς ὅ κεν: ’until you take’
glossary.λέλειπτο: λείπω — leave; plpf. pass. 3 sg., with simple past force: ’had been left behind, was left behind’
glossary.λύσασθ: λύω — loosen; mid. set free, ransom; aor. inf. mid., elided (λύσασθ’ = λύσασθαι): ’to free’
glossary.μέσσαυλον: μέσσαυλος — the court or yard in the middle of the steading; neut. acc. sg., epic double σσ (= μέσαυλον)
glossary.μαλακοῖς: μαλακός — soft, gentle, mild; masc. dat. pl., with ἐπέεσσι
glossary.μείζονες: μέγας — great, big; comparative μείζων; masc. nom. pl.: ’taller, bigger’
glossary.μεμνημένοι: μιμνήσκω — remind; mid. remember, be mindful of (+ gen.); perf. part. mid. masc. nom. pl.: ’mindful of’
glossary.μηνῶν: μείς (epic μήν) — month; masc. gen. pl., in a gen. absolute with φθινόντων
glossary.μιμνήσκεο: μιμνήσκω — mid. remember, be mindful of (+ gen.); pres. imper. 2 sg. mid., epic uncontracted (= Attic μιμνήσκου)
glossary.μυκώμεναι: μυκάομαι — low, bellow (of cattle); pres. part. mid. fem. nom. pl., contracted (from μυκαόμεναι)
glossary.νοστήσαντι: νοστέω — come home, return; aor. part. masc. dat. sg.: ’to you having come home’ · also ’(to him) who has come home’ (τῷ … οἴκαδε νοστήσαντι, of the man who has heard the Sirens)
glossary.οὐλόμενον: ὄλλυμι — destroy; mid. perish; οὐλόμενος (= ὀλόμενος) aor. part. mid. as adj., ’accursed, baneful, ruinous’; neut. nom. sg.
glossary.οὖδάσδε: οὖδας — ground, floor; neut.; οὖδάσδε = acc. + directional -δε (σ+δε): ’to the ground’
glossary.πάθετ: πάσχω — suffer, undergo; aor. 2 pl., elided (πάθετ’ = πάθετε)
glossary.πάσσασθαι: πατέομαι — eat, taste (+ gen.); aor. inf. mid., epic double σσ (= πάσασθαι): ’to taste’
glossary.πέποσθε: πάσχω — suffer; perf. 2 pl., epic πέποσθε (= Attic πεπόνθατε): ’you have suffered’
glossary.παχέος: παχύς — thick, stout, sturdy; masc. gen. sg., with μηροῦ
glossary.πελάσσαι: πελάζω — bring near, make approach; aor. inf. act., epic double σσ (= πελάσαι)
glossary.πελάσσατε: πελάζω — bring near, make approach; aor. imper. 2 pl., epic double σσ (= πελάσατε)
glossary.πελάσσομεν: πελάζω — bring near; aor. subj. 1 pl., epic double σσ, short vowel, hortatory (= πελάσωμεν): ’let us bring’
glossary.πηῷ: πηός — relative by marriage, kinsman; masc. dat. sg., epic
glossary.ποιήσεται: ποιέω — make, do; mid. make for oneself; fut. 3 sg. mid. (or short-vowel aor. subj.) with κεν: ’will make’, with a double acc.
glossary.προσάλειφεν: προσαλείφω — smear on, anoint with; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented, + dat. of person, acc. of salve
glossary.πρόφρασσα: πρόφρων — eager, willing, ready-minded; fem. nom. sg., epic double σσ (= πρόφρασα)
glossary.πρώτιστον: πρῶτος — first; superlative πρώτιστος; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’first of all’
glossary.πόριες: πόρις — calf, heifer; fem. nom. pl., epic -ιες (= πόρεις)
glossary.πόσ: πόσε — to where?, whither?; interrog. adv., elided (πόσ’ = πόσε)
glossary.σαωθῆναι: σαόω — save, keep safe (= σῴζω); aor. inf. pass.: ’to be saved’
glossary.σιάλοισιν: σίαλος — fatted hog, pig; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι(ν), with ἐοικότας
glossary.σκαίρουσιν: σκαίρω — skip, bound, frisk; pres. 3 pl.
glossary.σπασσάμενος: σπάω — draw, pull; mid. draw (a sword) for oneself; aor. part. mid. masc. nom. sg., epic double σσ (= σπασάμενος)
glossary.στεναχίζετο: στεναχίζω — groan, sigh, resound with groaning; impf. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented
glossary.συφειοῦ: συφεός — pigsty, sty; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.τίφθ: τίπτε (τί ποτε) — why, what then?; interrog. adv., elided τίπτ’, and τίφθ’ before a rough breathing
glossary.τανύηκες: τανύηκης — long-pointed (second element ἀκ- ’point’, sense not fully certain); neut. acc. sg., with ἄορ
glossary.τελέσθη: τελέω — fulfil, bring to an end; aor. 3 sg. pass., unaugmented: ’was completed’
glossary.τλαίη: τλάω — endure, bring oneself to, dare; aor. opt. 3 sg. (root aor. ἔτλην), + inf.
glossary.τρίχες: θρίξ — hair, bristle; fem. nom. pl. (stem τριχ-)
glossary.τρηχείης: τρηχύς — rough, rugged; fem. gen. sg., epic (= Attic τραχείας), with Ἰθάκης
glossary.φάμενοι: φημί — say, speak; mid. φάμενος, pres. part. mid. masc. nom. pl.: ’saying’
glossary.φαγέμεν: ἐσθίω — eat; aor. φαγεῖν; inf., epic -έμεν (= Attic φαγεῖν): ’to eat’
glossary.φθινόντων: φθίνω — waste away, wane, dwindle; pres. part. masc. gen. pl.: ’waning’
glossary.φράσσαντό: φράζω — point out; mid. notice, take note of; aor. 3 pl. mid., epic double σσ, unaugmented (= ἐφράσαντο)
glossary.φυλάσσοιμεν: φυλάσσω — guard, keep watch over; pres. opt. 1 pl.
glossary.χέοντας: χέω — pour, shed; pres. part. masc. acc. pl.: ’shedding’
glossary.χαλεπῆς: χαλεπός — hard, harsh, grievous; fem. gen. sg.
glossary.ἀγελαίας: ἀγελαῖος — of the herd, herd-; fem. acc. pl., with βοῦς
glossary.ἀμφιθέουσι: ἀμφιθέω — run round; pres. 3 pl., + acc.: ’run round’
glossary.ἀνάρσιοι: ἀνάρσιος — hostile, unfriendly; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἀνέῳξε: ἀνοίγνυμι (also ἀνοίγω) — open; aor. 3 sg., augmented with the stem vowel lengthened: ’opened’
glossary.ἀναύδῳ: ἄναυδος — speechless, voiceless; masc. dat. sg., with ἶσος
glossary.ἀποπλήξας: ἀποπλήσσω — strike off, smite away; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀπώμοσα: ἀπόμνυμι — swear, swear an oath; aor. 1 sg.: ’I have sworn’, with cognate acc. ὅρκον
glossary.ἀσκελέες: ἀσκελής — withered, dried up, shrunken; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἀφικοίμεθα: ἀφικνέομαι — arrive at, reach; aor. opt. 1 pl.
glossary.ἄγειν: ἄγω — lead, bring; pres. inf. act.
glossary.ἄγραυλοι: ἄγραυλος — living in the fields, out in the pasture; adj. (2-termination), fem. nom. pl.
glossary.ἄθυμοι: ἄθυμος — spiritless, disheartened; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἄλης: ἄλη — wandering, roaming; fem. gen. sg., with μεμνημένοι · also gen. of separation after παύω: ’from wandering’ (ἔπαυσας ἄλης ’you made me cease from wandering’)
glossary.ἅπτεαι: ἅπτω — fasten; mid. touch, take hold of, taste (+ gen.); pres. 2 sg. mid., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἅπτῃ)
glossary.ἆ: ἆ — ah!, oh!; interjection of dismay or reproach
glossary.ἐδηλήσαντ: δηλέομαι — harm, hurt, injure; aor. 3 pl. mid., elided (ἐδηλήσαντ’ = ἐδηλήσαντο)
glossary.ἐκεῖνοι: ἐκεῖνος — that, he; demonstrative pron., masc. nom. pl.: ’those men’ (the Attic form beside epic κεῖνος)
glossary.ἐκκαλέσαντες: ἐκκαλέω — call out; aor. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’calling out’
glossary.ἐλθούσας: ἔρχομαι — come, go; aor. ἦλθον, part. ἐλθών; fem. acc. pl.: ’having come’
glossary.ἐναντίοι: ἐναντίος — opposite, facing; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἐνιπήν: ἐνιπή — rebuke, reproof, threat; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἐννεώροισιν: ἐννέωρος — nine years old; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι(ν)
glossary.ἐοικότας: ἔοικα — be like, resemble (+ dat.); perf. part. masc. acc. pl.: ’like’
glossary.ἐρύκανε: ἐρύκω — hold back, restrain, keep off; impf. 3 sg., epic lengthened form, unaugmented (= ἔρυκε)
glossary.ἐρύσσατε: ἐρύω — draw, drag, haul; aor. imper. 2 pl., epic double σσ (= ἐρύσατε)
glossary.ἐσάντα: ἐσάντα — face to face, straight before; adv. (ἐς + ἄντα)
glossary.ἐχάρημεν: χαίρω — rejoice; aor. 1 pl. (passive form, active sense): ’we rejoiced’
glossary.ἐόντι: εἰμί — be; pres. part. masc. dat. sg., epic ἐών (= Attic ὄντι): ’being’
glossary.ἔγνωσαν: γιγνώσκω — recognise, come to know; aor. 3 pl.: ’they recognised’
glossary.ἔδοντας: ἔδω — eat (= ἐσθίω); pres. part. masc. acc. pl., epic: ’eating’
glossary.ἔκπαγλον: ἔκπαγλος — terrible, dreadful, astounding; fem. acc. sg., with ἐνιπήν · also neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’terribly’ (ἔκπαγλον καὶ ἀεικές ’in a terrifying and unseemly way’)
glossary.ἔρξ: ἔρδω (= ῥέζω) — do, act; aor. 3 sg., elided (ἔρξ’ = ἔρξε): ’did’
glossary.ἔρρεον: ῥέω — flow, stream; impf. 3 pl., uncontracted (= Attic ἔρρουν): ’flowed away, fell off’
glossary.ἔστησαν: ἵστημι — set up, stand; aor. 3 pl. of ἔστην, intransitive: ’took their stand, stood’
glossary.ἔτραπον: τρέπω — turn; aor. 3 pl. (2nd aor.), intransitive of the seasons: ’turned, came round’
glossary.ἔτραφεν: τρέφω — nourish; pass. grow up; intrans. aor. 3 pl., epic -εν (= Attic ἐτράφησαν): ’they were reared’
glossary.ἔφυσε: φύω — bring forth, make grow; aor. 3 sg. transitive: ’produced, made to grow’
glossary.ἕζεαι: ἕζομαι — sit, sit down; pres. 2 sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἕζῃ)
glossary.ἕπετ: ἕπομαι — follow, accompany; impf. 3 sg. mid., elided (ἕπετ’ = ἕπετο), unaugmented
glossary.ἡμέτεροι: ἡμέτερος — our, ours; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἥμενον: ἧμαι — sit; pres. part. mid. masc. acc. sg., epic ἥμενος: ’sitting’
glossary.ἰάλλοντα: ἰάλλω — send, hurl, stretch out; pres. part. masc. acc. sg.: ’putting forth (the hands)’
glossary.ἰχθυόεντι: ἰχθυόεις — teeming with fish; masc. dat. sg., epithet of the sea
glossary.ἱκοίατο: ἱκνέομαι — come to, reach; aor. opt. 3 pl. mid., epic -οίατο (= -οιντο)
glossary.ἱμείρετε: ἱμείρω — long for, yearn after (+ gen.); pres. 2 pl.
glossary.ἱμερόεις: ἱμερόεις — causing longing, full of longing; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἴδηθ: ὁράω — see; aor. subj. 2 pl., elided with θ before a rough breathing (ἴδηθ’ = ἴδητε), after ὄφρα
glossary.ἴδω: ὁράω — see; aor. subj. 1 sg., after ἵνα: ’that I may see’
glossary.ἴσχουσ: ἴσχω — hold, check, restrain; pres. 3 pl., elided (ἴσχουσ’ = ἴσχουσι)
glossary.ὀλοφυρομένους: ὀλοφύρομαι — lament, wail; pres. part. mid. masc. acc. pl.
glossary.ὀλοφυρόμενοι: ὀλοφύρομαι — lament, wail; pres. part. mid. masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ὀτρύνεσθε: ὀτρύνω — rouse, urge on; mid. bestir oneself; pres. imper. 2 pl. mid.
glossary.ὄρνυτε: ὄρνυμι — rouse, stir up; pres. imper. 2 pl.
glossary.ὑπέδυ: ὑποδύω — go under, steal beneath; aor. 3 sg. (root aor. ὑπέδυν), of a feeling: ’crept over’
glossary.αἵματος: αἷμα — blood; neut. gen. sg., with ἆσσον ’nearer to’ · also neut. gen. sg. of descent, after εἰμί: ’of (our) blood’ (ἐμός ἐσσι καὶ αἵματος ἡμετέροιο ’you are mine and of our blood’) · also neut. gen. sg. of the stuff filled with or smeared with: ’with blood’ (κνίσης τε καὶ αἵματος ἐμπλήσαντες; στῆθος … φύρσω αἵματος)
glossary.βαθυδίνῃ: βαθυδίνης — deep-eddying; masc. dat. sg., epithet of Ocean
glossary.βορέαο: Βορέης — Boreas, the North Wind; masc. gen. sg., epic -αο (= Attic Βορέου)
glossary.βόθρον: βόθρος — pit, trench; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.γένηαι: γίγνομαι — become, be; aor. subj. 2 sg. mid., epic -ηαι (= Attic γένῃ), after ὅτε: ’when you are’
glossary.γουνοῦσθαι: γουνόομαι — clasp the knees of, entreat; pres. inf. mid., used as an imperative: ’entreat’
glossary.γόων: γοάω — wail, lament; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented (= ἐγόων): ’they wailed’
glossary.δείραντας: δέρω — flay; aor. part. act. masc. acc. pl.: ’having flayed’
