glossary.νευρῆφιν: νευρά — bowstring, string; fem. sg. with epic ending -φιν, locative/instrumental sense: ’on the string’
glossary.νικᾶν: νικάω — conquer, win; pres. inf., after ὄφελον
glossary.οἰοπόλοισιν: οἰοπόλος — lonely, desolate (of mountains); masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις)
glossary.οὐλομένων: ὄλλυμι — destroy; mid. perish; aor. part. mid. gen. pl., epic οὐλόμενος (= ὀλόμενος): ’accursed, ruinous’
glossary.πάντοσ: πάντοσε — in every direction, on every side; adv., elided (πάντοσ’ = πάντοσε)
glossary.πέδονδε: πέδον — ground, plain; πέδονδε, with -δε of motion toward: ’to the ground, down to the plain’; adv.
glossary.πέλεθρα: πλέθρον (epic πέλεθρον) — plethron, a land measure of about a hundred feet; neut. acc. pl.
glossary.πέμψειεν: πέμπω — send; aor. opt. 3 sg., in a clause of fearing: ’might send’
glossary.πανοπῆος: Πανοπεύς — Panopeus, a town in Phocis; masc. gen. sg., epic -ῆος (= Attic -έως)
glossary.παπταίνων: παπταίνω — look about, peer around; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.
glossary.παρημένω: πάρημαι — sit beside, sit by; pres. part. masc. nom. dual: ’sitting beside’
glossary.πειρίθοόν: Πειρίθοος — Pirithous, king of the Lapiths, friend of Theseus; masc. acc. sg., epic uncontracted
glossary.πηληϊάδαο: Πηληϊάδης — son of Peleus, i.e. Achilles; masc. gen. sg., patronymic, epic -αο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.πιέειν: πίνω — drink; aor. inf., epic uncontracted (= Attic πιεῖν)
glossary.προσέπλαζε: προσπλάζω — dash against, lap against; impf. 3 sg.
glossary.προτέρους: πρότερος — earlier, former, before; masc. acc. pl.: ’men of earlier times’
glossary.πυθώδ: Πυθώ — Pytho, Delphi; Πυθώδε, with -δε of motion toward: ’to Pytho’; adv., elided (Πυθώδ’ = Πυθώδε)
glossary.σκηριπτόμενος: σκηρίπτομαι — prop oneself, brace oneself; pres. part. mid. masc. nom. sg.
glossary.στεῦτο: στεῦμαι — stand as if to do something, stand there; impf. 3 sg. (στεῦτο διψάων ’he stood thirsting’)
glossary.στρατὸν: στρατός — army, host; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.τέρπεται: τέρπω — delight; mid. take one’s pleasure, enjoy; pres. 3 sg. mid.
glossary.τέχνῃ: τέχνη — skill, craft, art; fem. dat. sg., dative of means
glossary.τελαμωνιάδαο: Τελαμωνιάδης — son of Telamon, i.e. Ajax; masc. gen. sg., patronymic, epic -αο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.τελαμών: τελαμών — broad strap, belt, baldric; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.τελαμῶνα: τελαμών — broad strap, belt, baldric; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.τελαμῶνος: Τελαμών — Telamon, father of Ajax; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.τευχέων: τεῦχος — arms, armour (usually pl. τεύχεα); neut. gen. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic τευχῶν)
glossary.τεχνήσαιτο: τεχνάομαι — make by art, contrive; aor. opt. 3 sg. mid., in a wish
glossary.τεχνησάμενος: τεχνάομαι — make by art, contrive; aor. part. mid. masc. nom. sg.
glossary.τιταινόμενος: τιταίνω — stretch, strain; mid. strain oneself; pres. part. mid. masc. nom. sg.
glossary.τοιῷδ: τοιόσδε — such, of such a kind; masc. dat. sg., elided (τοιῷδ’ = τοιῷδε)
glossary.τοσσάχ: τοσσάκι(ς) — so many times, so often; adv., elided (τοσσάχ’ = τοσσάκι); correlative of ὁσσάκι
glossary.τοῦδέ: ὅδε, ἥδε, τόδε — this; masc./neut. gen. sg., genitive of comparison: ’than this’
glossary.φάνεσκε: φαίνω — show; pass. appear; iterative impf. 3 sg. pass. in -σκε, unaugmented: ’would appear’
glossary.φθιμένοιο: φθίω (φθίνω) — perish, die away; aor. part. mid. masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου): ’dead’
glossary.φοίτα: φοιτάω — go to and fro, range about; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐφοίτα)
glossary.φράζετο: φράζομαι — consider, think, plan; impf. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented (= ἐφράζετο): ’thought, devised’
glossary.φόνοι: φόνος — slaughter, murder; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.χαλεποὺς: χαλεπός — hard, grievous, difficult; masc. acc. pl.
glossary.χαροποί: χαροπός — fierce-eyed (sense of the epithet uncertain, perhaps ’bright-eyed’); masc. nom. pl.
glossary.χείρονι: χείρων — worse, inferior; masc. dat. sg., comparative of κακός
glossary.χρυσοπεδίλου: χρυσοπέδιλος — with golden sandals; fem. gen. sg. (epithet of Hera)
glossary.χρύσεος: χρύσεος — golden; masc. nom. sg., uncontracted (= Attic χρυσοῦς)
glossary.χόλου: χόλος — anger, wrath; masc. gen. sg., object of λήσεσθαι
glossary.ἀέθλῳ: ἄεθλος — contest, struggle; masc. dat. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἄθλῳ)
glossary.ἀαγές: ἀαγής — unbreakable (ἀ- privative + ἄγνυμι ’break’); neut. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀγήνορα: ἀγήνωρ — proud, high-spirited, manly; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀγείρετο: ἀγείρω — gather; mid. assemble, come together; impf. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented (= ἠγείρετο)
glossary.ἀγρότεροί: ἀγρότερος — wild, of the countryside; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἀνένεικα: ἀναφέρω — carry up, bring up; aor. 1 sg., epic ἀνένεικα (= Attic ἀνήνεγκα)
glossary.ἀνέρας: ἀνήρ — man; masc. acc. pl., epic ἀνέρας (= Attic ἄνδρας)
glossary.ἀναβροχέν: ἀναβρόχω — swallow up, gulp back; aor. pass. part. neut. nom. sg. (agreeing with ὕδωρ): ’swallowed up’
glossary.ἀναιδής: ἀναιδής — shameless, ruthless, relentless; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀνδροκτασίαι: ἀνδροκτασία — man-slaying, slaughter of men; fem. nom. pl.
glossary.ἀορτὴρ: ἀορτήρ — strap by which a sword or quiver is slung, baldric; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀπαμύνετο: ἀπαμύνω — ward off, drive away; mid. defend oneself against; impf. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented (= ἀπημύνετο)
glossary.ἀπειρεσίην: ἀπειρέσιος — boundless, countless; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀπολέσκετ: ἀπόλλυμι — destroy; mid. perish, vanish; iterative impf. 3 sg. mid. in -σκε(το), elided (ἀπολέσκετ’): ’would vanish’
glossary.ἀποστρέψασκε: ἀποστρέφω — turn back, turn away; iterative aor. 3 sg. in -σκε, unaugmented: ’would turn back’
glossary.ἀπώλεο: ἀπόλλυμι — destroy; mid. perish; aor. 2 sg. mid., epic -εο (= Attic ἀπώλου): ’you perished’
glossary.ἀργείοισι: Ἀργεῖος — Argive, Greek; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
glossary.ἀριδείκετον: ἀριδείκετος — very conspicuous, most distinguished; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀσφοδελὸν: ἀσφοδελός — of asphodel, asphodel-covered; masc. acc. sg. (with λειμῶνα)
glossary.ἀτυζομένων: ἀτύζομαι — be panic-stricken, be dazed with fear; pres. part. mid. masc. gen. pl.
glossary.ἀφεστήκει: ἀφίστημι — stand away from; plpf. 3 sg., intransitive, epic ἀφεστήκει (= Attic ἀφειστήκει): ’stood apart’
glossary.ἀχνύμεθα: ἄχνυμαι — grieve, be distressed; pres. 1 pl. mid.
glossary.ἀχνύμεναι: ἄχνυμαι — grieve, be distressed; pres. part. mid. fem. nom. pl.
glossary.ἄξοντ: ἄγω — lead, bring, fetch; fut. part. masc. acc. sg., elided (ἄξοντ’ = ἄξοντα): ’to fetch’
glossary.ἐγκάτθετο: ἐγκατατίθημι — put in, lay in; aor. 3 sg. mid., syncopated, epic (= Attic ἐγκατέθετο)
glossary.ἐπετέλλετ: ἐπιτέλλω — lay a charge upon, enjoin; impf. 3 sg., elided (ἐπετέλλετ’ = ἐπετέλλετο), iterative sense: ’kept laying (labours) on’
glossary.ἐρεμνῇ: ἐρεμνός — dark, black, dusky; fem. dat. sg.
glossary.ἐρικυδέος: ἐρικυδής — very glorious, much honoured; fem. gen. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic -οῦς)
glossary.ἐρχομένην: ἔρχομαι — go, come; pres. part. mid. fem. acc. sg.: ’going’
glossary.ἑσταότες: ἵστημι — set up; perf. stand; perf. part. masc. nom. pl., epic ἑσταότες (= Attic ἑστῶτες)
glossary.ἑστεῶτ: ἵστημι — set up; perf. stand; perf. part. masc. acc. sg., elided epic (ἑστεῶτ’ = ἑστεῶτα; Attic ἑστῶτα)
glossary.ἑῇ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive; epic ἑός) — his own, her own; fem. dat. sg. (with τέχνῃ)
glossary.ἔθελόν: ἐθέλω — wish, be willing, want; impf. 1 sg., unaugmented (= ἤθελον)
glossary.ἔθνε: ἔθνος — tribe, throng, company; neut. nom. pl., elided (ἔθνε’ = ἔθνεα, uncontracted; Attic ἔθνη)
glossary.ἔκειρον: κείρω — shear, cut; of birds, tear at; impf. 3 pl.
glossary.ἔρρεεν: ῥέω — flow, run; impf. 3 sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἔρρει)
glossary.ἕλκησε: ἑλκέω (ἕλκω) — drag, pull about, maltreat; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἥλκησε); ἑλκέω is the epic form beside ἕλκω
glossary.ἕνεκ: ἕνεκα — because of, for the sake of; prep. + gen., elided (ἕνεκ’ = ἕνεκα)
glossary.ἡγηλάζεις: ἡγηλάζω — lead along, drive along (rare epic verb); pres. 2 sg.
glossary.ἡρακληείην: Ἡρακληεῖος (Ἡρακληείη) — of Heracles; fem. acc. sg., epic (with βίην): βίη Ἡρακληείη ’the might of Heracles’, a periphrasis for the hero
glossary.ἥβην: Ἥβη — Hebe, goddess of youth, wife of Heracles in heaven; fem. acc. sg. · also ἥβη — youth, prime of youth; fem. acc. sg.: ’youth’ (ἥβην πολυήρατον ’much-loved youth’)
glossary.ἰθύσει: ἰθύω — rush straight, make a dash; aor. opt. 3 sg., elided (ἰθύσει’ = ἰθύσειε): ’whenever he made a dash’
glossary.ὀχέεσκον: ὀχέω — bear, carry, endure; iterative impf. 1 sg. in -εσκον: ’I used to bear’
glossary.ὁσσάκι: ὁσσάκι(ς) — as often as, every time that; adv./conj. (= Attic ὁσάκις)
glossary.ὄρεσσι: ὄρος — mountain; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic ὄρεσι)
glossary.ὅμως: ὅμως — all the same, nevertheless, even so; adv.
glossary.ὑπερβαλέειν: ὑπερβάλλω — go over, surmount, pass over the top; aor. inf., epic uncontracted (= Attic ὑπερβαλεῖν)
glossary.ὑσμῖναί: ὑσμίνη — battle, fray; fem. nom. pl.
glossary.ὑψιπέτηλα: ὑψιπέτηλος — high-leafed, with lofty foliage; neut. nom. pl.
glossary.ὠκεανὸν: Ὠκεανός — Oceanus, the river encircling the earth; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ὤθεσκε: ὠθέω — push, shove; iterative impf. 3 sg. in -σκε, unaugmented: ’would push, kept pushing’
glossary.ὤσασκε: ὠθέω — push, shove; iterative aor. 3 sg. in -σκε (stem ὠσ-): ’would push, kept pushing’
glossary.ῥόοιο: ῥόος — stream, current; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic ῥοῦ)
glossary.αἰζήιος: αἰζήιος (αἰζηός) — vigorous, in the prime of youth; adj., masc. nom. sg. (with ἀνήρ)
glossary.βερέθρου: βέρεθρον — pit, abyss, gulf; neut. gen. sg.
glossary.γάνυνται: γάνυμαι — rejoice, be glad; pres. 3 pl.
glossary.γηθήσειεν: γηθέω — rejoice, be glad; aor. opt. 3 sg., with κέ potential: ’would rejoice’
glossary.δέδυκεν: δύω — sink, plunge, enter; perf. 3 sg. intrans., ν-movable (= δέδυκε): ’has sunk, is sunk’
glossary.δεσμοῖσι: δεσμός — bond, fetter; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οῖς)
glossary.δεψήσας: δεψέω — knead, soften (wax); aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having kneaded’
glossary.δησάντων: δέω — bind, tie; aor. imper. 3 pl. act.: ’let them bind’
glossary.διδέντων: δίδημι (by-form of δέω) — bind; pres. imper. 3 pl., epic (= Attic δεόντων): ’let them bind’
glossary.διείπομεν: διέπω — manage, arrange in order, carry out; impf. 1 pl., augmented: ’we were arranging’
glossary.δισθανέες: δισθανής — dying twice; adj., masc. nom. pl., uncontracted (= Attic -εῖς)
glossary.εἰσαφίκηται: εἰσαφικνέομαι — arrive at, come to; aor. subj. 3 sg. mid. (ὅτις … εἰσαφίκηται ’whoever comes to’)
glossary.εἰσαφίκοιτο: εἰσαφικνέομαι — arrive at, come to; aor. opt. 3 sg. mid., potential with κεν: ’would reach’
glossary.εἷσέ: ἕζω (ἵζω) — seat, set down; aor. 3 sg. act., augmented (εἷσε): ’seated’
glossary.θάπτομεν: θάπτω — bury; unaugmented impf. 1 pl., = ἐθάπτομεν: ’we buried’
glossary.θαμέες: θαμέες — thick, close-set, crowded; adj., masc. nom. pl., epic plural form (= Attic θαμεῖς)
glossary.θνῄσκουσ: θνῄσκω — die; pres. 3 pl., elided (θνῄσκουσ’ = θνῄσκουσι)
glossary.θὶς: θίς — heap, mound; masc. nom. sg. (with πολύς)
glossary.κίρκην: Κίρκη — Circe, the enchantress goddess; fem. acc. sg., object of ἐλήθομεν
glossary.κακορραφίῃ: κακορραφία — evil contrivance, mischief (a Homeric hapax, exact sense disputed); fem. dat. sg.
glossary.κελεύῃς: κελεύω — urge, bid; pres. subj. 2 sg.
glossary.κορυφῇ: κορυφή — peak, summit; fem. dat. sg.
glossary.κυανέη: κυάνεος — dark blue, dark; adj., fem. nom. sg., epic -έη (= Attic -έα)
glossary.κυανώπιδος: κυανῶπις — dark-eyed; adj., fem. gen. sg. (epithet of Amphitrite)
glossary.κύμαθ: κῦμα — wave; neut. nom./acc. pl., elided (κύμαθ’ = κύματα)
glossary.κύνας: κύων — dog; masc./fem. acc. pl. (of sea creatures, perhaps dogfish) · also fem. acc. pl. as a term of abuse for shameless women: ’shameless creatures, bitches’ (of maidservants)
glossary.λίπεν: λείπω — leave, quit; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔλιπε)
glossary.λίς: λίς — smooth, bare (of rock); adj., fem. nom. sg., predicate; accented before the enclitic ἐστι
glossary.λίσσηαι: λίσσομαι — beg, entreat; pres. subj. 2 sg., epic -ηαι (= Attic -ῃ)
glossary.λελακυῖα: λάσκω — cry, yelp, bark; perf. part. fem. nom. sg., epic λελακυῖα: ’yelping’
glossary.λιγυρῇ: λιγυρός — clear-toned, shrill, sweet-sounding; fem. dat. sg. (with ἀοιδῇ)
glossary.λὶς: λίς — smooth, bare (of rock); adj., fem. nom. sg. (λὶς πέτρη ’smooth rock’)
glossary.μέλουσα: μέλω — be a care to, be of concern to; pres. part. fem. nom. sg., + dat.: ’being a care to’
glossary.μέσση: μέσος — middle; fem. nom. sg., epic doubled-σ (= Attic μέση): ’in her middle’
glossary.μεγάλας: μέγας — great, big; fem. acc. pl.
glossary.μινύθουσι: μινύθω — wither, shrivel, dwindle; pres. 3 pl.
glossary.μνήσει: μιμνήσκω — remind, put in mind; fut. 3 sg. act.: ’will remind’
glossary.νεκροῦ: νεκρός — dead body, corpse; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.νεκρόν: νεκρός — dead body, corpse; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.νεκρός: νεκρός — dead body, corpse; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.νεογιλῆς: νεογιλός — newborn, new-whelped; adj., fem. gen. sg. (with σκύλακος): ’of a newborn pup’
glossary.οὔατ: οὖς — ear; neut. acc. pl., elided, epic οὔατα (= Attic ὦτα)
glossary.πέλειαι: πέλεια — dove, pigeon; fem. nom. pl.
glossary.πέτραι: πέτρα — rock, crag, cliff; fem. nom. pl.
glossary.πήξαμεν: πήγνυμι — fix, fasten, plant; aor. 1 pl.: ’we planted’
glossary.πίνακάς: πίναξ — plank, board; masc. acc. pl.
glossary.παθόντες: πάσχω — suffer, experience; aor. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’having suffered’
glossary.παρέπεμψεν: παραπέμπω — send past, convey past; aor. 3 sg.
glossary.παρέπλω: παραπλέω — sail past; aor. 3 sg., epic root aorist (ἔπλω; Attic παρέπλευσε)
glossary.παρέρχεται: παρέρχομαι — go past, pass by; pres. 3 sg.
glossary.παρίσταται: παρίστημι — stand beside, stand by; pres. 3 sg. mid., + dat.
glossary.παρεξελάαν: παρεξελαύνω — drive past, sail past; pres. inf., epic -άαν (= Attic -ᾶν), used as an imperative
glossary.παρφυγέειν: παραφεύγω — flee past, escape; aor. inf., epic -έειν (= Attic παραφυγεῖν), apocopated παρ-
glossary.πείρατ: πεῖραρ — end, limit; of a rope, its ends; neut. nom./acc. pl., elided (πείρατ’ = πείρατα)
glossary.πελάσῃ: πελάζω — draw near, approach; aor. subj. 3 sg.
glossary.πεπείρανται: περαίνω — bring to an end, accomplish; perf. pass. 3 pl.: ’have been accomplished’
glossary.περιμήκεες: περιμήκης — very long; adj., fem. nom. pl., uncontracted (= Attic -εις) · also masc. nom. pl., agreeing with a masc. noun (ἱστοὶ … περιμήκεες ’very tall (looms)’)
glossary.περιμαιμώωσα: περιμαιμάω — range about, grope around; pres. part. fem. nom. sg., epic -ώωσα (= Attic -ῶσα), + acc.
glossary.περιξεστῇ: περίξεστος — polished all round, smoothed; adj., fem. dat. sg., with ἐικυῖα
glossary.πλέουσα: πλέω — sail; pres. part. fem. nom. sg.
glossary.πλαγκτὰς: πλαγκτός — wandering, drifting; adj., fem. acc. pl.; Πλαγκταί, name of the Wandering Rocks
glossary.πλεύσεσθ: πλέω — sail; fut. 2 pl. mid., elided (πλεύσεσθ’ = πλεύσεσθε)
glossary.πλεῖοι: πλεῖος (πλέος) — full, filled, + gen.; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ποντοπόρος: ποντοπόρος — sea-faring, sea-crossing; adj., fem. nom. sg. (with νηῦς)
glossary.ποτητὰ: ποτητός — flying, winged; neut. nom. pl. used substantively: ’winged things’
glossary.προσέλεκτο: προσλέγομαι — lie down beside (some take it ’converse with’; sense disputed); aor. 3 sg. mid., root aorist
glossary.πρόεχ: προέχω — jut out, project; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented, elided (πρόεχ’ = πρόεχε)
glossary.πυθομένων: πύθω — make rot; mid. rot, decay; pres. part. mid. masc. gen. pl.: ’rotting’
glossary.σειρήνοιιν: Σειρήν — Siren; fem. gen. dual, ’of the two Sirens’
glossary.σημανέω: σημαίνω — show, make known; fut. 1 sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic σημανῶ)
glossary.σκοπέλῳ: σκόπελος — rock, crag, cliff; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.σκόπελοι: σκόπελος — rock, crag, cliff; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.σκόπελον: σκόπελος — rock, crag, cliff; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.σκύλακος: σκύλαξ — puppy, young dog; masc./fem. gen. sg.
glossary.σκύλλη: Σκύλλη — Scylla, the sea monster; fem. nom. sg., Ionic/epic (= Attic Σκύλλα)
glossary.σμερδαλέη: σμερδαλέος — terrible, dread; adj., fem. nom. sg., epic -έη (= Attic -έα)
glossary.στήλην: στήλη — upright slab, pillar, grave-marker; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.σχέτλιοι: σχέτλιος — hard, reckless, wretched; adj., masc. nom. pl., in address: ’reckless ones!’
glossary.σώματα: σῶμα — body (in Homer, a dead body); neut. acc. pl.
glossary.τάς: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); fem. acc. pl.: ’them’, of the Sirens · also ’them’, of the rocks (accented before the enclitic γε) · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ: fem. acc. pl. ’which’ (νῆας, τάς οἱ ξυνέαξαν ’ships which … shattered for him’)
glossary.ταμόντες: τάμνω (τέμνω) — cut; aor. part. masc. nom. pl., epic τάμνω (= Attic τεμόντες): ’having cut’
glossary.τεθνηῶτα: θνῄσκω — die; perf. part. masc. acc. sg., epic (= Attic τεθνεῶτα): ’dead’
glossary.τερπόμενος: τέρπω — delight; mid. enjoy, take pleasure; pres. part. mid. masc. nom. sg.: ’enjoying’
glossary.τετραμμένον: τρέπω — turn; perf. part. mid./pass. neut. nom. sg. (with σπέος): ’turned (toward)’
glossary.τρήρωνες: τρήρων — timid, fluttering (of doves); adj., fem. nom. pl.
glossary.τρίστοιχοι: τρίστοιχος — in three rows; adj., masc. nom. pl.
glossary.φιτροὺς: φιτρός — log, billet of wood; masc. acc. pl.
glossary.φωνὴ: φωνή — voice, sound; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.χεύαντες: χέω — pour; heap up (a mound); aor. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’having heaped up’
glossary.ἀγάστονος: ἀγάστονος — loud-groaning, loud-moaning; adj. (2 endings), fem. nom. sg. (epithet of Amphitrite)
glossary.ἀιδρείῃ: ἀιδρείη — ignorance, lack of knowledge; fem. dat. sg.: ’in ignorance’
glossary.ἀκήριοι: ἀκήριος — unscathed, unharmed (ἀ- + κήρ ’doom’; some take it ’lifeless’); adj., masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἀκροτάτη: ἄκρος — topmost, outermost; superlative ἀκρότατος, fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀκροτάτῳ: ἄκρος — topmost, outermost; superlative ἀκρότατος, masc. dat. sg.
glossary.ἀλγήσετε: ἀλγέω — feel pain, suffer; short-vowel aor. subj. 2 pl.
glossary.ἀλεγεινῇ: ἀλεγεινός — painful, grievous; adj., fem. dat. sg.
glossary.ἀλεῖψαι: ἀλείφω — anoint, smear; aor. inf. act., used as an imperative: ’smear!’
glossary.ἀμβαίη: ἀναβαίνω — go up, climb; aor. opt. 3 sg., apocope ἀμ- (ἀμβαίη = ἀναβαίη); potential with κεν
glossary.ἀμφιβέβηκε: ἀμφιβαίνω — go around, enfold, envelop; perf. 3 sg., + acc.: ’has wrapped around’
glossary.ἀνήφθω: ἀνάπτω — fasten to, tie up; perf. imper. pass. 3 sg.: ’let it be fastened’
glossary.ἀντιάσειεν: ἀντιάω — meet, encounter; aor. opt. 3 sg., epic -ειεν
glossary.ἀντολαὶ: ἀντολή — rising (of the sun); fem. nom. pl., epic (= Attic ἀνατολαί)
glossary.ἀργὼ: Ἀργώ — Argo, the ship of Jason; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀφίξεαι: ἀφικνέομαι — come to, arrive at; fut. 2 sg. mid., epic -εαι (= Attic ἀφίξῃ)
glossary.ἀφαιρεῖται: ἀφαιρέω — take away; mid. take away for oneself, snatch; pres. 3 sg. mid.
glossary.ἄωροι: ἄωρος — ill-fitted, dangling (sense disputed: ’unseasonable, shapeless’); adj., masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἅπαξ: ἅπαξ — once, a single time; adv.
glossary.ἐλάσωσιν: ἐλαύνω (ἐλάω) — drive, row, sail; aor. subj. 3 pl. act.
glossary.ἐλήθομεν: λήθω (λανθάνω) — escape the notice of, + acc.; impf. 1 pl.: ’we escaped notice of’
glossary.ἐλπήνορα: Ἐλπήνωρ — Elpenor, Odysseus’ companion; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἐνίησι: ἐνίημι — send in, put in; pres. 3 sg.
glossary.ἐναρίθμιον: ἐναρίθμιος — counted in, making up the number; adj., fem. acc. sg. (with ἄλλην)
glossary.ἐντυναμένη: ἐντύνω — make ready, equip; mid. array oneself; aor. part. mid. fem. nom. sg.: ’having made ready’
glossary.ἐξίσχει: ἐξίσχω — hold out, put out; pres. 3 sg.
glossary.ἐξαρπάξασα: ἐξαρπάζω — snatch out, seize; aor. part. fem. nom. sg.: ’having snatched’
glossary.ἐπηρεφέες: ἐπηρεφής — overhanging, beetling; adj., fem. nom. pl., uncontracted (= Attic -εῖς)
glossary.ἐπιβαίη: ἐπιβαίνω — step upon, mount; aor. opt. 3 sg., potential with κεν
glossary.ἐρωεῖ: ἐρωέω — withdraw, abate, cease; pres. 3 sg. (= ἐρωέει)
glossary.ἕλῃσι: αἱρέω — take, catch; aor. subj. 3 sg., epic -ῃσι (= Attic ἕλῃ)
glossary.ἠεροειδές: ἠεροειδής — misty, murky, dim (ἀήρ ’mist’ + εἶδος); adj., neut. nom. sg. (with σπέος) · also neut. acc. sg. (with σπέος, object of δῦνε)
glossary.ἠριγενείης: ἠριγένεια — early-born; fem. gen. sg., epithet of Dawn
glossary.ἰήσων: Ἰάσων — Jason, leader of the Argonauts; masc. nom. sg., Ionic/epic Ἰήσων (= Attic Ἰάσων)
glossary.ἰθύνετε: ἰθύνω — steer straight, direct; pres. 2 pl., short-vowel subj. with ἄν (= ἰθύνητε)
glossary.ἰχθυάᾳ: ἰχθυάω — fish, catch fish; pres. 3 sg., epic -άᾳ (= Attic -ᾷ)
glossary.ἱστοπέδῃ: ἱστοπέδη — mast-step, the block in which the mast stands; fem. dat. sg.
glossary.ὀλοοῖο: ὀλοός — destructive, deadly; adj., neut. gen. sg. (with πυρός), epic -οιο (= Attic -οῦ)
glossary.ὀξείῃ: ὀξύς — sharp, pointed; adj., fem. dat. sg.
glossary.ὀπώρῃ: ὀπώρα — late summer, early autumn; fem. dat. sg., Ionic -ῃ
glossary.ὀρθὸν: ὀρθός — upright, straight; masc. acc. sg., agreeing with the pronoun σ’ · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with με: ’upright’ (ὀρθὸν ἐν ἱστοπέδῃ)
glossary.ὀστεόφιν: ὀστέον — bone; neut. pl. in -φιν, an epic gen./dat. ending (= Attic ὀστῶν/ὀστέοις)
glossary.ὁπποτέρη: ὁπότερος — which of two; indirect interrog. adj., fem. nom. sg., epic doubled-π (= Attic ὁπότερος)
glossary.ὄπ: ὄψ — voice; fem. acc. sg., elided (ὄπ’ = ὄπα)
glossary.ὅση: ὅσος — as great as, as much as; relative adj., fem. nom. sg., of measure
glossary.ὑπήλθετε: ὑπέρχομαι — go under, go down into; aor. 2 pl. (ὑπῆλθον), + acc.
glossary.ῥοχθεῖ: ῥοχθέω — roar, dash with a roar (of waves); pres. 3 sg.
glossary.αὐγὴ: αὐγή — ray, beam, gleam of light; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.βωστρεῖν: βωστρέω — call upon, summon; pres. inf., used as an imperative: ’call on!’
glossary.βόες: βοῦς — ox, cow; pl. ’cattle’; masc./fem. nom. pl.
glossary.βόσκοντ: βόσκω — feed, pasture; mid. graze; pres. 3 pl. mid., elided (βόσκοντ’ = βόσκονται)
glossary.δήσατ: δέω — bind, make fast; aor. imper. 2 pl., elided (δήσατ’ = δήσατε): ’bind!’
glossary.δεσμῷ: δεσμός — bond, fetter; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.δηθύνῃσθα: δηθύνω — linger, delay; pres. subj. 2 sg., epic -σθα ending (= Attic δηθύνῃς)
glossary.διοϊστεύσειας: διοϊστεύω — shoot an arrow through or across; aor. opt. 2 sg., potential with κεν: ’you could shoot across’
glossary.διώκοντες: διώκω — pursue, drive on, chase; pres. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’driving on’ (of rowers)
glossary.θάνωμεν: θνῄσκω — die; aor. subj. 1 pl., with κε: ’we may die’
glossary.θεσπεσιάων: θεσπέσιος — wondrous, divinely sounding; fem. gen. pl., epic -άων (= Attic -ῶν)
glossary.θνητή: θνητός — mortal, subject to death; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.θρέψασα: τρέφω — rear, nourish; aor. part. fem. nom. sg.: ’having reared’
glossary.θρινακίην: Θρινακίη — Thrinacia, island of the Sun’s cattle; fem. acc. sg., epic -ίη (= Attic -ία)
glossary.κάρτιστον: κάρτιστος — best, mightiest; epic superlative (= Attic κράτιστος); neut. nom. sg., predicate
glossary.κέλετο: κέλομαι — urge on, bid, command; impf. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented (= ἐκέλετο)
glossary.κίχῃσι: κιχάνω — reach, overtake, catch; aor. subj. 3 sg., epic -ῃσι (= Attic κίχῃ), after μή ’lest’
glossary.κακοῦ: κακός — bad, evil; neut. gen. sg., substantive: ’the evil, the mischief’
glossary.κατάστησον: καθίστημι — set down, bring to a stand; aor. imper. 2 sg. act.: ’bring to a halt!’
glossary.κεφαλῇσι: κεφαλή — head; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῇσι (= Attic -αῖς)
glossary.κηροῖο: κηρός — wax; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -οῦ)
glossary.κορυσσόμενος: κορύσσω — arm, equip (with helmet); mid. arm oneself; pres. part. mid. masc. nom. sg.: ’arming oneself’
glossary.κράταιιν: Κράταιις — Crataeis, mother of Scylla; fem. acc. sg. (Κράταιιν)
glossary.λέγων: λέγω — say, tell, recount; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’telling’ · also λέγω — gather, pick up; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’gathering’ (αἱμασιὰς λέγων ’gathering stones for walls’)
glossary.λίσσωμαι: λίσσομαι — beg, entreat; pres. subj. 1 sg. mid., in a protasis with κε: ’if I beg’
glossary.λαμπετίη: Λαμπετίη — Lampetie (’Shining’), a daughter of the Sun; fem. nom. sg., epic -ίη (= Attic -ία)
glossary.λειμῶν: λειμών — meadow; masc. acc. sg., elided (λειμῶν’ = λειμῶνα)
glossary.λεύκαινον: λευκαίνω — make white, whiten; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented (= ἐλεύκαινον)
glossary.λιγυρὴν: λιγυρός — clear, shrill, sweet-sounding; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.μέμηλε: μέλω — be a care to (+ dat.); perf. 3 sg. with pres. force, epic (Attic μεμέληκε): ’is a care’
glossary.μίμνω: μένω — stay, remain, hold one’s place; pres. 1 sg., epic reduplicated form (= μένω), subj. after ὄφρα
glossary.μαχητόν: μαχητός — to be fought, fit for fighting (verbal adj. of μάχομαι); neut. nom. sg.
glossary.μελίγηρυν: μελίγηρυς — honey-voiced, sweet-toned; fem. acc. sg., with ὄπα
glossary.μετηύδων: μεταυδάω — speak among, address (+ dat.); impf. 1 sg., augment contracted (μετ-ηύδων)
glossary.μηρύσαντο: μηρύομαι — furl, draw in (sails); aor. 3 pl. mid., unaugmented (= ἐμηρύσαντο)
glossary.μόγησαν: μογέω — toil, suffer hardship; aor. 3 pl., unaugmented (= ἐμόγησαν)
glossary.νέαιρα: Νέαιρα — Neaera, a goddess, mother of the Sun’s nymphs; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.νεῖται: νέομαι — go, come, go one’s way; pres. 3 sg., contracted epic (= νέεται), here ’goes on his way’
glossary.νωιτέρην: νωίτερος — of us two, belonging to us two; dual possessive adj., fem. acc. sg. (cf. ἡμέτερος)
glossary.ξεστῇς: ξεστός — polished, smoothed; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῇς (= Attic ξεσταῖς)
glossary.οὔατα: οὖς — ear; neut. acc. pl., epic οὔατα (= Attic ὦτα)
glossary.πίεζον: πιέζω — press, squeeze; impf. 1 sg., unaugmented (= ἐπίεζον): ’I pressed’ · also impf. 3 pl.: ’they pressed’ (πλείοσί μ’ ἐν δεσμοῖσι … πίεζον ’they pressed me in more bonds’)
glossary.πίφαυσκον: πιφαύσκω — make known, declare, tell; impf. 1 sg., unaugmented (= ἐπίφαυσκον), reduplicated present stem: ’I kept declaring’
glossary.παρήλασε: παρελαύνω — drive past, sail past; aor. 3 sg. (παρήλασε = παρ-ήλασε)
glossary.πεπλημένος: πελάζω (πλάθω) — bring near; pass. draw near to (+ dat.); perf. part. pass. masc. nom. sg.: ’drawn close’
glossary.πλείονα: πολύς — much, many; comparative πλείων; neut. acc. pl. πλείονα: ’more’
glossary.ποθήμεναι: ποθέω — miss, long for; pres. inf., epic -ήμεναι (= Attic ποθεῖν)
glossary.πολεμήια: πολεμήιος — of war, warlike; neut. nom. pl., epic -ήιος (= Attic πολεμικός)
glossary.πολύαιν: πολύαινος — much-praised, of great renown; masc. voc. sg., elided (πολύαιν’ = πολύαινε)
glossary.σίνοιτό: σίνομαι — harm, damage, plunder; pres. opt. 3 sg. mid., accented before the enclitic γε; in a clause after ὅτε
glossary.σκύλλης: Σκύλλη — Scylla, the sea-monster of the cliff; fem. gen. sg.
glossary.σφοδρῶς: σφοδρῶς — vehemently, with all one’s force; adv.
glossary.τεθηλώς: θάλλω — bloom, flourish, be luxuriant; perf. part. masc. nom. sg. (τέθηλα): ’flourishing’
glossary.τεκοῦσά: τίκτω — bear, give birth to; aor. part. fem. nom. sg., accented before the enclitic τε
glossary.τερψάμενος: τέρπω — delight; mid. take one’s pleasure; aor. part. mid. masc. nom. sg.: ’having delighted himself’
glossary.τροχὸν: τροχός — wheel, round disc; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.τρῶές: Τρώς — Trojan; masc. nom. pl. Τρῶες, accented before the enclitic τε
glossary.τυτθὰ: τυτθός — small, little; neut. acc. pl. used adverbially: ’in small bits’
glossary.τόσους: τόσος — so many, as many; correlative demonstrative adj., masc. acc. pl.
glossary.τόσσῃσιν: τόσσος — so many, as many; epic double σ (= τόσος); fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσιν (= Attic -αις)
glossary.τύχοις: τυγχάνω — happen to be, chance to be; aor. opt. 2 sg., in a wish with μή: ’may you not chance to be’
glossary.φέρτερόν: φέρτερος — better, stronger; comparative (suppletive to ἀγαθός); neut. nom. sg., predicate
glossary.φαέθουσά: Φαέθουσα — Phaethusa (’Shining’), a daughter of the Sun; fem. nom. sg., accented before the enclitic τε
glossary.χάρυβδιν: Χάρυβδις — Charybdis, the whirlpool monster; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.χάρυβδις: Χάρυβδις — Charybdis, the whirlpool monster; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.χθαμαλώτερον: χθαμαλός — low-lying, low; comparative χθαμαλώτερος; masc. acc. sg.: ’lower’
glossary.ἀλευάμενοι: ἀλέομαι — avoid, shun, escape; aor. part. mid. masc. nom. pl., epic ἀλεύομαι stem
glossary.ἀλεύασθαι: ἀλέομαι — avoid, shun; aor. inf. mid., epic ἀλεύομαι stem
glossary.ἀλκή: ἀλκή — defence, strength to resist; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀναροιβδεῖ: ἀναρροιβδέω — suck down again, gulp back; pres. 3 sg., contracted (= -έει), single-ρ spelling
glossary.ἀναρροιβδεῖ: ἀναρροιβδέω — suck down again, gulp back; pres. 3 sg., contracted (= -έει)
glossary.ἀνθεμόεντα: ἀνθεμόεις — flowery, rich in blossoms; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀνῆπτον: ἀνάπτω — fasten to, tie up; impf. 3 pl.
glossary.ἀπέστιχε: ἀποστείχω — go away, depart; aor. 3 sg. (ἀπέστιχε, 2nd aorist)
glossary.ἀποπαύσει: ἀποπαύω — make cease, stop (+ acc. and inf.); fut. 3 sg.
glossary.ἀπῴκισε: ἀποικίζω — settle away, send to live far off; aor. 3 sg.
glossary.ἀργαλέῳ: ἀργαλέος — hard, grievous, painful; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.ἄλειψα: ἀλείφω — anoint, smear; aor. 1 sg., unaugmented (= ἤλειψα): ’I smeared’
glossary.ἐγών: ἐγώ — I; nom. sg., epic form with ν (= ἐγώ)
glossary.ἐλάτῃσιν: ἐλάτη — fir; fir-wood oar; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσιν (= Attic -αις), instrumental
glossary.ἐξίκετο: ἐξικνέομαι — arrive at, reach; aor. 3 sg. mid.
glossary.ἐπιποιμένες: ἐπιποιμήν — herdsman set over a flock, shepherd; nom. pl. (of goddesses, hence fem.)
glossary.ἐρινεὸς: ἐρινεός — wild fig tree; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἐυεργὴς: ἐυεργής — well-made, well-wrought; fem. nom. sg., epithet of a ship (= Attic εὐεργής)
glossary.ἐυπλόκαμοι: ἐϋπλόκαμος — fair-tressed, with fine plaits; fem. nom. pl. (= Attic εὐπλόκαμοι)
glossary.ἐφορμηθεῖσα: ἐφορμάω — set upon, rush at; aor. part. pass. fem. nom. sg., middle sense: ’having rushed upon’
glossary.ἔντυνον: ἐντύνω — make ready, set in train; impf. 3 pl.: ’they set going’
glossary.ἕληται: αἱρέω — take, seize; aor. subj. 3 sg. mid., after μή ’lest’; with ἐκ in tmesis, ’take out’
glossary.ὀλοὴν: ὀλοός — deadly, destructive; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ὀρνυμένη: ὄρνυμι — rouse, stir; mid. rush, dart; pres. part. mid. fem. nom. sg.: ’rushing’
glossary.ὁρμηθῆναι: ὁρμάω — set in motion; pass. rush forth; aor. inf. pass.: ’to rush out’
glossary.ὄψει: ὁράω — see; fut. 2 sg. mid., epic -ει (= Attic ὄψῃ)
glossary.ὑπείξεαι: ὑπείκω — give way, yield (+ dat.); fut. 2 sg. mid., epic -εαι (= Attic ὑπείξῃ)
glossary.ὑπεκπροφύγοιμι: ὑπεκπροφεύγω — flee out from under, escape entirely; aor. opt. 1 sg., after εἴ πως: ’if I might escape’ · also aor. opt. 1 sg. with κεν, potential, in a question: ’whither could I escape?’
glossary.ὑπερίονι: Ὑπερίων — Hyperion, a name of the Sun; masc. dat. sg., in apposition with Ἠελίῳ
glossary.ὑπεριονίδαο: Ὑπεριονίδης — son of Hyperion, i.e. the Sun; masc. gen. sg., epic -αο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.ῥοιβδήσειεν: ῥοιβδέω — gulp down with a roar, suck in noisily; aor. opt. 3 sg., in a clause after ὅτε
glossary.ῥύσαιτό: ῥύομαι — rescue, save, draw out; aor. opt. 3 sg. mid., potential with κεν, accented before the enclitic σε
glossary.αἰαίης: Αἰαῖος, -αίη — Aeaean, of Aeaea; fem. gen. sg., Ionic -ης (= Attic -ας), epithet of Circe
glossary.αὐλιζομενάων: αὐλίζομαι — lodge in a yard or fold, bed down; pres. part. mid. fem. gen. pl., epic -άων (= Attic -ῶν)
glossary.βάλλευ: βάλλω — throw, cast, lay; pres. imper. mid. 2 sg., epic -ευ (= Attic βάλλου): ’lay (it)!’
glossary.βάλῃσθα: βάλλω — throw, cast; aor. subj. 2 sg., epic -σθα ending (= Attic βάλῃς), in a ’lest’ clause after μή: ’you cast’
glossary.βίηφί: βίη — force, might, violence; instrumental case in -φι (= dat. βίῃ): ’in might’
glossary.βληχήν: βληχή — bleating (of sheep); fem. acc. sg.
glossary.βόμβησαν: βομβέω — boom, resound; aor. 3 pl., unaugmented (= ἐβόμβησαν): ’they boomed’
glossary.γοόωντες: γοάω — groan, wail; pres. part. masc. nom. pl., epic uncontracted -όωντες (= Attic γοῶντες)
glossary.δέον: δέω — bind, make fast; impf. 3 pl., epic uncontracted, unaugmented (= Attic ἔδουν): ’they bound’
glossary.δεινήν: δεινός — dread, terrible; fem. acc. sg., agreeing with Χάρυβδιν
glossary.δεσμῶν: δεσμός — bond, fetter; masc. gen. pl. (ἐκ δεσμῶν ’out of the bonds’)
glossary.δυνάμην: δύναμαι — be able, can; impf. 1 sg. mid., unaugmented (= Attic ἐδυνάμην): ’I could’
glossary.δώῃ: δίδωμι — give, grant; aor. subj. 3 sg. (= Attic δῷ), after αἴ κε: ’may grant’ · also aor. subj. 3 sg. in a general relative clause, without κε: ’gives, is to give’ (οἵ τ’ … βῶσιν καί σφι Ζεὺς … δώῃ) · also aor. subj. 3 sg. in a prospective relative clause with κε: ’who shall give’ (ὅς κ’ … τάμῃσι … δώῃ) · also aor. subj. 3 sg. in a purpose clause after ὄφρα: ’may give’ (ὄφρα … δώῃ γέρας ’so that he may give a prize’) · also aor. subj. 3 sg. in the protasis after εἴ κε, continuing a preceding subj.: ’grants’ (εἴ κέ μιν ἐντανύσῃ, δώῃ δέ οἱ εὖχος ’if he strings it, and grants him glory’)
glossary.εἴλει: εἴλω (εἰλέω) — shut in, pen up; impf. 3 sg.: ’was shutting in’
glossary.εὐρυμέτωποι: εὐρυμέτωπος — broad-browed; two-ending adj., fem. nom. pl., agreeing with βόες
glossary.θωρήσσεσθαι: θωρήσσω — arm, put on armour; mid. pres. inf., epic -σσ- (= Attic θωρήττεσθαι): ’to arm oneself’
glossary.κέρας: κέρας — horn; neut. acc. sg., object of προΐησι
glossary.καπνοῦ: καπνός — smoke; masc. gen. sg., governed by ἐκτός · also masc. gen. sg., governed by ἐκ: ’out of the smoke’
glossary.κατήσθιε: κατεσθίω — eat up, devour; impf. 3 sg., without movable ν (= κατήσθιεν): ’was devouring’
glossary.καταδὺς: καταδύω — go down into, put on (armour); 2nd aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg. (intrans. aor. κατέδυν): ’having put on’
glossary.κεκληγῶτας: κλάζω — scream, shriek; perf. part. κεκληγώς with pres. force, masc. acc. pl., epic -ῶτας (= Attic -ότας): ’screaming’
glossary.κληίδεσσιν: κληΐς — thwart, rowing-bench; fem. dat. pl., epic -εσσιν (= Attic -σι)
glossary.κυβερνῆθ: κυβερνήτης — helmsman; masc. voc. sg., elided and aspirated (κυβερνῆθ’ = κυβερνῆτα)
glossary.κυκωμένη: κυκάω — stir up, churn; pres. part. pass. fem. nom. sg.: ’churned’
glossary.κώπῃσιν: κώπη — oar, oar-handle; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσιν (= Attic -αις): ’with oars’
glossary.λάθῃσι: λανθάνω — escape the notice of (+ acc.); aor. subj. 3 sg., epic -σι (= Attic λάθῃ), after μή: ’lest it escape (you)’
glossary.λέβης: λέβης — cauldron, kettle; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.λανθανόμην: λανθάνομαι (λήθομαι) — forget, + gen.; impf. 1 sg. mid., unaugmented (= Attic ἐλανθανόμην): ’I forgot’
glossary.μάκρ: μακρός — long; neut. acc. pl., elided (μάκρ’ = μακρά), agreeing with δοῦρε
glossary.μαντήια: μαντήιον — oracle, prophecy; neut. acc. pl., epic (= Attic μαντεῖα)
glossary.μνήσεσθαι: μιμνῄσκω — remind; mid. remember, be mindful of (+ gen.); fut. inf. mid.: ’to be mindful’
glossary.μυκηθμοῦ: μυκηθμός — lowing, bellowing (of cattle); masc. gen. sg.
glossary.νευστάζων: νευστάζω — nod repeatedly, make signs; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’nodding’
glossary.νωμᾷς: νωμάω — handle, ply, steer; pres. 2 sg. (contracted νωμάεις): ’you handle’
glossary.οἰήια: οἰήιον — steering-oar, helm (= Attic οἴαξ); neut. acc. pl.: ’steering-gear’
glossary.οἴκτιστον: οἰκτρός — pitiable, piteous; superl. οἴκτιστος, neut. acc. sg., predicate: ’most pitiable’
glossary.παπταίνοντι: παπταίνω — look about, peer; pres. part. masc. dat. sg., agreeing with μοι: ’as I peered’
glossary.παρήλασαν: παρελαύνω — drive past, sail past; aor. 3 pl. (παρ-ήλασαν): ’they sailed past’
glossary.πειθώμεθα: πείθω — persuade; mid. obey, + dat.; pres. subj. mid. 1 pl., hortatory: ’let us obey’
glossary.πετραίην: πετραῖος — of the rock, rock-dwelling; fem. acc. sg., epic -ην (= Attic -αν)
glossary.πλείοσί: πολύς — much, many; comp. πλείων, masc. dat. pl.: ’more’
glossary.προΐησι: προΐημι — send forth, let down; pres. 3 sg., in a simile: ’lets down’
glossary.προήκεα: προήκης — pointed, tapering; neut. acc. pl., epic uncontracted -εα (= Attic -η), agreeing with ἐρετμά
glossary.προβόλῳ: πρόβολος — jutting rock, headland; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.πρῴρης: πρῷρα — prow, bow; fem. gen. sg., Ionic -ης (= Attic πρῴρας)
glossary.πυκάζοιεν: πυκάζω — pack closely, cover thickly; pres. opt. 3 pl., in a negative purpose clause after μή: ’they might pack’
glossary.πόρους: πόρος — passage, way across the sea; masc. acc. pl.
glossary.πᾶσ: πᾶς — all, whole; fem. nom. sg., elided (πᾶσ’ = πᾶσα), of Charybdis: ’all of her’
glossary.πῆμ: πῆμα — woe, calamity; neut. acc. sg., elided (πῆμ’ = πῆμα) · also neut. nom. sg., elided (πῆμ’ = πῆμα), subject: ’woe’ (πῆμ’ ὑπέδεκτο ’woe awaited’)
glossary.σκεψάμενος: σκέπτομαι — look about, observe; aor. part. mid. masc. nom. sg.: ’having looked’
glossary.σκοπέλοισιν: σκόπελος — crag, rock-peak; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις)
glossary.σκοπέλου: σκόπελος — crag, rock-peak; masc. gen. sg., with ἐπιμαίεο: ’make for the crag’
glossary.σκύλλην: Σκύλλη — Scylla, the sea monster; fem. acc. sg., Ionic/epic (= Attic Σκύλλαν)
glossary.στεινωπὸν: στεινωπός — narrow; acc. sg., used as a noun: ’narrow passage, strait’ (epic = Attic στενωπός)
glossary.στυγερῷ: στυγερός — hateful, loathsome; masc. dat. sg., with μύθῳ
glossary.τερψιμβρότου: τερψίμβροτος — delighting mortals; masc. gen. sg., epithet of Helios
glossary.τύπτετε: τύπτω — strike, beat; pres. imper. 2 pl.: ’strike!’
glossary.φέρτατοι: φέρτατος — best, mightiest; superl. of ἀγαθός (cf. φέρτερος), masc. nom. pl.
glossary.φανεῖσθαι: φαίνω — show; mid. appear; fut. inf. mid. (φανέομαι), after ἐδέγμην: ’to appear’
glossary.φθογγῆς: φθογγή — voice, sound; fem. gen. sg., governed by ἠκούομεν
glossary.ψάμμῳ: ψάμμος — sand; fem. dat. sg., instrumental: ’with sand’
glossary.ἀγραύλοιο: ἀγραῦλος — living in the fields; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου), with βοός
glossary.ἀδαήμονές: ἀδαήμων — unversed in, ignorant of (+ gen.); masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἀείροντο: ἀείρω — lift, raise (= Attic αἴρω); impf. 3 pl. pass.: ’were lifted’
glossary.ἀειρομένων: ἀείρω — lift, raise (= Attic αἴρω); pres. part. pass. masc. gen. pl.: ’being lifted’
glossary.ἀθρῆσαι: ἀθρέω — look at, catch sight of; aor. inf. act., complementary with δυνάμην
glossary.ἀκουέμεναι: ἀκούω — hear; pres. inf., epic -έμεναι (= Attic ἀκούειν)
glossary.ἀνέλυσαν: ἀναλύω — loose, unbind; aor. 3 pl.: ’they loosed’
glossary.ἀνίην: ἀνίη — distress, trouble; fem. acc. sg., epic -ίη (= Attic ἀνία), in apposition
glossary.ἀναβρόξειε: ἀναβρόχω — gulp back, swallow down again; aor. opt. 3 sg., in a past-general ὅτε clause: ’whenever she gulped back’
glossary.ἀναμορμύρεσκε: ἀναμορμύρω — seethe up with a roar; iterative impf. 3 sg. in -σκε, unaugmented: ’would seethe up’
glossary.ἀνεπλέομεν: ἀναπλέω — sail up; impf. 1 pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἀνεπλοῦμεν): ’we sailed up’
glossary.ἀνερροίβδησε: ἀναρροιβδέω — gulp down, suck down; aor. 3 sg. (ῥ doubled after the augment): ’it sucked down’
glossary.ἀπολλήξειαν: ἀπολλήγω — cease from, leave off (+ gen.); aor. opt. 3 pl., in a negative purpose clause after μή: ’they might cease’
glossary.ἀσπαίροντες: ἀσπαίρω — gasp, quiver, struggle; pres. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’gasping’
glossary.ἄκροισι: ἄκρος — topmost, at the top; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις), with σκοπέλοισιν
glossary.ἄλειψ: ἀλείφω — anoint, smear; aor. 1 sg., elided (ἄλειψ’ = ἄλειψα), unaugmented (= ἤλειψα)
glossary.ἄπρηκτον: ἄπρηκτος — without remedy, not to be dealt with; two-ending adj., fem. acc. sg., with ἀνίην
glossary.ἄχνη: ἄχνη — foam, spray; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἐβεβρύχει: βρύχω — roar, gnash; plpf. 3 sg. of βέβρυχα with impf. sense: ’roared’
glossary.ἐκφύγομεν: ἐκφεύγω — flee out, escape; aor. 1 pl., unaugmented (= Attic ἐξεφύγομεν): ’we escaped’
glossary.ἐλαύνετε: ἐλαύνω — drive, row, sail; pres. imper. 2 pl.: ’drive!’
glossary.ἐλείπομεν: λείπω — leave, quit; impf. 1 pl.: ’we were leaving’
glossary.ἐμόγησα: μογέω — toil, suffer hardship; aor. 1 sg.: ’I toiled through’
glossary.ἐξεμέσειε: ἐξεμέω — vomit forth, spew out; aor. opt. 3 sg., in a past-general ὅτε clause: ’whenever she vomited’
glossary.ἐξερεείνων: ἐξερεείνω — search out, inquire into; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’searching out’
glossary.ἐξονομακλήδην: ἐξονομακλήδην — calling by name, naming each one; adv. (ἐξ + ὄνομα + κλήδην)
glossary.ἐξορμήσασα: ἐξορμάω — rush forth, dart off; aor. part. act. fem. nom. sg., of the ship: ’darting off’
glossary.ἐπέτελλε: ἐπιτέλλω — lay charge on, enjoin (+ dat. + inf.); impf. 3 sg.: ’laid charge’
glossary.ἐφήμενοι: ἔφημαι — sit upon (+ dat.); pres. part. mid. masc. nom. pl.: ’sitting upon’
glossary.ἐφημοσύνης: ἐφημοσύνη — behest, charge, injunction; fem. gen. sg., with λανθανόμην
glossary.ἔεργε: εἴργω (ἔργω) — shut out, keep away; pres. imper. 2 sg., epic ἔεργε (= Attic εἶργε): ’keep (it) outside!’
glossary.ἔκαμον: κάμνω — grow weary, toil; aor. 3 pl. (ἔκαμον): ’grew weary’ · also aor. 1 sg. + part.: ’I grew weary (of)’ (ἔκαμον τανύων ’I toiled stringing’)
glossary.ἔπειγον: ἐπείγω — press, drive on; impf. 3 pl.: ’they plied’ (of oars)
glossary.ἔφασκεν: φάσκω — say, assert; impf. 3 sg., iterative: ’she kept saying’
glossary.ἕλεθ: αἱρέω — take, seize; aor. mid. 3 sg., elided and aspirated (ἕλεθ’ = ἕλετο)
glossary.ἕπει: ἕπω — be about, be busy with; of evils, be upon, attend; pres. 3 sg.: ’is upon (us)’
glossary.ἠκούομεν: ἀκούω — hear; impf. 1 pl.: ’we were hearing’
glossary.ἱεῖσαι: ἵημι — send forth, utter; pres. part. act. fem. nom. pl.: ’sending forth’
glossary.ἴδομεν: ὁράω — see, look; aor. 1 pl. ἴδομεν, unaugmented (= Attic εἴδομεν): ’we looked’
glossary.ὀλίγοισι: ὀλίγος — little, small; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
glossary.ὀρέγοντας: ὀρέγω — stretch out, reach; pres. part. act. masc. acc. pl.: ’stretching out’
glossary.ὑπεκφυγέειν: ὑπεκφεύγω — flee from under, escape; aor. inf., epic -έειν (= Attic ὑπεκφυγεῖν)
glossary.ὑψόσε: ὑψόσε — upward, on high; adv. (cf. elided ὑψόσ’)
glossary.ὕστατον: ὕστατος — last; neut. acc. sg., used adverbially: ’for the last time’
glossary.ὠσὶν: οὖς — ear; neut. dat. pl. (gen. ὠτός), ν-movable
glossary.ῥηγμῖνα: ῥηγμίν — surf, breakers on the shore; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.αἰθομένοις: αἴθω — kindle, burn; pres. part. pass. neut. dat. pl.: ’burning’ (agreeing with ἱεροῖσιν)
glossary.αἵδε: ὅδε, ἥδε, τόδε — this, this here; demonstrative pron., fem. nom. pl., agreeing with βόες: ’these (cattle)’ · also fem. nom. pl., agreeing with κύνες: ’these (dogs)’
glossary.βιάζετε: βιάζω — use force on, press hard; pres. 2 pl. act. (+ acc.): ’you press (me)’
glossary.βοσκέσκονθ: βόσκω — feed; mid. graze; impf. 3 pl. mid., iterative -εσκ-, unaugmented, elided (βοσκέσκονθ’ = βοσκέσκοντο, Attic ἐβόσκοντο): ’they were grazing’
glossary.βουλῆς: βουλή — counsel, plan, design; fem. gen. sg., Ionic η (= Attic βουλῆς), with ἐξήρχετο
glossary.βούλομ: βούλομαι — wish, prefer; pres. 1 sg. mid., elided (βούλομ’ = βούλομαι): ’I prefer’ (with ἤ ’rather than’)
glossary.γίγνετ: γίγνομαι — become, arise, come to be; impf. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented, elided (γίγνετ’ = γίγνετο, Attic ἐγίγνετο): ’arose’
glossary.δεινοῦ: δεινός — dread, awful, terrible; masc. gen. sg., agreeing with θεοῦ
glossary.δηλήματα: δήλημα — bane, destroyer, harm; neut. nom. pl., in apposition with ἄνεμοι: ’bane’
glossary.διαρραίουσι: διαρραίω — shatter utterly, wreck; pres. 3 pl. act. (ῥαίω with δια-, ρ doubled after the prefix)
glossary.δρεψάμενοι: δρέπω — pluck, gather; aor. part. mid. masc. nom. pl.: ’having plucked’
glossary.δρυὸς: δρῦς — oak; fem. gen. sg.: ’of an oak’
glossary.δυσαέος: δυσαής — ill-blowing, of foul wind; masc. gen. sg., epic uncontracted -έος (= Attic -οῦς), epithet of Zephyrus
glossary.εἰσερύσαντες: εἰσερύω — drag in, haul in; aor. part. act. masc. nom. pl., epic (= Attic εἰσελκύσαντες): ’having dragged in’
glossary.εὐξαίμην: εὔχομαι — pray, vow; aor. opt. mid. 1 sg., in a purpose clause after ὄφρα: ’I might pray’
glossary.εὕρωμεν: εὑρίσκω — find; aor. subj. act. 1 pl., in an εἴ κε clause: ’we find, we should find’
glossary.ζαῆν: ζαής — blowing hard, stormy (ζα- intensive); masc. acc. sg., agreeing with ἄνεμον
glossary.θεῖμεν: τίθημι — put, place, set up; aor. opt. act. 1 pl. (= θείημεν), with κε, potential: ’we would set up’
glossary.θόωκοι: θόωκος — seat; masc. nom. pl., epic (= Attic θῶκοι, θᾶκοι)
glossary.κάμνεις: κάμνω — toil, grow weary; pres. 2 sg. act.: ’you grow weary’
glossary.κακῇσιν: κακός — bad, evil; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσιν (= Attic -αῖς), agreeing with ἀτασθαλίῃσι
glossary.καλοὶ: καλός — beautiful, fair, fine; masc. nom. pl., agreeing with χοροί
glossary.κλαιόντεσσι: κλαίω — weep; pres. part. act. masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic κλαίουσι): ’to them weeping’
glossary.κνίσης: κνῖσα (epic κνίση) — savour of burning fat; fem. gen. sg., Ionic η (= Attic κνίσης): ’of the fat’
glossary.λαρὸν: λαρός — tasty, pleasant; masc. acc. sg., agreeing with δόρπον
glossary.λεῖψαι: λείβω — pour, pour as a libation; aor. inf. act. (μέθυ λεῖψαι ’to pour wine’)
glossary.λιλαιόμενοι: λιλαίομαι — long for, desire (+ gen.); pres. part. mid. masc. nom. pl.: ’longing for’
glossary.μνησάμενοι: μιμνήσκω — remind; mid. remember, call to mind; aor. part. mid. masc. nom. pl.: ’having remembered’
glossary.νηὸν: ναός (epic νηός) — temple, shrine; masc. acc. sg. (= Attic ναόν)
glossary.νυκτῶν: νύξ — night; fem. gen. pl.: ’of the nights’
glossary.νυμφέων: νύμφη — nymph; fem. gen. pl., Ionic -έων (= Attic -ῶν)
glossary.νότου: Νότος — the South Wind, personified; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.πάθωμεν: πάσχω — suffer, experience; aor. subj. 1 pl., after μή: ’lest we suffer’
glossary.περί: περί — around, about; adv. ’exceedingly, beyond others’ (περί τοι μένος ’you have strength beyond others’) · also adv. or preverb with ἦλθε (περί … ἦλθε ’came about’), exact force uncertain · also prep. + gen., ’about, concerning’ (περί τ’ αὐτοῦ καὶ περὶ πάντων ’about himself and about all’)
glossary.περίστησάν: περιίστημι — set around; aor. 3 pl. act., unaugmented (= Attic περιέστησαν): ’they stood (them) around’
glossary.πῶυ: πῶυ — flock (of sheep); neut. acc. sg., epic
glossary.σπένδοντες: σπένδω — pour a libation; pres. part. act. masc. nom. pl.: ’pouring a libation’
glossary.στήσαμεν: ἵστημι — set up, make stand; aor. 1 pl. act., unaugmented (= Attic ἐστήσαμεν): ’we stood (the ship) at moorings’
glossary.στρεύγεσθαι: στρεύγομαι — be worn out, waste away; pres. inf. mid./pass.: ’to be worn away’
glossary.στυγεροὶ: στυγερός — hateful, loathsome; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.σχέτλιός: σχέτλιος — cruel, hard, unyielding; masc. nom. sg., predicate, with accent from the enclitic εἰς
glossary.τέρενα: τέρην, τέρεινα, τέρεν — tender, soft; neut. acc. pl., agreeing with φύλλα
glossary.τελεύτησάν: τελευτάω — bring to an end, complete; aor. 3 pl., unaugmented (= Attic ἐτελεύτησαν): ’they completed’
glossary.τετυκοίμεθα: τεύχω — make, prepare; aor. opt. mid. 1 pl., epic reduplicated aorist (τετυκ-): ’we might prepare’
glossary.τετύκοντο: τεύχω — make, prepare; aor. 3 pl. mid., epic reduplicated aorist, unaugmented (= Attic ἐτεύξαντο): ’they prepared’
glossary.τεύξομεν: τεύχω — make, build; fut. 1 pl. (or short-vowel aor. subj. with κεν): ’we will build’
glossary.φήνειε: φαίνω — show, reveal; aor. opt. act. 3 sg., in a wish-condition after εἴ: ’might show’
glossary.χανὼν: χάσκω — gape, open the mouth wide; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’gaping’
glossary.χολωσάμενός: χολόω — anger; mid. be angered; aor. part. mid. masc. nom. sg., accent from the enclitic τι: ’having been angered’
glossary.χοροὶ: χορός — dancing-place, dance; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἀγάλματα: ἄγαλμα — ornament, glory, offering to a god; neut. acc. pl.
glossary.ἀθανάτη: ἀθάνατος — immortal, deathless; fem. nom. sg., epic -η (= Attic ἀθάνατος, two-ending), epithet of Circe
glossary.ἀλητεύοντες: ἀλητεύω — wander, roam about; pres. part. act. masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἀμφήλυθεν: ἀμφέρχομαι — come around, envelop; aor. 3 sg., epic ἀμφήλυθε(ν) (= Attic ἀμφῆλθε), with movable ν
glossary.ἀνάκτων: ἄναξ — lord, master; masc. gen. pl. (θεῶν ἀνάκτων ’of the lord gods’)
glossary.ἀπέστιχον: ἀποστείχω — go away, depart; impf. 1 sg.: ’I went off’
glossary.ἀπέχοντο: ἀπέχω — hold off; mid. keep away from (+ gen.); impf. 3 pl. mid.: ’they held off’
glossary.ἀπεχώμεθα: ἀπέχω — hold off; mid. keep away from (+ gen.); pres. subj. mid. 1 pl., hortatory: ’let us keep away’
glossary.ἀποκτάνῃ: ἀποκτείνω — kill; aor. subj. 3 sg. (epic 2nd aor. -κτάν-; Attic aor. ἀπέκτεινα), after μή: ’let him (not) kill’
glossary.ἀποπλαγχθέντας: ἀποπλάζω — drive off course; aor. part. pass. masc. acc. pl.: ’driven off course’
glossary.ἀπώμνυον: ἀπόμνυμι — swear, take an oath; impf. 3 pl.: ’they swore’
glossary.ἀρίστας: ἄριστος — best; fem. acc. pl.: ’the best (cattle)’
glossary.ἀτασθαλίῃσι: ἀτασθαλία — reckless folly, wantonness; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι (= Attic -αις), instrumental: ’through folly’
glossary.ἀυτμή: ἀυτμή — breath, vapour, blast; fem. nom. sg.: ’vapour’
glossary.ἁδηκότας: ἁδέω — be sated, worn out (+ dat.); perf. part. act. masc. acc. pl., epic: ’worn out’
glossary.ἄγρην: ἄγρη — hunting, game, catch; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἄη: ἄημι — blow; impf. 3 sg., epic uncontracted, unaugmented (= Attic ἄη, ἔπνει): ’blew’
glossary.ἄλληκτος: ἄληκτος — unceasing; masc. nom. sg., epic doubled λ, agreeing with Νότος: ’unceasing’
glossary.ἄνωγας: ἄνωγα — bid, command (perf. with present sense); perf. 2 sg., epic: ’you bid’
glossary.ἐθέλῃ: ἐθέλω — be willing, wish; pres. subj. 3 sg., in an εἰ clause without κε: ’is willing’ · also with κεν in a general relative clause: ’may wish’ (ὅττι κεν ᾧ θυμῷ ἐθέλῃ ’whatever he may wish in his heart’)
glossary.ἐλάσαντες: ἐλαύνω — drive, drive off; aor. part. act. masc. nom. pl.: ’having driven off’
glossary.ἐξέταμον: ἐκτάμνω — cut out; aor. 3 pl., epic 2nd aor. (= Attic ἐξέτεμον): ’they cut out’
glossary.ἐξήρχετο: ἐξάρχω — lead off; mid. begin (+ gen.); impf. 3 sg. mid.: ’began’
glossary.ἐξαπέβησαν: ἐξαποβαίνω — disembark; aor. 3 pl., augment inside the double prefix: ’they disembarked’
glossary.ἐπώπτων: ἐποπτάω — roast, grill; impf. 3 pl., contracted: ’they roasted’
glossary.ἐρήμῃ: ἐρῆμος — desert, uninhabited; fem. dat. sg.
glossary.ἐυσσέλμου: ἐύσσελμος — well-benched; two-ending adj., fem. gen. sg., epic -ου (= Attic -ου), with νηός
glossary.ἐφέπεσκον: ἐφέπω — go after, pursue; impf. 3 pl., iterative -εσκ- (Attic would use the plain impf. ἐφέπον): ’they kept going after’
glossary.ἔγκατα: ἔγκατα — entrails, innards; neut. nom./acc. pl. (only plural)
glossary.ἔδειραν: δέρω — flay; aor. 3 pl. act.: ’they flayed’
glossary.ἔκλαιον: κλαίω — weep, weep for; impf. 3 pl. (+ acc.): ’they wept for’
glossary.ἔσφαξαν: σφάζω — slaughter, cut the throat of; aor. 3 pl. act.: ’they slaughtered’
glossary.ἔφαγε: ἐσθίω — eat; aor. 3 sg. ἔφαγον (suppletive stem φαγ-), with movable ε (= ἔφαγε(ν)): ’ate’
glossary.ἕκηλοι: ἕκηλος — at ease, undisturbed; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἕλικες: ἕλιξ — twisted, curved; of cattle, with curved horns; masc./fem. nom. pl., agreeing with βόες
glossary.ἕσπωνται: ἕπομαι — follow; aor. subj. mid. 3 pl., epic σπ- aorist (= Attic ἕπωνται), in tmesis with ἐπί: ’they follow’
glossary.ἠρώμην: ἀράομαι — pray, pray to; impf. 1 sg. mid., contracted (ἠρώμην for ἠρᾱόμην): ’I prayed’
glossary.ἡδὺς: ἡδύς — sweet, pleasant; masc. nom. sg., used with the fem. noun ἀυτμή
glossary.ἤλυξα: ἀλύσκω — escape, slip away from; aor. 1 sg., epic (Attic would use ἔφυγον): ’I eluded’
glossary.ἱεροῖσιν: ἱερός — holy; neut. ἱερά, sacrificial offerings; neut. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οῖς)
glossary.ὀλέσαι: ὄλλυμι — destroy, ruin; aor. inf. act. (= Attic ἀπολέσαι): ’to destroy’
glossary.ὀλέσσαι: ὄλλυμι — destroy, lose; aor. inf. act., epic σσ (= ὀλέσαι), in tmesis with ἀπό: ’to lose (my life)’
glossary.ὀμόσσατε: ὄμνυμι — swear; aor. imper. act. 2 pl., epic σσ (= Attic ὀμόσατε): ’swear!’
glossary.ὀρθοκραιράων: ὀρθόκραιρα — straight-horned; fem. gen. pl., epic -άων (= Attic -ῶν), with βοῶν
glossary.ὁπλισόμεσθα: ὁπλίζω — make ready; mid. prepare for oneself; aor. subj. mid. 1 pl., short vowel, epic -μεσθα (= Attic -μεθα): ’let us prepare’
glossary.ὄμοσάν: ὄμνυμι — swear; aor. 3 pl. act., unaugmented (= Attic ὤμοσαν): ’they had sworn’
glossary.ὄρνιθάς: ὄρνις — bird; masc./fem. acc. pl., accent from the enclitic τε
glossary.ὑπεκφύγοι: ὑπεκφεύγω — escape from; aor. opt. act. 3 sg., potential with κέν: ’might escape’ · also optative of wish after μηδ’: ’may he not escape’
glossary.ὑψικόμοιο: ὑψίκομος — high-crowned, with lofty foliage; fem. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου), with δρυός
glossary.ὡρμίσαμεν: ὁρμίζω — bring to anchor, moor; aor. 1 pl. act.: ’we moored’
glossary.ᾔνεον: αἰνέω — praise, approve; impf. 3 pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ᾔνουν), in tmesis with ἐπί: ’they approved’
glossary.αἰζηῶν: αἰζηός — vigorous young man; masc. gen. pl.: ’young men’
glossary.βέβλητο: βάλλω — throw, cast; plpf. pass. 3 sg., unaugmented (= Attic ἐβέβλητο): ’had been thrown, lay’
glossary.βρόντησε: βροντάω — thunder; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= Attic ἐβρόντησε): ’thundered’
glossary.διήρεσα: διερέσσω — row through, row across; aor. 1 sg.: ’I rowed across’
glossary.διακτόρου: διάκτορος — guide, messenger (epithet of Hermes; exact sense disputed); masc. gen. sg.
glossary.δικαζομένων: δικάζω — judge; mid. go to law, plead; pres. part. masc. gen. pl.: ’pleading’
glossary.δύσομαι: δύω — sink, go down, enter; fut. 1 sg. mid.: ’I will go down’
glossary.εἰρημένα: ἐρῶ, εἶπον — say, tell; perf. pass. part. neut. acc. pl.: ’things told’
glossary.εἷρπον: ἕρπω — creep, crawl; impf. 3 pl., with lengthened augment εἷ-: ’they crawled’
glossary.ζέφυρος: Ζέφυρος — Zephyr, the west wind; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.θεείου: θέειον (θεῖον) — sulphur; neut. gen. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic θείου), partitive gen. after a verb of filling
glossary.θύων: θύω — rush, rage, surge (of wind; not θύω ’sacrifice’); pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’raging’
glossary.κάππεσ: πίπτω (καταπίπτω) — fall, fall down; aor. 3 sg., elided, κατ- assimilated before π (κάππεσ’ = κατέπεσε)
glossary.κατέχυνθ: καταχέω — pour down; aor. pass. 3 pl., epic, elided (κατέχυνθ’; Attic κατεχύθησαν): ’poured down’
glossary.κατεσκίαον: κατασκιάω (= κατασκιάζω) — overshadow, shade; impf. 3 pl., epic: ’they overshadowed’
glossary.κεάσαιμι: κεάζω — split, cleave; aor. opt. 1 sg.: ’I might split’
glossary.κεκληγὼς: κλάζω — scream, shriek, roar; perf. part. masc. nom. sg. (perf. κέκληγα), present sense: ’screaming’
glossary.κλύδων: κλύδων — surge, wave, billow; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.κοιμήσατε: κοιμάω — put to sleep, lull; aor. 2 pl. act., unaugmented (= Attic ἐκοιμήσατε): ’you lulled to sleep’
glossary.κορώνῃσιν: κορώνη — crow; also a sea-bird (which one is uncertain); fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσιν (= Attic -αις)
glossary.κρίνων: κρίνω — judge, decide; pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’judging’
glossary.κυανέην: κυάνεος — dark, dark blue; fem. acc. sg., epic -έην (= Attic -έαν)
glossary.κυβερνήτεω: κυβερνήτης — helmsman, steersman; masc. gen. sg., epic -εω (= Attic -ου)
glossary.λαερτιάδεω: Λαερτιάδης — son of Laertes; masc. gen. sg., epic -εω (= Attic -ου), a patronymic of Odysseus
glossary.μακροί: μακρός — long, tall; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.μεγάλῃ: μέγας — great, big; fem. dat. sg.
glossary.μεμύκει: μυκάομαι — low, bellow; plpf. 3 sg. (perf. μέμῡκα), unaugmented, with impf. sense: ’was lowing’
glossary.μοί: ἐγώ — I; dat. sg., accented μοί before the enclitic that follows: ’to me, for me’
glossary.μυθολογεύειν: μυθολογεύω — tell tales, recount; pres. inf. act.: ’to recount’
glossary.μυθολογεύω: μυθολογεύω — tell tales, recount; pres. 1 sg. act.: ’I tell’
glossary.μῆχος: μῆχος — means, remedy; neut. nom./acc. sg.
glossary.νείκεον: νεικέω — quarrel with, revile; impf. 1 sg. (the form also serves 3 pl.), epic uncontracted, unaugmented (= Attic ἐνείκουν)
glossary.νυκτερίς: νυκτερίς — bat (from νύξ ’night’); fem. nom. sg.
glossary.πληγεῖσα: πλήσσω — strike; aor. pass. part. fem. nom. sg.: ’struck’
glossary.πλῆξε: πλήσσω — strike, hit; aor. 3 sg. act., unaugmented (= Attic ἔπληξε)
glossary.πλῆτο: πίμπλημι — fill; aor. mid./pass. 3 sg., unaugmented, epic (= Attic ἐπλήσθη): ’was filled’ (+ gen.)
glossary.προσφὺς: προσφύω — grow fast to; 2nd aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg. (intrans.): ’having grown fast to, clinging to’
glossary.προτραποίμην: προτρέπω — turn forward; mid. turn oneself; 2nd aor. mid. opt. 1 sg., iterative after ὁπότε: ’whenever I turned’
glossary.προτόνους: πρότονος — forestay, the rope holding the mast forward; masc. acc. pl.
glossary.προύφαινον: προφαίνω — show forth, display; impf. 3 pl., contracted (προύφαινον = προέφαινον): ’they displayed’
glossary.πᾶσα: πᾶς — all, whole; fem. nom. sg.: ’all over’
glossary.στηρίξαι: στηρίζω — prop, brace, plant firmly; aor. inf. act.: ’to brace’
glossary.τέραα: τέρας — portent, sign; neut. acc. pl., epic (= Attic τέρατα)
glossary.τίσουσι: τίνω — pay (a price); fut. 3 pl. act.: ’they will pay’
glossary.τετευχώς: τεύχω — make, build; perf. part. masc. nom. sg., passive sense: ’made (of)’
glossary.τοίχους: τοῖχος — wall; of a ship, its side; masc. acc. pl.
glossary.τῖσαι: τίνω — pay; mid. exact payment from, punish; aor. imper. mid. 2 sg.: ’punish!’
glossary.φάεινε: φαείνω — shine (epic φαείνω = φαίνω intrans.); pres. imper. act. 2 sg.: ’shine!’
glossary.φαείνω: φαείνω — shine (epic φαείνω = φαίνω intrans.); pres. 1 sg. act., indic. or subj. (subj. with future sense): ’I will shine’
glossary.χαίρεσκον: χαίρω — rejoice; impf. 1 sg., iterative -εσκ-, unaugmented: ’I used to rejoice’
glossary.χαρύβδιος: Χάρυβδις — Charybdis, the whirlpool; fem. gen. sg., epic -ιος (= Attic -ιδος): ’out of Charybdis’
glossary.ψιλὴν: ψιλός — bare, stripped; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀγορῆθεν: ἀγορή — assembly, place of assembly; adv. ἀγορῆθεν, -θεν ’from’: ’from the assembly’
glossary.ἀερθείς: ἀείρω — lift, raise; aor. pass. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’lifted up’
glossary.ἀμοιβήν: ἀμοιβή — requital, recompense; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀναμετρήσαιμι: ἀναμετρέω — measure again, go over again; aor. opt. 1 sg., in a purpose clause after ὄφρα: ’so that I might retrace’
glossary.ἀνιόντι: ἄνειμι — go up, rise; pres. part. masc./neut. dat. sg.: ’rising’
glossary.ἀπήωροι: ἀπήωρος — hanging off, hanging aloft; adj. (2-termination), masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἀποαίνυτο: ἀπαίνυμαι — take away, deprive of; impf. 3 sg. mid., uncontracted, unaugmented (ἀποαίνυτο): ’took away’
glossary.ἀποτέθνασαν: ἀποθνῄσκω — die; plpf. act. 3 pl. (perf. τέθνηκα), unaugmented, epic: ’had died, were dead’
glossary.ἀριζήλως: ἀριζήλως — very clearly, plainly (ἀρι- ’very’ + ζῆλος; cf. ἀρίζηλος); adv.
glossary.ἀρνευτῆρι: ἀρνευτήρ — diver, one who plunges headfirst; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.ἄντλον: ἄντλος — bilge, the hold of a ship; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἄραξε: ἀράσσω — strike, dash, smash; aor. 3 sg. act., unaugmented (= Attic ἤραξε): ’dashed, smashed’
glossary.ἐελδομένῳ: ἐέλδομαι — long for, desire; pres. part. mid. masc. dat. sg., epic by-form of ἔλδομαι: ’longing’
glossary.ἐκόμει: κομέω — tend, take care of; impf. 3 sg. act.: ’tended, cherished’
glossary.ἐλελίχθη: ἐλελίζω — shake, make quiver; aor. pass. 3 sg.: ’was made to quiver, shook’
glossary.ἐμητίσαντο: μητίομαι — devise, contrive; aor. 3 pl. mid., epic (= Attic ἐμητιάσαντο): ’they devised’
glossary.ἐμφορέοντο: ἐμφορέω — carry in; pass. be carried about, tossed; impf. 3 pl. pass., epic uncontracted, unaugmented: ’were tossed’
glossary.ἐνήκαμεν: ἐνίημι — send in, put in; of a ship, launch, put out; aor. 1 pl.: ’we put out’
glossary.ἐνδούπησα: ἐνδουπέω — fall with a thud (cf. δοῦπος ’thud’); aor. 1 sg.: ’I fell with a thud’
glossary.ἐξεμέσειεν: ἐξεμέω — vomit forth; aor. opt. 3 sg., after ὄφρα ’until’: ’until she should vomit out’
glossary.ἐξεφαάνθη: ἐκφαίνω — show forth; pass. appear; aor. pass. 3 sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἐξεφάνη): ’appeared’
glossary.ἐοικὼς: ἔοικα — be like, resemble (+ dat.); perf. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’like’
glossary.ἐπίτονος: ἐπίτονος — rope of the mast, perhaps a backstay (exact fitting unknown); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἐπιεικέ: ἐπιεικής — fitting, suitable; fem. acc. sg., epic uncontracted, elided (ἐπιεικέ’ = ἐπιεικέα; Attic ἐπιεικῆ)
glossary.ἐπισταδόν: ἐπισταδόν — one after another, standing close by; adv.
glossary.ἐρινεὸν: ἐρινεός — wild fig-tree; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἐχθρὸν: ἐχθρός — hateful, odious; neut. nom. sg., predicate: ’hateful’
glossary.ἑρμείαο: Ἑρμῆς (epic Ἑρμείας) — Hermes; masc. gen. sg., epic -αο (= Attic Ἑρμοῦ)
glossary.ἔκτειναν: κτείνω — kill; aor. 3 pl. act.: ’they killed’
glossary.ἔρρηξ: ῥήγνυμι — break, snap; aor. 3 sg., elided (ἔρρηξ’ = ἔρρηξε), ῥ doubled after the augment: ’broke’
glossary.ἕβδομον: ἕβδομος — seventh; neut. acc. sg.: ’the seventh (day)’
glossary.ἠέλι: Ἠέλιος — the Sun (god); masc. voc. sg., elided (Ἠέλι’ = Ἠέλιε), epic (= Attic Ἥλιε): ’Sun!’
glossary.ἤχλυσε: ἀχλύω — grow dark, be misty; aor. 3 sg., augmented ἤ-: ’grew dark’
glossary.ἧκα: ἵημι — send, let go; aor. 1 sg. (κ-aorist): ’I let go’
glossary.ἱστοῦ: ἱστός — mast (also loom, in other contexts); masc. gen. sg.: ’of the mast’
glossary.ἱστὸς: ἱστός — mast (also loom, in other contexts); masc. nom. sg.: ’the mast’
glossary.ἴκελοι: ἴκελος — like, resembling (+ dat.); masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ὀβελοῖσι: ὀβελός — spit; masc. dat. pl., epic -οῖσι (= Attic -οῖς)
glossary.ὄζοι: ὄζος — branch, bough; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ὕπερ: ὑπέρ — over, above; prep. + gen., accent thrown back when it stands after its noun (anastrophe): ’above’
glossary.ὠκέα: ὠκύς — swift; neut. pl. (-έα) used adverbially: ’swiftly’ · also fem. nom. sg., epic -έα (= -εῖα): ’swift’
glossary.ὠμά: ὠμός — raw, uncooked; neut. nom. pl.
glossary.ῥινοί: ῥινός — hide, skin; fem. nom. pl.: ’hides’
glossary.ῥινοῖο: ῥινός — hide, skin; fem. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -οῦ): ’of hide’
glossary.αὐτόθεν: αὐτόθεν — from that very spot, right there; adv.
glossary.βασιλῆϊ: βασιλεύς — king; masc. dat. sg., epic -ῆϊ (= Attic βασιλεῖ)
glossary.βλάβεται: βλάπτω — hurt, hinder; pres. 3 sg. pass., epic βλάβ- (= Attic βλάπτεται), with a neut. pl. subject: ’are hampered’
glossary.βλάπτοι: βλάπτω — hurt, hinder; pres. opt. 3 sg., in a fear clause after μή: ’lest he hinder’
glossary.βρῶσιν: βρῶσις — eating, food; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.βόε: βοῦς — ox, cow; masc. nom./acc. dual: ’the two oxen’ (as subject of a dual verb)
glossary.γερούσιον: γερούσιος — of the elders (γέρων), of the council; adj., masc. acc. sg.
glossary.δμῳὰς: δμῳή — female slave, servant-woman; fem. acc. pl., epic (cf. Attic δούλη)
glossary.δυσαήων: δυσαής — ill-blowing, stormy; adj., masc. gen. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic δυσαῶν)
glossary.δόρποιο: δόρπον — evening meal, supper; neut. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.δῦναι: δύω — go down, sink, set; aor. inf. act. (root aorist), of the sun: ’to set’
glossary.δῶρ: δῶρον — gift; neut. nom. pl., elided (δῶρ’ = δῶρα)
glossary.εὐήνορα: εὐήνωρ — good for men, manly (εὖ + ἀνήρ; epithet of bronze; exact sense uncertain); masc. acc. sg.
glossary.εὐξάμενοι: εὔχομαι — pray, vow; aor. part. mid. masc. nom. pl.: ’having prayed’
glossary.εὕδοι: εὕδω — sleep; pres. opt. 3 sg., in a purpose clause after ἵνα: ’might sleep’
glossary.εὕροιμι: εὑρίσκω — find; aor. opt. 1 sg., wish: ’may I find’
glossary.ζυγά: ζυγόν — yoke; rower’s bench, thwart; neut. acc. pl.
glossary.θέεν: θέω — run; impf. 3 sg., epic uncontracted and unaugmented (= Attic ἔθει): ’ran’
glossary.θέουσα: θέω — run; pres. part. fem. nom. sg.: ’running’
glossary.θεώτεραι: θεῖος — divine; comp. θεώτερος, fem. nom. pl., epic (= Attic θειότεραι): ’more divine’
glossary.θῦε: θύω (B) — rush, surge, rage; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔθυε); distinct from θύω ’sacrifice’ · also θύω (A) — sacrifice; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔθυε), + dat. of the god: ’sacrificed’ (θῦε δ’ Ἀθήνῃ ’and sacrificed to Athena’)
glossary.κίρκος: κίρκος — falcon, a kind of hawk; masc. nom. sg., in apposition to ἴρηξ
glossary.καλέονται: καλέω — call, name; pres. 3 pl. pass., epic uncontracted (= Attic καλοῦνται)
glossary.κατέθεντο: κατατίθημι — put down, stow away; aor. 3 pl. mid.: ’stowed’
glossary.κατέθηχ: κατατίθημι — put down, lay by; aor. 3 sg. act., elided (κατέθηχ’ = κατέθηκε)
glossary.κατέλεκτο: καταλέγω — lay down; mid. lie down; aor. 3 sg. mid., root aorist: ’lay down’
glossary.καταιβαταὶ: καταιβατός — to be gone down by, passable on the way down; adj., fem. nom. pl., epic (= Attic καταβατός)
glossary.κείνῃ: κεῖνος — that (one); demonstrative, fem. dat. sg., epic (= Attic ἐκείνῃ)
glossary.κελαινεφέϊ: κελαινεφής — dark-clouded (epithet of Zeus); adj., masc. dat. sg.
glossary.κληῗσιν: κληΐς — thwart, rowing-bench (also thole-pin, key, bar); fem. dat. pl., epic -σιν (the diaeresis marks the two syllables) · also hook, clasp of a brooch: ’hooks’ (κληῗσιν ἐϋγνάμπτοις ’well-bent hooks’)
glossary.κομίζειν: κομίζω — carry, convey, take care of; pres. inf. act.: ’to carry’
glossary.κουριδίας: κουρίδιος — wedded, lawful (of a wife); adj., fem. acc. pl.
glossary.κρητῆρές: κρητήρ — mixing-bowl; masc. nom. pl., accented before enclitic τε
glossary.κόσμῳ: κόσμος — order, good order; masc. dat. sg., dat. of manner: ’in order’
glossary.λάϊνοι: λάϊνος — of stone; adj., masc. nom. pl., epic (= Attic λίθινοι)
glossary.λέβητα: λέβης — cauldron, basin; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.λίθεοι: λίθεος — of stone; adj., masc. nom. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic λίθινοι)
glossary.λίθοιο: λίθος — stone; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.λίνον: λίνον — flax; linen, linen cloth; neut. acc. sg.
glossary.λελασμένος: λανθάνω — escape notice; mid. forget (+ acc./gen.); perf. part. mid., masc. nom. sg., epic (= Attic λελησμένος): ’having forgotten’
glossary.λιλαίεται: λιλαίομαι — long for, be eager for (+ gen.); pres. 3 sg. mid. · also + inf., ’be eager to, long to’ (λιλαίεται ὀπτηθῆναι ’it longs to be roasted’)
glossary.μένουσι: μένω — stay, remain, wait; pres. 3 pl.: ’stay (moored)’
glossary.μήδε: μῆδος — counsel, plan, thought (pl. μήδεα); neut. acc. pl., elided (μήδε’ = μήδεα)
glossary.μενέαινε: μενεαίνω — be eager, be set on, rage; impf. 3 sg. (+ inf.): ’was eager’
glossary.μεταδήμιον: μεταδήμιος — among the people, in the community; adj., neut. nom. sg., with κακόν
glossary.μῆρα: μηρός — thigh; pl. μῆρα, thigh-pieces burnt in sacrifice; neut. acc. pl.
glossary.νέομαι: νέομαι — go, return home; pres. 1 sg., with future sense: ’I am going’
glossary.νήγρετον: νήγρετος — unwaking, not to be roused; adj., neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’soundly’
glossary.νήγρετος: νήγρετος — unwaking, not to be roused; adj., masc. nom. sg., with ὕπνος
glossary.νειὸν: νειός — fallow field; fem. acc. sg., after ἀνά: ’up along (the fallow)’
glossary.νηϊάδες: νηϊάς — Naiad, water-nymph; fem. nom. pl., epic (= Attic ναϊάδες) · also fem. voc. pl.: νύμφαι νηϊάδες ’Naiad nymphs!’
glossary.νηῒ: ναῦς — ship; fem. dat. sg., epic νηΐ (diaeresis marks the two syllables)
glossary.νῆάδ: ναῦς — ship; fem. acc. sg. νῆα + suffix -δε ’toward’, elided (νῆάδ’ = νῆάδε): ’to the ship’
glossary.οἴνοπε: οἴνοψ — wine-faced, having the look of wine (the colour meant is unsettled); adj., masc. nom./acc. dual
glossary.πάθ: πάσχω — suffer; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented, elided (πάθ’ = ἔπαθε)
glossary.πέμπετέ: πέμπω — send, send off; pres. imper. 2 pl., accented before enclitic με: ’send’
glossary.πέπονθας: πάσχω — suffer; perf. 2 sg.: ’you have suffered’
glossary.πίνετ: πίνω — drink; pres. 2 pl., elided (πίνετ’ = πίνετε): ’you drink’
glossary.παλιμπλαγχθέντα: παλιμπλάζομαι — be driven back, be turned back; aor. pass. part., masc. acc. sg.: ’driven back’
glossary.πανῆμαρ: πανῆμαρ — all day long, the whole day; adv.
glossary.πετεηνῶν: πετεηνός — winged; pl. as noun, birds; neut. gen. pl., epic (= Attic πετεινῶν): ’of birds’
glossary.πηκτὸν: πηκτός — fixed, well-joined; adj., neut. acc. sg., with ἄροτρον
glossary.ποιήσειαν: ποιέω — make, do; aor. opt. 3 pl., wish: ’may they make’
glossary.πολυδαίδαλος: πολυδαίδαλος — much-wrought, intricately worked; adj., masc. nom. sg.
glossary.πολυφλοίσβοιο: πολύφλοισβος — loud-roaring; adj., fem. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.ποτιπεπτηυῖαι: πτήσσω — crouch, cower; perf. part. fem. nom. pl. πεπτηυῖα with ποτί (= Attic προσ-): ’crouching toward’
glossary.πρήσσουσι: πράσσω — do, accomplish; make (a way); pres. 3 pl., epic πρήσσ- (= Attic πράττουσι)
glossary.προΐει: προΐημι — send forth, send along; impf. 3 sg.: ’sent along’
glossary.προικὸς: προίξ — gift, dowry; gen. sg. προικός, adverbial: ’as a free gift, with no return’
glossary.προσεπίλνατο: πίλναμαι — draw near, approach (+ dat.); aor. 3 sg. mid., in compound (προσεπίλνατο): ’drew near’
glossary.πρυμνῆς: πρυμνός — hindmost; adj., fem. gen. sg., with νηός: ’(of the ship’s) stern’
glossary.πρύμνη: πρύμνη — stern of a ship; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.πυκινὴν: πυκινός — close-packed, stout; adj., fem. acc. sg.
glossary.σκεπόωσι: σκεπάω — shelter, cover; pres. 3 pl., epic diectasis (= Attic σκεπῶσι)
glossary.σπερχοίατ: σπέρχομαι — hasten, press on; pres. opt. 3 pl. mid., epic -οίατο (= Attic -οιντο), elided (σπερχοίατ’ = σπερχοίατο)
glossary.σῖτόν: σῖτος — grain, bread, food; masc. acc. sg., accented before enclitic τε
glossary.τέρπεο: τέρπω — delight, gladden; mid. enjoy oneself; pres. imper. 2 sg. mid., epic uncontracted (= Attic τέρπου)
glossary.τανύφυλλος: τανύφυλλος — long-leaved; adj., fem. nom. sg., of the olive
glossary.τετέλεσται: τελέω — accomplish, fulfil; perf. 3 sg. pass.: ’has been accomplished’
glossary.τετιμένος: τιμάω — honour; perf. part. pass., masc. nom. sg., epic (= Attic τετιμημένος): ’honoured’
glossary.τετράοροι: τετράορος — yoked four abreast, four-horse; adj., masc. nom. pl.
glossary.τιθαιβώσσουσι: τιθαιβώσσω — make their hives, nest (of bees; rare word, sense disputed); pres. 3 pl.
glossary.τισόμεθ: τίνω — pay; mid. exact payment; fut. 1 pl. mid., elided (τισόμεθ’ = τισόμεθα): ’we shall repay ourselves’
glossary.τρητοῖο: τρητός — pierced, bored through; adj., masc. gen. sg., epic -οῖο (= Attic -οῦ)
glossary.φαάντατος: φαεινός — shining, bright; superl. φαάντατος, masc. nom. sg., epic (= Attic φαεινότατος): ’brightest’
glossary.χαρίσασθαι: χαρίζομαι — give as a favour, give freely; aor. inf. mid.: ’to give freely’
glossary.χαῖρέ: χαίρω — rejoice; pres. imper. 2 sg., accented before enclitic μοι: ’farewell’
glossary.χηλῷ: χηλός — chest, coffer; fem. dat. sg.
glossary.ἀγαυοὶ: ἀγαυός — noble, illustrious; adj., masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἀγγέλλων: ἀγγέλλω — announce, bring word; pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’announcing’
glossary.ἀγχόθι: ἀγχόθι — near, close by; adv. (+ gen.)
glossary.ἀείρετο: ἀείρω — raise, lift; mid. rise; impf. 3 sg. mid.: ’was lifted, rose’
glossary.ἀειρόμενοι: ἀείρω — raise, lift; mid. rise, spring up; pres. part. mid. masc. nom. pl.: ’rising’
glossary.ἀενάοντα: ἀέναος — ever-flowing; epic participial form, neut. nom. pl.: ’ever-flowing (waters)’
glossary.ἀκουάζεσθε: ἀκουάζομαι — listen to (+ gen.); pres. 2 pl. mid. (indic.): ’you listen’
glossary.ἀλέγυνον: ἀλεγύνω — make ready, prepare; impf. 3 pl.: ’prepared’
glossary.ἀμφιφορῆες: ἀμφιφορεύς — two-handled jar; masc. nom. pl., epic -ῆες (= Attic -εῖς)
glossary.ἀνακλινθέντες: ἀνακλίνω — lean back, recline; aor. pass. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’leaning back’
glossary.ἀνδρακάς: ἀνδρακάς — man by man, one man at a time; adv.
glossary.ἀνερρίπτουν: ἀναρρίπτω — throw up, toss up; impf. 3 pl., epic -ουν (= Attic ἀνέρριπτον): ’tossed up’
glossary.ἀπήμονα: ἀπήμων — unharmed, safe; adj., masc. acc. sg., agreeing with με
glossary.ἀπονοστήσειν: ἀπονοστέω — return home, come back; fut. inf. act.: ’that (you) will return’
glossary.ἀπορρῶγες: ἀπορρώξ — broken off, sheer, precipitous; adj., fem. nom. pl.
glossary.ἀρήτῃ: Ἀρήτη — Arete, queen of the Phaeacians; fem. dat. sg., Ionic η for α
glossary.ἀρτεμέεσσι: ἀρτεμής — sound, safe and well; adj., masc. dat. pl., epic -έεσσι (= Attic -έσι)
glossary.ἀτρέμας: ἀτρέμας — without moving, calmly, motionless; adv.
glossary.ἅπασαν: ἅπας — all, the whole; adj., fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἐΰσσελμοι: ἐΰσσελμος — well-benched (σέλμα ’bench, thwart’); adj., fem. nom. pl., epic (= Attic εὔσελμοι)
glossary.ἐλαίη: ἐλαία — olive tree; fem. nom. sg., epic -ίη (= Attic ἐλαία)
glossary.ἐλαυνόντων: ἐλαύνω — drive, row; pres. part. masc. gen. pl.: ’of those rowing’
glossary.ἐλαφρότατος: ἐλαφρός — light, nimble; superl. masc. nom. sg.: ’lightest’
glossary.ἐναλίγκια: ἐναλίγκιος — like, resembling (+ dat.); adj., neut. acc. pl.
glossary.ἐπήρατον: ἐπήρατος — lovely, desirable; adj., neut. nom. sg.
glossary.ἐπεσσεύοντο: ἐπισεύομαι — hurry on, rush to; impf. 3 pl. mid., epic -σσ- (= Attic ἐπεσεύοντο): ’hastened to’
glossary.ἐπιήνδανε: ἐπιανδάνω — please, be agreeable to (+ dat.); impf. 3 sg. (ἀνδάνω, augmented ἥνδανε)
glossary.ἐσέρχονται: εἰσέρχομαι — go in, enter; pres. 3 pl., epic ἐσ- (= Attic εἰσ-)
glossary.ἐφιέμενος: ἐφίημι — send upon; mid. enjoin, give a charge to (+ dat.); pres. part. mid. masc. nom. sg.: ’enjoining’
glossary.ἐϋξέστῃ: ἐΰξεστος — well-polished, well-planed; adj., fem. dat. sg., epic ἐϋ-
glossary.ἐϋπλυνὲς: ἐϋπλυνής — well-washed; adj., neut. acc. sg., epic ἐϋ-
glossary.ἐϋφραίνοιτε: εὐφραίνω — cheer, gladden; pres. opt. 2 pl., epic ἐϋ- (= Attic εὐφραίνοιτε): ’may you gladden’
glossary.ἑδρέων: ἕδρη — seat; fem. gen. pl., epic -έων (= Attic ἑδρῶν)
glossary.ἑτέρην: ἕτερος — other, second (of a series); fem. acc. sg., Ionic η for α (= Attic ἑτέραν)
glossary.ἔσπεισαν: σπένδω — pour a libation; aor. 3 pl.: ’poured libations’
glossary.ἔταμνεν: τέμνω — cut; impf. 3 sg., epic ἔταμνεν (= Attic ἔτεμνεν): ’was cutting’
glossary.ἔχουσαν: ἔχω — have, hold; pres. part. fem. acc. sg.: ’holding’
glossary.ἕλκητον: ἕλκω — drag, draw; pres. subj. 3 dual, in a general simile clause: ’the two (oxen) drag’
glossary.ἡγεῖσθαι: ἡγέομαι — lead the way, guide (+ dat.); pres. inf.: ’to lead’
glossary.ἥδιστος: ἡδύς — sweet, pleasant; superl. masc. nom. sg.: ’sweetest’
glossary.ἱέρευσ: ἱερεύω — sacrifice, slaughter; aor. 3 sg., elided (ἱέρευσ’ = ἱέρευσε)
glossary.ἱμάσθλης: ἱμάσθλη — whip, lash; fem. gen. sg.
glossary.ἴρηξ: ἴρηξ — hawk; masc. nom. sg., epic (= Attic ἱέραξ)
glossary.ἵκευ: ἱκνέομαι — come, arrive at; aor. 2 sg. mid., epic ἵκευ (= ἵκου): ’you have come’
glossary.ἵκωνται: ἱκνέομαι — come, reach; aor. subj. 3 pl. mid., after ὅτ’ ἄν: ’whenever they reach’
glossary.ὀΐω: ὀΐομαι — think, suppose; pres. 1 sg. (act. form ὀΐω, epic; = Attic οἴομαι): ’I think’
glossary.ὀδυσσῆϊ: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus; masc. dat. sg., epic -ῆϊ (= Attic Ὀδυσσεῖ)
glossary.ὁδός: ὁδός — way, path, journey; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ὁμαρτήσειεν: ὁμαρτέω — keep pace with, accompany (+ dat.); aor. opt. 3 sg., potential with κεν: ’could keep up with’
glossary.ὁρμηθέντες: ὁρμάω — set in motion; pass. start, dash off; aor. pass. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’having started’
glossary.ὄπασσε: ὀπάζω — give, bestow, send along; aor. 3 sg., epic -σσ- (= Attic ὤπασε): ’gave’
glossary.ὅρμου: ὅρμος — anchorage, mooring; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.ὑμέων: σύ — you; pl. ὑμεῖς, gen. pl. ὑμέων, epic (= Attic ὑμῶν)
glossary.ὑπερέσχε: ὑπερέχω — hold over, rise above; aor. 3 sg.: ’rose over’
glossary.ὑψερεφές: ὑψερεφής — high-roofed; adj., neut. acc. sg.
glossary.ὕδατ: ὕδωρ — water; neut. nom. pl., elided (ὕδατ’ = ὕδατα)
glossary.ῥῆγός: ῥῆγος — rug, blanket; neut. acc. sg., accented before enclitic τε
glossary.γνοίη: γιγνώσκω — come to know, recognise; aor. opt. 3 sg., in a negative purpose clause after μή: ’lest he or she recognise’
glossary.δήμου: δῆμος — people, community (also the land of a people); masc. gen. sg.
glossary.δεδμημένον: δαμάζω — subdue, overpower; perf. pass. part. masc. acc. sg., epic δεδμημένος (= Attic δεδαμασμένος), + dat.: ’overcome (by sleep)’
glossary.δηλήσαιτο: δηλέομαι — harm, injure; aor. opt. 3 sg. mid. (deponent), in a negative purpose clause after μή: ’lest he harm’
glossary.διηνεκέες: διηνεκής — continuous, unbroken, stretching on; masc./fem. nom. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic διηνεκεῖς)
glossary.διωκομένη: διώκω — chase, drive on, pursue; pres. part. pass. fem. nom. sg.: ’being driven on’
glossary.εἰσέλασαν: εἰσελαύνω — drive in, sail in; aor. 3 pl., augment kept after the preverb (= Attic εἰσήλασαν)
glossary.εὐδείελον: εὐδείελος — clear-seen or sunny (sense disputed); adj. of two terminations, fem. acc. sg., epithet of Ithaca
glossary.εὐρυσθενές: εὐρυσθενής — wide-ruling, of wide might; masc. voc. sg., address to Poseidon
glossary.εὔχοντο: εὔχομαι — pray, vow, make a prayer; impf. 3 pl. mid., augment εὐ- unchanged
glossary.εὕδοντ: εὕδω — sleep; pres. part. masc. acc. sg., elided (εὕδοντ’ = εὕδοντα)
glossary.εὕδων: εὕδω — sleep; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’sleeping’
glossary.θέσθαι: τίθημι — put, place, set; aor. inf. mid., after ἐπίσταμαι: ’to put (away), to stow’ · also aor. inf. mid. in the idiom θέσθαι γυναῖκα, ’to take as wife, make one’s wife’
glossary.θαυμάζωσιν: θαυμάζω — wonder at, marvel; pres. subj. 3 pl., in a purpose clause after ἵνα
glossary.θεῖναι: τίθημι — put, set, make; aor. inf. act., explaining ἄριστα: ’(best) to make, to set up (a stone)’
glossary.κάρτεϊ: κάρτος — strength, might (= Attic κράτος); neut. dat. sg., epic, with εἴκων: ’(yielding) to might’
glossary.καλλείψω: καταλείπω — leave behind, abandon; fut. or short-vowel aor. subj. 1 sg., κατα- assimilated (καλλείψω = καταλείψω)
glossary.κατένευσας: κατανεύω — nod assent, promise; aor. 2 sg., augmented
glossary.καταπρηνέσσ: καταπρηνής — bent forward, flat, palm down (said of a hand); fem. dat. pl., epic -έσσι (= Attic -έσι), elided
glossary.καταπρηνεῖ: καταπρηνής — bent forward, flat, palm down (said of a hand); fem. dat. sg.: ’with a flat hand’
glossary.κεκριμένους: κρίνω — pick out, choose, separate; perf. pass. part. masc. acc. pl.: ’picked out, chosen’
glossary.ληΐδος: ληΐς — booty, spoil; fem. gen. sg., Ionic ληΐς (= Attic λεία)
glossary.μηρὼ: μηρός — thigh; masc. acc. dual: ’both thighs’
glossary.οἴχωνται: οἴχομαι — be gone, have gone; pres. subj. 3 pl. with perfect force, in a fear clause after μή: ’lest they be gone’
glossary.πάνορμοι: πάνορμος — with good anchorage, all-harbouring; masc./fem. adj., nom. pl.
glossary.πατρωΐῃ: πατρώϊος — of one’s father, native; fem. dat. sg., epic (= Attic πατρῷος)
glossary.παύσασθε: παύω — stop; mid. cease from (+ gen.); aor. imper. 2 pl. mid.
glossary.πεπλήγετο: πλήσσω — strike; mid. strike one’s own (body); epic reduplicated past 3 sg. mid.: ’struck (his thighs)’
glossary.περίμηκες: περιμήκης — very long, exceedingly tall; neut. acc. sg.
glossary.πλάζομαι: πλάζω — drive astray; pass. wander, be driven about; pres. 1 sg. pass.
glossary.πρεσβύτατον: πρέσβυς — old, elder; superl. πρεσβύτατος ’eldest’; masc. acc. sg., used as a noun
glossary.προΐδωνται: προοράω — see beforehand, catch sight of; aor. subj. 3 pl. mid. (stem προ-ιδ-), after ὁππότε κεν
glossary.προὐφαίνετο: προφαίνω — show forth; pass. appear, become visible; impf. 3 sg. pass., crasis of προ-εφαίνετο
glossary.πυθμέν: πυθμήν — base, stock, trunk; masc. acc. sg., elided (πυθμέν’ = πυθμένα)
glossary.σπερχομένη: σπέρχω — hurry, press on; mid. rush; pres. part. mid. fem. nom. sg.: ’speeding’
glossary.σχῶνται: ἴσχομαι (ἔχω) — hold oneself back, stop; aor. subj. 3 pl. mid. (stem σχ-), in a purpose clause after ἵνα
glossary.τίει: τίω — honour, hold in honour; pres. 3 sg. (long ι; = Attic τιμᾷ)
glossary.τίνυται: τίνυμαι — punish, exact vengeance on; pres. 3 sg. mid.
glossary.τίουσιν: τίω — honour, hold in honour; pres. 3 pl. (long ι; = Attic τιμῶσι)
glossary.τίσαιτο: τίνυμαι — punish, exact payment from; aor. opt. 3 sg. mid., wish: ’may he punish’
glossary.τεύξειεν: τεύχω — make, render; aor. opt. 3 sg., with movable ν (τεύξειε), in a purpose clause after ὄφρα · also aor. opt. 3 sg. in a deliberative indirect question after ἠέ: ’whether he should contrive’
glossary.τιμήεις: τιμήεις — honoured, held in honour; masc. nom. sg., poetic (Attic ἔντιμος), predicate adj.
glossary.φέρω: φέρω — carry, bear, bring; pres. 1 sg. (or deliberative subj., same spelling): ’am I carrying / am I to carry’
glossary.φαινέσκετο: φαίνω — show; pass. appear, seem; iterative impf. 3 sg. pass. in -σκε-, epic (= Attic ἐφαίνετο): ’kept appearing’
glossary.χέρσ: χείρ — hand; fem. dat. pl., epic by-form χέρσι, elided (χέρσ’ = χέρσι, Attic χερσί): ’by the hands’
glossary.ψαμάθῳ: ψάμαθος — sand, sandy shore; fem. dat. sg.
glossary.ἀθρόα: ἀθρόος — crowded together, all together; neut. acc. pl.
