glossary.ἀλλοειδέα: ἀλλοειδής — of another look, strange-looking; neut. nom. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἀλλοειδῆ)
glossary.ἀμφικαλύψαι: ἀμφικαλύπτω — enfold, cover all round; aor. inf., in a proposal: ’to cover’
glossary.ἀπήγαγον: ἀπάγω — lead away, carry off; aor. 3 pl., augmented
glossary.ἀπειλάων: ἀπειλή — threat; fem. gen. pl., epic -άων (= Attic -ῶν)
glossary.ἀπεών: ἄπειμι — be away, be absent; pres. part. masc. nom. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἀπών)
glossary.ἀπηύρων: ἀπαυράω — take away, deprive of; impf. 1 sg., epic (augmented ἀπ-ηύρων), + acc. of the thing taken
glossary.ἀπολλήξωσι: ἀπολλήγω — cease from (+ gen.); aor. subj. 3 pl., in a purpose clause after ἵνα (= Attic ἀπολήγω)
glossary.ἀποτῖσαι: ἀποτίνω — pay back, pay in full; aor. inf., after πρίν: ’pay in full for’
glossary.ἀριθμήσω: ἀριθμέω — count, reckon; fut. indic. or short-vowel aor. subj. 1 sg., hortatory if subj.: ’I shall count / let me count’
glossary.ἀστοί: ἀστός — townsman, fellow citizen; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἀτιμάζουσι: ἀτιμάζω — dishonour, slight; pres. 3 pl. (= Attic ἀτιμάζουσιν), + acc.
glossary.ἀτιμίῃσιν: ἀτιμίη — dishonour, disgrace; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσιν (= Attic ἀτιμίαις)
glossary.ἀτραπιτοί: ἀτραπιτός — path, track; fem. nom. pl.
glossary.ἁμάρτῃ: ἁμαρτάνω — miss, err, do wrong; aor. subj. 3 sg., in a general relative clause without κε: ’whoever errs’
glossary.ἄξειν: ἄγω — lead, bring; fut. inf., after ἔφαντο: ’(said they) would bring’
glossary.ἐλάσας: ἐλαύνω — drive, strike; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having struck’ (with a blow of the hand)
glossary.ἐλαυνομένην: ἐλαύνω — drive, urge on, row; pres. part. pass. fem. acc. sg. (of a ship): ’being driven on’
glossary.ἐλεήσῃ: ἐλεέω — pity, have mercy; aor. subj. 3 sg., in a condition after αἴ κε: ’if he take pity’
glossary.ἐννοσίγαι: ἐννοσίγαιος — earth-shaker, epithet of Poseidon; masc. voc. sg., elided (ἐννοσίγαι’ = ἐννοσίγαιε)
glossary.ἐξείρετο: ἐξείρομαι — ask out, inquire into (+ acc.); impf. 3 sg. mid., augmented
glossary.ἐξικόμην: ἐξικνέομαι — come to, reach; aor. 1 sg., with κε, unreal past: ’I should have reached’
glossary.ἐπέδησ: ἐπιδέω — bind on, fetter (or aor. of πεδάω ’fetter’, spelled the same); aor. 3 sg., elided (ἐπέδησ’ = ἐπέδησε)
glossary.ἐπέκελσεν: ἐπικέλλω — drive on, run aground; aor. 3 sg., intransitive of a ship: ’ran ashore’
glossary.ἐπίσταμαι: ἐπίσταμαι — know how to, understand; pres. 1 sg. mid. deponent, + inf.
glossary.ἐπείγετο: ἐπείγω — press, drive on; pass./mid. hasten, be driven; impf. 3 sg. pass.: ’was driven on, was urged on’
glossary.ἐπηπείλησε: ἐπαπειλέω — threaten, make threats against; aor. 3 sg., augmented, + dat.
glossary.ἐρρίζωσεν: ῥιζόω — make take root, fix in the ground; aor. 3 sg., augment ἐ- with doubled ρ
glossary.ἐτέλεσσαν: τελέω — bring to pass, fulfil; aor. 3 pl., epic -εσσαν (= Attic ἐτέλεσαν)
glossary.ἐϋζύγου: ἐΰζυγος — well-yoked, with good cross-benches (exact sense uncertain); adj. of two terminations, fem. gen. sg., epic ἐΰ- (= εὐ-), epithet of a ship
glossary.ἑτοιμάσσαντο: ἑτοιμάζω — make ready, prepare; aor. 3 pl. mid., epic -σσ- (= Attic ἡτοιμάσαντο)
glossary.ἔγρεσθαι: ἐγείρω — wake, rouse; aor. inf. mid., 2nd aorist, epic (Attic ἐγερθῆναι): ’to wake up’, after πρίν
glossary.ἔνερθε: ἔνερθε — from beneath, below, underneath; adv.
glossary.ἔξ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; + gen.; accented ἔξ because the enclitic εἰσι follows it: ’of (my stock)’
glossary.ἔρξαιμι: ἔρδω — do, perform; aor. opt. 1 sg. with κε, potential: ’I would do it’
glossary.ἔρξον: ἔρδω — do, act; aor. imper. 2 sg.
glossary.ἔσομαι: εἰμί — be; fut. 1 sg., middle form
glossary.ἠεροειδέϊ: ἠεροειδής — misty, murky, dark (of the sea); masc. dat. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἠεροειδεῖ)
glossary.ἠλίβατοι: ἠλίβατος — steep, towering (sense uncertain; ’steep’ is the traditional guess); adj., fem. nom. pl.
glossary.ἠπείρῳ: ἤπειρος — mainland, dry land, shore; fem. dat. sg.
glossary.ἰάλλειν: ἰάλλω — send, hurl, let loose; pres. inf.: ’to assail, to heap upon’ (+ dat. of the thing, ἀτιμίῃσιν ’with dishonours’)
glossary.ἱερεύσομεν: ἱερεύω — sacrifice, slaughter; fut. or short-vowel aor. subj. 1 pl.: ’we shall sacrifice’
glossary.ἱκετήσιος: ἱκετήσιος — of suppliants, protector of suppliants; adj. of two terminations, masc. nom. sg. (epithet of Zeus)
glossary.ἴκελον: ἴκελος — like, resembling (+ dat.); masc. acc. sg., epic (= Attic ὅμοιος)
glossary.ὀδυσῆϊ: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus; masc. dat. sg., epic Ὀδυσῆϊ (single σ, diaeresis; = Ὀδυσσῆϊ, Attic Ὀδυσσεῖ)
glossary.ὀπίζομαι: ὀπίζομαι — fear, hold in awe, shrink from; pres. 1 sg. mid., + acc.
glossary.ὁδιτάων: ὁδίτης — wayfarer, traveller; masc. gen. pl., epic -άων (= Attic -ῶν)
glossary.ὁδοῦ: ὁδός — road, way; fem. gen. sg.: ’the road’ (ἐκτὸς ὁδοῦ ’off the road’)
glossary.ὑπέσχεο: ὑπισχνέομαι — promise, undertake; aor. 2 sg. mid., epic uncontracted (= ὑπέσχου)
glossary.ὑπερβασίην: ὑπερβασίη — overstepping, transgression, outrage; fem. acc. sg., Ionic -η (= Attic -α)
glossary.ὑπερμενέων: ὑπερμενής — of exceeding might, overweening; masc. gen. pl., epic -έων (= Attic -ῶν)
glossary.ὑφαντήν: ὑφαντός — woven; fem. acc. sg. (ἐσθῆτα ὑφαντήν ’woven clothing’)
glossary.ὣ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own; masc. acc. dual, taken so with μηρώ: ’his own (two thighs)’ (dual form, not the relative)
glossary.ὤπασαν: ὀπάζω — give, bestow, grant; aor. 3 pl., augmented (ὀπάζω, aor. ὤπασα), + dat. of the recipient
glossary.ᾤμωξέν: οἰμώζω — wail, cry out in distress; aor. 3 sg., augmented ᾤ- (οἰ- → ᾠ-), movable ν
glossary.ῥήγεϊ: ῥῆγος — rug, blanket; neut. dat. sg., epic -εϊ (= Attic ῥήγει)
glossary.ῥαῖσαι: ῥαίω — shatter, smash; aor. inf. act., after ἐθέλω: ’to smash’
glossary.βούβοτος: βούβοτος — cattle-grazed, good for cattle; adj. (2-term.), fem. nom. sg.
glossary.γῆ: γῆ — earth, land, country; fem. nom. sg. (Attic γῆ, epic γαῖα)
glossary.δίπτυχον: δίπτυχος — double-folded; adj. (2-term.), fem. acc. sg., agreeing with λώπην
glossary.δεδαϊγμένον: δαΐζω — tear apart, rend; perf. pass. part. neut. acc. sg. ’torn, lacerated’, agreeing with ἦτορ
glossary.δνοφερὴ: δνοφερός — dark, murky; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.δόλων: δόλος — trick, stratagem; masc. gen. pl., with ἆτα ’insatiate of tricks’
glossary.εἰκυῖα: ἔοικα — be like, resemble; perf. part. fem. nom. sg. (masc. ἐοικώς): ’likened, resembling’ + dat.
glossary.εἰλήλουθα: ἔρχομαι — come, go; redupl. perf. 1 sg., epic (= Attic ἐλήλυθα): ’I have come’
glossary.εὐδείελος: εὐδείελος — clear-seen or sunny (sense disputed); adj. (2-term.), fem. nom. sg.
glossary.εὐεργέα: εὐεργής — well-wrought; adj. (2-term.), fem. acc. sg., epic uncontracted -έα (= Attic -ῆ)
glossary.εὐρεῖα: εὐρύς — broad, wide; fem. nom. sg. (Attic εὐρεῖα)
glossary.θάρσυνάς: θαρσύνω — encourage, hearten; aor. 2 sg., unaugmented (= ἐθάρσυνας), accented before the enclitic τε
glossary.θεράπευον: θεραπεύω — serve, wait on, do service to; impf. 1 sg. (+ dat.)
glossary.κάτεχ: κατέχω — hold down, cover, envelop; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented, elided (κάτεχ’ = κάτεχε, = κατεῖχε)
glossary.κέρδε: κέρδος — gain, cunning, wile; neut. acc. pl., elided (κέρδε’ = κέρδεα, uncontracted; Attic κέρδη): ’wiles, schemes’
glossary.κέρδεσιν: κέρδος — gain, cunning, craft; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσιν (= Attic -εσι)
glossary.κατέκτανον: κατακτείνω — kill, slay; aor. 1 sg. (same -ον ending as 3 pl.), augmented epic ἔκτανον with κατά- prefixed (= Attic κατέκτεινα)
glossary.κατέρεξε: καταρρέζω — stroke, caress (with the hand); aor. 3 sg., epic
glossary.καταστῆσαι: καθίστημι — set down, bring to a place; aor. inf. act. (= Attic καταστῆσαι)
glossary.κατιόντα: κάτειμι — go down; pres. part. masc. acc. sg. (epic κατιών)
glossary.κερδαλέος: κερδαλέος — crafty, gain-seeking, cunning; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.κερτομέουσαν: κερτομέω — taunt, mock, jeer at; pres. part. fem. acc. sg., epic uncontracted -έουσαν (= Attic κερτομοῦσαν)
glossary.κεῖθ: κεῖμαι — lie, be situated; pres. 3 sg., κεῖται elided and aspirated before a rough breathing (κεῖθ’)
glossary.κιχάνω: κιχάνω — come upon, find, reach; pres. 1 sg. (poetic verb; middle by-form κιχάνομαι)
glossary.κλέομαι: κλέομαι — be famed, be renowned; pres. pass. 1 sg., epic (= κλείομαι)
glossary.κλοπίων: κλόπιος — thievish, stealthy, deceitful; adj., masc. gen. pl., with μύθων ’deceitful tales’
glossary.κρατέουσιν: κρατέω — rule, hold sway; pres. 3 pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic κρατοῦσιν)
glossary.λάθον: λανθάνω — escape notice of; aor. 1 sg./3 pl., unaugmented (= ἔλαθον), + acc. of the one deceived
glossary.λέβητας: λέβης — cauldron, basin; masc. acc. pl.
glossary.λήξειν: λήγω — cease, leave off, + gen.; fut. inf. (the future infinitive after ἔμελλες ’were going to’)
glossary.ληΐδα: ληΐς — booty, spoil; fem. acc. sg., Ionic (= Attic λεία)
glossary.λιπαροῖσι: λιπαρός — sleek, shining, oiled; masc./neut. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οῖς)
glossary.λυπρή: λυπρός — poor, mean, wretched; fem. nom. sg., predicative
glossary.λώπην: λώπη — cloak, mantle; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.μήτι: μῆτις — cunning intelligence, craft; fem. dat. sg., dative of respect ’in cunning’ (cf. acc. μῆτιν)
glossary.μνῆστις: μνῆστις — remembering, thought of; fem. nom. sg., + gen. (δόρπου μνῆστις ’thought of supper’)
glossary.νίκα: νικάω — conquer, surpass; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐνίκα) + acc.
glossary.ναιομένην: ναίω — dwell, inhabit; pres. pass. part. fem. acc. sg.: ’inhabited’, with εὖ ’well-peopled’
glossary.νωμῶν: νωμάω — handle, ply, turn over (in the mind); pres. part. masc. nom. sg., contracted
glossary.νώνυμός: νώνυμνος — nameless, without a name (= Attic ἀνώνυμος); adj., masc./fem. nom. sg., printed νώνυμος, accented before the enclitic ἐστιν
glossary.οἷοί: οἷος — such as, of the kind that; masc. nom. pl., correlative/relative, accented before the enclitic τε
glossary.οὐρανόν: οὐρανός — sky, heaven; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.πέδιλ: πέδιλον — sandal; neut. acc. pl., elided (πέδιλ’ = πέδιλα)
glossary.πίονι: πίων — fat, rich, fertile; masc./neut. dat. sg., with δήμῳ
glossary.παισὶ: παῖς — child, son; masc. dat. pl.
glossary.παναπάλῳ: παναπαλός — very tender (παν- intensive + ἁπαλός ’tender’); masc. dat. sg., agreeing with ἀνδρί
glossary.παντοίη: παντοῖος — of every kind, of all sorts; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.παντὶ: πᾶς — all, every; masc./neut. dat. sg.: ’to everyone’ (or ’to everything’)
glossary.παρέασι: πάρειμι — be present, be at hand; pres. 3 pl., epic (= Attic πάρεισι)
glossary.παρέλθοι: παρέρχομαι — pass by, get past, outwit; aor. opt. 3 sg.
glossary.παρίσταμαι: παρίστημι — set beside; mid. stand by, stand beside (to help); pres. 1 sg.
glossary.πεδόθεν: πεδόθεν — from the ground, from the bottom; adv. (πέδον ’ground’ + -θεν): ’from the foundations, through and through’
glossary.περικαλλέας: περικαλλής — very beautiful (περι- intensive); adj. (2-term.), masc. acc. pl., epic uncontracted -έας (= Attic -εῖς)
glossary.πλαγχθέντες: πλάζω — drive astray; pass. wander; aor. pass. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’driven off course’
glossary.ποιητοῖσι: ποιητός — well-made, well-built; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οῖς)
glossary.ποικιλομῆτα: ποικιλομήτης — of varied cunning, many-wiled; masc. voc. sg., short -α in the vocative
glossary.πολεμίζομεν: πολεμίζω — make war, fight; impf. 1 pl., unaugmented (= ἐπολεμίζομεν; the same form is also pres.): ’we were fighting’
glossary.πολυκερδέα: πολυκερδής — very crafty, full of cunning; adj. (2-term.), masc. acc. sg., epic uncontracted -έα (= Attic -ῆ)
glossary.πυνθανόμην: πυνθάνομαι — learn by inquiry, hear; impf. 1 sg. mid.: ’I used to hear’ (+ acc., gen.)
glossary.πόθει: ποθέω — long for, miss; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented, contracted from πόθεε (= ἐπόθει); + gen. of the thing longed for
glossary.πόνοισι: πόνος — toil, hardship; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
glossary.σάω: σαόω — save, keep safe; pres. imper. 2 sg., epic (= Attic σάου/σῴζε)
glossary.σιδονίην: Σιδονίη — Sidonia, Sidon (Phoenician city); fem. acc. sg., with ἐς ’to Sidon’
glossary.στερέσαι: στερέω — deprive of, rob (+ gen.); aor. inf. act. (= Attic στερῆσαι), epic
glossary.σῖτος: σῖτος — grain, bread, food; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ταχέεσσι: ταχύς — swift, fast; masc./neut. dat. pl., epic -έεσσι (= Attic ταχέσι)
glossary.τετλάμεναι: τλάω — endure, bear; perf. inf., epic -μεναι (= τετληκέναι); used as an imperative ’endure!’
glossary.τοίσδεσσι: ὅδε, ἥδε, τόδε — this (here); neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic τοῖσδε); ’with these goods’
glossary.τοσαῦτα: τοσοῦτος — so much, so many; neut. acc. pl., object of λιπών
glossary.τούς: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. pl. ’them’ · also with a noun, article-like: ’the, those’ (τούς τ’ ἄλλους ’and the others’)
glossary.τρηχεῖα: τρηχύς (Attic τραχύς) — rough, rugged; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.τρωϊάδος: Τρωϊάς — Trojan (woman); fem. adj., gen. sg., with ληΐδος ’Trojan booty’
glossary.φασὶν: φημί — say, assert; pres. 3 pl. (ν-movable), accented from the enclitic
glossary.φεύγω: φεύγω — flee, go into exile; pres. 1 sg.
glossary.χατέουσιν: χατέω — need, want, desire; pres. part. masc. dat. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic χατοῦσιν); ’for them wanting (to take)’ · also pres. 3 pl. indic., epic uncontracted (= Attic χατοῦσι), + inf.: ’they long (to speak)’ (δμῶες χατέουσιν … φάσθαι)
glossary.χρήμασι: χρῆμα — thing, goods; neut. dat. pl. (Attic -σι); ’with these goods’
glossary.χρήματά: χρῆμα — thing, matter; pl. ’goods, property’; neut. acc. pl., accented before the enclitic τε
glossary.ἀγορευέμεναι: ἀγορεύω — speak, say; pres. inf., epic -έμεναι (= Attic ἀγορεύειν)
glossary.ἀγρόθεν: ἀγρόθεν — from the field, from the country; adv. (ἀγρός ’field’ + -θεν)
glossary.ἀεκαζομένους: ἀεκάζομαι — be unwilling, act against one’s will; pres. part. masc. acc. pl.: ’unwilling, constrained’
glossary.ἀκτὴ: ἀκτή — headland, shore, coast; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀλάλκοις: ἀλαλκεῖν — ward off, keep off (ἀλέξω); aor. opt. 2 sg., reduplicated epic aorist, + dat. of the person
glossary.ἀλφηστὰς: ἀλφηστής — ’bread-eating’ (epithet of men); sense disputed, some derive it from ἀλφεῖν ’earn’ (’gain-winning’); masc. acc. pl.
glossary.ἀναστρέφομαι: ἀναστρέφω — turn up and down; mid. roam over, move about in; pres. 1 sg. (+ acc.)
glossary.ἀνασχέσθαι: ἀνέχομαι — endure, bear; aor. inf. mid. (second aorist, ἀν- + ἔσχον)
glossary.ἀντιάσαντι: ἀντιάω — meet, encounter; aor. part. masc. dat. sg.: ’to one meeting (her)’
glossary.ἀντιάσειε: ἀντιάω — meet, encounter; aor. opt. 3 sg.
glossary.ἀπατάων: ἀπάτη — trick, deceit; fem. gen. pl., epic -άων (= Attic -ῶν)
glossary.ἀποβάντες: ἀποβαίνω — step off, disembark; aor. part. masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἀπούρας: ἀπαυράω — take away, deprive; aor. part. masc. nom. sg., epic (ἀπούρας = ἀφελόμενος): ’having taken away’
glossary.ἀπώσατο: ἀπωθέω — push away, drive off; aor. 3 sg. mid., epic ἀπώσατο (= ἀπεώσατο): ’thrust away’
glossary.ἄκοντα: ἄκων — javelin, spear; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἆτ: ἄατος (ἆτος) — insatiable; masc. voc. sg., elided (ἆτ’ = ἆτα, an unusual -α vocative), with the gen. δόλων ’insatiate of tricks’
glossary.ἐΐσκεις: ἐΐσκω — liken, make like; deem, suppose; pres. 2 sg.: ’you liken (yourself)’ · also with an object, ’you liken (me)’ (τί μ’ ἀθανάτοισιν ἐΐσκεις ’why do you liken me to the immortals?’)
glossary.ἐγγεγάασιν: ἐγγίγνομαι — be born in, dwell in; perf. 3 pl., epic (= Attic ἐγγεγόνασιν): ’have been born in, live in’
glossary.ἐκείμεθα: κεῖμαι — lie, be laid; impf. 1 pl.: ’we lay’
glossary.ἐκείμην: κεῖμαι — lie, be laid; impf. 1 sg.: ’I lay’
glossary.ἐμὰς: ἐμός — my, mine; fem. acc. pl., agreeing with φρένας
glossary.ἐναντίος: ἐναντίος — opposite, face to face; masc. nom. sg., predicative: ’facing (her)’
glossary.ἐξαπατῆσαι: ἐξαπατάω — deceive utterly, cheat; aor. inf. act.
glossary.ἐπίκλοπος: ἐπίκλοπος — thievish, wily, deceitful; adj. (2-term.), masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἐπειοί: Ἐπειοί — the Epeians (people of Elis); masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἐπηετανοὶ: ἐπηετανός — abundant, never-failing (sense only approximate); masc. nom. pl., agreeing with ἀρδμοί
glossary.ἐπιβώτορι: ἐπιβώτωρ — herdsman, shepherd; masc. dat. sg., in apposition to ἀνδρί
glossary.ἐπιβᾶσαν: ἐπιβαίνω — step on, go aboard (+ gen.); aor. part. fem. acc. sg., agreeing with σέ; ’having boarded’
glossary.ἐπισταμένῳ: ἐπίσταμαι — know, understand, be skilled; pres. part. masc. dat. sg.: ’to one who knows well’
glossary.ἐριβώλακος: ἐριβώλαξ — rich-soiled, with big clods; adj. (2-term.), fem. gen. sg., with ἠπείροιο
glossary.ἐφέσσαι: ἐφίζω — make sit upon, set upon; aor. inf. act., epic -σσ- (= Attic ἐφίσαι)
glossary.ἐῢ: ἐΰς — good; neut. ἐῢ as adv. ’well’ (= εὖ)
glossary.ἑρπύζων: ἑρπύζω — creep, crawl, walk slowly; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἔγνως: γιγνώσκω — know, recognize; aor. 2 sg.: ’you recognized’
glossary.ἔθηκα: τίθημι — put, place; make (so-and-so); aor. 1 sg. (κ-aorist): ’I made (you dear to)’
glossary.ἠπίη: ἤπιος — kindly, gentle, mild; fem. nom. sg., epic (Attic ἠπία), predicative
glossary.ἠπεροπεύσῃς: ἠπεροπεύω — deceive, cheat; aor. subj. 2 sg., in a purpose clause with ἵν’
glossary.ἠρίθμει: ἀριθμέω — count, number; impf. 3 sg., contracted -εε → -ει: ’he went on counting’ (augment lengthens α to η)
glossary.ἤγαγες: ἄγω — lead, bring; aor. 2 sg. (reduplicated 2nd aorist), augmented: ’you led’
glossary.ἤλιδα: Ἦλις — Elis (region of the Epeians); fem. acc. sg., with εἰς ’to Elis’ · also acc. sg. after παρά: ’past Elis’ (παρ’ Ἤλιδα δῖαν)
glossary.ἤϊκτο: ἔοικα — be like, seem; plpf. 3 sg., epic (= Attic ᾔκει): ’she was like’ + dat.
glossary.ἥκειν: ἥκω — have come, be present; pres. inf.
glossary.ἧός: ἧος — until, while; temporal conj., epic (= Attic ἕως), accented before the enclitic με · also ’as long as’, accented before the enclitic μοι (ἧός μοι … ζώει)
glossary.ἰδομενῆος: Ἰδομενεύς — Idomeneus, Cretan leader; masc. gen. sg., epic -ῆος (= Attic -έως)
glossary.ἰδυίῃ: οἶδα — know; perf. part. fem. dat. sg., epic (= Attic εἰδυίᾳ): ’skilled, knowing’ + acc.
glossary.ἱκάνομεν: ἱκάνω — come to, arrive at; impf. 1 pl. (the same form is also pres.; poetic by-form of ἱκνέομαι): ’we came’
glossary.ἱππήλατός: ἱππήλατος — fit for driving horses (ἵππος + ἐλαύνω); adj., masc./fem. nom. sg., accented before the enclitic ἐστιν
glossary.ὀδύρετο: ὀδύρομαι — lament, mourn; impf. 3 sg. mid.
glossary.ὀξέϊ: ὀξύς — sharp, keen; masc. dat. sg., epic ὀξέϊ (= Attic ὀξεῖ)
glossary.ὀρσίλοχον: Ὀρσίλοχος — Orsilochus, a Cretan; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ὑποδέγμενος: ὑποδέχομαι — receive, undergo; aor. part. masc. nom. sg., syncopated (= ὑποδεξάμενος)
glossary.ὑφήνω: ὑφαίνω — weave, plot; aor. subj. 1 sg., in a purpose clause with ἵνα
glossary.ὑφαντά: ὑφαντός — woven; verbal adj., neut. acc. pl., agreeing with εἵματα
glossary.ὤμοισιν: ὦμος — shoulder; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις)
glossary.ᾤχοντ: οἴχομαι — be gone, go; impf. 3 pl., elided (ᾤχοντ’ = ᾤχοντο): ’they were gone’
glossary.αἵματί: αἷμα — blood; neut. dat. sg., accent from the following enclitic τ’ ’with blood’
glossary.βάλανον: βάλανος — acorn, mast; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.βουλεύσαντε: βουλεύω — plan, take counsel; aor. part. masc. nom. dual ’the two having planned’
glossary.γήθησέν: γηθέω — rejoice, be glad; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐγήθησεν); extra accent from the enclitic τ’
glossary.γλαυκῶπι: γλαυκῶπις — gleaming-eyed (or ’owl-eyed’; sense uncertain), epithet of Athena; fem. voc. sg.
glossary.δαήμεναι: δάω — learn, find out (aor. pass. ἐδάην); aor. 2 pass. inf., epic -ήμεναι (= Attic δαῆναι)
glossary.διέτμαγεν: διατμήγω — cut apart; aor. 2 pass. 3 pl., epic -εν (= -ησαν), ’parted’; can agree with a dual subject
glossary.διδώσομεν: δίδωμι — give; fut. 1 pl., epic by-form with the reduplicated stem kept (= Attic δώσομεν)
glossary.εἰποῦσα: λέγω, aor. εἶπον — say; aor. part. fem. nom. sg. ’having said’
glossary.εἰσαφικέσθαι: εἰσαφικνέομαι — come to, arrive at; aor. inf. mid. (also in the sense of a command, ’go to’)
glossary.εὐποίητα: εὐποίητος — well-made; neut. acc. pl. (= εὖ + ποιέω)
glossary.εὐχωλῇς: εὐχωλή — prayer, vow; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃς (= Attic εὐχαῖς; Ionic η for α)
glossary.θείμεν: τίθημι — put, place; aor. 1 pl., optative (Attic θεῖμεν) or shortened subjunctive θείομεν; used as an exhortation, ’let us put’
glossary.κάρψεν: κάρφω — dry up, wither, shrivel; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔκαρψεν)
glossary.κάρψω: κάρφω — dry up, wither, shrivel; fut. 1 sg. ’I will wither’
glossary.καθέξει: κατέχω — hold down, cover, hold fast; fut. 3 sg. (καθ- from κατά before the rough breathing of ἕξει)
glossary.καθεζομένω: καθέζομαι — sit down; pres. part. masc. nom. dual ’the two sitting down’
glossary.καλέουσα: καλέω — call, summon; pres. part. fem. nom. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic καλοῦσα); may carry a sense of purpose, ’to summon’
glossary.καλλιγύναικα: καλλιγύναιξ — with fair women; adj. (2-term.), fem. acc. sg., agreeing with Σπάρτην
glossary.κατέδουσιν: κατεσθίω — eat up, devour; pres. 3 pl., from the epic present κατέδω (= Attic κατεσθίουσιν)
glossary.κατέθηκε: κατατίθημι — put down, put away, store; aor. 3 sg. (κ-aorist) ’put away’
glossary.καταειμένον: καθέννυμι — clothe, cover; perf. mid./pass. part. neut. nom. sg. (καταείμενος) ’clothed in’, with dat. · also neut. acc. sg., agreeing with ὄρος: ’clothed in forest’
glossary.κνυζώσω: κνυζόω — make dim, darken (rare; sense from context); fut. 1 sg. ’I will dim’
glossary.κνύζωσεν: κνυζόω — make dim, darken (rare; sense from context); aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐκνύζωσεν)
glossary.κοιρανέουσι: κοιρανέω — rule, lord it over; pres. 3 pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic κοιρανοῦσι)
glossary.κρήνῃ: κρήνη — spring, fountain; fem. dat. sg.
glossary.κόρακος: κόραξ — raven; masc. gen. sg.; in Κόρακος πέτρη it is a name (’the rock of Corax’), the same word as κόραξ ’raven’
glossary.λήσεις: λανθάνω — escape the notice of (+ acc.); fut. 2 sg. ’you will escape me’
glossary.λαῖφος: λαῖφος — rag, tattered cloth (also sail); neut. acc. sg.
glossary.λοχόωσι: λοχάω — lie in ambush for, waylay; pres. 3 pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic λοχῶσι)
glossary.λύομεν: λύω — loose, untie; impf. 1 pl., unaugmented (= ἐλύομεν) ’we were loosing’ · also pres. indic. 1 pl. (same form) ’we loose’
glossary.μάχεσθαι: μάχομαι — fight (epic μαχέομαι); pres. inf. (Attic μάχεσθαι), + dat. ’fight against’
glossary.μίμνῃ: μίμνω — stay, remain (reduplicated by-form of μένω); pres. subj. 3 sg. (Attic μένῃ)
glossary.μαιομένη: μαίομαι — seek, search for; pres. part. mid. fem. nom. sg.
glossary.μελέεσσι: μέλος — limb; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic μέλεσι), with the stem vowel kept (μελε-)
glossary.μελόντων: μέλω — be a care to, concern; pres. imper. 3 pl. (also μελέτωσαν) ’let them be a care’
glossary.μεμαυῖα: μέμονα (perf. of μάω) — be eager, strive; perf. part. fem. nom. sg. (masc. μεμαώς), ’eager’
glossary.μεμορυγμένα: μορύσσω — smear, befoul; perf. pass. part. neut. nom./acc. pl. ’smeared’, with dat. of the stain
glossary.νέμονται: νέμω — mid. graze, feed on, range over; pres. 3 pl. mid. ’they graze’
glossary.νήριτόν: Νήριτος — Neriton, a wooded mountain of Ithaca; neut. nom. sg. (Νήριτον ὄρος)
glossary.νοστήσεις: νοστέω — return home; fut. 2 sg. ’you will come home’
glossary.νύμφῃς: νύμφη — nymph; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃς (= Attic νύμφαις; Ionic η for α)
glossary.νύμφῃσι: νύμφη — nymph; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι (= Attic νύμφαις; Ionic η for α)
glossary.ξανθὰς: ξανθός — yellow, fair (of hair); fem. acc. pl.
glossary.πάσχῃ: πάσχω — suffer, experience; pres. subj. 3 sg. (after ἵνα)
glossary.πήρην: πήρη — wallet, beggar’s bag; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.πίνουσαι: πίνω — drink; pres. part. fem. nom. pl. ’drinking’
glossary.παλαξέμεν: παλάσσω — spatter, besmear; fut. inf., epic -έμεν (= Attic παλάξειν), ’to spatter’ with dat. of the stain
glossary.παρέσσομαι: πάρειμι — be present, stand by; fut. 1 sg., epic σσ (= Attic παρέσομαι)
glossary.παρήμενον: πάρημαι — sit beside, sit near; pres. part. masc. acc. sg.
glossary.παρασταίης: παρίστημι — stand beside, support; aor. opt. 2 sg. (Attic παραστείης) ’you would stand by’
glossary.πατροκασιγνήτῳ: πατροκασίγνητος — father’s brother, uncle; masc. dat. sg., in apposition to Ποσειδάωνι
glossary.παῖδάς: παῖς — child, son; masc. acc. pl., accented before the enclitic τε
glossary.πειρήσεαι: πειράω — try, test, make trial of (+ gen.); aor. subj. mid. 2 sg., short-vowel (= πειρήσῃ) · also fut. indic. mid. 2 sg. (same form)
glossary.πενώμεθα: πένομαι — toil at, busy oneself with, prepare; pres. subj. 1 pl. mid., after ὁππότε κεν
glossary.πεποίθῃς: πείθω — persuade; perf. πέποιθα be convinced, trust; perf. subj. 2 sg. ’you may be convinced’
glossary.πολλὰς: πολύς — much, many; fem. acc. pl., accent grave mid-clause
glossary.πολυθαρσὲς: πολυθαρσής — very daring, full of courage (πολύ + θάρσος); neut. acc. sg., agreeing with μένος
glossary.προλιπεῖν: προλείπω — leave, forsake, abandon; aor. 2 inf.
glossary.πόμπευον: πομπεύω — escort, conduct; impf. 1 sg., unaugmented (= ἐπόμπευον) ’I escorted’
glossary.σκέδασ: σκεδάννυμι — scatter, disperse; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented, elided (σκέδασ’ = σκέδασε, Attic ἐσκέδασε)
glossary.στρόφος: στρόφος — twisted cord, rope; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.στυγέῃσιν: στυγέω — hate, shudder at, loathe; pres. subj. 3 sg., epic -ῃσιν (= Attic στυγῇ), in a relative clause with κε
glossary.στῆθι: ἵστημι — set; aor. 2 intrans. stand; aor. imper. 2 sg. ’stand!’
glossary.σόα: σόος — safe, sound (Attic σῶς); neut. nom. pl.
glossary.σύεσσι: σῦς — pig (by-form of ὗς); masc./fem. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic συσί)
glossary.ταχείης: ταχύς — swift, fleet; fem. gen. sg., Ionic -είης (= Attic -είας)
glossary.τεθαλυῖαν: θάλλω — bloom, thrive, swell; perf. part. fem. acc. sg. ’thriving, flourishing’ (masc. τεθηλώς)
glossary.τεύξω: τεύχω — make, fashion, render; fut. 1 sg. ’I will make’ (also aor. subj., same form)
glossary.τριηκοσίοισιν: τριακόσιοι — three hundred; masc. dat. pl., epic τριηκόσιοι with -οισιν (= Attic τριακοσίοις)
glossary.φανήῃς: φαίνω — show; aor. 2 pass. φανῆναι appear; aor. subj. 2 sg. pass., epic uncontracted -ήῃς (= Attic φανῇς)
glossary.φθίσεσθαι: φθίνω — perish, waste away; fut. inf. mid. ’to perish’ (after ἔμελλον)
glossary.φραζέσθην: φράζομαι — think out, devise, plan; impf. 3 dual, unaugmented (= ἐφραζέσθην)
glossary.φραζώμεθ: φράζομαι — think out, devise, plan; pres. subj. 1 pl. mid., hortative, elided (φραζώμεθ’ = φραζώμεθα) ’let us plan’
glossary.χαίρετ: χαίρω — rejoice, be glad, farewell; pres. imper. 2 pl., elided (χαίρετ’ = χαίρετε) ’be glad’, with dat. of what gives joy; also a parting word ’farewell’ · also indic. 2 pl. (same form)
glossary.χθών: χθών — earth, land, ground; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ψιλόν: ψιλός — bare, stripped; neut. acc. sg., agreeing with δέρμα (masc. ψιλός)
glossary.ἀέξῃ: ἀέξω — make grow, rear, increase; pres. subj. 3 sg. (after αἴ κεν) · also pres. subj. 3 sg. in a general relative clause (ὅς … κάμῃσι, θεὸς … ἀέξῃ): ’may make grow’
glossary.ἀγανῇσι: ἀγανός — gentle, kindly; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι (= Attic ἀγαναῖς)
glossary.ἀγελείη: ἀγελείη — epithet of Athena, traditionally ’driver of spoil’ (ἄγω + λεία); fem. nom. sg., sense not certain
glossary.ἀγχίνοος: ἀγχίνοος — quick-witted, shrewd (ἄγχι + νόος); adj. (2-term.), masc. nom. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἀγχίνους)
glossary.ἀλαλήμενος: ἀλάομαι — wander; perf. part. mid. masc. nom. sg., reduplicated, epic (ἀλαλήμενος) ’wandered’
glossary.ἀλοιφήν: ἀλοιφή — fat, grease; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀορτήρ: ἀορτήρ — strap, sling (by which a bag hangs); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀπίστεον: ἀπιστέω — disbelieve, distrust; impf. 1 sg., unaugmented and uncontracted (= ἠπίστουν)
glossary.ἀποτίσομαι: ἀποτίνομαι — exact vengeance upon, punish; fut. 1 sg. mid. (also aor. subj., same form)
glossary.ἀρεθούσῃ: Ἀρέθουσα — Arethusa, a spring on Ithaca; fem. dat. sg.
glossary.ἀτειρέα: ἀτειρής — unwearing, hard, unbreakable; masc. acc. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἀτειρῆ)
glossary.ἄνθρωπον: ἄνθρωπος — man, human being; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἄροιτο: ἄρνυμαι — win, gain, earn; aor. 2 opt. 3 sg. mid. (ἀρέσθαι) ’might win’
glossary.ἐθέλησα: ἐθέλω — wish, be willing; aor. 1 sg., unaugmented (= ἠθέλησα)
glossary.ἐλάφοιο: ἔλαφος — deer, hind; masc./fem. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.ἐνεῖσα: ἐνίημι — send in, put into; aor. part. fem. nom. sg. ’having put in’
glossary.ἐνθύμιος: ἐνθύμιος — taken to heart, weighing on the mind; adj., masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἐπίουρος: ἐπίουρος — guardian, overseer (ἐπί + οὖρος); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἐπαρήγοις: ἐπαρήγω — come to help, assist; pres. opt. 2 sg. ’you would help’
glossary.ἐπεμάσσατ: ἐπιμάσσομαι — touch, stroke; aor. 3 sg. mid., elided (ἐπεμάσσατ’ = ἐπεμάσσατο)
glossary.ἐπητής: ἐπητής — kindly, gracious (sense uncertain; perhaps ’of good speech’); adj., masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἐφήσεις: ἐφίημι — send upon, set on; fut. 2 sg.; χεῖρας ἐφιέναι ’lay hands on’
glossary.ἐχέφρονα: ἐχέφρων — sensible, prudent (ἔχω + φρήν); adj. (2-term.), fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἐᾷ: ἐάω — allow, permit; pres. subj. 3 sg., contracted (also indic., same form)
glossary.ἔλθω: ἔρχομαι — come, go; aor. (ἦλθον) subj. 1 sg. ’I may go’
glossary.ἔρδεσκες: ἔρδω — do, perform, sacrifice; iterative impf. 2 sg. in -εσκ- ’you used to perform’
glossary.ἔσθουσαι: ἔσθω — eat (epic by-form of ἐσθίω); pres. part. fem. nom. pl. ’eating’
glossary.ἕσσ: ἕννυμι — clothe, put on; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented, elided (ἕσσ’ = ἕσσε, Attic ἡμφίεσε), with ἀμφί in tmesis
glossary.ἕσσω: ἕννυμι — clothe, put on; fut. 1 sg. (cf. aor. ἕσσε), with ἀμφί in tmesis ’I will clothe in’ · also fut. 1 sg. with no preverb, double accusative: ’I will clothe (him) in (a cloak)’
glossary.ἠρήσατο: ἀράομαι — pray, pray to; aor. 3 sg. mid. (augment ἀ- → ἠ-)
glossary.ἤπια: ἤπιος — gentle, kindly; neut. acc. pl., ἤπια εἰδέναι ’be kindly disposed’
glossary.ἱερῆς: ἱερός — sacred, holy; fem. gen. sg., Ionic -ῆς (= Attic -ᾶς)
glossary.ἵετ: ἵεμαι (mid. of ἵημι) — hasten, long, be eager; impf. 3 sg. mid., elided (ἵετ’ = ἵετο)
glossary.ὀδυρομένη: ὀδύρομαι — lament, mourn for; pres. part. fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ὀλέσω: ὄλλυμι — destroy, lose; fut. 1 sg. (Attic ὀλῶ), uncontracted; also aor. subj. 1 sg. (same form)
glossary.ὀϊζυραὶ: ὀϊζυρός — wretched, miserable; fem. nom. pl.
glossary.ὄλεσε: ὄλλυμι — destroy, lose; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ὤλεσε)
glossary.ὑπερφιάλοισιν: ὑπερφίαλος — overweening, arrogant; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις)
glossary.ὑῶν: ὗς — pig, swine; masc./fem. gen. pl. (Attic ὑῶν)
glossary.ὔμμ: σύ — you; pl. acc. ὔμμε, epic/Aeolic (= Attic ὑμᾶς), elided (ὔμμ’ = ὔμμε)
glossary.ὕεσσι: ὗς — pig, swine; masc./fem. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic ὑσί)
glossary.ὕλῃ: ὕλη — forest, woodland; fem. dat. sg.
glossary.ὕφηνον: ὑφαίνω — weave; devise; aor. imper. 2 sg. (aor. ὕφηνα) ’weave!’
glossary.ῥωγαλέα: ῥωγαλέος — ragged, torn; neut. nom./acc. pl.
glossary.ῥωγαλέην: ῥωγαλέος — ragged, torn; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.αἰπόλια: αἰπόλιον — herd of goats; neut. nom./acc. pl.
glossary.βόειον: βόειος — of an ox, ox-; neut. acc. sg., agreeing with δέρμα
glossary.βόσκουσι: βόσκω — feed, pasture, tend; pres. 3 pl. act., transitive: ’tend’
glossary.βῶσιν: βαίνω — go; aor. subj. 3 pl. (= Attic βῶσι), ν-movable
glossary.δίκην: δίκη — justice, right; fem. acc. sg., object of τίουσι ’honour justice’
glossary.δαρδάπτουσιν: δαρδάπτω — devour, tear up; pres. 3 pl., ν-movable
glossary.δασείας: δασύς — thick, bushy; fem. acc. pl., agreeing with ῥῶπας
glossary.δασύ: δασύς — thick, shaggy; neut. acc. sg. (nom. and acc. alike), agreeing with ἐνεύναιον
glossary.δείμαθ: δέμω — build; aor. mid. 3 sg., unaugmented, elided (δείμαθ’ = ἐδείματο; θ for τ before a rough breathing)
glossary.δειδιότων: δείδω — fear; perf. part. gen. pl., present force, epic (= Attic δεδιότων)
glossary.δεσποίνης: δέσποινα — mistress, lady; fem. gen. sg.
glossary.διεδηλήσαντο: διαδηλέομαι — mangle, maul, tear apart; aor. 3 pl. mid., augment after the prefix
glossary.δικαίως: δικαίως — justly, rightly; adv. of δίκαιος
glossary.δμώεσσι: δμώς — slave, servant; masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic δμωσί)
glossary.δώδεκ: δώδεκα — twelve; numeral, indeclinable, elided (δώδεκ’ = δώδεκα)
glossary.εἰσαγαγών: εἰσάγω — lead in, bring in; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.
glossary.εὔθυμος: εὔθυμος — good-hearted, kindly; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.εὔμαιε: Εὔμαιος — Eumaeus, the swineherd; masc. voc. sg.
glossary.εὔπωλον: εὔπωλος — rich in foals, of fine horses; fem. acc. sg. (two-ending adj.), epithet of Ilios
glossary.εὗρ: εὑρίσκω — find; aor. 3 sg., elided (εὗρ’ = εὗρε)
glossary.εὗσέ: εὕω — singe; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= Attic ηὗσε); extra accent from the enclitic τε
glossary.ζατρεφέων: ζατρεφής — well-fed, sleek, thriving; gen. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ζατρεφῶν); masc. with σιάλων, fem. with αἰγῶν
glossary.ζωή: ζωή — life, livelihood, substance; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ζωστῆρι: ζωστήρ — belt, girdle; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.θέρμ: θερμός — hot; neut. acc. pl., elided (θέρμ’ = θέρμα, Attic θερμά), of roasted meat
glossary.θαμέας: θαμέες — close-set, thick, crowded (plural adj.); masc. acc. pl., epic (= Attic θαμεῖς), agreeing with σταυρούς
glossary.κάμῃσι: κάμνω — toil, work hard; aor. subj. 3 sg., epic -σι (= Attic κάμῃ), in a general relative clause
glossary.κήδετο: κήδω — trouble; mid. κήδομαι + gen. ’care for’; impf. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented (= ἐκήδετο)
glossary.κίρνη: κίρνημι — mix (wine with water); impf. 3 sg., unaugmented, epic (= ἐκίρνη)
glossary.κακίων: κακός — bad, base; comparative κακίων, masc. nom. sg. ’worse’, + gen. of comparison
glossary.καλή: καλός — fine, fair; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.κατέχευας: καταχέω — pour over, heap upon; aor. 2 sg., with κέν: unreal past ’you would have poured’
glossary.κεκλήγοντες: κλάζω — cry out, clamour; perf. part. masc. nom. pl., present force, epic -οντες (= κεκληγότες)
glossary.κισσυβίῳ: κισσύβιον — ivy-wood bowl, cup; neut. dat. sg.
glossary.κλισίηνδ: κλισίη — hut, shelter; fem. acc. sg., epic -ίη (= Attic κλισία) + suffix -δε ’towards’, elided: ’to the hut’
glossary.κλῆρόν: κλῆρος — allotment, land-portion; masc. acc. sg., accent from enclitic τε
glossary.κορεσαίατο: κορέννυμι — sate, satisfy; aor. mid. opt. 3 pl., epic -αίατο (= Attic κορέσαιντο), purpose after ὄφρα
glossary.κορεσσάμενος: κορέννυμι — sate; aor. mid. part. masc. nom. sg., epic -σσ- (= Attic κορεσάμενος), + gen.
glossary.κραιπνοῖσι: κραιπνός — swift, rushing; masc. dat. pl., epic -οῖσι (= Attic -οῖς)
glossary.κτήσατο: κτάομαι — acquire, get; aor. 3 sg. mid.
glossary.λιθάδεσσιν: λιθάς — stone; fem. dat. pl., epic -εσσιν (= Attic λιθάσι)
glossary.μίστυλλέν: μιστύλλω — cut up (meat) into pieces; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐμίστυλλε), ν-movable with accent from the enclitic τε
glossary.μετασπὼν: μεθέπομαι (lemma uncertain) — go after, hasten after; aor. part. masc. nom. sg., from the aorist stem σπ- of ἕπομαι
glossary.μινύθεσκον: μινύθω — lessen, wear down; iterative impf. 3 pl., -σκον (= ἐμινύθεσκον, unaugmented): ’kept diminishing’
glossary.μνᾶσθαι: μνάομαι — woo, court; pres. inf. mid.
glossary.ξυνεείκοσι: ξυνεείκοσι — twenty together, twenty in all; numeral, indeclinable (ξυν- = συν-, ἐείκοσι = εἴκοσι)
glossary.οἰκήων: οἰκεύς — household servant; masc. gen. pl., epic -ήων (= Attic οἰκέων)
glossary.οἰκῆϊ: οἰκεύς — household servant; masc. dat. sg., epic (= Attic οἰκεῖ)
glossary.οἶκόν: οἶκος — house, household; masc. acc. sg., accent from enclitic τε
glossary.πάλυνεν: παλύνω — sprinkle; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐπάλυνε), ν-movable
glossary.πάρεστι: πάρειμι — be present, be at hand; pres. 3 sg. (πάρ + ἐστι)
glossary.παρέθηκ: παρατίθημι — set beside, set before; aor. 3 sg., elided (παρέθηκ’ = παρέθηκε)
glossary.παυρότεροι: παῦρος — few, little; comparative παυρότερος, masc. nom. pl. ’fewer’
glossary.περίδρομος: περίδρομος — running round, open all round; fem. nom. sg. (two-ending adj.)
glossary.πλατέ: πλατύς — broad, wide; neut. nom./acc. pl., elided (πλατέ’ = πλατέα)
glossary.πλησάμενοι: πίμπλημι — fill; aor. mid. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’having filled’
glossary.πολυμνήστην: πολύμνηστος — much-wooed, with many suitors; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.προσέβη: προσβαίνω — go to, step forward; aor. 3 sg., root aorist (= προσ- + ἔβη), + acc. of the way
glossary.προσέφης: προσφημί — speak to, address; impf. 2 sg. (the poet’s address to Eumaeus; the usual 3 sg. is προσέφη)
glossary.πρόθυρον: πρόθυρον — forecourt, gateway; neut. acc. sg.
glossary.πρόχνυ: πρόχνυ — utterly, completely; adv., of uncertain origin (perhaps ’down on the knees’)
glossary.πυκνοὺς: πυκνός — thick, close, dense; masc. acc. pl.
glossary.πυκνῇσιν: πυκνός — thick, dense; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῇσιν (= Attic -αῖς)
glossary.σεῦεν: σεύω — chase, drive; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= Attic ἔσευε), ν-movable
glossary.σιάλων: σίαλος — fat hog; masc. gen. pl.
glossary.σκῦτος: σκῦτος — leather, hide; neut. nom. sg.
glossary.σταθμῷ: σταθμός — steading, farm-building, stall; masc. dat. sg. · also door-post, jamb (σταθμῷ κυπαρισσίνῳ ’a cypress door-post’)
glossary.σταυροὺς: σταυρός — stake, pale; masc. acc. pl.
glossary.στοναχάς: στοναχή — groan, sigh; fem. acc. pl.
glossary.συβόσια: συβόσιον — drove of swine; neut. nom./acc. pl.
glossary.συβῶτα: συβώτης — swineherd; masc. voc. sg., epic -α (in apposition to Εὔμαιε)
glossary.συνέεργε: συνέργω — shut together, bind up; impf. 3 sg., epic (= Attic συνεῖργε)
glossary.συσίν: σῦς (ὗς) — swine; masc./fem. dat. pl. (= epic ὕεσσι)
glossary.συφεούς: συφεός — pigsty, pen; masc. acc. pl.
glossary.συφεοὺς: συφεός — pigsty, pen; masc. acc. pl.
glossary.σφέτερ: σφέτερος — their own; possessive adj., neut. acc. pl., elided (σφέτερ’ = σφέτερα)
glossary.σύας: σῦς (ὗς) — swine, pig; masc./fem. acc. pl.
glossary.σύεσσιν: σῦς (ὗς) — swine; masc./fem. dat. pl., epic -εσσιν (= Attic συσί)
glossary.σῦν: σῦς (ὗς) — swine, hog; masc./fem. acc. sg.
glossary.τάμνων: τάμνω — cut; pres. part. masc. nom. sg., epic (= Attic τέμνων)
glossary.τάσδε: ὅδε, ἥδε, τόδε — this, this one; demonstrative pron., fem. acc. pl.: ’these’
glossary.τινι: τις, τι — someone, anyone; indef. pron., dat. sg., after a negative: οὔ τινι ’to no one’
glossary.τοκάδες: τοκάς — breeding, bearing young; fem. nom. pl., of sows: ’breeders’
glossary.τριηκόσιοί: τριηκόσιοι — three hundred; numeral, masc. nom. pl., epic -η- (= Attic τριακόσιοι); accent from enclitic τε
glossary.τόσ: τόσος — so much, so many; correlative adj., neut. acc. pl., elided (τόσ’ = τόσα)
glossary.τόσση: τόσος — so great, so much; epic τόσσος, fem. nom. sg.
glossary.φαίνηται: φαίνω — show; mid. φαίνομαι ’appear’; pres. subj. 3 sg. mid., in a general relative clause (ὅς τις …): ’whichever appears’
glossary.φειδώ: φειδώ — sparing, restraint, mercy; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.φιλέουσιν: φιλέω — love; pres. 3 pl., uncontracted (= Attic φιλοῦσι)
glossary.φρονέοντες: φρονέω — think, have in mind, heed; pres. part. masc. nom. pl., uncontracted (= Attic φρονοῦντες), + acc.
glossary.χοίρε: χοίρεος (χοίρειος) — of a piglet; neut. pl. as noun ’piglet-meat’, elided (χοίρε’ = χοίρεα)
glossary.ἀγέμεν: ἄγω — lead, drive; pres. inf., epic -έμεν (= Attic ἄγειν)
glossary.ἀγινεῖ: ἀγινέω — lead, bring; pres. 3 sg., contracted from ἀγινέει (epic by-form of ἄγω)
glossary.ἀγρίου: ἄγριος — wild, savage; masc./fem. gen. sg. (two-ending adj.), agreeing with αἰγός
glossary.ἀγρομένοισι: ἀγείρω — gather; epic syncopated aor. mid. part., dat. pl. -οισι (= ἀγερομένοις)
glossary.ἀεικέλιον: ἀεικέλιος — unseemly, shameful; neut. acc. sg., agreeing with ἄλγος · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with δίφρον: ’unseemly, mean’
glossary.ἀλλοθρόων: ἀλλόθροος — of other speech, foreign-speaking; masc. gen. pl.
glossary.ἀμφικεάσσας: ἀμφικεάζω (κεάζω) — split all around; aor. part. masc. nom. sg., epic -σσ-
glossary.ἀνέτλης: τλάω (ἀνα-) — endure, bear up; aor. 2 sg., root aorist (ἔτλην), with the prefix
glossary.ἀντίθεοι: ἀντίθεος — godlike, equal to the gods; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἀντιθέου: ἀντίθεος — godlike, equal to the gods; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.ἀποπέμπω: ἀποπέμπω — send off, send away; pres. 1 sg.
glossary.ἀποπροέηκε: ἀποπροίημι — send away, send forth; aor. 3 sg., epic -έηκε (= Attic ἀποπροῆκε)
glossary.ἀράρισκε: ἀραρίσκω — fit, join; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented: ’was fitting’
glossary.ἀταρπὸν: ἀταρπός — path, track; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀτιμῆσαι: ἀτιμάω — dishonour, slight; aor. inf., epic -ησαι (= Attic ἀτιμάσαι)
glossary.ἀτιτάλλω: ἀτιτάλλω — nurture, raise, tend; pres. 1 sg.
glossary.ἀχέρδῳ: ἄχερδος — wild pear (a thorny tree); fem. dat. sg., instrumental: ’with wild pear’
glossary.ἄλγεά: ἄλγος — pain, grief; neut. acc. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἄλγη); accent from enclitic τε
glossary.ἄνακτες: ἄναξ — lord, master; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἄσπετος: ἄσπετος — boundless, immense, unspeakable; fem. nom. sg. (two-ending adj.)
glossary.ἄφενος: ἄφενος — wealth, abundance; neut. nom. sg.
glossary.ἐελδόμενός: ἐέλδομαι (ἔλδομαι) — long for, desire; pres. part. mid. masc. nom. sg., + gen.; accent from the following enclitic
glossary.ἐθρίγκωσεν: θριγκόω — top with a coping, finish off (a wall); aor. 3 sg., augmented
glossary.ἐλεγχείην: ἐλεγχείη — disgrace, reproach; fem. acc. sg., epic -είη (= Attic ἐλεγχεία)
glossary.ἐλεητύν: ἐλεητύς — pity, compassion; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἐνεύναιον: ἐνεύναιον — bedding, bedclothes; neut. acc. sg.
glossary.ἐξαφύοντες: ἐξαφύω — draw off, ladle out; pres. part. masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἐπέδραμον: ἐπιτρέχω — run at, rush upon; aor. 3 pl. (stem δραμ-)
glossary.ἐπικρατέωσιν: ἐπικρατέω — rule, hold sway; pres. subj. 3 pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἐπικρατῶσιν), after ὅτ(ε) without ἄν · also pres. subj. 3 pl. after εὖτ’ ἄν, in a general temporal clause: ’whenever they hold sway’
glossary.ἐπιμίμνω: ἐπιμίμνω — stay at, persist in; pres. 1 sg., epic (= ἐπιμένω), + dat.
glossary.ἐποτρύνων: ἐποτρύνω — urge on, spur on; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἐρχατόωντο: ἐρχατάομαι — be penned, be shut in; impf. 3 pl. pass., epic -όωντο (= Attic -ῶντο)
glossary.ἐϋχροές: ἐϋχροής (εὔχροος) — of good colour, fine-skinned; neut. acc. sg., agreeing with δέρμα
glossary.ἔκπεσε: ἐκπίπτω — fall out, fall from; aor. 3 sg., + gen. of the place
glossary.ἔπειρεν: πείρω — pierce, run through, spit; impf. 3 sg. (augmented ἔ-πειρε), ν-movable
glossary.ἔσσυτ: σεύομαι — rush, hasten; aor. mid. 3 sg., epic, elided (ἔσσυτ’ = ἔσσυτο)
glossary.ἰονθάδος: ἰονθάς — shaggy, hairy (sense not certain); fem. gen. sg.
glossary.ἱερήϊον: ἱερήϊον — sacrificial animal, victim; neut. acc. sg., epic (= Attic ἱερεῖον)
glossary.ἱερεύσαντες: ἱερεύω — sacrifice, slaughter; aor. part. masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἱρεύουσ: ἱρεύω — sacrifice, slaughter (Ionic ἱρ- = ἱερ-); pres. 3 pl., elided (ἱρεύουσ’ = ἱρεύουσι)
glossary.ἴαυον: ἰαύω — sleep, lie down to sleep; impf. 3 pl. (the form also serves 1 sg.)
glossary.ὀλίγου: ὀλίγος — little, small; neut. gen. sg., of degree, adverbial: ὀλίγου ’within a little, almost’
glossary.ὀπτήσας: ὀπτάω — roast; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ὁμοκλήσας: ὁμοκλέω (ὁμοκλάω) — shout at, rebuke; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ὁππόσα: ὁππόσος — how many, how much; epic indirect interrog. (= Attic ὁπόσος); neut. acc. pl.
glossary.ὄλεθ: ὄλλυμι — destroy; mid. perish; aor. mid. 3 sg., unaugmented, elided (ὄλεθ’ = ὄλετο; θ for τ before a rough breathing)
glossary.ὄπιδα: ὄπις — regard (for the gods), fear of divine retribution; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ὄπιδος: ὄπις — regard (for the gods), fear of divine retribution; fem. gen. sg.
glossary.ὄρονται: ὄρομαι — keep watch over, guard; pres. 3 pl. mid., epic
glossary.ὑλήεντα: ὑλήεις — wooded, forested; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ὑλακόμωροι: ὑλακόμωρος — barking (ὑλάω ’bark’ + -μωρος, whose meaning is unknown); masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ὑπέδεξο: ὑποδέχομαι — receive, welcome; aor. 2 sg. mid., epic -ο (= Attic ὑπεδέξω)
glossary.ὑπέχευε: ὑποχέω — pour or spread beneath; aor. 3 sg. (ὑπ-έχευε)
glossary.ὑφορβόν: ὑφορβός — swineherd (ὑπό + φέρβω ’feed’); masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ὑφορβός: ὑφορβός — swineherd (ὑπό + φέρβω ’feed’); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ὕεσσιν: ὗς (σῦς) — swine; masc./fem. dat. pl., epic -εσσιν (= Attic ὑσί)
glossary.ὤνησεν: ὀνίνημι — benefit, help; aor. 3 sg. (ὤνησε), ν-movable; with κέ: ’would have benefited’
glossary.ὤφελλ: ὀφέλλω (ὀφείλω) — owe, be bound; impf. 3 sg., elided (ὤφελλ’ = ὤφελλε), in an unfulfillable wish with ὡς: ’would that’
glossary.ῥύομαί: ῥύομαι — protect, guard, keep safe; pres. 1 sg. mid., accent from enclitic τε
glossary.ῥῶπας: ῥώψ — twig, bush, brushwood; fem. acc. pl.
glossary.αἴνυται: αἴνυμαι — take, seize; pres. 3 sg. mid., epic (Attic αἱρεῖται, λαμβάνει); of a feeling, ’seizes, takes hold of’ + acc.
glossary.βάζει: βάζω — speak, say, utter; pres. 3 sg., epic: ’speaks’
glossary.βλάψε: βλάπτω — hinder, damage, disable; aor. 3 sg. act., unaugmented (= ἔβλαψε): ’harmed’
glossary.γλυκερὸν: γλυκερός — sweet; neut. nom. sg., epic by-form (Attic γλυκύς), agreeing with μέθυ · also neut. nom. sg. used in address, agreeing with φάος: ’sweet light’
glossary.γνώω: γιγνώσκω — get to know, recognise; aor. subj. 1 sg. act., epic -ώω (= Attic γνῶ): ’I may recognise’
glossary.γυναῖκά: γυνή — woman, wife; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.δεξαμένη: δέχομαι — receive, welcome; aor. part. mid. fem. nom. sg.: ’having welcomed’
glossary.δεχοίμην: δέχομαι — accept, receive; pres. opt. 1 sg. mid., potential with κε: ’I would accept’
glossary.διαπρήξαιμι: διαπρήσσω (Attic διαπράττω) — get through, accomplish, finish; aor. opt. 1 sg. act., potential: ’I could get through’
glossary.εἰλυμένα: εἰλύω — wrap, cover up; perf. part. mid./pass. neut. nom. pl.: ’wrapped, covered’ (in something, dat.)
glossary.εἶς: εἰμί — be; pres. 2 sg., epic (= Attic εἶ): ’you are’
glossary.εὐαγγέλιον: εὐαγγέλιον — reward for good news, news-gift (also the good news itself); neut. nom./acc. sg.
glossary.θρέψαν: τρέφω — rear, nurture; aor. 3 pl., epic -αν (= Attic ἔθρεψαν), unaugmented: ’they reared’
glossary.καλέω: καλέω — call, name; pres. 1 sg., uncontracted epic (= Attic καλῶ): ’I call’
glossary.κεδνοῖο: κεδνός — careful, caring, trusty; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -οῦ)
glossary.κεχρημένοι: χράομαι — use; perf. part. (+ gen.) ’in need of, lacking’; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.κεχρημένος: χράομαι — use; perf. part. (+ gen.) ’in need of, lacking’; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.κιχήσομαι: κιχάνω — come upon, find, reach; fut. 1 sg. mid., epic: ’I shall find’
glossary.κλισίης: κλισίη — hut, shelter; fem. gen. sg., Ionic -ίη (= Attic κλισία)
glossary.κομιδῆς: κομιδή — care, tending, provision; fem. gen. sg., after κεχρημένοι: ’in need of care’
glossary.λέλοιπεν: λείπω — leave, forsake; perf. 3 sg., ν-movable: ’has left’
glossary.λοχῶσιν: λοχάω — lie in ambush for, waylay; pres. 3 pl., contracted (Attic λοχῶσι), ν-movable
glossary.λυκάβαντος: λυκάβας — year, the circling of the year (exact sense and etymology disputed); masc. gen. sg.
glossary.μέλλουσι: μέλλω — be about to, be likely to (+ inf.); pres. 3 pl. (Attic μέλλουσι), ν-movable
glossary.μίμνησκ: μιμνήσκω — remind, bring to mind (+ gen.); pres. imper. 2 sg. act., elided (μίμνησκ’ = μίμνησκε): ’remind’
glossary.μεμνώμεθα: μιμνήσκομαι — remember, be mindful of; perf. subj. 1 pl. (of μέμνημαι), hortatory: ’let us remember’
glossary.μεταλλᾷ: μεταλλάω — inquire after, ask about; pres. 3 sg., contracted (Attic μεταλλᾷ)
glossary.μηνός: μείς (Attic μήν) — month; masc. gen. sg., epic/Ionic
glossary.νοστήσει: νοστέω — return home; fut. 3 sg. act.: ’will return’ · also aor. opt. 3 sg., elided (νοστήσει’ = νοστήσειε), in an indirect question after a past verb: ’how he might return’ (ὅππως νοστήσει’ …)
glossary.νώνυμον: νώνυμος — nameless, without fame; adj., neut. nom. sg., epic (= Attic ἀνώνυμος, ν- for ἀν-)
glossary.νῶϊν: ἐγώ — I; dual gen./dat., epic (= Attic νῷν): ’for us two’
glossary.ξενίη: ξένιος — of a guest, of hospitality; fem. nom. sg., Ionic -η (= Attic ξενία): ’hospitable’ (or the noun ’hospitality’)
glossary.παρατεκτήναιο: παρατεκταίνομαι — fashion falsely, forge, fabricate (τεκταίνομαι ’build’); aor. opt. 2 sg. mid., potential with κε: ’you would invent’
glossary.παρεόντ: πάρειμι — be present, be at hand; pres. part. masc. acc. sg., elided, epic (παρεόντ’ = παρεόντα, Attic παρόντα)
glossary.πείσειε: πείθω — persuade, win over; aor. opt. 3 sg. act., potential without ἄν: ’could persuade’
glossary.πενίῃ: πενία — poverty, need; fem. dat. sg., Ionic -ίῃ (= Attic πενίᾳ), dat. after εἴκων
glossary.πλησάμενος: πίμπλημι — fill; aor. part. mid. masc. nom. sg., ’having filled (for himself)’
glossary.πύλῃσι: πύλη — gate; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι (= Attic πύλαις)
glossary.πῖνέ: πίνω — drink; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔπινε); accented πῖνέ before the enclitic τε · also pres. imper. 2 sg.: ’drink!’ (πῖνέ τε οἶνον ’and drink wine’)
glossary.σκύφον: σκύφος — cup, drinking bowl; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.τέκ: τίκτω — beget, bear; aor. 3 sg. act., elided, unaugmented (τέκ’ = ἔτεκε): ’begot’
glossary.τίσεται: τίνυμαι — take vengeance, punish; fut. 3 sg. mid. (τίσεται): ’will exact payment’
glossary.ταχέες: ταχύς — swift, fast; masc. nom. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ταχεῖς)
glossary.τελείεται: τελείω (τελέω) — fulfil, bring to pass; pres. 3 sg. pass., epic: ’is fulfilled, comes true’
glossary.φάγον: ἐσθίω (aor. ἔφαγον) — eat, devour; aor. 3 pl. act., unaugmented (= ἔφαγον): ’they ate’
glossary.φθίνοντος: φθίνω — waste away, wane, perish; pres. part. masc. gen. sg.: ’waning’
glossary.φθίσθαι: φθίνω — perish, waste away; aor. inf. mid.: ’to have perished’
glossary.φύγῃ: φεύγω — flee, escape; aor. subj. 3 sg. act. (with κε): ’may escape’
glossary.φύτευεν: φυτεύω — plant, sow; devise; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐφύτευε), ν-movable
glossary.φῇσθα: φημί — say, declare, think; pres. 2 sg., epic by-form in -σθα (= φῇς)
glossary.χέρηα: χέρης — worse, inferior; masc. acc. sg., epic (Attic χείρων), + gen. of comparison: ’inferior to’ · also neut. acc. pl., substantivized: ‘the worse things’ (τὰ χέρηα)
glossary.ψεύδοντ: ψεύδομαι — lie, speak falsely; pres. 3 pl. mid., elided (ψεύδοντ’ = ψεύδονται)
glossary.ἀΐδαο: Ἀΐδης — Hades, god and realm of the dead; masc. gen. sg., epic -αο (= Attic Ἅιδου)
glossary.ἀγγείλαιμι: ἀγγέλλω — announce, bring word; aor. opt. 1 sg. act., in a protasis: ’I should report’
glossary.ἀγητόν: ἀγητός — wondrous, admirable (from ἄγαμαι); masc. acc. sg., agreeing with the object of an infinitive clause
glossary.ἀκέοντ: ἀκέων — silent, in silence; adj. of participle form, elided (ἀκέοντ’ = ἀκέοντε, dual, or ἀκέοντα), agreeing with the unexpressed subject of an infinitive
glossary.ἀλήθην: ἀλάομαι — wander, roam; aor. 1 sg. pass./dep., unaugmented, epic (= ἠλήθην): ’I wandered’
glossary.ἀλητεύων: ἀλητεύω — wander about, roam as a beggar; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀλῆται: ἀλήτης — wanderer, vagrant, beggar; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἀναίνεαι: ἀναίνομαι — refuse, reject, disbelieve; pres. 2 sg. mid., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἀναίνῃ)
glossary.ἀπατήλια: ἀπατήλιος — deceitful; neut. acc. pl. used as a noun: ’deceits, lies’
glossary.ἀρκεισίου: Ἀρκείσιος — Arceisius, father of Laertes; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.ἀφικάνω: ἀφικάνω — arrive at, come to; pres. 1 sg., epic by-form of ἀφικνέομαι: ’I have come to’
glossary.ἁλώῃ: ἁλίσκομαι — be caught, be taken; aor. subj. 3 sg., epic (= Attic ἁλῷ), with κε: ’may be caught’
glossary.ἄπιστος: ἄπιστος — disbelieving, not trusting; adj., masc. nom. sg., predicate
glossary.ἄχνυται: ἄχνυμαι — be grieved, be distressed; pres. 3 sg. mid.
glossary.ἐΐσας: ἐΐσος (ἔΐσος) — equal, even, balanced; fem. acc. pl., epic, agreeing with φρένας: ’well-balanced’
glossary.ἐδωδὴ: ἐδωδή — food, meat; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἐθέλουσιν: ἐθέλω — wish, be willing; pres. 3 pl., ν-movable
glossary.ἐνίπλειον: ἐνίπλειος — full of, filled (+ gen.); masc. acc. sg., agreeing with a masc. noun · also neut. acc. sg., agreeing with a neuter noun: δῶμα … ἐνίπλειον βιότοιο ’a house full of livelihood’
glossary.ἐοῦσι: εἰμί — be; pres. part. masc. dat. pl., epic (= Attic οὖσι), agreeing with a dual νῶϊν
glossary.ἐπέλθω: ἐπέρχομαι — go to, come upon, visit; aor. subj. 1 sg.: ’I may reach’
glossary.ἐπειδὴ: ἐπειδή — since, seeing that, after; conj.
glossary.ἐρύσαι: ἐρύω — draw, drag, tear off; aor. inf. act.: ’to tear off’
glossary.ἐχθρὸς: ἐχθρός — hateful, hated; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἑοῖο: ἑός — his own, her own (possessive, by-form of ὅς); masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -οῦ)
glossary.ἔπινεν: πίνω — drink; impf. 3 sg., ν-movable: ’was drinking, drank’
glossary.ἔρνεϊ: ἔρνος — young shoot, sapling; neut. dat. sg., epic -ϊ (= Attic ἔρνει)
glossary.ἔσσεσθαι: εἰμί — be; fut. inf., epic (= Attic ἔσεσθαι)
glossary.ἕποιεν: ἕπομαι — follow, go after; pres. opt. 3 pl. mid., jussive: ’let them follow’
glossary.ἕσσαι: ἕννυμι — clothe, put clothes on (someone, acc. of person and garment); aor. inf. act., epic: ’to clothe’
glossary.ἠθεῖον: ἠθεῖος — dear, honoured (exact sense not known); masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἱστίη: ἱστίη — hearth, hearth-fire, household; fem. nom. sg., Ionic (= Attic ἑστία)
glossary.ἱσταμένοιο: ἵσταμαι — stand; of a month, begin; pres. part. mid. masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου): ’beginning’
glossary.ἵκωμαι: ἱκνέομαι — come, arrive at; aor. subj. 1 sg. mid., after εἴ κεν: ’I should come to’ · also deliberative, in a question: ’am I to come to’ (τεῦ δώμαθ’ ἵκωμαι ’to whose halls am I to come’)
glossary.ὀΐομαι: ὀΐω — think, suppose; pres. 1 sg. mid., epic ὀΐομαι: ’I think’ (+ acc. and inf.)
glossary.ὀδυρομένῃ: ὀδύρομαι — lament, weep; pres. part. mid. fem. dat. sg.: ’to her as she mourns’
glossary.ὀνομάζειν: ὀνομάζω — name, call by name; pres. inf. act.
glossary.ὁππόσ: ὁππόσε — to whatever place; adv., elided (ὁππόσ’ = ὁππόσε) · also ὁππόσος — as many as; neut. acc. pl. (ὁππόσ’ = ὁππόσα), the other possible reading
glossary.ὑπέρσχῃ: ὑπερέχω — hold over, hold above (+ acc.); aor. subj. 3 sg. act., with κε: ’may hold over’ (as protection)
glossary.ῥηϊδίως: ῥηΐδιος — easy; adv. ῥηϊδίως: ’easily, readily’, epic (= Attic ῥᾳδίως)
glossary.αἰγυπτίων: Αἰγύπτιος — Egyptian; masc. gen. pl. (Αἰγυπτίων ἀνδρῶν ’of Egyptian men’)
glossary.αἴγυπτον: Αἴγυπτος — Egypt, also the river Nile (masc., as river); acc. sg., with ἐϋρρείτην ’fair-flowing’: ’the Egypt river’, goal of ἱκόμεσθα
glossary.αἴγυπτόνδε: Αἴγυπτος — Egypt; acc. sg. + directional -δε: ’to Egypt’
glossary.αἴθρῳ: αἴθρος — cold, frost, the chill of the open air (lemma and sense not certain; related to αἴθρη ‘clear sky’); masc. dat. sg., dat. of cause with δεδμημένον: ‘by cold’
glossary.αὐτοῖσί: αὐτός — self; masc. dat. pl., epic -οῖσι (= Attic αὐτοῖς), reflexive of the subject: ’for themselves’
glossary.βουλεύσας: βουλεύω — plan, devise; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having devised’ (ψεύδεα βουλεύσας ’devising lies’)
glossary.γιγνώσκειν: γιγνώσκω — recognise, know; pres. inf. act., after ὀΐομαι with σε as subject: ’that you recognise’
glossary.γνήσιοι: γνήσιος — legitimate, born in wedlock; masc. nom. pl., agreeing with υἱέες
glossary.δίδοσαν: δίδωμι — give; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented (= Attic ἐδίδοσαν): ’they kept giving’
glossary.δειλῷ: δειλός — wretched, miserable; masc. dat. sg., agreeing with ἐμοί: ’to wretched me’
glossary.δύη: δύη — woe, distress, pain; fem. nom. sg. · also δύω — sink into, enter; aor. subj. 3 sg., with acc.: ὄφρ’ … δύη ἄχος κραδίην ’that grief might sink into the heart’ · also δύω — sink into, enter; aor. subj. 3 sg. (= Attic δύῃ): ’may enter’ (δύη ἄχος κραδίην ’that grief may enter the heart’)
glossary.εἰνάκις: εἰνάκις — nine times; adv., epic (= Attic ἐνάκις)
glossary.εἴξαντες: εἴκω — yield, give way to (+ dat.); aor. part. act. masc. nom. pl.: ’giving in to’
glossary.εἴξειε: εἴκω — yield, give ground; aor. opt. 3 sg., in a general relative clause (ὅ τε … εἴξειε ’whoever gave way’)
glossary.εὐρειάων: εὐρύς — wide, broad; fem. gen. pl., epic -άων (= Attic -ῶν), agreeing with Κρητάων
glossary.ζωούς: ζωός — alive, living; masc. acc. pl., epic/Ionic (= Attic ζῶντας): ’alive’, predicative
glossary.θεοῖσίν: θεός — god; masc. dat. pl., epic -οῖσιν (= Attic θεοῖς)
glossary.θεσπρωτῶν: Θεσπρωτοί — the Thesprotians, a people of Epirus; masc. gen. pl.
glossary.κάστωρ: Κάστωρ — Castor, Cretan nobleman, son of Hylax (a name); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.καλάμην: καλάμη — stalk, stubble (what is left after harvest); fem. acc. sg.
glossary.καλῷ: καλός — fair, fine; masc. dat. sg., agreeing with ἀνέμῳ: ‘fine (wind)’
glossary.καταριγηλὰ: καταριγηλός — dreadful, causing a shudder (rare word, sense traditional); neut. nom. pl., predicate with πέλονται
glossary.κεχολώατο: χολόομαι — be angry, be enraged; plpf. 3 pl. mid., epic -ατο (= Attic ἐκεχόλωντο): ’they were enraged’
glossary.κουριδίῃ: κουρίδιος — wedded, lawful (of a wife); fem. dat. sg.
glossary.κρήτεσσι: Κρής — a Cretan; masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic Κρησί): ’among the Cretans’
glossary.κρίνοιμι: κρίνω — pick out, choose; pres. opt. 1 sg., in a general temporal clause with ὁπότε: ’whenever I would choose’
glossary.κρητάων: Κρήτη — Crete; fem. gen. pl., epic -άων (= Attic -ῶν), the one island named in the plural: ’of broad Crete’
glossary.κυδαλίμοισιν: κυδάλιμος — glorious, renowned; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις)
glossary.κυλίνδον: κυλίνδω — roll, whirl along; pres. part. act. neut. nom. sg. (= κυλῖνδον), agreeing with κῦμα: ’rolling’
glossary.κυνέην: κυνέη — helmet, cap; fem. acc. sg., epic -έην (= Attic κυνῆν)
glossary.κύσα: κυνέω — kiss; aor. 1 sg., unaugmented (= ἔκυσα), + acc.: ’I kissed’
glossary.κῆρες: κήρ — death-spirit, doom of death; fem. nom. pl.: ’the death-spirits’ (a different word from κῆρ ’heart’)
glossary.λόχονδε: λόχος — ambush; acc. sg. + directional -δε: ’to an ambush’
glossary.μένεϊ: μένος — might, force, fury; neut. dat. sg., epic -εϊ (= Attic -ει), object of ἐπισπόμενοι (‘following’): ‘their own might’
glossary.μήδετ: μήδομαι — devise, plan; impf. 3 sg., elided (μήδετ’ = μήδετο): ’was devising’
glossary.μελίῃσιν: μελίη — ash tree; ash-wood spear; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσιν (= Attic -αις), instrumental: ’with ash spears’
glossary.μεῖνα: μένω — stay, remain; aor. 1 sg., unaugmented (= Attic ἔμεινα): ’I stayed’
glossary.μητίετα: μητίετα — counsellor, wise in counsel (epithet of Zeus); masc. nom. sg., epic -α
glossary.νέεσσιν: ναῦς — ship; fem. dat. pl., epic νέεσσιν (= Attic ναυσί)
glossary.νήεσσ: ναῦς — ship; fem. dat. pl., elided (νήεσσ’ = νήεσσι), epic (= Attic ναυσί)
glossary.ναυτίλλεσθαι: ναυτίλλομαι — sail, go by sea; pres. inf. mid., after ἀνώγει: ’to sail’
glossary.ξεινίου: ξείνιος — of hospitality, guardian of guests (epithet of Zeus); masc. gen. sg., epic ξεινίου (= Attic ξενίου)
glossary.οἰκωφελίη: οἰκωφελίη — care of the household, thrifty husbandry; fem. nom. sg., Ionic -η
glossary.πάντοθεν: πάντοθεν — from all sides, on every side; adv.
glossary.πέλασεν: πελάζω — bring near, drive to (+ dat.); aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= Attic ἐπέλασεν): ’drove’
glossary.παλλακίς: παλλακίς — concubine; fem. nom. sg., in apposition to μήτηρ
glossary.παρεῖχον: παρέχω — furnish, supply; impf. 1 sg., augmented: ’I supplied’
glossary.παρπεπιθὼν: παραπείθω — win over, talk round; aor. 2 part. act. masc. nom. sg., reduplicated, apocope (παρπεπιθών = παραπεπιθών): ’having won over’
glossary.παῦρα: παῦρος — few, little; neut. acc. pl., object of δόσαν: ’very little’
glossary.πεζῶν: πεζός — on foot; used as a noun: ’foot-soldiers’; masc. gen. pl., gen. of what fills, after πλῆτο
glossary.πεμπταῖοι: πεμπταῖος — on the fifth day; masc. nom. pl., predicate adj. used like an adverb: ’on the fifth day’
glossary.περάσειε: περάω (πέρνημι) — carry across, export for sale, sell abroad; aor. opt. 3 sg., purpose with ὡς after a past tense: ’that he might sell’
glossary.περιπλεχθεὶς: περιπλέκω — twine round, clasp; aor. pass. part. masc. nom. sg., passive form with middle sense, + dat.: ’having clung to’
glossary.πημάνθη: πημαίνω — harm, hurt; aor. pass. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐπημάνθη): ’was harmed’
glossary.πλούτῳ: πλοῦτος — wealth; masc. dat. sg., dat. of respect or cause: ‘in (for) wealth’
glossary.ποίησ: ποιέω — make, cause, put; aor. 3 sg., elided and unaugmented (ποίησ’ = ποίησε, Attic ἐποίησε): ’put (a thought) in’
glossary.πολυκλήρων: πολύκληρος — rich in allotted land, of great estates; masc. gen. pl.
glossary.ποντοπόροιο: ποντοπόρος — sea-going, crossing the sea; fem. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου), with νηός
glossary.πριάμου: Πρίαμος — Priam, king of Troy; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.προτιόσσετο: προτιόσσομαι — look toward, foresee, have a presentiment of; impf. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented, epic προτι- (= πρός)
glossary.πρώτιστος: πρῶτος — first; masc. nom. sg., epic double superlative πρώτιστος: ’the very first’
glossary.πόλεμοι: πόλεμος — war, battle; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.πόρθεον: πορθέω — sack, ravage, plunder; impf. 3 pl., epic uncontracted, unaugmented (= Attic ἐπόρθουν): ’they ravaged’
glossary.πᾶν: πᾶς — all, whole; neut. nom. sg., agreeing with πεδίον: ’the whole (plain)’ · also neut. nom. sg. as a plain substantive: ’all, everything’ (οὔ πω πᾶν εἴρηθ’ ’not yet had everything been said’)
glossary.σκοπιὰς: σκοπιή — lookout, watch-post; fem. acc. pl.
glossary.στείλαντα: στέλλω — fit out, equip, make ready; aor. part. act. masc. acc. sg., agreeing with the implied ’me’: ’having fitted out’
glossary.στεροπῆς: στεροπή — lightning, flash, gleam; fem. gen. sg., Ionic -ῆς, gen. of what fills after πλῆτο: ’the gleam (of bronze)’
glossary.στεῖλα: στέλλω — fit out, equip; aor. 1 sg., epic στεῖλα (= Attic ἔστειλα, unaugmented): ’I fitted out’
glossary.σφίσιν: σφεῖς — they; epic dat. pl. pron. (= Attic αὐτοῖς), reflexive of the subject: ’for themselves’ · also dat. pl. after μετά, not reflexive: ’among them’ (μετὰ σφίσιν) · also dat. pl. indirect object, not reflexive: ’to them’
glossary.σφῷ: σφός — their own; neut. dat. sg., epic possessive adj. of the 3rd person (not a relative), agreeing with μένεϊ: ‘their own’
glossary.τίετο: τίω — honour, esteem; impf. 3 sg. pass., unaugmented (= ἐτίετο): ’was honoured’
glossary.τερπικέραυνος: τερπικέραυνος — delighting in the thunderbolt (epithet of Zeus); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.τεταρπόμενος: τέρπομαι — take one’s fill of, enjoy (+ dat.); aor. 2 part. mid. masc. nom. sg., reduplicated: ’having had my fill of’
glossary.τετύγμην: τεύχω — make; pass. be, prove, have come to be; plpf. 1 sg. (τετύγμην = τετεύγμην/ἐτετύγμην): ’I had become, I was’, with predicate adjectives
glossary.τρώκτης: τρώκτης — gnawer, hence rogue, swindler (sense traditional); masc. nom. sg., in apposition to Φοῖνιξ
glossary.τύγχανε: τυγχάνω — hit, fall to one’s lot, happen; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐτύγχανε), + dat.: ’kept coming (to me)’
glossary.φέρουσαι: φέρω — carry, bear; pres. part. act. fem. nom. pl., agreeing with κῆρες: ’bearing’
glossary.φείδων: Φείδων — Pheidon, king of the Thesprotians (a name); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.φοῖνιξ: Φοῖνιξ — a Phoenician; masc. nom. sg. (also ’palm, purple-red’)
glossary.φυγοπτόλεμος: φυγοπτόλεμος — shunning war, war-shy; masc. nom. sg., predicate with ἦα
glossary.φυτεύων: φυτεύω — plant, sow; devise (evils); pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’working (evil) for’
glossary.φόρτον: φόρτος — freight, cargo; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.φύγοιμι: φεύγω — flee, escape; aor. opt. 1 sg. (2nd aor.), in a purpose clause after ὅπως and a past tense: ’that I might escape’
glossary.φύζαν: φύζα — panic flight, rout; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.φῆμις: φῆμις — report, talk, rumour; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ψεύδεα: ψεῦδος — lie, falsehood; neut. acc. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ψεύδη)
glossary.ἀΐοντες: ἀΐω — hear, perceive (+ gen.); pres. part. act. masc. nom. pl.: ’hearing’
glossary.ἀκραέϊ: ἀκραής — blowing fresh, strong (of a wind); masc. dat. sg., epic uncontracted -έϊ (= Attic -εῖ), agreeing with ἀνέμῳ
glossary.ἀλλοδαπούς: ἀλλοδαπός — of another land, foreign; masc. acc. pl.
glossary.ἀμαιμάκετον: ἀμαιμάκετος — huge (sense uncertain; ‘huge’ and ‘irresistible’ are the guesses); masc. acc. sg., agreeing with ἱστόν
glossary.ἀνέμῳ: ἄνεμος — wind; masc. dat. sg., in apposition to Βορέῃ (the dat. of means with ἐπλέομεν): ‘with a (fresh) wind’
glossary.ἀπέκτανον: ἀποκτείνω — kill; aor. 3 pl., epic 2nd aor. ἔκτανον with ἀπο- (= Attic ἀπέκτειναν): ’they killed’
glossary.ἀποφώλιος: ἀποφώλιος — empty, worthless, feeble; masc. nom. sg., predicate with ἦα (οὐκ ἀποφώλιος ’no weakling’)
glossary.ἀπριάτην: ἀπρίατος — unbought, unpurchased; fem. acc. sg. used as an adverb (it cannot agree with masc. με or ἥρως): ‘without price, freely’; the usual explanation, not certain
glossary.ἀριστῆας: ἀριστεύς — best man, chief, champion; masc. acc. pl., epic -ῆας (= Attic -εῖς)
glossary.ἀσκηθέες: ἀσκηθής — unharmed, safe; masc. nom. pl., epic uncontracted -έες (= Attic -εῖς)
glossary.ἀφνειοῖο: ἀφνειός — rich, wealthy; masc. gen. sg., epic -οῖο (= Attic -οῦ)
glossary.ἀϋτή: ἀϋτή — war-cry, shout, din; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἄγειρα: ἀγείρω — gather, collect; aor. 1 sg., unaugmented (= ἤγειρα): ’I gathered’
glossary.ἄγεν: ἄγω — lead, take; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented, ν-movable (= ἦγεν): ’took, brought’
glossary.ἄγοιμι: ἄγω — lead, carry; pres. opt. 1 sg., purpose with ἵνα after a past tense: ’that I might carry’
glossary.ἄκοντες: ἄκων — javelin, dart; masc. nom. pl. (a different word from ἄκων ’unwilling’)
glossary.ἄναγον: ἀνάγω — lead up, carry off; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented (= Attic ἀνῆγον): ’they led off’
glossary.ἄνουσοι: ἄνουσος — free of sickness, sound; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἄψ: ἄψ — back, again; adv.: ’back round’, of the returning year
glossary.ἐέσσατο: ἵζω — set, seat, put on board (causative); aor. mid. 3 sg., augmented (ἐ-ἕσσατο, with digamma): ‘set me aboard’, ‘embarked me’; form unusual, sense from the context
glossary.ἐΰξεστοι: ἐΰξεστος — well-polished, well-planed; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἐβάλοντο: βάλλω — throw; mid. throw for oneself; aor. 3 pl. mid., augmented, with ἐπί in tmesis (ἐπὶ … ἐβάλοντο): ’they cast (lots)’
glossary.ἐδάσαντο: δατέομαι — divide among themselves, share out; aor. 3 pl. mid. (= ἐδάσσαντο): ’they divided’
glossary.ἐκομίσσατο: κομίζω — take care of, receive, entertain; aor. 3 sg. mid., epic σσ (= Attic ἐκομίσατο): ’took in, welcomed’
glossary.ἐναντίβιον: ἐναντίβιος — face to face, in open opposition; neut. acc. sg. used as an adverb: ’to meet them face to face’
glossary.ἐναντίον: ἐναντίος — opposite; neut. acc. sg. as adv./prep. + gen.: ’in front of, before’
glossary.ἐξαιρεύμην: ἐξαιρέω — take out, pick out; mid. choose for oneself; impf. 1 sg. mid., unaugmented, epic -εύμην (= Attic ἐξῃρούμην): ‘I would pick out, I took for myself’
glossary.ἐπάλμενος: ἐφάλλομαι — leap upon, spring at; aor. part. mid. masc. nom. sg., syncopated (ἐπάλμενος = ἐφαλόμενος): ’leaping on (them)’
glossary.ἐπήϊσσον: ἐπαΐσσω — rush upon, dart at; impf. 3 pl., augmented: ’they rushed at (me)’
glossary.ἐπιτέρπεται: ἐπιτέρπομαι — take delight in (+ dat.); pres. 3 sg. mid.: ’delights in’
glossary.ἐπλέομεν: πλέω — sail; impf. 1 pl., uncontracted, augmented: ’we sailed’
glossary.ἐργάζεσθαι: ἐργάζομαι — work, labour; pres. inf. mid., of purpose: ’to work (for)’
glossary.ἐρύσατο: ἐρύομαι — protect, rescue, save; aor. 3 sg. mid.: ’saved, shielded’
glossary.ἐσαγείρατο: εἰσαγείρομαι — gather in; aor. 3 sg. mid., epic ἐσ-, intransitive, unaugmented: ’(the host) mustered, came together’
glossary.ἐφράσαθ: φράζομαι — consider, devise, contrive; aor. 3 sg. mid., elided (ἐφράσαθ’ = ἐφράσατο): ’devised, planned’
glossary.ἐϋρρείτην: ἐϋρρείτης — fair-flowing; masc. acc. sg., epithet of a river (ἐΰς + ῥέω)
glossary.ἔβημεν: βαίνω — go, step; aor. 1 pl., root (athematic) aorist, not the sigmatic ἐβήσαμεν, augmented (= Attic ἔβημεν): ‘we went, set off’
glossary.ἔκβαλον: ἐκβάλλω — throw out, cast away; aor. 1 sg. (2nd aor.), augmented: ’I threw away’ · also aor. 3 pl.: ’they threw out’
glossary.ἔκτεινον: κτείνω — kill; impf. 3 pl., augmented: ’they were killing’
glossary.ἔκτοσε: ἔκτοσε — out, away, far; adv. + gen.: ’away from’
glossary.ἔνειμαν: νέμω — distribute, deal out, assign; aor. 3 pl., augmented: ’they allotted’
glossary.ἔργοις: ἔργον — deed, work, occupation; neut. dat. pl.
glossary.ἔχοντί: ἔχω — have, hold; pres. part. act. masc. dat. sg., concessive with περ (accent before the enclitic): ’though having’
glossary.ἕλεσκον: αἱρέω — take, strike down; iterative past of the aor. stem ἑλ-, epic -σκον, unaugmented: ‘I would take, bring down’
glossary.ἕλοιτο: αἱρέω — take, get for oneself; aor. opt. mid. 3 sg., purpose after a past tense: ’that he might take’ · also in an alternative deliberation (ἠὲ … ἦ …): ’should take’ (ἠὲ … ἐκ θυμὸν ἕλοιτο ’whether he should take his life out’)
glossary.ἕσας: ἵζω — set, seat (causative); aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg., epic (= Attic εἵσας): ’having seated’
glossary.ἦρξα: ἄρχω — lead, rule (+ dat.); aor. 1 sg., augmented: ’I led’
glossary.ἰδομενῆα: Ἰδομενεύς — Idomeneus, leader of the Cretans; masc. acc. sg., epic -ῆα (= Attic -έα)
glossary.ἰθαιγενέεσσιν: ἰθαιγενής — born in lawful wedlock, legitimate (formation not certain; perhaps ‘straight-born’); masc. dat. pl., epic -έεσσιν (= Attic -έσιν)
glossary.ἱερήϊα: ἱερήϊον — sacrificial victim; neut. acc. pl., epic (= Attic ἱερεῖα)
glossary.ὀπτῆρας: ὀπτήρ — watcher, scout; masc. acc. pl.
glossary.ὀφέλλετο: ὀφέλλω — increase, enlarge; impf. 3 sg. pass., unaugmented (= ὠφέλλετο): ‘was growing, was enlarged’
glossary.ὀϊόμενός: ὀΐω — suppose, expect, forebode; pres. part. mid. masc. nom. sg., concessive with περ (accent before the enclitic): ’though suspecting’
glossary.ὁδ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. nom. sg. ὁ with elided δέ (ὁδ’ = ὁ δ’): ’and he’
glossary.ὄγδοόν: ὄγδοος — eighth; neut. nom. sg., agreeing with ἔτος (accent before the enclitic μοι)
glossary.ὄλβῳ: ὄλβος — prosperity, wealth; masc. dat. sg., dat. of respect or cause: ‘in (for) prosperity’
glossary.ὑλακίδης: Ὑλακίδης — son of Hylax; masc. nom. sg., patronymic in apposition to Κάστωρ
glossary.ὕβρει: ὕβρις — wanton violence, arrogance; fem. dat. sg., with εἴξαντες: ’to (their) arrogance’
glossary.ὠκυπόροισι: ὠκυπόρος — swift-going, swift-sailing; fem. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις; a two-ending adjective), agreeing with νέεσσιν
glossary.ὠνητὴ: ὠνητός — bought, purchased; fem. nom. sg., agreeing with μήτηρ
glossary.ὠπίζετο: ὀπίζομαι — fear, stand in awe of, respect; impf. 3 sg. mid., augmented: ’he feared’ (+ acc.)
glossary.ὤμοιϊν: ὦμος — shoulder; masc. dual (epic ὤμοιϊν = Attic ὤμοιν), taken as a gen. of separation with ἀπό carried over: ‘from the two shoulders’; the dual and the case are the usual reading, not certain
glossary.ὤτρυνα: ὀτρύνω — urge on, rouse; aor. 1 sg., augmented: ’I urged’ (+ inf.)
glossary.ὦνον: ὦνος — price, purchase price; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ῥηξηνορίην: ῥηξηνορίη — courage that breaks the ranks of men; fem. acc. sg., Ionic -ίη
glossary.αἰδέσσομαι: αἰδέομαι — respect, show regard for; fut. 1 sg. mid., epic σσ (= Attic αἰδέσομαι)
glossary.αἰτωλὸς: Αἰτωλός — Aetolian, of Aetolia in central Greece; adj., masc. nom. sg.
glossary.βιῶναι: βιόω — live; aor. inf. (root aor. ἐβίων)
glossary.βόσκοι: βόσκω — feed, nourish; pres. opt. 3 sg.: ’it might feed’
glossary.γενεὴν: γενεή — generation, race; fem. acc. sg., Ionic η (= Attic γενεά)
glossary.γενοίμην: γίγνομαι — become, come to be, be brought to; aor. opt. mid. 1 sg.: ’I might become’
glossary.δάμασσαν: δαμάζω — overpower, subdue; aor. 3 pl., unaugmented, epic σσ (= ἐδάμασαν)
glossary.δία: Ζεύς — Zeus; masc. acc. sg. Δία
glossary.δειλὲ: δειλός — wretched, miserable; masc. voc. sg.
glossary.διήρεσσ: διερέσσω — row through, cleave by rowing; aor. 1 sg., epic σσ, elided (διήρεσσ’ = διήρεσσα)
glossary.δμῶας: δμώς — slave, servant of the household; masc. acc. pl.
glossary.δουλίχιον: Δουλίχιον — Dulichium, an island in Odysseus’ region of the Ionian sea; neut. acc. sg.
glossary.δουλίχιόνδ: Δουλίχιον — Dulichium, an island of the Ionian sea; acc. + suffix -δε ’to’, elided (Δουλίχιόνδ’): ’to Dulichium’
glossary.δούλιον: δούλιος — of a slave, of slavery; neut. acc. sg.
glossary.δρίος: δρίος (δρῖος) — thicket, copse; neut. nom. sg., epic
glossary.δωδώνην: Δωδώνη — Dodona, seat of the oracle of Zeus in Epirus; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.δύης: δύη — misery, woe; fem. gen. sg., Ionic η
glossary.εὐδειέλου: εὐδείελος — sunny, clear-seen (sense not certain); fem. gen. sg.
glossary.θέλγε: θέλγω — charm, enchant, beguile; pres. imper. 2 sg. · also impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔθελγε): ’she enchanted’
glossary.θύρηθ: θύρηθι (θύρηθε) — outside, out of doors; epic adv., elided (θύρηθ’), the ending -θι (place where) or -θε
glossary.καταβὰς: καταβαίνω — go down, step down; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.
glossary.κατειρύσθαι: κατερύω — draw down, haul down; perf. pass. inf., epic κατειρύσθαι (= Attic κατηρύσθαι): ’to have been hauled down’
glossary.κλισίῃ: κλισίη — hut, shelter; fem. dat. sg., Ionic η
glossary.κρονίωνα: Κρονίων — son of Cronus, epithet of Zeus; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.κτείναιμι: κτείνω — kill, slay; aor. opt. 1 sg.: ’I might kill’
glossary.λιτοίμην: λίσσομαι — beg, pray to; aor. opt. mid. 1 sg. (stem λιτ-): ’I would pray to’
glossary.μαίεσθαι: μαίομαι — seek, search; pres. inf. mid.
glossary.μεγάλης: μέγας — great, large; fem. gen. sg.
glossary.νοστήσῃ: νοστέω — return home; aor. subj. 3 sg.: ’may return’
glossary.ξένιον: ξένιος — of guests, protector of guests (epithet of Zeus); masc. acc. sg. (= epic ξείνιος)
glossary.ξεινίσαι: ξεινίζω (Attic ξενίζω) — entertain as a guest, receive hospitably; aor. inf.
glossary.ξεστὸν: ξεστός — polished, smoothed; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ξυνέαξαν: συνάγνυμι — shatter, break to pieces; aor. 3 pl., epic ξυν- (= συν-), augmented (= Attic συνέαξαν)
glossary.ξυναγείρατ: συναγείρω — gather together; aor. mid. 3 sg., epic ξυν- (= συν-), elided (ξυναγείρατ’ = ξυναγείρατο): ’gathered for himself’
glossary.πάθες: πάσχω — suffer, undergo; aor. 2 sg., unaugmented (= ἔπαθες)
glossary.πέμψουσι: πέμπω — send, convey; fut. 3 pl., epic -σι(ν)
glossary.παρήμενοι: πάρημαι — sit beside, sit by; pres. part. mid. masc. nom. pl.
glossary.πείθω: πείθω — persuade, win over; pres. 1 sg.
glossary.πείσεις: πείθω — persuade, win over; fut. 2 sg.
glossary.πεπτηώς: πτήσσω — crouch, cower; perf. part. masc. nom. sg., epic πεπτηώς (= Attic πεπτηκώς)
glossary.περιμηχανόωντο: περιμηχανάομαι — contrive all around, devise; impf. 3 pl. mid., epic diectasis, unaugmented (= Attic περιεμηχανῶντο)
glossary.ποιησόμεθ: ποιέω — make, do; mid. ποιέομαι ’make for oneself’; fut. 1 pl. (or short-vowel aor. subj.), elided (ποιησόμεθ’ = ποιησόμεθα)
glossary.πολυανθέος: πολυανθής — rich in flowers; fem. gen. sg.
glossary.πολυπενθές: πολυπενθής — of many griefs; masc. voc. sg.
glossary.πολύκμητόν: πολύκμητος — wrought with much toil; masc. acc. sg., accented before enclitic τε
glossary.πολύπυρον: πολύπυρος — rich in wheat; neut. acc. sg.
glossary.τάχιστά: ταχύς — swift; neut. acc. pl. superl. τάχιστα as adv.: ’as quickly as possible’, accented before enclitic μοι
glossary.τεὸς: τεός — your, yours; epic (= Attic σός); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.τηλεδαπῷ: τηλεδαπός — from a far country, far-off; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.τολύπευσε: τολυπεύω — wind off, bring to an end (a war); aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐτολύπευσε)
glossary.τύχησε: τυγχάνω — happen, chance (+ part.: happen to be); aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐτύχησε)
glossary.φιλήσω: φιλέω — love, welcome kindly; fut. 1 sg.
glossary.φιλῆσαι: φιλέω — love, welcome kindly; aor. inf.
glossary.χαρίζεο: χαρίζομαι — gratify, please, indulge; pres. imper. 2 sg. mid., epic -εο (= Attic χαρίζου), + dat.
glossary.ψεύδεσθαι: ψεύδομαι — lie, speak falsely; pres. inf. mid.
glossary.ψεύδεσσι: ψεῦδος — lie, falsehood; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic ψεύδεσι)
glossary.ἀγγελίη: ἀγγελίη — news, message; fem. nom. sg., Ionic η
glossary.ἀκάστῳ: Ἄκαστος — Acastus, a king named in Odysseus’ tale; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.ἀκειόμενον: ἀκέομαι — mend, repair; pres. part. mid. masc. acc. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἀκούμενον)
glossary.ἀλήθης: ἀλάομαι — wander, roam; aor. 2 sg. (passive form, intransitive sense), unaugmented: ’you wandered’
glossary.ἀλεύεται: ἀλέομαι — avoid, shun, take care not (to); aor. subj. 3 sg. mid., short vowel (= ἀλεύηται), perhaps a fut.; + inf.
glossary.ἀληθείς: ἀλάομαι — wander, roam; aor. part. (passive form) masc. nom. sg.: ’having wandered’
glossary.ἀμφαγάπαζον: ἀμφαγαπάζω — welcome warmly, embrace; impf. 1 sg.: ’I welcomed warmly’
glossary.ἀνέγναμψαν: ἀναγνάμπτω — bend back, undo, loosen; aor. 3 pl., augment inside the compound
glossary.ἀναβάς: ἀναβαίνω — go up, climb; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀπέπλω: ἀποπλώω (ἀποπλέω) — sail away; aor. 3 sg., epic ἀπέπλω (= Attic ἀπέπλευσε)
glossary.ἀπότροπος: ἀπότροπος — turned away, out of the way, remote; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀργιοδόντων: ἀργιόδους — white-toothed; adj., masc./fem. gen. pl., epic -όντων
glossary.ἀρετή: ἀρετή — excellence, goodness, good repute; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀφίκοντο: ἀφικνέομαι — arrive, reach; aor. 3 pl. mid.
glossary.ἄγαγον: ἄγω — lead, bring; aor. 1 sg., unaugmented (= ἤγαγον): ’I brought’ · also aor. 3 pl., unaugmented (= ἤγαγον): ’they brought’
glossary.ἄγοντα: ἄγω — lead, bring; pres. part. masc. acc. sg.: ’bringing’
glossary.ἄξεθ: ἄγω — lead, bring; aor. imper. 2 pl. ἄξετε, elided and aspirated before ὑῶν (ἄξεθ’): ’bring!’
glossary.ἄχνυνται: ἄχνυμαι — be grieved, grieve; pres. 3 pl. mid.
glossary.ἐκείνων: ἐκεῖνος — that, that one; demonstrative pron., masc. gen. pl.: ’of those men’
glossary.ἐξήπαφε: ἐξαπαφίσκω — deceive utterly; aor. 3 sg., epic reduplicated aor. (ἤπαφε)
glossary.ἐξερέουσιν: ἐξερέω — inquire thoroughly, question; 3 pl., epic uncontracted -έουσιν (= -οῦσιν), pres. or fut.: ’they ask out’
glossary.ἐπέλασσα: ἐπελάζω — bring near, bring to; aor. 1 sg., epic σσ (= Attic ἐπήλασα)
glossary.ἐπέλασσαν: ἐπελάζω — bring near, bring to; aor. 3 pl., epic σσ (= Attic ἐπήλασαν)
glossary.ἐπήγαγον: ἐπάγω — lead on, bring over, win over; aor. 1 sg., augmented: ’I won over’
glossary.ἐπακούσαι: ἐπακούω — listen to, hear; aor. opt. 3 sg. in a purpose clause after ὄφρα, epic -σαι (= -σειε)
glossary.ἐπαρτέας: ἐπαρτής — ready, prepared; adj., masc. acc. pl.
glossary.ἐπισσεύας: ἐπισσεύω — urge on, set upon; aor. part. masc. nom. sg., epic σσ (= Attic ἐπισεύας)
glossary.ἐπισταμένου: ἐπίσταμαι — understand, know how; pres. part. mid. masc. gen. sg.: ’of one who understands’
glossary.ἐφόλκαιον: ἐφόλκαιον — a part of a ship, perhaps the rudder or a gangway (meaning not certain); neut. acc. sg.
glossary.ἐϋκλείη: εὐκλεία (epic ἐϋκλείη) — good fame, good repute; fem. nom. sg., Ionic η
glossary.ἐϋσσέλμῳ: ἐΰσσελμος — well-benched, with good rowing benches; adj., fem. dat. sg., epic (= Attic εὔσελμος)
glossary.ἐϋστρεφέϊ: εὐστρεφής — well-twisted; masc. dat. sg., epic -έϊ (= Attic -εῖ)
glossary.ἑλοίμην: αἱρέω — take; aor. opt. mid. 1 sg.: ’I might take’ (with ἀπό in tmesis: ’take away’)
glossary.ἑσπέριοι: ἑσπέριος — of evening, at evening; masc. nom. pl., used of time: ’at evening’
glossary.ἔδειξεν: δείκνυμι — show, point out; aor. 3 sg.
glossary.ἔδυσαν: ἐκδύω — strip off, take off; aor. 3 pl. (transitive: ’they stripped’), ἐκ … ἔδυσαν in tmesis
glossary.ἔμμεν: εἰμί — be; pres. inf., epic ἔμμεν(αι) (= Attic εἶναι)
glossary.ἕσσας: ἕννυμι — clothe, put clothes on; aor. part. masc. nom. sg., epic σσ (= Attic ἕσας)
glossary.ἕτερόν: ἕτερος — other, another; masc. acc. sg., accented before enclitic γε
glossary.ἤθεα: ἦθος — accustomed place, haunt; neut. pl. ἤθεα, acc.: ’usual places’
glossary.ἤχθετο: ἔχθομαι — be hated, be hateful; impf. 3 sg. mid., augmented, + dat.: ’was hateful to’ · also ἄχθομαι — be vexed, be burdened (from ἄχθος ’load’); impf. 3 sg., augmented: of a ship, ’was weighed down, was loaded’ (sense not certain)
glossary.ἰδομενῆϊ: Ἰδομενεύς — Idomeneus, king of Crete; masc. dat. sg., epic -ῆϊ (= Attic Ἰδομενεῖ)
glossary.ἰόντ: εἶμι — go; pres. part. masc. acc. sg., elided (ἰόντ’ = ἰόντα): ’as he went’
glossary.ἱερεύσω: ἱερεύω — sacrifice, slaughter; aor. subj. 1 sg., short vowel, in a purpose clause after ἵνα: ’that I may slaughter’
glossary.ὀμόσας: ὄμνυμι — swear; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ὀνησόμεθ: ὀνίνημι — benefit, profit; mid. ’have profit, enjoy’; fut. 1 pl., elided (ὀνησόμεθ’ = ὀνησόμεθα)
glossary.ὀπώρην: ὀπώρα — late summer, early autumn; fem. acc. sg., Ionic η
