glossary.ὀτρύνῃσιν: ὀτρύνω — urge on, rouse; pres. subj. 3 sg., epic -ῃσι(ν) (= Attic -ῃ), after εἰ
glossary.ὀϊζὺν: ὀϊζύς — woe, distress, misery; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ὅπλῳ: ὅπλον — rope, cable (pl. gear, tackle); neut. dat. sg.
glossary.ὅρηαι: ὁράω — see; pres. 2 sg. mid., epic ὅρηαι (a subjunctive-looking form used as a plain present; = Attic ὁρᾷ): ’you see’
glossary.ῥήτρην: ῥήτρη — agreement, covenant, bargain; fem. acc. sg., Ionic η
glossary.αἰειγενέτῃσι: αἰειγενέτης — ever-born, everlasting (of the gods); adj., masc. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι (= Attic -αις), agreeing with θεοῖς
glossary.αἰπύ: αἰπύς — high, steep, sheer; neut. acc. sg., agreeing with τεῖχος
glossary.αἶνος: αἶνος — tale, story (also praise, saying); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.βάλλε: βάλλω — throw, cast; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔβαλλε)
glossary.βάλλεν: βάλλω — throw, cast; impf. 3 sg., with movable ν
glossary.βιότου: βίοτος — life, livelihood, means of living; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.βορέω: Βορέης — Boreas, the North Wind; masc. gen. sg., epic -έω (= Attic Βορέου)
glossary.βουλευέμεν: βουλεύω — take counsel, plan; pres. inf., epic -έμεν (= Attic βουλεύειν)
glossary.γέραιρεν: γεραίρω — honour, treat with honour; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐγέραιρεν)
glossary.γεραίρεις: γεραίρω — honour, treat with honour (+ dat. of the gift); pres. 2 sg.
glossary.δάμναται: δάμνημι (δαμνάω) — overpower, subdue; pres. 3 sg., epic mid. form with active sense (= Attic δαμάζει)
glossary.δαΐζων: δαΐζω — cleave, cut in pieces; pres. part. act., masc. nom. sg.
glossary.δαιμόνιε: δαιμόνιος — strange, uncanny, of one moved by a power beyond himself; as address ’strange one’ (tone from rebuke to affection); masc. voc. sg.
glossary.δαιτρεύσων: δαιτρεύω — carve, portion out meat at a feast; fut. part. act., masc. nom. sg., of purpose: ’to carve’
glossary.δημόν: δημός — fat (of an animal; not δῆμος ’people’); masc. acc. sg.
glossary.διεμοιρᾶτο: διαμοιράομαι — divide up, distribute; impf. 3 sg. mid., from the contract verb -άομαι (-ᾶτο = -άετο)
glossary.διηνεκέεσσι: διηνεκής — continuous, unbroken, whole; neut. dat. pl., epic -έεσσι (= Attic -έσι), agreeing with νώτοισιν
glossary.δνοπαλίξεις: δνοπαλίζω — shake about, toss, tumble about (rare word); fut. 2 sg.
glossary.εἰλυμένοι: εἰλύω — wrap, enfold; perf. part. mid./pass., masc. nom. pl.: ’wrapped’, with dat. of the covering and acc. of the part covered
glossary.εἵματι: εἷμα — garment, clothing, cloak; neut. dat. sg.
glossary.εὐξάμενός: εὔχομαι — pray, vow, declare; aor. part. mid., masc. nom. sg., accented before an enclitic
glossary.εὔκηλοι: εὔκηλος — at ease, undisturbed, in peace; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.εὗσαν: εὕω — singe (hair or bristles off a carcass); aor. 3 pl., unaugmented (= ηὗσαν)
glossary.ζῶμα: ζῶμα — girdle, belt (a warrior’s waist-belt); neut. acc. sg.
glossary.θεῖός: θεῖος — divine, from the gods; adj., masc. nom. sg., accented before an enclitic
glossary.θόας: Θόας — Thoas, an Achaean warrior (son of Andraemon); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.θῦσε: θύω — offer, make a burnt offering (of first portions); aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔθυσε)
glossary.κέασε: κεάζω — split, cleave; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐκέασε)
glossary.κέκλυθι: κλύω — hear, listen; imper. 2 sg., reduplicated aorist form, epic: ’hear!’
glossary.κατέλεκτ: καταλέγω — lay down; mid. lie down; aor. 3 sg. mid., elided (κατέλεκτ’ = κατέλεκτο)
glossary.κείων: κείω (= κεάζω) — split, cleave; pres. part., masc. nom. sg., epic · also κείω — be minded to lie down, go to rest (desiderative of κεῖμαι); pres. part., masc. nom. sg.
glossary.κεκορημένοι: κορέννυμι — sate, satisfy; perf. part. mid./pass., masc. nom. pl. (+ gen.): ’having had one’s fill’
glossary.κοιμήσατο: κοιμάω — put to sleep; mid. go to sleep; aor. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented (= ἐκοιμήσατο)
glossary.κοῖτον: κοῖτος — bed, sleep, lying down; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.κοῖτος: κοῖτος — bed, sleep, lying down; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.κόψε: κόπτω — strike, cut; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔκοψε)
glossary.κύδαινε: κυδαίνω — exalt, honour, gladden; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐκύδαινε)
glossary.μαιάδος: Μαιάς — Maia, the mother of Hermes (Attic Μαῖα); fem. gen. sg., epic -άδος
glossary.μεσαύλιος: Μεσαύλιος — Mesaulius, the servant Eumaeus bought from the Taphians; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.μετέσσομαι: μέτειμι — be among (+ dat.); fut. 1 sg. mid., epic μετέσσομαι (stem ἐσσ-, = Attic μετέσομαι)
glossary.μοίρῃ: μοῖρα — share, portion; fem. dat. sg., Ionic -ῃ (= Attic μοίρᾳ)
glossary.νάκην: νάκη — fleece, woolly skin; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ναῦφιν: ναῦς — ship; pl. with epic suffix -φιν, ablatival (’from the ships’; = Attic νεῶν)
glossary.νεηνίαι: νεηνίης (Attic νεανίας) — young man; masc. nom. pl., Ionic -νίαι
glossary.νεῖμεν: νέμω — distribute, deal out; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented, with movable ν (= ἔνειμε)
glossary.νηκερδὲς: νηκερδής — gainless, unprofitable (νη- ’not’ + κέρδος ’gain’); neut. acc. sg., agreeing with ἔπος
glossary.νηλέϊ: νηλεής — pitiless, ruthless; masc. dat. sg., epic -έϊ (= Attic νηλεεῖ), agreeing with χαλκῷ
glossary.νύξας: νύσσω — prick, jab, nudge; aor. part. act., masc. nom. sg.
glossary.νώτοισιν: νῶτον — back (of an animal or a person; a cut of meat); neut. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις)
glossary.οἰοχίτων: οἰοχίτων — in a tunic alone, with nothing over the tunic (οἶος + χιτών); masc. acc. sg., elided (οἰοχίτων’ = οἰοχίτωνα)
glossary.πάννυχος: πάννυχος — all night long; adj., masc. nom. sg., used of Zeus’s rain as ’all night long’
glossary.πάχνη: πάχνη — hoar-frost, rime; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.πέμψει: πέμπω — send, send on one’s way; fut. 3 sg.
glossary.παλύνας: παλύνω — sprinkle; aor. part. act., masc. nom. sg.
glossary.παρά: παρά — beside, from beside; preverb standing apart from its verb in tmesis (παρά … ἤπαφε = παρήπαφε ’led astray’); accented before an enclitic
glossary.παρεκέσκετ: παράκειμαι — lie beside, be at hand; iterative impf. 3 sg. in -σκε-, elided (παρεκέσκετ’ = παρεκέσκετο): ’used to lie by’
glossary.πειρητίζων: πειρητίζω (= πειράω) — try, test (+ gen.); pres. part., masc. nom. sg., epic
glossary.πενταέτηρον: πενταέτηρος — five years old; masc. acc. sg., agreeing with ὗν · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with βοῦν: ’a five-year-old (ox)’
glossary.πεπτηῶτες: πτήσσω — crouch, cower; perf. part., masc. nom. pl., epic πεπτηώς (= Attic πεπτηκώς)
glossary.περιτρέφετο: περιτρέφομαι — congeal, thicken round about (περί + τρέφω ’make solid’); impf. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented (= περιετρέφετο)
glossary.περιφραδέως: περιφραδέως — very thoughtfully, carefully (adv. of περιφραδής)
glossary.πεσόντος: πίπτω — fall, drop; aor. part. act., masc. gen. sg. (of a wind: ’having fallen, died down’)
glossary.πηγυλίς: πηγυλίς — frosty, freezing; adj. of two endings, fem. nom. sg.
glossary.πολύφρονά: πολύφρων — of many counsels, much-minded; masc. acc. sg., accented before an enclitic
glossary.πτολιπόρθῳ: πτολίπορθος — city-sacking, sacker of cities; masc. dat. sg., epic πτολι- (= πολι-)
glossary.πυκνήν: πυκνός — thick, close-set, dense; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.πυκνὴν: πυκνός — thick, close-set, dense; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.πόροι: πόρον (πορεῖν) — give, furnish; aor. opt. 3 sg. (a defective aorist with no present in this sense)
glossary.σάκεσιν: σάκος — shield; neut. dat. pl. (= Attic σάκεσι)
glossary.σίγα: σιγάω — be silent; pres. imper. 2 sg.: ’be quiet!’
glossary.σακέεσσι: σάκος — shield; neut. dat. pl., epic uncontracted -έεσσι (= Attic σάκεσι)
glossary.σκοτομήνιος: σκοτομήνιος — moonless, dark (σκότος + μήν ’month, moon’); adj. of two endings, fem. nom. sg.
glossary.σπείσας: σπένδω — pour a libation; aor. part. act., masc. nom. sg.
glossary.σταθμοῖσι: σταθμός — steading, farmstead, stall; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
glossary.στιβαροῖς: στιβαρός — stout, strong, sturdy; masc. dat. pl.
glossary.συβώτεω: συβώτης — swineherd; masc. gen. sg., epic -εω (= Attic -ου)
glossary.σχέθεν: ἔχω — hold, check, restrain; aor. 3 sg., root aorist σχέθε, unaugmented, with movable ν (= ἔσχε)
glossary.σχίζῃ: σχίζα — billet of split wood, log; fem. dat. sg., Ionic -ῃ (= Attic σχίζᾳ)
glossary.τεύχεσι: τεῦχος — (pl.) armour, gear; neut. dat. pl.
glossary.υἱεῖ: υἱός — son; masc. dat. sg., epic by-form υἱεῖ (= Attic υἱῷ)
glossary.φάε: φαίνω — shine, give light; 3 sg., epic φάε, unaugmented (= Attic ἔφαινε), from the by-form φάω
glossary.φαεινόν: φαεινός — shining, bright; adj., neut. acc. sg.
glossary.φθεγξάμενος: φθέγγομαι — utter a sound, speak out; aor. part. mid., masc. nom. sg.
glossary.φοινικόεσσαν: φοινικόεις — crimson, purple-red; adj., fem. acc. sg., epic -όεσσα (= Attic φοινικοῦς)
glossary.φωτὸς: φώς — man, mortal; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.ψυχρή: ψυχρός — cold, chill; fem. nom. sg., Ionic -ή (= Attic ψυχρά)
glossary.ἀγαθοῖσι: ἀγαθός — good; neut. dat. pl. as noun: ’good things’, epic -οισι (= Attic -οις) · also masc. dat. pl. as noun: ’the good (men of rank)’ (τοῖς ἀγαθοῖσι ’for the good’)
glossary.ἀγαθῇσιν: ἀγαθός — good; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσιν (= Attic -αῖς)
glossary.ἀεῖσαι: ἀείδω — sing; aor. inf. act. (= Attic ᾆσαι)
glossary.ἀκτῇ: ἀκτή — ground grain, grist (a different word from ἀκτή ’shore’); fem. dat. sg., Ionic -ῃ, of means
glossary.ἀλεξάνεμον: ἀλεξάνεμος — warding off the wind; adj. of two endings, fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀλκτῆρα: ἀλκτήρ — defender, one who wards off (+ gen.); masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀμοιβάς: ἀμοιβή — exchange, change, requital; fem. acc. pl., adverbial: ’by way of change, in exchange’
glossary.ἀμφότερον: ἀμφότερος — both; neut. acc. sg., adverbial: ’in both ways, on both counts’
glossary.ἀνέκραγον: ἀνακράζω — cry out, shout; aor. 1 sg. (2nd aorist)
glossary.ἀνασχόμενος: ἀνέχω — hold up; mid. raise oneself, lift up one’s arm; aor. part. mid., masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀνδραίμονος: Ἀνδραίμων — Andraemon, father of Thoas; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.ἀνῆκε: ἀνίημι — send up, rouse, stir (to something); aor. 3 sg., the gnomic aorist of a general truth · also simple aorist ’let go, released’, of sleep releasing a sleeper (τὴν δὲ γλυκὺς ὕπνος ἀνῆκε ’sweet sleep released her’)
glossary.ἀρτύναντες: ἀρτύνω — arrange, prepare, set in order; aor. part. act., masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἀρχόμενος: ἄρχω — lead, rule; mid. ἄρχομαι begin (+ gen.); pres. part. mid., masc. nom. sg.: ’beginning from’
glossary.ἀφεῖλε: ἀφαιρέω — take away, remove; aor. 3 sg., augmented
glossary.ἀφραδίῃς: ἀφραδίη — thoughtlessness, folly; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃς (= -ῃσι, Attic -αις): ’through folly’
glossary.ἁπαλὸν: ἁπαλός — soft, tender; neut. acc. sg., adverbial: ’softly, gently’
glossary.ἄργματα: ἄργμα — first-offering, portion offered first (from ἄρχομαι); neut. acc. pl.
glossary.ἄρρητον: ἄρρητος — unspoken, unsaid (also unspeakable); neut. nom. sg., predicate
glossary.ἄρχον: ἄρχω — lead, rule, be in command; impf. 1 sg., unaugmented (= ἦρχον)
glossary.ἐκδὺς: ἐκδύω — strip off, take off (clothes); aor. 2 part. act. (intrans.), masc. nom. sg.: ’having stripped’
glossary.ἐλεοῖσιν: ἐλεός — a board or table on which meat was set (exact object uncertain); masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις)
glossary.ἐμμαπέως: ἐμμαπέως — quickly, readily, at once; adv. (formation uncertain)
glossary.ἐνύπνιον: ἐνύπνιος — in sleep; neut. acc. sg., adverbial: ’in sleep, in a dream’
glossary.ἐπευξάμενος: ἐπεύχομαι — pray (to), make a vow; aor. part. mid., masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἐπεύχετο: ἐπεύχομαι — pray (to), make a vow (+ dat.); impf. 3 sg. mid.
glossary.ἐπημοιβοί: ἐπημοιβός — in exchange, for changing (clothes); adj., masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἐποτρύνειε: ἐποτρύνω — urge on, stir up; aor. opt. 3 sg., in a clause after εἰ: ’might urge’
glossary.ἐποτρύνειεν: ἐποτρύνω — urge on, stir up; aor. opt. 3 sg., with movable ν, in a clause after εἰ: ’might urge’
glossary.ἐρύσαντό: ἐρύω — draw, drag; pull off a spit; aor. 3 pl. mid., accented before an enclitic
glossary.ἐσσεύοντο: σεύω — set moving; mid. rush, hasten; impf. 3 pl. mid., epic augment with doubled σ (ἐσσ-)
glossary.ἐφέηκε: ἐφίημι — send upon, set on, impel; aor. 3 sg., epic (= Attic ἐπῆκε), gnomic: ’impels’
glossary.ἐϋτρεφέος: ἐϋτρεφής — well-fed, well-nourished; masc. gen. sg., epic uncontracted -έος (= Attic -οῦς)
glossary.ἑέσσατ: ἕννυμι — clothe; mid. put on; aor. 3 sg. mid., elided (ἑέσσατ’ = ἑέσσατο), epic; ἀμφὶ … ἑέσσατο = ἀμφιέσσατο
glossary.ἑο: ἕ — him, her, it; 3rd-person pron., gen. sg. ἕο (= Attic οὗ), enclitic
glossary.ἑρμῇ: Ἑρμῆς — Hermes, god of messengers, son of Zeus and Maia; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.ἑῆος: ἐΰς (ἠΰς) — good, noble; masc. gen. sg., epic ἑῆος/ἐῆος (= Attic ἀγαθοῦ)
glossary.ἔκπαγλος: ἔκπαγλος — terrible, dreadful, astounding; adj., masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἔλειπον: λείπω — leave, leave behind; impf. 1 sg.
glossary.ἔλιπε: λείπω — leave, forsake; aor. 3 sg., augmented
glossary.ἔνειμε: νέμω — distribute, deal out; aor. 3 sg., augmented
glossary.ἔσφαξάν: σφάζω — slaughter, cut the throat of; aor. 3 pl., accented before an enclitic
glossary.ἔφυδρος: ἔφυδρος — rainy, wet, bringing rain; adj., masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἕλετ: αἱρέω — take, seize; aor. 3 sg. mid., elided and unaugmented (ἕλετ’ = ἕλετο = εἵλετο)
glossary.ἕλος: ἕλος — marsh, marshy meadow; neut. acc. sg.
glossary.ἕπταχα: ἑπτάχα — in seven parts, sevenfold; adv.
glossary.ἠΰτε: ἠΰτε — like as, even as; epic particle introducing a comparison
glossary.ἠλεός: ἠλεός — crazed, distracted, foolish; adj., masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἡβώοιμι: ἡβάω — be in the prime of youth; pres. opt. 1 sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἡβῴην), in a wish
glossary.ἡγείσθην: ἡγέομαι — lead, go before; impf. 3 dual: ’the two led’
glossary.ἤγομεν: ἄγω — lead, bring; impf. 1 pl.: ’we led’
glossary.ἤπαφε: ἀπαφίσκω — deceive, beguile, lead astray; aor. 3 sg., reduplicated 2nd aorist (ἤπαφον)
glossary.ἥνδανεν: ἁνδάνω — please, be pleasing (+ dat.); impf. 3 sg., augmented, with movable ν
glossary.ἰωγῇ: ἰωγή — shelter, cover (from wind); fem. dat. sg., Ionic -ῇ
glossary.ἴαν: εἷς, μία, ἕν — one; fem. acc. sg., epic ἴαν (= Attic μίαν)
glossary.ὀΐων: ὄϊς — sheep; masc./fem. gen. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic οἰῶν)
glossary.ὀλίγῃ: ὀλίγος — little, small, slight; fem. dat. sg.
glossary.ὀπί: ὄψ (gen. ὀπός) — voice (not ὤψ ’face’); fem. dat. sg. ὀπί
glossary.ὄροιτο: ὄρνυμι — stir up; mid./intrans. arise; aor. opt. 3 sg. mid. (root aorist), of a general case in past time: ’might arise’
glossary.ὅγ: ὁ, ἡ, τό + γε — he, that one; masc. nom. sg. pronoun with emphatic γε, elided (ὅγ’ = ὅ γε): ’he for his part’
glossary.ὑπάκουσε: ὑπακούω — give ear, listen (to), answer; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ὑπήκουσε)
glossary.ὗν: ὗς (σῦς) — pig, boar, sow; masc./fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ὠμοθετεῖτο: ὠμοθετέω — lay raw pieces of flesh (on the fat) as an offering; impf. 3 sg. mid., contracted
glossary.ὡπλίζετο: ὁπλίζω — make ready, equip; mid. arm oneself; impf. 3 sg. mid., augmented (ὁ → ὡ)
glossary.ὤπτησάν: ὀπτάω — roast; aor. 3 pl., accented before an enclitic
glossary.ῥάκεα: ῥάκος — rag, tattered garment; neut. acc. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ῥάκη)
glossary.ῥιγωσέμεν: ῥιγόω — shiver, be cold; fut. inf. act., epic -έμεν (= Attic ῥιγώσειν)
glossary.ῥωπήϊα: ῥωπήϊον — thicket, brushwood; neut. acc. pl.
glossary.βούλεται: βούλομαι — wish, want, be minded; pres. 3 sg. mid., + inf.: ’wants’
glossary.γλυκύς: γλυκύς — sweet, pleasant; masc. nom. sg., agreeing with ὕπνος
glossary.δειπνήσαντας: δειπνέω — dine, take a meal; aor. part. act., masc. acc. pl.: ’having dined’
glossary.δνοφερὴν: δνοφερός — dark, murky; fem. acc. sg., agreeing with νύκτα
glossary.δουρικλειτὸς: δουρικλειτός — famed for the spear; masc. nom. sg., epithet of Menelaus
glossary.δώροισι: δῶρον — gift; neut. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις), dat. of respect: ’in gifts’
glossary.δῦνεν: δύνω (by-form of δύω) — put on, enter; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= Attic ἔδυνεν), with movable ν
glossary.εὐρυμάχῳ: Εὐρύμαχος — Eurymachus, a suitor of Penelope; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.εὐχάλκων: εὔχαλκος — of good bronze; adj. (2-term.), masc. gen. pl., agreeing with τριπόδων
glossary.ζεῦξον: ζεύγνυμι — yoke, harness; aor. imper. act. 2 sg.: ’harness’
glossary.κέλονται: κέλομαι — urge, bid, command; pres. 3 pl. mid., + inf.
glossary.καλλικόμοιο: καλλίκομος — with fair hair; adj. (2-term.), fem. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου), agreeing with Ἑλένης
glossary.κασίγνητοί: κασίγνητος — brother (also sibling); masc. nom. pl.: ’brothers’
glossary.κουριδίοιο: κουρίδιος — wedded, lawful (of a spouse); masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου), agreeing with φίλοιο: ’wedded’
glossary.κτῆμα: κτῆμα — possession, piece of property; neut. acc. sg. (also nom., same form), object of φέρηται
glossary.κῦδός: κῦδος — glory, renown; neut. nom. sg.
glossary.λεβήτων: λέβης — cauldron, basin; masc. gen. pl.
glossary.λοχόωσιν: λοχάω — lie in ambush for, waylay; pres. 3 pl., epic -όωσιν (= Attic λοχῶσιν)
glossary.λὰξ: λάξ — with the foot, by kicking; adv.
glossary.μαλακῷ: μαλακός — soft, gentle; masc. dat. sg., agreeing with ὕπνῳ
glossary.μιμνήσκεται: μιμνήσκομαι — remember, be mindful of; pres. 3 sg. mid., + gen.: ’remembers’
glossary.μώνυχας: μώνυξ — solid-hoofed, with an undivided hoof (of horses); masc./fem. acc. pl., agreeing with ἵππους
glossary.νεμεσσῶμαι: νεμεσσάομαι — be indignant at, disapprove of; pres. 1 sg. mid., contracted, epic doubled σ (= Attic νεμεσῶμαι), + dat. · also + acc. of the person and an infinitive: ’resent (you) for …’ (οὔ σε νεμεσσῶμαι κεχολῶσθαι)
glossary.νεστορίδην: Νεστορίδης — son of Nestor (patronymic, of Peisistratus); masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ξεινοδόκου: ξεινοδόκος — host, one who receives guests; masc. gen. sg., epic ξεινο- (= Attic ξενοδόκος)
glossary.πέμπειν: πέμπω — send, send on one’s way; pres. inf. act. (Attic form of epic πεμπέμεν)
glossary.παράσχῃ: παρέχω — offer, show, provide; aor. subj. 3 sg. act., in a general relative with κεν: ’shows’
glossary.παραυδήσας: παραυδάω — speak to, soothe with words; aor. part. act., masc. nom. sg.: ’having soothed’
glossary.παρεόντα: πάρειμι — be present, be at hand; pres. part., epic uncontracted (= Attic παρόντα), masc. acc. sg.: ’who is present’
glossary.παριστάμενος: παρίστημι — set beside; mid. stand beside, approach; pres. part. mid., masc. nom. sg.: ’standing beside’
glossary.πεισίστρατε: Πεισίστρατος — Peisistratus, son of Nestor; masc. voc. sg.
glossary.περίφρονι: περίφρων — circumspect, thoughtful; adj. (2-term.), fem. dat. sg., agreeing with Πηνελοπείῃ
glossary.περιβάλλει: περιβάλλω — throw around; also surpass, excel; pres. 3 sg. act., + acc. of those surpassed: ’surpasses’
glossary.πλείειν: πλέω — sail; pres. inf. act., epic form (= Attic πλεῖν), with imperative force
glossary.πρήσσωμεν: πράσσω — do, accomplish, make one’s way; pres. subj. 1 pl., epic πρήσσω (= Attic πράσσω), + gen. of the way: ’that we may get on’
glossary.προτέρων: πρότερος — earlier, former; masc. gen. pl., agreeing with παίδων: ’children of an earlier marriage’
glossary.σπερχόμενός: σπέρχομαι — hasten, be in a hurry; pres. part. mid., masc. nom. sg. (accented before enclitic ῥα): ’hurrying’
glossary.σύνθεο: συντίθημι — put together; mid. take to heart, mark; aor. imper. mid. 2 sg., unaugmented, epic (= Attic σύνθου)
glossary.τέτμῃς: τέτμον — come upon, find, reach; aor. subj. 2 sg., defective epic aorist with no present: ’you may find’
glossary.τεθνηκότος: θνῄσκω — die; perf. part. act., masc. gen. sg.: ’(of one) dead’
glossary.τετυκεῖν: τεύχω — make, prepare; reduplicated aor. inf. act., epic (= Attic τεῦξαι): ’to prepare’
glossary.τραφθῆναι: τρέπω — turn; mid./pass. turn oneself, travel; aor. pass. inf. with α-stem (Attic τρεφθῆναι)
glossary.τριπόδων: τρίπους — tripod, three-legged vessel; masc. gen. pl.
glossary.φάγωσι: ἐσθίω — eat; aor. subj. 3 pl. (stem φαγ-), after μή ’lest’; in tmesis with κατά: ’devour’
glossary.φέρηται: φέρω — carry, bear; pres. subj. 3 sg. mid., after μή ’lest’: ’she may carry off (for herself)’
glossary.φήνωσι: φαίνω — show, bring to light; aor. subj. 3 pl. act.: ’may show, point out’
glossary.φιλέῃσιν: φιλέω — love, treat as a friend; pres. subj. 3 sg., epic -έῃσιν (= Attic -ῇ), in a general relative: ’shows love’
glossary.φιλεῖν: φιλέω — love, treat with kindness, entertain; pres. inf. act.
glossary.φιλότητα: φιλότης — friendship, love, kindness; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀέσαι: ἄω (aor. ἄεσα) — spend the night, sleep; aor. inf. act., with imperative force: ’spend the night’
glossary.ἀγανοῖσι: ἀγανός — gentle, kindly, soothing; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις), agreeing with μύθοις
glossary.ἀγλαΐη: ἀγλαΐα — splendour, glory; fem. nom. sg., epic -ΐη (= Attic -ΐα)
glossary.ἀκτὴν: ἀκτή — headland, foreland, shore; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀλάλησαι: ἀλάομαι — wander, roam; perf. 2 sg. mid., present sense: ’you are wandering’
glossary.ἀνστὰς: ἀνίστημι — raise up; intrans. aor. stand up, rise; aor. part. act., masc. nom. sg., epic (= Attic ἀναστάς)
glossary.ἀπέχειν: ἀπέχω — hold off, keep away; pres. inf. act., with imperative force, + gen.: ’keep away from’
glossary.ἀποπέμψῃ: ἀποπέμπω — send away, send off; aor. subj. 3 sg. act.: ’may send off’
glossary.ἀππέμψει: ἀποπέμπω — send away; fut. 3 sg. act., epic apocope and assimilation ἀππ- (= Attic ἀποπέμψει)
glossary.ἀτρείδης: Ἀτρεΐδης — son of Atreus (Menelaus); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἐέλδεται: ἐέλδομαι — long for, wish; pres. 3 sg. mid., epic with prothetic ἐ- (= Attic ἐπιθυμεῖ), + inf.
glossary.ἐξώφελλεν: ἐξοφέλλω — increase greatly, augment; impf. 3 sg. act., augmented ὠ-, with movable ν (poetic; Attic uses αὔξω)
glossary.ἐπειγομένους: ἐπείγω — press, urge on; mid. hurry; pres. part. mid., masc. acc. pl., acc. subject of an inf.: ’(we) who are in haste’
glossary.ἐπιδίφρια: ἐπιδίφριος — on the chariot-board, for the chariot; adj. (2-term.), neut. acc. pl., agreeing with δῶρα
glossary.ἐπιτηδὲς: ἐπιτηδές — on purpose, in earnest; adv. (Attic ἐπίτηδες)
glossary.ἐπιτρέψειας: ἐπιτρέπω — turn over, entrust; aor. opt. 2 sg., Aeolic -ειας (= Attic -αις), as a mild command: ’you should entrust’
glossary.ἐρέοντα: ἐρέω — will say, tell; fut. part. act., masc. acc. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἐροῦντα), of purpose: ’to tell’
glossary.ἐρύξω: ἐρύκω — hold back, detain; fut. 1 sg. act.: ’I shall keep (you)’
glossary.ἐσθ: εἰμί — be; pres. 3 sg., elided (ἐσθ’ = ἐστί)
glossary.ἐσσύμενον: σεύω — drive, hurry; mid./pass. rush, hasten; perf. part. mid./pass., masc. acc. sg., epic doubled σ: ’eager to go’
glossary.ἐχθαίρῃσιν: ἐχθαίρω — hate; pres. subj. 3 sg., epic -ῃσιν (= Attic -ῃ), in a general relative: ’hates’
glossary.ἔγειρεν: ἐγείρω — wake, rouse, stir up; impf. 3 sg. act., unaugmented (= Attic ἤγειρεν), with movable ν
glossary.ἔγρεο: ἐγείρω — wake, rouse; mid. wake up; aor. imper. mid. 2 sg., epic: ’wake up!’
glossary.ἕπωμαι: ἕπομαι — follow, accompany; pres. subj. 1 sg. mid. (after ὄφρα): ’that I may go with (you)’ · also pres. subj. 1 sg. mid., deliberative, in an either/or question: ’or am I to follow?’ (ἠὲ μένω … ἦ … ἕπωμαι)
glossary.ἡγήσομαι: ἡγέομαι — lead, guide; fut. 1 sg. mid.: ’I shall lead’
glossary.ἱέμενον: ἵεμαι — long for, be eager; pres. part. mid., masc. acc. sg., + gen.: ’(you) eager for (your return)’ · ἵεμαι — hasten, make for; pres. part. mid. masc. acc. sg.: ’making for (Troy)’
glossary.ἴδῃς: ὁράω (aor. εἶδον) — see; aor. subj. 2 sg. act., after εἰς ὅ κε: ’you may see’
glossary.ἶσόν: ἶσος — equal, like (Attic ἴσος); neut. nom. sg., predicate with κακόν: ’an equal evil’
glossary.ὀπυίῃ: ὀπυίω — take as wife, marry (of a man); pres. subj. 3 sg., in a general relative with κεν: ’whoever marries’
glossary.ὀτρυνέουσα: ὀτρύνω — urge on, rouse; fut. part. act., fem. nom. sg., epic uncontracted -έουσα (= Attic ὀτρυνοῦσα), of purpose: ’to urge on’
glossary.ὀτρῦναι: ὀτρύνω — urge on, rouse, send on; aor. inf. act., with imperative force: ’urge on, send on’
glossary.ὀφέλλειν: ὀφέλλω — increase, enlarge; pres. inf. act. (οἶκον ὀφέλλειν ’to enlarge a household’)
glossary.ὄτρυνε: ὀτρύνω — urge on, rouse; pres. imper. act. 2 sg.: ’urge on’
glossary.ὑποζεύξω: ὑποζεύγνυμι — yoke, harness; fut. 1 sg. act. (the form could also be an aor. subj.): ’I shall harness’
glossary.ὑπομνήσουσα: ὑπομιμνήσκω — remind; fut. part. act., fem. nom. sg., of purpose, + gen.: ’to remind (of)’
glossary.ᾤχετ: οἴχομαι — go, be gone; impf. 3 sg. mid., elided (ᾤχετ’ = ᾤχετο): ’went’
glossary.ῥύεταί: ῥύομαι (ἐρύομαι) — protect, guard, rescue; pres. 3 sg. mid. (accent drawn back by enclitic τε): ’protects’
glossary.αἰετὸς: ἀετός — eagle; masc. nom. sg., epic αἰετός (= Attic ἀετός)
glossary.βοηθοΐδης: Βοηθοΐδης — son of Boethous; masc. nom. sg., patronymic (-ίδης), used alone as a name for Eteoneus, Menelaus’s attendant
glossary.βούλομαι: βούλομαι — wish, want, be minded; pres. 1 sg. mid., + inf.: ’I want’
glossary.γάμου: γάμος — marriage, wedding; masc. gen. sg.: ’of marriage’
glossary.γήθησαν: γηθέω — rejoice, be glad; aor. 3 pl. act., unaugmented (= Attic ἐγήθησαν)
glossary.δίδωμι: δίδωμι — give; pres. 1 sg. act.: ’I give’
glossary.δαίετο: δαίω (B) — divide, distribute, carve; impf. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented (= ἐδαίετο): ’was carving’
glossary.δεδισκόμενος: δεδίσκομαι (δειδίσκομαι) — greet, welcome with a gesture (sense traditional, uncertain); pres. part. mid., masc. nom. sg.
glossary.δεξάμενος: δέχομαι — receive, take; aor. part. mid., masc. nom. sg.: ’having received’
glossary.δεξιτερῆφι: δεξιτερός — right, on the right; fem. dat. sg. with the suffix -φι (= Attic δεξιᾷ): ’in the right (hand)’
glossary.δεξιὸς: δεξιός — right, on the right, auspicious; masc. nom. sg., agreeing with ὄρνις: ’on the right’ · also masc. nom. sg., predicative, of motion: ’darting up on the right’
glossary.δῶρόν: δῶρον — gift; neut. nom./acc. sg., accented because the enclitic τοι follows: ’a gift’
glossary.εἰπόντι: εἶπον — say, speak; aor. part. act., masc. dat. sg., agreeing with οἱ: ’to him as he spoke’
glossary.εἴποιμ: εἶπον — say, tell; aor. opt. act. 1 sg., elided (εἴποιμ’ = εἴποιμι), optative of wish: ’I might say’
glossary.θῆκ: τίθημι — put, place, set; aor. 3 sg. act., elided (θῆκ’ = θῆκε, = Attic ἔθηκε): ’set down’
glossary.κάμεν: κάμνω — toil, work at, make with toil; aor. 3 sg. act., unaugmented (= ἔκαμεν): ’wrought’
glossary.καλλιπάρῃος: καλλιπάρῃος — fair-cheeked; adj. (2-term.), fem. nom. sg., epic -ῃος, from παρῃά ’cheek’ (Attic παρειά); epithet of Helen · also epithet of the maid Melantho
glossary.καταλέξομεν: καταλέγω — recount, tell in full; fut. 1 pl. act. (or short-vowel aor. subj.): ’we shall tell’
glossary.κείσθω: κεῖμαι — lie, be laid up; pres. imper. 3 sg.: ’let it lie’
glossary.κηώεντα: κηώεις — fragrant (traditional gloss, origin uncertain); masc. acc. sg., agreeing with θάλαμον
glossary.κιοίτην: κίω — go, go one’s way; pres. opt. 3 dual (= Attic -οίτην), secondary dual ending -την: ’the two might go’
glossary.κιχὼν: κιχάνω — reach, come upon, find; aor. part. act., masc. nom. sg. (epic aor. ἔκιχον): ’having found’
glossary.κρεῶν: κρέας — meat, flesh; neut. gen. pl., partitive with ὀπτῆσαι: ’some of the meat’
glossary.κῆαι: καίω — burn, kindle; aor. inf. act., epic (= Attic καῦσαι): ’to kindle’
glossary.λάβεν: λαμβάνω — take; aor. 3 sg. act., unaugmented, with movable ν (= ἔλαβεν)
glossary.λείψαντε: λείβω — pour, pour a libation; aor. part. act., masc. nom. dual: ’having poured a libation’
glossary.μεγαπένθε: Μεγαπένθης — Megapenthes, son of Menelaus; masc. acc. sg., elided (Μεγαπένθε’ = Μεγαπένθεα)
glossary.μνῆμ: μνῆμα — keepsake, memorial; neut. nom./acc. sg., elided (μνῆμ’ = μνῆμα), in apposition to δῶρον
glossary.νείατος: νείατος (= νέατος) — undermost, last, lowest; adj., masc. nom. sg., epic νει- (= νέατος), + gen.: ’lowest of the others’
glossary.νεῖσθαι: νέομαι — go, come back, return; pres. inf. mid.: ’to go home’
glossary.οἰνοχόει: οἰνοχοέω — pour wine, serve wine; impf. 3 sg. act., unaugmented (= ᾠνοχόει)
glossary.πέπλον: πέπλος — robe, woman’s garment; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.παμποίκιλοι: παμποίκιλος — all-varied, richly embroidered; adj. (2-term.), masc. nom. pl., agreeing with πέπλοι
glossary.πείρινθα: πείρινς — wicker basket, the body of a wagon or chariot (sense traditional); fem. acc. sg., with ἐς: ’into the chariot-box’
glossary.ποικίλμασιν: ποίκιλμα — piece of embroidery, variegated work; neut. dat. pl., with movable ν, dat. of respect: ’in embroideries’
glossary.πολυηράτου: πολυήρατος — much-loved, lovely; adj., masc. gen. sg., agreeing with γάμου
glossary.τυχὼν: τυγχάνω — hit upon, obtain, + gen.; aor. part. act., masc. nom. sg.: ’having obtained’ · also aor. part., absolute, of a blow: ’having hit’ (the mark)
glossary.τῆος: τῆος — meanwhile, for so long; adv., epic (= Attic τέως), correlative of ἧος
glossary.φαεινὸν: φαεινός — shining, bright (cf. φαίνω ’show, shine’); adj., masc. acc. sg., agreeing with κρητῆρα
glossary.φορέειν: φορέω — carry, wear; pres. inf. act., epic uncontracted (= Attic φορεῖν)
glossary.φωριαμοῖσιν: φωριαμός — chest, coffer; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις)
glossary.ἀειραμένη: ἀείρω (= αἴρω) — lift, raise, take up; aor. part. mid., fem. nom. sg., epic uncontracted: ’having taken up’
glossary.ἀπέλαμπεν: ἀπολάμπω — shine forth, gleam; impf. 3 sg. act.: ’was gleaming’
glossary.ἀπίθησεν: ἀπιθέω — disobey; aor. 3 sg. act. (= Attic ἀπείθησεν); with οὐκ: ’did not disobey’
glossary.ἀργὴν: ἀργός — white, gleaming; adj., fem. acc. sg., agreeing with χῆνα (ἀργός also means swift or idle elsewhere)
glossary.ἀρηΐφιλος: ἀρηΐφιλος — dear to Ares, war-loving; adj. (2-term.), masc. nom. sg., epithet of Menelaus
glossary.ἁπάσης: ἅπας — all, the whole; fem. gen. sg., agreeing with φιλότητος
glossary.ἐπέπτατο: ἐπιπέτομαι — fly at, fly up to; aor. 3 sg. mid. (ἐπί + ἔπτατο, aorist of πέτομαι): ’flew up’
glossary.ἐϋκτίμενον: ἐΰκτίμενος — well-built, well-founded; adj., masc. acc. sg., agreeing with οἶκον, epic ἐϋ- (= εὖ)
glossary.ἑζέσθην: ἕζομαι — sit down, seat oneself; impf. 3 dual mid. (cf. ἕζοντο): ’the two sat down’
glossary.ἔκιε: κίω — go, go one’s way; impf. 3 sg. act., augmented ἔ-: ’went’
glossary.ἔφηνε: φαίνω — show, make appear; aor. 3 sg. act.: ’showed, sent as a sign’
glossary.ἡμέτερ: ἡμέτερος — our; neut. acc. pl., elided (ἡμέτερ’ = ἡμέτερα), used as a noun: ’our (home)’
glossary.ἤϊξε: ἀΐσσω — dart, rush; aor. 3 sg. act., augmented ἤϊ- (= Attic ᾖξε)
glossary.ἥμερον: ἥμερος — tame, domesticated; adj. (2-term.), fem. acc. sg., agreeing with χῆνα
glossary.ἰΰζοντες: ἰύζω — shout, cry out; pres. part. act., masc. nom. pl.: ’shouting’
glossary.ἵκανον: ἱκάνω — come, arrive at; impf. 3 pl. act., unaugmented, epic (Attic ἀφικνέομαι)
glossary.ὀπτῆσαί: ὀπτάω — roast; aor. inf. act., accented because the enclitic τε follows: ’to roast’
glossary.ὄλωμαι: ὄλλυμι — destroy; mid. perish; aor. subj. mid. 1 sg. (μή + subj.: ’lest I perish’; = Attic ἀπόλωμαι)
glossary.ὑποκρίναιτο: ὑποκρίνομαι — answer, interpret; aor. opt. mid. 3 sg., in an indirect question after ὅππως: ’how he might answer’
glossary.ὑποφθαμένη: ὑποφθάνω — anticipate, be beforehand; aor. part. mid., fem. nom. sg.: ’getting in first’
glossary.ὥρην: ὥρη — season, time (of life); fem. acc. sg., Ionic η (= Attic ὥραν): ’for the time of marriage’
glossary.αἰγίοχος: αἰγίοχος — aegis-bearing (epithet of Zeus; sense disputed); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.αἴσιμον: αἴσιμος — fated, due, fitting; neut. nom. sg., predicate: ’it was fated’, with an infinitive
glossary.βαρείης: βαρύς — heavy, grievous; fem. gen. sg., Ionic -είης (= Attic -είας), agreeing with ἄτης
glossary.γήραος: γῆρας — old age; neut. gen. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic γήρως)
glossary.γενεή: γενεή — race, kindred, family; fem. nom. sg., Ionic η (= Attic γενεά)
glossary.δέδετο: δέω — bind; plpf. pass. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐδέδετο): ’was bound’
glossary.δασπλῆτις: δασπλῆτις — terrible (epithet of the Erinys; sense traditional, origin uncertain); fem. nom. sg.
glossary.εἴσεται: εἶμι — go, come; fut. 3 sg. mid., epic: ’will come’ · also οἶδα — know; fut. 3 sg.: ’will know’ (same spelling; the context decides)
glossary.εὐχόμενόν: εὔχομαι — pray; pres. part. masc. acc. sg., accent from the following enclitic τε: ’praying’
glossary.θάνεν: θνῄσκω — die; aor. 3 sg., epic, unaugmented (= ἔθανε): ’died’
glossary.θήβῃσι: Θῆβαι — Thebes; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι (= Attic -αις): ’in Thebes’
glossary.θεοκλύμενος: Θεοκλύμενος — Theoclymenus, the seer, son of Polypheides; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.κάλλεος: κάλλος — beauty; neut. gen. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic κάλλους), with εἵνεκα: ’on account of beauty’
glossary.κέλευέ: κελεύω — bid, order; pres. imper. 2 sg. (accent from the following enclitic τε): ’bid’
glossary.κατάσχῃ: κατέχω — hold back, detain; aor. subj. 3 sg., after μή in a negative purpose clause: ’lest he detain’
glossary.κατακτάς: κατακτείνω — kill; aor. part. masc. nom. sg., epic root-aorist form (= Attic κατακτείνας): ’having killed’
glossary.κενεόν: κενεός — empty; masc. acc. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic κενόν): ’empty’, ’empty-handed’
glossary.κεχολώσεται: χολόω — anger; mid. χολόομαι ’be angry’; fut. perf. 3 sg. mid.: ’will be angry’
glossary.κλεῖτον: Κλεῖτος — Cleitus, son of Mantius; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.κλεῖτόν: Κλεῖτος — Cleitus, son of Mantius; masc. acc. sg. (accent from the following enclitic τε)
glossary.κληῗσι: κληΐς — rowing-bench, thwart; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι (= Attic -σι), diaeresis marks the syllables
glossary.κραταιώ: κραταιός — strong, mighty; masc. acc. dual, agreeing with υἷε: ’two strong (sons)’
glossary.λαοσσόον: λαοσσόος — rousing the people (λαός + σεύω; ’saving the people’ also ancient, derivation disputed); masc. acc. sg., epithet
glossary.μάντιν: μάντις — seer, prophet; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.μάντιον: Μάντιος — Mantius, son of Melampus, father of Polypheides and Cleitus; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.μάντιος: Μάντιος — Mantius, son of Melampus; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.μάστιν: μάστιξ — whip; fem. acc. sg., epic short form (= Attic μάστιγα)
glossary.μαντεύετο: μαντεύομαι — prophesy, divine; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐμαντεύετο): ’prophesied’
glossary.μελάμποδος: Μελάμπους — Melampus, the seer, founder of the family; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.μεμαῶτες: μέμονα — be eager, strive; perf. part. masc. nom. pl., epic (μεμαώς, μεμαῶτ-), with present sense: ’eager’
glossary.μετείη: μέτειμι — be among, have a share in; pres. opt. 3 sg., + dat., in a purpose clause after ἵνα: ’that he might be among’
glossary.ναιέμεναι: ναίω — dwell, live; pres. inf., epic -έμεναι (= Attic ναίειν)
glossary.νηλέα: Νηλεύς — Neleus, king of Pylos; masc. acc. sg., Attic-shaped (= epic Νηλῆα)
glossary.οὐδόν: οὐδός — threshold; masc. acc. sg.: ’threshold (of old age)’, a figure for reaching it · also the literal threshold of a house (ὑπέρβη λάϊνον οὐδόν ’stepped over the stone threshold’) · also the ground underfoot (a sense disputed): ’the ground’ (ἀρισφαλέ’ ἔμμεναι οὐδόν ’that the ground is very slippery’)
glossary.πεδίονδε: πεδίον — plain; neut. acc. sg. + directional -δε: ’to the plain’
glossary.πολυφείδεά: Πολυφείδης — Polypheides, seer, son of Mantius; masc. acc. sg., epic -εα (= Attic -η), accent from the following enclitic τε
glossary.πολυφείδεα: Πολυφείδης — Polypheides, seer, son of Mantius; masc. acc. sg., epic -εα (= Attic -η)
glossary.πονεῖτο: πονέομαι — busy oneself, toil; impf. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented (= ἐπονεῖτο): ’was busy’
glossary.πρύμνῃ: πρύμνη — stern (of a ship); fem. dat. sg., Ionic η (= Attic -α)
glossary.πυλίοισι: Πύλιος — Pylian; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις): ’among the Pylians’
glossary.σπένδοντ: σπένδω — pour a libation; pres. part. masc. acc. sg., elided (σπένδοντ’ = σπένδοντα): ’pouring a libation’
glossary.στρέψ: στρέφω — turn; aor. 3 sg., elided and unaugmented (στρέψ’ = στρέψε, Attic ἔστρεψε): ’turned’
glossary.τέκετο: τίκτω — beget, bear; aor. 3 sg. mid., epic, unaugmented (= ἐτέκετο), said of a father: ’begot’
glossary.τελέσειας: τελέω — bring to pass, fulfil; aor. opt. 2 sg., potential with κεν: ’how could you fulfil’
glossary.τηλεδαπός: τηλεδαπός — from a far land; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.τόθι: τόθι — there; epic adv., correlative of ὅθι (= Attic ἐκεῖ)
glossary.τόκος: τόκος — offspring, brood (from τίκτω); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.υἷε: υἱός — son; masc. acc. dual: ’two sons’
glossary.φιλότητ: φιλότης — love, friendship; fem. acc. sg., elided (φιλότητ’ = φιλότητα), cognate acc. with φιλέω: ’with love’
glossary.φυλάκοιο: Φύλακος — Phylacus, lord of Phylace; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.χολωθείς: χολόω — anger; aor. pass. part. masc. nom. sg., + dat. of the cause: ’angered’
glossary.χῆν: χήν — goose; masc./fem. acc. sg., elided (χῆν’ = χῆνα)
glossary.ἀγαυότατον: ἀγαυός — noble, illustrious; superl. ἀγαυότατος, masc. acc. sg., with partitive gen.: ’most noble (of the living)’
glossary.ἀλκμαίων: Ἀλκμαίων — Alcmaeon, son of Amphiaraus; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀμβαίνωμεν: ἀναβαίνω — go up, go aboard, embark; pres. subj. 1 pl., apocope (ἀμ- = ἀνα- before β), hortatory: ’let us embark’
glossary.ἀμφίλοχός: Ἀμφίλοχος — Amphilochus, son of Amphiaraus; masc. nom. sg. (accent from the following enclitic τε)
glossary.ἀμφιάραον: Ἀμφιάραος — Amphiaraus, the seer of Argos; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀμφιάραος: Ἀμφιάραος — Amphiaraus, the seer of Argos; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀνάβαινε: ἀναβαίνω — go up, go aboard, embark; pres. imper. 2 sg.: ’go aboard’
glossary.ἀνάσσοντ: ἀνάσσω — rule, be lord; pres. part. masc. acc. sg., elided (ἀνάσσοντ’ = ἀνάσσοντα), + dat. of those ruled: ’ruling over’
glossary.ἀντιφάτην: Ἀντιφάτης — Antiphates, son of Melampus; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀντιφάτης: Ἀντιφάτης — Antiphates, son of Melampus, father of Oicles; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀπαγγεῖλαί: ἀπαγγέλλω — report, bring word; aor. inf. (accent from the following enclitic τε): ’to report’
glossary.ἀπενάσσατο: ἀπονάσσω — settle away from home, remove (causative of ναίω); mid. remove oneself; aor. 3 sg. mid., augmented (ἀπ-ε-νάσσατο): ’removed himself’
glossary.ἀτιταλλομένην: ἀτιτάλλω — rear, nurture; pres. part. mid./pass. fem. acc. sg., agreeing with χῆνα: ’being reared’
glossary.ἄκοντε: ἄκων — unwilling; masc. nom. dual (Attic ἄκων, epic ἀέκων), with οὐκ: ’not unwilling’
glossary.ἄτης: ἄτη — ruin, blind folly sent by a god; fem. gen. sg., with εἵνεκα
glossary.ἐγένοντ: γίγνομαι — be born, become; aor. 3 pl., elided (ἐγένοντ’ = ἐγένοντο): ’were born’
glossary.ἐγκοσμεῖτε: ἐγκοσμέω — put in order, arrange; pres. imper. 2 pl.: ’set in order’
glossary.ἐκίχανεν: κιχάνω — come upon, find; impf. 3 sg.: ’came upon’
glossary.ἐνήσει: ἐνίημι — send in, put into; fut. 3 sg., + dat.: ’will put (us) into’
glossary.ἐξαίνυτο: ἐξαίνυμαι — take out, take away; impf. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented: ’took out’
glossary.ἐριμύκους: ἐρίμυκος — loud-lowing (ἐρι- intensive + μυκάομαι); masc./fem. acc. pl., of cattle
glossary.ἐρινύς: Ἐρινύς — Erinys, avenging spirit, a Fury; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἔγημε: γαμέω — marry (of a man), take as wife; aor. 3 sg., augmented (ἔ-γημε): ’married’
glossary.ἔτικτεν: τίκτω — beget, bear; impf. 3 sg., augmented: ’fathered’
glossary.ἕ: οὗ, οἷ, ἕ — he, she, it (3rd-person pron.); acc. sg., subject of an infinitive: ’him’
glossary.ἠγάγετο: ἄγω — lead; mid. lead home (a bride); aor. 3 sg. mid., augmented: ’led home’
glossary.ἤϊξαν: ἀΐσσω — dart, rush; aor. 3 pl., augmented (ἤϊξαν = Attic ᾖξαν): ’darted’
glossary.ἥρπαξ: ἁρπάζω — snatch, seize; aor. 3 sg., augmented, elided (ἥρπαξ’ = ἥρπαξε): ’snatched’
glossary.ἥρπασεν: ἁρπάζω — snatch, seize; aor. 3 sg., augmented: ’snatched away’
glossary.ἱππόβοτον: ἱππόβοτος — horse-feeding, horse-pasturing; neut. acc. sg., epithet of Argos
glossary.ἵπποιϊν: ἵππος — horse; masc. dat. dual, epic -οιϊν (= Attic -οιν): ’upon the two horses’
glossary.ὀϊκλείης: Ὀϊκλῆς — Oicles, son of Antiphates; masc. nom. sg., epic nom. in -είης beside Ὀϊκλῆς
glossary.ὀϊκλῆα: Ὀϊκλῆς — Oicles, son of Antiphates; masc. acc. sg., epic -ῆα (= Attic -έα)
glossary.ὁμήλικές: ὁμήλιξ — of the same age, like in age; masc. nom. pl. (accent from the following enclitic): ’of like age’
glossary.ὁμοφροσύνῃσιν: ὁμοφροσύνη — like-mindedness, concord; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσιν (= Attic -αις), plural for the abstract
glossary.ὄλετ: ὄλλυμι — destroy; mid. perish; aor. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented, elided (ὄλετ’ = ὄλετο, Attic ὤλετο): ’perished’
glossary.ὑπέρβιος: ὑπέρβιος — overweening, violent, arrogant; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ὑπέρθυμον: ὑπέρθυμος — high-spirited, proud (ὑπέρ + θυμός); masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ὑπερησίηνδ: Ὑπερησίη — Hypereisia, a place name; fem. acc. sg. + directional -δε, elided (ὑπερησίηνδ’ = ὑπερησίηνδε): ’to Hypereisia’
glossary.ὑποσχόμενος: ὑπισχνέομαι — promise, undertake; aor. mid. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having promised’
glossary.αἰνῆς: αἰνός — dread, grim, grievous; fem. gen. sg., agreeing with ὀϊζύος
glossary.βεβρίθασιν: βρίθω — be heavy, be laden; perf. 3 pl. (= Attic βεβρίθασι), present sense, + gen.: ’are laden with’
glossary.βοεῦσι: βοεύς — thong or rope of ox-hide; masc. dat. pl., of the means
glossary.γαστρὸς: γαστήρ — belly, stomach; fem. gen. sg., contracted stem γαστρ-
glossary.δαιτρεῦσαί: δαιτρεύω — carve, portion out meat; aor. inf. act.
glossary.δανὰ: δανός — dry, parched (of wood; sense uncertain); neut. acc. pl., agreeing with ξύλα
glossary.διωκέμεναι: διώκω — pursue, chase; pres. inf. act., epic -μεναι (= Attic διώκειν)
glossary.δορπείτην: δορπέω — take the evening meal, sup; impf. 3 dual, unaugmented (= Attic ἐδορπείτην)
glossary.δρηστοσύνῃ: δρηστοσύνη — service, work of a servant; fem. dat. sg., dat. of respect: ’in service’
glossary.δρώοιμι: δράω — do, perform; pres. opt. 1 sg., epic -ώοιμι (= Attic δρῴην), potential with κε: ’I could serve’
glossary.εἰρομένῳ: ἔρομαι — ask, inquire; pres. part. mid. masc. dat. sg., epic (= Attic ἐρομένῳ), agreeing with μοι: ’to me asking’
glossary.εἱμένοι: ἕννυμι — clothe; perf. pass. part. masc. nom. pl., + acc.: ’clothed in’
glossary.ζώουσιν: ζώω — live; pres. 3 pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ζῶσιν)
glossary.θεοκλύμενον: Θεοκλύμενος — Theoclymenus, the seer; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.θυέων: θύος — sacrifice, offering; neut. gen. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic θυῶν)
glossary.θύοντα: θύω (A) — sacrifice, make an offering; pres. part. masc. acc. sg.: ’sacrificing’
glossary.κατέλειπεν: καταλείπω — leave behind; impf. 3 sg., + acc.
glossary.καταδῦναι: καταδύω — go down into, enter, plunge into; aor. inf. act. (intrans.), + acc.: ’to go down among’
glossary.κατακτείνωσι: κατακτείνω — kill, slay; aor. subj. 3 pl., after μή: ’lest they kill’
glossary.κατακτὰς: κατακτείνω — kill, slay; aor. 2 part. act. masc. nom. sg., stem κτα- (= Attic κατακτανών): ’having killed’
glossary.κατατρύχω: κατατρύχω — wear out, exhaust; pres. subj. 1 sg., short vowel, after ἵνα μή: ’so that I may not wear out’
glossary.κεάσσαι: κεάζω — split, cleave; aor. inf. act., epic -σσαι (= Attic κεάσαι)
glossary.κοτύλην: κοτύλη — cup, small measure; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.κρουνοὺς: Κρουνοί — Crouni (’Springs’), a place on the coast; masc. acc. pl. (κρουνός ’spring’)
glossary.λάβρον: λάβρος — violent, boisterous, furious; masc. acc. sg., agreeing with οὖρον
glossary.λίσσομ: λίσσομαι — beg, entreat; pres. 1 sg., elided (λίσσομ’ = λίσσομαι)
glossary.λιλαίομαι: λιλαίομαι — long for, be eager; pres. 1 sg., + inf.: ’I am eager to’
glossary.λιπαροὶ: λιπαρός — sleek, shining (with oil); masc. nom. pl.
glossary.μεῖναί: μένω — stay, remain; aor. inf. act., intrans.: ’to stay’ · also trans. + acc.: ’to wait for’ (μεῖναί … κεῖνον ’to wait for that man’)
glossary.μιγείην: μίγνυμι — mix; pass. mingle with, join; aor. pass. opt. 1 sg., + dat., potential with κε: ’I might mingle with’
glossary.μυρί: μυρίος — countless, numberless; neut. acc. pl., elided (μυρί’ = μυρία), agreeing with ὀνείατα
glossary.νηῆσαι: νηέω — heap up, pile; aor. inf. act. (= Attic νῆσαι)
glossary.παραδρώωσι: παραδράω — serve, wait upon; pres. 3 pl., epic -ώωσι (= Attic -δρῶσι), + dat.
glossary.παρεόντι: πάρειμι — be present, be at hand; pres. part. masc. dat. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic παρόντι): ’while present’
glossary.πλάγξομαι: πλάζω — drive astray; pass. wander, roam; fut. mid. 1 sg., epic: ’I shall wander’
glossary.πλαγκτοσύνης: πλαγκτοσύνη — wandering, roaming; fem. gen. sg., gen. of comparison after κακώτερον: ’than wandering’
glossary.πτωχεύσων: πτωχεύω — beg, live as a beggar; fut. part. masc. nom. sg., purpose: ’to beg’
glossary.πύρνον: πύρνος — wheaten bread; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.σιδήρεον: σιδήρεος — of iron; masc. acc. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic σιδηροῦς), agreeing with οὐρανόν
glossary.τάνυσεν: τανύω — stretch, lay out; aor. 3 sg., epic, unaugmented (= Attic ἐτάνυσεν)
glossary.τίη: τίη — why?; interrog. adv., epic (= Attic τί)
glossary.τεθνᾶσι: θνῄσκω — die; perf. 3 pl. (= τεθνήκασι): ’are dead’
glossary.τοιοίδ: τοιόσδε — of such a kind, such; masc. nom. pl., elided (τοιοίδ’ = τοιοίδε)
glossary.φεὰς: Φεαί — Pheae, a coastal town of Elis; fem. acc. pl.
glossary.φιλέοι: φιλέω — love, treat kindly, entertain; pres. opt. 3 sg., uncontracted (= Attic φιλοῖ), in an indirect question: ’whether he would welcome’
glossary.χέρηες: χέρης — inferior, lesser, worse; masc. nom. pl., epic (= Attic χείρονες), used as a noun: ’inferiors’
glossary.χαλκίδα: Χαλκίς — Chalcis, a coastal place; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀγάγῃ: ἄγω — lead, guide; aor. subj. 3 sg., prospective relative with κε: ’who shall lead’
glossary.ἀνιᾶται: ἀνιάω — grieve, vex, trouble; pres. pass. 3 sg.: ’is distressed’
glossary.ἀνύσειε: ἀνύω — accomplish, complete, finish; aor. opt. 3 sg., purpose after ὄφρα: ’might finish’
glossary.ἀπώσω: ἀπωθέω — push away, thrust off; fut. 1 sg.: ’I shall thrust away’
glossary.ἄλη: ἄλη — wandering, roaming; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἐΐσης: ἐΐσος — equal, balanced, well-proportioned (of a ship; sense debated); fem. gen. sg., epic (= Attic ἴσος) · also fem. gen. sg. agreeing with δαιτός: ’equal, fair-shared’ (δαιτὸς ἐΐσης)
glossary.ἐδόρπεον: δορπέω — take the evening meal, sup; impf. 3 pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἐδόρπουν)
glossary.ἐθέλοντά: ἐθέλω — wish, be willing; pres. part. masc. acc. sg.: ’willing’
glossary.ἐπαιγίζοντα: ἐπαιγίζω — rush upon, blow upon (of a wind; sense uncertain); pres. part. masc. acc. sg., agreeing with οὖρον
glossary.ἐπειγομένη: ἐπείγω — press, drive; mid. hasten, press on; pres. part. mid. fem. nom. sg.: ’hastening’
glossary.ἐπικεύσῃς: ἐπικεύθω — conceal, hide; aor. subj. 2 sg., prohibition after μηδ’: ’do not hide’
glossary.ἐπιπροέηκε: ἐπιπροΐημι — send forward to; aor. 3 sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἐπιπροῆκε), + dat.
glossary.ἐρίσσειε: ἐρίζω — vie, contend; aor. opt. 3 sg., epic -σσ- (= Attic ἐρίσειε), + dat., potential with ἄν: ’could rival’
glossary.ἐϋστρέπτοισι: ἐΰστρεπτος — well-twisted; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
glossary.ἔμφυλον: ἔμφυλος — of the same tribe, of one’s own kin; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἔπαυσας: παύω — make cease, stop; aor. 2 sg., + gen.: ’you made me cease from’
glossary.ἔργοισι: ἔργον — work, deed; neut. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
glossary.ἔφεσσαι: ἐφέζω (ἐφίζω) — set upon, take on board; aor. imper. mid. 2 sg., epic -σσ- (= Attic ἔφισαι): ’take me aboard’
glossary.ἔχωμεν: ἔχω — have, hold; pres. subj. 1 pl., long vowel, in a relative clause with κε: ’whatever we have’ · also hortatory, in a main clause: ’let us keep’ (βίοτον … ἔχωμεν ’let us keep his livelihood’)
glossary.ἕκητι: ἕκητι — by the will of, thanks to; epic prep. + gen.
glossary.ἕπευ: ἕπομαι — follow, accompany; pres. imper. 2 sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἕπου)
glossary.ἕσσει: ἕννυμι — clothe; fut. 3 sg., + two acc.: ’will clothe (you) in’
glossary.ἡγεμόν: ἡγεμών — guide, leader; masc. acc. sg., elided (ἡγεμόν’ = ἡγεμόνα)
glossary.ἰσχανάᾳς: ἰσχανάω — hold back, be eager to hold (sense disputed); pres. 2 sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἰσχανᾷς)
glossary.ἱκέτευσα: ἱκετεύω — beseech, supplicate; aor. 1 sg.: ’I besought’
glossary.ὀπάζει: ὀπάζω — bestow, grant, give as a follower; pres. 3 sg.
glossary.ὀρέξῃ: ὀρέγω — reach out, hold out, offer; aor. subj. 3 sg., after αἴ κέν: ’should hold out’
glossary.ὀτρύνειε: ὀτρύνω — urge on, send on; pres. opt. 3 sg., in an indirect question: ’whether he would send’
glossary.ὀϊζύος: ὀϊζύς — woe, misery; fem. gen. sg., epic
glossary.ὁρμαίνων: ὁρμαίνω — ponder, turn over in mind; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’pondering’
glossary.ὄπασσον: ὀπάζω — give as a companion, grant; aor. imper. 2 sg., epic -σσ- (= Attic ὄπασον): ’grant’
glossary.ὅμιλον: ὅμιλος — crowd, throng; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ὅππη: ὅππῃ — where, whither; epic relative adv. (= Attic ὅπῃ)
glossary.ὑπαλευάμενος: ὑπαλεύομαι — evade, escape from; aor. part. mid. masc. nom. sg., + acc.: ’having evaded’
glossary.ὑποδρηστῆρες: ὑποδρηστήρ — servant, attendant; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ὑποδρώωσιν: ὑποδράω — serve, do service; pres. 3 pl., epic -ώωσιν (= Attic -δρῶσιν), + dat.
glossary.ὑπόθευ: ὑποτίθημι — put under; mid. suggest, provide; aor. imper. mid. 2 sg., epic (= Attic ὑπόθου)
glossary.ὕβρις: ὕβρις — insolence, violence, outrage; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.γηράσκωσι: γηράσκω — grow old; pres. subj. 3 pl., after ὅτε
glossary.δέδασται: δατέομαι — divide, share out; perf. pass. 3 sg.: ’has been divided’
glossary.δαινυμένω: δαίνυμαι — feast, dine; pres. part. mid. masc. nom. dual, agreeing with νῶϊ
glossary.διεπράθετο: διαπέρθω — sack utterly; aor. 3 sg. mid., passive sense: ’was sacked’ (aor. ἐπραθόμην, Attic διεπορθήθη)
glossary.δοῦσα: δίδωμι — give; aor. part. act. fem. nom. sg.
glossary.εἰρώτα: εἰρωτάω — ask; impf. 3 sg., epic (= Attic ἠρώτα)
glossary.εὐεργὸς: εὐεργός — well-working, skilled or perhaps upright (sense disputed); fem. nom. sg., two-ending adj. (= Attic εὔεργος)
glossary.εὐρυάγυια: εὐρυάγυιος — with broad streets; fem. nom. sg., two-ending adj., agreeing with πτόλις
glossary.εὑδέτω: εὕδω — sleep; pres. imper. 3 sg.: ’let him sleep’
glossary.εὔβοτος: εὔβοτος — rich in pasture, good for grazing; fem. nom. sg., two-ending adj.
glossary.θάνοι: θνῄσκω — die; aor. opt. 3 sg. (= Attic ἀποθάνοι), in a wish after ὡς μή
glossary.θρέψεν: τρέφω — rear, nourish; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented, epic -εν (= Attic ἔθρεψε)
glossary.κήδεσιν: κῆδος — care, trouble, sorrow; neut. dat. pl.
glossary.καταδήσῃ: καταδέω — bind fast; aor. subj. 3 sg., after μή: ’lest he bind’
glossary.καταλέχθαι: κατα-λέγομαι — lie down, go to bed; aor. inf. (= Attic κατακλιθῆναι)
glossary.κικλήσκεται: καλέω — call, name; pres. pass. 3 sg., epic reduplicated κικλήσκω (= Attic καλεῖται)
glossary.κουριδίης: κουρίδιος — wedded, lawful (of a wife); fem. gen. sg., epic -ης (= Attic -ας)
glossary.κτήσιος: Κτήσιος — Ctesius, a man’s name (Eumaeus’ father); masc. nom. sg. · also κτῆσις — possessions, property; fem. gen. sg., Ionic -ιος (= Attic -εως), gen. of cause with ἀσχαλόων: ’vexed about the property’
glossary.κτιμένῃ: Κτιμένη — Ctimene, a woman’s name (Odysseus’ sister, Laertes’ youngest daughter); fem. dat. sg.
glossary.λάβον: λαμβάνω — take, seize; aor. 3 pl., unaugmented (= Attic ἔλαβον)
glossary.λάθρη: λάθρα — secretly, by stealth; adv., epic/Ionic λάθρη (= Attic λάθρᾳ), originally a dative
glossary.λευγαλέοισι: λευγαλέος — wretched, grievous, pitiful; neut. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις), agreeing with κήδεσιν
glossary.ληΐστορες: ληΐστωρ — raider, pirate; masc. nom. pl. (= Attic λῃστής, pl. λῃσταί)
glossary.μείλιχον: μείλιχος — soothing, gentle, kindly; neut. acc. sg., object of ἀκοῦσαι: ’anything gentle’
glossary.μνωομένω: μνάομαι — be mindful of, recall; pres. part. mid. masc. nom. dual, epic (= Attic μνωμένω), agreeing with νῶϊ
glossary.μουνωθέντα: μονόω — leave alone, isolate; aor. pass. part. masc. acc. sg., epic μουν- (= Attic μονωθέντα)
glossary.μυρίον: μυρίος — countless, numberless; masc. acc. sg., agreeing with ὦνον
glossary.ναιετάασκε: ναιετάω — dwell, live; impf. 3 sg., iterative -ασκε, epic (= Attic ᾤκει)
glossary.νῆσός: νῆσος — island; fem. nom. sg. (accent from the enclitic τις)
glossary.νῶϊ: ἐγώ — I; pron., 1st pers. dual nom. ’we two’, epic (= Attic νώ) · also dual acc.: ’us two’ (τις νῶϊ τίει ’someone honours us two’)
glossary.ξυμβλήμενος: συμβάλλω — meet, encounter; aor. part. mid. masc. nom. sg., epic ξυν- and syncopated (= Attic συμβαλόμενος), + dat.
glossary.οἰνοπληθής: οἰνοπληθής — abounding in wine; fem. nom. sg., two-ending adj.
glossary.οἴεσιν: ὄϊς — sheep; masc./fem. dat. pl., epic (= Attic οἰσί)
glossary.πάθῃ: πάσχω — suffer, experience; aor. subj. 3 sg., after ὅς τις: ’whoever has suffered’
glossary.πέρασαν: περάω — sell (abroad); aor. 3 pl., unaugmented (= Attic ἐπέρασαν)
glossary.πίνοντέ: πίνω — drink; pres. part. act. masc. nom. dual, agreeing with νῶϊ (accent from the enclitic τε)
glossary.πείνη: πεῖνα — hunger; fem. nom. sg., Ionic -η (= Attic πεῖνα)
glossary.περάσητε: περάω — sell (abroad); aor. subj. 2 pl., in an indefinite clause after ὅπῃ
glossary.περιπληθὴς: περιπληθής — very full, populous; fem. nom. sg., two-ending adj.
glossary.πιέμεν: πίνω — drink; aor. inf. act., epic -εμεν (= Attic πιεῖν)
glossary.πιστωθῆναι: πιστόω — make trusty, bind by a pledge; aor. inf. pass.: ’to be pledged’, + dat. ὅρκῳ ’by oath’
glossary.πλείη: πλεῖος — full, + gen.; fem. nom. sg., epic (= Attic πλέα)
glossary.πλυνούσῃ: πλύνω — wash; pres. part. act. fem. dat. sg.: ’to her washing’
glossary.πολυήρατον: πολυήρατος — much-loved, lovely; fem. acc. sg., agreeing with ἥβην
glossary.πολυπαίπαλοι: πολυπαίπαλος — very artful, crafty (sense uncertain, a traditional guess); masc. nom. pl.
glossary.πολυχάλκου: πολύχαλκος — rich in bronze; fem. gen. sg., two-ending adj., agreeing with Σιδῶνος
glossary.πολύπυρος: πολύπυρος — rich in wheat; fem. nom. sg., two-ending adj.
glossary.προσαυδάτω: προσαυδάω — address, speak to; pres. imper. 3 sg., in a prohibition after μή: ’let not … address’
glossary.πτόλις: πόλις — city; fem. nom. sg., epic πτόλις (= Attic πόλις)
glossary.πόλιες: πόλις — city; fem. nom. pl., epic (= Attic πόλεις)
glossary.σάμηνδ: Σάμη — Same, an island; acc. + -δε ’to Same’, elided σάμηνδε
glossary.σιδῶνος: Σιδών — Sidon, a Phoenician city; fem. gen. sg.
glossary.στυγερὴ: στυγερός — hateful, loathsome; fem. nom. sg., agreeing with νοῦσος
glossary.συρίη: Συρίη — Syrie, an island (location uncertain); fem. nom. sg.
glossary.τάφιοι: Τάφιος — Taphian, of the Taphians (a seafaring raiding people); masc. nom. pl.
glossary.τανυπέπλῳ: τανύπεπλος — long-robed, with trailing robe; fem. dat. sg., two-ending adj., agreeing with Κτιμένῃ
glossary.τερπομένοισιν: τέρπω — delight, please; pres. part. mid. masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις): ’for those taking pleasure’
glossary.τροπαὶ: τροπή — turning; fem. nom. pl.: ’turnings’ (of the sun; sense disputed)
glossary.τροχόωντα: τροχάω — run; pres. part. act. masc. acc. sg., epic -όωντα (= Attic τροχῶντα)
glossary.τρῶκται: τρώκτης — gnawer, nibbler, hence trader, rogue (sense disputed); masc. nom. pl.
glossary.τυτθὸς: τυτθός — small, little; masc. nom. sg., epic
glossary.τῇσιν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); fem. dat. pl., epic (= Attic ταῖς): ’them’ · also fem. dat. pl. ’at them, at which’, of the mills (τῇσιν … ἐπερρώοντο γυναῖκες ’at which the women worked’)
glossary.φοίνισσ: Φοίνισσα — Phoenician (woman); fem. nom. sg. adj., elided φοίνισσα
glossary.ἀέξουσιν: ἀέξω — make grow, increase; pres. 3 pl., epic (= Attic αὐξάνω)
glossary.ἀγαγόντες: ἄγω — lead, bring; aor. part. act. masc. nom. pl. (aor. ἤγαγον)
glossary.ἀγρόνδ: ἀγρόνδε — to the field, to the country; adv. with -δε, elided
glossary.ἀγρόνδε: ἀγρόνδε — to the field, to the country; adv. with -δε of motion toward
glossary.ἀγυιῇ: ἀγυιά — street; fem. dat. sg., Ionic -ῃ (= Attic -ᾷ)
glossary.ἀεὶ: ἀεί — always, ever; adv. (epic also αἰεί)
glossary.ἀθέσφατοι: ἀθέσφατος — immense, beyond telling (traditional gloss, uncertain); fem. nom. pl. (adj. of two endings), agreeing with νύκτες
glossary.ἀθύρματα: ἄθυρμα — plaything, trinket; neut. acc. pl.
glossary.ἀνήρπαξαν: ἀναρπάζω — snatch away, carry off; aor. 3 pl.
glossary.ἀνίη: ἀνίη — grief, irksomeness, tedium; fem. nom. sg., Ionic (= Attic ἀνία)
glossary.ἀνακτορίῃσιν: ἀνακτόριος — of the lord, the master’s; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσιν (= Attic -αις), agreeing with ὕεσσιν
glossary.ἀπάξειν: ἀπάγω — lead away, take home; fut. inf. act.
glossary.ἀποφθιμένη: ἀποφθίνω — perish, die; aor. part. mid. fem. nom. sg. (aor. ἀπεφθίμην)
glossary.ἀρύβαντος: Ἀρύβας — Arybas, a man’s name (the Sidonian woman’s father); masc. gen. sg.
glossary.ἀφνειοὶ: ἀφνειός — rich, wealthy; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἀχέουσά: ἀχέω — grieve, be distressed; pres. part. act. fem. nom. sg., epic (accent from the enclitic περ)
glossary.ἄγοιμ: ἄγω — lead, bring; pres. opt. 1 sg., elided ἄγοιμι, potential with κεν: ’I would bring’
glossary.ἄλφοι: ἀλφάνω — earn, fetch (a price); aor. opt. 3 sg., potential with κεν: ’he would earn’ · also aor. opt. 3 sg. in a purpose clause after ἵνα, with no κεν: ’may bring in’ (ἵνα μοι βίοτον πολὺν ἄλφοι)
glossary.ἐθέλοιτέ: ἐθέλω — wish, be willing; pres. opt. 2 pl., in a condition after εἰ (accent from the enclitic γε)
glossary.ἐθέλουσά: ἐθέλω — wish, be willing; pres. part. act. fem. nom. sg. (accent from the enclitic γε)
glossary.ἐκείνη: ἐκεῖνος — that; demonstrative pron., fem. nom. sg.: ’that woman’
glossary.ἐμίσγετο: μίσγω — mix, mingle; impf. mid. 3 sg., + dat.: ’lay with’, epic (= Attic ἐμείγνυτο)
glossary.ἐμβασίλευε: ἐμβασιλεύω — be king in, rule over; impf. 3 sg., + dat.
glossary.ἐξείπῃ: ἐξαγορεύω — speak out, tell; aor. subj. 3 sg. (aor. ἐξεῖπον), after μή: ’lest he tell’
glossary.ἐξελθών: ἐξέρχομαι — go out; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἐπέρασσαν: περάω — sell (abroad); aor. 3 pl., with -σσ- (= Attic ἐπέρασαν)
glossary.ἐπίβαθρον: ἐπίβαθρον — fare for boarding, passage-money; neut. acc. sg.
glossary.ἐπαληθῇ: ἐπαλάομαι — wander about; aor. subj. 3 sg., passive form with active sense, after ὅς τις
glossary.ἐπείγετε: ἐπείγω — press, hasten; pres. imper. act. 2 pl.
glossary.ἐπιδεύομαι: ἐπιδεύομαι — lack, be in want of; pres. 1 sg. mid., + gen.
glossary.ἐπιείκελος: ἐπιείκελος — resembling, like; masc. nom. sg., epic, + dat.
glossary.ἐπιφράσσετ: ἐπιφράζομαι — devise, plan against; 3 sg. mid., elided ἐπιφράσσεται (fut. or short-vowel subj.), after μή, + dat. of person
glossary.ἐσέρχεται: εἰσέρχομαι — go in, enter; pres. 3 sg., Ionic ἐσ- (= Attic εἰσ-)
glossary.ἐτρεφόμην: τρέφω — rear, nourish; impf. pass. 1 sg.: ’I was being reared’
glossary.ἑπέσθω: ἕπομαι — follow; aor. imper. mid. 3 sg., + dat.: ’let him follow’
glossary.ἔρδοι: ἔρδω — do, perform; pres. opt. 3 sg., epic (= Attic ῥέζοι, δρῴη)
glossary.ἔφαγόν: ἐσθίω — eat; aor. 1 sg. (aor. ἔφαγον; accent from the enclitic τε)
glossary.ἔχετ: ἔχω — have, hold, keep; pres. imper. 2 pl., elided ἔχετε
glossary.ἕποιο: ἕπομαι — follow; pres. opt. 2 sg. mid., potential with κε: ’would you follow’
glossary.ἠπεροπεύει: ἠπεροπεύω — deceive, beguile; pres. 3 sg., epic
glossary.ἠπερόπευον: ἠπεροπεύω — deceive, beguile; impf. 3 pl., epic
glossary.ἤκαχ: ἀκαχίζω — grieve, distress; aor. 3 sg., elided ἤκαχε (reduplicated aor.), + acc.
glossary.ἧσσον: ἥσσων — less, weaker; neut. acc. sg. as adv. ’less’, Ionic (= Attic ἧττον)
glossary.ἱκέσθω: ἱκνέομαι — come, reach; aor. imper. mid. 3 sg.: ’let it come’
glossary.ὀρμενίδης: Ὀρμενίδης — son of Ormenus; masc. nom. sg., patronymic
glossary.ὀρτυγίης: Ὀρτυγίη — Ortygia, an island; fem. gen. sg., with καθύπερθεν
glossary.ὀϊσάμενος: ὀΐω — suppose, suspect; aor. part. mid. masc. nom. sg. (aor. ὀϊσάμην), epic
glossary.ὑποχείριος: ὑποχείριος — under one’s hand, within reach; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ὠμῷ: ὠμός — raw, harsh, cruel; neut. dat. sg., agreeing with γήραϊ
glossary.ῥυδὸν: ῥυδόν — in a flood, abundantly; adv. (sense uncertain)
glossary.αἰθέρι: αἰθήρ — upper air, bright sky; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.αὐλήν: αὐλή — courtyard, enclosed yard; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.βίον: βίος — life, way of living; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.βασιλεύτερον: βασιλεύτερος — more kingly, more royal; neut. nom. sg., comparative, agreeing with γένος
glossary.βαῖνον: βαίνω — go, step; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented (= Attic ἔβαινον)
glossary.γαμέειν: γαμέω — marry (of a man); pres. inf., uncontracted (= Attic γαμεῖν)
glossary.γνοίης: γιγνώσκω — come to know, recognise; aor. opt. 2 sg., potential after κε: ’you would come to know’
glossary.δέπα: δέπας — drinking-cup; neut. acc. pl., epic
glossary.δήμοιό: δῆμος — people, community; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.δεῖπνόν: δεῖπνον — meal, main meal; neut. acc. sg., accented before an enclitic
glossary.δουρικλυτὸς: δουρικλυτός — famed for the spear (δόρυ + κλυτός); masc. nom. sg., epithet
glossary.εἰναλίη: εἰνάλιος — of the sea, sea-dwelling; fem. nom. sg., epic with lengthened first syllable (= Attic ἐνάλιος)
glossary.εὐρύμαχον: Εὐρύμαχος — Eurymachus, a leading suitor, son of Polybus; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.εὔμαι: Εὔμαιος — Eumaeus, the swineherd; masc. voc. sg., elided (Εὔμαι’ = Εὔμαιε)
glossary.ζώεις: ζώω — live; pres. 2 sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic ζῇς)
glossary.θῶκον: θῶκος — seat, session (of an assembly); masc. acc. sg.
glossary.κάτειμι: κατέρχομαι — go down; pres. 1 sg. of κάτ-ειμι (εἶμι), with future sense: ’I shall go down’
glossary.κήξ: κήξ — a sea-bird, perhaps shearwater or gull (identity uncertain); nom. sg.
glossary.καδδραθέτην: καταδαρθάνω — fall asleep; aor. 3 dual, κατά assimilated to καδ- before δ, unaugmented (= Attic κατεδραθέτην)
glossary.καννεύσας: κατανεύω — nod; aor. part. masc. nom. sg., κατά assimilated to καν- before ν
glossary.καρτεροὶ: καρτερός — strong, powerful; masc. nom. pl., epic (= Attic κρατεροί)
glossary.κατακρύψασ: κατακρύπτω — hide away, conceal; aor. part. fem. nom. sg., elided (κατακρύψασ’ = κατακρύψασα)
glossary.κελοίμην: κέλομαι — bid, urge; pres. opt. 1 sg. mid., potential after ἄν: ’I would bid’
glossary.κερῶντό: κεράννυμι — mix; impf. mid. 3 pl., epic κεράομαι contracted (= Attic ἐκεράννυντο): ’mixed for themselves’
glossary.κλυτίδη: Κλυτίδης — son of Clytius; masc. voc. sg., patronymic
glossary.κοίλη: κοῖλος — hollow; fem. nom. sg., standing epithet of ships
glossary.κομιῶ: κομίζω — take care of, look after; fut. 1 sg., contracted (= κομίσω)
glossary.κόλπῳ: κόλπος — bosom, fold of a garment; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.λύον: λύω — loose, untie; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented (= Attic ἔλυον)
glossary.μέμονέν: μέμονα — be eager, have in mind; perf. with pres. sense, 3 sg., ν-movable, accented before an enclitic
glossary.μίμνοι: μίμνω — stay, wait (reduplicated epic form of μένω); pres. opt., agreeing with σύ, 2 sg. (the form is -οι for -οις)
glossary.μίνυνθα: μίνυνθα — for a little while, briefly; adv.
glossary.μακαρίζοι: μακαρίζω — call blessed, congratulate; pres. opt. 3 sg., in a purpose clause after ὡς ἄν
glossary.μνηστῆρσ: μνηστήρ — suitor; masc. dat. pl., elided epic (μνηστῆρσ’ = μνηστῆρσι)
glossary.μυρίαι: μυρίος — countless, numberless; fem. nom. pl.
glossary.νὼ: ἐγώ — I; dual νώ, nom./acc.: ’we two, us two’
glossary.ξενίων: ξένιον — gift of hospitality, hospitable entertainment; neut. gen. pl. (usually ξένια)
glossary.οἰωνὸν: οἰωνός — bird of omen, bird of prey; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.πέλειαν: πέλεια — dove, rock-pigeon; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.παραθείμην: παρατίθημι — set beside, set before; aor. opt. mid. 1 sg., potential after κε: ’I would set before’ · also opt. in a past general clause after ἐπεί, without κε: ’whenever I had set (torches) beside’
glossary.πείθῃ: πείθομαι — obey, heed (+ dat.); pres. ind. mid. 2 sg. (the uncontracted form is πείθεαι)
glossary.πείραιε: Πείραιος — Peiraeus, son of Clytius, Telemachus’s companion; masc. voc. sg.
glossary.πείραιον: Πείραιος — Peiraeus, son of Clytius, Telemachus’s companion; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.πείραιος: Πείραιος — Peiraeus, son of Clytius, Telemachus’s companion; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.πεσοῦσ: πίπτω — fall; aor. part. fem. nom. sg., elided (πεσοῦσ’ = πεσοῦσα)
glossary.πιστὸν: πιστός — faithful, trusty; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ποθή: ποθή — longing, want, need (+ gen.); fem. nom. sg. (same word as ποθὴ, accented before a pause)
glossary.πολύϊδρις: πολύϊδρις — knowing much, shrewd (πολύς + ἴδρις); masc. nom. sg., two-ending adj.
glossary.προέρυσσαν: προερύω — drag forward, haul down; aor. 3 pl., epic -σσ- (= Attic προήρυσαν)
glossary.προβιβάντα: προβιβάω — stride forward; pres. part. masc. acc. sg., epic (= Attic προβαίνοντα)
glossary.πρόμολον: προβλώσκω — go forth, come forward; aor. 3 pl., unaugmented (= Attic προὔμολον)
glossary.πῆ: πῆ — where? whither? interrog. adv., of motion (Attic ποῖ)
glossary.σοῖο: σός — your, yours; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic σοῦ)
glossary.συναντόμενος: συναντάομαι — meet, encounter; pres. part. mid. masc. nom. sg., epic (= Attic συναντώμενος)
glossary.τίλλε: τίλλω — pluck, tear; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= Attic ἔτιλλε)
glossary.τελευτήσει: τελευτάω — accomplish, bring to pass; fut. 3 sg. (or short-vowel aor. subj. after κε); trans. ’will bring about’ or intrans. ’will come to pass’
glossary.τεῦ: τίς — who? whose?; interrog. pron., gen. sg., epic (= Attic τίνος)
glossary.τιέμεν: τίω — honour, esteem; pres. inf., epic -έμεν (= Attic τιμᾶν)
glossary.τρί: τρεῖς — three; neut. acc. pl., elided (τρί’ = τρία)
glossary.φιλότητά: φιλότης — friendship, affection; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.φώκῃσι: φώκη — seal; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι (= Attic -αις)
glossary.χεῖρον: χείρων — worse; comparative adj., neut. nom./acc. sg. (of κακός)
glossary.ἀεσιφροσύνῃσι: ἀεσιφροσύνη — witlessness, folly (ἀεσι- of uncertain origin); fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι (= Attic -αις)
glossary.ἀμφαφόωντο: ἀμφαφάω — handle, feel all over; impf. mid. 3 pl., unaugmented, uncontracted (= Attic ἠμφαφῶντο)
glossary.ἀμφεπένοντο: ἀμφιπένομαι — busy oneself about, attend to; impf. mid. 3 pl., augmented
glossary.ἀνάκτεσιν: ἄναξ — lord, master; masc. dat. pl., epic -εσιν (= Attic ἀνάκτεσι)
glossary.ἀναβησάμενοι: ἀναβαίνω — go up; aor. mid. part. masc. nom. pl., transitive: ’having taken aboard’ (= Attic ἀναβιβασάμενοι)
glossary.ἀνώσαντες: ἀνωθέω — push up, push off; aor. part. act. masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἀπέσσομαι: ἄπειμι (εἰμί) — be away, be absent; fut. 1 sg. mid., epic -σσ- (= Attic ἀπέσομαι)
glossary.ἄλεισα: ἄλεισον — goblet, cup; neut. acc. pl.
glossary.ἄντλῳ: ἄντλος — bilge, bilge-water in the hold; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.ἐΰθρονος: ἐΰθρονος — fair-throned, with a beautiful seat; fem. nom. sg., two-ending adj., epithet of Dawn
glossary.ἐμπολόωντο: ἐμπολάω — get by trading, barter for; impf. mid. 3 pl., unaugmented, uncontracted (= Attic ἠμπολῶντο)
glossary.ἐνίαυεν: ἐνιαύω — sleep in, spend the night; impf. 3 sg., ν-movable
glossary.ἐνδούπησε: ἐνδουπέω — fall with a thud, thud; aor. 3 sg.
glossary.ἐντύνοντο: ἐντύνω — make ready, prepare; impf. mid. 3 pl., unaugmented: ’they prepared’
glossary.ἐξῆγε: ἐξάγω — lead out; impf. 3 sg., augmented (ἐξ- + ἦγε)
glossary.ἐπιείσομαι: ἐπέρχομαι — go to, visit; fut. 1 sg. mid., from the εἶμι stem (ἐπι- + εἴσομαι)
glossary.ἔερτο: εἴρω (ἐείρω) — string, fasten in a row; plpf. pass. 3 sg., epic: ’was strung’
glossary.ἔκφερεν: ἐκφέρω — carry out; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented, ν-movable (= Attic ἐξέφερε)
glossary.ἔραζε: ἔραζε — to the ground, earthward; adv., ἔρα + directional -ζε
glossary.ἕλον: αἱρέω — take, take down; aor. 3 pl., epic (= Attic εἷλον)
glossary.ἠλέκτροισιν: ἤλεκτρον — amber; neut. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις)
glossary.ἠπίου: ἤπιος — gentle, kindly; masc. gen. sg., agreeing with ἀνδρός
glossary.ἡμέτερόνδε: ἡμέτερος — our; adv. with -δε of motion toward: ’to our house’ (neut. acc. sg. + -δε)
glossary.ἧκαν: ἵημι — send, dispatch; aor. 3 pl. (the κ-aorist ἧκα; Attic has εἷσαν)
glossary.ἴαλλεν: ἰάλλω — send forth, hurl; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented, ν-movable (≈ Attic ἔπεμπε)
glossary.ὁδοιπόριον: ὁδοιπόριον — provision for a journey, road-supplies; neut. acc. sg.
glossary.ὁρῶντο: ὁράω — see, look at; impf. mid. 3 pl., unaugmented (= Attic ἑωρῶντο)
glossary.ὅρμον: ὅρμος — necklace (from εἴρω ’string’); masc. acc. sg. · also ὅρμος — anchorage, roadstead (cf. ὁρμίζω ’bring to anchor’); masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ὑμετέρου: ὑμέτερος — your (pl.), yours; masc./neut. gen. sg., standing alone: ’than yours’
glossary.ὑπερωΐῳ: ὑπερώϊον — upper room, upper storey; neut. dat. sg., epic with diaeresis
glossary.ὑπισχόμεναι: ὑπισχνέομαι — promise, offer; pres. part. mid. fem. nom. pl.
glossary.ὕες: ὗς — pig, swine; masc./fem. nom. pl.
glossary.αἰδομένη: αἰδέομαι — feel shame before, show respect for; pres. part. mid., fem. nom. sg., epic (= Attic αἰδουμένη)
glossary.αἰνόν: αἰνός — dread, grim, terrible; neut. nom. sg., epic
glossary.γνώριμος: γνώριμος — known, familiar; masc. nom. sg., ’an acquaintance’ as a noun
glossary.δαμασαίατο: δαμάζω — overpower, subdue; aor. opt. mid. 3 pl., epic -αίατο (= Attic δαμάσαιντο)
glossary.διαφυσσόμενον: διαφύσσω — draw off, drain out (wine); pres. part. mid., masc. acc. sg.
glossary.δινηθῆναι: δινέω — whirl; pass. be whirled about, roam; aor. inf. pass.: ’to have roamed’
glossary.δμῳάς: δμῳή — female slave, maidservant (Attic δούλη); fem. acc. pl.
glossary.εἰσορόων: εἰσοράω — look upon, gaze at; pres. part. masc. nom. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic εἰσορῶν)
glossary.εἴρητο: ἐρῶ (perf. εἴρημαι) — say, speak; plpf. pass. 3 sg.: ’had been said’
glossary.εἴσελθε: εἰσέρχομαι — go in, come in; aor. imper. 2 sg.
glossary.εὐνὴ: εὐνή — bed, marriage-bed; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.εὔαδε: ἁνδάνω — please; aor. 3 sg., epic with augment fused to the lost digamma (= Attic ἥνδανε/ἤρεσε)
glossary.εὔμαιον: Εὔμαιος — Eumaeus, the swineherd; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.θήν: θήν — surely, indeed; epic enclitic particle (= Attic δήπου)
glossary.θεοειδέα: θεοειδής — godlike, of godlike form; masc. acc. sg., uncontracted (= Attic θεοειδῆ)
glossary.θυμαλγὲς: θυμαλγής — heart-grieving, painful; neut. nom./acc. sg.
glossary.καταδάπτετ: καταδάπτω — tear apart, rend, devour; pres. 2 pl., elided (καταδάπτετ’ = καταδάπτετε)
glossary.καταθήσει: κατατίθημι — put down, set down; fut. 3 sg.
glossary.κατακτάμενος: κατακτείνω — kill; syncopated aor. part. (κατεκτάμην), masc. nom. sg., passive sense: ’slain’ (= Attic κατακτανθείς)
glossary.κατατρύχῃ: κατατρύχω — wear out, consume; pres. subj. 3 sg., after ὡς ἂν μή
glossary.κείνοισι: κεῖνος — that, that one; demonstrative pron., masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic ἐκείνοις)
glossary.κερτομέωσιν: κερτομέω — taunt, mock, insult; pres. subj. 3 pl., uncontracted (= Attic κερτομῶσιν)
glossary.κηαμένω: καίω — kindle, burn; aor. part. mid., masc. nom. dual, epic κηα- (= Attic καυσαμένω)
glossary.κιρνὰς: κίρνημι — mix (wine with water); pres. part. masc. nom. sg., by-form of κεράννυμι
glossary.κομίζῃ: κομίζω — take care of, tend; pres. subj. 3 sg.
glossary.κτύπος: κτύπος — crash, thud, din; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.κόμισσον: κομίζω — take care of, entertain; aor. imper. 2 sg., epic double σ (= Attic κόμισον)
glossary.κύσεν: κυνέω — kiss; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented, ν-movable (= ἔκυσε)
glossary.κύσσε: κυνέω — kiss; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented, epic double σ (= ἔκυσε)
glossary.κῶας: κῶας — fleece, sheepskin; neut. acc. sg. (Attic κῴδιον)
glossary.λάϊνον: λάϊνος — of stone, stone; masc. acc. sg., epic (= Attic λίθινος)
glossary.μένῃ: μένω — stay, remain; pres. subj. 3 sg., in an indirect deliberative clause after ἢ … ἢ ’whether … or’
glossary.μαρναμένοισι: μάρναμαι — fight; pres. part. mid., masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic μαρναμένοις)
glossary.μνᾶται: μνάομαι — woo, court; pres. 3 sg. mid.
glossary.μογήσῃ: μογέω — toil, suffer hardship; aor. subj. 3 sg., in a simile without ἄν/κε
glossary.μὰψ: μάψ — idly, to no purpose, recklessly; adv.
glossary.νομῆας: νομεύς — herdsman; masc. acc. pl., epic -ῆας (= Attic νομέας)
glossary.οἷσί: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (relative) — who, which; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic οἷς), accented before the enclitic περ; dat. after πέποιθε ’trusts in’ · also accented before the enclitic τε, dat. of interest: ’whose’ (οἷσί τε τέκνα ’whose young’)
glossary.πέποιθα: πείθω — persuade; perf. πέποιθα, with present sense: trust, rely on (+ dat.); 1 sg.
glossary.πέποιθε: πείθω — persuade; perf. πέποιθε, with present sense: trust, rely on (+ dat.); 3 sg.
glossary.παρενήνεεν: παρανηνέω — heap up beside, pile up; impf. 3 sg., epic uncontracted -εεν (= Attic -ει), reduplicated stem (cf. ἐπενήνεον)
glossary.περίσσαινον: περισσαίνω — fawn around, wag the tail round; impf. 3 pl., epic doubled σ (= Attic περιέσαινον)
glossary.περισσαίνουσι: περισσαίνω — fawn around, wag the tail round; pres. 3 pl., epic doubled σ
glossary.περιφύς: περιφύω — grow round, throw oneself about, cling to; aor. 2 part. (περιέφυν) masc. nom. sg.: ’clinging round’
glossary.πλαζόμενος: πλάζω — drive astray; pass. wander, roam; pres. part. mid./pass., masc. nom. sg.
glossary.πλεόνεσσιν: πολύς — much, many; comparative πλείων ’more, several’, masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσιν (= Attic πλείοσιν)
glossary.ποδοῖϊν: πούς — foot; gen. dual, epic -οῖϊν (= Attic ποδοῖν): ’of the two feet’
glossary.προσιόντα: πρόσειμι (εἶμι) — go to, approach; pres. part. masc. acc. sg.: ’approaching’
glossary.πρότερος: πρότερος — before, first, earlier; masc. nom. sg., predicative: ’first (to)’
glossary.σαίνοντάς: σαίνω — wag the tail, fawn on; pres. part. masc. acc. pl., with a second accent on the last syllable before the enclitic τε
glossary.σταθμόν: σταθμός — steading, farm-building, stall; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.στυφελιζομένους: στυφελίζω — strike roughly, buffet, abuse; pres. part. pass., masc. acc. pl.
glossary.τάμοι: τέμνω — cut; aor. opt. 3 sg., epic strong aor. (= Attic τέμοι)
glossary.τέρψομαι: τέρπω — delight, gladden; mid. take pleasure; 1 sg. fut. or short-vowel aor. subj. mid.: ’I shall (may) take my pleasure’
glossary.ταφὼν: τέθηπα — be astounded; aor. part. ταφών (ἔταφον), masc. nom. sg.: ’astounded’
glossary.τεθνάμεν: θνῄσκω — die; perf. inf. ’to be dead’, epic -μεν (= Attic τεθνάναι)
glossary.τηλύγετον: τηλύγετος — late-born, or on another view tenderly loved (meaning disputed); masc. acc. sg.
glossary.τοιούτου: τοιοῦτος — such, of such a kind; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.φάεα: φάος — light; pl. ’eyes’ (lights); neut. acc. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic φῶτα)
glossary.φατε: φημί — say, speak; pres. 2 pl. (Attic φατέ): ’you say’
glossary.φυγόντα: φεύγω — flee, escape; aor. part. masc. acc. sg.
glossary.χήτει: χῆτος — want, lack, need; neut. dat. sg., ’for want of’ + gen.
glossary.χλωρὰς: χλωρός — green, fresh; fem. acc. pl.
glossary.ἀΐδηλον: ἀΐδηλος — destructive, baneful (exact sense debated); masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀγαπάζῃ: ἀγαπάζω — welcome gladly, greet with affection; pres. subj. 3 sg., epic by-form of ἀγαπάω, in a simile without ἄν/κε
glossary.ἀγρὸν: ἀγρός — field, farmland, country; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀκούοντος: ἀκούω — hear; pres. part. masc. gen. sg., agreeing with the pronoun μευ: ’as I listen’
glossary.ἀλλότριος: ἀλλότριος — of another, foreign, strange; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀνηνύστῳ: ἀνήνυστος — unaccomplished, endless; neut. dat. sg.
glossary.ἀντίος: ἀντίος — opposite, facing, to meet (+ gen.); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀπαμύνασθαι: ἀπαμύνω — ward off; mid. defend oneself against, keep off; aor. inf. mid.
glossary.ἀποδρὰς: ἀποδιδράσκω — run away, escape; aor. part. masc. nom. sg. (ἀπέδραν)
glossary.ἀτέλεστον: ἀτέλεστος — unfulfilled, without result, endless; neut. acc. sg.
glossary.ἄττα: ἄττα — father; voc. sg., a respectful address by a younger man to an older one, carrying no kinship
glossary.ἐγγυαλίξω: ἐγγυαλίζω — put into the hands of, hand over; fut. 1 sg., epic
glossary.ἐμοῖσι: ἐμός — my, mine; masc./neut. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic ἐμοῖς)
glossary.ἐνευναίων: ἐνευναῖος — lying in (a bed); as noun, one who lies in it, bedfellow; masc. gen. pl.; a rare word, sense taken from its formation
glossary.ἐπέκλωσεν: ἐπικλώθω — spin to, assign by fate (of the Fates’ thread); aor. 3 sg.
glossary.ἐπέρχεαι: ἐπέρχομαι — come to, visit; pres. 2 sg. mid., epic -εαι (= Attic ἐπέρχῃ)
glossary.ἐπιδημεύεις: ἐπιδημεύω — be among the people, stay in town; pres. 2 sg.
glossary.ἐπιμέμφεαι: ἐπιμέμφομαι — blame, find fault with (+ dat.); pres. 2 sg., epic -εαι (= Attic ἐπιμέμφῃ)
glossary.ἐπιόντι: ἐπέρχομαι — come up to, approach; pres. part. (ἐπιών) masc. dat. sg.
glossary.ἐπονεῖτο: πονέομαι — toil, be busy with; impf. 3 sg. mid.
glossary.ἐρήτυε: ἐρητύω — hold back, restrain; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἠρήτυε)
glossary.ἐρύξας: ἐρύκω — keep, hold back, detain; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἐσορᾶν: εἰσοράω — look upon, behold; pres. inf., epic ἐσ- (= Attic εἰσορᾶν)
glossary.ἐῷμι: ἐάω — let, allow; pres. opt. 1 sg., epic (= Attic ἐῴην)
glossary.ἔκπεμψάν: ἐκπέμπω — send out; aor. 3 pl., ν-movable, with a second accent before the enclitic τε
glossary.ἔργῳ: ἔργον — deed, work, task; neut. dat. sg.
glossary.ἕδρην: ἕδρη — seat; fem. acc. sg., Ionic η
glossary.ἕδρης: ἕδρη — seat; fem. gen. sg., Ionic η, gen. of separation with ὑπόειξεν
glossary.ἕπηται: ἕπομαι — follow, accompany; pres. subj. 3 sg.
glossary.ἧσ: ἧμαι — sit; pres. imper. 2 sg., elided (ἧσ’ = ἧσο)
glossary.ἴεν: εἶμι — go; impf. 3 sg., epic (= Attic ᾔει)
glossary.ἴφθιμον: ἴφθιμος — stout, strong, mighty; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ὀπταλέων: ὀπταλέος — roasted, broiled; neut. gen. pl., agreeing with κρειῶν
glossary.ὁράασθαι: ὁράω — see, look upon; pres. inf. mid., uncontracted, diectasis (= Attic ὁρᾶσθαι)
glossary.ὄρηται: ὄρνυμι — rouse; mid. rise, arise; aor. subj. 3 sg. mid., without ἄν/κε after εἰ · also aor. subj. 3 sg. mid. in a purpose clause after ἵνα μή: ’may arise’
glossary.ὄψεσθαι: ὁράω — see; fut. inf. mid. (ὄψομαι), after ἐφάμην
glossary.ὑλάουσιν: ὑλάω — bark; pres. 3 pl., uncontracted (= Attic ὑλῶσιν)
glossary.ὑπέλειπον: ὑπολείπω — leave behind, leave over; impf. 3 pl.
glossary.ὑποδέξομαι: ὑποδέχομαι — receive as a guest, welcome; fut. 1 sg.
glossary.ὑπόειξεν: ὑπείκω — yield, give way; aor. 3 sg., epic (= Attic ὑπεῖξε)
glossary.ὕλαον: ὑλάω — bark; impf. 3 pl., uncontracted (= Attic ὕλων)
glossary.ᾤχεο: οἴχομαι — be gone, go off; impf. 2 sg., epic -εο (= Attic ᾤχου)
glossary.ῥυστάζοντας: ῥυστάζω — drag about, handle roughly; pres. part. masc. acc. pl.
glossary.αὐτάγρετα: αὐτάγρετος — self-chosen, to be had for the choosing (rare word); neut. nom. pl.: ’(all things) of one’s own choice’
glossary.γενειάδες: γενειάς — beard, beard-hair; fem. nom. pl.
glossary.γιγνώσκω: γιγνώσκω — come to know, recognise, understand; pres. 1 sg.: ’I know’
glossary.γναθμοὶ: γναθμός — jaw, cheek; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.δησάμενος: δέω — bind, tie; aor. part. mid., masc. nom. sg.: ’having bound (on for himself)’
glossary.δώομεν: δίδωμι — give; aor. subj. 1 pl., epic lengthened vowel (= Attic δῶμεν): ’we may give’
glossary.εὔμαιος: Εὔμαιος — Eumaeus, the swineherd; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.θάμβησε: θαμβέω — be amazed, astonished (at); aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐθάμβησε)
glossary.θαυμάζειν: θαυμάζω — marvel, wonder (at); pres. inf. act.
glossary.θνητὸν: θνητός — mortal, subject to death; masc. acc. sg., agreeing with βροτόν
glossary.θνητὸς: θνητός — mortal, subject to death; masc. nom. sg., agreeing with ἀνήρ
glossary.κίεν: κίω — go, go one’s way; impf. 3 sg., epic unaugmented (= ἔκιεν): ’went’
glossary.κακῶσαι: κακόω — maltreat, afflict, bring low; aor. inf. act.
glossary.κνυζηθμῷ: κνυζηθμός — whining, whimpering; masc. dat. sg., instrumental: ’with a whine’
glossary.κυάνεαι: κυάνεος — dark, dark-blue; fem. nom. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic κυαναῖ)
glossary.κυδῆναι: κυδαίνω — glorify, exalt, give honour to; aor. inf. act.
glossary.λῆθεν: λανθάνω — escape the notice of (+ acc.); aor. 3 sg., epic unaugmented (= ἔλαθεν)
glossary.μελαγχροιὴς: μελαγχροιής — dark-skinned, swarthy; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.μηχανόῳτο: μηχανάομαι — contrive, devise; pres. opt. mid. 3 sg., epic uncontracted -όῳτο (= Attic μηχανῷτο), potential with ἄν: ’could devise’
glossary.μούνωσε: μονόω — make single, leave alone; aor. 3 sg., epic μούνωσε (= Attic ἐμόνωσε), unaugmented
glossary.νεῦσε: νεύω — nod; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔνευσε)
glossary.νοέοντι: νοέω — perceive, understand; pres. part. act., masc. dat. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic νοοῦντι): ’to one who understands’
glossary.νωλεμὲς: νωλεμής — unceasing, unbroken; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’unceasingly, without a break’
glossary.οἴῃ: οἶος — alone, only; fem. dat. sg. (= Attic μόνῃ): ’to her alone’
glossary.οὐκέθ: οὐκέτι — no longer, no more; adv., elided (οὐκέθ’ = οὐκέτι)
glossary.πάροιθ: πάροιθε(ν) — before, in front of; prep. + gen., elided (πάροιθ’ = πάροιθεν): ’before (her)’
