glossary.περιώσιον: περιώσιος — beyond measure, excessive; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’exceedingly’
glossary.πευθέσθω: πυνθάνομαι — learn, hear of, inquire; aor. imper. mid. 3 sg., epic πευθ- grade (= Attic πυθέσθω): ’let him learn’
glossary.πλάζεσθαι: πλάζω — drive astray; pass. wander, roam; pres. inf. pass.: ’to wander’
glossary.πᾶς: πᾶς, πᾶσα, πᾶν — all, whole, every; masc. nom. sg., with a noun: ’the whole (land)’
glossary.στεναχίζων: στεναχίζω — groan, lament; pres. part. masc. nom. sg., epic (= Attic στενάζων)
glossary.στοναχῇ: στοναχή — groaning, sighing; fem. dat. sg., instrumental: ’with groaning’
glossary.συφορβόν: συφορβός — swineherd (= ὑφορβός); masc. acc. sg.
glossary.σφῶϊν: σύ (dual σφῶϊ) — you two; dual gen./dat. 2nd person, epic (= Attic σφῷν): ’from you two’
glossary.τάνυσθεν: τανύω — stretch, draw taut; aor. pass. 3 pl., epic unaugmented -σθεν (= Attic ἐτάθησαν): ’were drawn taut’
glossary.ταρβήσας: ταρβέω — be afraid, fear; aor. part. act., masc. nom. sg.: ’having been frightened’
glossary.τειχίον: τειχίον — little wall, low wall; neut. acc. sg.
glossary.τεκὼν: τίκτω — bear, beget; aor. part. act., masc. nom. sg.: ’having begotten’
glossary.φάνης: φαίνω — show; pass. appear, show oneself; aor. 2 pass. 2 sg., unaugmented (= ἐφάνης): ’you appeared’
glossary.φάο: φημί — say, speak; pres. imper. mid. 2 sg., epic (= Attic φάθι): ’speak!’
glossary.φανεῖσα: φαίνω — show; pass. appear; aor. 2 pass. part., fem. nom. sg.: ’appearing, having appeared’
glossary.φείδεο: φείδομαι — spare (+ gen.); pres. imper. mid. 2 sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic φείδου)
glossary.φθινύθει: φθινύθω — waste away, perish (epic lengthened form of φθίνω); pres. 3 sg. intransitive: ’wastes away’
glossary.φρονέω: φρονέω — think, have understanding, be minded; pres. 1 sg.: ’I understand’
glossary.φόβηθεν: φοβέω — frighten; pass. flee in fear; aor. pass. 3 pl., epic unaugmented -θεν (= Attic ἐφοβήθησαν): ’fled in fear’
glossary.χαλεπαίνει: χαλεπαίνω — be harsh, rage at (+ dat.); pres. 3 sg.
glossary.χαμᾶζε: χαμᾶζε — to the ground, down to earth; adv. (χαμαί + -δε)
glossary.χρύσεα: χρύσεος — golden; neut. acc. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic χρυσᾶ)
glossary.χρώς: χρώς — skin, flesh, the body’s surface; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.χρὼς: χρώς — skin, flesh, the body’s surface; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀγάασθαι: ἀγάομαι (ἄγαμαι) — wonder at, be amazed; pres. inf. mid., epic (= Attic ἄγασθαι)
glossary.ἀγγείλας: ἀγγέλλω — announce, report; aor. part. act., masc. nom. sg.: ’having reported’
glossary.ἀγελείης: ἀγελείη — driver of spoil, spoil-bringer (epithet of Athena); fem. gen. sg., epic (= ἀγελείας)
glossary.ἀλλοῖός: ἀλλοῖος — of another sort, different; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀντίθυρον: ἀντίθυρον — the space facing the door, doorway; neut. acc. sg., after κατά: ’over against the door’
glossary.ἀπαγγείλας: ἀπαγγέλλω — report back, announce; aor. part. act., masc. nom. sg.: ’having reported’
glossary.ἀπαγγείλειε: ἀπαγγέλλω — report back, announce; aor. opt. act. 3 sg., potential with κεν: ’she could report’
glossary.ἀραρόντε: ἀραρίσκω — fit together, join; aor. 2 part. act., masc. nom. dual, agreeing with the two addressed: ’(you two) having fitted’
glossary.ἀρκείσιος: Ἀρκείσιος — Arcesius, father of Laertes; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἐκεῖνον: ἐκεῖνος — that, that one; demonstrative pron., masc. acc. sg. (epic κεῖνος)
glossary.ἐναλίγκιον: ἐναλίγκιος — like, resembling (+ dat.); masc. acc. sg., agreeing with the speaker: ’like (a beggar)’ · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with the object ἄνακτα: ’like (a beggar)’ · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with the relative ὅν (subject of εἶναι), + dat.: ’like (the gods)’ (θεοῖς ἐναλίγκιον)
glossary.ἐπίκευθε: ἐπικεύθω — hide, conceal; pres. imper. act. 2 sg., in a prohibition with μηδέ: ’do not hide (it)’
glossary.ἐπείθετο: πείθω — persuade; mid. obey, be persuaded, believe; impf. mid. 3 sg.: ’was persuaded’
glossary.ἐπιμέμφομαι: ἐπιμέμφομαι — blame, find fault with (+ dat.); pres. 1 sg.
glossary.ἐποπτεύεσκε: ἐποπτεύω — oversee, look over; impf. 3 sg., iterative -εσκε: ’used to oversee’
glossary.ἐχέφρονι: ἐχέφρων — sound-minded, prudent; fem. dat. sg.
glossary.ἑλοίμεθα: αἱρέω — take; mid. choose; aor. opt. mid. 1 pl. (stem ἑλ-), potential with κεν: ’we would choose’ · also aor. opt. in a purpose clause after ὡς ἄν: ’we might seize’ (ὡς ἂν ἐπιθύσαντες ἑλοίμεθα ’so that, rushing in, we might seize’)
glossary.ἑτέρωσε: ἑτέρωσε — to the other side, to one side; adv.
glossary.ἔρξασα: ἔρδω (ῥέζω) — do, accomplish; aor. part. act., fem. nom. sg.: ’having done’
glossary.ἔρχησθον: ἔρχομαι — come, go; pres. subj. 2 dual, epic (= Attic ἴητον), in a purpose clause: ’you two may go’
glossary.ἔτεϊ: ἔτος — year; neut. dat. sg., epic (= Attic ἔτει)
glossary.ἔτικτε: τίκτω — bear, beget; impf. 3 sg. act.: ’begot’
glossary.ἔχοντι: ἔχω — have, hold, wear; pres. part. act., masc. dat. sg.: ’having, wearing’
glossary.ἕσσο: ἕννυμι — clothe; mid./pass. be clothed, wear; plpf. mid./pass. 2 sg., epic: ’you were clothed in’
glossary.ἤϊεν: εἶμι — go; impf. 3 sg., epic (= Attic ᾔει): ’went’
glossary.ἦσθ: ἧμαι — sit; impf. 3 sg., elided (ἦσθ’ for ἦστο): ’sat’
glossary.ἵληθ: ἵλημι (ἱλάσκομαι) — be gracious, be propitious; pres. imper. 2 sg., elided (ἵληθ’ = ἵληθι): ’be gracious!’
glossary.ὀστεόφι: ὀστέον — bone; neut. gen. pl., epic -φι suffix (= Attic ὀστῶν)
glossary.ὀτρυνέμεν: ὀτρύνω — urge on, send forth; pres. inf. act., epic -έμεν (= Attic ὀτρύνειν)
glossary.ὑλάοντο: ὑλάω — bark; impf. 3 pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ὑλῶντο), middle form
glossary.ὤφελλε: ὀφέλλω — increase, enlarge; impf. 3 sg. act.: ’increased’
glossary.ῥηΐδιον: ῥηΐδιος — easy; neut. nom. sg., epic (= Attic ῥᾴδιον), predicate: ’(it is) easy’
glossary.αἰχμητὴν: αἰχμητής — spearman, warrior; masc. acc. sg., predicate accusative with an infinitive
glossary.βάλλωσι: βάλλω — throw, strike; pres. subj. 3 pl. (Attic βάλλωσι(ν))
glossary.βέλεσι: βέλος — missile, dart; neut. dat. pl., instrumental: ’with missiles’
glossary.βοάγρια: βοάγριον — ox-hide shield (exact sense uncertain); neut. acc. pl.
glossary.βουλεύσωμεν: βουλεύω — plan, take counsel; aor. subj. 1 pl., in a purpose clause: ’that we may plan’
glossary.γαμψώνυχες: γαμψώνυξ — with crooked talons; adj., masc. nom. pl.
glossary.γνώομεν: γιγνώσκω — come to know, discern; aor. subj. 1 pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic γνῶμεν), hortative: ’let us find out’
glossary.δαήμονε: δαήμων — skilled, knowing (+ gen.); masc. nom. dual
glossary.δαιτροσυνάων: δαιτροσύνη — art of carving meat; fem. gen. pl., epic -άων (= Attic -ῶν), gen. of respect after δαήμων
glossary.δείδιε: δείδω — fear; perf. 3 sg. with present sense, epic δείδιε (= Attic δέδιε): ’he fears’
glossary.δεκὰς: δεκάς — a group of ten, a ten; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.διζησόμεθ: δίζημαι — seek, look for; fut. 1 pl. mid., elided (διζησόμεθ’ = διζησόμεθα); Attic ζητέω
glossary.δουλιχίοιο: Δουλίχιον — Dulichium, an island near Ithaca; neut. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.δρηστῆρες: δρηστήρ — servant, attendant; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.δυνησόμεθ: δύναμαι — be able, can; fut. 1 pl. mid., elided (δυνησόμεθ’ = δυνησόμεθα)
glossary.δύνασαί: δύναμαι — be able, can; pres. 2 sg. mid., accented before an enclitic
glossary.εἰδέω: οἶδα — know; subj. 1 sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic εἰδῶ), in a purpose clause after ὄφρα: ’that I may know’
glossary.εἰσί: εἰμί — be; pres. 3 pl. (Attic εἰσί(ν)): ’they are’
glossary.εἶβον: εἴβω — let fall in drops, pour; impf. 3 pl.; epic by-form of λείβω (= Attic ἔλειβον)
glossary.ζακύνθου: Ζάκυνθος — Zacynthus, an island near Ithaca; fem. gen. sg.
glossary.θέλξει: θέλγω — enchant, cast a spell over; fut. 3 sg.
glossary.θῇσιν: τίθημι — put, place; aor. subj. 3 sg., epic -σιν (= Attic θῇ), with ὁππότε κεν: ’whenever … shall put’
glossary.καθημένω: κάθημαι — sit, be seated; pres. part. masc. nom. dual mid.
glossary.καλλιπέειν: καταλείπω — leave behind; aor. inf., epic κάλλιπ- (κατα- shortened) with -έειν (= Attic καταλιπεῖν)
glossary.κατέθηκ: κατατίθημι — put away, lay by; aor. 1 sg., elided (κατέθηκ’ = κατέθηκα)
glossary.καταθεῖναι: κατατίθημι — put away, lay down; aor. inf.
glossary.καταισχύνητέ: καταισχύνω — disgrace, shame; pres. or aor. subj. 2 pl. (the forms coincide) after μή (’lest you … ’), accented before the enclitic τε
glossary.κατῄκισται: καταικίζω — disfigure, maltreat, spoil; perf. pass. 3 sg. (augmented, hence ῃ): ’has been spoiled’
glossary.κείνω: κεῖνος — that one, he; demonstrative pron., masc. nom. dual, epic (= Attic ἐκείνω): ’those two’
glossary.κεκριμένοι: κρίνω — pick out, choose; perf. part. pass. masc. nom. pl.: ’picked men’
glossary.κρίνηται: κρίνω — decide, settle; pres. subj. 3 sg. pass. with ὁπότε: ’is decided’
glossary.κρατέουσι: κρατέω — rule, hold sway (over); pres. 3 pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic κρατοῦσι(ν)) · or masc. dat. pl. of the pres. part. (= Attic κρατοῦσι): ’to those who rule’
glossary.κρατερῆς: κρατερός — strong, mighty, fierce; fem. gen. sg.
glossary.μερμηρίξω: μερμηρίζω — ponder, devise; aor. subj. 1 sg. (or fut.), in an indirect question: ’whether I must devise’
glossary.μεταλλῶσιν: μεταλλάω — ask, inquire of; pres. subj. 3 pl., contracted (= Attic μεταλλῶσι(ν)), with ὅτε κεν
glossary.μνηστύν: μνηστύς — wooing, courtship, the suitors’ feasting; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.μούνω: μόνος — alone, only; epic μοῦνος (= Attic μόνος), masc. nom. dual: ’we two alone’
glossary.νεύσω: νεύω — nod; fut. 1 sg. (or short-vowel aor. subj. with future sense): ’I will nod’
glossary.νηΐ: ναῦς — ship; fem. dat. sg., epic νηΐ (diaeresis marks the two syllables), of means: ’by ship’
glossary.οἰνωθέντες: οἰνόω — make drunk, fuddle with wine; aor. part. pass. masc. nom. pl.: ’made drunk’
glossary.οἰωνοί: οἰωνός — bird, esp. a bird of prey; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.οἶαι: οἶος — alone, only; fem. nom. pl. (= Attic μόναι), agreeing with an understood feminine noun
glossary.οἶοι: οἶος — alone, only; masc. nom. pl., epic (= Attic μόνοι): ’we alone’
glossary.πάσχοντος: πάσχω — suffer, be ill-treated; pres. part. masc. gen. sg., in a gen. absolute with ἐμεῖο: ’while I suffer’
glossary.πέμπουσιν: πέμπω — send, convey, escort; pres. 3 pl.
glossary.πίσυρές: πίσυρες — four; numeral, epic (= Attic τέτταρες), masc. nom. pl., accented before the enclitic τε
glossary.παραυδῶν: παραυδάω — speak soothingly to, coax; pres. part. masc. nom. sg., contracted
glossary.παρφάσθαι: παράφημι — talk round, put off, coax; mid. inf., preverb παρ- for παρα-
glossary.παύεσθαι: παύω — stop; mid. cease, leave off (+ gen.); pres. inf. mid.
glossary.πείσονται: πείθω — persuade; mid. obey, heed; fut. 3 pl. mid.
glossary.πειρηθεῖμεν: πειράω — try, test; aor. opt. 1 pl., from the passive-form aorist πειρήθην with active sense (= Attic πειραθεῖμεν)
glossary.πετεηνὰ: πετεηνός — winged, flying; adj., neut. nom./acc. pl. πετεηνά (= Attic πτηνά), also as noun: ’winged things’
glossary.ποίῃ: ποῖος — of what kind, which?; interrog. adj., fem. dat. sg., epic -ῃ (= Attic ποίᾳ), with νηΐ · also ποίη — grass, herbage; fem. dat. sg.: ἐν ποίῃ ’in the grass’
glossary.ποθέοντες: ποθέω — long for, yearn; pres. part. masc. nom. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ποθοῦντες)
glossary.πολλοῖσι: πολύς — much, many; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic πολλοῖς)
glossary.πολύβουλος: πολύβουλος — of many plans, of much counsel; epithet of Athena, fem. nom. sg.
glossary.πολύπικρα: πολύπικρος — very bitter; neut. acc. pl., also adverbial: ’very bitterly’
glossary.προσεφώνεεν: προσφωνέω — speak to, address; impf. 3 sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic προσεφώνει)
glossary.πρόφρονι: πρόφρων — eager, willing, whole-hearted; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.σάμης: Σάμη — Same, an island near Ithaca; fem. gen. sg.
glossary.σίδηρος: σίδηρος — iron; masc. nom. sg., hence weapon of iron
glossary.στήσαντες: ἵστημι — make stand, set up, raise; aor. part. act. masc. nom. pl.: ’having raised’
glossary.τεο: τις — someone, any; indefinite pron., masc. gen. sg., epic enclitic τεο (= Attic του), with a gen. pl.: ’any of’
glossary.τετλάτω: τλάω — endure, bear; perf. imper. 3 sg. with present sense: ’let it endure’
glossary.τούτω: οὗτος — this; demonstrative pron., masc. nom. dual (= Attic τούτω): ’these two’
glossary.τρώσητε: τιτρώσκω — wound; aor. subj. 2 pl. after μή (’lest you wound’)
glossary.φαίηκές: Φαίηξ — Phaeacian; masc. nom. pl., epic Φαίηκες (= Attic Φαίακες)
glossary.φράσαι: φράζομαι — consider, think out, take thought; aor. imper. 2 sg. mid.: ’consider’
glossary.φυλόπιδος: φύλοπις — battle-din, battle; fem. gen. sg.
glossary.φόνου: φόνος — killing, slaughter; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.ἀγρόται: ἀγρότης — countryman, hunter; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἀδινώτερον: ἀδινός — thick, close-packed, shrill (of wailing; sense uncertain); comp. neut. acc. sg., adverbial: ’more heavily’
glossary.ἀκουσάτω: ἀκούω — hear; aor. imper. 3 sg.: ’let him hear’
glossary.ἀλέγει: ἀλέγω — care for, heed; pres. 3 sg.
glossary.ἀμφιχυθεὶς: ἀμφιχέω — pour around; pass. throw oneself about, embrace; aor. part. pass. masc. nom. sg., intransitive: ’having flung himself around’
glossary.ἀμύνοι: ἀμύνω — ward off, defend (+ dat.); pres. opt. 3 sg.
glossary.ἀμύντορα: ἀμύντωρ — defender, helper; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀνέχεσθαι: ἀνέχω — hold up; mid. endure, put up with; pres. inf. mid., used as an imperative: ’endure’ · also pres. inf. mid. dependent on impersonal ἔστιν: ’(not) possible to put up with’ (οὔ πως ἔστιν … ἀνέχεσθαι)
glossary.ἀντήσομεν: ἀντάω — meet, face (+ gen.); aor. subj. 1 pl., short vowel (= ἀντήσωμεν), after εἴ κεν: ’if we face’
glossary.ἀντιφέρεσθαι: ἀντιφέρομαι — set oneself against, match oneself with (+ dat.); pres. inf. mid.
glossary.ἀνωγέμεν: ἄνωγα — bid, command; perf. inf., epic -έμεν (= Attic ἀνωγέναι)
glossary.ἀρήϊα: ἀρήϊος — of Ares, warlike; neut. nom./acc. pl.
glossary.ἀριθμήσας: ἀριθμέω — count, number; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having counted’
glossary.ἀρκέσει: ἀρκέω — suffice, ward off, be enough; fut. 3 sg.
glossary.ἀτιμήσουσι: ἀτιμάω — dishonour, treat with contempt; fut. 3 pl., after εἰ (= Attic ἀτιμήσουσι(ν))
glossary.ἀτιμᾷ: ἀτιμάω — dishonour, slight; pres. 3 sg., contracted
glossary.ἀτρεκὲς: ἀτρεκής — exact, precise; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’exactly’
glossary.ἀφροσυνάων: ἀφροσύνη — folly, thoughtlessness; fem. gen. pl., epic -άων (= Attic -ῶν), gen. of separation after παύεσθαι
glossary.ἀϋτμή: ἀϋτμή — breath, blast, hot vapour; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἄρηος: Ἄρης — Ares, god of war; also war, battle; masc. gen. sg., epic Ἄρηος (= Attic Ἄρεως)
glossary.ἐξείλοντο: ἐξαιρέω — take out; mid. take away for oneself, snatch; aor. 3 pl. mid. (stem ἑλ-)
glossary.ἐπίφρονα: ἐπίφρων — thoughtful, prudent; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἐπαμύντορε: ἐπαμύντωρ — helper, defender; masc. nom. dual
glossary.ἐπιθύσαντες: ἐπιθύω — rush upon, charge; aor. part. act. masc. nom. pl.: ’having rushed on’
glossary.ἐσθλώ: ἐσθλός — good, noble, brave; masc. nom. dual
glossary.ἐφέλκεται: ἐφέλκω — drag towards; mid. draw to oneself, attract; pres. 3 sg. mid.
glossary.ἔπορον: πόρω (defective, aor. only) — furnish, grant, give; aor. 3 pl.: ’they gave’
glossary.ἔσεσθον: εἰμί — be; fut. 3 dual mid.: ’the two will be’
glossary.ἕλκωσι: ἕλκω — drag, pull; pres. subj. 3 pl. (Attic ἕλκωσι(ν)), after ἤν περ
glossary.ἰφθίμοισι: ἴφθιμος — stout, strong, mighty; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
glossary.ἵμερος: ἵμερος — longing, desire; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ὀδυρομένοισιν: ὀδύρομαι — lament, mourn; pres. part. masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις)
glossary.ὑποθημοσύνῃσιν: ὑποθημοσύνη — counsel, prompting; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσιν (= Attic -αις)
glossary.ὑψηλοῦ: ὑψηλός — high, lofty; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.ὥ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., masc. nom. dual (= Attic ὥ), with epic τε: ’both of whom’
glossary.αἰνήσουσιν: αἰνέω — praise, approve; fut. 3 pl.: ’they will approve’
glossary.βόλεσθε: βούλομαι — wish, want, prefer; pres. 2 pl., epic βόλεσθε (= Attic βούλεσθε)
glossary.γήμαιθ: γαμέω — marry (of a woman, mid. γαμέομαι); aor. opt. 3 sg. mid., elided (γήμαιθ’ = γήμαιτο), potential with κε: ’she might marry’
glossary.γερόντων: γέρων — old man, elder; masc. gen. pl.
glossary.γνώσεαι: γιγνώσκω — come to know, perceive; fut. 2 sg. mid., epic uncontracted (= Attic γνώσῃ)
glossary.δείσασ: δείδω — fear, be afraid; aor. part. fem. nom. sg., elided (δείσασ’ = δείσασα): ’having feared’
glossary.δεδάασθαι: δάω — learn, find out; perf. inf. mid. with aor. sense, epic: ’to learn about’
glossary.εἰλήλουθε: ἔρχομαι — come, go; perf. 3 sg., epic (= Attic ἐλήλυθε): ’has come’
glossary.εἴβοι: εἴβω — let fall in drops, shed; pres. opt. 3 sg., in a purpose clause after a past verb: ’she might shed’
glossary.εἴρηθ: εἴρω (ἐρῶ) — say, tell; plpf. pass. 3 sg. (εἴρηθ’ read as εἴρητο, the printed θ not explained by elision alone): ’had been said’
glossary.εἴσῃ: εἶμι — go; fut. 2 sg. mid., epic (= εἴσεαι): ’you will go (about)’
glossary.εὐεργής: εὐεργής — well-made, well-wrought; fem. nom. sg. (2-ending adj.), agreeing with νηῦς
glossary.θυμηδέ: θυμηδής — heart-pleasing, delightful; neut. acc. pl., elided (θυμηδέ’ = θυμηδέα), agreeing with χρήματα or used adverbially: ’to the heart’s pleasing’
glossary.κέρδος: κέρδος — gain, profit, advantage; neut. nom. sg.
glossary.κατήγετο: κατάγομαι — put in to land, come to shore; impf. 3 sg. mid.: ’was putting in’
glossary.κατήφησάν: κατηφέω — be downcast, be dejected; aor. 3 pl. (accented κατήφησάν before the enclitic τ’)
glossary.καταδύντι: καταδύω — sink, set (of the sun); intrans. aor. part., masc. dat. sg., temporal: ’as it sank’
glossary.κείνοις: κεῖνος — that, that one; demonstrative pron., epic (= Attic ἐκείνοις); masc. dat. pl.: ’to those’
glossary.κιχῆναι: κιχάνω — overtake, reach; aor. inf., epic root aorist (ἐκίχην): ’to overtake’
glossary.κλυτίοιο: Κλύτιος — Clytius, a man whose house is named; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.μέγαρόν: μέγαρον — hall; neut. acc. sg., accented before the enclitic τε
glossary.μέσῃσι: μέσος — middle, in the midst; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι (= Attic -αις), with μετά: ’in the midst of’
glossary.μεθησέμεναί: μεθίημι — let go, give up; fut. inf., epic -έμεναι (= Attic μεθήσειν), accented before the enclitic μιν
glossary.μετερχόμενος: μετέρχομαι — go after, go among, pursue; pres. part. mid. masc. nom. sg.: ’going after’
glossary.μετεφώνεεν: μεταφωνέω — speak among, address a company; impf. 3 sg., epic uncontracted -εεν (= Attic μετεφώνει)
glossary.μνάσθω: μνάομαι — woo, court; pres. imper. 3 sg. mid.: ’let him woo’
glossary.μόρσιμος: μόρσιμος — destined, fated; adj., masc. nom. sg.: ’the destined (suitor)’
glossary.νηλείτιδές: νηλείτις — guiltless, blameless; fem. nom. pl. (accented νηλείτιδές before the enclitic εἰσιν)
glossary.παρερχομένην: παρέρχομαι — go past, pass by; pres. part. mid. fem. acc. sg., agreeing with νῆα
glossary.πατρώϊα: πατρώϊος — of one’s father, paternal; neut. acc. pl., epic (= Attic πατρῷα): ’what is one’s father’s’
glossary.πειράζειν: πειράζω — try, test; pres. inf., by-form of πειράω (Attic πειρᾶν), + gen. or acc. of the person tried
glossary.πλείοντες: πλέω — sail; pres. part. masc. nom. pl., epic πλείω (= Attic πλέοντες)
glossary.πυλόθεν: Πύλος — Pylos, Nestor’s city; place-name with suffix -θεν: ’from Pylos’
glossary.σκοποὶ: σκοπός — lookout, watcher; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.στέλλοντας: στέλλω — furl, take in (sails); pres. part. masc. acc. pl.
glossary.σταθμοὺς: σταθμός — farmstead, steading; masc. acc. pl. · also σταθμός — door-post; masc. acc. pl.: ἐν δὲ σταθμοὺς ἄρσε ’fitted door-posts in’
glossary.συναντήτην: συναντάω — meet (+ dat.); impf. 3 dual, epic (= Attic συνηντάτην): ’the two met’
glossary.φθέωμεν: φθάνω — be beforehand, forestall; aor. subj. 1 pl., epic φθέωμεν (= Attic φθῶμεν), hortatory: ’let us forestall (him)’
glossary.φθίσωμεν: φθίω — destroy, kill; aor. subj. 1 pl., in a purpose clause after ἵνα: ’that we may destroy’
glossary.χαλιφροσύναι: χαλιφροσύνη — slackness of mind, thoughtless laxity; fem. nom. pl.
glossary.χώρης: χώρη — place, spot (Ionic; Attic χώρα); fem. gen. sg.
glossary.ἀγγείλωσι: ἀγγέλλω — announce, report; aor. subj. 3 pl. (ν-movable), with κε in a relative clause of purpose: ’who are to announce’
glossary.ἀγείρομεν: ἀγείρω — gather, assemble; pres. subj. 1 pl., short-vowel hortatory (= Attic ἀγείρωμεν): ’let us gather’
glossary.ἀθρόοι: ἀθρόος — crowded together, all together; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἀκάχοντο: ἀκαχίζω — distress, grieve; redup. aor. 3 pl. mid., unaugmented, epic: ’were grieved’
glossary.ἀμφίνομος: Ἀμφίνομος — Amphinomus, one of the suitors; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀναστὰς: ἀνίστημι — stand up, rise; intrans. aor. part. masc. nom. sg., root aorist: ’standing up’
glossary.ἀνύσσεσθαι: ἀνύω — accomplish, bring about; fut. inf. mid., epic doubled σ (= Attic ἀνύσεσθαι)
glossary.ἀπέειπε: ἀπεῖπον — say out, deliver (a message), tell out; aor. 3 sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἀπεῖπε)
glossary.ἀπένεικαν: ἀποφέρω — carry off, bear away; aor. 3 pl., epic (= Attic ἀπήνεγκαν): ’they carried off’
glossary.ἀπήγαγεν: ἀπάγω — lead away, carry off; aor. 3 sg.
glossary.ἀπομηνίσει: ἀπομηνίω — rage, be wrathful (against); fut. 3 sg.: ’he will rage’
glossary.ἀποπλείειν: ἀποπλέω — sail away, sail off; pres. inf., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἀποπλεῖν)
glossary.ἀφανδάνει: ἀφανδάνω — be displeasing, displease; pres. 3 sg. + dat., epic (ἀπο- + ἁνδάνω)
glossary.ἀφικώμεθα: ἀφικνέομαι — arrive at, come to; aor. subj. 1 pl. mid., in a fear clause after μή: ’and we come to’
glossary.ἁλιῆας: ἁλιεύς — seaman, sailor (lit. one of the sea); masc. acc. pl., epic -ῆας (= Attic -έας)
glossary.ἄγετε: ἄγω — lead; pres. imper. 2 pl., in the interjection ἄγε/ἄγετε: ’come now!’
glossary.ἄσαμεν: ἄω — spend the night, sleep; aor. 1 pl., epic (= ἀέσαμεν, contracted): ’we passed (the night)’
glossary.ἐέδνοισιν: ἕεδνον — bridal gift; neut. dat. pl. ἕεδνα, epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις), instrumental: ’with bridal gifts’
glossary.ἐκίχημεν: κιχάνω — overtake, reach; aor. 1 pl., epic root aorist (ἐκίχην): ’we overtook’
glossary.ἐκγελάσας: ἐκγελάω — laugh out, laugh aloud; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἐμίμνομεν: μίμνω — stay, wait for; impf. 1 pl., epic reduplicated present (= Attic μένω, ἐμένομεν)
glossary.ἐξελάσωσι: ἐξελαύνω — drive out; aor. subj. 3 pl. (ν-movable), in a fear clause after μή, + acc.: ’and drive us out’
glossary.ἐπασσύτεροι: ἐπασσύτερος — close one upon another, in quick succession; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἐπιστήμων: ἐπιστήμων — skilled, knowing, expert (+ dat. of respect); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἐράπτομεν: ῥάπτω — stitch together, devise (of plots); impf. 1 pl., augmented with ρ not doubled, epic (= Attic ἐρράπτομεν): ’we were stitching’
glossary.ἐρέοντε: ἐρέω — will say, tell; fut. part. act., masc. nom. dual, epic uncontracted (= Attic ἐροῦντε), of purpose: ’to tell’
glossary.ἐφημοσύνην: ἐφημοσύνη — behest, charge, message entrusted; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἔδωμεν: ἔδω — eat, devour; pres. subj. 1 pl., epic (= Attic ἐσθίω), prohibitive after μή: ’let us not devour’
glossary.ἔχοντας: ἔχω — have, hold; pres. part. masc. acc. pl.: ’holding’
glossary.ἕρκεά: ἕρκος — enclosure, fence, pen; neut. acc. pl., epic uncontracted -εα (= Attic ἕρκη), accented before the enclitic τε
glossary.ἧμας: ἐγώ (pl. ἡμεῖς) — we; acc. pl., epic ἧμας (= Attic ἡμᾶς): ’us’
glossary.ἰφθίμη: ἴφθιμος — stout, mighty; fem. nom. sg., agreeing with βασίλεια
glossary.ἷζον: ἵζω — sit, sit down; impf. 3 pl., epic: ’were sitting’
glossary.ὁδῷ: ὁδός — road, way; fem. dat. sg.
glossary.ὁμηγυρίσασθαι: ὁμηγυρίζω — call to assembly (mid. convene, gather); aor. inf. mid.: ’to gather’
glossary.ὅστις: ὅστις, ἥτις, ὅ τι — whoever; indefinite relative pron., masc. nom. sg., with opt.: ’whoever might’
glossary.ὕστερα: ὕστερος — later, last; neut. acc. pl. used adverbially: ’afterwards’
glossary.ῥέξωσι: ῥέζω — do, perform, bring about; aor. subj. 3 pl. (ν-movable), epic (= Attic δράω/ποιέω), in a fear clause after μή
glossary.αἰνήσωσι: αἰνέω — praise, approve; aor. subj. 3 pl., with κε in a protasis after εἰ: ’if they approve’
glossary.βασιλήϊόν: βασιλήϊος — royal, of a king; neut. nom. sg., epic (= Attic βασίλειος), accented before an enclitic
glossary.βεβρίθει: βρίθω — be heavy, be laden (+ dat.); plpf. 3 sg. with impf. sense, epic: ’was laden’
glossary.γούνασιν: γόνυ — knee; neut. dat. pl., epic γούνασιν (= Attic γόνασι)
glossary.δερκομένοιο: δέρκομαι — see, look; pres. part. mid. masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου): ’seeing’
glossary.δουλιχίου: Δουλίχιον — Dulichium, an island kingdom near Ithaca; neut. gen. sg.
glossary.δῖ: δῖος — heavenly, divine, illustrious; masc. voc. sg., elided (δῖ’ = δῖε) · also fem. nom. sg., elided (δῖ’ = δῖα): ’heavenly’, epithet of Aphrodite
glossary.εἰρύσσαιτο: ἐρύομαι (εἰρύομαι) — guard, keep, hold fast; aor. opt. 3 sg. mid., epic εἰρ-, -σσ- (= Attic ἐρύσαιτο), in the μή clause: ’might keep (in mind)’
glossary.εἰρώμεθα: ἔρομαι (ἐρέομαι) — ask, inquire; pres. subj. 1 pl. mid., epic εἰρ- (= Attic ἐρώμεθα), hortatory: ’let us ask’
glossary.εἰσαναβᾶσ: εἰσαναβαίνω — go up into; aor. part. fem. nom. sg., elided (εἰσαναβᾶσ’ = εἰσαναβᾶσα): ’having gone up’
glossary.ζώοντός: ζώω (Attic ζάω) — live; pres. part. masc. gen. sg., epic, accented before an enclitic: ’living’
glossary.θαρσύνων: θαρσύνω — encourage, hearten; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’heartening’
glossary.θεσπρωτούς: Θεσπρωτοί — Thesprotians, a people of north-west Greece; masc. acc. pl.
glossary.θεόθεν: θεόθεν — from the gods, by the gods’ will; adv., -θεν suffix of source
glossary.θρόνοισιν: θρόνος — chair, seat; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις)
glossary.κακομήχανε: κακομήχανος — contriving evil, of evil devices; masc. voc. sg.
glossary.καταβλώσκοντα: καταβλώσκω — go down; pres. part. masc. acc. sg.: ’going down’
glossary.κατακτείνειν: κατακτείνω — kill, slay (= Attic ἀποκτείνω); pres. inf.
glossary.κατιοῦσαν: κάτειμι — go down, come down (to a harbour); pres. part. fem. acc. sg.: ’coming in’
glossary.κιών: κίω — go; pres. part. masc. nom. sg., epic (cf. Attic ἰών): ’going’
glossary.κτενέω: κτείνω — kill, slay; fut. 1 sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic κτενῶ): ’I will kill’
glossary.λαερτιάδην: Λαερτιάδης — son of Laertes, patronymic of Odysseus; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ληϊστῆρσιν: ληϊστήρ — raider, pirate (Attic ληστής); masc. dat. pl., epic -σιν
glossary.λιμέν: λιμήν — harbour; masc. acc. sg., elided (λιμέν’ = λιμένα)
glossary.λόφος: λόφος — ridge, hill; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.μάργε: μάργος — mad, frenzied, reckless; masc. voc. sg., in address
glossary.μάρτυρος: μάρτυρος — witness (o-stem by-form of Attic μάρτυς); masc. nom. sg., predicative
glossary.μέγαρόνδε: μέγαρον — hall, house; μέγαρόνδε ’to the hall’, adv., -δε suffix of direction
glossary.μνάᾳ: μνάομαι — woo, court (as a suitor); pres. 2 sg. mid., contracted (-άῃ → -ᾳ): ’you court’
glossary.μνήσαντο: μιμνήσκω — remind; mid. remember, think of (+ gen.); aor. 3 pl. mid., unaugmented (= ἐμνήσαντο)
glossary.μνηστήρεσσι: μνηστήρ — suitor; masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσι
glossary.νίσου: Νῖσος — Nisus, father of Amphinomus; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.οἶσθ: οἶδα — know; perf. 2 sg. with pres. sense, elided (οἶσθ’ = οἶσθα): ’you know’
glossary.παύσαντο: παύω — stop; mid. cease (+ gen.); aor. 3 pl. mid., unaugmented (= ἐπαύσαντο)
glossary.περίφρον: περίφρων — circumspect, of sound understanding; fem. voc. sg., stock epithet of Penelope
glossary.πεύθετο: πεύθομαι (epic by-form of πυνθάνομαι) — learn, hear of; impf. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented (= ἐπεύθετο)
glossary.ποιήεντος: ποιήεις — grassy, rich in grass; masc./neut. gen. sg., epic -ήεντος
glossary.πολλάκι: πολλάκι(ς) — many times, often; adv., epic (= Attic πολλάκις)
glossary.πολυπύρου: πολύπυρος — rich in wheat; masc./neut. gen. sg.
glossary.σάκεσσι: σάκος — shield; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσι
glossary.ταφίοισιν: Τάφιος — Taphian, of Taphos, a seafaring people; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις)
glossary.τρομέεσθαι: τρομέω (mid. τρομέομαι) — tremble, fear; pres. inf. mid., epic uncontracted -έεσθαι (= Attic -εῖσθαι): ’to dread’
glossary.υἱέϊ: υἱός — son; masc. dat. sg., epic υἱέϊ (= Attic υἱῷ)
glossary.φίλτατός: φίλος — dear; superl. φίλτατος, masc. nom. sg., accented before an enclitic: ’dearest’
glossary.φαγέειν: ἐσθίω (aor. ἔφαγον) — eat, devour; aor. inf., epic uncontracted (= Attic φαγεῖν)
glossary.φανῆναι: φαίνω — show; pass. appear; aor. pass. inf.: ’to appear’
glossary.ἀκαχίζεις: ἀκαχίζω — distress, grieve; pres. 2 sg., epic reduplicated present: ’you grieve’
glossary.ἀμφιγύοισι: ἀμφίγυος — epithet of spears, meaning not known (the usual guess is ’pointed at both ends’); neut. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις), agreeing with ἔγχεσιν
glossary.ἀνώξω: ἀνώγω (perf. ἄνωγα) — bid, command, urge; fut. 1 sg.: ’I will urge on’
glossary.ἀπαγγέλλων: ἀπαγγέλλω — report, bring word; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’bringing word’
glossary.ἀποκτείνεις: ἀποκτείνω — kill, slay; pres. 2 sg., conative (the killing is not yet done): ’you seek to kill’
glossary.ἀπορραῖσαι: ἀπορραίω — tear away, shatter; aor. inf.: ’to tear out’
glossary.ἀποτρωπῶσι: ἀποτρωπάω — turn away, discourage (cf. Attic ἀποτρέπω); pres. subj. 3 pl., with κε in a protasis: ’if they forbid’
glossary.ἀρητιάδαο: Ἀρητιάδης — son of Aretes, patronymic; masc. gen. sg., epic -άδαο (= Attic -άδου), agreeing with Νίσου
glossary.ἄρθμιοι: ἄρθμιος — bound in friendship, friendly; masc. nom. pl., predicative
glossary.ἄτιμον: ἄτιμος — without honour, dishonoured; masc. acc. sg., agreeing with οἶκον: ’dishonoured’
glossary.ἐδεύετο: δεύομαι — lack, be in want of (+ gen.); impf. 3 sg. mid.: ’was lacking’
glossary.ἐμπάζεαι: ἐμπάζομαι — care for, heed, regard; pres. 2 sg. mid., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἐμπάζῃ): ’you heed’
glossary.ἐνένιπεν: ἐνίπτω (aor. ἐνένιπον) — rebuke, chide; aor. 3 sg., epic reduplicated aorist: ’rebuked’
glossary.ἐνιαύσιον: ἐνιαύσιος — a year old, yearly; masc. acc. sg.: ’yearling’
glossary.ἐπέσχε: ἐπέχω — hold out, hold to, offer; aor. 3 sg.: ’held out’
glossary.ἐπισπόμενος: ἐφέπομαι (ἐπί + ἕπομαι; aor. ἐπισπόμην) — follow after, join; aor. part. mid. masc. nom. sg.: ’following’
glossary.ἐπισταδὸν: ἐπισταδόν — standing by, standing close; adv. (ἐπί + ἵστημι, -δόν suffix); also read ’one after another’
glossary.ἐποίσει: ἐπιφέρω — bring upon, lay on; fut. 3 sg. (with κε): ’will lay on’
glossary.ἐρωήσει: ἐρωέω — rush, gush; fut. 3 sg.: ’will gush’
glossary.ἐφεσσάμενος: ἐφέζω — set upon; mid. set (another) upon oneself; aor. part. mid. masc. nom. sg., epic -σσ-: ’having set (me) on’
glossary.ἐϋφρονέων: εὐφρονέω (epic ἐϋφρονέω) — be well-minded, be well-disposed; pres. part. masc. nom. sg., uncontracted (= Attic εὐφρονῶν): ’well-disposed’
glossary.ἔδεις: ἔδω — eat, devour; pres. 2 sg., epic (= Attic ἐσθίεις): ’you devour’
glossary.ἔησθα: εἰμί — be; impf. 2 sg., epic ἔησθα (= Attic ἦσθα): ’you were’
glossary.ἔμελέν: μέλω — be a care to, concern; impf. 3 sg., accented before an enclitic: ’it was a care’
glossary.ἕρμαιος: Ἕρμαιος — of Hermes, sacred to Hermes; masc. nom. sg. adj.
glossary.ἕσσε: ἕννυμι — clothe, put clothes on; aor. 3 sg., epic -σσ-: ’clothed, put on’
glossary.ἡγεῖτο: ἡγέομαι — lead, go first (+ dat.); impf. 3 sg. mid.: ’led’
glossary.ἤκαχε: ἀκαχίζω — distress, grieve, harass; aor. 3 sg., epic reduplicated aorist: ’grieved’
glossary.ἤρτυεν: ἀρτύω — prepare, contrive; impf. 3 sg., augmented: ’was preparing’
glossary.ἱεμένους: ἵεμαι (mid. of ἵημι) — hasten, be eager; pres. part. masc. acc. pl.: ’eager’
glossary.ὀπτὸν: ὀπτός — roasted, cooked; neut. acc. sg., agreeing with κρέας (grave, mid-clause form)
glossary.ὁμήλικας: ὁμήλιξ — of the same age, a peer; masc. acc. pl.: ’age-mates’
glossary.ὁσίη: ὁσίη — what is right and hallowed, sanctioned by divine law; fem. nom. sg., with ἐστί understood: ’it is holy, it is right’
glossary.ὑπερώϊα: ὑπερῷον — upper room, upper storey; neut. pl., epic ὑπερώϊα (= Attic ὑπερῷα), acc. of goal
glossary.ὠΐσθην: οἴομαι — think, suppose; aor. 1 sg. (passive form, deponent), epic ὠΐσθην (= Attic ᾠήθην): ’I thought’
glossary.ὠκύς: ὠκύς — swift, quick; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ὡμήρησε: ὁμηρέω — meet, fall in with, join (+ dat.); aor. 3 sg., augmented: ’met’
glossary.ὡπλίζοντο: ὁπλίζω — make ready, prepare; impf. 3 pl. mid.: ’they prepared’
glossary.ῥάπτειν: ῥάπτω — stitch together, contrive; pres. inf.: ’to contrive’
glossary.ῥάπτεις: ῥάπτω — stitch together, contrive; pres. 2 sg.: ’you contrive’
glossary.βέλτερόν: βέλτερος — better; comparative of ἀγαθός, epic (= Attic βελτίων); neut. nom. sg., predicate: ’better (it is)’
glossary.δάσωνται: δατέομαι — divide among themselves, share out; aor. subj. mid. 3 pl., with κε in a protasis after εἰ (Attic ἐάν): ’if they share out’
glossary.δαιδαλέοισι: δαιδάλεος — skilfully wrought, cunningly made; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
glossary.δαμάσσῃ: δάμνημι (δαμάζω) — overpower, subdue; aor. subj. 3 sg., epic -σσ- (= Attic δαμάσῃ), in a fear clause after μή: ’lest it overpower’
glossary.θερέω: θέρομαι — warm oneself, grow warm; aor. subj. pass. 1 sg., epic uncontracted (contracted θερῶ; prose has θερμαίνομαι), in a temporal clause with κε: ’when I am warmed’
glossary.καλέσσω: καλέω — call, summon; aor. subj. 1 sg., epic -σσ- (= Attic καλέσω), in a purpose clause after ὄφρα: ’so that I may summon’
glossary.καστορνῦσα: καταστορέννυμι (cf. στόρνυμι) — spread over, strew; pres. part. fem. nom. sg., epic, κατά shortened to κα- before στ-: ’spreading (fleeces)’
glossary.κλαυθμοῦ: κλαυθμός — weeping, wailing; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.κλισμοῖσι: κλισμός — reclining chair, seat; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
glossary.κραιπνὰ: κραιπνός — swift, rushing; neut. acc. pl. used as an adverb: ’at a rush, swiftly’
glossary.κτείναντες: κτείνω — kill, slay; aor. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’having killed’
glossary.κύνεον: κυνέω — kiss; impf. 3 pl., epic, unaugmented (= Attic ἐκύνουν): ’were kissing’
glossary.κώεα: κῶας — fleece, sheepskin; neut. acc. pl. κώεα, epic uncontracted (the sg. is κῶας; prose says κῴδιον)
glossary.λέπτ: λεπτός — fine, thin, delicate; neut. acc. pl., elided (λέπτ’ = λεπτά)
glossary.μενεαίνω: μενεαίνω — be eager, be set on, be furious; pres. 1 sg., epic, with inf.: ’am eager (to)’
glossary.μηνίει: μηνίω — be angry, bear a grudge; pres. 3 sg., in a concessive εἴ περ clause
glossary.ναιετάοντας: ναιετάω — dwell, be inhabited; pres. part. masc. acc. pl., epic uncontracted (contracted ναιετῶντας; prose says οἰκέω): ’inhabited’
glossary.πήχεε: πῆχυς — forearm, arm; masc. acc. dual, epic -εε (= Attic πήχει)
glossary.παλάμηφιν: παλάμη — palm, hand; fem. dat. sg. with epic suffix -φιν (= Attic παλάμῃ)
glossary.πατρώϊοι: πατρώϊος — of one’s father, paternal; masc. nom. pl., epic (= Attic πατρῷοι)
glossary.πείραι: Πείραιος — Peiraeus, Telemachus’s companion; masc. voc. sg., elided (Πείραι’ = Πείραιε)
glossary.πιθέσθαι: πείθομαι — obey, trust (+ dat.); aor. inf. mid. (2nd aor. ἐπιθόμην): ’to obey’
glossary.προβιβάς: προβιβάω (προβίβημι) — stride forward, step on; pres. part. masc. nom. sg., epic (= Attic προβαίνων)
glossary.προὔπεμψα: προπέμπω — send forward, send ahead; aor. 1 sg., with crasis προ-ἔπεμψα (προὔπεμψα)
glossary.πτωχεύειν: πτωχεύω — beg, live as a beggar; pres. inf.
glossary.πτωχεύῃ: πτωχεύω — beg, live as a beggar; pres. subj. 3 sg., in a purpose clause after ὄφρ’ ἄν: ’so that he may beg’
glossary.σημάντορι: σημάντωρ — overseer, one who gives orders; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.στρωφῶσα: στρωφάω — turn, twirl (the spindle); pres. part. fem. nom. sg., contracted (= Attic στρέφουσα)
glossary.στυγεροῖο: στυγερός — hateful, loathsome; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -οῦ)
glossary.τελέσσῃ: τελέω — accomplish, fulfil; aor. subj. 3 sg., epic -σσ- (= Attic τελέσῃ), with κε in a protasis after αἴ: ’if … should accomplish’
glossary.τούτοισι: οὗτος — this, that; demonstrative pron., masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic τούτοις): ’for these men’
glossary.τράπετ: τρέπω — turn; aor. 3 sg. mid., epic, elided and unaugmented (τράπετ’ = ἐτράπετο): ’turned (away)’
glossary.φυγόντι: φεύγω — flee, escape; aor. part. masc. dat. sg., agreeing with μοι: ’having escaped’
glossary.φυτεύσω: φυτεύω — plant, sow; contrive; aor. subj. 1 sg. (or fut. indic.), with κε in a protasis after εἰ: ’if I plant (evil)’
glossary.χαίροντι: χαίρω — rejoice, be glad; pres. part. masc. dat. sg., agreeing with μοι: ’(to me) rejoicing’
glossary.ἀγαπαζόμεναι: ἀγαπάζομαι — welcome gladly, greet fondly; pres. part. mid. fem. nom. pl., epic (cf. Attic ἀσπάζομαι)
glossary.ἀγορεύοντες: ἀγορεύω — speak, say; pres. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’speaking’
glossary.ἀλέη: ἀλέη — warmth, heat; fem. nom. sg., epic (= Attic ἀλέα)
glossary.ἀλεύατο: ἀλέομαι — avoid, shun; aor. 3 sg. mid., epic, unaugmented (= ἠλεύατο): ’avoided’
glossary.ἀρήρει: ἀραρίσκω — fit, fit together; plpf. 3 sg. with intransitive impf. sense, epic: ’was fitted’
glossary.ἄντιτα: ἄντιτος — of requital, requiting (built on ἀντί ’in return’ and the root of τίνω ’pay’; the exact sense is uncertain); neut. acc. pl., in ἄντιτα ἔργα ’deeds of requital’
glossary.ἄπτερος: ἄπτερος — wingless; masc. nom. sg., predicate with μῦθος: ’wingless (word)’
glossary.ἄττ: ἄττα — father; respectful address to an older man (not a kinsman); masc. voc. sg., elided (ἄττ’ = ἄττα)
glossary.ἐκεῖθι: ἐκεῖ — there, in that place; adv., epic by-form ἐκεῖθι (= Attic ἐκεῖ)
glossary.ἐξερέεινον: ἐξερεείνω — question closely, ask about; impf. 3 pl., epic, unaugmented (cf. Attic ἐξερωτάω)
glossary.ἐπαυρέμεν: ἐπαυρίσκω — get a share of, enjoy (+ gen. or acc.); aor. inf., epic -έμεν (= Attic ἐπαυρεῖν)
glossary.ἐπιτέλλω: ἐπιτέλλω — enjoin, give charge to; pres. 1 sg.: ’I give charge’
glossary.ἐπιτειλαμένῳ: ἐπιτέλλω — enjoin, give charge to; aor. part. mid. masc. dat. sg.: ’having given charge’
glossary.ἐρύκεσθαι: ἐρύκω — hold back, keep off; pres. inf. pass.: ’to be held back’
glossary.ἐϋξέστας: ἐΰξεστος — well-polished, finely planed; fem. acc. pl., epic ἐϋ- (= Attic εὔξεστος)
glossary.ἔσθλ: ἐσθλός — good, noble; neut. acc. pl., elided (ἔσθλ’ = ἐσθλά): ’good things’
glossary.ἔχοντά: ἔχω — have, hold; pres. part. masc. acc. sg., accented before an enclitic: ’having’; with ἄλγεα, ’beset by (pains)’
glossary.ἕκαθεν: ἑκάς (ἕκαθεν) — far off, from afar; adv., epic -θεν (= Attic πόρρωθεν)
glossary.ἰκέλη: ἴκελος — like, resembling (+ dat.); fem. nom. sg., epic (= Attic ὁμοία, ἐοικυῖα)
glossary.ὄρινε: ὀρίνω — stir up, rouse; pres. imper. 2 sg., after μηδέ in a prohibition: ’do not stir up’ · also impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ὤρινε): ’he stirred’
glossary.ὄρνυθι: ὄρνυμι — rouse, stir up; pres. imper. 2 sg., after μή in a prohibition: ’do not rouse’
glossary.ὄτρυνον: ὀτρύνω — urge on, send speedily; aor. imper. 2 sg. · also impf. 1 sg. or 3 pl. (same -ον ending), unaugmented
glossary.ὑπηοίη: ὑπηοῖος — at dawn, of early morning; fem. nom. sg., epic -ίη (Ionic η for α; cf. Attic ἑῷος)
glossary.ὥστ: ὥστε — so as to, so that; conj. introducing a result, + inf. (ὥστ’ … πιθέσθαι); elided (ὥστ’ = ὥστε), as in Attic
glossary.βάλλετο: βάλλω — throw, cast; mid. throw on oneself, sling; impf. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented (= ἐβάλλετο): ’he slung on’ · also mid. with a passive sense, ’was thrown on’ (ἐπὶ … βάλλετο κῶας ’a fleece was thrown on’, ἐπί in tmesis)
glossary.δάκρυσ: δάκρυ — tear; neut. dat. pl., elided (δάκρυσ’ = δάκρυσι)
glossary.δείπνηστος: δειπνηστός — time for the meal, meal-time; masc. nom. sg., predicate: ’it was meal-time’
glossary.δουρικλειτὸν: δουρικλειτός — famed for the spear; masc. acc. sg., epithet of Menelaus in apposition
glossary.εἰσαναβᾶσα: εἰσαναβαίνω — go up into; aor. part. act. fem. nom. sg. (aor. εἰσανέβην): ’having gone up’
glossary.ζωοῦ: ζωός — alive, living; masc. gen. sg., epic (= Attic ζῶν, gen. ζῶντος): ’alive’
glossary.θανόντος: θνῄσκω — die; aor. part. masc. gen. sg. (aor. ἔθανον): ’dead’, lit. ’having died’
glossary.θυμαρὲς: θυμαρής — pleasing to the heart, fitting, welcome; adj., neut. acc. sg.
glossary.κηρύκων: κῆρυξ — herald; masc. gen. pl., partitive: ’of the heralds’
glossary.κολλητοῖσιν: κολλητός — glued together, well-joined; adj., masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις)
glossary.λέξομαι: λέγω (II) — lay down; mid. lie down, go to bed; fut. 1 sg. mid.: ’I will lie down’
glossary.μέμβλωκε: βλώσκω — go, come; perf. 3 sg. (μέμβλωκε from *μέμλωκε), epic: ’has gone, has passed’
glossary.μεγάλους: μέγας — great, big, large; masc. acc. pl.
glossary.μενεαίνεις: μενεαίνω — be eager, be set on (doing); pres. 2 sg., epic, + inf.: ’you are eager’
glossary.νεικείῃ: νεικέω — quarrel with, rail at, rebuke; pres. subj. 3 sg., epic -είῃ (= Attic νεικῇ), in a fear clause after μή: ’lest he rebuke’
glossary.παρακλιδὸν: παρακλιδόν — sideways, aslant, evasively; adv.: ’in a roundabout way’
glossary.παρεγίγνετο: παραγίγνομαι — be present, be at hand; impf. 3 sg. mid./dep., augment ε- inserted after the preverb παρ-, + dat.: ’was with (them)’
glossary.πείθοντό: πείθω — persuade; mid. obey, comply with (+ dat.); impf. 3 pl. mid., unaugmented (= ἐπείθοντο), acute on the last syllable before enclitic τε: ’they obeyed’
glossary.πευθόμενος: πεύθομαι — learn, hear of, inquire; pres. part. mid. masc. nom. sg., epic (= Attic πυνθανόμενος): ’learning of’
glossary.πεφυρμένη: φύρω — mix, mingle, soil; perf. pass. part. fem. nom. sg., + dat.: ’mingled, drenched (with tears)’
glossary.ποθί: ποθί — somewhere, anywhere; enclitic adv., epic (= Attic που), in εἴ ποθί τοι ’if anywhere you have’
glossary.προὔπεμψε: προπέμπω — send forward, send on one’s way; aor. 3 sg., with crasis προὔπεμψε (= προέπεμψε): ’sent forward’
glossary.σήμερον: σήμερον — today, this day; adv. (Attic τήμερον)
glossary.σκηπτόμενον: σκήπτομαι — lean on, support oneself on; pres. part. mid. masc. acc. sg.: ’leaning (on a staff)’
glossary.σκηρίπτεσθ: σκηρίπτομαι — lean on, prop oneself; pres. inf. mid., elided (σκηρίπτεσθ’ = σκηρίπτεσθαι), of purpose: ’to lean on’
glossary.σταθμῶν: σταθμός — steading, farmstead, station (also door-post); masc. gen. pl., plural for one steading: ’of the steading’
glossary.στονόεσσα: στονόεις — full of groaning, mournful; adj., fem. nom. sg., epic -όεσσα
glossary.τετμημένον: τέμνω — cut; perf. pass. part. neut. nom./acc. sg.: ’cut, hewn’
glossary.φατ: φημί — say; pres. 2 pl., elided (φατ’ = φατέ; sg. φῄς), plural of address: ’you say’
glossary.χέρειον: χερείων — worse, inferior; comparative of κακός, neut. nom./acc. sg., epic (= Attic χεῖρον): ’worse’
glossary.χαλεπαὶ: χαλεπός — hard, harsh, grievous; adj., fem. nom. pl.
glossary.χρηΐζων: χρηΐζω — need, want, have need of; pres. part. masc. nom. sg., epic (= Attic χρῄζων): ’needing’
glossary.χρόνιον: χρόνιος — after a long time, long-absent; adj., masc. acc. sg., agreeing with ἐλθόντα: ’after a long time’
glossary.ἀγελαίην: ἀγελαῖος — of the herd, herd-bred; fem. acc. sg., Ionic/epic -αίην (= Attic -αίαν)
glossary.ἀγροῖο: ἀγρός — field, farm, countryside; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -οῦ)
glossary.ἀργείην: Ἀργεῖος — Argive, of Argos; adj., fem. acc. sg., epic -είην (= Attic Ἀργείαν)
glossary.ἀρισφαλέ: ἀρισφαλής — very slippery, treacherous; adj., masc. acc. sg., elided (ἀρισφαλέ’ = ἀρισφαλέα), predicate with οὐδόν
glossary.ἀτρεΐδῃσιν: Ἀτρεΐδης — son of Atreus (Agamemnon, Menelaus); masc. dat. pl., epic -ῃσιν (= Attic -αις)
glossary.ἐγεγώνευν: γεγωνέω — call out, shout so as to be heard; impf. 1 sg., epic -ευν (= Attic ἐγεγώνουν), + dat.: ’I called out’
glossary.ἐκόμιζε: κομίζω — care for, take care of, convey; impf. 3 sg.: ’cared for’
glossary.ἐντυνώμεθα: ἐντύνω — make ready, prepare; subj. mid. 1 pl. (pres. or aor., same form), in a purpose clause after ἵνα: ’that we may prepare’
glossary.ἐτέρφθητε: τέρπω — delight; pass. take pleasure, enjoy; aor. 2 pl. pass., + dat.: ’you have taken your pleasure’
glossary.ἐφρασάμην: φράζω — point out; mid. notice, observe; aor. 1 sg. mid.: ’I noticed’
glossary.ἐϋκτιμένῃ: ἐΰκτιμένος — well-built, well-founded; adj., fem. dat. sg., epic ἐϋ- (= Attic εὐ-), of Lesbos
glossary.ἐϋσσέλμου: ἐΰσσελμος — with good benches, well-benched; adj., fem. gen. sg., epithet of a ship, epic doubled -σσ-
glossary.ἔρχεσθε: ἔρχομαι — go, come; pres. imper. 2 pl.: ’go, come’
glossary.ἕρπων: ἕρπω — creep, crawl, go slowly; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’creeping’
glossary.ἕσπερα: ἕσπερος — of evening; neut. pl. used as a noun, ’evening’; acc. pl. after ποτί: ’toward evening’
glossary.ἕστο: ἕννυμι — clothe; mid. put on, wear; plpf. 3 sg. mid., epic, + acc.: ’he was wearing, he had put on’
glossary.ἱέρευον: ἱερεύω — sacrifice, slaughter; impf. 1 sg. or 3 pl.: ’they were sacrificing’
glossary.ἵρευον: ἱρεύω — sacrifice, slaughter; impf. 1 sg. or 3 pl., epic by-form of ἱερεύω: ’they were sacrificing’
glossary.ὁμοκλαί: ὁμοκλή — rebuke, threatening cry, reproof; fem. nom. pl.
glossary.ὄϊς: ὄϊς — sheep; common gender (masc. or fem.), acc. pl., epic ὄϊς (= Attic οἶς): ’sheep’
glossary.ὅττευ: ὅστις — whoever, whatever; also indirect interrogative ’who, what’; gen. sg., epic ὅττευ (= Attic ὅτου), object genitive after χρηΐζων: ’in need of what’
glossary.ὑπερώϊον: ὑπερῷον — upper room, upper storey; neut. acc. sg., epic ὑπερώϊον (= Attic ὑπερῷον)
glossary.ὠτρύνοντ: ὀτρύνω — urge on, rouse; mid. hasten; impf. 3 pl. mid., augmented ὠ-, elided (ὠτρύνοντ’ = ὠτρύνοντο): ’were hastening’
glossary.ᾠχόμεθ: οἴχομαι — go, be gone; impf. 1 pl., augmented ᾠ-, elided (ᾠχόμεθ’ = ᾠχόμεθα): ’we went’
glossary.ᾤχεθ: οἴχομαι — go, be gone; impf. 3 sg., augmented ᾤ-, elided with τ > θ before a rough breathing (ᾤχεθ’ = ᾤχετο): ’he went off’
glossary.ῥίγιον: ῥίγιον — colder, harsher, worse (cf. ῥῖγος ’cold’); comparative adj., neut. nom. sg., predicate: ’colder’
glossary.ῥυτῆρα: ῥυτήρ — protector, guardian (from ῥύομαι); masc. acc. sg., predicative: ’as protector’ · also, if from ἐρύω ’draw’: ’drawer, one who draws’ (ῥυτῆρα βιοῦ ’drawer of the bow’); the sense is disputed
glossary.ῥύατ: ῥύομαι — protect, guard; impf. 3 pl. mid., epic ῥύατο, elided (ῥύατ’ = ῥύατο; Attic ἐρρύοντο): ’they guarded’
glossary.αἰπολίοισι: αἰπόλιον — herd of goats; neut. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
glossary.αἰτίζων: αἰτίζω — ask for, beg; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’begging’
glossary.βάλλετ: ἀναβάλλω — throw up; mid. strike up (a song); impf. 3 sg. mid., elided (βάλλετ’ = βάλλετο), unaugmented, ἀνὰ … βάλλετ’ in tmesis, + inf.: ’began to sing’
glossary.βαλλομένοιο: βάλλω — throw, pelt; pres. part. pass. masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου): ’being pelted’
glossary.βολάων: βολή — throw, cast (of a missile); fem. gen. pl., epic -άων (= Attic -ῶν)
glossary.βόσκειν: βόσκω — feed, pasture; pres. inf. act.: ’to feed’
glossary.γῆν: γῆ (epic also γαῖα) — earth, ground, land; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.δαιτῶν: δαίς — feast, meal; fem. gen. pl.
glossary.δηθύνειν: δηθύνω — linger, delay; pres. inf. used as an imperative after μηδέ: ’do not linger’
glossary.διασκεδάσειεν: διασκεδάννυμι — scatter, disperse; aor. opt. 3 sg., potential with κε: ’would scatter’
glossary.δολίοιο: Δόλιος — Dolius, father of Melanthius; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.δυνήσατο: δύναμαι — be able, can; aor. 3 sg. (deponent), unaugmented (= ἐδυνήσατο)
glossary.δύσεο: δύω — go into, enter; aor. imper. mid. 2 sg., epic -σεο (Attic δῦσαι), + acc.: ’go in among’
glossary.εὐερκέες: εὐερκής — well-fenced, well-secured; fem. nom. pl., uncontracted (Attic εὐερκεῖς)
glossary.εὐρυμάχου: Εὐρύμαχος — Eurymachus, one of the suitors; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.θαλλόν: θαλλός — green shoot, leafy fodder; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.θεῖτο: τίθημι — put, place; aor. opt. mid. 3 sg., potential with κεν: ’would put (on himself)’
glossary.θλίψεται: θλίβω — press, crush, chafe; fut. 3 sg. mid.: ’will rub raw’ (one’s own body)
glossary.θριγκοῖσι: θριγκός — coping, crowning course of a wall; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οῖς)
glossary.κάββαλεν: καταβάλλω — throw down, let drop; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented, κατά assimilated (κὰβ βάλε = κατέβαλε), ν-movable
glossary.κάτ: κατά — down, throughout; prep. + acc., elided κάτ’ and placed after its noun (anastrophe): ἄστυ κάτ’ ’through the town’
glossary.κέχυτ: χέω — pour, shed; plpf. pass. 3 sg., elided (κέχυτ’ = κέχυτο), unaugmented: ’lay poured out, lay heaped’
glossary.καθῖζεν: καθίζω — sit down, seat oneself; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented, ν-movable (Attic ἐκάθιζε)
glossary.καλλίροον: καλλίρροος — fair-flowing; fem. acc. sg., uncontracted (Attic καλλίρρους)
glossary.καλύψας: καλύπτω — cover, hide; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having covered’
glossary.κείμενος: κεῖμαι — lie; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’lying’
glossary.κιόντας: κίω — go, move; pres. part. masc. acc. pl.: ’going’
glossary.κνίση: κνίση — savour of burning fat; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.κοπρήσοντες: κοπρέω — dung, manure (a field); fut. part. masc. nom. pl., of purpose: ’to dung’
glossary.κρηναῖαι: κρηναῖος — of a spring; fem. voc. pl. (same form as nom.), in address, with νύμφαι
glossary.κυκλοτερές: κυκλοτερής — round, circular; neut. nom. sg.
glossary.κυνοραιστέων: κυνοραιστής — dog-tick; masc. gen. pl., uncontracted -έων (= Attic -ῶν)
glossary.κύων: κύων — dog; masc./fem. nom. sg. (common gender)
glossary.λαγωούς: λαγωός — hare; masc. acc. pl., epic (= Attic λαγῴς)
glossary.λαθὼν: λανθάνω — escape the notice of; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg. + acc.: ’escaping the notice of’
glossary.μελάνθιος: Μελάνθιος — Melanthius, the goatherd; masc. nom. sg. (beside the by-form Μελανθεύς)
glossary.μελανθεὺς: Μελανθεύς — Melanthius, the goatherd; masc. nom. sg., by-form of Μελάνθιος
glossary.μεμαυῖαν: μάω (perf. μέμαα) — be eager, strive; perf. part. fem. acc. sg.: ’eager, clamouring’
glossary.μετέπρεπον: μεταπρέπω — stand out among, be conspicuous among; impf. 3 pl., + dat.: ’were outstanding among’
glossary.μεταΐξας: μεταΐσσω — rush after, rush at; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’rushing at’
glossary.μολοβρὸν: μολοβρός — word of abuse, meaning unknown (ancient guesses: ’glutton, scrounger’); masc. acc. sg.
glossary.νήριτος: Νήριτος — Neritus, one of the makers of the spring; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.νείκεσ: νεικέω — quarrel with, revile; aor. 3 sg., elided (νείκεσ’ = νείκεσε), unaugmented
glossary.νείκεσσεν: νεικέω — quarrel with, revile; aor. 3 sg., epic -σσ-, unaugmented, ν-movable
glossary.νομῆες: νομεύς — herdsman, shepherd; masc. nom. pl., epic -ῆες (= Attic -εῖς)
glossary.οὐλομένην: ὄλλυμι — destroy; mid. perish; aor. part. mid. οὐλόμενος used as adj., ’accursed, ruinous’; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.οὐρῇ: οὐρά — tail; fem. dat. sg., Ionic -ῇ (= Attic οὐρᾷ), dat. of means: ’with his tail’
glossary.πάντοσε: πάντοσε — in every direction, all round; adv.
glossary.πέπονθα: πάσχω — suffer, experience; perf. 1 sg.: ’I have suffered’
glossary.παλαμάων: παλάμη — palm, hand; fem. gen. pl., epic -άων (= Attic -ῶν)
glossary.παριὼν: πάρειμι (εἶμι) — go by, pass by; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’passing by’
glossary.πλευραὶ: πλευρά — rib, side; fem. nom. pl.: ’ribs’
glossary.πληγέων: πληγή — blow, stroke; fem. gen. pl., epic -έων (= Attic -ῶν)
glossary.πολλῇς: πολύς — much, many; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῇς (= Attic -αῖς)
glossary.πολύκτωρ: Πολύκτωρ — Polyctor, one of the makers of the spring; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.πονέοντο: πονέομαι — toil, labour, be busy; impf. 3 pl., uncontracted (Attic ἐπονοῦντο), unaugmented
glossary.πρόκας: πρόξ — roe-deer, deer; fem. acc. pl.
glossary.πτώσσων: πτώσσω — crouch, cower; go cringing, beg; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’cowering’
glossary.σηκοκόρον: σηκοκόρος — one who sweeps the pen, pen-sweeper; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.στήτην: ἵστημι — set up; intrans. aor. stand; aor. 3 dual, root aorist (= Attic ἐστήτην): ’the two stood still’
glossary.στείχοντες: στείχω — go, walk; pres. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’going’
glossary.τοίχῳ: τοῖχος — wall (of a house or yard); masc. dat. sg.
glossary.τολμήεις: τολμήεις — enduring, daring; masc. nom. sg., epic -ήεις (= Attic τολμηρός)
glossary.τυκτὴν: τυκτός — wrought, built (verbal adj. of τεύχω); fem. acc. sg.
glossary.φήμιος: Φήμιος — Phemius, the household singer; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.φθείρουσι: φθείρω — ruin, destroy, waste; pres. 3 pl.
glossary.φλιῇσι: φλιά — door-post; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῇσι (= Attic -αῖς)
glossary.φορέεις: φορέω — carry, bear about; pres. 2 sg., uncontracted (Attic φορεῖς)
glossary.φορῆναι: φορέω — carry, bring; pres. inf., epic -ῆναι (= Attic φορεῖν)
glossary.ψυχρὸν: ψυχρός — cold; neut. nom. sg., agreeing with ὕδωρ
glossary.ἀγάγοι: ἄγω — lead, bring; aor. opt. 3 sg. (wish): ’may he lead’
glossary.ἀγίνεσκον: ἀγινέω — lead, bring; impf. 3 pl., iterative in -σκ-, unaugmented: ’used to lead’
glossary.ἀγλαΐας: ἀγλαΐα — splendour, finery, adornment; fem. acc. pl.
glossary.ἀδαήμων: ἀδαήμων — unacquainted with, ignorant of; masc. nom. sg., + gen.
glossary.ἀκόλους: ἄκολος — morsel, bit of food; masc. acc. pl.
glossary.ἀμέγαρτε: ἀμέγαρτος — not to be envied, luckless (sense in abuse uncertain); masc. voc. sg.
glossary.ἀμφουδὶς: ἀμφουδίς — ’bodily’ (a traditional guess; sense uncertain); adv.
glossary.ἀνήνοθεν: ἀνήνοθα — well up, rise (perf. with pres. sense); perf. 3 sg. (ἀνήνοθε), ν-movable
glossary.ἀνιηρόν: ἀνιηρός — troublesome, irksome; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀποκρύψαι: ἀποκρύπτω — hide away, conceal; aor. inf. act.: ’to hide’
glossary.ἀπολυμαντῆρα: ἀπολυμαντήρ — spoiler, ruiner (rare; from λύμη ’ruin’); masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀπομόρξατο: ἀπομόργνυμι — wipe off; mid. wipe from oneself; aor. 3 sg. mid.: ’wiped away’
glossary.ἀποτρίψουσι: ἀποτρίβω — rub off, wear away; fut. 3 pl.
glossary.ἀπόθεστος: ἀπόθεστος — neglected, cast aside (a rare word, sense uncertain); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀταρπιτοῦ: ἀταρπιτός (= ἀτραπός) — footpath, track; fem. gen. sg.
glossary.ἄγοιεν: ἄγω — lead, carry off; pres. opt. 3 pl., in a clause of ὄφρ’ ἂν ’until’: ’should carry’
glossary.ἄξω: ἄγω — lead, take; fut. 1 sg.: ’I will take’
glossary.ἐΰζυγοι: εὔζυγος — well-yoked, well-benched (of ships); fem. nom. pl., epic ἐΰ-
glossary.ἐθελήσει: ἐθέλω — wish, be willing; fut. 3 sg.
glossary.ἐκίχαν: κιχάνω — come upon, meet, find; impf. 3 sg., elided (ἐκίχαν’ = ἐκίχανε)
glossary.ἐνίπλειος: ἐνίπλειος — full of, filled with; masc. nom. sg., + gen.
glossary.ἐπήσκηται: ἐπασκέω — work up, fit out; perf. pass. 3 sg.: ’has been fitted out’
glossary.ἐπετόλμησε: ἐπιτολμάω — endure, bring oneself to bear; aor. 3 sg.
glossary.ἐπιγουνίδα: ἐπιγουνίς — thigh, upper part of the thigh; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἐπιρρέζεσκον: ἐπιρρέζω — sacrifice at, make offering; impf. 3 pl., iterative in -σκ-, unaugmented: ’used to sacrifice’
glossary.ἐρίφοισι: ἔριφος — kid; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
glossary.ἐρεείνετο: ἐρεείνω — ask, question; impf. 3 sg. mid. (with active sense), unaugmented
glossary.ἐρχομένω: ἔρχομαι — go, come; pres. part. masc. dual nom.: ’the two coming’
glossary.ἐσσ: εἰμί — be; pres. 2 sg., epic ἐσσί, elided (ἐσσ’ = ἐσσί; Attic εἶ): ’you are’
glossary.ἐστυφέλιξεν: στυφελίζω — strike hard, thrust roughly; aor. 3 sg., ν-movable
glossary.ἐϋσσέλμοιο: ἐΰσσελμος — well-benched (of ships; σέλματα are the rowing-benches); fem. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.ἑτέρων: ἕτερος — other, one of two; gen. pl.: ’of others’
glossary.ἑταίρην: ἑταίρη — companion, mate (fem. of ἑταῖρος); fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἔκτοσθε: ἔκτοσθε(ν) — outside, from outside; adv. (= ἐκτός)
glossary.ἔμμαθεν: μανθάνω — learn; aor. 3 sg., epic -μμ- (= Attic ἔμαθε), ν-movable: ’has learned’
glossary.ἔνθορεν: ἐνθρῴσκω — leap in, leap upon; aor. 3 sg., ν-movable (ἔνθορε)
glossary.ἔσελθε: εἰσέρχομαι — go in, enter; aor. imper. 2 sg., epic ἔσελθε (= Attic εἴσελθε), + acc.
glossary.ἔσηνε: σαίνω — fawn, wag the tail; aor. 3 sg., ν-movable
glossary.ἔσχεν: ἔχω — hold, have; aor. 3 sg., ν-movable, with ἂν in tmesis (ἂν … ἔσχεν = ἀνέσχεν ’held up, lifted’)
glossary.ἕνεκεν: ἕνεκα (ἕνεκεν) — for the sake of, on account of; prep. + gen., placed after its pronoun (τῆς ἕνεκεν ’for whose sake’)
glossary.ἕτερ: ἕτερος — other; neut. nom. pl., elided (ἕτερ’ = ἕτερα): ’others’
glossary.ἡγηλάζει: ἡγηλάζω — lead, guide (a rare verb); pres. 3 sg.
glossary.ἰσχίῳ: ἰσχίον — hip, hip-joint; neut. dat. sg., local dat.: ’upon the hip’
glossary.ἰωὴ: ἰωή — sound, cry; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἱρὴν: ἱερός (epic ἱρός) — holy, sacred; fem. acc. sg., epic ἱρήν (= Attic ἱεράν)
glossary.ἴθακος: Ἴθακος — Ithacus, one of the makers of the spring; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ὀδυσσέα: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus; masc. acc. sg., double-σ form (beside single-σ Ὀδυσέα)
glossary.ὀδυσῆΐ: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus; masc. dat. sg., single-σ metrical variant Ὀδυσῆΐ (= Ὀδυσσῆϊ), dat. of the person affected: ’for Odysseus’
glossary.ὀλοφώϊα: ὀλοφώϊος — baneful, destructive; neut. acc. pl., as a substantive: ’baneful things’
glossary.ὁδῖται: ὁδίτης — wayfarer, traveller; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ὁμοῖον: ὅμοιος — like, similar; masc. acc. sg., as a noun with the article: τὸν ὁμοῖον ’the like’
glossary.ὁπλίζονται: ὁπλίζω — make ready, equip; pass. pres. 3 pl.: ’are fitted out’
glossary.ὑβρίζων: ὑβρίζω — act insolently, wax wanton; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’in insolence’
glossary.ὑδατοτρεφέων: ὑδατοτρεφής — nourished by water; fem. gen. pl., uncontracted -έων (= Attic -ῶν)
glossary.ὑπεροπλίσσαιτο: ὑπεροπλίζομαι — overpower (a rare verb, sense a little uncertain); aor. opt. mid. 3 sg., potential with ἄν: ’could overpower’
glossary.ὑπολείψομαι: ὑπολείπω — leave behind; mid. stay behind; fut. 1 sg. mid.: ’I will stay behind’
glossary.ῥέεν: ῥέω — flow; impf. 3 sg., uncontracted, unaugmented (= ἔρρει): ’flowed’
glossary.ῥοπάλῳ: ῥόπαλον — club, cudgel; neut. dat. sg., dat. of means: ’with a club’
glossary.αἰδῶ: αἰδώς — shame, a sense of respect or reserve; fem. acc. sg., subject of an infinitive
glossary.αἰτήσων: αἰτέω — ask, beg; fut. part. masc. nom. sg., of purpose: ’to beg’
glossary.αἰτίζειν: αἰτίζω — ask for, beg; pres. inf., after κελεύω: ’to beg’ (Attic αἰτεῖν)
glossary.βένθεσιν: βένθος — depth, deep part; neut. dat. pl. (Attic βάθος)
glossary.βασιλείης: βασίλεια — queen; fem. gen. sg., epic -ης (= Attic -ας)
glossary.βούλεαι: βούλομαι — wish, prefer; pres. 2 sg. mid., epic uncontracted (= Attic βούλει); with ἤ ’rather than’
glossary.γένοιθ: γίγνομαι — come to be, happen; aor. opt. 3 sg. mid., elided and aspirated (γένοιθ’ = γένοιτο), in a wish: ’may … come to be’
glossary.γίγνοντ: γίγνομαι — become, come to be; pres. 3 pl. mid., elided (γίγνοντ’ = γίγνονται)
glossary.δίοιτο: δίεμαι — chase, pursue; pres. opt. 3 sg. mid., in a general relative clause after ὅττι: ’whatever he chased’
glossary.δαινυμένοισι: δαίνυμαι — feast, dine; pres. part. mid. masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις): ’feasting’
glossary.δαιόμενος: δαίομαι — divide, distribute; pres. part. mid. masc. nom. sg.: ’dividing’
glossary.δεδειπνήκειν: δειπνέω — dine, take a meal; plpf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= Attic ἐδεδειπνήκει): ’had dined’
glossary.δημιοεργοὶ: δημιοεργός — craftsman working for the community (δῆμος + ἔργον); masc. nom. pl. (Attic δημιουργός)
glossary.διέσθαι: δίεμαι — chase, drive off; pres. inf. mid., epic: ’to drive away’ (Attic ἐλαύνειν)
glossary.δμωσὶν: δμώς — slave, servant; masc. dat. pl., epic -σιν (= Attic δούλοις)
glossary.δούρων: δόρυ — wood, timber, spear; neut. gen. pl., ’of timber’
glossary.δόμεν: δίδωμι — give; aor. inf., epic -μεν (= Attic δοῦναι)
glossary.εἴδεϊ: εἶδος — form, shape, appearance; neut. dat. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic εἴδει)
glossary.εἴωθε: ἔωθα (εἴωθα) — be accustomed, be wont; perf. 3 sg. with present sense: ’is accustomed’, + inf.
glossary.θηήσαιο: θηέομαι — gaze at, marvel at; aor. opt. 2 sg. mid., epic (Attic θεάομαι), potential with κε: ’you would marvel at’
glossary.κήδεαι: κήδομαι — care for, be concerned for (+ gen.); pres. 2 sg. mid., epic uncontracted (= Attic κήδῃ)
glossary.καλέοι: καλέω — call, invite; pres. opt. 3 sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic καλοίη), potential with ἄν: ’would invite’
glossary.κανέοιο: κάνεον — basket; neut. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic κανοῦ)
glossary.κανέου: κάνεον — basket; neut. gen. sg., uncontracted (= Attic κανοῦ)
glossary.κεχρημένῳ: χράομαι — use; perf. part. (+ gen.) ’in need of, lacking’; masc. dat. sg., used alone: ’needy, in want’
glossary.κλητοί: κλητός — invited, summoned; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.κλινάμενος: κλίνω — lean, rest; aor. part. mid. masc. nom. sg., + dat.: ’leaning (on)’
glossary.κνώδαλον: κνώδαλον — wild creature, beast; neut. nom./acc. sg.
glossary.κομέουσι: κομέω — tend, take care of; pres. 3 pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic κομῶσι)
glossary.κομέουσιν: κομέω — tend, keep, take care of; pres. 3 pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic κομῶσι), ν-movable
glossary.κυπαρισσίνῳ: κυπαρίσσινος — of cypress-wood; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.μέγαρ: μέγαρον — hall; neut. acc. pl., elided (μέγαρ’ = μέγαρα), plural for a single house
glossary.μελίνου: μέλινος — of ash-wood; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.μῆνας: μείς (Ionic μήν) — month; masc. acc. pl.
glossary.νείκεσσε: νεικέω — quarrel with, revile, rebuke; aor. 3 sg., epic -σσ-, unaugmented (= Attic ἐνείκεσε)
glossary.νεῦσ: νεύω — nod, make a sign; aor. 3 sg., elided (νεῦσ’ = νεῦσε), unaugmented (= ἔνευσε)
glossary.ξέσσεν: ξέω — scrape, plane, smooth; aor. 3 sg., epic -σσ-, unaugmented, ν-movable (= Attic ἔξεσε)
glossary.ξείνου: ξεῖνος — stranger, guest-friend (epic = Attic ξένος); masc. gen. sg.
glossary.οὖλον: οὖλος — whole, entire (Attic ὅλος); masc. acc. sg.
glossary.οὗτοι: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο — this; masc. nom. pl.: ’these’
glossary.πήρης: πήρη — wallet, beggar’s bag; fem. gen. sg.
glossary.παπτήνας: παπταίνω — look about, glance around; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having looked about’
glossary.περιῄδη: περίοιδα — know thoroughly, be skilled in (+ dat.); plpf. 3 sg., epic (= Attic περιῄδει): ’was exceedingly skilled’
glossary.προΐκτῃ: προΐκτης — beggar, one who asks alms; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.πύρνα: πύρνος (pl. πύρνα) — wheaten loaf; neut. acc. pl.: ’loaves’
glossary.σκηπτόμενος: σκήπτομαι — prop oneself, lean on a staff; pres. part. mid. masc. nom. sg.: ’propping himself’
glossary.συφορβός: συφορβός — swineherd (= συβώτης); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.τέκτονα: τέκτων — carpenter, builder; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.τέκτων: τέκτων — carpenter, builder; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.τέρπῃσιν: τέρπω — delight, give pleasure to; pres. subj. 3 sg., epic -ῃσιν (= Attic -ῃ), with κεν in a relative clause: ’who may delight’
glossary.ταχυτῆτα: ταχυτής — swiftness, speed; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.τηλέμαχόν: Τηλέμαχος — Telemachus, son of Odysseus; masc. acc. sg. (accented before enclitic μοι), subject of an infinitive in a wish
glossary.τοῦδε: ὅδε, ἥδε, τόδε — this; masc. gen. sg.: ’of this (man)’
glossary.τραπεζῆες: τραπεζεύς — of the table, kept at table; masc. nom. pl., epic -ῆες (= Attic -εῖς), qualifying κύνες
glossary.τρύξοντα: τρύχω — wear out, exhaust; fut. part. masc. acc. sg., of purpose: ’to wear down’
glossary.τῷδε: ὅδε, ἥδε, τόδε — this; masc./neut. dat. sg., agreeing with a noun
glossary.φησ: φημί — say; pres. 3 sg., elided (φησ’ = φησί): ’he says’
glossary.φύγεσκε: φεύγω — flee, escape; aor. 3 sg., iterative -σκε, unaugmented: ’would escape, used to escape’
glossary.χαλεπὸς: χαλεπός — harsh, hard to deal with; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀγαυούς: ἀγαυός — noble, illustrious; masc. acc. pl.
glossary.ἀγείροι: ἀγείρω — gather, collect; pres. opt. 3 sg., in a purpose clause with ὡς ἄν: ’that he might collect’
glossary.ἀγλαΐης: ἀγλαΐη — splendour, show, finery; fem. gen. sg., epic -ης (= Attic -ας)
glossary.ἀγόρευε: ἀγορεύω — speak, say; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἠγόρευε)
glossary.ἀεικελίης: ἀεικέλιος — unseemly, shabby; fem. gen. sg., epic -ης (= Attic -ας)
glossary.ἀθέμιστοι: ἀθέμιστος — lawless, regardless of right; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἀκηδέες: ἀκηδής — uncaring, negligent; masc./fem. nom. pl., uncontracted (= Attic ἀκηδεῖς)
glossary.ἀλέγω: ἀλέγω — care for, heed (mostly with a negative); pres. 1 sg.
glossary.ἀλήμονές: ἀλήμων — wandering, vagrant; masc. nom. pl., used as a noun: ’vagrants’
glossary.ἀμείβεο: ἀμείβομαι — answer, reply to (+ acc.); pres. imper. 2 sg. mid., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἀμείβου)
glossary.ἀμφιβαλόντι: ἀμφιβάλλω — throw round, put round; aor. part. masc. dat. sg.: ’having thrown (his hands) round’
glossary.ἀναγκαίῳ: ἀναγκαῖος — compelling, of necessity; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.ἀνιηροί: ἀνιηρός — troublesome, irksome, grievous; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἀπαλεξήσειν: ἀπαλέξω — ward off, keep off; fut. inf., after μέλλω: ’to ward off’
glossary.ἀποαίνυται: ἀπαίνυμαι (ἀποαίνυμαι) — take away, rob of (+ gen.); pres. 3 sg. mid., epic uncontracted
glossary.ἀπολυμαντῆρες: ἀπολυμαντήρ — despoiler, ruiner (cf. λύμη ’outrage’); masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἀρίγνωτε: ἀρίγνωτος — easily recognised, conspicuous; masc. voc. sg.
glossary.ἄνα: ἄναξ — lord, master; voc. sg., shortened epic form: ’lord!’ · also ἀνά (ἄνα) — up!; adv./interjection used as an imperative: ’up! get up!’ (ἀλλ’ ἄνα)
glossary.ἄργον: Ἄργος — Argus, name of Odysseus’ dog (cf. ἀργός ’swift, gleaming’); masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἄρτον: ἄρτος — loaf, bread; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἅζευ: ἅζομαι — shrink from, stand in awe of (+ acc.); pres. imper. 2 sg. mid., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἅζου)
glossary.ἐκάλεσσας: καλέω — call, invite; aor. 2 sg., epic -σσ- (= Attic ἐκάλεσας)
glossary.ἐλεαίροντες: ἐλεαίρω — pity, feel compassion for; pres. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’pitying’
glossary.ἐνδέξια: ἐνδέξιος — to the right; neut. acc. pl. as adv.: ’rightwards, towards the right’
glossary.ἐπαύετο: παύω — stop; mid. cease, leave off; impf. 3 sg. mid., augmented: ’was ceasing’
glossary.ἐποιχόμενον: ἐποίχομαι — go up to, go round; pres. part. mid. masc. acc. sg.: ’going round’
glossary.ἐφέζετο: ἐφέζομαι — sit down, take a seat; impf. 3 sg., aoristic sense (= Attic ἐκαθέζετο): ’sat down’
glossary.ἐφίζεσκε: ἐφίζω — sit, sit down; impf. 3 sg., iterative -σκε: ’used to sit’
glossary.ἐχάνδανον: χανδάνω — hold, contain; impf. 3 pl., augmented: ’were able to hold’
glossary.ἓ: ἕ, οὗ, οἷ — him, her, it(self); 3rd-person pron., acc. sg., reflexive, with αὐτόν: ’himself’
glossary.ἔπεσιν: ἔπος — word; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσιν (= Attic -εσι), ν-movable: ’with words’
glossary.ἕλῃσιν: αἱρέω — take, seize; aor. subj. 3 sg., epic -ῃσιν (= Attic ἕλῃ); with κατά, ’lay hold of’
glossary.ἰδόντ: ὁράω (aor. stem ἰδ-) — see; aor. part. masc. acc. sg., elided (ἰδόντ’ = ἰδόντα): ’having seen’
glossary.ἰητῆρα: ἰητήρ — healer, physician; masc. acc. sg. (Attic ἰατρός)
glossary.ἴχνεσι: ἴχνος — track, footprint; neut. dat. pl.
glossary.ὀρέξειαν: ὀρέγω — stretch out, offer; aor. opt. 3 pl., Aeolic -ειαν (= Attic ὀρέξαιεν), in a protasis: ’if they were to offer’
glossary.ὄλβιον: ὄλβιος — prosperous, fortunate; masc. acc. sg., predicate, in an infinitive wish
glossary.ὄνοσαι: ὄνομαι — make light of, scorn, find fault with; pres. 2 sg. mid., epic (= Attic ὄνῃ)
glossary.ὄπωπα: ὁράω — see; perf. 1 sg., epic stem ὀπ- with present force (= Attic ἑώρακα): ’I have seen’
glossary.βλήεται: βάλλω — throw, hit, strike; aor. subj. 3 sg. pass. (ἐβλήμην), epic -ηεται (= Attic βληθῇ): ’is struck’
glossary.βλεφάροιϊν: βλέφαρον — eyelid; neut. gen., probably dual, epic -οιϊν (= Attic -οιν), after ἐκ: ’from the eyelids’
glossary.βλημένου: βάλλω — throw, hit, strike; aor. part. pass. (ἐβλήμην) masc. gen. sg. (= Attic βληθέντος): ’of one struck’
glossary.γαστέρος: γαστήρ — belly, stomach; fem. gen. sg., uncontracted (= γαστρός)
glossary.γεύσεσθαι: γεύομαι — taste, make trial of (+ gen.); fut. inf. mid.: ’to taste, to partake of’
glossary.δεξιὸν: δεξιός — right, on the right hand; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.δμήτορι: Δμήτωρ — Dmetor, a lord of Cyprus; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.δόσκον: δίδωμι — give; iterative impf. 1 sg. in -σκ-, unaugmented (= Attic ἐδίδουν): ’I would give, used to give’
glossary.εἰλαπινάζων: εἰλαπινάζω — feast, banquet; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.
glossary.εὐνομίην: εὐνομίη — good order, lawfulness; fem. acc. sg., Ionic -ίη (= Attic εὐνομία)
glossary.εὐρυνόμη: Εὐρυνόμη — Eurynome, the housekeeper of Odysseus’s house; fem. nom. sg. · also fem. voc. sg., in address: ’Eurynome!’
glossary.ζώουσι: ζώω — live, be alive, prosper; pres. 3 pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ζῶσι)
glossary.θαλάμῳ: θάλαμος — inner room, bedchamber; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.θρήνυι: θρῆνυς — footstool; masc. dat. sg., instrumental: ’with a footstool’
glossary.κίνησε: κινέω — move, set in motion; aor. 3 sg. (κίνησε κάρη ’shook the head’)
glossary.κιχείη: κιχάνω — reach, overtake, come upon; aor. opt. 3 sg., athematic (ἔκιχον, κιχείην), in a wish: ’may it overtake’
glossary.κλείω: κλείω — make famous, tell of; pres. indic. or subj. 1 sg., epic (= Attic κλέω), with κε of future sense: ’I shall spread your fame’
glossary.κλυτότοξος: κλυτότοξος — famed for the bow, of the glorious bow; epithet of Apollo; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.κραδίῃ: κραδίη — heart; fem. dat. sg., Ionic -ίῃ (= Attic καρδία)
glossary.κτεάτεσσι: κτέαρ — possession, property (mostly pl.); neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic κτήμασι)
glossary.κύπρου: Κύπρος — Cyprus; fem. gen. sg., with ἄνασσεν: ’ruled over Cyprus’
glossary.ληϊστῆρσι: ληϊστήρ — raider, pirate; masc. dat. pl., epic -ηϊ- (= Attic ληστήρ)
glossary.λιπαροὺς: λιπαρός — shining with oil, sleek, glossy; masc. acc. pl.
glossary.λώϊον: λώϊος (comparative λωΐων) — better, more desirable (= Attic βέλτιον); neut. acc. sg., used as a noun: ’something better’
glossary.μαχειόμενος: μαχέομαι — fight, do battle; pres. part. masc. nom. sg., epic μαχειόμενος (= Attic μαχόμενος)
glossary.μεγάροιό: μέγαρον — hall, great room; neut. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου), after διέκ: ’out through the hall’
glossary.νεμέσησαν: νεμεσάω — be indignant, take offence; aor. 3 pl., unaugmented (= Attic ἐνεμέσησαν)
glossary.νῶτον: νῶτον — back; neut. acc. sg. (usually pl. νῶτα)
glossary.οὐλόμεν: οὐλόμενος — ruinous, destructive (part. of ὄλλυμι used as adj.; also a curse-word); masc. voc. sg., elided (οὐλόμεν’ = οὐλόμενε): ’you ruinous one!’
glossary.πάρεστιν: πάρειμι — be present, be at hand (παρά + εἰμί); pres. 3 sg., ν-movable
glossary.παντοῖοι: παντοῖος — of every kind, of all sorts; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.παρίστασαι: παρίσταμαι — stand beside, stand by (+ dat.); pres. 2 sg. mid. of παρίστημι
glossary.πικρὴν: πικρός — bitter, harsh, cruel; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.πλῆσαν: πίμπλημι — fill; aor. 3 pl., unaugmented (= Attic ἔπλησαν): ’they filled’
glossary.ποδὸς: πούς — foot; masc. gen. sg., gen. of the part seized: ’by the foot’ · also gen. sg. after ἅπτομαι ’touch’: ’(touch) the foot’ (ποδὸς ἅψεται)
glossary.πολυπλάγκτοισιν: πολύπλαγκτος — much-straying, far-roaming (from πλάζω ’drive astray’); masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις)
glossary.προΐκτης: προΐκτης — beggar, one who asks for gifts; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.προσήγαγε: προσάγω — bring to, bring upon; aor. 3 sg.
glossary.πρυμνότατον: πρυμνός — hindmost, at the very end or base; superlative πρυμνότατος, masc. acc. sg., agreeing with ὦμον: ’at its very base’
glossary.πρυμνὸν: πρυμνός — hindmost, at the end or base; masc. acc. sg., agreeing with ὦμον: ’at its base’
glossary.πτωχῶν: πτωχός — beggar; masc. gen. pl.: ’of beggars’
glossary.πόληας: πόλις — city; fem. acc. pl., epic -ηας (= Attic πόλεις)
glossary.στῆναι: ἵστημι — set, stand; aor. inf. act., intrans.: ’to stand, make a stand’ (= Attic στῆναι)
glossary.σφῆλεν: σφάλλω — trip up, make fall, bring down; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= Attic ἔσφηλεν)
glossary.τελέθοντες: τελέθω — be, come to be, prove; pres. part. masc. nom. pl. (poetic for εἰμί, γίγνομαι)
glossary.τοίῳ: τοῖος — of such a kind, such; masc. dat. sg., correlative of ὁποῖος: ’to such a one’
glossary.τραπέζης: τράπεζα — table; fem. gen. sg., of separation: ’from under’ after ὑπο-, ’away from’ after ἀπάνευθε
glossary.ἀλάπαξε: ἀλαπάζω — sack, plunder, lay waste; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= Attic ἠλάπαξε)
glossary.ἀλήτην: ἀλήτης — wanderer, vagrant, beggar; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀλήτῃ: ἀλήτης — wanderer, vagrant, beggar; masc. dat. sg.: ’to a beggar’
glossary.ἀλητεύει: ἀλητεύω — wander about, roam as a beggar; pres. 3 sg.
glossary.ἀλλοτρίοισι: ἀλλότριος — belonging to another, not one’s own; masc./neut. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις), as a noun: ’another’s (people or goods)’
glossary.ἀλλοτρίων: ἀλλότριος — belonging to another, not one’s own; masc./neut. gen. pl., as a noun: ’of what is another’s’
glossary.ἀναχωρήσας: ἀναχωρέω — go back, draw back, withdraw; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀναχωρήσειν: ἀναχωρέω — go back, draw back, withdraw; fut. inf. act., after ὀΐω: ’that you will go back’
glossary.ἀποδρύψωσι: ἀποδρύπτω — tear off, scratch off; aor. subj. 3 pl., after μή (’lest’)
glossary.ἀπολοίμην: ἀπόλλυμι — destroy; mid. perish, be lost; aor. opt. 1 sg. mid., in a purpose clause after ὄφρα: ’that I might perish’
glossary.ἀποπροελὼν: ἀποπροαιρέω — take away from, take off from (+ gen.); aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg. (aor. stem ἑλ-; Attic ἀφελών)
glossary.ἀργεννῇς: ἀργεννός — shining white, white; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῇς (= -ῇσι; Attic -αῖς), agreeing with ὀΐεσσιν
glossary.ἀρῇσιν: ἀρή — prayer, curse; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῇσιν (= Attic -αῖς)
glossary.ἀχρημοσύνη: ἀχρημοσύνη — want of means, poverty, need; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἄεξε: ἀέξω — make grow, increase, swell; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= Attic ηὔξανε)
glossary.ἄπιθ: ἄπειμι (εἶμι) — go away, depart; pres. imper. 2 sg., elided (ἄπιθ’ = ἄπιθι): ’go away!’
glossary.ἐΰθρονον: εὔθρονος — fair-throned, with a goodly seat; epithet of Dawn; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἐδείπνεε: δειπνέω — dine, take a meal; impf. 3 sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἐδείπνει)
glossary.ἐλεητὺς: ἐλεητύς — pity, compassion; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἐνέπλησάν: ἐμπίμπλημι — fill full, fill up; aor. 3 pl. (= ἐνέπλησαν), accented before the enclitic τε
glossary.ἐπίσχεσις: ἐπίσχεσις — holding back, restraint, check; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἐπιστάτῃ: ἐπιστάτης — one who stands by (cf. ἐφίστημι); perhaps a dependant or suppliant at one’s door, exact sense uncertain; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.ἐπιστρωφῶσι: ἐπιστρωφάω — turn about, range over, visit; pres. subj. 3 pl., contracted, in a general statement with τε: ’they go about’
glossary.ἐπουράνιος: ἐπουράνιος — in heaven, heavenly; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἐρύσσωσ: ἐρύω — drag, pull; aor. subj. 3 pl. act. (ἔρυσσα), elided (ἐρύσσωσ’ = ἐρύσσωσι), after μή: ’lest they drag’
glossary.ἐστάθη: ἵστημι — set, stand; aor. pass. 3 sg. in intrans. sense (= ἔστη): ’stood firm, stood still’
glossary.ἐφορῶντες: ἐφοράω — look upon, watch over, oversee; pres. part. masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἐχθροὶ: ἐχθρός — hated, hateful, hostile; masc. nom. pl., predicate
glossary.ἐχολώσατο: χολόομαι — be angry, grow wroth; aor. 3 sg. mid.: ’grew angry’
glossary.ἐϋπλείην: ἐΰπλειος — well filled, full; fem. acc. sg., agreeing with πήρην
glossary.ἔβαλες: βάλλω — throw, hit, strike; aor. 2 sg., augmented: ’you struck’
glossary.ἔδοσάν: δίδωμι — give; aor. 3 pl., epic (= Attic ἔδοσαν), accented before the enclitic τε
glossary.ἔοι: εἰμί — be; pres. opt. 3 sg., epic (= Attic εἴη)
glossary.ἔπεχεν: ἐπέχω — hold on, rest upon; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented, ν-movable (= Attic ἐπεῖχε)
glossary.ἔσθι: ἐσθίω (epic ἔσθω) — eat; pres. imper. 2 sg., elided (ἔσθι’ = ἔσθιε): ’eat!’
glossary.ἡμένη: ἧμαι — sit, be seated; pres. part. fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἡμετέρῃσι: ἡμέτερος — our; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι (= Attic -αις)
glossary.ἤκουσε: ἀκούω — hear, hear of (+ gen.); aor. 3 sg., augmented: ’heard’
glossary.ἰασίδῃ: Ἰασίδης — son of Iasus; masc. dat. sg., patronymic
glossary.ἵκω: ἱκνέομαι — come, arrive at, reach; pres. 1 sg. act. form, epic ἵκω (= Attic ἥκω): ’I come, I have come’
glossary.ὀΐεσσιν: ὄϊς — sheep; fem. dat. pl., epic -εσσιν (= Attic οἰσί)
glossary.ὁποῖος: ὁποῖος — of what sort, such as; relative adj., masc. nom. sg., correlative of τοῖος: ’such as’
glossary.ὅτευ: ὅστις — whoever, whatever; masc./neut. gen. sg., epic ὅτευ (= Attic ὅτου): ’of whatever’, with κεχρημένος
glossary.ὑπέφηνε: ὑποφαίνω — show from beneath, bring into view from below; aor. 3 sg.
glossary.ὤριστος: ἄριστος — best, noblest (superlative of ἀγαθός); masc. nom. sg., crasis ὁ ἄριστος (ὤριστος): ’the best’
glossary.αἰδεῖται: αἰδέομαι — feel shame, be shy of, respect; pres. 3 sg. mid., contracted (= uncontracted αἰδέεται): ’he is shy’
glossary.βοσκήσεις: βόσκω — feed, tend, graze; fut. 2 sg.: ’you will feed’
glossary.γέλασσε: γελάω — laugh; aor. 3 sg., epic -σσ-, unaugmented (= Attic ἐγέλασε)
glossary.γνώῃ: γιγνώσκω — get to know, recognise; aor. subj. 3 sg. act., epic -ώῃ (= Attic γνῷ): ’she may recognise’
glossary.δίφρου: δίφρος — stool, seat; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.δείελον: δείελος — of the evening, late in the day (Attic δειλινός); neut. nom. sg., agreeing with ἦμαρ: ’evening’
glossary.δεδαὼς: δάω — learn, be taught (cf. δαῆναι); perf. part. act. masc. nom. sg., epic: ’having learned, skilled’
glossary.δειελιήσας: δειελιάω — take the evening meal (sense inferred from δείελος ’evening’; ’spend the evening’ also given); aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having taken the evening meal’
glossary.διήνυσεν: διανύω — accomplish, get through, finish; aor. 3 sg.
glossary.εἰρέσθω: ἔρομαι — ask, inquire; aor. imper. 3 sg. mid., epic εἰρ- (= Attic ἐρέσθω): ’let her ask’
glossary.θέλγοιτό: θέλγω — enchant, charm, beguile; pres. opt. 3 sg. pass., potential with κε: ’would be charmed’; extra acute on the last syllable from the enclitic κε
glossary.κάλεσσον: καλέω — call, summon; aor. imper. 2 sg. act., epic -σσ- (= Attic κάλεσον)
glossary.καθίσασα: καθίζω — make sit, seat; aor. part. act. fem. nom. sg.: ’having seated’
glossary.καλέει: καλέω — call, summon; pres. 3 sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic καλεῖ)
glossary.κονάβησε: κοναβέω — ring, resound, clang; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐκονάβησε)
glossary.μεταλλῆσαί: μεταλλάω — inquire, ask about; aor. inf. act. (accent from the following enclitic): ’to ask’
glossary.οἰκῆες: οἰκεύς — member of a household, household servant; masc. nom. pl., epic -ῆες
glossary.οἴοιτο: οἴομαι — suppose, think; pres. opt. 3 sg. mid., potential with κε: ’would suppose’
glossary.πάθῃς: πάσχω — suffer, experience; aor. subj. 2 sg., in a fear clause after μή: ’lest you suffer’
glossary.πατρώϊος: πατρώϊος — of one’s father, inherited from one’s father; masc. nom. sg., epic (= Attic πατρῷος)
glossary.πεπαθυίῃ: πάσχω — suffer, experience; perf. part. act. fem. dat. sg., epic stem πεπαθ- (= Attic πεπονθυίᾳ): ’who has suffered’
glossary.πολυπλάγκτῳ: πολύπλαγκτος — much-wandering, far-roving (πλάζω ’drive astray’); masc./neut. dat. sg., after ἔοικε
glossary.ποτιδέρκεται: ποτιδέρκομαι — look at, gaze at; pres. 3 sg. mid., epic ποτι- (= πρός)
glossary.προπροκυλινδόμενος: προπροκυλίνδομαι — roll oneself forward, grovel along; pres. part. mid. masc. nom. sg.
glossary.πρῶθ: πρῶτος — first; neut. acc. pl. used adverbially, elided and aspirated before a rough breathing (πρῶθ’ = πρῶτα): ’first’
glossary.σιωπήσειαν: σιωπάω — be silent; aor. opt. 3 pl. in -σειαν (= -σαιεν), in a wish after εἰ γάρ: ’would that they were silent’
glossary.στεῦται: στεῦμαι — stand forth as promising, declare, claim (defective); 3 sg. στεῦται, + inf.: ’he declares’
glossary.τρία: τρεῖς, τρία — three; neut. nom./acc. pl.
glossary.φρονέουσιν: φρονέω — think, have in mind; pres. 3 pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic φρονοῦσι)
glossary.φυλάξων: φυλάσσω — guard, keep watch over; fut. part. act. masc. nom. sg., of purpose: ’to guard’
glossary.χαλεπῶν: χαλεπός — hard, harsh, grievous; masc. gen. pl.
glossary.χρηΐζεις: χρηΐζω — need, be in want of (+ gen.); pres. 2 sg., epic χρηΐζ- (= Attic χρῄζεις)
glossary.ἀγορεύων: ἀγορεύω — speak, tell, recount; pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’telling’
glossary.ἀείδῃ: ἀείδω — sing; pres. subj. 3 sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic ᾄδῃ), general temporal clause: ’whenever he sings’
glossary.ἀκήρατα: ἀκήρατος — untouched, unharmed, intact; neut. nom./acc. pl.
glossary.ἀλήτης: ἀλήτης — wanderer, vagrant, beggar (ἀλάομαι ’wander’); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀλυσκάζων: ἀλυσκάζω — shun, keep avoiding (cf. ἀλύσκω); pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’avoiding’
glossary.ἀλύξει: ἀλύσκω — escape, shun; fut. 3 sg. (ἀλύξω): ’will escape’
glossary.ἀνεδέγμεθ: ἀναδέχομαι — take upon oneself, undergo; aor. 1 pl. mid., athematic (ἐδέγμην), elided (ἀνεδέγμεθ’ = ἀνεδέγμεθα)
glossary.ἀποδράς: ἀποδιδράσκω — run away, escape; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg. (ἀπέδραν): ’having run away’
