glossary.ἀσσοτέρω: ἀσσότερος — nearer; adv., comparative of ἄγχι (cf. ἆσσον): ’nearer’
glossary.ἀτελὴς: ἀτελής — unfulfilled, without effect (ἀ- + τέλος); masc./fem. nom. sg., agreeing with θάνατος
glossary.ἄπειμι: ἄπειμι (ἀπό + εἶμι) — go away; pres. 1 sg. · also ἄπειμι (ἀπό + εἰμί) — be away, be absent; pres. 1 sg.
glossary.ἐΰφρων: εὔφρων — cheerful, glad (lit. good-minded); masc./fem. nom. sg., epic ἐΰ- (= Attic εὔ-)
glossary.ἐνέποιμι: ἐνέπω — tell, relate, speak; pres. opt. 1 sg., potential with κε: ’I would tell’
glossary.ἐνέποντα: ἐνέπω — tell, relate, speak; pres. part. act. masc. acc. sg.: ’telling’
glossary.ἐξολέσειε: ἐξόλλυμι — destroy utterly; aor. opt. 3 sg. act., in a wish: ’may he destroy’ (-σειε = -σαι)
glossary.ἐπέπταρε: ἐπιπτάρνυμαι — sneeze at, sneeze in response; aor. 3 sg., without the movable ν (cf. ἔπταρεν)
glossary.ἐπήρκεσεν: ἐπαρκέω — ward off from, defend, help; aor. 3 sg., + acc. of what is warded off
glossary.ἐπακοῦσαι: ἐπακούω — listen to, hear (+ gen.); aor. inf. act.
glossary.ἐπειγομένην: ἐπείγω — press, urge on; mid. hasten, be eager; pres. part. mid./pass. fem. acc. sg.: ’being eager’
glossary.ἐρέωμαι: ἔρομαι — ask, inquire; subj. 1 sg. mid., epic ἐρέωμαι (= Attic ἔρωμαι): ’I may ask’
glossary.ἐϋξέστου: εὔξεστος — well-polished, well-planed; masc. gen. sg., epic ἐϋ- (= Attic εὔ-), agreeing with δίφρου
glossary.ἑψιαάσθων: ἑψιάομαι — amuse oneself, play, make merry; pres. imper. 3 pl. mid., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἑψιάσθων)
glossary.ἔθελγε: θέλγω — enchant, charm, beguile; impf. 3 sg., augmented: ’was enchanting’
glossary.ἔπταρεν: πτάρνυμαι — sneeze; aor. 3 sg., ν-movable form (ἔπταρε(ν)): ’sneezed’
glossary.ἔρυξα: ἐρύκω — hold back, keep, detain; aor. 1 sg.: ’I kept’
glossary.ἔρχεό: ἔρχομαι — go, come; pres. imper. 2 sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἔρχου), extra acute on the last syllable from the following enclitic
glossary.ἱμερόεντα: ἱμερόεις — lovely, charming, arousing longing (ἵμερος ’longing’); neut. acc. pl. (with ἔπεα) · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with χορόν: ’full of longing, lovely’ (χορὸν ἱμερόεντα)
glossary.ἵκοιτ: ἱκνέομαι — come, arrive at, reach; aor. opt. 3 sg., elided (ἵκοιτ’ = ἵκοιτο), in a condition: ’should reach’
glossary.ὀΐεται: ὀΐομαι — suppose, think; pres. 3 sg. mid., epic (= Attic οἴεται)
glossary.ὀδύνῃσιν: ὀδύνη — pain, grief; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσιν (= Attic -αις)
glossary.ὀϊζύν: ὀϊζύς — misery, woe, distress; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ὁράᾳς: ὁράω — see; pres. 2 sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic ὁρᾷς)
glossary.ὑποδείδι: ὑποδείδω — be afraid of, dread (+ acc.); perf. 1 sg. ὑποδείδια with pres. sense, elided (ὑποδείδι’): ’I fear’
glossary.ῥέξαντα: ῥέζω — do, act, perform; aor. part. act. masc. acc. sg.: ’having done’
glossary.αἰνεῖτον: αἰνέω — praise, approve; pres. 3 dual (ἐπὶ … αἰνεῖτον in tmesis = Attic ἐπαινεῖτον); the 2 dual has the same form
glossary.αἰσχύνομαι: αἰσχύνομαι — be ashamed, feel shame; pres. 1 sg. mid./pass. deponent
glossary.αἰτήσοντα: αἰτέω — ask, beg; fut. part. act. masc. acc. sg.: ’about to beg, to beg’, expressing purpose
glossary.αἵδ: ὅδε, ἥδε, τόδε — this (here); demonstrative pron., fem. nom. pl., elided (αἵδ’ = αἵδε): ’these here’
glossary.αὐχέν: αὐχήν — neck; masc. acc. sg., elided (αὐχέν’ = αὐχένα)
glossary.βαρείῃ: βαρύς — heavy, weighty; fem. dat. sg., Ionic -είῃ (= Attic βαρείᾳ)
glossary.βουγάϊε: βουγάϊος — braggart (a guess; meaning not known); masc. voc. sg., a term of abuse
glossary.βραχίονες: βραχίων — upper arm, arm; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.γέλῳ: γέλως — laughter; masc. dat. sg. γέλῳ (= Attic γέλωτι): ’with laughter’
glossary.γαστέρες: γαστήρ — belly, stomach, paunch; fem. nom. pl.
glossary.γελόωντες: γελάω — laugh; pres. part. act. masc. nom. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic γελῶντες)
glossary.γενετῆς: γενετή — birth; fem. gen. sg.: ἐκ γενετῆς ’from birth’
glossary.γρηῒ: γρηῦς — old woman; fem. dat. sg., epic (= Attic γραΐ, from γραῦς)
glossary.δάσασθαι: δατέομαι — divide, share out, carve up; aor. inf. mid. (same form in Attic): ’to divide among themselves’
glossary.δαμείω: δάμνημι — overpower, subdue; aor. pass. subj. 1 sg., epic lengthened vowel (= Attic δαμῶ): ’I be overpowered’
glossary.δείδιας: δείδω — fear; perf. 2 sg. with present sense (= Attic δέδιας): ’you fear’
glossary.δείδιθ: δείδω — fear; perf. imper. 2 sg., elided (δείδιθ’ = δείδιθι, Attic δέδιθι): ’fear!’, in a prohibition with μή
glossary.δειδιότα: δείδω — fear; perf. part. act. masc. acc. sg., epic (= Attic δεδιότα): ’frightened’
glossary.δηλήμονα: δηλήμων — destroyer, harmer; masc. acc. sg., in apposition
glossary.διώκετο: διώκω — pursue, drive away; impf. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented (= ἐδιώκετο), + gen. of the place driven from
glossary.δολοφρονέων: δολοφρονέω — have guile in the mind, plot craftily; pres. part. masc. nom. sg., uncontracted (= Attic δολοφρονῶν)
glossary.δόρπῳ: δόρπον — evening meal, supper; neut. dat. sg.
glossary.δύῃ: δύη — woe, distress; fem. dat. sg., Ionic (= Attic δύᾳ): ’by misery’
glossary.εἶκε: εἴκω — yield, give way (+ gen. of what one yields from); pres. imper. 2 sg.: ’give way!’
glossary.ζώσαντες: ζώννυμι — gird, bind with a belt; aor. part. act. masc. nom. pl.: ’having girded’
glossary.ζώσατο: ζώννυμι — gird; aor. 3 sg. mid.: ’girded himself’
glossary.ζῶσαι: ζώννυμι — gird; aor. imper. mid. 2 sg.: ’gird yourself!’
glossary.θείνῃ: θείνω — strike, hit; pres. subj. 3 sg., in a prospective relative clause with κε: ’who shall strike’
glossary.κέατ: κεῖμαι — lie, be laid; pres. 3 pl., epic κέαται elided (= Attic κεῖνται): ’they lie’
glossary.κίκλησκον: καλέω (κικλήσκω) — call, name; impf. 3 pl. of the reduplicated present κικλήσκω, unaugmented (= Attic ἐκάλουν): ’they used to call’
glossary.κακοείμονας: κακοείμων — ill-clad, wearing wretched clothes; masc. acc. pl.
glossary.κακοεργός: κακοεργός — doing evil, mischief-making; fem. nom. sg. of a 2-ending adj.
glossary.καλούς: καλός — beautiful, fair, fine; masc. acc. pl.
glossary.καμινοῖ: καμινώ — furnace-woman, a woman who tends the furnace (exact sense uncertain); fem. dat. sg. of a noun in -ώ (dat. -οῖ)
glossary.κατθέμεθα: κατατίθημι — put down, set aside; aor. 1 pl. mid., unaugmented, with κατ- for κατά by apocope (= Attic κατεθέμεθα)
glossary.κοίρανος: κοίρανος — ruler, commander; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.κρείσσων: κρατύς — strong; comparative κρείσσων, stronger, mightier (= Attic κρείττων); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.κόπτων: κόπτω — strike, beat; pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’beating’
glossary.λακτίζων: λακτίζω — kick; pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’kicking’
glossary.ληϊβοτείρης: ληϊβότειρα — crop-devouring, grazing the crops; fem. gen. sg., epic adj.
glossary.λυγρὸς: λυγρός — grievous, baneful, sorry; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.μάργῃ: μάργος — raging, greedy, frenzied; fem. dat. sg.
glossary.μάχοιο: μάχομαι — fight (epic μαχέομαι); pres. opt. 2 sg., potential with ἄν: ’would you fight?’
glossary.μέλεσσιν: μέλος — limb; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσι(ν) (= Attic μέλεσιν)
glossary.μέλλουσιν: μέλλω — be about to, be likely to (+ inf.); pres. 3 pl.
glossary.μήδεά: μῆδος — plan, counsel; in the pl. also the genitals; neut. acc. pl. (accent from the following enclitic)
glossary.μίσγεσθαι: μίγνυμι (μίσγω) — mix, mingle; pres. inf. mid.: ’to mingle with, join’
glossary.μαρναμένους: μάρναμαι — fight; pres. part. mid. masc. acc. pl.: ’fighting’
glossary.μαχέσσασθαι: μάχομαι — fight; aor. inf. mid., epic -σσ- (= Attic μαχέσασθαι), + dat. ’fight with’
glossary.μαχήσεται: μάχομαι — fight; fut. 3 sg. (= Attic μαχεῖται), + dat. ’will fight against’
glossary.μεταδαίσεται: μεταδαίνυμαι — feast among, share the meal with (root disputed, rare); 3 sg. mid., fut. or short-vowel aor. subj.
glossary.μετεφώνει: μεταφωνέω — speak among, address; impf. 3 sg., contracted (= Ionic μετεφώνεε)
glossary.μητισαίμην: μητίομαι — plan, devise; aor. opt. 1 sg. mid., potential with ἄν: ’I would devise (evils)’
glossary.μολοβρὸς: μολοβρός — glutton, scrounger (meaning uncertain, a word of abuse); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.νεικείων: νεικέω — quarrel with, revile; pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg., epic (= Attic νεικῶν)
glossary.νεωτέρῳ: νέος — young; comparative νεώτερος, younger; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.νικήσῃ: νικάω — win, conquer; aor. subj. 3 sg., after κε/αἴ κεν: ’shall win’
glossary.ξεινοδόκος: ξεινοδόκος — host, one who receives guests (Ionic = Attic ξενοδόκος); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ξεστοῦ: ξεστός — polished, smoothed; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.ξυνέηχ: συνίημι — hear, perceive; aor. 3 sg., epic ξυν- (= σύν), elided (ξυνέηχ’ = ξυνέηκε = Attic συνῆκε), + gen.
glossary.ξυνελάσσομεν: συνελαύνω — drive together, set (men) against each other; aor. subj. 1 pl., epic ξυν-, -σσ-, short vowel (= Attic συνελάσωμεν), hortative: ’let us set them together’
glossary.οἵην: οἷος — such as, what a (exclamatory); fem. acc. sg.: ’such a, what a’
glossary.οὔατος: οὖς — ear; neut. gen. sg., epic (= Attic ὠτός)
glossary.πανδήμιος: πανδήμιος — of the whole people, public, common to all; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.πανθυμαδὸν: πανθυμαδόν — with all one’s heart and spirit, wholeheartedly; adv.
glossary.πεπνυμένω: πέπνυμαι (πινύσκω) — be wise, prudent; perf. part. masc. nom. dual: ’(both) prudent’
glossary.περιτρομέοντο: περιτρομέομαι — tremble all over; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented, epic uncontracted
glossary.πεσόντα: πίπτω — fall; aor. part. act. masc. acc. sg.: ’having fallen’
glossary.πλήξῃ: πλήσσω — strike; aor. subj. 3 sg., after μή: ’lest he strike’
glossary.πληγῇσι: πληγή — blow, stroke; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῇσι (= Attic πληγαῖς)
glossary.ποδός: πούς — foot; masc. gen. sg., gen. of the part seized: ’by the foot’
glossary.προθύρου: πρόθυρον — forecourt, gateway before the house-door; neut. gen. sg. in -ου (epic -οιο), gen. of separation
glossary.προκαλίζεο: προκαλίζομαι — challenge, provoke; pres. imper. mid. 2 sg., uncontracted (= Attic προκαλίζου)
glossary.πτωχεύεσκ: πτωχεύω — beg, be a beggar; iterative impf. 3 sg. in -σκε(ν), elided: ’used to beg’
glossary.στήθεά: στῆθος — breast, chest; neut. nom./acc. pl., uncontracted (= Attic στήθη)
glossary.στιβαροί: στιβαρός — stout, sturdy, strong; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.συὸς: σῦς (ὗς) — swine, pig, sow; masc./fem. gen. sg.
glossary.τάμῃσι: τέμνω — cut; aor. subj. 3 sg., epic ending -σι (= Attic τέμῃ), in a prospective relative clause: ’shall cut’
glossary.τανύσσειέν: τανύω — stretch out; aor. opt. 3 sg., epic -σσ-, with movable ν (= τανύσειε): ’should stretch out’
glossary.τερπωλὴν: τερπωλή — delight, amusement, entertainment; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.τοῖϊν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun); gen./dat. dual ’of/to the two of them’, epic (= Attic τοῖν)
glossary.τοῦτόν: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο — this; masc. acc. sg. (accent from the following enclitic)
glossary.τρομέεις: τρομέω — tremble, tremble before; pres. 2 sg., uncontracted (= Attic τρομεῖς), + acc.
glossary.τρόμος: τρόμος — trembling, quaking; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.φάνεν: φαίνω — show; aor. pass. 3 pl., epic -εν (= ἐφάνησαν): ’appeared, showed themselves’
glossary.φαίνει: φαίνω — show, bring to light; pres. 3 sg.
glossary.φθονέειν: φθονέω — begrudge, grudge (+ gen. of the thing); pres. inf., uncontracted (= Attic φθονεῖν)
glossary.φοίνιον: φοίνιος — blood-red, bloody; neut. acc. sg.
glossary.φύρσω: φύρω — mix, smear, defile; aor. subj. 1 sg., short vowel, after μή: ’lest I smear’
glossary.χείσεται: χανδάνω — hold, contain; fut. 3 sg. mid. (χείσομαι): ’will hold, have room for’
glossary.χολώσῃς: χολόω — anger, enrage; aor. subj. 2 sg., after μή (prohibition): ’do not enrage’
glossary.ἀΐεις: ἀΐω — perceive, hear, notice; pres. 2 sg.: ’you perceive’
glossary.ἀγάσαντο: ἀγάομαι — marvel at, be astonished; aor. 3 pl. mid., unaugmented (= ἠγάσαντο)
glossary.ἀζηχὲς: ἀζηχής — unceasing, incessant; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’unceasingly’
glossary.ἀλέξασθαι: ἀλέξω — ward off, defend oneself against; aor. inf. mid., + acc.
glossary.ἀλλήλοιϊν: ἀλλήλων — one another; masc. dat. dual, epic -οιϊν (= Attic ἀλλήλοιν): ’with each other’
glossary.ἀνέσχον: ἀνέχω — hold up, raise; aor. 3 pl. (also 1 sg.): ’they held up’
glossary.ἀνήϊξαν: ἀναΐσσω — spring up, leap up; aor. 3 pl., epic (= Attic ἀνῇξαν)
glossary.ἀνακλίνας: ἀνακλίνω — lean back, prop up; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having leaned (him) back’
glossary.ἀνασχομένω: ἀνέχομαι — hold up (one’s own); aor. part. mid. masc. nom. dual: ’having raised (their hands)’
glossary.ἀνασχόμενοι: ἀνέχομαι — hold up (one’s own); aor. part. mid. masc. nom. pl.: ’having raised (their hands)’
glossary.ἀνελόντα: ἀναιρέω — take up, pick up; aor. part. act. masc. acc. sg.: ’having taken up’
glossary.ἀντίνοός: Ἀντίνοος — Antinous, a leading suitor; masc. nom. sg. (accent from the following enclitic)
glossary.ἀπαγγέλλεσκε: ἀπαγγέλλω — report, carry word; iterative impf. 3 sg. in -σκε(ν): ’used to carry messages’
glossary.ἀπερύκων: ἀπερύκω — keep off, hold back; pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’keeping off’
glossary.ἀρναῖος: Ἀρναῖος — Arnaeus, the beggar’s birth-name (later replaced by Ἶρος); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀτασθάλλων: ἀτασθάλλω — act recklessly, be wanton or presumptuous; pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἄϊρος: Ἄϊρος — ’Un-Irus’ (ἀ- privative + Ἶρος), a mocking coined name: ’Irus no more’; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἐλάσαι: ἐλαύνω — drive, strike; aor. inf. act. (same form in Attic): ’to strike’
glossary.ἐλάσει: ἐλαύνω — drive, strike; aor. opt. 3 sg., elided (ἐλάσει’ = ἐλάσειε), in a deliberation · also fut. 3 sg. (unelided): ’he will drive’
glossary.ἐμπλήσαντες: ἐμπίπλημι — fill (+ gen. of the filling); aor. part. act. masc. nom. pl.: ’having filled’
glossary.ἐνταυθοῖ: ἐνταυθοῖ — here, to this very spot; adv., Attic-looking form
glossary.ἐξελάσαιμι: ἐξελαύνω — drive out, knock out; aor. opt. 1 sg., potential with κε: ’I would knock out’
glossary.ἐξερύσας: ἐξερύω — draw out, tear out; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having torn out’
glossary.ἐπίσπαστον: ἐπίσπαστος — drawn on, brought upon oneself; masc./neut. acc. sg.
glossary.ἐπαύρῃ: ἐπαυρίσκομαι — get, meet with (a good or ill); aor. subj. 2 sg. mid., after μή: ’lest you meet with’
glossary.ἐπιγνώωσι: ἐπιγιγνώσκω — recognize, perceive; aor. subj. 3 pl., epic lengthened (= Attic ἐπιγνῶσι)
glossary.ἐπιλλίζουσιν: ἐπιλλίζω — wink at, make signs at with the eyes; pres. 3 pl.
glossary.ἐπιτροχάδην: ἐπιτροχάδην — glibly, fluently, ’at a run’; adv.
glossary.ἐπιφρασσαίατ: ἐπιφράζομαι — notice, take note of; aor. opt. 3 pl. mid., epic -αίατο (= -αιντο), elided
glossary.ἐρίζετον: ἐρίζω — rival, strive; pres. 3 dual (2 dual has the same form): ’the two rival each other’
glossary.ἑλέσθω: αἱρέω — take; aor. imper. mid. 3 sg.: ’let him take (for himself)’
glossary.ἑλκέμεναι: ἕλκω — drag, pull; pres. inf., epic -έμεναι (= Attic ἕλκειν)
glossary.ἑρκίον: ἑρκίον — fence, enclosing wall; neut. acc. sg. (diminutive of ἕρκος)
glossary.ἔθλασεν: θλάω — crush, smash; aor. 3 sg. act.
glossary.ἔκθανον: ἐκθνῄσκω — die, die away; aor. 3 pl. (also 1 sg.), unaugmented (= Attic ἐξέθανον)
glossary.ἔλασσεν: ἐλαύνω — drive, strike; aor. 3 sg., epic -σσ- (= Attic ἤλασε)
glossary.ἔπρεπε: πρέπω — stand out, be conspicuous; impf. 3 sg.
glossary.ἔρις: ἔρις — strife, quarrel, contest; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἔχετον: Ἔχετος — Echetus, a cruel king of the mainland; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἕλκε: ἕλκω — drag, pull; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= εἷλκε)
glossary.ἕλκῃ: ἕλκω — drag, pull; pres. subj. 3 sg., after μή: ’lest he drag’ · also pres. subj. 2 sg. mid./pass. (= ἕλκηαι): ’lest you be dragged’
glossary.ἡσυχίη: ἡσυχίη — quiet, calm, peace; fem. nom. sg., Ionic (= Attic ἡσυχία)
glossary.ἤλασ: ἐλαύνω — drive, strike; aor. 3 sg., elided (ἤλασ’ = ἤλασε)
glossary.ἤλδανε: ἀλδαίνω — make grow, strengthen; aor. 3 sg., augmented (ἤλδανε)
glossary.ἦκ: ἦκα — gently, softly, lightly; adv., elided (ἦκ’ = ἦκα)
glossary.ἴρῳ: Ἶρος — Irus, the town beggar; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.ἶρον: Ἶρος — Irus, the town beggar; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἶρος: Ἶρος — Irus, the town beggar; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ὀκριόωντο: ὀκριάομαι — bluster, bandy angry words (exact sense uncertain); impf. 3 pl., epic uncontracted -όωντο (Attic ὀκριῶντο)
glossary.ὀπάζειν: ὀπάζω — grant, bestow, give as a follower; pres. inf. act.
glossary.ὁππότερος: ὁππότερος — whichever of the two; masc. nom. sg., indefinite relative (= Attic ὁπότερος)
glossary.ὑποστρέψεσθαι: ὑποστρέφω — turn back, return; fut. inf. mid.: ’to return’
glossary.ὠμὰ: ὠμός — raw, uncooked; neut. acc. pl.
glossary.ὠρίνετο: ὀρίνω — stir up, agitate; impf. 3 sg. pass., augmented: ’was stirred, was shaken’
glossary.ῥάκεσιν: ῥάκος — rag, tattered cloth; neut. dat. pl. (= ῥάκεσι(ν))
glossary.ῥέζω: ῥέζω — do, work, act (to someone, with double acc.); pres. 1 sg.
glossary.ῥακέων: ῥάκος — rag, tattered cloth; neut. gen. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ῥακῶν)
glossary.αἰνοπαθῆ: αἰνοπαθής — suffering terribly, sorely afflicted (αἰνός + the root of πάσχω); masc./fem. acc. sg., contracted (= αἰνοπαθέα)
glossary.αἰῶνα: αἰών — life, lifetime; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.αἴθε: αἴθε — would that, if only; epic particle introducing a wish (= Attic εἴθε)
glossary.αὐτονόην: Αὐτονόη — Autonoe, a maid of Penelope’s household; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.γένοιτό: γίγνομαι — become, happen; aor. opt. 3 sg., in a wish, accented before the enclitic τοι: ’may it be’
glossary.γελώοντες: γελάω — laugh; pres. part. masc. nom. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic γελῶντες)
glossary.γενειήσαντα: γενειάω — grow a beard, reach manhood; aor. part. act. masc. acc. sg.: ’having grown a beard’
glossary.γρηῢς: γρηῦς — old woman; fem. nom. sg., epic (= Attic γραῦς)
glossary.δακρύοισι: δάκρυ (δάκρυον) — tear; neut. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic δάκρυσι)
glossary.δειδίσκετο: δειδίσκομαι — greet, welcome with a gesture such as a raised cup; impf. 3 sg. mid./dep., unaugmented (= ἐδειδίσκετο); exact sense disputed
glossary.δεικανόωντ: δεικανάομαι — greet with a gesture, welcome (perhaps mockingly); impf. 3 pl. mid./dep., elided and uncontracted (δεικανόωντ’ = δεικανόωντο)
glossary.διακρινέεσθαι: διακρίνω — separate, decide; fut. mid./pass. inf., uncontracted (= Attic διακρινεῖσθαι): ’to be settled, to part’
glossary.δουλιχιῆα: Δουλιχιεύς — man of Dulichium, Dulichian; masc. acc. sg., epic -ῆα (= Attic -έα)
glossary.εἴσειμι: εἴσειμι (εἰς + εἶμι) — go in, go among; pres. 1 sg. with future sense: ’I shall go’
glossary.θησαίατ: θηέομαι — gaze at, gaze at with wonder; aor. opt. mid. 3 pl., epic -αίατο (= θηήσαιντο), elided (θησαίατ’ = θησαίατο)
glossary.κάθηρεν: καθαίρω — cleanse, purify; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐκάθηρεν)
glossary.κάκιον: κακός — bad, evil; comparative κακίων, neut. nom./acc. sg.: ’worse’
glossary.κακοῖς: κακός — bad, evil; neut. dat. pl. used as a noun: ’(by) evils, troubles’
glossary.κασιγνήτοισι: κασίγνητος — brother; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
glossary.κατέβαιν: καταβαίνω — go down, descend; impf. 3 sg., elided (κατέβαιν’ = κατέβαινε)
glossary.κείροντας: κείρω — shear, cut off; waste, devour; pres. part. masc. acc. pl.
glossary.κηδομένη: κήδομαι — care for, be concerned; pres. part. mid./dep. fem. nom. sg.
glossary.κλεηδόνι: κλεηδών — omen, a chance word heard and taken as a sign (from κλέος ’report’); fem. dat. sg.
glossary.κλιντῆρι: κλιντήρ — couch, seat to recline on (from κλίνω); masc. dat. sg.
glossary.κοσμήτορι: κοσμήτωρ — marshaller, one who arranges and orders (from κοσμέω); masc. dat. sg.
glossary.κυθέρεια: Κυθέρεια — Cytherea, name of Aphrodite (from the island Cythera); fem. nom. sg.
glossary.κῶμ: κῶμα — deep sleep, slumber; neut. acc. sg., elided (κῶμ’ = κῶμα)
glossary.λευκοτέρην: λευκός — white; comparative λευκότερος, fem. acc. sg.: ’whiter’
glossary.μέλαθρον: μέλαθρον — roof-beam, roof; the roof standing for the house; neut. acc. sg.
glossary.μακροτέρην: μακρός — long, tall; comparative μακρότερος, fem. acc. sg.: ’taller’
glossary.μηχανόωντας: μηχανάομαι — devise, contrive; pres. part. mid./dep. masc. acc. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic μηχανωμένους)
glossary.νῖσον: Νῖσος — Nisus, father of Amphinomus; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.πίσυνος: πίσυνος — trusting, relying on (+ dat.); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.παρέχωσι: παρέχω — furnish, grant; pres. subj. 3 pl.
glossary.παρστήετον: παρίστημι — stand beside, stand by; aor. subj. dual 3, epic uncontracted (= Attic παραστῆτον)
glossary.πενθήμεναι: πενθέω — grieve, mourn; pres. inf., epic -ήμεναι (= Attic πενθεῖν)
glossary.πετάσειε: πετάννυμι — spread out, open wide; aor. opt. 3 sg.
glossary.πνείει: πνέω — breathe; pres. 3 sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic πνεῖ)
glossary.ποθέουσα: ποθέω — long for, miss (+ acc. or gen.); pres. part. fem. nom. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic ποθοῦσα)
glossary.πολέεσσι: πολύς — much, many; neut./masc. dat. pl., epic -έεσσι (= Attic πολλοῖς)
glossary.πριστοῦ: πριστός — sawn, cut with a saw; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.προσώπατα: πρόσωπον — face; neut. acc. pl., epic -ατα (= Attic πρόσωπα), plural for one face
glossary.πόσιός: πόσις — husband; masc. gen. sg., accented before the enclitic τε
glossary.τελέσωσι: τελέω — bring to pass, accomplish; aor. subj. 3 pl.
glossary.τιμήεσσα: τιμήεις — honoured, held in honour; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.τοὔνεκά: τοὔνεκα (τοῦ + ἕνεκα, crasis) — therefore, for that reason; adv., accented before the enclitic τοι
glossary.φθινύθω: φθινύθω — waste away, consume (epic by-form of φθίνω); pres. subj. 1 sg. (same form as the indic.); intrans. ’waste away’, or with an acc. ’consume’
glossary.φθόγγῳ: φθόγγος — voice, sound; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.φρονέουσι: φρονέω — think, have in mind; pres. 3 pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic φρονοῦσι)
glossary.χαῖρεν: χαίρω — rejoice; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented, ν-movable (= ἔχαιρε), + dat. of cause: ’rejoiced at’
glossary.χρίεται: χρίω — anoint, smear; pres. 3 sg. mid.: ’anoints herself’
glossary.χρῶτ: χρώς — skin, flesh; masc. acc. sg., elided (χρῶτ’ = χρῶτα)
glossary.ἀγγελέουσα: ἀγγέλλω — announce, bear a message; fut. part. act. fem. nom. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἀγγελοῦσα), of purpose: ’to announce’
glossary.ἀγλαΐην: ἀγλαΐη — splendour, beauty (from ἀγλαός); fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀεκαζόμενος: ἀεκάζομαι — act against one’s will, be unwilling (from ἀέκων); pres. part. mid./dep. masc. nom. sg.: ’unwillingly’
glossary.ἀθεμίστιος: ἀθεμίστιος — lawless, disregarding θέμις ’established right’; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀκιδνότερον: ἀκιδνός — slight, feeble, of little account (derivation not known); comparative ἀκιδνότερος, neut. nom./acc. sg.: ’slighter’
glossary.ἀλητεύειν: ἀλητεύω — wander, roam as a vagrant; pres. inf.
glossary.ἀλοιφῇ: ἀλοιφή — ointment, anything smeared on (fat, oil); fem. dat. sg., instrumental
glossary.ἀμβροσίῳ: ἀμβρόσιος — ambrosial, divine, deathless; masc./neut. dat. sg.
glossary.ἀμφίνομ: Ἀμφίνομος — Amphinomus, one of the suitors; masc. voc. sg., elided (Ἀμφίνομ’ = Ἀμφίνομε)
glossary.ἀνάξομεν: ἀνάγω — lead up, take away (as by sea); fut. 1 pl.
glossary.ἀναιμωτί: ἀναιμωτί — without bloodshed; adv. (ἀ- privative + αἷμα)
glossary.ἀνθρώποιο: ἄνθρωπος — human being, man; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.ἀντιάσειας: ἀντιάω — meet, encounter (+ dat.); aor. opt. 2 sg. (-ειας = -αις)
glossary.ἀπέπαυσας: ἀποπαύω — stop, make cease (from); aor. 2 sg. act.
glossary.ἀπέσσεσθαι: ἄπειμι (εἰμί) — be away, be absent; fut. inf., epic -σσ- (= Attic ἀπέσεσθαι)
glossary.ἀπεβήσετο: ἀποβαίνω — go away, depart; aor. 3 sg. mid., epic -ήσετο (= ἀπέβη)
glossary.ἀπεχθομένοισί: ἀπέχθομαι — be hated, be hateful (to); pres. part. mid./pass. masc./neut. dat. pl., epic -οισι, accented before the enclitic περ
glossary.ἀπονίπτεσθαι: ἀπονίζω (ἀπονίπτω) — wash off; mid. wash oneself, wash one’s own skin; pres. inf. mid.
glossary.ἀπονιψαμένη: ἀπονίζω (ἀπονίπτω) — wash off; mid. wash from oneself; aor. part. mid. fem. nom. sg.: ’having washed’
glossary.ἀρετήν: ἀρετή — excellence, merit; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀτάσθαλ: ἀτάσθαλος — wanton, reckless; neut. acc. pl., elided (ἀτάσθαλ’ = ἀτάσθαλα), used as a noun: ’wanton deeds’
glossary.ἀτιμάζοντας: ἀτιμάζω — dishonour, treat without honour; pres. part. masc. acc. pl.
glossary.ἀφνειόν: ἀφνειός — rich, wealthy; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀχρεῖον: ἀχρεῖος — useless, to no purpose; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’uselessly, idly’
glossary.ἄγησι: ἄγω — lead, bring; pres. subj. 3 sg., epic -ησι (= Attic ἄγῃ); with ἐπί, ’bring upon’
glossary.ἄκριτον: ἄκριτος — unending, ceaseless (literally ’undecided’); neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’endlessly’
glossary.ἄρτους: ἄρτος — loaf of bread; masc. acc. pl.
glossary.ἐΰν: ἐΰς (ἠΰς) — good, noble; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἐγέλασσεν: γελάω — laugh; aor. 3 sg., epic -σσ- (= ἐγέλασε), ν-movable
glossary.ἐκάλυψεν: καλύπτω — cover, wrap; aor. 3 sg., ν-movable; with περί in tmesis, ’wrapped round’
glossary.ἐμπλείην: ἔμπλειος — full of (+ gen.); fem. acc. sg., epic (= Attic ἔμπλεως)
glossary.ἐπερχόμεναι: ἐπέρχομαι — come on, approach; pres. part. mid./dep. fem. nom. pl.
glossary.ἐπητῇ: ἐπητής — kindly, ready of speech (sense only approximate); masc. dat. sg.
glossary.ἐπιχρίεσθαι: ἐπιχρίω — smear on, anoint; mid. anoint oneself; pres. inf. mid.
glossary.ἐπιχρίσασα: ἐπιχρίω — smear on, anoint; aor. part. act. fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἐϋστέφανος: ἐΰστέφανος — well-crowned, fair-wreathed; adj. (2 endings), fem. nom. sg., of Aphrodite
glossary.ἔγχεϊ: ἔγχος — spear; neut. dat. sg., epic -εϊ (= Attic ἔγχει)
glossary.ἔθελχθεν: θέλγω — charm, enchant; aor. pass. 3 pl., epic -εν (= ἐθέλχθησαν)
glossary.ἔξοχος: ἔξοχος — standing out, pre-eminent (+ partitive gen.); adj. (2 endings), masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἔπιεν: πίνω — drink; aor. 3 sg., ν-movable (= ἔπιε)
glossary.ἔρξασ: ῥέζω — do, perform; aor. part. act. fem. nom. sg., elided (ἔρξασ’ = ἔρξασα)
glossary.ἔρῳ: ἔρος (epic for ἔρως) — desire, love; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.ἔχεαι: ἔχω — have, hold; mid. be held, be beset by (+ dat.); pres. 2 sg. mid., uncontracted (= Attic ἔχῃ)
glossary.ἕρπει: ἕρπω — creep, move along; pres. 3 sg.
glossary.ἠρῶ: ἀράομαι — pray, pray for; impf. 2 sg. mid./dep., contracted (ἠράου > ἠρῶ): ’you prayed’
glossary.ἱπποδάμειαν: Ἱπποδάμεια — Hippodameia, a maid of Penelope’s household; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ὀρώρῃ: ὄρνυμι — rouse, set in motion; perf. subj. 3 sg. (of ὄρωρα ’have risen, am stirred’), intrans.: ’be stirring’
glossary.ὁμιλεῖν: ὁμιλέω — keep company with, consort (+ dat.); pres. inf.
glossary.ὄλβος: ὄλβος — prosperity, happiness, wealth; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ὑπέλθῃ: ὑπέρχομαι — go under, come under (+ acc.); aor. subj. 3 sg.
glossary.ὑπεξαγάγοι: ὑπεξάγω — lead out from under, lead away; aor. opt. 3 sg. act., in a wish
glossary.ὤλεσαν: ὄλλυμι — destroy, ruin; aor. 3 pl. act.
glossary.αἰνὸν: αἰνός — dread, fearsome, grim; neut. nom./acc. sg. (αἰνὸν ἄχος ’fearsome grief’)
glossary.αὐλείῃσι: αὔλειος — of the courtyard, belonging to the αὐλή; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι (= Attic -αις), with θύρῃσι: ’courtyard doors’
glossary.γήμασθ: γαμέω — marry; aor. inf. mid., elided (γήμασθ’ = γήμασθαι), of a woman, used as an imperative: ’marry!’ · also aor. inf. mid., elided, after εἴα ’allowed’: ’(did not allow me) to marry’ · also aor. inf. mid., elided, after κελεύω: ‘(I urge her) to marry’ (κελεύω γήμασθ’)
glossary.δέξασθ: δέχομαι — receive, accept; aor. inf. mid., elided (δέξασθ’ = δέξασθαι), used as an imperative: ’accept!’ (not a plural δέξασθε)
glossary.δαινύατ: δαίνυμαι — feast, dine; opt. 3 pl. mid., elided (δαινύατ’ = δαινύατο, epic for δαινυίατο): ’they would feast’ (with κε)
glossary.δεδμημένοι: δάμνημι (δαμάζω) — overpower, subdue, tame; perf. part. pass. masc. nom. pl.: ’overpowered’
glossary.διογενῆς: διογενής — Zeus-born, sprung from Zeus; masc. nom. sg., stock epithet of Odysseus
glossary.εἴρια: εἴριον (εἶρος) — wool, fleece; neut. acc. pl.
glossary.εὐρυδάμαντι: Εὐρυδάμας — Eurydamas, one of the suitors; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.κάγκανα: κάγκανος — dry, parched; neut. acc. pl., with ξύλα: ’dry (logs)’
glossary.καρπῷ: καρπός — wrist; masc. dat. sg. (distinct from καρπός ’fruit’) · also καρπός — fruit, produce; masc. dat. sg., dat. of cause or respect: ’with fruit’ (βρίθῃσι δένδρεα καρπῷ ’the trees are laden with fruit’)
glossary.κεκεασμένα: κεάζω — split, cleave; perf. part. pass. neut. acc. pl. (κεκεασμένα, epic form): ’split’
glossary.κραδίην: κραδίη — heart (epic = Attic καρδία); fem. acc. sg., Ionic -ην
glossary.λαμπτῆρας: λαμπτήρ — brazier, a stand holding a fire for light; masc. acc. pl.
glossary.λελῦτο: λύω — loose, loosen; perf. opt. 3 sg. pass. (usual view), in a wish continued from νεύοιεν: ’may (the limbs) be loosened’
glossary.λιποῦσα: λείπω — leave, leave behind; aor. part. act. fem. nom. sg.: ’leaving’; with κατά in tmesis (κατὰ … λιποῦσα = καταλιποῦσα)
glossary.λώβη: λώβη — outrage, shameful abuse, disgrace; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.μέγεθος: μέγεθος — size, stature; neut. acc. sg., after the preposition ἐς: ’to stature’
glossary.μαχητὰς: μαχητής — fighter, warrior; masc. acc. pl.
glossary.μεθύοντι: μεθύω — be drunk; pres. part. masc. dat. sg., with ἐοικώς: ’like one drunk’
glossary.μετέμισγον: μεταμίσγω — mix in among, mingle with; impf. 3 pl. act., augmented: ’they mixed in’
glossary.μνηστεύειν: μνηστεύω — woo, court; pres. inf. act.
glossary.μορόεντα: μορόεις — of uncertain sense, perhaps ’mulberry-like’ (μόρον ’mulberry’); neut. acc. pl.
glossary.μῶλος: μῶλος — toil of battle, struggle, strife; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.νεύοιεν: νεύω — nod, bow the head; pres. opt. 3 pl., in a wish after αἲ γάρ: ’may they nod’
glossary.νικήσουσι: νικάω — conquer, overcome, outlast; fut. 3 pl. act.: ’they will overcome’
glossary.πάθοι: πάσχω — suffer, experience; aor. opt. 3 sg., in a remote condition after εἰ: ’were to suffer’ · also aor. opt. 3 sg. in an indirect question in past sequence: ’what he had suffered’
glossary.πέλοιτο: πέλομαι (πέλω) — be, become, come to be; pres. opt. 3 sg. mid., with κε: ’would come to be’
glossary.παρέλκετο: παρέλκω — draw aside, draw out for oneself; impf. 3 sg. mid., augmented: ’she was drawing out’
glossary.πείκετε: πείκω — comb, card (wool); pres. imper. 2 pl. act.
glossary.πεισάνδροιο: Πείσανδρος — Peisander, a suitor, son of Polyctor; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.περίεσσι: περίειμι — be superior to, surpass (+ gen.); pres. 2 sg., epic ἐσσί (= Attic περίει)
glossary.περόναι: περόνη — pin, brooch for fastening a robe; fem. nom. pl.
glossary.πλέονές: πλείων (πλέων) — more; comparative of πολύς, masc. nom. pl., epic uncontracted πλέονες (= Attic πλείους), accented before enclitic κε
glossary.πλήσσουσι: πλήσσω — strike; pres. 3 pl. act.; with ἐκ in tmesis (ἐκ … πλήσσουσι = ἐκπλήσσουσι): ’strike out of one’s wits, daunt’
glossary.πολυκτορίδαο: Πολυκτορίδης — son of Polyctor; masc. gen. sg., patronymic, epic -αο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.πολυτλήμων: πολυτλήμων — much-enduring, very patient; masc. nom. sg., predicate (πολύ + root of τλῆναι ’endure’)
glossary.στροφαλίζετε: στροφαλίζω — twirl, spin (thread); pres. imper. 2 pl. act.
glossary.τέρπετε: τέρπω — delight, please; pres. imper. 2 pl. act.
glossary.τρίγληνα: τρίγληνος — three-eyed, with three pendants or drops (sense uncertain); neut. acc. pl.
glossary.τρῶάς: Τρώς — Trojan; masc. acc. pl., accusative subject of ἔμμεναι (Attic Τρῶας)
glossary.τὼς: τώς — thus, so; epic adv. (= Attic οὕτως)
glossary.φέρτερος: φέρτερος — stronger, better; comparative of ἀγαθός, masc. nom. sg., predicate
glossary.φαίη: φημί — say, assert; pres. opt. 3 sg., with κέν: ’might say’
glossary.φαείνοιεν: φαείνω — give light, shine (epic by-form of φαίνω); pres. opt. 3 pl., in a purpose clause after ὄφρα: ’might give light’
glossary.χέρεια: χερείων (χέρης) — worse, inferior; comparative of κακός, neut. nom./acc. pl. (τὰ χέρεια ’the worse things’)
glossary.ἀεικισθήμεναι: ἀεικίζω — treat unseemly, maltreat; aor. inf. pass., epic -θήμεναι (= Attic ἀεικισθῆναι): ’to be maltreated’
glossary.ἀμοιβηδὶς: ἀμοιβηδίς — in turn, by turns; adv.
glossary.ἀμφιπολεύοι: ἀμφιπολεύω — attend, tend, look after; pres. opt. 3 sg. act., in a remote condition after εἰ: ’were to tend’
glossary.ἀνέβαιν: ἀναβαίνω — go up, mount; impf. 3 sg., elided and augmented (ἀνέβαιν’ = ἀνέβαινε): ’went up’
glossary.ἀνέσει: ἀνίημι — let go, release; fut. 3 sg. act., or short-vowel subj. with κε (the sense is the same): ’will let go’
glossary.ἀνέφαινον: ἀναφαίνω — make appear, cause to blaze up; impf. 3 pl. act., augmented: ’they made blaze’
glossary.ἀντιβολήσει: ἀντιβολέω — meet, encounter (+ gen.); fut. 3 sg. act.: ’will meet’
glossary.ἀντινόῳ: Ἀντίνοος — Antinous, son of Eupeithes, a leading suitor; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.ἀπάγουσι: ἀπάγω — lead away, carry off, bring; pres. 3 pl. act.: ’they bring’
glossary.ἀπελάμπετο: ἀπολάμπω — shine forth, gleam; impf. 3 sg. mid. with active sense, augmented: ’shone forth’
glossary.ἀρ: ἄρα — then, so; inferential particle, short form ἀρ’ (= ἄρα, elided before a vowel)
glossary.ἀρωγοί: ἀρωγός — helper, helping; masc. nom. pl., as a noun: ’helpers’
glossary.ἁλώω: ἁλίσκομαι — be taken, be captured; aor. subj. 1 sg., epic lengthened vowel (= Attic ἁλῶ): ’I may be taken’
glossary.ἄχομαι: ἄχομαι (ἄχνυμαι) — be grieved, sorrow, from ἄχος; pres. 1 sg. mid.: ’I grieve’
glossary.ἐερμένον: εἴρω — string, fasten in a row; perf. part. pass. masc. acc. sg. (ἐερμένον, reduplicated), agreeing with ὅρμον: ’strung’
glossary.ἐθέλωσιν: ἐθέλω — wish, be willing; pres. subj. 3 pl., ν-movable: ’they may wish’ (after ἤν = ἐάν)
glossary.ἐνεῖκαι: φέρω — bring, carry; aor. inf. act., epic -αι (= Attic ἐνεγκεῖν): ’to bring’
glossary.ἐνώμας: ἐνωμάω — handle, turn over, ply; impf. 2 sg. act., contracted: ’you used to turn over’
glossary.ἐπέσσευεν: ἐπισεύω — drive on, hurl upon; aor. 3 sg. act., epic form with doubled σ (aor. ἔσσευα of σεύω): ’drove upon’
glossary.ἐπιβήτορας: ἐπιβήτωρ — one who mounts, rider; masc. acc. pl.
glossary.ἐρίσωσιν: ἐρίζω — contend, strive; aor. subj. 3 pl. act., in a general relative clause: ’such as contend’
glossary.ἐϋγνάμπτοις: ἐΰγναμπτος — well-bent; adj., dat. pl., agreeing with κληῗσιν: ’well-bent (hooks)’
glossary.ἐϋκνήμιδας: ἐΰκνημις — well-greaved, with good greaves; masc. acc. pl., standing epithet of the Achaeans
glossary.ἔασας: ἐάω — allow, permit; aor. 2 sg. act., epic uncontracted (= Attic εἴασας): ’you allowed’
glossary.ἔκριναν: κρίνω — decide, judge, separate; aor. 3 pl. act., augmented; with κε in a general relative clause: ’who would decide’
glossary.ἔμπεδοι: ἔμπεδος — firm, steady, abiding; masc./fem. nom. pl., predicate: ’firm’
glossary.ἔφερον: φέρω — bring, carry; impf. 3 pl. act., augmented: ’they carried’ · also impf. 1 sg. (same form)
glossary.ἕρματα: ἕρμα — earring, pendant (also ’prop, support’); neut. acc. pl. ἕρματα
glossary.ἤνεικεν: φέρω — bring, carry; aor. 3 sg. act., epic ἤνεικε(ν) (= Attic ἤνεγκε); with ἐκ in tmesis (ἐκ … ἤνεικεν): ’brought out’
glossary.ἴασον: Ἴασος — Iasian; obscure epithet of Ἄργος (meaning not certain); neut. acc. sg.
glossary.ἴδοιεν: ὁράω (aor. stem ἰδ-) — see; aor. opt. 3 pl. act., in a remote condition after εἰ: ’were to see’
glossary.ἴρου: Ἶρος — Irus, the town beggar; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.ἴσθμιον: ἴσθμιον — neck-band, necklace (from ἰσθμός ’neck’); neut. acc. sg.
glossary.ὀλβίου: ὄλβιος — prosperous, blessed, fortunate; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.ὀρθὸς: ὀρθός — upright, straight; masc. nom. sg., predicate: ’upright’
glossary.ὁμοιΐου: ὁμοίϊος (= ὅμοιος) — impartial, common to both sides (sense disputed); masc. gen. sg., with πολέμοιο
glossary.ὅπη: ὅπῃ — where, in what direction; relative adv. (ὅπῃ οἱ νόστος ’where his homecoming lies’)
glossary.ὠκυπόδων: ὠκύπους — swift-footed; masc. gen. pl., epithet of horses
glossary.ᾖε: εἶμι — go; impf. 3 sg., epic (= Attic ᾔει): ’went’
glossary.ᾖεν: εἶμι — go; impf. 3 sg., epic ᾖεν, ν-movable (= Attic ᾔει): ’went’
glossary.ῥυστακτύος: ῥυστακτύς — rough handling, being dragged about (sense inferred from ῥυστάζω ’pull about’; rare); fem. gen. sg.
glossary.ῥυτῆρας: ῥυτήρ — one who draws, drawer (of a bow), archer; masc. acc. pl.
glossary.αἰθομένοισιν: αἴθω — burn, blaze; pres. part. pass. masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις): ’burning’, of braziers
glossary.αἰσχρῶς: αἰσχρός — shameful, ugly; adv. αἰσχρῶς: ’shamefully, abusively’
glossary.αἱμασιάς: αἱμασιά — dry-stone wall, fence of gathered stones (round a field or garden); fem. acc. pl.
glossary.αἴθωνες: αἴθων — blazing, fiery, tawny; masc. nom. pl., of oxen: ’fire-bright, tawny’
glossary.βρωτὺν: βρωτύς — eating, food; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.βόμβησε: βομβέω — make a deep ringing or booming noise; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐβόμβησε)
glossary.βῶλος: βῶλος — clod, lump of earth, soil; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.γέλω: γέλως — laughter; masc. acc. sg., epic (= Attic γέλωτα)
glossary.γένοντο: γίγνομαι — become, come to pass; aor. 3 pl., unaugmented (= ἐγένοντο)
glossary.δαίδων: δαΐς (δάς) — torch, brand of pine; fem. gen. pl.: ’of torches’
glossary.δεξιτερήν: δεξιτερός — on the right, right (hand); fem. acc. sg., epic (= Attic δεξιός), agreeing with χεῖρα
glossary.διεπτοίησε: διαπτοιέω — scare, scatter in terror; aor. 3 sg., augment inside the compound (δι-ε-πτοίησε)
glossary.διηνεκέα: διηνεκής — unbroken, continuous, running the whole way; masc./fem. acc. sg., epic -έα (= Attic -ῆ), with ὦλκα: ’(a furrow) unbroken’
glossary.διώκω: διώκω — chase, pursue, drive; pres. 1 sg.
glossary.δολίος: Δόλιος — Dolius, father of Melantho; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.δουλιχιεύς: Δουλιχιεύς — man of Dulichium (the island Δουλίχιον); masc. nom. sg., used as an adj. with κῆρυξ: ’the Dulichian’
glossary.δουλιχιῆος: Δουλιχιεύς — man of Dulichium; masc. gen. sg., epic -ῆος (= Attic -έως), agreeing with Ἀμφινόμου: ’the Dulichian’
glossary.δρέπανον: δρέπανον — sickle, reaping-hook; neut. acc. sg.
glossary.εἰαρινῇ: εἰαρινός — of spring; fem. dat. sg., epic (= Attic ἐαρινῇ), with ὥρῃ: ’in spring-time’
glossary.εἴκοι: εἴκω — yield, give way; pres. opt. 3 sg.: ’it would give way’ (of soil under the plough)
glossary.εὐκαμπὲς: εὐκαμπής — well-curved, finely bent; neut. acc. sg., with δρέπανον
glossary.θυμαλγέος: θυμαλγής — heart-paining, grievous; fem. gen. sg., epic uncontracted -έος (= Attic -οῦς), with λώβης
glossary.θύρετρα: θύρετρον — door, doorway; neut. nom. pl. (the plural for a single door)
glossary.κέλαδον: κέλαδος — din, clamour, noise; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.κατακείομεν: κατακείω — lie down, go to bed (desiderative of κατάκειμαι); pres. subj. 1 pl., epic short vowel (= κατακείωμεν): ’let us go to bed’
glossary.κείοντες: κείω — lie down, go to rest (desiderative of κεῖμαι); pres. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’meaning to lie down’
glossary.κεκοπὼς: κόπτω — strike, beat; perf. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having struck, having battered’
glossary.κεκορηότε: κορέννυμι — sate, satisfy; perf. part. act. masc. dual nom., epic κεκορηώς (= Attic κεκορεσμένος), + gen.: ’sated with’
glossary.κερτομέων: κερτομέω — taunt, mock, jeer at; pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg. (+ acc.)
glossary.κεύθετε: κεύθω — hide, keep hidden, hold within; pres. 2 pl.
glossary.κνέφαος: κνέφας — darkness, dusk, evening gloom; neut. gen. sg., after ἄχρι
glossary.κραταιός: κραταιός — mighty, strong; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.κροτάφοις: κρόταφος — temple (side of the head); masc. dat. pl.
glossary.κυνέη: κυνέη — helmet (originally a dog-skin cap); fem. nom. sg.
glossary.κόμισσε: κομίζω — take care of, tend, look after; aor. 3 sg., epic σσ (= ἐκόμισε), unaugmented
glossary.κύον: κύων — dog; masc. voc. sg., a term of abuse
glossary.λέσχην: λέσχη — place of talk, common lounge or meeting-hall; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.λαμπτῆρσι: λαμπτήρ — fire-basket, brazier (for light); masc. dat. pl.
glossary.λώβης: λώβη — outrage, insult, shameful abuse; fem. gen. sg., with ἴσχεσθαι ’refrain from’
glossary.μαίνεσθε: μαίνομαι — rave, be mad; pres. 2 pl. mid. indic.
glossary.μελέμεν: μέλω — be a care to, concern (+ dat.); pres. inf., epic -έμεν (= Attic μέλειν)
glossary.μελανθὼ: Μελανθώ — Melantho, a maidservant of Penelope’s house, daughter of Dolius; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.μετέθηκε: μετατίθημι — place among, transfer; aor. 3 sg., augmented
glossary.μιγέντα: μίγνυμι — mix, mingle; aor. part. pass. masc. acc. sg. (= μιγείς), + dat.: ’having mingled among’
glossary.μισγέσκετο: μίσγω (μίγνυμι) — mingle, consort, lie with; impf. iterative 3 sg. mid., epic -σκετο: ’used to lie with’ (+ dat.)
glossary.μισθὸς: μισθός — pay, wages, hire; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.μούλιος: Μούλιος — Mulius, a herald from Dulichium in Amphinomus’ service; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.νήστιες: νῆστις — fasting, without food; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.νικᾷ: νικάω — conquer, prevail; pres. 3 sg., contracted (= νικᾷ from epic νικάει)
glossary.οἰνοχόον: οἰνοχόος — wine-pourer, cupbearer; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.πάγχαλκος: πάγχαλκος — all of bronze; adj. (2-term.), fem. nom. sg., with κυνέη
glossary.πίον: πίνω — drink; aor. 3 pl., epic unaugmented (= ἔπιον): ’they drank’
glossary.παρέχοιμι: παρέχω — supply, furnish, provide; pres. opt. 1 sg., potential with κε: ’I would supply’
glossary.παύροισι: παῦρος — few, little; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις): ’few’
glossary.πειρησαίμεθα: πειράομαι — try, test, make trial; aor. opt. 1 pl. mid., epic: ’we might test (ourselves)’, + gen.
glossary.πεσοῦσα: πίπτω — fall; aor. part. fem. nom. sg.: ’having fallen’
glossary.ποίη: ποίη — grass, herbage; fem. nom. sg. (distinct from ποῖος ’of what kind’)
glossary.ποτῆτα: ποτής — drinking, drink; fem. acc. sg. (stem ποτητ-)
glossary.προμάχοισι: πρόμαχος — front-fighter, champion; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
glossary.προταμοίμην: προτάμνω (προτέμνω) — cut forward, drive on cutting (a furrow); aor. opt. 1 sg. mid.: ’I might cut’
glossary.πρόχοος: πρόχοος — jug, ewer (for pouring wine or water); fem. nom. sg.
glossary.πτολίπορθον: πτολίπορθος — sacker of cities (Attic πολίπορθος); masc. acc. sg., epithet of Odysseus
glossary.πτώσσειν: πτώσσω — cower, go cringing (as a beggar); pres. inf. act.
glossary.σέλας: σέλας — light, gleam, glare; neut. nom. sg.
glossary.στείνοιτο: στείνομαι — be straitened, be too narrow (for); pres. opt. 3 sg. mid., potential with κε, + dat.
glossary.στυφελίζετε: στυφελίζω — treat roughly, abuse, buffet; pres. imper. 2 pl., in a prohibition with μήτε
glossary.τάλαν: τάλας — wretched, suffering; masc. voc. sg., in address, ’you wretch’, scornful
glossary.τάμῃσιν: τάμνω (τέμνω) — cut; aor. subj. 3 sg., epic -ῃσιν (= Attic τέμῃ), in tmesis with διά: ’cut up’
glossary.ταρβεῖς: ταρβέω — fear, be afraid; pres. 2 sg.
glossary.ταρβοσύνῃ: ταρβοσύνη — fear, terror; fem. dat. sg.: ’with fear’
glossary.τετράγυον: τετράγυος — of four γύαι, four-acre (of a ploughland); neut. nom. sg., as a noun: ’a four-acre field’
glossary.φαείνων: φαείνω — give light, shine; pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg., epic (= Attic φαίνων)
glossary.φεύγοντι: φεύγω — flee; pres. part. masc. dat. sg.: ’to one fleeing’
glossary.φορύξας: φορύσσω (φύρω) — knead, soil, smear; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg., with αἵματι: ’smeared with’
glossary.φὰν: φημί — say, think, believe; impf. 3 pl., epic unaugmented (= ἔφασαν), + inf.
glossary.χαλκήϊον: χαλκήϊος — of the smith, of bronze; masc. acc. sg., epic, with δόμον: ’the smithy’
glossary.χερείονα: χερείων (Attic χείρων) — worse, inferior; neut. nom. pl., comparative of κακός, with τά: ’the worse things’
glossary.ἀγαθοῖσιν: ἀγαθός — good, brave, worthy; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις)
glossary.ἀγορεύοις: ἀγορεύω — speak, declare; pres. opt. 2 sg., potential with ἄν: ’you would speak’
glossary.ἀθεεὶ: ἀθεεί (ἀθέει) — without a god, without divine help; adv.
glossary.ἀλαπαδνόν: ἀλαπαδνός — feeble, weak; neut. nom. sg., with σθένος
glossary.ἀλλήλας: ἀλλήλων — one another; fem. acc. pl.
glossary.ἀλύεις: ἀλύω — be distraught, beside oneself, out of one’s senses; pres. 2 sg.
glossary.ἀμφιέσαιμι: ἀμφιέννυμι — clothe, put around; aor. opt. 1 sg. (with εἵματα): ’I would clothe (him)’
glossary.ἀμφινόμοιο: Ἀμφίνομος — Amphinomus, a suitor; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.ἀμφινόμου: Ἀμφίνομος — Amphinomus, a suitor, son of Nisus; masc. gen. sg., with πρὸς γοῦνα: ’to the knees of’
glossary.ἀναστῇ: ἀνίστημι — set up; aor. intrans. rise up; aor. subj. 3 sg., after μή: ’lest he rise up (against you)’
glossary.ἀνελοίμην: ἀναιρέω — take up, take on (hire); aor. opt. 1 sg. mid., in a condition after εἰ: ’if I took you on’
glossary.ἀντιβίοις: ἀντίβιος — hostile, face to face, opposing; neut. dat. pl., with ἐπέεσσι
glossary.ἀπηνής: ἀπηνής — harsh, rough, unfeeling; masc. nom. sg., with νόος
glossary.ἀρότρῳ: ἄροτρον — plough; neut. dat. sg.: ’beneath the plough’
glossary.ἀτέλεστα: ἀτέλεστος — unfulfilled, unaccomplished; neut. nom. pl. (οὐκ ἀτέλεστα ’not unfulfilled’, i.e. fulfilled)
glossary.ἀτίταλλε: ἀτιτάλλω — rear, tend as a child, nurse; impf. 3 sg., epic (= Attic ἠτίταλλε)
glossary.ἄρκιος: ἄρκιος — sure, certain, assured; masc. nom. sg., predicate: ’guaranteed’
glossary.ἄχρι: ἄχρι — as far as, until; adv./prep. + gen.: ’right up to, until’
glossary.ἐγέλασσαν: γελάω — laugh; aor. 3 pl., epic σσ for the metre (= ἐγέλασαν)
glossary.ἐθελήσεις: ἐθέλω — be willing, wish; fut. 2 sg.: ’you will be willing’
glossary.ἐκπέμψῃσι: ἐκπέμπω — send out, drive out; aor. subj. 3 sg., epic -ῃσι (= Attic -ῃ), in a general relative clause: ’who may send out’
glossary.ἐκπεπαταγμένος: ἐκπατάσσω — strike out, knock out of one’s senses; perf. part. pass. masc. nom. sg., with φρένας: ’out of one’s wits’
glossary.ἐνένιπε: ἐνίπτω — rebuke, chide; aor. 3 sg., epic reduplicated aor. (= ἐνένιπεν, aor. ἐνένιπον)
glossary.ἐνίκησας: νικάω — conquer, defeat; aor. 2 sg., + acc.: ’you beat’
glossary.ἐπαρξάσθω: ἐπάρχομαι — begin (a libation), pour the first drops into the cups; aor. imper. 3 sg. mid., + dat.: ’let him begin with the cups’
glossary.ἐσθλῆς: ἐσθλός — good, noble, fine; fem. gen. sg., with δαιτός
glossary.ἐῶμεν: ἐάω — allow, let be, leave alone; pres. subj. 1 pl., hortatory: ’let us leave’
glossary.ἑαδότα: ἁνδάνω — please, be pleasing; perf. part. act. masc. acc. sg., epic (perf. ἕαδα): ’pleasing’, with μῦθον
glossary.ἑστήκειν: ἵστημι — set up; perf./plpf. stand; plpf. 3 sg., epic ἑστήκειν (= Attic εἱστήκει): ’he was standing’
glossary.ἔλλαβεν: λαμβάνω — take, seize; aor. 3 sg., epic λλ (= Attic ἔλαβε), ν-movable
glossary.ἔμμαθες: μανθάνω — learn; aor. 2 sg., epic μμ for the metre (= Attic ἔμαθες)
glossary.ἔργοιο: ἔργον — deed, work, task; neut. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου), with ἔρις: ’a contest of work’
glossary.ἔργου: ἔργον — deed, work, task; neut. gen. sg., after πειράομαι: ’test oneself at the work’
glossary.ἔτευχε: τεύχω — make, build, cause; impf. 3 sg.: ’was making’ (γέλω ἔτευχε ’was causing laughter’)
glossary.ἔχοιμι: ἔχω — have, hold; pres. opt. 1 sg., in a wish: ’may I have’
glossary.ἔχῃς: ἔχω — have, hold, keep; pres. subj. 2 sg., in a purpose clause after ὄφρ’ ἄν: ’so that you may keep’
glossary.ἠβαιαί: ἠβαιός — little, small, scanty; fem. nom. pl., in οὐδ’ ἠβαιαί ’not even a few’
glossary.ἥλικες: ἥλιξ — of the same age, age-mate; masc. nom. pl., of oxen: ’of an age’
glossary.ἦδος: ἦδος — pleasure, delight; neut. nom. sg.
glossary.ἰσοφόροι: ἰσοφόρος — pulling evenly, matched under the yoke; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἴδοις: ὁράω (aor. stem ἰδ-) — see; aor. opt. 2 sg., potential with κε: ’you would see’
glossary.ἴσχεσθαι: ἴσχω — hold; mid. hold oneself back, refrain from (+ gen.); pres. inf. mid., after εἴα: ’to refrain’
glossary.ὀδυσήϊον: Ὀδυσήϊος — of Odysseus, Odysseus’; adj., masc. acc. sg., with δόμον (= Ὀδυσσέως)
glossary.ὀνειδίζων: ὀνειδίζω — reproach, revile, taunt; pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg., + acc.: ’reproaching (my belly)’
glossary.ὀνειδείοις: ὀνείδειος — abusive, reproachful; neut. dat. pl., with ἐπέεσσιν
glossary.ὀροθύνει: ὀροθύνω — rouse, stir up, incite; pres. 3 sg.
glossary.ὁμιλεῖς: ὁμιλέω — consort with, keep company; pres. 2 sg.
glossary.ὁρμήσειε: ὁρμάω — set in motion, stir up (trans.); aor. opt. 3 sg., in a condition after εἰ: ’(if) he should stir up’
glossary.ὑβρίζεις: ὑβρίζω — behave insolently, outrage, wax wanton; pres. 2 sg.
glossary.ὦλκα: ὦλξ (ὄλκος) — furrow; masc. acc. sg., epic (cf. Attic αὖλαξ): ’furrow’
glossary.ῥηθέντι: ἐρέω (εἶπον; aor. pass. ἐρρήθην) — say; aor. part. pass. neut. dat. sg.: ’what was said’, with δικαίῳ
glossary.δαΐδων: δαΐς — pine-torch, brand; fem. gen. pl. (Attic δᾴς, gen. pl. δᾳδῶν)
glossary.δαιμονίη: δαιμόνιος — strange, baffling, ill-starred; fem. voc. sg., epic -η (= Attic -α), reproachful address: ’strange one’
glossary.δαλῷ: δαλός — firebrand, burning stick; masc. dat. sg., instrumental: ’by a firebrand’
glossary.δινεύων: δινεύω — whirl, go round and round, roam about; pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’roaming’
glossary.δινωτὴν: δινωτός — turned in a lathe or inlaid in rings (sense not certain); fem. acc. sg. (δινέω ’turn round’)
glossary.εἰλάτιναί: ἐλάτινος — of fir; fem. nom. pl., epic εἰλ- for ἐλ- (= Attic ἐλάτιναι)
glossary.εἰληλουθώς: ἔρχομαι — go, come; perf. part. act. masc. nom. sg., epic (= Attic ἐληλυθώς): ’having come’
glossary.εἰρήσεται: εἴρομαι (= ἔρομαι) — ask, inquire; fut. 3 sg. mid. (= Attic ἐρήσεται): ’will ask’
glossary.εἴας: ἐάω — allow, permit, let; impf. 2 sg., augmented (ἐ- → εἰ-): ’you allowed’
glossary.εἶσθα: εἶμι — go; pres. 2 sg., epic -σθα (= Attic εἶ), with future sense: ’you will go’
glossary.εἷμαι: ἕννυμι — clothe, put on; perf. mid./pass. 1 sg., epic, with pres. force: ’I am clothed in, I wear’
glossary.εὐρυνόμην: Εὐρυνόμη — Eurynome, the housekeeper of Odysseus’s house; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.εὐρύκλειαν: Εὐρύκλεια — Eurycleia, Odysseus’s old nurse; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.θέρεσθαι: θέρομαι — warm oneself, be warmed; pres. inf. mid. (= Attic θερμαίνεσθαι)
glossary.θαρσαλέη: θαρσαλέος — bold, confident, over-bold; fem. voc. sg., epic -η (= Attic -α), address: ’bold one’
glossary.κέκασσαι: καίνυμαι — excel, surpass (+ dat.); perf. 2 sg. mid. (κέκασμαι): ’you excel’
glossary.κήδεσθαι: κήδομαι — care for, be concerned about (+ gen.); pres. inf. mid.
glossary.κίονες: κίων — pillar, column; masc./fem. nom. pl.
glossary.καλαί: καλός — fine, beautiful; fem. nom. pl.
glossary.καλεσσάμενος: καλέω — call, summon; aor. part. mid. masc. nom. sg., epic -σσ- (= Attic καλεσάμενος): ’having called to himself’
glossary.κατάλεξαι: καταλέγω — lay down; mid. lie down, go to bed; aor. imper. 2 sg. mid.: ’lie down!’
glossary.καταθέσθαι: κατατίθημι — put away, lay down, store; aor. inf. mid.
glossary.καταθείομαι: κατατίθημι — put away, store; aor. subj. 1 sg. mid., epic lengthened vowel -ει- (= Attic καταθῶμαι): ’that I may put away’
glossary.κατθέμεν: κατατίθημι — put away, lay down; aor. inf. act., epic -μεν, shortened κατ- (= Attic καταθεῖναι)
glossary.κλήϊσεν: κληΐω (= Attic κλῄω) — shut, bar; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐκλήϊσεν): ’shut’
glossary.κοιμᾶθ: κοιμάομαι — sleep, lie down to rest; impf. 3 sg. mid., elided and unaugmented (κοιμᾶθ’ = κοιμᾶτο, Attic ἐκοιμᾶτο): ’used to sleep’
glossary.κοτεσσαμένη: κοτέω — bear a grudge, be angry; aor. part. mid. fem. nom. sg., epic -σσ- (= Attic κοτεσαμένη): ’having become angry’
glossary.λήθει: λήθω (= Attic λανθάνω) — escape the notice of (+ acc.); pres. 3 sg., with a participle: ’escapes notice’
glossary.λήθεις: λήθω (= Attic λανθάνω) — escape the notice of (+ acc.); pres. 2 sg., with a participle: ’you escape me’
glossary.λαμπομενάων: λάμπομαι (= λάμπω) — shine, flare, blaze; pres. part. mid. fem. gen. pl., epic -άων (= Attic -ων)
glossary.λαμπτήρων: λαμπτήρ — brazier, fire-stand, torch; masc. gen. pl.
glossary.λύχνον: λύχνος — lamp, light; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.μήποτε: μήποτε — never, lest ever; adv. (= μή ποτε), with the aor. subj. in a warning: ’never’
glossary.μεσόδμαι: μεσόδμη — cross-timber of a house (exact fitting not known; also a ship’s mast-block); fem. nom. pl.
glossary.μετοιχομένη: μέτοιχομαι — go after, go along with; pres. part. mid. fem. nom. sg.: ’going along’
glossary.νήησαν: νηέω — heap up, pile; aor. 3 pl., unaugmented (= ἐνήησαν): ’they heaped’
glossary.οἴσει: φέρω — bear, carry, bring; fut. 3 sg. (fut. οἴσω): ’will carry’
glossary.πάντως: πάντως — altogether, certainly, in every way; adv.
glossary.προβλωσκέμεν: προβλώσκω — go forth, go forward; pres. inf. act., epic -έμεν (= Attic προβλώσκειν)
glossary.προσφυέ: προσφυής — attached, grown on to; masc. acc. sg., elided (προσφυέ’ = προσφυέα): ’fixed on’
glossary.πτωχεύω: πτωχεύω — beg, live as a beggar; pres. 1 sg.
glossary.τοιοῦτοι: τοιοῦτος — of such a kind, such; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.φαίνοντ: φαίνω — show; mid. appear, shine; pres. 3 pl. mid., elided (φαίνοντ’ = φαίνονται): ’they appear’
glossary.χοίνικος: χοῖνιξ — a dry measure of about a quart, a day’s ration of grain; fem. gen. sg.
glossary.ἀδεές: ἀδεής — fearless, shameless (ἀ- + δέος ’fear’); masc. voc. sg. (same form as neut.)
glossary.ἀεργὸν: ἀεργός — idle, not working; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀλήμονες: ἀλήμων — wandering, vagrant; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἀμέρδει: ἀμέρδω — rob, deprive of; pres. 3 sg.
glossary.ἀνέλοιο: ἀναιρέομαι — take up, take on oneself; aor. opt. 2 sg. mid., in a wish after αἲ γάρ: ’would that you took up’
glossary.ἀνέξομαι: ἀνέχομαι — put up with, tolerate; fut. 1 sg. mid.
glossary.ἀναΐξαντ: ἀναΐσσω — spring up, leap up; aor. part. act. masc. nom. dual, elided (ἀναΐξαντ’ = ἀναΐξαντε): ’the two having sprung up’
glossary.ἀναγκαίη: ἀναγκαῖος — necessary; fem. ἀναγκαίη as a noun, necessity (= ἀνάγκη); fem. nom. sg., Ionic -η
glossary.ἀναμάξεις: ἀναμάσσω — wipe off, wipe up; fut. 2 sg. act.: ’you will wipe off’
glossary.ἀνιήσεις: ἀνιάω — grieve, distress, annoy; fut. 2 sg. act., epic -ήσω (= Attic ἀνιάσω)
glossary.ἀπόλλωνός: Ἀπόλλων — Apollo; masc. gen. sg., after ἕκητι
glossary.ἀτασθάλλουσ: ἀτασθάλλω — act recklessly, behave wantonly; pres. part. fem. nom. sg., elided (ἀτασθάλλουσ’ = ἀτασθάλλουσα)
glossary.ἅπτηται: ἅπτω — fasten; mid. touch, lay hold of (+ gen.); pres. subj. 3 sg. mid., in a general relative clause with κεν: ’touches’
glossary.ἐΰξεστον: ἐΰξεστος — well-polished, well-planed; adj., masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἐλέφαντι: ἐλέφας — ivory, elephant; masc. dat. sg., instrumental: ’with ivory’
glossary.ἐλπίδος: ἐλπίς — hope, expectation; fem. gen. sg., dependent on a noun: ’of hope’
glossary.ἐπέχεις: ἐπέχω — hold toward, press upon, assail (+ dat.); pres. 2 sg. act.: ’you press on’
glossary.ἐπακούσῃ: ἐπακούω — listen to, hear (+ gen.); aor. subj. 3 sg., after ὄφρα: ’he may hear’
glossary.ἐπείγει: ἐπείγω — press, drive, urge on; pres. 3 sg.
glossary.ἐπιφροσύνας: ἐπιφροσύνη — presence of mind, forethought; fem. acc. pl.
glossary.ἐποίει: ποιέω — make, produce, do; impf. 3 sg., augmented: ’was making, gave’
glossary.ἐρεθίζω: ἐρεθίζω — provoke, stir up, irritate; pres. subj. 1 sg., short vowel (same form as the indic.), in a purpose clause with ὄφρα κε
glossary.ἔγχεά: ἔγχος — spear; neut. acc. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἔγχη)
glossary.ἔλεκτο: λέγω (old sense) — lay to rest; mid. lie down; aor. 3 sg. mid. (ἐλέγμην): ’lay down’
glossary.ἔμιμνεν: μίμνω (= μένω) — stay, wait, wait for (+ acc.); impf. 3 sg. (Attic ἔμενεν): ’waited for’
glossary.ἔξελθε: ἐξέρχομαι — go out; aor. imper. 2 sg. (aor. stem ἐλθ-): ’go out!’
glossary.ἔρδουσα: ἔρδω (= ῥέζω) — do, perform; pres. part. act. fem. nom. sg., epic (Attic ποιοῦσα): ’doing’
glossary.ἔρυξον: ἐρύκω — hold back, keep in, restrain; aor. imper. 2 sg. act.: ’hold back!’
glossary.ἰκμάλιος: Ἰκμάλιος — Icmalius, a craftsman, the maker of a chair (name of unknown meaning); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἴσχανε: ἰσχάνω (= ἴσχω) — hold back, restrain; pres. imper. 2 sg. act.: ’hold back!’
glossary.ἵξετ: ἱκνέομαι — come, arrive at, reach; fut. 3 sg. mid., elided (ἵξετ’ = ἵξεται): ’will come’
glossary.ὀλέσσῃς: ὄλλυμι — destroy; mid. perish; aor. subj. 2 sg. act., epic -σσ- (= Attic ὀλέσῃς), with ἀπό in tmesis: ’you lose’
glossary.ὀμφαλοέσσας: ὀμφαλόεις — with bosses, bossed (ὀμφαλός ’navel, boss’); fem. acc. pl., epic -έσσας
glossary.ὀξυόεντα: ὀξυόεις — sharp, pointed; neut. acc. pl., epic -εντα (ὀξύς ’sharp’)
glossary.ὀπιπεύσεις: ὀπιπεύω — look at, spy on, watch; fut. 2 sg. act.
glossary.ὀφθαλμοῖς: ὀφθαλμός — eye; masc. dat. pl., ’to the eyes’
glossary.ὁρῶμαι: ὁράω — see; pres. 1 sg. mid. with active sense (epic): ’I behold’
glossary.ὄνησο: ὀνίνημι — benefit, help; mid. have profit or enjoyment of (+ gen.); aor. imper. 2 sg. mid.: ’enjoy!’
glossary.ὑπερμενέοντες: ὑπερμενής — of surpassing strength (with a tone of arrogance); masc. nom. pl., epic -έοντες, participle-shaped
glossary.ᾔδησθ: οἶδα — know; plpf. 2 sg. with impf. force, elided (ᾔδησθ’ = ᾔδησθα, Attic ᾔδεισθα): ’you knew’
glossary.ᾕρεον: αἱρέω — take, seize; impf. 3 pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ᾕρουν); with ἀπό in tmesis, ’they took away’
glossary.ῥυπόω: ῥυπόω — be dirty, be filthy; pres. 1 sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic ῥυπῶ)
glossary.αἰδοῖόν: αἰδοῖος — held in respect, revered; masc. acc. sg., accented before enclitic τε, predicative: ’as one to be revered’
glossary.αἴθων: αἴθων — blazing, tawny, fiery (αἴθω ’burn’); masc. nom. sg., here the assumed name Αἴθων, ’Aethon’
glossary.βεβαρηότα: βαρέω — weigh down, burden; perf. part. act. masc. acc. sg., epic -ηότα (= Attic βεβαρηκότα): ’weighed down’
glossary.βρίθῃσι: βρίθω — be heavy, be laden; pres. subj. 3 sg., epic -ῃσι (= Attic βρίθῃ), + dat.: ’is laden with’
glossary.γαῖ: γαῖα — earth, land; fem. nom. sg., elided (γαῖ’ = γαῖα; Attic γῆ)
glossary.γιγνώσκων: γιγνώσκω — come to know, perceive, recognise; pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’realising, being aware’
glossary.γλῶσσα: γλῶσσα — tongue, language; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.γοόωντά: γοάω — wail, lament; pres. part. act. masc. acc. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic γοῶντα)
glossary.δακρυπλώειν: δακρυπλώω — swim in tears, be awash with weeping (δάκρυ + πλώω ’float’); pres. inf. act.
glossary.δεκάτη: δέκατος — tenth; fem. nom. sg. (with ἠώς, ’the tenth dawn’)
glossary.δευκαλίων: Δευκαλίων — Deucalion, son of Minos and father of Idomeneus; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.δευκαλίωνος: Δευκαλίων — Deucalion, son of Minos and father of Idomeneus; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.δημόθεν: δῆμος — people, community; adv. with suffix -θεν of source: ’from the people, at the public’s cost’
glossary.δμῳῶν: δμώς (δμῳός) — slave, servant of the household; fem. δμῳή, maid; gen. pl., partitive: ’of the servants (maids)’
glossary.δωριέες: Δωριεύς — Dorian; masc. nom. pl., epic -ες (= Attic Δωριεῖς)
glossary.δώσεις: δίδωμι — give, give over; fut. 2 sg. act.: ’you will give’
glossary.δῖοί: δῖος — heavenly, divine, illustrious; masc. nom. pl., accented before enclitic τε (cf. δῖοι)
glossary.εἰλειθυίης: Εἰλείθυια — Eileithyia, goddess of childbirth; fem. gen. sg., Ionic -ης (= Attic -ας)
glossary.εἷλον: αἱρέω — take, seize, catch; aor. 3 pl. act., augmented (εἷλον = ἔ-ελον): ’they caught’
glossary.εὐδικίας: εὐδικία — right judgement, justice (εὖ + δίκη); fem. acc. pl.
glossary.εὐηγεσίης: εὐηγεσίη — good leadership, good government (εὖ + ἡγέομαι); fem. gen. sg., Ionic -ης (= Attic -ας)
glossary.εὑρίσκω: εὑρίσκω — find, discover; pres. 1 sg. act.
glossary.θεουδὴς: θεουδής — god-fearing, righteous (θεός + δέος ’fear’); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.κατατήκομαι: κατατήκω — melt down, waste away; mid./pass. κατατήκομαι ’pine away’; pres. 1 sg.: ’I waste away’
glossary.κατεδόντων: κατέδω (κατεσθίω) — eat up, devour; pres. part. act. masc. gen. pl. (Attic κατεσθιόντων), gen. of the thing wasted: ’of (them) devouring’
glossary.κνωσός: Κνωσός — Cnossus, chief city of Crete; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.κορωνίσιν: κορωνίς — curved, with a curved stern (of ships); fem. dat. pl., epic -ισιν, agreeing with νηυσί/νήεσσι
glossary.κρήτη: Κρήτη — Crete; fem. nom. sg., Ionic η (= Attic Κρήτη, with ᾱ in other cases)
glossary.κρήτηνδε: Κρήτη — Crete; acc. sg. + suffix -δε of motion toward: ’to Crete’
glossary.κριθάς: κριθή — barley, barley-corn (usually pl.); fem. acc. pl.
glossary.λιμέσιν: λιμήν — harbour, anchorage; masc. dat. pl., epic -έσιν (= Attic λιμέσι)
glossary.μίνως: Μίνως — Minos, king of Cnossus; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.μαλειῶν: Μαλέαι — Malea, the cape at the south-east of the Peloponnese; fem. gen. pl., Ionic -ειῶν (= Attic Μαλεῶν), gen. of the place passed
glossary.μεγαλήτορες: μεγαλήτωρ — great-hearted, high-spirited; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.μεμιγμένη: μίγνυμι — mix, mingle; perf. part. mid./pass. fem. nom. sg.: ’mixed’
glossary.μετάλλα: μεταλλάω — inquire, ask after; pres. imper. 2 sg., uncontracted -αε → -α: ’ask!’ · also impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐμετάλλα): ’he asked after’
glossary.μετέειπον: μετεῖπον (μετά + εἶπον) — speak among, address; aor. 1 sg., epic uncontracted μετέ-ειπον (= Attic μετεῖπον)
glossary.μνησαμένῳ: μιμνήσκω — remind; mid. remember, call to mind; aor. part. mid. masc. dat. sg.: ’(to me) remembering’
glossary.μυρόμενόν: μύρομαι — weep, lament; pres. part. mid. masc. acc. sg., accented before enclitic τε
glossary.νεικέοι: νεικέω — quarrel with, revile, blame; pres. opt. 3 sg. act., epic uncontracted (= Attic νεικοίη), potential with ἄν: ’could blame’
glossary.νεμεσήσεται: νεμεσάω — feel righteous indignation, resent; fut. 3 sg. mid., after μή: ’lest anyone resent’
glossary.οἰχομένῳ: οἴχομαι — go, be gone; pres. part. mid. masc. dat. sg.: ’(for him) gone’
glossary.πίειρα: πίων — fat, rich, fertile; fem. nom. sg. πίειρα (masc. πίων)
glossary.παλαιφάτου: παλαίφατος — spoken of long ago, of ancient story; fem. gen. sg. (two-termination), epithet of the oak
glossary.παρέχῃ: παρέχω — furnish, supply, provide; pres. subj. 3 sg. act., in a general relative description: ’provides’
glossary.παραπλάγξασα: παραπλάζω — drive off course past, turn astray; aor. part. act. fem. nom. sg. (aor. -πλάγξα)
glossary.πελασγοί: Πελασγοί — the Pelasgians, an old people; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.περίρρυτος: περίρρυτος — flowed round by water; fem. nom. sg. (two-termination adj.); of an island
glossary.πλείοσιν: πλείων (πλέων) — more, greater; comparative of πολύς; neut. dat. pl., epic -οσιν, agreeing with ἀχέεσσι
glossary.πλησαίατο: πίμπλημι — fill, satisfy; aor. opt. 3 pl. mid., epic -αίατο (= Attic πλήσαιντο), purpose clause after ἵνα: ’might satisfy’
glossary.πολύστονος: πολύστονος — much-groaning, full of sorrow (πολύς + στόνος ’groan’); masc./fem. nom. sg. (two-termination adj.)
glossary.πόληες: πόλις — city; fem. nom. pl., epic -ηες (= Attic -εις)
glossary.σπεύδουσιν: σπεύδω — hurry, press on, be eager for; pres. 3 pl. act., + acc.: ’press for’
glossary.στησαμένῃ: ἵστημι — set up; mid. set up for oneself; aor. part. mid. fem. dat. sg.: ’(for me) having set up’
glossary.τίκτε: τίκτω — bear, beget; impf. 3 sg. act., unaugmented (= ἔτικτε): ’bore, begot’ (said of mother or father)
glossary.τίκτῃ: τίκτω — bear, bring forth; pres. subj. 3 sg. act., in a general description: ’bears’
glossary.ταφήϊον: ταφήϊος — of burial, for a funeral; neut. acc. sg. as noun: ’burial-shroud’ (Attic ταφήιος)
glossary.τολυπεύω: τολυπεύω — wind off wool into a ball; fig. work out, spin (wiles); pres. 1 sg. act.
glossary.τρισκαιδεκάτῃ: τρισκαιδέκατος — thirteenth; fem. dat. sg., dat. of time, with article τῇ: ’on the thirteenth’
glossary.τριχάϊκες: τριχάϊκες — meaning uncertain (perhaps ’in three tribes’), epithet of the Dorians; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.φέρῃσι: φέρω — bear, bring, yield; pres. subj. 3 sg. act., epic -ῃσι (= Attic φέρῃ): ’yields’
glossary.φιλέων: φιλέω — love, treat kindly, welcome; pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic φιλῶν)
glossary.φῇ: φημί — say; pres. subj. 3 sg. (= Attic φῇ), after μή: ’lest he say’
glossary.χαλεποῖσι: χαλεπός — harsh, hard, dangerous; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οῖς)
glossary.ἀγείρας: ἀγείρω — gather, collect; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having collected’
glossary.ἀεκαζομένην: ἀεκάζομαι — act or be made to act against one’s will (ἀέκων); pres. part. mid./pass. fem. acc. sg.: ’unwilling’
glossary.ἀλεγούσας: ἀλέγω (ἀλεγίζω) — care for, heed, regard (+ gen. or acc.); pres. part. act. fem. acc. pl.: ’heeding’
glossary.ἀλλοτρίῳ: ἀλλότριος — belonging to another, foreign; masc./neut. dat. sg.
glossary.ἀλλύεσκον: ἀναλύω (aphaeretic ἀλλύω) — undo, unravel; impf. iterative 1 sg. (also 3 pl.), -σκ-: ’I used to undo’
glossary.ἀμνισῷ: Ἀμνισός — Amnisus, a harbour town of Crete; dat. sg.
glossary.ἀμφινέμονται: ἀμφινέμομαι — dwell around, inhabit; pres. 3 pl. mid., + acc.
glossary.ἀνάγοντο: ἀνάγω — lead up; mid. put out to sea; impf. 3 pl. mid., unaugmented (= ἀνήγοντο): ’they put to sea’
glossary.ἀνάσσων: ἀνάσσω — be lord, rule (+ dat.); pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’ruling’
glossary.ἀνέχῃσι: ἀνέχω — hold up, uphold, maintain; pres. subj. 3 sg. act., epic -ῃσι (= Attic ἀνέχῃ)
glossary.ἀπέῃσιν: ἄπειμι — be away, be absent; pres. subj. 3 sg., epic -ῃσιν (= Attic ἀπῇ), in a general clause: ’is away’
glossary.ἀπειρέσιοι: ἀπειρέσιος — boundless, countless (= ἀπείριτος); masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἀπολλήξεις: ἀπολήγω — cease from, leave off (+ part.); fut. 2 sg. act., epic double λ (= Attic ἀπολήξεις): ’will you cease’
glossary.ἀρείων: ἀρείων — better, braver; comparative of ἀγαθός (cf. ἄριστος); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀρετῶσι: ἀρετάω — thrive, prosper; pres. 3 pl. act. (ἀρετάω, from ἀρετή)
glossary.ἀσχαλάᾳ: ἀσχαλάω — be distressed, chafe, be vexed; pres. 3 sg. act., epic diectasis (= Attic ἀσχαλᾷ)
glossary.ἀτρείδῃσιν: Ἀτρείδης — son of Atreus (Agamemnon, Menelaus); masc. dat. pl., epic -ῃσιν (= Attic Ἀτρείδαις)
glossary.ἀχέεσσί: ἄχος — pain, grief; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic ἄχεσι); accent from enclitic γε
glossary.ἐνέπνευσε: ἐμπνέω — breathe into, inspire; aor. 3 sg. act.: ’put into (the mind)’
glossary.ἐνιπλήσῃς: ἐνίπλημι (ἐμπίμπλημι) — fill full; aor. subj. 2 sg. act., after μή (fear/purpose, ’lest’) or as a prohibition, + gen.: ’lest you fill’
glossary.ἐννέωρος: ἐννέωρος — nine years old, or ruling in nine-year periods (sense disputed); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἐννήκοντα: ἐνενήκοντα — ninety; indeclinable numeral, epic ἐννήκοντα (= Attic ἐνενήκοντα)
glossary.ἐξείνισσα: ξεινίζω (Attic ξενίζω) — entertain as a guest; aor. 1 sg. act., augmented, epic double σ (= Attic ἐξένισα)
glossary.ἐξερέεινε: ἐξερεείνω — question closely, search out; pres. imper. 2 sg. act.: ’inquire into’
glossary.ἐξερέουσα: ἐξερέω — ask out, question closely; pres. part. act. fem. nom. sg., with ἀπολήγω: ’(cease) asking out’
glossary.ἐξετέλεσσα: ἐκτελέω — bring to an end, complete; aor. 1 sg. act., augmented, epic double σ (= Attic ἐξετέλεσα)
glossary.ἐπελθόντες: ἐπέρχομαι — come upon, come on; aor. part. act. masc. nom. pl.: ’coming upon (me)’
glossary.ἐτεόκρητες: Ἐτεόκρητες — the Eteocretans, ’true Cretans’, a people of Crete; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἔληθον: λήθω (λανθάνω) — escape notice, be unseen; impf. 1 sg. (also 3 pl.), epic (= Attic ἔλαθον): ’I went unnoticed’
glossary.ἥρωϊ: ἥρως — hero, warrior; masc. dat. sg., epic -ϊ (= Attic ἥρῳ), dat. of interest: ’for the hero’
glossary.ἰφθίμοισιν: ἴφθιμος — stout, strong, mighty; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις)
glossary.ἱρεύσασθαι: ἱερεύω — sacrifice, slaughter; aor. inf. mid., epic ἱρ- (= Attic ἱερεύσασθαι): ’to slaughter for themselves’
glossary.ἵστασθαι: ἵστημι — set; mid. take a stand, stand; pres. inf. mid.: ’to stand’
glossary.ὀαριστής: ὀαριστής — intimate companion, confidant (ὀαρίζω ’converse intimately’); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ὀτρύνουσι: ὀτρύνω — urge on, rouse, spur; pres. 3 pl. act.
glossary.ὁμόκλησαν: ὁμοκλάω — shout at, rebuke, threaten; aor. 3 pl. act., unaugmented (= Attic ὡμόκλησαν)
glossary.ὁπλότερος: ὁπλότερος — younger; comparative adj. (superl. ὁπλότατος); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ὑφαίνεσκον: ὑφαίνω — weave; impf. iterative 1 sg. (also 3 pl.), -σκ-: ’I used to weave’
glossary.αἰδοίως: αἰδοῖος — held in respect; adv. αἰδοίως: ’with respect, reverently’
glossary.αἴσῃ: αἶσα — portion, lot, fate; fem. dat. sg., Ionic and Attic alike (the η follows σ); κακῇ αἴσῃ ’by an evil fate’
glossary.αὐλοῖσιν: αὐλός — pipe, tube; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οῖς); of a brooch, apparently the sheaths for the pin
glossary.γυρὸς: γυρός — rounded, bent, hunched; masc. nom. sg.: ’round-shouldered’
glossary.γόου: γόος — wailing, lament; masc. gen. sg., + παῦσαι: ’from lament’
glossary.δίπλακα: δίπλαξ — double cloak, a mantle folded double; fem. acc. sg. (δίπλαξ, δίπλακος)
glossary.δαίδαλον: δαίδαλος — cunningly wrought; neut. nom. sg. (as a noun δαίδαλον ’a work of art’)
glossary.διδύμοισι: δίδυμος — double, twin; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
glossary.διπλῆν: διπλόος (Attic διπλοῦς) — double, folded double; fem. acc. sg., contracted from διπλόην (as in Attic)
glossary.εἵπετο: ἕπομαι — follow, accompany; impf. 3 sg., with augment εἵ- (= ἐ- + ἕπετο)
glossary.εὐρυβάτης: Εὐρυβάτης — Eurybates, Odysseus’ herald (’wide-strider’); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.θαυμάζεσκον: θαυμάζω — wonder at, marvel at; impf. 3 pl., iterative -εσκον, unaugmented (= Attic ἐθαύμαζον): ’used to marvel’
glossary.θρινακίης: Θρινακίη — Thrinacia, the island of the Sun’s cattle; fem. gen. sg., Ionic -ης (= Attic -ας)
glossary.κέρα: κέρας — horn; neut. pl. κέρα (epic, beside Attic κέρατα), of horn as a material: ’horn’
glossary.κακοΐλιον: Κακοΐλιος — ’Evil Ilium’, ill-omened Troy (κακός + Ἴλιος); fem. acc. sg.
glossary.κατέτηξεν: κατατήκω — melt down, dissolve; aor. 3 sg. act., transitive: ’melted’
glossary.κατατήκετ: κατατήκομαι — melt away, dissolve; pres. 3 sg. mid./pass., elided (κατατήκετ’ = κατατήκεται)
glossary.καταχεύῃ: καταχέω — pour down; aor. subj. 3 sg. act., epic stem χευ- (Attic aor. κατέχεα, subj. καταχέῃ), in a clause with ἐπήν
glossary.κεῦθεν: κεύθω — hide, conceal; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔκευθεν): ’kept hidden’
glossary.κλαιούσης: κλαίω — weep, lament; pres. part. fem. gen. sg.: ’weeping’
glossary.κουρίδιον: κουρίδιος — wedded, lawful (of a husband or wife); masc. acc. sg. · also neut. acc. sg., agreeing with a neuter noun: κουρίδιον δῶμα ’the wedded home’
glossary.κρομύοιο: κρόμυον — onion; neut. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.λάε: λάω — grip, seize; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔλαε); sense disputed, also taken as ’gaze at’
glossary.λάων: λάω — grip, seize; pres. part. masc. nom. sg. (sense disputed, also taken as ’gazing at’)
glossary.λαμπρὸς: λαμπρός — bright, shining; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.λοπὸν: λοπός — peel, skin (of an onion); masc. acc. sg.
glossary.μαλακός: μαλακός — soft, tender; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.μελανόχροος: μελανόχρους — dark-skinned, swarthy; masc. nom. sg., epic uncontracted -όχροος (= Attic -όχρους)
glossary.μεμαὼς: μέμαα (μάω) — strive, be eager; perf. part. masc. nom. sg., epic, with present sense (no Attic equivalent): ’straining, eager’
glossary.ξείνισας: ξεινίζω — entertain as a guest; aor. 2 sg., Ionic ξειν- (= Attic ξενίζω, ἐξένισας), unaugmented: ’you entertained’
glossary.ξεῖνέ: ξεῖνος — stranger, guest-friend (epic = Attic ξένος); masc. voc. sg., accented before the enclitic γε
glossary.οἴκοθ: οἴκοθεν — from home, from one’s house; adv., elided (οἴκοθ’ = οἴκοθεν), with -θεν ’from’
glossary.οὐλοκάρηνος: οὐλοκάρηνος — woolly-headed, curly-haired (οὖλος ’thick, woolly’ + κάρη ’head’); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.οὔλην: οὖλος — thick, woolly (of a cloak); fem. acc. sg., not the homograph οὖλος ’destructive’
glossary.παρήϊα: παρήϊον — cheek; neut. nom./acc. pl., epic -ήϊα (= Attic παρειά, pl. παρειαί)
glossary.παῦσαι: παύω — make stop; mid. cease, leave off (+ gen.); aor. imper. mid. 2 sg.: ’cease!’ · also aor. inf. act., ’to make cease’: νῦν μὲν παῦσαι τόξον ’let the bow rest’
glossary.πειρήσεσθαι: πειράω — try, test (+ gen.); fut. inf. mid., Ionic η (= Attic πειράσεσθαι): ’to put to the test’
glossary.περόνη: περόνη — brooch, pin for fastening a garment; fem. nom. sg. (same in Attic)
glossary.περόνην: περόνη — brooch, pin for fastening a garment; fem. acc. sg. (same in Attic)
glossary.πλήθουσι: πλήθω — be full, swell, overflow; pres. 3 pl.: ’are full’
glossary.πολλαί: πολύς — much, many; fem. nom. pl.: ’many’
glossary.πολυδακρύτοιο: πολυδάκρυτος — much-wept, tearful; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου), + gen. after τάρφθη
glossary.προτέροισι: πρότερος — former, fore; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις): πρότεροι πόδες ’forefeet’
glossary.πτύξασ: πτύσσω — fold; aor. part. act. fem. nom. sg., elided (πτύξασ’ = πτύξασα): ’having folded’
glossary.σήματ: σῆμα — sign, token, mark; neut. acc. pl., elided (σήματ’ = σήματα)
glossary.σόος: σόος (Attic σῶς) — safe, sound; masc. nom. sg., epic uncontracted
glossary.τάρφθη: τέρπω — delight, satisfy; aor. pass. 3 sg., epic, unaugmented (= ἐτέρφθη), + gen.: ’took her fill of’
glossary.τέκῃ: τίκτω — bear, give birth to; aor. subj. 3 sg. act., in a general relative clause without κε (= Attic τέκῃ with ἄν)
glossary.τερμιόεντα: τερμιόεις — with a border or fringe (τέρμα ’end, edge’; exact sense uncertain); masc. acc. sg.
glossary.τηκομένης: τήκω — melt; mid./pass. pres. part. fem. gen. sg.: ’melting’
glossary.τιμήσαντο: τιμάω — honor; aor. 3 pl. mid., epic, unaugmented (= ἐτιμήσαντο): ’they honored’
glossary.τῆκε: τήκω — melt, waste; pres. imper. act. 2 sg., transitive: ’melt away (your heart)’
glossary.φαεινὴν: φαεινός — bright, shining; fem. acc. sg. (epic by-form of φανός)
glossary.χάλκειον: χάλκειος (Attic χάλκεος) — of bronze; neut. acc. sg., epic (= Attic χαλκοῦν)
glossary.χεούσης: χέω — pour, shed; pres. part. fem. gen. sg.: ’shedding’
glossary.χιτῶν: χιτών — tunic; masc. acc. sg., elided (χιτῶν’ = χιτῶνα)
glossary.χρύσεοι: χρύσεος — golden, of gold; masc. nom. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic χρυσοῖ)
glossary.ἀγυρτάζειν: ἀγυρτάζω — collect by begging, beg together; pres. inf. act.: ’to beg up’
glossary.ἀκουούσης: ἀκούω — hear, listen; pres. part. act. fem. gen. sg. (same in Attic)
glossary.ἀκροπόλοισιν: ἀκρόπολος — high-peaked, lofty; dat. pl. in -οισιν, the same in all genders (= Attic -οις), of mountains
glossary.ἀλλοῖον: ἀλλοῖος — of another sort, different; masc. acc. sg.: ’another kind of (man)’
glossary.ἀναγνούσῃ: ἀναγιγνώσκω — know again, recognize; aor. part. fem. dat. sg. (ἀναγνούς, ἀναγνοῦσα)
glossary.ἀπάγχων: ἀπάγχω — throttle, strangle; pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀπέπεμπον: ἀποπέμπω — send away, send off; impf. 1 sg. (form also 3 pl.): ’I sent off’
glossary.ἀπήμαντον: ἀπήμαντος — unharmed, without hurt; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀπελήλυθε: ἀπέρχομαι — go away, depart; perf. 3 sg. (perf. ἀπελήλυθα): ’has gone away’
glossary.ἀπεσσεῖται: ἄπειμι — be away, be absent; fut. 3 sg., epic -σσ-, ending -εῖται (= Attic ἀπέσται)
glossary.ἄγαλμ: ἄγαλμα — delight, ornament, keepsake; neut. nom./acc. sg., elided (ἄγαλμ’ = ἄγαλμα)
glossary.ἄσσα: τις, τι — some, any; indef. pron., neut. nom./acc. pl., epic ἄσσα (= Attic τινά), after ὁπποῖα: ’of what sort’
glossary.ἐεικοστὸν: εἰκοστός — twentieth; neut. nom. sg., epic ἐεικοστός (= Attic εἰκοστόν)
glossary.ἐλεεινός: ἐλεεινός — pitiable, piteous; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἐλλόν: ἐλλός — fawn, young deer; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἐναίρεο: ἐναίρω — kill, destroy, ruin; pres. imper. mid. 2 sg., epic -εο (= Attic ἐναίρου): ’destroy!’
glossary.ἐπέθηκα: ἐπιτίθημι — put on, place upon; aor. 1 sg. act.: ’I put on’
glossary.ἐποψόμενος: ἐφοράω — look upon, visit; fut. part. mid. masc. nom. sg., epic ἐπόψομαι, of purpose: ’to look upon’
glossary.ἐτεὸν: ἐτεός — true, real; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’truly, in truth’
glossary.ἐτύμοισιν: ἔτυμος — true, real; neut. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις): ’true things’
glossary.ἔσῃ: εἰμί — be; fut. 2 sg.: ’you will be’
glossary.ἤην: εἰμί — be; impf. 3 sg., epic (= Attic ἦν)
glossary.ἤσπαιρε: ἀσπαίρω — gasp, quiver, struggle; impf. 3 sg., augmented: ’struggled’
glossary.ἰσχαλέοιο: ἰσχαλέος — dry, dried; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου), with κρομύοιο
glossary.ἴσκε: ἴσκω — make like, liken, represent as; impf. 3 sg.: ’made (lies) like (true things)’
glossary.ὀδύσαντο: ὀδύσσομαι — be angry with, hate (+ dat.); aor. 3 pl. mid., epic, unaugmented (= ὠδύσαντο)
glossary.ὀλέσασα: ὄλλυμι — destroy; aor. part. act. fem. nom. sg., with an object: ’having lost’
glossary.ὀνομαστήν: ὀνομαστός — to be named, nameable, famous; fem. acc. sg., with οὐκ: ’not to be named’
glossary.ὁπποῖ: ὁποῖος (epic ὁπποῖος) — of what sort; neut. acc. pl., elided (ὁπποῖ’ = ὁπποῖα), in an indirect question
glossary.ὅρκια: ὅρκιον — oath, sworn pledge; neut. acc. pl.: ὅρκια δοῦναι ’give oaths, swear’
glossary.ὕπατος: ὕπατος — highest, supreme; masc. nom. sg. (superlative form, ὕπερ)
glossary.ὤμνυε: ὄμνυμι — swear; impf. 3 sg. act., augmented: ’swore, was swearing’
glossary.ῥέοντες: ῥέω — flow; pres. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’flowing’
glossary.αἰδοίους: αἰδοῖος — held in respect, revered; masc. acc. pl.: ’revered (strangers)’
glossary.αὐτόλυκος: Αὐτόλυκος — Autolycus, Odysseus’ maternal grandfather, a master thief; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.αὐτόλυκόν: Αὐτόλυκος — Autolycus, Odysseus’ maternal grandfather, a master thief; masc. acc. sg., after μετά: ’to Autolycus’
glossary.γεγαῶτα: γίγνομαι — be born, come to be; perf. part. masc. acc. sg., epic γεγαώς (= Attic γεγονώς): ’born’, with νέον ’newly born’
glossary.γρηῦ: γρηῦς — old woman; fem. voc. sg., epic (= Attic γραῦ): ’old woman!’
glossary.γρηῦς: γρηῦς — old woman; fem. nom. sg., epic (= Attic γραῦς), indefinite after εἰ μή τις: ’some old woman’
glossary.γῆράς: γῆρας — old age; neut. acc. sg.; with λιπαρόν: ’a sleek old age’, the object of ἵκοιο ’reach’
glossary.δέχεσθαι: δέχομαι — receive, welcome; pres. inf. mid.: ’to receive’ (a guest)
glossary.δείπνοιο: δεῖπνον — meal, main meal; neut. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου); the gen. object of μέδομαι ’mind, think of’
glossary.δολιχηρέτμοιο: δολιχήρετμος — long-oared; fem. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου), of a ship (νηός), two-ending adjective
glossary.δὶα: διά — through, abroad; prep., also adverb or preverb in tmesis with φορέω: δὶα … φορέουσι ’carry far and wide’ (grave accent mid-clause)
glossary.εἰκέλω: εἴκελος (= ἴκελος) — like, resembling; masc. acc. dual (the form is also nom.), predicate with ἡμέας: ’alike’, with ἀλλήλοιϊν
glossary.εἰσ: εἰμί — be; pres. 3 pl., elided (εἰσ’ = εἰσί): ’are’
glossary.εἱμένος: ἕννυμι — clothe; perf. pass. part. masc. nom. sg., epic εἱμένος: ’clothed, dressed’, with κακά ’in poor clothes’
glossary.εὐφραδέως: εὐφραδής — speaking well, eloquent; adv. εὐφραδέως: ’eloquently, with good sense’
glossary.ζωῷ: ζωός (= ζῶν) — alive, living; masc. dat. sg., epic ζωός (= Attic ζῶν): ’while he lives’
glossary.θαλπιόων: θαλπιάω — be warm, keep warm; pres. part. masc. nom. sg., epic with diectasis -όων (= Attic -ιῶν): ’keeping warm’
glossary.θεουδέα: θεουδής — god-fearing, pious; masc. acc. sg., epic (= Attic θεοδεής): ’god-fearing’, with θυμόν
glossary.θερμά: θερμός — hot, warm; neut. acc. pl.: ’hot’ (of tears)
glossary.θρέψαιό: τρέφω — rear, nourish; aor. opt. 2 sg. mid. (θρέψαιο, accented by the enclitic τε): ’you might rear’, in a prayer clause after ἧος
glossary.θυγατέρος: θυγάτηρ — daughter; fem. gen. sg. (Attic θυγατρός): ’of a daughter’, with the possessive ἧς: ’his own daughter’s’
glossary.θυμοφθόρος: θυμοφθόρος — heart-destroying (whose heart is destroyed, or who destroys it; the sense is not clear); masc. nom. sg.: ’heart-destroying’
glossary.κάτθετε: κατατίθημι — put down, lay out, set up; aor. imper. 2 pl., with apocope κάτθετε (= κατάθετε): ’make up (a bed)’
glossary.καθεψιόωνται: καθεψιάομαι — mock, jeer at (= ἐφεψιάομαι); pres. 3 pl. mid., epic diectasis -όωνται (= Attic -ῶνται): ’mock at’
glossary.κατέσχετο: κατέχω — hold down, hold back; mid. cover; aor. 3 sg. mid., augmented κατ-έσχετο: ’covered’ (χερσὶ πρόσωπα ’her face with her hands’)
glossary.καταγηράσκουσιν: καταγηράσκω — grow old, age; pres. 3 pl. (ν-movable): ’grow old’
glossary.καταρῶνται: καταράομαι — call down curses on (+ dat.); pres. 3 pl. mid. dep., contracted as in Attic: ’call down curses’
glossary.καῖεν: καίω — burn; impf. 3 sg., epic καῖε(ν) (= Attic ἔκαιε), of repeated sacrifice: ’used to burn’
glossary.κείω: κεῖμαι — lie, lie down; epic κείω, 1 sg., short-vowel subj. with future sense (the exact class of the form is disputed): ’I shall lie’
glossary.κλεπτοσύνῃ: κλεπτοσύνη — thievery, skill in stealing; fem. dat. sg., dat. of respect: ’in thievery’
glossary.κοίτῃ: κοίτη — bed, resting-place; fem. dat. sg.
glossary.λέβηθ: λέβης — cauldron, basin; masc. acc. sg., elided and aspirated before a rough breathing (λέβηθ’ = λέβητα; cf. δώμαθ’)
