glossary.ἐξάγαγ: ἐξάγω — lead out; aor. 2 3 sg., elided and unaugmented (ἐξάγαγ’ = ἐξήγαγε)
glossary.ἐπέγρετο: ἐπεγείρω — rouse; aor. mid. 3 sg., epic (ἐπ-έγρετο): ’woke up’
glossary.ἐπέλησεν: ἐπιλήθω — make forget (+ gen.); aor. 3 sg., causative: ’made (him) forget’
glossary.ἐπεύξατο: ἐπεύχομαι — pray to, vow; aor. mid. 3 sg.: ’prayed’
glossary.ἐρινύσιν: Ἐρινύς — Erinys, Fury (avenging spirit); fem. dat. pl.
glossary.ἐτόλμας: τολμάω — endure, bear, dare; impf. 2 sg.: ’you bore it’
glossary.ἐϋπλόκαμος: ἐϋπλόκαμος — with fine-plaited hair; adj., fem. nom. sg. (2-termination), epithet of goddesses
glossary.ἐϋφραίνοιμι: εὐφραίνω — gladden; pres. opt. 1 sg., epic ἐϋ- (= Attic εὐφραίνοιμι): ’I might gladden’
glossary.ἐῷ: ἐάω — allow, let; pres. subj. 3 sg., contracted (= Attic ἐᾷ), in a deliberative question
glossary.ἑλέτω: αἱρέω — take, seize; aor. imper. 3 sg.: ’let (sleep) take’
glossary.ἑλίσσετο: ἑλίσσω — turn, roll; mid. impf. 3 sg.: ’turned himself’
glossary.ἔμαρπτε: μάρπτω — seize, grasp; impf. 3 sg.: ’was seizing’
glossary.ἔπορ: πόρω — give, grant (defective, aor. only); aor. 3 sg., elided (ἔπορ’ = ἔπορε)
glossary.ἕλοιο: αἱρέω — take; aor. opt. mid. 2 sg., in a wish, with ἐκ in tmesis: ’would you take out’
glossary.ἠνίπαπε: ἐνίπτω — rebuke, chide; aor. 2 3 sg., epic reduplicated (ἠνίπαπον, no Attic equivalent)
glossary.ἡδέϊ: ἡδύς — sweet; masc. dat. sg., epic uncontracted -έϊ (= Attic ἡδεῖ)
glossary.ἰφθίμους: ἴφθιμος — stout, mighty; masc. acc. pl.
glossary.ἰὸν: ἰός — arrow; masc. acc. sg. (a different word from ἰός ’poison, rust’)
glossary.ἱρεύεσκον: ἱρεύω — sacrifice, slaughter; impf. 3 pl., iterative -σκ-, epic ἱρ- (= Attic ἱερεύω): ’used to sacrifice’
glossary.ὀνείρατ: ὄνειρον (ὄνειρος) — dream; neut. acc. pl., elided (ὀνείρατ’ = ὀνείρατα)
glossary.ὀπτηθῆναι: ὀπτάω — roast; aor. pass. inf.: ’to be roasted’
glossary.ὀρφαναὶ: ὀρφανός — orphaned, bereft; fem. nom. pl.
glossary.ὀσσομένη: ὄσσομαι — foresee, picture in the mind; pres. part. mid. fem. nom. sg.: ’picturing’
glossary.ὀϊόμενον: ὀΐομαι — expect, suppose; pres. part. mid. masc. acc. sg., epic (= Attic οἰόμενον)
glossary.ὑλάει: ὑλάω — bark; pres. 3 sg., uncontracted (= Attic ὑλᾷ)
glossary.ὑποδύσεαι: ὑποδύω — slip under, slip out from (+ gen.); fut. mid. 2 sg., epic -εαι (= Attic ὑποδύσῃ)
glossary.αἰγλήεντος: αἰγλήεις — gleaming, radiant, bright; masc. gen. sg., epic -ήεις adjective (epithet of Olympus)
glossary.αἰτίζεις: αἰτίζω — ask for, beg; pres. 2 sg.
glossary.αἰτιόῳο: αἰτιάομαι — blame, accuse; pres. opt. 2 sg. mid., epic uncontracted (= Attic αἰτιῷο): ’you would blame’
glossary.βάλλετε: βάλλω — throw, cast, put; pres. imper. 2 pl.: ’throw on, spread’
glossary.βοέῃ: βοέη — ox-hide, hide of an ox (fem. of βόειος ’of an ox’); fem. dat. sg., Ionic -ῃ
glossary.βροντῇ: βροντή — thunder, thunderclap; fem. dat. sg.
glossary.βῆσαν: βαίνω — go, walk, step; aor. 3 pl., unaugmented (= Attic ἔβησαν): ’went’
glossary.γεύσασθαι: γεύομαι — taste, make trial of (+ gen.); aor. inf. mid.
glossary.δαῖτες: δαίς — feast, meal; fem. nom. pl.
glossary.δειλῇ: δειλός — wretched, miserable, poor; fem. dat. sg.
glossary.δεξιτερῇ: δεξιτερός — right, on the right; fem. dat. sg., epic (= Attic δεξιᾷ)
glossary.διήγαγον: διάγω — carry across, convey through; aor. 3 pl.: ’they conveyed’
glossary.δυόωσι: δυάω — plunge in woe, afflict (from δύη ’woe’); pres. ind. 3 pl., epic uncontracted -όωσι (= Attic δυῶσι); a rare word, root and sense disputed
glossary.δύσμορος: δύσμορος — ill-fated, unlucky; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.εἴασε: ἐάω — let, allow, leave; aor. 3 sg. (augment εἰ-): ’let, left’
glossary.εὐνῆθεν: εὐνῆθεν — from bed; adv., -θεν suffix of source (from εὐνή ’bed’)
glossary.εὐποιήτοισι: εὐποίητος — well-made, well-wrought; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
glossary.θυμαλγέι: θυμαλγής — heart-grieving, painful; masc./neut. dat. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic θυμαλγεῖ)
glossary.κέασαν: κεάζω — split, cleave; aor. 3 pl., unaugmented (= ἔκεασαν): ’split’
glossary.καθήρατε: καθαίρω — cleanse, clean; aor. imper. 2 pl. act.: ’clean’
glossary.καθεύδειν: καθεύδω — sleep, lie asleep; pres. inf.
glossary.κατάγων: κατάγω — lead down, bring in; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’bringing’
glossary.κορήσατε: κορέω — sweep, sweep clean; aor. imper. 2 pl.
glossary.κρήνηνδε: κρήνη — spring, fountain; fem. acc. sg. + -δε of direction: ’to the spring’
glossary.κρήνης: κρήνη — spring, fountain; fem. gen. sg.
glossary.κρῆνον: κραίνω — accomplish, bring to pass, fulfil; aor. imper. 2 sg., Ionic η (= Attic κρᾶνον): ’fulfil’
glossary.μελάνυδρον: μελάνυδρος — dark-watered; fem. acc. sg. (two-ending adjective)
glossary.μιμνήσκοιτο: μιμνήσκομαι — remember, take thought of (+ gen.); pres. opt. 3 sg. mid., in a general temporal clause
glossary.μύλαι: μύλη — hand-mill, mill for grinding; fem. nom. pl.
glossary.μύλην: μύλη — hand-mill, mill for grinding; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.νέμεσθαι: νέμομαι — graze, pasture, feed; pres. inf. mid.
glossary.νέονται: νέομαι — go, come, return; pres. 3 pl., with future sense: ’will come back’
glossary.νεφέων: νέφος — cloud; neut. gen. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic νεφῶν)
glossary.οἴσετε: φέρω — bring, carry; οἴσετε, imper. 2 pl. (epic οἶσε, οἴσετε; or fut. 2 pl. of οἴσω used as a command): ’bring’
glossary.παύετ: παύω — stop, make cease; mid. cease; impf. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented, elided (παύετ’ = παύετο): ’was ceasing’
glossary.πεινήμεναι: πεινάω — be hungry; pres. inf., epic -ήμεναι (= Attic πεινῆν)
glossary.ποιπνύσασαι: ποιπνύω — bustle about, busy oneself, hurry; aor. part. fem. nom. pl.
glossary.πολυμήτις: πολύμητις — of many wiles, epithet of Odysseus (built on μῆτις ’cunning intelligence’); masc. nom. sg., with the accent on the second syllable as printed
glossary.πολυπλάγκτους: πολύπλαγκτος — much-wandering, driven far astray; masc. acc. pl.
glossary.πορθμῆες: πορθμεύς — ferryman; masc. nom. pl., epic -ῆες (= Attic -εῖς)
glossary.πορφυρέους: πορφύρεος — purple, dark-red; masc. acc. pl.
glossary.πύματόν: πύματος — last, final; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’for the last time’ (acute added on the last syllable by the enclitic τε)
glossary.στήσασα: ἵστημι — set, make stand, bring to a stop; aor. part. act. fem. nom. sg.: ’having stopped’
glossary.τευχούσῃ: τεύχω — make, prepare; pres. part. fem. dat. sg.
glossary.τεύχουσαι: τεύχω — make, prepare; pres. part. fem. nom. pl.
glossary.τισαίατο: τίνω (mid. τίνομαι) — pay; mid. exact payment from, punish; aor. opt. 3 pl. mid., epic -αίατο (= Attic τίσαιντο), in a wish: ’may they punish’
glossary.τοιαύτη: τοιοῦτος — such, of such a kind; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.τραφερήν: τραφερός — solid, firm (of land, opposed to the sea); fem. acc. sg. used substantively: ’the solid (land)’
glossary.φάσθω: φημί — say, speak; pres. imper. 3 sg. mid., epic (the active is φάτω): ’let him speak’
glossary.φήμην: φήμη — voice, a chance utterance taken as an omen; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.φαίνεις: φαίνω — show, make appear; pres. 2 sg.
glossary.φανήτω: φαίνω (pass. φαίνομαι) — show; appear; aor. imper. 3 sg. pass.: ’let it appear’
glossary.φιλοίτιος: Φιλοίτιος — Philoetius, the cowherd; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.χείρονα: χείρων — worse, inferior; masc. acc. sg., comparative
glossary.ἀγρεῖθ: ἀγρέω — seize, take; imper. 2 pl. ἀγρεῖτε, elided (τ > θ before the rough breathing), as an exhortation: ’come on, up’
glossary.ἀγρόμεναι: ἀγείρω — gather, assemble; aor. 2 part. mid. fem. nom. pl., syncopated (= ἀγερόμεναι): ’having gathered’
glossary.ἀδεψήτῳ: ἀδέψητος — untanned, not yet dressed (of hide); masc./fem./neut. dat. sg.
glossary.ἀκάματον: ἀκάματος — untiring, unwearied; neut. acc. sg., of fire: ’unflagging’
glossary.ἀκηδής: ἀκηδής — uncared-for, neglected; also careless; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀλείατα: ἄλειαρ — wheat-flour, meal (epic, = ἄλευρον); neut. acc. pl. (gen. sg. ἀλείατος)
glossary.ἀλείτας: ἀλείτης — sinner, wrongdoer; masc. acc. pl.
glossary.ἀλετρὶς: ἀλετρίς — woman who grinds corn, grinding-woman; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀμφικύπελλα: ἀμφικύπελλος — epithet of a cup, perhaps ’double-cupped’ or ’two-handled’ (meaning disputed); neut. acc. pl.
glossary.ἀμφιμάσασθε: ἀμφιμάομαι — wipe all over, wipe round; aor. imper. 2 pl. mid.
glossary.ἀνέκαιον: ἀνακαίω — kindle, light up; impf. 3 pl.
glossary.ἀνίστατο: ἀνίστημι — set up, raise; mid. rise, get up; impf. 3 sg. mid.: ’was rising, got up’
glossary.ἀναίτιον: ἀναίτιος — guiltless, blameless; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀπέσσονται: ἄπειμι (εἰμί) — be away, be absent; fut. 3 pl., epic ἀπέσσονται (= Attic ἀπέσονται): ’will be away’
glossary.ἀποπέμπει: ἀποπέμπω — send away, dismiss; pres. 3 sg.
glossary.ἀρείον: ἀρείων — better, superior; masc. acc. sg., comparative, elided (ἀρείον’ = ἀρείονα)
glossary.ἀστερόεντος: ἀστερόεις — starry, star-spangled; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.ἀτιμήσασ: ἀτιμάω — dishonour, slight (epic, = Attic ἀτιμάζω); aor. part. fem. nom. sg., elided (ἀτιμήσασ’ = ἀτιμήσασα)
glossary.ἀφαυροτάτη: ἀφαυρός — weak, feeble; fem. nom. sg., superlative: ’weakest’
glossary.ἄλεσσαν: ἀλέω — grind; aor. 3 pl., unaugmented with doubled σ (= Attic ἤλεσαν); in tmesis κατὰ … ἄλεσσαν ’ground up’
glossary.ἄποτμος: ἄποτμος — ill-fated, unlucky; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἐγειρομένων: ἐγείρω — rouse; mid. wake up; pres. part. mid. masc. gen. pl.: ’waking’
glossary.ἐθέλοντες: ἐθέλω — be willing, wish; pres. part. masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἐκακώσατε: κακόω — maltreat, afflict, harm; aor. 2 pl.
glossary.ἐμπλήγδην: ἐμπλήγδην — heedlessly, at random, without judgment (from ἐμπλήσσω ’strike’); adv.
glossary.ἐοῦσα: εἰμί — be; pres. part. fem. nom. sg., epic ἐοῦσα (= Attic οὖσα)
glossary.ἐπερρώοντο: ἐπιρρώομαι — move briskly, work with vigour; impf. 3 pl. mid., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἐπερρῶντο)
glossary.ἐπιέσσαμεν: ἐπιέννυμι — put on over, throw over (a cloak); aor. 1 pl., epic doubled σ (aor. stem ἐσσ-, as ἕννυμι ’clothe’): ’we put over’
glossary.ἐπικλώσωνται: ἐπικλώθω — spin to, allot by spinning (of the Fates); aor. subj. 3 pl. mid., in a general temporal clause after ὁππότε
glossary.ἐτιμήσασθ: τιμάω — honour, treat with honour; aor. 2 pl. mid., elided (ἐτιμήσασθ’ = ἐτιμήσασθε)
glossary.ἑλοίατο: αἱρέω — take; mid. take for oneself; aor. opt. 3 pl. mid., epic -οίατο (= Attic ἕλοιντο), in a wish
glossary.ἑορτή: ἑορτή — festival, feast-day; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἔδραθ: δαρθάνω — sleep; aor. 2 3 sg., elided (ἔδραθ’ = ἔδραθε), epic metathesis (= Attic ἔδαρθε): ’slept’
glossary.ἔθελ: ἐθέλω — be willing, wish; impf. 3 sg., elided (ἔθελ’ = ἔθελε)
glossary.ἔξεισθα: ἔξειμι (ἐκ + εἶμι) — go out; pres. 2 sg., epic -εισθα (= Attic ἔξει), with future sense: ’you will go out’
glossary.ἤγετ: ἄγω — lead, take, bring; impf. 2 pl., elided (ἤγετ’ = ἤγετε)
glossary.ἰοῦσαι: εἶμι — go; pres. part. fem. nom. pl.: ’going’
glossary.ὀλύμπου: Ὄλυμπος — Olympus, the mountain home of the gods; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.ὀϊζυρὸς: ὀϊζυρός — wretched, miserable; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ὑποστορέσαι: ὑποστόρνυμι — spread under, make up (a bed); aor. inf. act.
glossary.ῥάσσατέ: ῥαίνω — sprinkle; aor. imper. 2 pl., epic stem ῥασσ- (Attic ῥάνατε), accented on the last syllable before the enclitic τε
glossary.ῥήγεσσι: ῥῆγος — rug, blanket; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic ῥήγεσι)
glossary.βουκόλ: βουκόλος — cowherd; masc. voc. sg., elided (βουκόλ’ = βουκόλε)
glossary.βόεσσιν: βοῦς — ox, cow; dat. pl., epic -εσσιν (= Attic βουσί)
glossary.γείνεαι: γείνομαι — beget, bring forth (of a father); pres. 2 sg. mid., epic -εαι (= Attic γείνῃ); after ἐπήν, a short-vowel subjunctive: ’you beget’
glossary.δάμαρτα: δάμαρ (gen. δάμαρτος) — wife, spouse; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.δάσσασθαι: δατέομαι — divide, share out; aor. inf. mid., epic doubled σ (= Attic δάσασθαι)
glossary.δήμιός: δήμιος — of the people, public; masc. nom. sg., predicate; accented before the enclitic ἐστιν
glossary.δίκαιον: δίκαιος — just, right; neut. nom. sg., predicate: ’(it is) just’
glossary.δεδάκρυνται: δακρύω — weep, shed tears; perf. 3 pl. mid./pass.: ’are wet with tears’
glossary.δεχώμεθα: δέχομαι — receive, accept; pres. subj. 1 pl. mid., hortatory: ’let us accept’
glossary.εἷσ: ἵζω (aor. εἷσα) — seat, set, place; aor. 3 sg. act., elided (εἷσ’ = εἷσε): ’he set’
glossary.εὐρυμετώπων: εὐρυμέτωπος — broad-browed; gen. pl., epithet of cattle
glossary.θείῃ: τίθημι — put, place, make; aor. subj. 3 sg., epic θείῃ (= Attic θῇ); with σκέδασιν, ’bring about’
glossary.θεσπεσίοισι: θεσπέσιος — wondrous, marvellous (lit. ’divinely sounding’); neut. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
glossary.καθίδρυε: καθιδρύω — seat, set down; impf. 3 sg.: ’he seated’
glossary.καλοῖς: καλός — beautiful, fine; neut. dat. pl.
glossary.καταθεὶς: κατατίθημι — put down, set down; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having set down’
glossary.κερτομίας: κερτομία — taunt, mockery, gibe; fem. acc. pl.
glossary.κερόωντο: κεράννυμι (epic κεράω) — mix; impf. 3 pl. mid., epic uncontracted and unaugmented (= Attic ἐκεράννυντο): ’they mixed’
glossary.κεφαλλήνων: Κεφαλλῆνες — the Cephallenians, Odysseus’ island people; masc. gen. pl.
glossary.κομόωντες: κομάω — wear the hair long; pres. part. masc. nom. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic κομῶντες): ’long-haired’
glossary.κρητῆρσιν: κρατήρ (epic κρητήρ) — mixing-bowl for wine and water; masc. dat. pl., epic -ῆρσιν (= Attic κρατῆρσι)
glossary.κτήσιππος: Κτήσιππος — Ctesippus, a suitor from Same; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.κτεινομένους: κτείνω — kill, slay; pres. part. pass. masc. acc. pl.: ’being killed’
glossary.λαίφε: λαῖφος — rag, tattered garment; neut. acc. pl., elided (λαίφε’ = λαίφεα)
glossary.λευγαλέοισιν: λευγαλέος — pitiful, wretched, baneful; neut. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις)
glossary.λιγύν: λιγύς — clear-voiced, shrill, clear; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.λοετροχόῳ: λοετροχόος — bath-pourer, one who pours the bath-water (λοετρόν ’bath’ + χέω ’pour’); dat. sg., adjective used as a noun (= Attic λουτροχόος)
glossary.μένοντα: μένω — stay, remain, wait; pres. part. masc. acc. sg.: ’staying’
glossary.μεγάρου: μέγαρον — hall, great room; neut. gen. sg.
glossary.μελανθεύς: Μελανθεύς — Melanthius, a goatherd of Odysseus (the same man as Μελάνθιος); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.μισγέμεναι: μίσγω — mix, mingle; pres. inf. mid./pass., epic -έμεναι (= Attic μίσγεσθαι)
glossary.μνάσκετ: μνάομαι — woo, court; impf. 3 sg. mid., with -σκ- of continued action, elided (μνάσκετ’ = μνάσκετο): ’was wooing’
glossary.νεῖμε: νέμω — distribute, deal out; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔνειμε)
glossary.οἰνοποτάζων: οἰνοποτάζω — drink wine, be a drinker; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.
glossary.παύσαμεν: παύω — stop, make cease; aor. ind. 1 pl., unaugmented (= ἐπαύσαμεν): ’we stopped’; with κε, unreal past: ’we would have stopped’
glossary.πεποιθὼς: πείθω — persuade; perf. πέποιθα: trust, rely on (+ dat.); perf. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’trusting’
glossary.πινυτὴ: πινυτή — good sense, discernment, prudence (from πινυτός ’sensible’); fem. nom. sg.
glossary.σκιερὸν: σκιερός — shady, shadowy; neut. acc. sg.
glossary.συνθεύσεται: συνθέω — run along with, i.e. fall in with, suit (+ dat.); fut. 3 sg. mid.; the figurative sense is uncertain
glossary.τοιάδε: τοιόσδε — of such a kind, such; neut. acc. pl.
glossary.τρήρωνα: τρήρων — timorous, shy (epithet of doves); fem. acc. sg.
glossary.τρομέουσι: τρομέω — tremble (at), fear; pres. 3 pl., epic uncontracted -έουσι (= Attic τρομοῦσι)
glossary.ἀγινέμεναί: ἀγινέω — lead, bring, drive; pres. inf., epic -έμεναι (= Attic ἀγινεῖν); accented before the enclitic σφισιν
glossary.ἀγορητήν: ἀγορητής — speaker, orator; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀλλοτρίῃσι: ἀλλότριος — of another, foreign, belonging to someone else; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι (= Attic -αις)
glossary.ἀνεκτὰ: ἀνεκτός — endurable, bearable; neut. nom. pl.
glossary.ἀπειλήσας: ἀπειλέω — threaten; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having threatened’
glossary.ἀριστερὸς: ἀριστερός — left, on the left; masc. nom. sg., predicative: ’on the left’
glossary.ἀτέμβειν: ἀτέμβω — cheat of what is due, wrong; pres. inf.; a rare word of uncertain sense
glossary.ἀφέξω: ἀπέχω — hold off, keep away (+ acc.); fut. 1 sg., ἀφέξω with ἀπό aspirated before ἔξω
glossary.ἐκτήσατο: κτάομαι — acquire, get for oneself; aor. 3 sg. mid., augmented: ’acquired’
glossary.ἐλάγχανον: λαγχάνω — get by lot, obtain; impf. 3 pl.: ’were getting’
glossary.ἐλεαίρεις: ἐλεαίρω — pity, have compassion on; pres. 2 sg., epic by-form of ἐλεέω
glossary.ἐνιπῆς: ἐνιπή — rebuke, reproach; fem. gen. sg.
glossary.ἐπένειμε: ἐπινέμω — deal out to, distribute (+ dat.); aor. 3 sg., augmented: ’dealt out’
glossary.ἐπέοικεν: ἐπέοικα (ἐπί + ἔοικα) — be fitting, be seemly; perf. 3 sg. with pres. sense: ’it is fitting’
glossary.ἐπίσχετε: ἐπέχω (aor. ἐπέσχον) — hold back, restrain; aor. imper. 2 pl.
glossary.ἐπιδινεῖται: ἐπιδινέω — whirl round; mid. turn over (in the mind); pres. 3 sg. mid., contracted
glossary.ἐπόψεαι: ἐφοράω (fut. ἐπόψομαι) — look upon, behold; fut. 2 sg. mid., epic -εαι (= Attic ἐπόψῃ)
glossary.ἐϋσταθέος: ἐϋσταθής — well-standing, firmly built; masc./neut. gen. sg., epic uncontracted -έος (= Attic -οῦς)
glossary.ἐῳνοχόει: οἰνοχοέω — pour wine, serve wine; impf. 3 sg., augmented: ’was pouring wine’
glossary.ἑκατηβόλου: ἑκατηβόλος — far-shooting (epithet of Apollo; traditional sense); masc. gen. sg.
glossary.ἑκατόμβην: ἑκατόμβη — hecatomb, great sacrifice (originally of a hundred oxen); fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἤρτυον: ἀρτύω — prepare, arrange; impf. 3 pl., augmented: ’were preparing’
glossary.ἱερὴν: ἱερός — sacred, holy; fem. acc. sg., Ionic -ήν (= Attic ἱεράν)
glossary.ἴσην: ἴσος — equal, even; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ὀλίγην: ὀλίγος — little, small, scanty; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ὀλοώτερος: ὀλοός — destructive, deadly; masc. nom. sg., comparative ὀλοώτερος: ’deadlier’
glossary.ὀμοῦμαι: ὄμνυμι — swear; fut. 1 sg. mid. (contracted from ὀμόσσομαι): ’I shall swear’
glossary.ὀπτήσαντες: ὀπτάω — roast; aor. part. act. masc. nom. pl.: ’having roasted’
glossary.ὑποσταχύοιτο: ὑποσταχύομαι — spring up like ears of corn, i.e. multiply; pres. opt. 3 sg. mid., potential with κεν; a rare word
glossary.αἱμοφόρυκτα: αἱμοφόρυκτος — smeared with blood (αἷμα + φορύσσω ‘befoul’); neut. acc. pl., agreeing with κρέα
glossary.αὖτέ: αὖτε — again, on the other hand; adv., accented αὖτέ before the enclitic τις (same word as αὖτε)
glossary.γέλασσαν: γελάω — laugh; aor. 3 pl. act., epic -σσ- and unaugmented (= ἐγέλασαν)
glossary.γελοίων: γελοιάω (by-form of γελάω) — laugh; impf. 3 pl., epic, unaugmented (= Attic ἐγέλων)
glossary.γελοίωντες: γελοιάω (by-form of γελάω) — laugh; pres. part. act. masc. nom. pl., epic, lengthened ω (= Attic γελῶντες)
glossary.γναθμοῖσι: γνάθμος (= γνάθος) — jaw; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι, instrumental: ‘with jaws’
glossary.δέγμενος: δέχομαι — receive; wait for, await; syncopated aor. part. mid. masc. nom. sg. with present sense, epic (= Attic δεξάμενος)
glossary.δέδηε: δαίω — kindle, burn; perf. 3 sg. intrans., epic: ‘is ablaze, burns’
glossary.δίεσθαι: δίεμαι — drive away, chase; pres. inf. mid., epic (cf. Attic διώκειν)
glossary.δαμαστορίδης: Δαμαστορίδης — son of Damastor (patronymic in -ίδης); masc. nom. sg., epic
glossary.διατρίβω: διατρίβω — rub through; wear away time, delay, hold up (+ acc.); pres. 1 sg. act.: ‘I delay, hold up’
glossary.δῆλον: δῆλος — clear, evident; neut. nom. sg., predicate: ‘it is clear’
glossary.εἰδώλων: εἴδωλον — phantom, ghost, image; neut. gen. pl., gen. of fullness after πλέον: ‘full of phantoms’
glossary.εἰλύαται: εἰλύω (εἱλύω) — wrap, enfold; perf. 3 pl. mid./pass., epic -αται (= -νται): ‘are wrapped’
glossary.εὔδμητον: εὔδμητος — well-built (εὖ + δέμω ‘build’); masc. acc. sg., agreeing with τοῖχον
glossary.ζῆν: Ζεύς — Zeus; acc. sg. Ζῆν (elided Ζῆν’ = Ζῆνα), after μά in an oath
glossary.θεμένη: τίθημι — put, set; aor. part. mid. fem. nom. sg.: ‘having set (for herself)’
glossary.θησέμεναι: τίθημι — put, set (before); fut. inf. act., epic -έμεναι (= Attic θήσειν)
glossary.κακοξεινώτερος: κακόξεινος — bad to strangers, inhospitable (κακός + ξεῖνος); comparative, masc. nom. sg., + gen. of comparison
glossary.κτήσιππ: Κτήσιππος — Ctesippus, a suitor; masc. voc. sg., elided (Κτήσιππ’ = Κτήσιππε)
glossary.κτήσιππον: Κτήσιππος — Ctesippus, a suitor; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.μείδησε: μειδάω — smile; aor. 3 sg. act., unaugmented (= ἐμείδησε)
glossary.μενεαίνετε: μενεαίνω — be eager, be set on (+ inf.); pres. 2 pl. act.: ‘you are bent on’
glossary.μενοεικές: μενοεικής — satisfying, abundant (‘fitting the spirit’, μένος + εἰκ-); neut. acc. sg., agreeing with δεῖπνον
glossary.μηχανάασθε: μηχανάομαι — devise, contrive; pres. 2 pl. mid./dep., epic uncontracted (= Attic μηχανᾶσθε)
glossary.μηχανόωντο: μηχανάομαι — devise, contrive; impf. 3 pl. mid./dep., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἐμηχανῶντο), unaugmented
glossary.μὰ: μά — by (in oaths, + acc. of the one sworn by); particle: οὐ μά ‘no, by …’
glossary.νέμηαι: νέμομαι — have the use of, enjoy, possess; pres. subj. 2 sg. mid., epic -ηαι (= Attic νέμῃ), purpose after ὄφρα
glossary.νόστησ: νοστέω — return home; aor. 3 sg., elided (νόστησ’ = νόστησε), unaugmented (= ἐνόστησε)
glossary.ξείνοις: ξεῖνος — stranger, guest-friend (epic = Attic ξένος); masc. dat. pl., after ἐπί: ‘at the strangers’
glossary.οἰμωγὴ: οἰμωγή — wailing, lamentation; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.οἴνοιό: οἶνος — wine; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου), accented before enclitic τε; gen. absolute with πινομένοιο
glossary.πέμψωμεν: πέμπω — send, escort; aor. subj. 1 pl., hortatory: ‘let us send’
glossary.πίθοιο: πείθομαι — obey, heed (+ dat.); aor. opt. 2 sg. mid., in a condition: ‘if you were to heed’
glossary.παρακλίνας: παρακλίνω — bend aside; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ‘having bent aside’
glossary.πινομένοιο: πίνω — drink; pres. part. mid./pass. masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο: ‘being drunk’, gen. absolute with οἴνοιο
glossary.πολυκληῗδι: πολυκλήϊς — with many thwarts (rowing-benches; πολύς + κληΐς); dat. sg., epic, agreeing with νηΐ
glossary.πομπῆας: πομπεύς — escort, conductor; masc. acc. pl., epic -ῆας (= Attic -εῖς)
glossary.προσεδέρκετο: προσδέρκομαι — look at, gaze toward; impf. 3 sg. mid./dep., augment placed after the preverb
glossary.πρόσωπά: πρόσωπον — face; neut. nom. pl., accented πρόσωπά before enclitic τε
glossary.πρότεροι: πρότερος — earlier, first (comparative of πρό); masc. nom. pl., predicative: ‘first (to do it)’
glossary.σαρδάνιον: σαρδάνιος — bitter, scornful, of a smile (sense and origin uncertain; Attic σαρδόνιος); neut. acc. sg., adverbial
glossary.σικελοὺς: Σικελός — Sicel, a man of the Sicels, a people of a distant land; masc. acc. pl.: ‘to the Sicels’ after ἐς
glossary.σφέων: σφεῖς — they, them (3rd-person pl. pron.); gen. pl., epic σφέων (= Attic σφῶν), possessive: ‘their’
glossary.σφαζομένων: σφάζω — slaughter, cut the throat of; pres. part. mid./pass. neut. gen. pl.: ‘being slaughtered’, gen. absolute with μήλων
glossary.σφωϊν: σύ (dual σφῶϊ) — you two; dat. dual σφῶϊν (same form as gen.), epic (= Attic σφῷν): ‘to you two’
glossary.τέτλαμεν: τλάω — endure, bear; perf. 1 pl. with pres. sense, epic: ‘we endure’
glossary.τετυγμένος: τεύχω — make, fashion; perf. part. mid./pass. masc. nom. sg., epic: ‘well made, wrought’
glossary.φαίην: φημί — say; pres. opt. 1 sg. act., potential with κε: ‘I would say’
glossary.φαινέτω: φαίνω — show, bring to light; pres. imper. 3 sg. act.: ‘let (no one) show’
glossary.ἀγέλαε: Ἀγέλαος — Agelaus, a suitor (‘leader of the host’); masc. voc. sg.
glossary.ἀγέλαος: Ἀγέλαος — Agelaus, a suitor (‘leader of the host’); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀεικής: ἀεικής — unseemly, shameful; masc./fem. nom. sg.; with οὐδέν adverbial: ‘in no way unseemly’
glossary.ἀεικείας: ἀεικείη — unseemly conduct, indignity; fem. acc. pl., object of φαινέτω
glossary.ἀλάληται: ἀλάομαι — wander, rove; perf. 3 sg. mid./dep. with pres. sense: ‘is wandering’
glossary.ἀλέαιτο: ἀλέομαι — avoid, escape; aor. opt. 3 sg. mid., epic, in a potential clause: ‘could avoid’
glossary.ἀλεύατ: ἀλέομαι — avoid, shun; aor. 3 sg. mid., elided (ἀλεύατ’ = ἀλεύατο), epic, unaugmented (= ἠλεύατο)
glossary.ἀλλοτρίοισιν: ἀλλότριος — of another, not one’s own; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις), agreeing with γναθμοῖσι
glossary.ἀμφεπονεῖτο: ἀμφιπονέομαι — busy oneself about, tend (+ acc.); impf. 3 sg. mid., contracted; with κέ, unreal past: ‘would have been busy’
glossary.ἀμφοτέροιϊν: ἀμφότερος — both (of two); dat. dual, epic -οιϊν (= Attic -οιν), agreeing with σφωϊν
glossary.ἀρούρης: ἄρουρα — ploughed land, field; fem. gen. sg., Ionic -ης (= Attic -ας); ἄχθος ἀρούρης ‘a burden on the land’
glossary.ἀφραίνει: ἀφραίνω — be witless, be out of one’s senses (ἄφρων); pres. 3 sg. act.
glossary.ἀχαρίστερον: ἀχάριστος — graceless, unpleasing; comparative ἀχαρίστερος, neut. nom. sg., agreeing with ἄλλο
glossary.ἀχλύς: ἀχλύς — mist, dimness, haze; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἄντηστιν: ἄντηστις — a meeting face to face; fem. acc. sg., adverbial in κατ’ ἄντηστιν: ‘right opposite’
glossary.ἐΐσκει: ἐΐσκω — liken; take one thing for another, suppose; pres. 3 sg. act., epic
glossary.ἐκπέμψασθε: ἐκπέμπω — send out; aor. imper. 2 pl. mid., sigmatic (-ασθε)
glossary.ἐξαπόλωλε: ἐξαπόλλυμι — destroy utterly; perf. 3 sg., intrans.: ‘has perished, has vanished’
glossary.ἐξῆλθε: ἐξέρχομαι — go out; aor. 3 sg. act. (ἐξῆλθε, stem ἐλθ-)
glossary.ἐπίμαστον: ἐπίμαστος — sought out, hunted up (cf. ἐπιμαίομαι ‘seek after’); masc. acc. sg., agreeing with ἀλήτην; exact sense uncertain
glossary.ἐρέθιζον: ἐρεθίζω — provoke, goad; impf. 3 pl. act.
glossary.ἐρράδαται: ῥαίνω — sprinkle, splash; perf. 3 pl. mid./pass., epic (= Attic ἔρρανται): ‘are splashed’
glossary.ἐώλπει: ἔλπομαι — hope, expect; plpf. 3 sg. of the perf. ἔολπα (present sense), with imperfect force: ‘was hoping’
glossary.ἔμπαιον: ἔμπαιος — skilled in, versed in (+ gen.); masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἔξειμι: ἔξειμι (ἐκ + εἶμι ‘go’) — go out; pres. 1 sg. with future sense: ‘I shall go out’
glossary.ἔρεβόσδε: Ἔρεβος — Erebus, the dark under-gloom of the dead; acc. sg. + suffix -σδε (= -δε) ‘to, toward’: ‘down to Erebus’
glossary.ἔφθιται: φθίνω — perish, waste away; perf. 3 sg. mid./pass.: ‘has perished, is dead’
glossary.ἰσχέμεναί: ἴσχω — hold back, check, restrain; pres. inf. act., epic -έμεναι (= Attic ἴσχειν), accented before enclitic τε
glossary.ἱέρευσαν: ἱερεύω — sacrifice, slaughter (for a feast); aor. 3 pl. act.
glossary.ἱεμένων: ἵεμαι — hasten, press on, be eager; pres. part. mid. gen. pl., epic: ‘hastening’, agreeing with εἰδώλων
glossary.ὀξυόεντι: ὀξυόεις — sharp, pointed; neut. dat. sg., epic -όεντι, agreeing with ἔγχεϊ
glossary.ὑπότροπος: ὑπότροπος — returning, back again; masc. nom. sg., predicative: ‘back home’
glossary.ὠΐετο: ὀΐομαι — forebode, suspect, think; impf. 3 sg. mid./dep., augmented ὠΐετο (= Attic ᾤετο), + acc.
glossary.αἴνυτο: αἴνυμαι — take, grasp, lift up; impf. 3 sg. mid., epic, unaugmented (cf. Attic ἐλάμβανε)
glossary.βοσκόμενος: βόσκω — feed; mid. graze, feed (of cattle); pres. part. mid. masc. nom. sg.: ’grazing’
glossary.βουκόλος: βουκόλος — cowherd, herdsman; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.γνώτην: γιγνώσκω — come to know, recognize; aor. 3 dual act., unaugmented (= Attic ἐγνώτην): ’the two knew’
glossary.γωρυτῷ: γωρυτός — bow-case, quiver-case; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.γῆμαι: γαμέω — marry, take as wife (of a man); aor. inf. act.: ’to marry’
glossary.δακρύσας: δακρύω — weep, shed tears; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having wept’
glossary.δειλώ: δειλός — wretched, miserable, poor; masc. voc. dual: ’you two wretches’
glossary.διοϊστεύσειν: διοϊστεύω — shoot an arrow through; fut. inf. act.: ’to shoot through’
glossary.δρύϊνον: δρύϊνος — of oak, oaken; masc. acc. sg. (Attic δρύινος)
glossary.εὐκαμπέα: εὐκαμπής — well-bent, with a good curve; fem. acc. sg., epic uncontracted -έα (= Attic εὐκαμπῆ)
glossary.εὐρυτίδην: Εὐρυτίδης — son of Eurytus (patronymic in -ίδης); masc. acc. sg., epic
glossary.εὐρυτίδης: Εὐρυτίδης — son of Eurytus (patronymic in -ίδης); masc. nom. sg., epic
glossary.θάλαμόνδε: θάλαμος — inner room, chamber; acc. sg. with -δε of direction: θάλαμόνδε ’to the chamber’
glossary.θεῖσα: τίθημι — put, place; aor. part. act. fem. nom. sg.: ’having placed’
glossary.θυρέων: θύρη — door; fem. gen. pl., epic uncontracted -έων (= Attic θυρῶν)
glossary.κέσκετ: κεῖμαι — lie; iterative impf. 3 sg., epic -σκε- (elided κέσκετ’ = κέσκετο; cf. Attic ἔκειτο): ’used to lie’
glossary.καρτερόθυμον: καρτερόθυμος — stout-hearted, of enduring spirit; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.κατέκτανεν: κατακτείνω — kill, slay; aor. 3 sg. act. (strong aor. -έκτανον), ν-movable (Attic κατέκτεινεν): ’killed’
glossary.κατείβετον: κατείβω — pour down, let fall; pres. 2 dual act.: ’you two let fall’
glossary.κλαίετον: κλαίω — weep, wail; pres. imper. 2 dual act.: ’weep, you two’
glossary.κληΐδι: κληΐς, -ΐδος — key, bolt; fem. dat. sg., epic (= Attic κλειδί), instrumental: ’with the key’
glossary.κληῗδ: κληΐς, -ΐδος — key, bolt; fem. acc. sg. κληῗδα, elided (κληῗδ’; Attic κλεῖδα)
glossary.κορώνης: κορώνη — curved door-handle or ring (the same word as κορώνη ’crow’); fem. gen. sg.; exact sense uncertain
glossary.λακεδαίμονι: Λακεδαίμων — Lacedaemon, the Spartan land; fem. dat. sg., locative: ’in Lacedaemon’
glossary.λιπόντε: λείπω — leave; aor. part. act. masc. nom. dual: ’having left, you two’
glossary.μεγάλων: μέγας — big, great; gen. pl. (all genders)
glossary.μεσσήνιοι: Μεσσήνιος — of Messene, Messenian; adj., masc. nom. pl.
glossary.μεσσήνῃ: Μεσσήνη — Messene, a land in the southwest Peloponnese; fem. dat. sg., locative: ’in Messene’
glossary.μνῆμα: μνῆμα — reminder, keepsake, memorial; neut. nom. sg.
glossary.μύθου: μῦθος — word, speech, talk; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.νευρὴν: νευρή — bowstring, cord; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ξεινοσύνης: ξεινοσύνη — guest-friendship, hospitality; fem. gen. sg., epic ξειν- (cf. Attic ξενία)
glossary.ξυμβλήτην: συμβάλλω — throw together; mid. meet (+ dat.); syncopated aor. 3 dual mid., epic ξυν- and unaugmented (= Attic συνεβλήτην)
glossary.παιδνὸς: παιδνός — young, small, boyish; masc. nom. sg., epic (cf. Attic παιδικός)
glossary.παλίντονον: παλίντονος — bent back, springing back, of a bow (exact sense uncertain); neut. nom./acc. sg.
glossary.περίκειτο: περίκειμαι — lie around, be set around (+ dat.); impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= Attic περιέκειτο)
glossary.πετάσθησαν: πετάννυμι — spread out; (of doors) fly open; aor. 3 pl. pass., unaugmented (= ἐπετάσθησαν)
glossary.πληγέντα: πλήσσω — strike, smite; aor. part. pass. neut. nom./acc. pl. (or masc. acc. sg.): ’struck’
glossary.πολιόν: πολιός — grey, hoary; masc. acc. sg. (also neut. nom./acc. sg.)
glossary.πολυκλήϊσι: πολυκλήϊς — with many oar-benches or thole-pins (sense disputed); fem. dat. pl., epic -ισι
glossary.πολύκμητός: πολύκμητος — much-wrought, laboriously worked; masc. nom. sg., accented before the enclitic τε
glossary.προσεβήσετο: προσβαίνω — go up to, step onto; aor. 3 sg. mid., epic -σετο (cf. Attic προσέβη): ’mounted, stepped onto’
glossary.προσκηδέος: προσκηδής — attached, closely bound (of friendship); gen. sg., epic uncontracted -έος (= Attic -οῦς)
glossary.σανίδος: σανίς, -ίδος — board, plank; fem. gen. sg.
glossary.στονόεντες: στονόεις — causing groans, woeful, grievous; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ταλαεργοί: ταλαεργός — enduring toil, hard-working; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.τιτυσκομένη: τιτύσκομαι — aim at, aim; pres. part. mid. fem. nom. sg., reduplicated present: ’aiming’
glossary.τραπέζῃ: τράπεζα — table; fem. dat. sg., epic -ῃ (Ionic η for α), locative: ’at table’
glossary.τριηκόσι: τριηκόσιοι, -αι, -α — three hundred; neut. acc. pl. τριηκόσια, elided (τριηκόσι’), epic (= Attic τριακόσια)
glossary.τυχήσας: τυγχάνω — hit upon, meet with, chance upon (+ gen./dat.); aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg., aor. in -ησα
glossary.φαεινάς: φαεινός — shining, bright; fem. acc. pl., epic (cf. Attic φανός)
glossary.φαεινός: φαεινός — shining, bright; masc. nom. sg., epic (cf. Attic φανός)
glossary.φαρέτρην: φαρέτρη — quiver; fem. acc. sg., epic -ην (Ionic η for α; Attic φαρέτρᾱν)
glossary.φόρει: φορέω — carry, wear, bear about; impf. 3 sg. act., epic, unaugmented (= Attic ἐφόρει)
glossary.φῶθ: φώς, φωτός — man, mortal; masc. acc. sg. φῶτα, elided and aspirated before a rough breathing (φῶθ’)
glossary.χαλκείην: χάλκειος — of bronze, brazen; fem. acc. sg., epic (cf. Attic χαλκοῦς)
glossary.χηλοὶ: χηλός — chest, coffer; fem. nom. pl.
glossary.ἀάατον: ἀάατος — harmless, not working ruin (ἀ- + ἄτη); sense debated; neut. acc. sg., epic -άα- uncontracted
glossary.ἀνέβραχεν: ἀναβράχω — crash out, clang, resound; aor. 3 sg. act., ν-movable
glossary.ἀνέκοπτεν: ἀνακόπτω — strike up, force back; impf. 3 sg. act., ν-movable: ’was striking back’
glossary.ἀπέλυσε: ἀπολύω — loose, untie, set free; aor. 3 sg. act.: ’unfastened’
glossary.ἀποθνῄσκων: ἀποθνῄσκω — die; pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’dying’
glossary.ἀρχήν: ἀρχή — beginning, first cause (also rule, office); fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀρχὴν: ἀρχή — beginning, first cause (also rule, office); fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀτίμα: ἀτιμάω — dishonour, slight, hold cheap; impf. 3 sg. act., epic, unaugmented (= Attic ἠτίμα)
glossary.ἄρσε: ἀραρίσκω — fit, join together; aor. 3 sg. act., epic, unaugmented (= ἦρσε): ’fitted’
glossary.ἐδύνασθε: δύναμαι — be able, can; impf. 2 pl. mid.-pass. (Attic ἠδύνασθε): ’you were able’
glossary.ἐντανύεσθαι: ἐντανύω — stretch tight, string (a bow); pres. inf. mid.-pass., epic (cf. Attic ἐντείνω): ’to be strung’
glossary.ἐντανύσειν: ἐντανύω — stretch tight, string (a bow); fut. inf. act., epic (cf. Attic ἐντείνω): ’to string’
glossary.ἐξελθόντε: ἐξέρχομαι — go out; aor. part. act. masc. nom. dual: ’having gone out, you two’
glossary.ἐξεσίην: ἐξεσίη — mission, embassy, errand; fem. acc. sg., epic -ην (Ionic η for α)
glossary.ἐπιίστορα: ἐπίστωρ, -ορος — one who knows, acquainted with, witness of (+ gen.); masc. acc. sg., epic ἐπιίστωρ
glossary.ἐπιείκελον: ἐπιείκελος — like, resembling (+ dat.); masc. acc. sg., epic
glossary.ἐπισχεσίην: ἐπισχεσίη — pretext, excuse; fem. acc. sg., epic -ην (Ionic η for α); exact sense debated
glossary.ἐπῆεν: ἔπειμι (εἰμί) — be upon, be on it; impf. 3 sg., epic ἦεν (= Attic ἐπῆν)
glossary.ἐρχόμενος: ἔρχομαι — come, go; pres. part. mid. masc. nom. sg.: ’going’
glossary.ἐφημέρια: ἐφημέριος — of a day, lasting but a day; neut. acc. pl., as a cognate object: ’things of the day’ (cf. ἐφήμερος)
glossary.ἐχράετ: χράω — press upon, assail (+ acc.; sense disputed); impf. 2 pl. act., epic uncontracted, elided (ἐχράετ’ = ἐχράετε; Attic ἐχρᾶτε)
glossary.ἑζομένη: ἕζομαι — seat oneself, sit down; pres. part. mid. fem. nom. sg.: ’sitting down’
glossary.ἔβραχε: βράχω — crash, clang, roar; aor. 3 sg. act., strong aorist
glossary.ἔνεσαν: ἔνειμι — be in, be within; impf. 3 pl., epic ἔσαν (= Attic ἐνῆσαν): ’were in it’
glossary.ἔσχατον: ἔσχατος — outermost, farthest, last; masc. acc. sg. (or neut. nom./acc. sg.)
glossary.ἰοδόκον: ἰοδόκος — arrow-holding, arrow-receiving; adj. (2-term.), fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἰοδόκος: ἰοδόκος — arrow-holding, arrow-receiving; adj. (2-term.), fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἴφιτον: Ἴφιτος — Iphitus, son of Eurytus; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἴφιτος: Ἴφιτος — Iphitus, son of Eurytus; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ὀρίνετον: ὀρίνω — stir up, trouble, agitate; pres. 2 dual act.: ’you two stir up’
glossary.ὀρεξαμένη: ὀρέγω — stretch out; mid. reach out, reach for; aor. part. mid. fem. nom. sg.: ’having reached up’
glossary.ὀχῆας: ὀχεύς — bolt, bar; masc. acc. pl., epic -ῆας (= Attic ὀχέας)
glossary.ὀϊστοῦ: ὀϊστός — arrow; masc. gen. sg. (partitive with γεύομαι ’taste of’)
glossary.ὄγκιον: ὄγκιον — a container, perhaps a chest or basket (sense inferred, uncertain); neut. acc. sg.
glossary.ὄπιν: ὄπις, -ιδος — regard, heed, awe (esp. of the gods’ retribution; sense uncertain); fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ὄφελλε: ὀφέλλω — owe (epic = ὀφείλω); impf. 3 sg. act., unaugmented (= ὤφελλε): ’owed’
glossary.ὑψηλῆς: ὑψηλός — high, lofty; fem. gen. sg.
glossary.ὤλεσ: ὄλλυμι — destroy, lose; aor. 3 sg. act., elided (ὤλεσ’ = ὤλεσε): ’destroyed’
glossary.ὤρνυε: ὄρνυμι — rouse, stir, urge on; impf. 3 sg. act., with ἐπί in tmesis (ἐπὶ … ὤρνυε): ’urged on’
glossary.ᾐδέσατ: αἰδέομαι — respect, feel awe before; aor. 3 sg. mid., elided (ᾐδέσατ’ = ᾐδέσατο)
glossary.ᾑρεῖτ: αἱρέω — take; mid. take for oneself, take up; impf. 3 sg. mid., elided (ᾑρεῖτ’ = ᾑρεῖτο): ’was taking, took’
glossary.ᾕρεε: αἱρέω — take; impf. 3 sg. act., epic uncontracted (= Attic ᾕρει); with ἐκ in tmesis: ’took out’
glossary.αἰέν: αἰέν — always, ever; adv., epic by-form of αἰεί (= Attic ἀεί)
glossary.αἴνου: αἶνος — tale, story, praise; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.βιοῦ: βιός — bow; masc. gen. sg. (distinct from βίος ’life’)
glossary.βουκόλε: βουκόλος — cowherd, herdsman; masc. voc. sg.
glossary.γελόω: γελάω — laugh; pres. 1 sg., epic uncontracted -όω (= Attic γελῶ)
glossary.διοϊστεύσω: διοϊστεύω — shoot an arrow through; aor. subj. 1 sg., short vowel (or fut. indic.): ’shoot through’
glossary.εἴπαθ: εἶπον — say, tell; aor. imper. 2 pl. act., elided and aspirated (εἴπαθ’ = εἴπατε): ’tell!’
glossary.εἶτ: εἰμί — be; pres. opt. 2 pl., epic, elided (εἶτ’ = εἶτε = Attic εἴητε), potential with κε: ’you would be’
glossary.εὐκόσμως: εὐκόσμως — in good order, neatly; adv. of εὔκοσμος
glossary.εὐπέπλων: εὔπεπλος — fair-robed, with beautiful robes; fem. gen. pl.
glossary.ζώοντας: ζώω — live; pres. part. act. masc. acc. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ζῶντας): ’living’
glossary.θάλποντες: θάλπω — warm, heat; pres. part. act. masc. nom. pl.: ’warming’
glossary.θυοσκόος: θυοσκόος — sacrificing priest, one who inspects offerings; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.κάμε: κάμνω — grow weary, tire; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔκαμε)
glossary.κεκαδήσει: χάζω — make yield, deprive (+ gen.); fut. 3 sg., epic reduplicated (cf. aor. κεκαδον): ’will deprive (of)’
glossary.κεύθω: κεύθω — hide, conceal, keep secret; pres. 1 sg., subj. in a deliberative question: ’am I to hide?’
glossary.κλίνας: κλίνω — lean, make lean; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having leaned’
glossary.κολλητῇσιν: κολλητός — glued, close-fitted; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσιν (= Attic -αῖς)
glossary.κῆον: καίω — kindle, light; imper. 2 sg., epic form of uncertain explanation (cf. aor. ἔκηα): ’kindle!’
glossary.λαβέτω: λαμβάνω — take; aor. imper. 3 sg. act.: ’let him take’
glossary.λείποι: λείπω — leave, forsake; pres. opt. 3 sg., potential with κε: ’would leave’
glossary.λειώδης: Λειώδης — Leiodes, son of Oenops, the suitors’ priest; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.λιποίμην: λείπω — leave; mid. be left behind; aor. opt. 1 sg. mid.: ’I should be left behind’
glossary.μεθῆκε: μεθίημι — let go, slacken, give up (+ gen.); aor. 3 sg. act. (= μετά + ἧκε)
glossary.μελάνθιον: Μελάνθιος — Melanthius, the goatherd; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.μελανθεῦ: Μελανθεύς — Melantheus, by-form of Μελάνθιος; masc. voc. sg.: ’Melanthius!’
glossary.μυχοίτατος: μύχιος — innermost, farthest in; superl. μυχοίτατος, masc. nom. sg.
glossary.μύνῃσι: μύνη — pretext, excuse (meaning uncertain; rare word); fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι (= Attic -αις)
glossary.νεμέσσα: νεμεσσάω — be indignant, take offence (+ dat.); impf. 3 sg., unaugmented, epic doubled σ (= Attic ἐνεμέσα)
glossary.νημερτέ: νημερτής — unerring, true; masc. acc. sg., elided (νημερτέ’ = νημερτέα): ’unerring’
glossary.οἰνοχοεύει: οἰνοχοεύω — pour wine, serve wine; pres. 3 sg.
glossary.οἴνοπος: Οἴνοψ — Oenops, father of Leiodes; masc. gen. sg. (Οἴνοπος)
glossary.οὗθ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ (relative) — who, which; neut. gen. sg. οὗ + τε, elided and aspirated (οὗθ’ = οὗ τε), with ἕνεκα: ’for the sake of which’
glossary.παρέλκετε: παρέλκω — draw aside, put off, drag out; pres. imper. 2 pl. act., in a prohibition: ’do not put off’
glossary.πειρήσασθε: πειράω — try, test, make trial of (+ gen.); aor. imper. 2 pl. mid.: ’make trial!’
glossary.πειρήτιζε: πειρητίζω — try, test (+ gen.); impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐπειρήτιζε)
glossary.πειρήτιζεν: πειρητίζω — try, test (+ gen.); impf. 3 sg., unaugmented, ν-movable (= ἐπειρήτιζεν)
glossary.πειρησαίμην: πειράω — try, test (+ gen.); aor. opt. 1 sg. mid., potential with κεν: ’I would try’
glossary.πειρώμεσθα: πειράω — try, test (+ gen.); pres. subj. 1 pl. mid., epic -μεσθα (= Attic πειρώμεθα)
glossary.πελέμιξεν: πελεμίζω — shake, make quiver; aor. 3 sg. act., unaugmented (= ἐπελέμιξεν)
glossary.ποῖοί: ποῖος — of what sort?, what kind of?; interrog. adj., masc. nom. pl., accented before an enclitic
glossary.προσέκλινε: προσκλίνω — lean (something) against; aor. 3 sg. act., augmented after the preverb
glossary.προφερέστεροί: προφερής — superior, surpassing (+ gen.); comparative προφερέστερος, masc. nom. pl., accented before an enclitic: ’better than’
glossary.σανίδεσσιν: σανίς — board, door-leaf; fem. dat. pl., epic -εσσιν (= Attic σανίσιν)
glossary.στέατος: στέαρ — fat, tallow; neut. gen. sg.
glossary.σφε: σφε — them; epic enclitic acc. pl. pron. (= Attic αὐτούς), masc.
glossary.τάφος: τάφος — amazement, astonishment; masc. nom. sg. · also τάφος — tomb, burial; masc. nom. sg. (homograph)
glossary.τάφρον: τάφρος — trench, ditch; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.τανυστύος: τανυστύς — stringing, bending (of a bow); fem. gen. sg.
glossary.τανύουσι: τανύω — stretch, string (a bow); pres. 3 pl. act.: ’they stretch’; with τάχα of the near future
glossary.τανύω: τανύω — stretch, string (a bow); pres. 1 sg. act.
glossary.τελευτήσειας: τελευτάω — accomplish, fulfil; aor. opt. 2 sg. act., Aeolic -σειας (= Attic -σαις), wish: ’may you fulfil’
glossary.φθεγξάμενός: φθέγγομαι — utter a sound, speak; aor. part. mid. masc. nom. sg., accented before an enclitic: ’having spoken’
glossary.ἀμύνοιτ: ἀμύνω — ward off, defend (+ dat.); pres. opt. 2 pl. act., elided (ἀμύνοιτ’ = ἀμύνοιτε), potential with κε: ’you would defend’
glossary.ἀνέλκων: ἀνέλκω — draw up, draw back; pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’drawing back’
glossary.ἀνένευε: ἀνανεύω — throw back the head, nod ’no’, refuse by a sign; impf. 3 sg., augment inside the compound (ἀν-έ-νευε)
glossary.ἀνελέσθαι: ἀναιρέω — take up, win (a prize); aor. inf. mid.: ’to take up, win’
glossary.ἀποτρωπᾶσθε: ἀποτρωπάομαι — turn away from, shrink from (+ gen.); pres. imper. 2 pl. mid., contracted: ’do not shrink’
glossary.ἀρξάμενοι: ἄρχω — begin; mid. ἄρχομαι begin from (+ gen.); aor. part. mid. masc. nom. pl.: ’beginning’
glossary.ἀτασθαλίαι: ἀτασθαλία — reckless folly, wicked arrogance; fem. nom. pl.
glossary.ἀτρίπτους: ἄτριπτος — unworn, not rubbed by toil; adj. of two endings, fem. acc. pl.
glossary.ἀχαιΐδα: Ἀχαιΐς — Achaean; adj. of land, fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἁμαρτεῖν: ἁμαρτάνω — miss, fail of, be wanting; aor. inf. act.: ’to miss’
glossary.ἁπαλάς: ἁπαλός — soft, tender; fem. acc. pl.
glossary.ἄγρει: ἄγρει — come now! up!; epic interjection with an imper. sense (perhaps from ἀγρέω ’take’)
glossary.ἄφρονα: ἄφρων — senseless, foolish; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἐκτελέωμεν: ἐκτελέω — bring to an end, accomplish; pres. subj. 1 pl. act., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἐκτελῶμεν): ’let us finish’, ’that we may finish’
glossary.ἐνείκαι: φέρω — bring, carry (aor. stem ἐνεικ-); aor. opt. 3 sg. act. in -αι, epic (= Attic ἐνέγκαι): ’might bring’
glossary.ἐντάνυσε: ἐντανύω — stretch, string (a bow); aor. 3 sg. act., unaugmented (= ἐνετάνυσε)
glossary.ἐντανύειν: ἐντανύω — stretch, string (a bow); pres. inf. act.: ’to string’
glossary.ἐντανύσω: ἐντανύω — stretch, string (a bow); aor. subj. 1 sg. act., short vowel (or fut. indic.)
glossary.ἐπειρῶντ: πειράω — try, test; mid. πειράομαι; impf. 3 pl. mid., elided (ἐπειρῶντ’ = ἐπειρῶντο): ’they tried’
glossary.ἐπεῖχε: ἐπέχω — hold back, hold off, restrain oneself; impf. 3 sg. act.
glossary.ἐπιδέξια: ἐπιδέξιος — to the right, on the right hand; neut. acc. pl. used as adv.: ’towards the right’
glossary.ἐπιδευέες: ἐπιδευής — in want of, lacking (+ gen.); masc. nom. pl., epic uncontracted -έες (= Attic -εῖς)
glossary.ἐπιελπόμενος: ἐπιέλπομαι — hope, expect; pres. part. mid. masc. nom. sg.: ’hoping’
glossary.ἐπιχρίοντες: ἐπιχρίω — smear on, rub over; pres. part. act. masc. nom. pl.: ’smearing’
glossary.ἐρύσσεσθαι: ἐρύω — draw, pull; pres. inf. mid., epic doubled σ (= ἐρύεσθαι): ’to draw’
glossary.ἐχθραὶ: ἐχθρός — hateful, hostile; fem. nom. pl.
glossary.ἐϋξέστῃς: ἐΰξεστος — well-planed, well-polished; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃς (= Attic -αις)
glossary.ἔλπετ: ἔλπομαι — hope, expect, long for; pres. 3 sg. mid., elided (ἔλπετ’ = ἔλπεται)
glossary.ἔναξε: νάσσω — pack down, stamp firm; aor. 3 sg. act., augmented (ἔ-ναξε)
glossary.ἕψεσθαι: ἕπομαι — follow, go with; fut. inf. mid.: ’to follow’
glossary.ἰοῦσ: εἶμι — go; pres. part. act. fem. nom. sg., elided (ἰοῦσ’ = ἰοῦσα): ’going’
glossary.ἱέμενόν: ἵημι — send, let go; mid. ἵεμαι be eager, strive; pres. part. mid. masc. acc. sg., accented before an enclitic: ’eager’
glossary.ἴδωμεν: εἶδον (aor. of ὁράω) — see; aor. subj. 1 pl. act.: ’let us see’, ’that we may see’
glossary.ὀπώπει: ὁράω — see; pluperf. 3 sg. (perf. ὄπωπα), epic (= Attic ἑωράκει): ’he had seen’
glossary.ὀρύξας: ὀρύσσω — dig; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having dug’
glossary.ὁμαρτήσαντες: ὁμαρτέω — go together with, accompany; aor. part. act. masc. nom. pl.: ’going together’
glossary.ὁμιλέομεν: ὁμιλέω — keep company, be together, throng; pres. 1 pl., epic uncontracted -έομεν (= Attic ὁμιλοῦμεν)
glossary.ὄρνυσθ: ὄρνυμι — rouse; mid. rouse oneself, rise; pres. imper. 2 pl. mid., elided (ὄρνυσθ’ = ὄρνυσθε): ’rise!’
glossary.ὠκύ: ὠκύς — swift, quick; neut. acc. sg.
glossary.ὠκὺ: ὠκύς — swift, quick; neut. acc. sg.
glossary.αἰπολίοισιν: αἰπόλιον — herd of goats; neut. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις)
glossary.γνῶτον: γιγνώσκω — come to know; aor. subj. 2 dual, athematic: ’that you two may know’
glossary.δαίνυσαι: δαίνυμι (mid. δαίνυμαι) — feast, dine; pres. mid. 2 sg.: ’you feast’
glossary.δαινύσθω: δαίνυμι (mid. δαίνυμαι) — feast, dine; pres. imper. mid. 3 sg.: ’let him feast’
glossary.δμῶε: δμώς — slave, bondman; masc. nom./acc. dual: ’the two servants’
glossary.δῖε: δῖος — heavenly, divine, illustrious; masc. voc. sg.
glossary.εἰσιδέτην: εἰσοράω (aor. εἰσεῖδον) — look at, see; aor. 3 dual, unaugmented (= Attic εἰσείδετην): ’the two saw’
glossary.εἰῶμεν: ἐάω — allow, let be; pres. subj. 1 pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἐῶμεν): ’we should leave’
glossary.εὐξαμένου: εὔχομαι — pray, vow; aor. part. mid. masc. gen. sg.: ’praying’
glossary.εὐρυτίωνα: Εὐρυτίων — Eurytion, a Centaur; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.εὕρετο: εὑρίσκω — find, get; aor. mid. 3 sg., epic (= Attic ηὕρετο): ’found for himself’
glossary.θάλπων: θάλπω — warm, heat; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’warming’
glossary.θέντες: τίθημι — put, place; aor. part. act. masc. nom. pl.: ’having placed’
glossary.θήσεσθαι: τίθημι — put, make; fut. inf. mid.: ’to make (for himself)’
glossary.κάτθετ: κατατίθημι — put down, lay aside; aor. imper. 2 pl., apocope and elision (κάτθετ’ = κατάθετε): ’lay (it) down’
glossary.κέλεσθε: κέλομαι — urge, command; pres. imper. mid. 2 pl.: ’urge!’
glossary.κασιγνήτω: κασίγνητος — brother; masc. nom. dual: ’two brothers’
glossary.καταθείομεν: κατατίθημι — put down, lay aside; aor. subj. 1 pl., epic (= Attic καταθῶμεν): ’let us lay down’
glossary.κενταύροισι: Κένταυρος — Centaur; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
glossary.κληῗδι: κληΐς — bolt, bar, key; fem. dat. sg., epic (= Attic κλείς, dat. κλειδί): ’with a bolt’
glossary.κληῗσαι: κληΐω — shut, bar; aor. inf. act., epic (= Attic κλῇσαι), in indirect command: ’to shut’
glossary.κλυτοτόξῳ: κλυτότοξος — famed for the bow; masc. dat. sg., epithet of Apollo
glossary.κουροτέροισιν: κουρότερος — younger (comparative of κοῦρος ’youth’); masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις)
glossary.κτύπου: κτύπος — din, noise; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.κυδάλιμον: κυδάλιμος — glorious, noble; neut. acc. sg., epithet of the heart
glossary.λαπίθας: Λαπίθαι — the Lapiths, a people of Thessaly; masc. acc. pl.
glossary.μαινόμενος: μαίνομαι — rage, be mad; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’raving’
glossary.νοέεις: νοέω — perceive, understand; pres. 2 sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic νοεῖς): ’you realise’
glossary.οἴοισι: οἶος — alone, only; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
glossary.οἶνός: οἶνος — wine; masc. nom. sg., accented by the following enclitic σε
glossary.οὐλῆς: οὐλή — scar, healed wound; fem. gen. sg., gen. of separation: ’from the scar’
glossary.πέμψομεν: πέμπω — send, conduct; fut. 1 pl.: ’we will send’
glossary.πίνῃ: πίνω — drink; pres. subj. 3 sg., in a general relative with ἄν
glossary.παύεσθον: παύω — make stop; mid. cease (+ gen.); pres. imper. mid. 2 dual: ’you two cease’
glossary.πειριθόοιο: Πειρίθοος — Peirithous, king of the Lapiths; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.πελέκεάς: πέλεκυς — axe; masc. acc. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic πελέκεις), accented by the enclitic γε
glossary.πιθήσας: πιθέω (epic aor. ἐπίθησα; cf. πείθομαι) — trust, obey (+ dat.); aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’trusting in’
glossary.πιστωθῆτόν: πιστόω — make sure; pass. be assured; aor. subj. pass. 2 dual, accented by the enclitic τε: ’that you two may be assured’
glossary.πολίεσσιν: πόλις — city; fem. dat. pl., epic -εσσιν (= Attic πόλεσιν)
glossary.προβλώσκειν: προβλώσκω — go forth; pres. inf., in indirect command: ’(tell them) not to go out’
glossary.προμνηστῖνοι: προμνηστῖνοι — one after another, one by one; rare word of uncertain formation, masc. nom. pl.
glossary.σέλᾳ: σέλας — flame, blaze, brightness; neut. dat. sg.: ’in the blaze (of fire)’
glossary.σαώσεαι: σαόω (= σῴζω) — save; fut. mid. 2 sg., epic -εαι (= Attic -ῃ), passive sense: ’you will be saved’
glossary.σθένεος: σθένος — strength, might; neut. gen. sg., epic -εος (= Attic -ους)
glossary.στοναχῆς: στοναχή — groaning, sighing; fem. gen. sg.
glossary.τιταίνοιτ: τιταίνω — stretch, strain (a bow); pres. opt. mid. 3 sg., elided (τιταίνοιτ’ = τιταίνοιτο), potential with κε: ’would bend’
glossary.τρώει: τρώω — wear down, hurt, undo; pres. 3 sg.
glossary.φιλοίτιε: Φιλοίτιος — Philoetius, the cowherd; masc. voc. sg.
glossary.χανδὸν: χανδόν — greedily, with open mouth; adv.
glossary.ἀασθεὶς: ἀάω (mid. ἀάομαι) — blind, infatuate; aor. part. pass. masc. nom. sg.: ’blinded, infatuated’
glossary.ἀγαπᾷς: ἀγαπάω — welcome, be content; pres. 2 sg.: ’you are content (that)’
glossary.ἀγκύλα: ἀγκύλος — curved, bent; neut. acc. pl., agreeing with τόξα
glossary.ἀεσίφρονι: ἀεσίφρων — witless, senseless in mind (meaning uncertain); masc. dat. sg., epic
glossary.ἀκομιστίη: ἀκομιστίη — lack of tending, neglect; fem. nom. sg., Ionic -ίη (= Attic ἀκομιστία)
glossary.ἀμέρδεαι: ἀμέρδω — deprive (+ gen.); pres. pass. 2 sg., epic -εαι (= Attic -ῃ): ’you are deprived (of)’
glossary.ἀμήσαντες: ἀμάω — cut off, reap; aor. part. act. masc. nom. pl., with ἀπό in tmesis: ’having cut off’
glossary.ἀμφοτέροις: ἀμφότερος — both; masc. dat. pl.: ’to both’
glossary.ἀναΐξαντες: ἀναΐσσω — spring up, rush up; aor. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’having sprung up’
glossary.ἀναιρήσεσθαι: ἀναιρέω — take up, lift; fut. inf. mid.: ’to take up’
glossary.ἀντιβολήσεις: ἀντιβολέω — meet, encounter, share in (+ gen.); fut. 2 sg.: ’you will meet with’
glossary.ἀποέργαθεν: ἀποέργω (= ἀπείργω) — keep away, thrust aside; aor. 3 sg., epic with ν-movable (= Attic ἀπεῖρξε): ’thrust aside’
glossary.ἀραρυίας: ἀραρίσκω — fit together; perf. part. fem. acc. pl., epic -υῖα (Attic ἠρηρυῖα): ’closely fitted’
glossary.ἀριφραδὲς: ἀριφραδής — very clear, plain; neut. acc. sg., agreeing with σῆμα
glossary.ἀχαιΐδες: Ἀχαιΐς — Achaean woman; fem. nom. pl.
glossary.ἄασ: ἀάω — blind, infatuate, ruin; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented, elided (ἄασ’ = ἄασε)
glossary.ἄασεν: ἀάω — blind, infatuate, ruin; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented, ν-movable
glossary.ἄλλῃσιν: ἄλλος — other, another; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσιν (= Attic ἄλλαις)
glossary.ἄξεσθαι: ἄγω — lead, bring; fut. inf. mid.: ’to take (for himself)’
glossary.ἐάσουσιν: ἐάω — allow, let be; fut. 3 pl.: ’they will allow’
glossary.ἐελδομένοισιν: ἐέλδομαι — long for, desire; pres. part. masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις)
glossary.ἐλεγχείη: ἐλεγχείη — reproach, disgrace; fem. nom. sg., Ionic -είη (= Attic ἐλεγχεία)
glossary.ἐλθόνθ: ἔρχομαι — go, come; aor. part. masc. acc. sg., elided (ἐλθόνθ’ = ἐλθόντα): ’having come’
glossary.ἐντανύσειεν: ἐντανύω — stretch, string (a bow); aor. opt. act. 3 sg., in a fear clause after μή
glossary.ἐντανύσῃς: ἐντανύω — stretch, string (a bow); aor. subj. act. 2 sg., in a protasis after αἴ κε: ’if you string’
glossary.ἐνώμα: νωμάω — handle, wield, ply; impf. 3 sg.: ’was handling’
glossary.ἐπητύος: ἐπητύς — kindness, courtesy (meaning a guess); fem. gen. sg., gen. with ἀντιβολήσεις
glossary.ἐπιτρέψαι: ἐπιτρέπω — turn over, entrust, yield; aor. inf. act., after λίσσομαι: ’to entrust’
glossary.ἐρίδαινε: ἐριδαίνω — quarrel, contend; pres. imper. 2 sg.: ’quarrel!’
glossary.ἐρύκακε: ἐρύκω — hold back, restrain; aor. 3 sg., epic reduplicated aorist: ’checked’
glossary.ἐσέλθετε: εἰσέρχομαι — go in, enter; aor. imper. 2 pl.: ’go in!’
glossary.ἐφράσσαντο: φράζω — point out; mid. notice, take note of; aor. 3 pl. mid., doubled σ (= Attic ἐφράσαντο)
glossary.ἑορτὴ: ἑορτή — festival, feast-day; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἑστάμεν: ἵστημι — set up; intrans. perf. stand; perf. inf. act., epic (= Attic ἑστάναι): ’to stand’
glossary.ἑτάρω: ἑταῖρος (epic ἑτάρος) — companion; masc. nom. dual, epic (= Attic ἑταίρω): ’two companions’
glossary.ἔκυσσε: κυνέω — kiss; aor. 3 sg., doubled σ: ’kissed’
glossary.ἔλπεαι: ἔλπομαι — hope, expect; pres. 2 sg., epic -εαι (= Attic ἔλπῃ)
glossary.ἔξοχοι: ἔξοχος — standing out above (+ dat.); fem. nom. pl.: ’standing out above’
glossary.ἔολπε: ἔλπω — make hope; perf. ἔολπα, hope, expect; perf. 3 sg. with present sense: ’he expects’
glossary.ἕλῃ: αἱρέω — take, seize; aor. subj. 3 sg., in a general relative with ἄν: ’takes (it)’
glossary.ἕρκεσι: ἕρκος — fence, enclosure, court; neut. dat. pl.
glossary.ἧφι: ἑός (= ὅς, ἥ, ὅν possessive) — his own; fem. instrumental sg. in -φι, epic (= dat. ᾗ): ’by his own (might)’
glossary.ἰῆλαι: ἰάλλω — send, hurl, throw; aor. inf. act., in indirect command: ’to throw (on)’
glossary.ἴς: ἴς — strength, force; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ὀχέων: ὀχέω — bear, carry; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’bearing’
glossary.ὄλεσσεν: ὄλλυμι — destroy, ruin; aor. 3 sg., doubled σ (= Attic ὤλεσε)
glossary.ὑμείων: σύ (pl. ὑμεῖς) — you; gen. pl., epic ὑμείων (= Attic ὑμῶν): ’of you’
glossary.ὑπότροπον: ὑπότροπος — returning, back home; masc. acc. sg.: ’returned’
glossary.ὔμμες: σύ (pl. ὑμεῖς) — you; nom. pl., epic ὔμμες (= Attic ὑμεῖς)
glossary.ῥήσιος: ῥῆσις — speech, speaking; fem. gen. sg., epic -ιος (= Attic -εως)
glossary.αἰσχυνόμενοι: αἰσχύνομαι — feel shame, be ashamed of (+ acc.); pres. part. mid. masc. nom. pl.: ’feeling shame at’
glossary.αἴθοπι: αἴθοψ — fiery, flashing, gleaming; masc. dat. sg., agreeing with χαλκῷ: ’fire-faced, gleaming’
glossary.βιήσεται: βιάω (mid. βιάομαι) — use force on, constrain; fut. 3 sg. mid., epic η (= Attic βιάσεται): ’will force’
glossary.βιόν: βιός — bow; masc. acc. sg. (a poetic word = τόξον; not βίος ’life’)
glossary.βύβλινον: βύβλινος — made of papyrus; neut. nom. sg., agreeing with ὅπλον: ’of papyrus’
glossary.γλυφίδας: γλυφίς — notch of an arrow, where the string is set; fem. acc. pl.: ’the notches’
glossary.δίφροιο: δίφρος — stool, seat; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου), after ἐκ
glossary.δίωμαι: δίημι (mid. δίεμαι) — drive, chase, hunt away; pres. subj. mid. 1 sg., in a fear clause after μή: ’lest I chase’
glossary.δόμεναί: δίδωμι — give; aor. inf., epic -μεναι (= Attic δοῦναι), accented before the enclitic τε, complementing ἐθέλω: ’to give’
glossary.εἰκέλη: εἴκελος — like, resembling (+ dat.); fem. nom. sg., epic (= Attic ὅμοιος, ἐοικυῖα): ’like’
glossary.εὐερκέος: εὐερκής — well-fenced, strongly walled; fem. gen. sg., agreeing with αὐλῆς
glossary.εὐπηγής: εὐπηγής — well-built, strongly made; masc. nom. sg., predicate with ξεῖνος
glossary.θηητὴρ: θηητήρ — admirer, one who gazes at with wonder; masc. nom. sg., epic (= Attic θεατής)
glossary.κέλεταί: κέλομαι — bid, urge, command; pres. 3 sg. mid., epic (= Attic κελεύει), accent from the enclitic σε: ’bids’
glossary.καθάπαξ: καθάπαξ — once for all, outright, altogether; adv. (καθ’ ἅπαξ)
glossary.κατέδονται: κατεσθίω (epic κατέδω) — eat up, devour; fut. 3 pl. mid. of ἔδω: ’will devour’
glossary.κείατο: κεῖμαι — lie; impf. 3 pl., epic -ατο and unaugmented (= Attic ἔκειντο): ’lay’
glossary.κεκορυθμένος: κορύσσω — arm, equip with a helmet; perf. part. mid./pass. masc. nom. sg.: ’armed, equipped’
glossary.κρόνου: Κρόνος — Cronus, father of Zeus; masc. gen. sg.: Κρόνου πάϊς ’son of Cronus’ is Zeus
glossary.κόλλοπι: κόλλοψ — peg of a lyre, round which the string is wound; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.μέθιεν: μεθίημι — let go, relax, give up (+ gen.); impf. 3 pl., epic (= Attic μεθίεσαν): ’they let go of’
glossary.μολπῇ: μολπή — song with dance, play, merry-making; fem. dat. sg., Ionic -ῃ (= Attic μολπῇ): ’with song and dance’
glossary.νήσοισι: νῆσος — island; fem. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
glossary.νευρῆς: νευρή — bowstring, string; fem. gen. sg., object of πειράω (+ gen.): ’the string’
glossary.νεῦσεν: νεύω — nod; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔνευσεν): ’nodded’
glossary.νωμᾷ: νωμάω — handle, ply, turn this way and that; pres. 3 sg., contracted (= νωμάει): ’turns’
glossary.οἰός: ὄϊς (οἶς) — sheep; gen. sg. οἰός (epic ὄϊος), dependent on ἔντερον: ’of a sheep’
glossary.οὗτός: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο — this; masc. nom. sg., accented before the enclitic ποτε: ’this man’
glossary.πάντη: πάντῃ — on every side, in every direction; adv. (Ionic -η)
glossary.πέμψαιμι: πέμπω — send; aor. opt. 1 sg., potential with κε: ’I would send’
glossary.πήχει: πῆχυς — forearm; of a bow, perhaps the grip or bow-arm (sense debated); masc. dat. sg.
glossary.παρέκειτο: παράκειμαι — lie beside, lie near (+ dat.); impf. 3 sg.: ’lay beside’
glossary.πειρήσατο: πειράω (mid. πειράομαι) — try, test (+ gen.); aor. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented, Ionic η (= ἐπειράσατο): ’tried’
glossary.πειρώμενος: πειράω (mid. πειράομαι) — try, test; pres. part. mid. masc. nom. sg.: ’testing’
glossary.πιθήσεις: πιθέω (= πείθομαι) — obey, give way to (+ dat.); fut. 2 sg., epic η (= Attic πείσῃ): ’you will give way’
glossary.πλαγκτέ: πλαγκτός — wandering, straying; masc. voc. sg., in address: ’you roamer’
glossary.ποιησέμεν: ποιέω — make, do; fut. inf., epic -σέμεν (= Attic ποιήσειν): ’to make’
glossary.πρώτης: πρῶτος — first; fem. gen. sg., agreeing with στειλειῆς
glossary.σπουδῆς: σπουδή — haste, effort, exertion; fem. gen. sg., after ἄτερ: ’without effort’
glossary.στειλειῆς: στειλειή — socket of an axe-head, the hole for the haft; fem. gen. sg., Ionic (= Attic στειλειᾶς): ’haft-hole’
glossary.στυγερῶς: στυγερός — hateful, grim; adv. στυγερῶς: ’hatefully, grimly’
glossary.τίθεσθε: τίθημι — put, place; mid. make, hold (for oneself); pres. indic. mid. 2 pl.: ’you make’
glossary.τανύων: τανύω — stretch, string (a bow); pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’stringing’
glossary.τετυκέσθαι: τεύχω — make, make ready; aor. inf. mid./pass., epic reduplicated (τετυκεῖν): ’to be prepared’
glossary.τιτυσκόμενος: τιτύσκομαι — aim at, take aim; pres. part. mid. masc. nom. sg., reduplicated: ’aiming’
glossary.φάει: φάος (φῶς) — light; neut. dat. sg., epic (= Attic φωτί): ’in the light’
glossary.φάτιν: φάτις — talk, report, rumour; fem. acc. sg.: ’the talk’
glossary.φέρεις: φέρω — carry, bring; pres. 2 sg.: ’you carry’
glossary.φέρτερός: φέρτερος — stronger, better; masc. nom. sg., predicate, accented before the enclitic εἰμί: ’stronger’
glossary.φαίνων: φαίνω — show, bring to light; pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’showing’
glossary.φαρέτρης: φαρέτρη — quiver; fem. gen. sg., Ionic -ης (= Attic φαρέτρας)
glossary.φόρμιγγι: φόρμιγξ — lyre; fem. dat. sg.: ’lyre’ (with μολπῇ, ’song and dance and lyre’)
glossary.χαλεποῖο: χαλεπός — harsh, grievous; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -οῦ), agreeing with χόλοιο
glossary.χαλκοβαρής: χαλκοβαρής — heavy with bronze; masc. nom. sg., agreeing with ἰός: ’bronze-heavy’
glossary.χείρονες: χείρων — worse, inferior; comparative of κακός; masc. nom. pl.: ’worse’
glossary.χελιδόνι: χελιδών — swallow; fem. dat. sg., after εἰκέλη: ’to a swallow’
glossary.χερμαδίοισι: χερμάδιον — stone for throwing, hand-stone; neut. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις): ’with stones’
glossary.χορδήν: χορδή — string of gut; fem. acc. sg.: ’string’
glossary.χόλοιο: χόλος — anger, bile; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου), after μεθίημι
glossary.χώρῃ: χώρα (Ionic χώρη) — place, spot; fem. dat. sg., Ionic -ῃ (= Attic χώρᾳ)
glossary.ἀγαθοῦ: ἀγαθός — good, noble; masc. gen. sg., agreeing with πατρός
glossary.ἀγκυλομήτεω: ἀγκυλομήτης — of crooked cunning (exact sense uncertain); masc. gen. sg., epic -εω (= Attic -ου), epithet of Cronus
glossary.ἀμπερὲς: ἀμπερές — right through, straight through; adv.
glossary.ἀμφέθετο: ἀμφιτίθημι — put around; mid. put on oneself; aor. 3 sg. mid.: ’put on, girded on’
glossary.ἀναστρωφῶν: ἀναστρωφάω — turn about, turn over and over; pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg., contracted (from -άων): ’turning about’
glossary.ἀριστῆος: ἀριστεύς (ἀριστῆς) — best man, chief; masc. gen. sg., epic -ῆος (= Attic ἀριστέως): ’of a best man’
glossary.ἀτιμάζοντες: ἀτιμάζω — dishonour, treat with contempt; pres. part. act. masc. nom. pl.: ’dishonouring’
glossary.ἀχαιοῖσιν: Ἀχαιοί — the Achaeans, the Greeks; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οῖς)
glossary.ἄεισε: ἀείδω — sing; aor. 3 sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic ᾖσε): ’sang’
glossary.ἅψας: ἅπτω — fasten, attach, bind; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having fastened’
glossary.ἆλτο: ἅλλομαι — leap, spring; aor. 3 sg. mid., athematic, epic (= Attic ἥλατο): ’sprang’
glossary.ἐβάστασε: βαστάζω — lift, weigh in the hand, handle; aor. 3 sg.: ’weighed in his hand’
glossary.ἐγεγώνει: γεγωνέω — call aloud, shout; impf. 3 sg.: ’called aloud’
glossary.ἐθέλωμι: ἐθέλω — wish, be willing; pres. subj. 1 sg., epic -μι (= Attic ἐθέλω): ’I wish’
glossary.ἐλέγχεα: ἔλεγχος — reproach, disgrace; neut. nom./acc. pl., epic (Attic masc. ἔλεγχοι): ’reproaches’
glossary.ἐλέγχει: ἐλέγχω — put to shame, disgrace, reproach; pres. 3 sg.: ’puts to shame’
glossary.ἐντανύουσιν: ἐντανύω — stretch, string (a bow); pres. 3 pl.: ’they string’
glossary.ἐντανύσασθαι: ἐντανύω — stretch, string (a bow); aor. inf. mid.: ’to string’
glossary.ἐρέουσ: ἐρέω — will say, tell; fut. 3 pl., elided (ἐρέουσ’ = ἐρέουσι), uncontracted (= Attic ἐροῦσι): ’they will say’
glossary.ἐτράπετο: τρέπω — turn; aor. 3 sg. mid., strong aorist: ’turned, changed’
glossary.ἐϋκλεῖας: ἐϋκλεής — of good fame, well-famed; masc. acc. pl., contracted (= ἐϋκλεέας), subject of the inf. ἔμμεναι
glossary.ἐϋστρεφὲς: ἐΰστρεφής — well-twisted, firmly twisted; neut. acc. sg., agreeing with ἔντερον
glossary.ἑψιάασθαι: ἑψιάομαι — amuse oneself, play, make merry; pres. inf. mid., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἑψιᾶσθαι): ’to amuse ourselves’
glossary.ἔδοιεν: ἔδω (= ἐσθίω) — eat; pres. opt. 3 pl., in a fear clause after μή: ’might eat’
glossary.ἔκτυπε: κτυπέω — crash, resound, thunder; aor. 3 sg., strong aorist: ’thundered’
glossary.ἔμπαιος: ἔμπαιος — skilled in, versed in (+ gen.); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἔμπεδόν: ἔμπεδος — steady, firm, unshaken; neut. nom. sg., predicate with μένος
glossary.ἔντερον: ἔντερον — gut, intestine; neut. acc. sg.
glossary.ἕλκεν: ἕλκω — draw, pull; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented, ν-movable (= Attic εἷλκε): ’drew’
glossary.ἡμετέρου: ἡμέτερος — our; masc. gen. sg., agreeing with οἴκου
glossary.ἤλιδος: Ἦλις — Elis, region of the western Peloponnese; fem. gen. sg., after πρός
glossary.ἤμβροτε: ἁμαρτάνω — miss (+ gen.); aor. 3 sg., epic strong aorist (= Attic ἥμαρτε): ’missed’
glossary.ἤμβροτον: ἁμαρτάνω — miss (+ gen.); aor. 1 sg., epic strong aorist (= Attic ἥμαρτον): ’I missed’
glossary.ἰὸς: ἰός — arrow; masc. nom. sg. (not ἰός ’poison’)
glossary.ἱλήκῃσι: ἵλημι (ἱλήκω) — be gracious, propitious (+ dat.); pres. subj. 3 sg., epic -ῃσι (= Attic ἱλήκῃ): ’be gracious’
glossary.ἶπες: ἴψ — worm that eats horn; masc. nom. pl. (ἰπός): ’worms’
glossary.ὀνήσιος: ὄνησις — profit, benefit; fem. gen. sg., Ionic -ιος (= Attic ὀνήσεως), partitive with ἀντιάω: ’of profit’
glossary.ὀϊστὸν: ὀϊστός — arrow; masc. acc. sg. (= Attic ὀιστός)
glossary.ὀϊόμεθ: ὀΐομαι — suppose, think; pres. 1 pl. mid., elided (ὀϊόμεθ’ = ὀϊόμεθα; Attic οἰόμεθα): ’we suppose’
glossary.ὁμόκλεον: ὁμοκλέω — call out sharply, shout; impf. 3 pl., epic uncontracted and unaugmented (= Attic ὡμόκλουν): ’were shouting’
glossary.ὁπλότερός: ὁπλότερος — younger; comparative, masc. nom. sg., accented before the enclitic περ (= Attic νεώτερος)
glossary.ὄνονται: ὄνομαι — scorn, slight, find fault with; pres. 3 pl. mid.: ’they scorn’
glossary.ὅπλον: ὅπλον — tool, implement; of a ship, a rope or cable; neut. nom. sg.
glossary.ὠκὺν: ὠκύς — swift, quick; masc. acc. sg., agreeing with ὀϊστόν
